en: Our new ally may forge your sword, but on the battlefield, you'll wield it alone. A sharp blade is vital as a sharp mind — and to find strength from within, you need ample rest and shelter. Enjoy the comfort of a warm hearth whilst you can. Only then will you be ready for what lies below.
cn: 我们的新盟友为你锻造了锋利的武器，但是在战场上你仍然需要依靠自己的力量。锋利的剑刃就和锐利的头脑一样至关重要，为了唤醒内心的力量，你需要充足的休息与庇护。尽可能抓住机会享受温暖炉火的舒服。只有这样，你才能够为面对地下做好准备。

en: A versatile and durable material that is smooth to the touch. It also has the advantage of being waterproof.
cn: 拥有多种用途的牢固材料，触感柔滑，除此以外还有着防水的特点。

en:
A ripped piece of a wall tapestry. Find both missing pieces to reassemble the scenery!

Both pieces can be found in the Albaneve Summits.
cn:
一块被撕裂的挂毯的碎片。找到两块碎片以拼凑出完整的挂毯！

两块挂毯碎片都在阿尔班耶夫山脉中。

en: A dark concoction distilled from enemy remains. It unveils the writings of their kin and sharpens your blade against them. Enables you to read Drakian writings and grants you additional damage against them.
cn: 使用敌人的残骸蒸馏而成的黑暗混合物。这种药水能够揭示龙裔的文字并帮助你的武器对抗它们。 允许你阅读龙裔文字并使你能够对它们造成额外伤害。

en: Jumping with %k while gliding lifts you upwards. Can be used once per flight. Charge As the Updraft charges before activation, the resulting lift is increased. A full charge grants you an additional boost. The charge is accelerated while inside your base. Cost: 100 Mana
cn: 滑翔时使用%k跳跃将使你向上升起。每次飞行期间仅能发动1次。 充能 随着上升气流逐渐充能，发动后将能够提升更多高度。完全充能将能够额外提升高度。在基地中时将加快充能速度。 消耗：100点法力

en: A fearsome chest piece. It's rumored to have belonged to a fallen warrior whose name is never spoken out loud.
cn: 可怕的胸甲。据传，它属于一位不具名的阵亡战士。

en: A bow that aims to strike the heart of the dark with silver-tipped arrows and no hesitation.
cn: 这把弓将毫无犹豫地把银制箭头射入敌人的黑暗之心。

en: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.
cn: 白手起家，从一颗石头开始。

en: Investigate The Fourth Spot On The Shipment Route
cn: 调查货运路线上的第四个停靠点

en: The tusks remain dangerous since they don't dull after death. Never stumble!
cn: 虽然身体早死去，这些獠牙却依旧无比锐利。小心别被戳到！
浏览有关刺激不适的内容

en: This <craftingstation>Loom</craftingstation> will be a great addition. Strong thread, binding. Tight and reliable — like a bond forged in blood.
cn: 这个<craftingstation>织布机</craftingstation>一定能够派上大用场。强韧的丝线不会轻易断裂。紧密又牢固可靠，就像是在鲜血中铸就的纽带。

en: Thank you, Flameborn! We can do so much good with this <craftingstation>Almanac of Plants and Seedlings</craftingstation>!
cn: 谢谢，火之子！这本<craftingstation>植物与幼苗图鉴</craftingstation>一定能派上大用处！

en: The Flame has instructed you to create shelter that will allow you to become Rested between adventures. Being Rested will increase your Stamina and Stamina Regeneration temporarily. To become Rested, you must spend time in a warm and comfortable environment. You can add Comfort to your home through furniture and decoration. Additionally, you must be sheltered, sitting, or lying down. To create shelter, you must first craft a Workbench. Craft or obtain a Workbench to proceed! The Workbench recipe is available in your Manual Crafting tab.
cn: 灵火已经指示你建造庇护所，这么做将使你能够在冒险的间隙获得休息良好状态。休息良好状态将能够暂时提高你的体力以及体力恢复。 为了获得休息良好状态，你必须在温暖而且舒适的环境中逗留一段时间。你可以通过添加家具与装饰品来提高你的家园的舒适度。 除了舒适度以外，你还必须处于受到庇护、坐下或躺下的状态。为了创造庇护所，首先你必须先制作一个工作台。 制作或获取一个工作台以继续！ 你可以在手工制作界面中找到工作台的配方。

en:
We swore to protect our Queen and her lands, and to never let royal blood get spilled. Even now, over 20 years after her demise, that oath still binds us.

It's no surprise that not many of us are willing to spill Vorgoth's blood, it will cost us our titles. They call us dissenters because we refuse to look away. They say to raise the blade against royal blood is the death of honor, but what honor is there in apathy.

The island has cast us into exile. It's monastery will never open it's doors for us ever again, but we will not be silenced. We will not bow. We will protect what we believe in until the very end.

For the Queen we swore to. For the realm she loved.
cn:
我们当初发誓要保护女王与她的领土，不管要付出什么代价，绝不能让皇室的血脉遭受伤害。哪怕如今她已经逝去二十余载，我们仍然没有忘记那个誓言。

并没有多少人愿意反抗沃格斯，不过考虑到这么做将会使我们失去头衔，这也是情理之中。因为我们拒绝自欺欺人，他们便污蔑我们是是在蛊惑人心。他们说对皇室动武有悖荣誉，但袖手旁观更没有荣誉可言。

岛屿已经将我们放逐。那里的修道院大门将永远不会再为我们敞开，但是我们绝不会就此陷入沉默。我们绝不会屈服。我们将坚守信念直到最后一刻。

为了我们宣誓效忠的女王，为了她深爱的国度。

en: I can't stand out here without a roof over my head! Help and build me a shop, would ya?
cn: 这头上连个顶都没有像什么话呀！帮我造间工坊出来，好吗？

en:
You've reached the old lot that belonged to the Reed family. 

Look around and search for valuables!
cn:
你已经抵达里德家族的祖宅。

在附近寻找有用的物品！

en:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison. 

This variant can be found in the Springlands.
cn:
散发着光耀的能量旋涡，用于将宝石嵌入各类武器。

最初由远古者使用，之后又被瘴气魔据为己有并成为了怪物们的养料，直到最后才被你从有机物质的牢笼中解救出来。

可以在春日平原中找到这种形态的能量。

en: A lightweight, protective gel. Has properties of Fell magic. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Banshees, initially found in the Springlands.
cn: 一种轻盈如羽的保护凝胶。蕴含着瘴气魔的魔力。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于春日平原的瘴气魔女妖。

en:
A larger storage opportunity for bulk items.

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!
cn:
能够储存大量物品的大型容器。

你将可以在基地任意位置使用存放在这里面的物品进行制造！

en: A simple percussion instrument used to play music. The little chimes add a nice flair to any song.
cn: 构造简单的敲击乐器，能够用来演奏乐曲。小小的风铃能够在演奏时带来空灵的底蕴。

en:
The sun has burnt the leaves. What would have been fruit and grain last year is ash today. I'm the only person still able to cultivate the land (and barely so). I gave away the last rations, baked the last bread. No more water to make soup, or ale to serve. No more customers, only people in need... blinded and blistered by the sun.

Is this drought really an Ancient curse...? Did we fail them...? Anger them...? I can't let my faith waver... It's all I have left. 
— Emily Fray
cn:
灸烤的阳光已经将叶片灼伤。虽然去年的这个时候这里结满了各种果实与作物，但现在这里只剩下了一地灰烬。只剩下我一个人还在努力耕作（但说实话收效甚微）。我已经把最后的口粮送出去了，剩下来的所有谷物的也都烤成了面包。酒馆已经没有能够用来炖汤的饮用水，就连啤酒也是一滴不剩了。客人们已经全走光了，剩下来的就只有无法自理的难民……刺眼的光芒灼伤了他们的眼球与皮肤。

难道这次的干旱是远古者降下的诅咒……？是我们辜负了他们……？还是不知不觉间激怒了他们……？不，我必须坚定自己的信仰……这是我唯一剩下来的东西。
— 艾米丽·弗莱

en: A little companion lights your way.
cn: 这位小伙伴将帮助你照亮前路。

en: You've reached <location>Sapphire Strand</location>. Now search for the cat and tame it to proceed!
cn: 你已经抵达<location>蓝石湾</location>。寻找并驯服猫咪以继续！

en: Embervale has changed. Before our time, a race of Ancients built towers to survey the land... The Ancient Spires. One is close by. Climb it and discover the world anew!
cn: 薪谷已经样貌全非。在久远的过去，有一个名为远古者的种族在各地建造了俯瞰大地的高塔……也就是远古尖塔。这附近就有一座，爬上顶部之后，你就能发现不一样的世界了！

en: Sigil Ring of the Elder Guard
Thanks for gettin' those <craftingstation>Masonry Tools</craftingstation> for me, champ! Now let's get to crafting!
cn: 谢谢你帮我弄到<craftingstation>石匠工具</craftingstation>，朋友！现在咱们赶紧开始制作吧！

en: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!
cn: 被瘴气腐化的凶狠锤子。硕大的外形最适合用来砸碎害虫！

en: Increases the skill level of Shock Resistance
cn: 提高电击抗性的技能等级

en:
Grayish green hues combined with a dusty rose color.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
cn:
灰绿色与黯淡玫瑰色的组合。

可以使用春日平原材料制作这种调色板。

en: The undergrowth of the Revelwood hides madnesss within. The  Elixir's cradle, the root of the rot — the seed of insanity. A labyrinth of malady and disorder, nestled in the bosket's heart.
cn: 疯狂之物正潜伏在喧嚣森林的密林中。那里是魔药的摇篮，腐化的根须，癫狂的种子。疫病与混乱的迷宫就寄生在森林的深处。

en: When you kill an enemy with a magic weapon, all mana costs are ignored for 10 seconds.
cn: 使用魔法武器击杀敌人后无视所有法力消耗，持续10秒。

en: Increases the skill level of Silent Stride
cn: 提高无声步伐的技能等级

en: You've retrieved some bellows from inside the forge! They can be used to craft a blast furnace. Return to your base and craft a blast furnace with the bellows to proceed!
cn: 你已经从锻炉中取回了一些风箱！这些东西能够用来制作高炉。 返回基地并使用风箱制作一个高炉以继续！

en: Flameborn! You've got that spark... we share a passion, don't we? Architecture! Art! Graverobbing! Uh, I mean preserving forgotten beauty! It's rumored that our Queen was buried, although none know where, alongside her curios. She's got no use for 'em now. She's dead! Ha! So, why not go exploring?
cn: 火之子！你有那种才华......我们有共同的激情，不是吗？建筑艺术！艺术！盗墓！我是说 保存被遗忘的美好！据说我们的王后和她的古玩埋在一起，虽然没有人知道埋在哪里。她现在用不着它们了。她已经死了！哈！那么，为什么不去探险呢？

en: Screen Space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO) decides if objects cast secondary shadows, increasing the overall shadow quality. Disabling SSAO will increase performance.
cn: 屏幕空间环境遮蔽(SSAO)可决定物体是否投射二次阴影，从而提高整体阴影质量。禁用SSAO会提高性能。
黑铁瘴气魔幼龙战利品

en: A sweet candy alternative made from plant fiber. The sugar rush is known to regenerate stamina for a short amount of time.
cn: 使用植物纤维制作的另一种美味糖果。糖分冲击能够为你提供短暂的体力恢复效果。

en: You have not yet realized the power of your inner Fire. It connects you to a network of Flames and allows you to appear at Ancient Spires or Flame Altars in the blink of an eye. Travel to this Ancient Spire by opening the map and selecting its location.
cn: 你还没有发掘内心中的火焰的真正力量。它将允许你与灵火网络建立连接并在眨眼之间前往其他远古尖塔或者是灵火祭坛。前往远古尖塔，打开地图并选择对应地点。

en: A highly prized trophy of a Drak, recognizable by the large number of feathers with which it was adorned. Probably a reminiscence of a legendary battle, or a treacherous slaughter.
cn: 来自卓克的宝贵战利品，上面装饰着大量独特的羽毛。估计是来自某场传奇大战或者是残忍屠杀的纪念品。

en: A common ingredient with a smooth consistency. Needed for illumination of all sorts.
cn: 表面光滑的常见材料。被用于各类照明器具中。

en: Oh, flame-touched friend. I love your company, but at times, my days are lonely... won't you bring me a little companion?
cn: 哦，被灵火触碰的朋友啊。我热爱你的陪伴，但有时候我只能孑然一身……你愿意为我提供些许陪伴吗？

en: It's considered to be one of the most dangerous materials in the world! Touching it directly is usually not a good idea.
cn: 世上最危险的材料之一！请勿直接触摸。

en: Pick Up A Baby Common Goat
cn: 拾取一只普通山羊宝宝

en: Scholar of the Young Flame Set
You don't own this game on Steam!
cn: 你的Steam平台账户并未拥有这款游戏！

en: While there are three or more enemies within 20 meters, you receive %k increased Physical Resistance.
cn: 如果20米范围内存在至少三名敌人，你的物理抗性将提高%k。

en: The summits are harsh. You have to prepare yourself against the cold if you want to venture out far. You can make some warmer armor with warm padding kits, but a belly full of meat stew could also do the trick. If all else fails, a torch can provide warmth, too. Fire is your friend. The more options you use, the better.
cn: 山顶的环境异常恶劣。如果想要继续探索，你必须做好御寒准备。你可以使用温暖衬垫来制作更为暖和的护甲，除此以外分量充足的肉汤也可以为你提供温暖。在紧急情况下，火把也可以提供有限的温暖。火焰是你的朋友。记住未雨绸缪，有备无患。

en:
Visit the Barber to change your appearance. 

Once you've unlocked this color, you can use it on any server.
cn:
拜访理发师并改变你的外貌。

解锁后，你将可以在任意服务器上使用这种颜色。

en: Mh, to re-enter my music career, I'll need a bit more than inspiration! Sadly, I abandoned my old lute a long while back. Don't fret, I don't want it back! My spirit needs something new and fresh — a legendary handpan would work! Such a rare find can only be hidden inside a Drak temple! I've heard their haunting melodies from deep inside the thicket!
cn: 嗯，为了重振我的音乐事业，我需要一些比灵感更有用的东西！很遗憾，很久以前我弄丢了自己的旧鲁特琴。不用担心，我不需要那东西！我的灵魂需要一些全新的东西——一个传奇手碟应该就行了！像这样的稀有宝物只能够隐藏在一座卓克神殿中！我听说在灌木深处永远回荡着它们的鬼魅旋律！

en: I gave in to my suspicion tonight and slipped aboard the vessel. The soldiers had turned their backs, staring off into the distance, fixated on a point beyond the horizon... unmoving. It was the perfect time to strike. A dockmaster ought to know what passes through his harbor, no matter whose seal it bears, I say! So I snuck into the cargo hold, careful not to let the iron grate cover slip from my trembling hands. The air below smelled rotten. Infested. Could it be rats, or some dead stowaway? I covered my nose and mouth with a handkerchief and pressed on, making my way to the back of the hold where the crates were stacked. Once there, I broke one's seal and recoiled at the sight that revealed itself before me. The cases were not filled with grain or powder, but with some choking fog — sealed inside like a thing alive, pressing against its confines, rebelling. No markings, no warning. Just a pale mist festering on a bed of foul mushroom flesh. Does the Lord seek to spread a sickness to distant shores? My vessels should ship food and clothing, not a new form of warfare crueler than steel! I am resigning tomorrow... may the next sod bear witness to what comes next.
cn: 屈服于自己对这一切的怀疑，我决定今晚偷偷溜上船。士兵们都背对着甲板，他们凝视着地平线外某个看不见的位置……而且所有人都一动不动的。这是出手的最佳时机。 身为码头管理员，我永远知道如何悄无声息地穿过自己的港口，无论是谁下了封锁令！总之我偷偷潜入了货舱，并且小心翼翼地抵住了铁栅栏的盖子，以免它从我颤抖的手中滑落。下方的空气散发着腐烂的气味。那是感染的恶臭。难道是老鼠或者是某个偷渡客的尸体？我用一块手绢捂住了口鼻并继续前进，最后我终于来到了用于存放货箱的船舱深处。 我再一次打开了一个货箱的封印，眼前的景象让我彻底震惊。 箱子里装的并不是谷物或者是火药，而且某种令人窒息的浓雾——那些瘴气就像是拥有生命的货物一样抵在容器的墙壁上反抗着。没有任何标记和警告。就是一团徘徊在恶臭蘑菇的菌床上的苍白迷雾。 难道领主是想要向遥远的海岸散播瘟疫？我的船应该用来运送食物与衣服，而不是成为某种比钢铁还要残忍的战争工具！ 我明天就要提交辞呈……愿下一个倒霉蛋见证这一切的结果。

en: Much luck and prosperity to you.
cn: 愿好运与繁荣与你同在。

en: Repeated exposure to toxins has thickened your blood, weakening you significantly. You should ask the Alchemist about a cure to ensure this new ailment doesn't impact your vitality long-term.
cn: 反复接触毒素使得你的血液变得异常黏稠并让你的身体变得无比虚弱。 你应该询问炼金术士是否能够调配一种解药来应对这种新出现的病症，以免这种问题为你带来永久性的负面影响。

en: This entry cannot be edited anymore as the attached savegame is no longer available.
cn: 无法编辑条目，原因：关联的游戏存档已不可用。

en: I could be of great help to you with a room — a bed, some shelter — to craft my art. Perhaps you could build me some?
cn: 只要能得到一处房间的庇护，我的专长将为你所用。我只需要一张床以及一个合适的庇护所。也许你可以帮我建造？

en: If anyone dares to engage you in close combat, they'll get a taste of your wildly thrashing spiked shoulder pads. Your defense will be impenetrable, and the cuts you'll leave will be deep.
cn: 如果有人胆敢与你展开近战，他们将会领教到锐利无比的尖刺肩甲的厉害。你的防御无懈可击，你的攻击势如破竹。

en: Talk To Someone About Life And Renewal
cn: 与某人谈论生命与新生

en: A mace with a segmented body, reminiscent of a totem pole climbing towards the sky. The head is augmented with a stone crown that radiates outwards.
cn: 采用多段设计的钉锤，外形就像是一个朝着天空攀爬的图腾柱。钉锤头部加装有向外延伸的石冠。

en: You found a pretty ring after defeating a Fell Banshee. There's a Gemini symbol on the inside.
cn: 打败一只瘴气魔女妖后，你发现了一枚漂亮的戒指。戒指内侧刻有双子图案。

en:
An improved storage option with enhanced capacity.

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!
cn:
改良后的储藏容器，拥有更大的容量。

你将可以在基地任意位置使用存放在这里面的物品进行制造！

en: Weapons, shields, armors and rings can have different rarities. Salvage them in the inventory to receive Runes. Higher item rarity restores more Runes. Runes can be used by craftspeople and their assistants to enhance weapons, shields, armors and rings. Gear found beneath the Shroud is exceedingly rare and powerful.
cn: 武器、盾牌、护甲以及戒指有不同的稀有度。拆解物品栏中的装备可以得到符文。稀有度更高的物品将能够回收更多符文。符文可用于在工匠以及他们的助手那里强化武器、盾牌、护甲以及戒指。 在瘴气下找到的装备极为稀有和强大。
幕水盆地 空荡礼堂钥匙

en: Perhaps such bewildering and unusual implementation for my button causes more issues than anticipated. I thought locking my laboratory door this way would be useful, but my back pain tells me otherwise. Soot besmirches my feathers, and my spine aches. This was among my worse ideas.
cn: 也许当初我并不应该用这种异想天开的方式去利用我的按钮。我原以为通过这种方式锁上实验室大门会很有趣，但我现在只感觉腰酸背痛。 我现在背疼得不行，身上也被烟灰抹得一塌糊涂。只能怪我自己太傻。
焕然一新。耳目一新。万象更新。

en: I need a proper shop to smith in — only then I can craft the right equipment for your journey! Don't fret , it's not hard to build one.You'll need a Workbench, some building blocks and a Construction Hammer. Let's get to work!
cn: 没有“铺”还叫什么铁匠，有了干活的地方我才能为你打造合适的装备。别担心，那东西建造很方便。你需要一张工作台，一些建筑方块还有一个建筑锤。开工吧！

en: Heavy gloves, usually carried by bony or rotting ice-cold fingers.
cn: 这些沉重的手套里面往往隐藏着森森白骨或者是腐烂的冰冷手指。
圆形雕刻窗框木窗框（大）

en: Throw out the fishing line and wait for a fish to bite. Once a fish bit, quickly press %k to start reeling it in. Once you have a fish on the hook, you need to reduce the fish's stamina by steering against its movement with %k and %k. When a segment of its stamina is drained, you can pull the fish closer with %k. Deplete its stamina before your fishing line breaks!
cn: 抛竿并等待鱼上钩。当有鱼咬钩后，快速按%k开始收线。 有鱼上钩时，你需要朝其移动的反方向使用%k与%k来消耗鱼的体力。 当鱼的一段体力消耗殆尽，你就可以使用%k将鱼进一步拉近。 在鱼线断裂前彻底耗尽它的体力！

en: After defeating a Fell enemy with a Skillshot, your group gains an additional %k Experience Points. Skillshot Striking enemy weak points, such as heads or exposed hearts, is considered a Skillshot.
cn: 通过爆头射击打败瘴气魔敌人后，你的团队将获得额外%k点经验值。 爆头射击 打击敌人的弱点，例如头部或者是暴露在外的心脏都会被视为爆头射击。

en: Show The Barber A Calla Luna
cn: 向理发师展示一份月之莲

en:
A lonely gastropod, sitting peacefully on a rock. Descendants of this variant still populated Embervale's shores until recently. Their colorful shells and slippery mucus were crushed into the iridescent pigment used to dye cloth.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.
cn:
一只孤独的腹足动物，安详地坐在一块岩石上。直到最近，这种变种的后代仍在恩伯韦尔的海岸上栖息。它们五颜六色的贝壳和滑溜溜的粘液被碾成五彩缤纷的颜料，用来染布。

此收藏品在 喧嚣森林 中找到。

en: Weakens the effect of the Wet and Soaked debuffs. Stamina and Stamina Regeneration is reduced by 10% instead of 20%. Wet Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration. Soaked Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%. Soaked can be applied to enemies. Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.
cn: 削弱潮湿以及湿透的减益效果。 体力以及体力恢复降低10%而不是20%。 潮湿 体力与体力恢复降低30%，持续15分钟。温暖环境将能够缩短此效果的持续时间。 湿透 体力与体力恢复降低30%，持续30秒。同时使寒冰与电击抗性降低30%，但是火焰抗性将提高30%。 敌人也会进入湿透状态。 湿透的持续时间无法通过温暖环境缩短，并且等结束时将会变为潮湿减益。

en: An arrow enhanced with pieces of Fossilized Bone. Strikingly beautiful and deadly.
cn: 使用化石骨强化过的箭矢。美丽而又致命。

en: Talk To Someone About Envy And Immortality
cn: 与某人谈论嫉妒与不朽

en: An athletic-looking top made from vibrant fabric, held together by leather straps. The cropped cut lets you show off your physique!
cn: 使用鲜亮布料制作并通过皮带固定的运动员上装。简洁的外形将允许你尽情展现自己的身材！

en: We're proud to announce that we will host the annual gliding contest on Day 40 of Midyear, 502 D.A. again! As last time, the goal is to jump off the large wooden platform outside the sleeping quarters and glide in a slight curve towards the landing platform on the right-hand side. Don't miss those upstreams, or you won't reach the platform! The best glider gets a reward at the end! If you're up for the challenge, write your name below! Kip Dipper Ryan the Ragged "Lucky" Chester Loft Abraham Walz
cn: 我们骄傲地向大家宣布，我们将在岁中第40日，502 D.A.再次举办年度滑翔大赛！ 和上次一样，参赛选手们需要从休息区外的大型木制平台上一跃而下，然后沿着略有弧度的路线滑翔至右侧的着陆平台。 千万不要错过上升气流，这是抵达平台的唯一方法！表现最佳的滑翔者将在比赛结束后获得一份奖励！ 如果有兴趣参与挑战，请在下方留下你的名字！ 吉普·迪普尔 破烂佬莱恩 “幸运”切斯特·洛夫特 亚布拉罕·华尔兹

en: Defeating an enemy at night has a %k chance to spawn a Lunar Orb. Collecting a Lunar Orb grants %k Health and %k Mana aswell as a special food buff that grants %k max Health, %k max Mana, %k max Stamina and %k melee damage for %k.
cn: 在夜晚打败敌人时有%k几率生成1枚月亮球。收集月亮球将赋予%k生命值与%k法力，以及赋予%k最大生命值、%k最大法力、%k最大体力以及%k近战伤害的特殊食物增益，持续%k。

en: A wood block made from trees that died a long time ago. They are extremely common in areas of the Shroud. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 使用早已死去的树木制作的方块。在瘴气区域中极为常见的材料。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: Open The Night Door And Explore The Sanctum
cn: 打开黑夜之门并调查圣所

en: Set the quality of the Water Simulation. Lowering the quality improves performance.
cn: 设置水体模拟品质。降低品质能够改善性能表现。

en: A laced-up metal bodice that births a crinoline-esque cage. You shan't let these shackles fool you. No band, and no blood can manacle the wrath of the Blood Rose.
cn: 用交织丝带固定的紧身胸衣，宛如衬裙一般的金属牢笼。千万不要被这些枷锁给骗了。没有任何束缚或鲜血能够扼制血玫瑰的怒火。

en: Roasted ribs were a delicacy back in the day, providing a substantial amount of health to the consumer.
cn: 曾经广受好评的烤肋排，食用后提供大量生命值。

en: A few Well Blocks were found inside the Elixir Well. The <npc>Carpenter</npc> should be pleased.
cn: 魔药之井中存在着少量魔井方块。<npc>木匠</npc>应该会很满意。

en: Find Jezmina's Second Veilwater Basin Camp
cn: 找到杰兹米娜的第二处幕水盆地营地

en: A dagger set that was scavenged from the ruins of the old world. It's dirty and dusty, but still does the trick. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 从旧世界的废墟之中找到的匕首。虽然锈蚀严重而且沾满泥泞，但仍然锋利。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: You need to craft color palettes to colorize items.
cn: 如果要给物品染色，你需要先制作对应的调色板。

en: The Hydrak'Dal Head you've gathered can be used to upgrade the Flame. Gather all other materials necessary to complete the upgrade. Afterwards, you will be able to travel deeper into the Veilwater Basin.
cn: 你之前收集的海卓克·达尔头颅能够被用来升级灵火。 收集完成升级需要的其他材料。升级完毕后你将可以进入幕水盆地的更深处。

en: Backpack & Magic Chests in this Base
cn: 该基地中的背包&魔法箱

en: Starting A New Chapter, Midyear, 502 D.A.
A metal <keyitem>Kettle</keyitem> which can be suspended over a <craftingstation>Cooking Station</craftingstation>.
cn: 能够挂在<craftingstation>烹饪站</craftingstation>之上的金属<keyitem>烧水壶</keyitem>。

en: A useful item for watering thirsty flowers and plants.
cn: 用于浇灌干渴花朵与植物的有用物品。

en: Digging through the floorboards near the grindmill in <location>Willow Crush</location> uncovered remains. A ring was found amidst the ashes.
cn: 在<location>碎柳镇</location>，一具尸体从磨坊旁的地板下被挖了出来。残骸之中有一枚戒指。

en: Claudy, I dare you to join me for a little mischief! We're meeting at Skimmer's Cove tonight with June and Ricky to celebrate surviving this mess till yearfall, haha! We've got a "borrowed" lantern, a ladder for the wall, and a big dream of freedom! June's even bringing cake crumbs from the bakery, so you've gotta come along! I know how to get past the guards since last early midyear, so no worries there! Ricky says he's gonna yell real loud to rock the cove and scare the lizards! I think he won't dare, though. He's a chicken! I'll be at your window when the sun sets. Come join us! I dare you, I double dare you! OR: Tell Ricky you like him! You won't!! 'Cause you're a chicken as well!
cn: 克劳迪，敢不敢跟我一起搞个恶作剧！我们今晚计划去水兽湾与琼还有瑞奇见面，然后一起庆祝大家在这个混乱的局面中撑到了岁末，哈哈！。我们已经“借了”一个灯笼、爬墙用的梯子以及自由的美梦！琼甚至还从烘焙坊拿来了一些碎蛋糕，所以你一定得来！ 去年岁中刚开始的那段时间我就知道怎么绕开守卫了，所以不用担心！ 瑞奇说到时候他要朝着海湾用力大喊，到时候吓死那些蜥蜴！不过我觉得他不敢那么做，这家伙胆子可小了！ 等太阳下山，我会在你的窗外等你。一定要来！不来也行，那你得告诉瑞奇你喜欢他！我知道你不敢！！因为你也是个胆小鬼！

en:
A living shell to encase the wearer's face like an iron maiden.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
这种活体甲壳会像铁处女一样紧紧攀附穿戴者的面部。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: Flameborn — you survive like this? Unprotected? Build us some shelter! Then I can craft supplies for the hunt.
cn: 火之子，你平常也是住在这种毫无防护的环境里面吗？给我造一处庇护所！那样我就可以制作狩猎用的补给品。

en: Scales the amount of materials per loot stack.
cn: 调整每个战利品堆中的材料数量。

en: Wherever he fled — if at all — Gormander is alone. Or with another courtesan. The city is drenched. They've crushed our wall early morn and now coat our town with thick, suffocating nebula colored like ostrich feathers. I cower here — alone, for the first time in years. Like a little girl. My heart flutters like a thrashing, caged canary. I should have run away and chartered a ship. Seized it. I can fence and read a map, after all! Maybe it's not too late. I could still wake up to ocean blues and feel salt on my skin. See mermaids and sing at the docks, loudly, finally! I want to end in a storm, in a blaze, and not a lonely little tower! Don't laugh at me. I feel so small
cn: 就算他真的逃走了，那无论逃去了哪里，戈曼德都是孤身一人，或者最多也就是带上了一个妓女。 这座城市已经彻底被淹没。 清晨时分，他们彻底粉碎了我们的城墙，现在一切都被像鸵鸟羽毛一般密不透风而且让人窒息的深蓝色所吞没。此刻我正孤身一人蜷缩在这里，仿佛又重新变成了多年前的那个小女孩。 我的心就像是一只不停冲撞着牢笼的金丝雀一般怦怦直跳。我当初就该直接找船逃走。就算找不到也可以强行抢一艘，毕竟我并不是手无缚鸡之力，而且我还懂得看海图！也许现在还有机会。 我就能够在碧蓝汪洋的怀抱中醒来并感受咸味的海风吹拂我的肌肤。我将终于有机会一睹人鱼们在码头边纵情高歌的模样！我希望自己能够在风暴与激烈的火焰中走向尽头，而不是像这样孤身一人被困在小小的塔楼之中！ 请不要嘲笑我，此时此刻我感觉自己真的好渺小

en:
An inconspicuous moth ripped from its natural ecosystem to be used as an alchemic ingredient.

Can only be found at night in the fields of the Revelwood.
Can be used as fishing bait, most likely to catch uncommon fish.
cn:
从大自然的生态环境中被掳走的平凡飞蛾，炼金术原料。

只能够在深夜的喧嚣森林的田野间找到。
能够作为鱼饵使用，大大提高捕获罕见鱼类的概率。

en: The world is worth fighting for!
cn: 这个世界值得我们为之奋斗！

en: Melee weapon Critical Strike chance is increased by %k.
Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: Increases Stamina by %k per Attribute Point.

Log NR. 03
Last Fed: Friday, bones and scraps (didn't eat them)
Note: Looks pretty weird for a wolf, don't know if this is right. Keeps crying and barking at night. Just yell back, then it stops.
cn:
3号日志
最后喂食时间：周五，骨头与剩饭（没吃）
记录：感觉不太像正常的狼，不知道是不是生病了。晚上一直在嚎哭和吠叫。吼了它几句之后终于停下来了。

en: A building block that makes it easier to create harsh and visually enticing edges.
cn: 这种建筑方块很适合用于创造视觉上引人入胜的粗糙边缘。

en:
I'm starving
They want me to rot

Never sharing
Always pretending to care

My stomach is rumbling, and I cannot rest
Can't catch my breath... something sits inside my lungs, choking me

I need fresh fish
Fresh blood
But they won't ever share — She deserved it
And if you don't open up
Nils
I will come for you too
And I will get you like I got Harriot
cn:
我要饿死了
他们要让我自生自灭

从来不分享
总是在假装善良

我的肚子咕噜咕噜叫个不停，我根本睡不着
我喘不过气了……感觉肺里被什么东西堵住了

我需要新鲜的鱼
新鲜的血
但是他们不肯分享……她完全是活该
如果你不愿意
奈尔斯
那我就亲自来找你要
到时候你就会变得和哈略特一样

en: You've reached the location of the Gem Forge, but there are enemies nearby. Defeat the enemies inside the Gem Forge before taking a look around!
cn: 你已经抵达宝石锻炉的位置，但是附近存在敌人。打败宝石锻炉中的敌人，然后再开始调查！

en:
Nutritious Dune Armadillo food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
cn:
为农场中已经驯服的沙丘犰狳准备的营养饲料。

必须被放置在对应的喂食器中。

en: Stamina cost while climbing is reduced by %k.
cn: 攀爬时的体力消耗减少%k。

en: This armor set can be found in Veilwater Basin tombs.
cn: 可以在幕水盆地墓穴中找到这套护甲。
瘴气魔 混乱费洛蒙

en: A dark clay brick, dried in the sun.
cn: 在阳光下曝晒而成的深色黏土砖。

en:
A wearable floral wreath. Each sprig, bud, and leaf has been meticulously woven to create a blooming halo.
Whoever hand-crafted this did so with botanical knowledge and love.
cn:
戴在头上的花冠。每一根细枝嫩芽与叶片都经过了精心编制并构成了一道绽放的光环。
这件手工制品之中蕴含着深刻的自然知识与爱。

en: The obelisks we've studied so far indicate a formal writing system, consisting of logograms and syllabary, validating my hypothesis. Certain lexigraphs are repeated, hinting at a thematic consensus. Alternatively, a limited vocabulary. As per usual, I cannot decipher the language. I am disappointed but not surprised. — Loraine Crim, Yearwake, 505 D.A.
cn: 我们迄今为止调查过的方尖碑展现了一种正式的书面语言。与我最初的猜想一样，这种语言包含标点符号和音节。特定字形有反复出现，暗示里面存在连贯的主题。或者是有限的词汇量。 和以往一样，我尚无法破译这种语言的具体内容。说实话我有点失望，不过这也是在预料之中。 — 洛琳·克里姆，岁初，505 D.A.

en: Increases the skill level of Counter Battery
cn: 提高争锋相对的技能等级

en: I heard this story of a quiver that was always full, no matter how many arrows were drawn from it. Sometimes, there's a kernel of truth in the most fantastic tales, you know?
cn: 我曾经听说过一个永远不会用光的箭袋的故事，据说不管你抽出多少箭矢，里面永远都是满满当当。有时候，就算是最荒诞离奇的故事里面也隐藏着微妙的真相，你知道么？

en: Increases the skill level of Purification
All melee Blunt damage is increased by 20%.
cn: 所有近战钝击伤害增加20%。

en: Eternal Arrow: Eternal arrows do not deplete. Equip the eternal arrow and use mana to shoot it with a bow.
cn: 永恒之箭永恒之箭不会消耗。装备永恒之箭并使用法力用弓箭射出。

en: A straw puppet which is often mistaken for a creature from the Shroud when the sun has set.
cn: 用稻草扎成的人偶，到了晚上经常会被误认为是来自瘴气之中的怪物。

en: A soft velvet heart-shaped pillow, bringing not only comfort but a luxurious, elegant look to any space.
cn: 使用柔软天鹅绒制作的心脏枕头，不光能够带来舒适，还能够为任意空间营造一种奢华优雅的氛围。

en:
A large and slender sea lily, reaching up towards the surface and sky. If it had any sense of perception, it'd be able to judge the rise and fall of the sea, as well as the looming change in the waters.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
cn:
一朵巨大而纤细的海百合，伸向海面和天空。如果它有知觉的话，就能判断出海水的涨落以及迫在眉睫的变化。

此收藏品在 游牧高地 中找到。

en: By using Shroud magic, your Time in the Shroud is reduced by 5 minutes.
cn: 因为使用了瘴气魔法，你在瘴气中的停留时间已缩短5分钟。

en: Quickly dash to the rescue in these comfortable and snug boots!
cn: 穿上这双舒适贴身的靴子，快速冲向救援现场！

en:
The Barber thinks that your eyes are the windows to your soul. Luckily, you can discover new eye colors for customizing your appearance by finding inspiration and reading referential tales. New colors are added to the Barber's repertoire. 

Furthermore, the Barber claimed he once witnessed someone's eye color change. A former client of his allegedly had manic blue eyes after an accident at a cursed construction site. His eye color dulled once he recovered from the incident. 

The Barber insists that the site is haunted. Search for the construction site to find out more!
cn:
理发师觉得眼睛就是通往灵魂的窗户。幸运的是，你可以通过寻找灵感，或者是浏览相关传说来发现用于定制外貌的全新眼睛颜色。找到新配色之后，理发师将能够提供对应的选择。

除此以外，理发师宣称曾经亲眼看见某人的眼睛颜色发生改变。据说他以前的一位顾客在一处被诅咒的建筑工地遭遇意外之后，此人的眼睛就变成了代表疯狂的蓝色。但是等到顾客治愈意外带来的创伤之后，此人的眼睛颜色就变得温和淡化了起来。

理发师坚持认为那个地方有幽灵作祟。寻找理发师提到的建筑工地并调查此事！

en: Damaging an enemy puts a mark on them for %k. Marked enemies spawn a soul phial on death that can be destroyed to heal you and your allies for %k in a 5m radius and also counts as an enemy kill for other effects.
cn: 对一名敌人造成伤害将对其施加标记，持续%k。被标记的敌人在死亡时将掉落灵魂瓶，摧毁灵魂瓶将为你自己以及5米范围内的友军恢复%k，除此以外，摧毁灵魂瓶将能够触发其他“击杀”类效果。

en: Bright, blue eyes have something mystical, don't you think?
cn: 明亮的蓝色眼睛让人感觉很神秘，你说呢？

en: To all who used to fish in these waters: there is a blight further upstream. I have seen livestock and woodland creatures wash past in the rapids on occasion... however, yesterday I thought I'd hooked a large catch. When I reeled it in, it was a rotting corpse corrupted by some kind of blight, its skin and bones twisted and barely recognizable. As I stood there in shock, two more surfaced and floated by me. What kind of destruction is befalling these lands?
cn: 致这片水域的所有渔夫：上游发生了一场瘟疫。以前我有看见激流中飘浮着牲畜与森林野兽的尸体……昨天我原本以为自己钓上了一条大鱼。但是等我收线的时候，才发现那其实是一具被某种瘟疫感染的腐烂尸体，上面的血肉和骨骼都已经扭曲得不成样子。正当我站在那里手足无措的时候，我身边又漂过了两具浮尸。 难以想象这片大地正面临着什么样的灾难。

en: Blessed by the Flame and bathed in glorious light, these gloves will ensure that your every strike is guided by the Ancients themselves.
cn: 受到灵火祝福并且沐浴在荣耀的光芒下，这双手套将确保你的每一击都能得到远古者的指引。

en: An oval shield with a regal aura. When your enemies see your eyes peak up from the safety of the shield, they are merely seconds away from taking their last breath.
cn: 这块椭圆形盾牌散发着一种尊贵的气场。在牢固盾牌的守护下，你将能够游刃有余地迅速斩杀面前的敌人。

en: A beautiful mineral, usually found beneath the Shroud. Its color can range from a deep and saturated royal purple to a light, lavender hue.
cn: 一种美丽的矿物，通常能够在瘴气下方的区域找到。这种矿石拥有从鲜艳的深紫色到浅浅的薰衣草色等多种色彩。

en: Twisted and gnarled horns. They are infused with dense Shroud energy. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Thunderbrutes, initially found in the Springlands.
cn: 瘤节丛生的扭曲之角。里面蕴含着强大的瘴气能量。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于春日平原中的瘴气魔雷兽。

en: Save data error. Data could not be read.
cn: 存档数据错误。无法读取数据。

en: Dieter fares well, cease your prattle! He has shovel and fortitude, he'll be out of the mineshaft shortly. Perhaps he plays a prank on us, that scamp. Pray tell, did you put some provisions in there, Hans..? All the same, he'll survive. Aye, the chest was fine bait... though we had some need of it... fie, should have considered this before...
cn: 迪亚特好得很，别乱说话！他有铲子有力气，肯定要不了多久就能挖出井道。甚至说不定这一切都是他的恶作剧，毕竟那家伙老是这样不正经。 话说还有件事，你之前有在下面留些吃的吗，汉斯……？ 算了无所谓，他不会有事的。 嗯，那个箱子确实是不错的诱饵……不过说实话我们也需要那东西……唉，要是提前想到就不会有这事了……

en: Sick of me yet? Ha! What else, then?
cn: 受不了我了？哈哈！所以还有什么事？

en:
Tuō ní sū dǎ 

CorwLRoce
All thoughts are illusions.

Moxiyang
Long live Bohemian Rhapsody

Jing
Happy Everyday

Forest Legends
Nature is an art
cn:
托尼苏打

CorwLRoce
所思所想皆为虚妄。

沫汐阳
波西米亚狂想曲万岁

晶
开心每一天

l恕
大自然便是艺术

en:
A tiny frog. He could be your best friend if you didn't need to use him as fishbait. 

Found in the Veilwater Basin and especially helpful to catch epic fish.
cn:
一只小青蛙。如果不需要把他做成鱼饵的话，他也许能够成为你的好朋友。

能够在幕水盆地中找到，能够帮助你钓上史诗鱼。

en: Craft A Blast Furnace With The Bellows
cn: 使用风箱制作一个高炉

en: An eternal version of the Ice Bolt. The spell damages enemies upon impact and slows them afterwards. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 寒冰矢的永恒版本。该法术会在命中敌人时对其造成伤害，并使其减速。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: The Barber, Elio Ricci, allows you to change your appearance.
cn: 理发师埃里奥·里奇将允许你改变自己的外貌。

en: Protects the fingers from traps and cuts. A rogue's best friend!
cn: 保护手指抵御陷阱和割伤。游荡者最好的朋友

en: These gloves were patched together with two different fabrics. They re-create the look of "hooves".
cn: 使用两种不同的布料缝制而成的手套。看上去就像是你长了一对“蹄子”一样。

en: A mythical wand formed around a winding vertebrae core. It strikes with deadly precision. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 使用扭曲的椎骨制作的神秘魔棒。每一次的挥舞都带着致命的精准。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: The Flame senses a barrier, built by the elder Ancients, that inhibits its reach and vision. Whatever is hidden behind the barrier is invisible to the Flame — making it all the more interesting for you. Reach and investigate the dark barrier!
cn: 灵火感知到了一道由远古者长老建造的屏障，屏障的存在使得它无法洞察内部的情况。同样的，灵火也无法察觉隐藏在屏障背后的存在，这使得你的心中充满了好奇。 前往并调查黑暗屏障！

en: Max subscription count reached. Unsubscribe from a world to make space for new subscriptions.
cn: 已达到订阅数量上限。取消一个世界订阅以腾出空间来订阅新的世界。

en: The source of the dangerous Poison.
cn: 能够提炼出危险的毒素。

en: Increases the skill level of Barbarian's Path
cn: 提高野蛮人之道的技能等级

en: Black Is Your Absence, Dark Is My Night

6.1.7	
If Keen takes the aforementioned measures, Keen will notify the Uploader by an in-game pop-up screen. Keen will also inform the Uploader whether the world title led to the aforementioned measures. In the notice regarding the removal or blocking of User Content, the Uploader will also be informed that their Uploader's Platform ID may be blocked from uploading to Adventure Sharing as a possible measure for enforcing the provisions under Section 3.
cn:
6.1.7	
如果 Keen 采取了上述措施，会通过游戏内弹窗通知上传者。Keen 还将告知上传者是否由于世界标题导致了上述措施。在关于删除或屏蔽用户内容的通知中，上传者还将被告知：作为执行第 3 条下条款的一项可能措施，可能会禁止其上传者平台 ID 向冒险分享上传内容。

en:
Removes the Fell Curse upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.
cn:
使用时移除瘴气魔诅咒。

同时为使用者提供长达一小时的诅咒免疫加成。

en: All upgradable items from your backpack and action bar are listed here.
cn: 这里将列出你的背包与动作栏中的所有可升级物品。

en: With this new <craftingstation>Table Saw</craftingstation>, I'm just "buzzing" with new crafting ideas... you get it! Yes, I can operate it one-handed. It's fine!
cn: 有了这张崭新的<craftingstation>锯台</craftingstation>，我干起活来一定不遗“锯”细……懂我意思吧！不用担心，这种设备我单手就能操作！

en: A deadly club that will decimate any enemy.
cn: 能够摧毁一切敌人的致命棍棒。

en:
<lorename>Sameth</lorename>, your greed for the Elixir cannot be quenched! You keep it to yourself when you said you'd share! You LIAR!

We, your people, DIE for you in those tunnels! For what? We banish you from our midst! Go now — or we will show you the strength of our numbers! Find your Elixir somewhere else! This is OUR mine!
cn:
<lorename>赛姆斯</lorename>，你对于魔药的渴望实在是贪婪无度！之前你明明说会跟大家分享，却选择了独吞！你这个骗子！

有多少人在那些隧道里为你而死？到头来有任何意义？从今以后，我们和你一刀两断！赶紧滚吧，否则你将感受到我们的力量！去其他地方找你的魔药吧！这是我们的矿井！

en: The Hunter needs shelter to craft provisions and supplies. Build a home for the Huntress and grant her access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already! To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed. This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.
cn: 猎人需要庇护所才能制作各类补给品。为女猎人搭建一个家，并且确保她的周围有能够使用的受到庇护的床！ 若要为幸存者提供庇护所，首先请制作合适的床。将床放置在幸存者能够方便使用，且拥有良好保护的区域内。放置后，床将自动分配给附近没有床铺的幸存者。如果想要重新分配床，装备召唤法杖然后使用它瞄准床铺。 如果幸存者缺乏庇护，此任务将重新开启。

en:
When the silence of the night begins to envelop the mountains, you best not step outside into the dark. Terror hides where the light does not reach.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn:
当寂静的黑夜逐渐笼罩群山，最好还是不要闯入那黑暗。在光芒无法触及的地方，恐惧蠢蠢欲动。

可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en: Blue eyes can be deep like the ocean, or clear as the skies! I love the mysticism they exude!
cn: 蓝色的眼睛可以像大海一样深沉，但也可以像晴天一样清澈！我太爱蓝色散发的神秘感了！

en: The Ancient Spire, Beacons Of Light

cn: 瘴气魔独眼巨人战利品

en: It's a nice day for fishing, ain't it?
cn: 今天真是个钓鱼的好天气，你说呢？
罗伯特·吉布森需要帮助

en: Scales the time you can dive.
cn: 调整你能够潜水的时间。

en: Cleave through it all. Part the Shroud. Excise the tumor.
cn: 斩尽杀绝。劈开瘴气，铲除危害世界的毒瘤。

en: Embervale can still be saved... Where there's ash, there's embers, kid! The Shroud suffocates the valleys, so seek the Elixir Well with your new gear and raze the root of our misery! Ignite the depths and set this evil ablaze! Go on, I'm counting on ya, Flameborn!
cn: 薪谷还有救……我们将从灰烬中浴火重生，孩子！不过现在峡谷已经被瘴气笼罩，带着你的新装备找到魔药之井，铲除我们那些带来痛苦的根源！点燃深渊，让邪恶无所遁形！出发吧，我相信你，火之子！

en: Once, as a seamstress, I had quite the popular customer — the old Captain himself! I will never forget the dawn at which he stumbled through my open doors, beard not nearly as ashen as it is today, little more than a stained shirt on his body. "Morn', young lass!" He cawed with a hoarse voice, "I'd like a new coat! Deep blue as the sea, with gold and glamor, I'd say — hick!" While taking his measurements, I observed him closely. He smelled of wine and was missing not only his coat, but one shoe... When I asked him about it, he said: "Nay, the wine is half the story — See, as I was out late on the canal, an old devil born from the frothing blue called to me from below! He said he'd trade me a bottle of his finest for one button of my coat! A bottle for a button? I thought: Why not? But as I reached down to receive the wine, the impish creature pulled me in by my cufflinks and turned back seafoam! Hick! I went overboard, mayday, mayday! They had to fish me and my boat out — and my coat, it was gone with the waves! Hick!" I had his new jacket ready within three days, but I always wondered how his old clothes didn't wash ashore. Did they turn into seafoam, too?
cn: 曾经作为一名裁缝，我有一位备受欢迎的顾客——老船长本人！ 我永远不会忘记他跌跌撞撞走进我店门的那个清晨，那时候他的胡子还没有像现在这样灰白，他的身上只披了一件脏兮兮的衬衣。 “早上好，小姑娘！”他用沙哑的嗓音喊着，“我想要来件新的大衣！和大海一样深蓝，然后还要加上金色和华丽的风格 - 嗝！” 在给他量尺寸的时候，我抓住机会仔细观察着他。船长身上有一股浓重的葡萄酒味，而且他当时不光是没有穿外套，就连鞋子也少了一只……当我问起这件事的时候，他只是说： “不不不，葡萄酒只是一半的原因——是这样，当时我正在深夜的运河里，有一个诞生自蓝海白沫的古老恶魔竟然在水下呼唤着我！他说他愿意用一瓶最上等的美酒换我的大衣上的一枚纽扣！一枚纽扣换一瓶酒？我心里想着：有何不可？但是就当我伸手想去接酒瓶的时候，那个可恨的家伙突然拽住了我的袖口并直接逃回了水里！嗝！我直接就被扯下了船，有人落水，有人落水！最后他们总算把我和我的船给吊了上来——而我的外套，它已经跟海浪一起消失了！嗝！” 我在三天之后为他做好了新的夹克，但是我一直弄不明白，他的那件旧衣服怎么一直没有被冲上岸。难道那些布料也与那个水下恶魔一起变成了泡沫吗？

en: Increases the skill level of Fatal Precision
cn: 提高致命精准的技能等级

en:
The Halls have beckoned me for a long time. I've ignored their call in ages past, but now, I stand emboldened by the men behind me. Valiant, undaunted soldiers armed to the teeth. They said they'd follow me anywhere, into any dark, any depth. 

This cursed sanctuary shan't taint our peaks any longer. Do not fret, Brother. If we fall, we fall together.

I plan to return at first light — Should the sun rise without me, send aid.

Berhtolf, Firstborn of the Dimwealds
cn:
一直以来，礼堂都在呼唤着我。过去我一直努力忽视它们，但如今，追随在我身后的人们给我带来了勇气。这些英勇无畏的士兵都武装到了牙齿。他们说无论要面对什么样的黑暗与深渊，他们都将誓死追随我。

这座该死的圣所将不会再污染我们的山峰。不要害怕，兄弟。就算倒下，我们也将一同战至最后。

我计划将在黎明时返回，如果太阳升起时我还没有回来，请立即派遣增援。

巴索夫，迪姆维尔德家族长子

en:
6.1.3	
After the report has been submitted, the Reporting Person shall receive an acknowledgment of receipt of the report, via in-game pop-up or, if the report is submitted via customer support, by email.
cn:
6.1.3	
举报提交后，举报人将通过游戏内弹窗收到举报回执；若通过客户支持提交举报，则通过电子邮件接收回执。

en: A top-quality bow inspired by antlers. One might call it art.
cn: 形似鹿角的顶级之弓，足以被当成一份艺术品。

en: Fell Critter Queen, First: Revelwood Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔虫女王，首次出现：喧嚣森林瘴气区

en: The craft takes time! Rest up!
cn: 制作需要时间！你先休息一会儿！

en: It's true! The glowing Wisps are celebrating!! Dancing all jolly, gleefully under the waves! I saw them, yes! With my own eyes, I did! The lights danced at dawn, in the dark waters below... Gleaming from the deep... decades after Queen Pikemead's passing, no less!! People scoff and laugh, but I know what I saw. Is it a sign? Will she return? Can Embvervale reunite? Perhaps fortune smiles upon the world at last!
cn: 传说是真的！闪闪发光的精灵在庆祝着！！欢歌笑语，就在水面之下 我亲眼看见它们了，千真万确！ 黎明时分，光芒在幽暗的水域之下跳起了舞……水下最深处闪烁着光明……就在派克米德女王离去数十年之后！！ 虽然其他人对此嗤之以鼻，但我知道自己没看错。也许这是某种征兆？是女王要回来了吗？也许薪谷终于能够统一？也许这个世界终于迎来了转机！

en: Gleaming golden gloves were the mark of a Scholar in motion, swift of thought and radiant of heart.
cn: 这些闪闪发光的手套代表着学者们永不停歇的敏捷思维与赤诚之心。

en:
6.1.4	
Keen endeavors to maintain a safe and user-friendly environment in Enshrouded and Adventure Sharing. Depending on the nature and severity of a violation, Keen may take the following measures:
a)	Removing or blocking User Content.
b)	Temporarily blocking the Uploader's Platform ID from uploading for Adventure Sharing as a whole.
c)	Permanently blocking the Uploader's Platform ID from uploading for Adventure Sharing as a whole.
cn:
6.1.4	
Keen 竭力在 Enshrouded 和冒险分享中维持用户友好的安全环境。根据违规行为的性质和严重程度，Keen 可采取以下措施：
a)	删除或屏蔽用户内容。
b)	暂时全面禁止上传者的平台 ID 上传内容用于冒险分享。
c)	永久全面禁止上传者的平台 ID 上传内容用于冒险分享。

en: I can't stop thinking about this striking look the "Bony Fellows" have. So scary, yet so fascinating! I love how spooky it is!
cn: 我一直忘不了那些“瘦骨嶙峋的家伙”的惊人长相。恐怖但又充满魅力！我超喜欢那种可怕的氛围！

en:
This magical small chest offers increased storage space for items. 

The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!
cn:
这口充满魔力的小箱子能够提供更多物品储存空间。

你将可以在基地任意位置使用存放在这里面的物品进行制造！

en: Collect The Desert Shingle Roof Block
cn: 收集沙漠瓦片屋顶方块

en: Killing an enemy with blunt damage has a  %k chance to create homing bone shards that deal %k blunt damage, with a chance of spawning up to 4 projectiles.
cn: 使用钝击伤害击杀敌人将有%k几率创造追踪骨片，骨片会造成%k钝击伤害，有几率创造至多4枚投射物。

en:
I awoke to the smell of freshly spilled blood.
When I looked outside my bedroom window, I saw that some predator had dragged 2 Fae Deer from the northern wilds all the way to the village square. The kill looked effortless, but it certainly wasn't painless.

At first, I cried out in shock. But then the realization hit me: 2 Fae Deer. 8 rib portions. Maybe 10, 12 sausages. Blood pudding as dessert. Gallons of stew! This will feed the whole village, war or not. Thank the Ancients!
cn:
鲜血的气味唤醒了我。
当我往卧室窗外看去时，我看见某种捕食者将两头北方荒野的仙鹿拖到了城镇广场。看上去猎物们死得干净利落，但恐怕并不是没有痛苦。

一开始我吓了一跳，但很快我便意识到了：整整两头仙鹿。那可是等于8份肋排、10或者12根香肠。剩下来的还可以拿来做血肠点心。炖汤更是能做不知道多少份！不管是不是在打仗，这些肉绝对能喂饱整座村子。感谢远古者！

en: All incoming light fractures on the surface of this elegant blade, creating a dancing ensemble of floating colors. It is practically dripping with excellence.
cn: 这把优雅宝剑会折射所有落到剑身上的光线并创造出绚丽夺目的缤纷色彩。这可以说是一件非同凡响的宝物。

en:
6.1.1	
Keen does not carry out a general prior content review of User Content. However, inappropriate expressions in titles, descriptions, and in-game text are automatically filtered out immediately when displayed on the client by the Downloader using the word-filter libraries of the Platforms through which Enshrouded and Adventure Sharing are used. The filtering decision is made by the respective Platform based on its libraries. As such, Keen does not make its own substantive assessment in this regard. You may be able to adjust the filter settings individually on the respective Platform. If, after uploading, you notice that terms in your User Content have been filtered, you can adjust your User Content using the edit function. The word filter does not replace your obligation under Section 3.5 not to upload any Prohibited Content.
cn:
6.1.1	
Keen 不会对用户内容进行常规的事先内容审查。但是，标题、描述及游戏内文本中的不当表达，在使用 Enshrouded 和冒险分享功能所通过的平台所提供的词库进行过滤后，会在下载者的客户端显示时被立即自动滤除。过滤决定由各平台根据其词库作出。因此，Keen 对此不作实质性的评估。您或许可以在各平台上单独调整过滤设置。如果您在上传后发现用户内容中的某些词汇被过滤，可以使用编辑功能调整您的用户内容。该词汇过滤器并不免除您根据第 3.5 条所承担的不上传任何禁止内容的义务。

en: What is that...? That thing you carry. Mycelium? Flameborn, I advise you to be cautious. What you're holding is highly dangerous. It's a disease. It's suffering. It's a fungus that aims to devour our world... humans saw potential in the flesh of the plant, but they only brought calamity. Please, stay clear of the substance. It marks demise.
cn: 你带着的东西，那是什么……？难道是菌丝？火之子，还请千万小心。此物极度危险，只会带来瘟疫与痛苦。这种真菌存在的唯一目的就是吞噬我们的世界……曾经人类觊觎潜藏其中的潜力，但是最终只招来了灾厄。拜托了，不要碰那种东西。它们只会带来不幸。

en: Flameborn! My friend, there's something I need from you!
cn: 火之子！我的朋友，请你帮我一个忙！

en: Magical ammunition that sprays acid in a cone in front of the caster, poisoning all enemies hit. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 魔法弹药，使用时将朝施法者前方扇形区域喷洒酸液，对命中的所有敌人施加中毒。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: A pair of proper trousers. The metal delicate accents around the waist resemble the moon and the tide.
cn: 一条得体的长裤。裤腰处的金属装饰精致小巧，宛若日月星辰，引人注目。

en: This aquamarine is as clear as a crystalline lake under bright blue skies.
cn: 这块海蓝宝石像晴空下的水晶湖一样清澈。

en: Could not find content files. Please reinstall the game.
cn: 无法找到内容文件。请重新安装游戏。

en: A fish fillet seared over an open flame until lightly crisped on the outside, which increases its nutritional value.
cn: 在明火上烤得外焦里嫩的鱼排，能够提供更多营养价值。

en: There's not much time. Forgive my candor, brother. 1. Gormander poses no threat His capital is nearly defenseless. No signs of "Ancient weapons" or a conspiracy. The Elixir merely made his ilk plump and greedy, not bloodthirsty... though they've grown paranoid, like most. 2. We've been lied to That wanderer poisons the mind of our Lord. We cannot trust a word from his forked tongue. 3. Leave with me Abandon your post. Join me on my route down south. Turn your back on the war, the Shroud, the death. Wash your hands clean in more peaceful waters. 4. Discard this letter ...Lest you want your sister's blood spilled. — Athalan
cn: 时间不多了。请原谅我的唐突。 1.戈曼德不构成威胁 他的首都几乎毫无防备。没有任何“远古者武器”或者是阴谋的迹象。魔药只是让他的人变得臃肿贪婪，但是绝非嗜血……不过他们和大多数人一样变得偏执多疑。 2.我们被欺骗了 那个旅人已经毒害了我们的领主的心灵。那条毒蛇说的话一个字也不能信。 3.跟我走吧 离开你的岗位。和我一起去南方放下这场战争、迷雾还有死亡。在更平静的清水中洗净你的双手。 4.丢掉这封信 ……除非你想看见自己的姐妹血流成河。 ——阿萨兰

en:
The Collector's assistant wants to see a gem that rivals the moon's beauty. Such a thing might be found inside a Night Sanctum.

Visit the Night Sanctum marked on your map to obtain the gem!

If you're gifted the gem from your peers, the quest will also proceed!
cn:
收藏家的助手想要亲眼见证能够媲美月亮之美的宝石。这种东西只有在黑夜圣所能够找到。

拜访地图上标记的黑夜圣所并获取宝石！

如果你的其他同伴交付了宝石，该任务也能够同时推进！

en: Once upon a time, there lived a little princess with rosy cheeks and ashen hair, who loved nothing more than playing by the castle pond with her golden ball. One day, the ball slipped from her hands and sank beneath the water. Distraught, the princess wept until a voice croaked from the reeds: "Do not cry, little princess. I shall fetch your golden ball — for a kiss from your cherry lips!" The girl looked up to see a lumpy frog upon a lily pad. Though repulsed, she nodded, yearning for her treasure back. The creature dove in and returned with the ball — but once the princess reclaimed her toy, she fled into the castle without so much as a thank-you. That night, the frog came knocking on the gates. The king, upon hearing his daughter's promise, insisted she honor her word. But the princess proved reluctant evermore, and overcome by desperation, she threw the pest against a wall. As the pale green frog splattered against the bricks, the curse that bound him was broken, and he was freed from the shackles of his cold-blooded form. Born anew, he revealed himself to be a prince. And so, as is custom, the underage princess was wed to a grown stranger who had tricked her into a kiss — but he was quite handsome, so all was well.
cn: 曾经有一位拥有粉嫩脸颊与灰色头发的小公主，她最爱的莫过于在城堡的池塘旁用自己的金色小球玩耍。 有一天，金球不小心从她的手上滑落并沉入了池水之中。手足无措的公主放声大哭，直到芦苇荡中传来了一个声音： “不要哭泣，小公主，我可以帮你拿回金球——只要能够一亲你的芳泽！” 女孩抬起头，眼前的百合叶上赫然坐着一只臃肿的青蛙。尽管心中充满厌恶，但为了拿回自己的宝贝，公主还是不情愿地点了点头。青蛙立刻跳入水中并取回了金球——但是当公主拿回自己的玩具后，她便一溜烟跑回了城堡里面，甚至没有留下一声谢谢。 当天晚上，青蛙敲响了城堡的大门。得知女儿许下的承诺，国王要求公主履行自己的诺言。但是公主说什么也不肯，最后甚至气急败坏将那个讨人厌的害虫甩到了墙上。 当淡绿色的青蛙在石砖上摔得粉身碎骨，原本束缚着他的诅咒被意外解除了，他不再被囚禁于那个冷血动物的身躯中。新生的男人表示自己其实是一名王子。 于是乎，按照习俗，未成年的公主就被许配给了靠诡计骗得她的吻的陌生男子——不过好在男子足够英俊，也算是皆大欢喜。

en: Warmer and sturdier than simple cloth.
cn: 与布料相比更加温暖牢固。

en:
A feeding device that holds Hophare food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.
cn:
用于存放跳脚兔的饲料的喂食装置。

装满对应的食物后将喂食你的动物。

en: The map shows the location of the <npc>Hunter</npc> in an Ancient Vault. She is adept at ranged combat and survival.
cn: 地图显示了<npc>猎人</npc>所处的远古密室位置。她是一位远距离战斗与生存方面的专家。

en: The characteristic building material used inside the Hollow Halls. The originators of this architectural style are unknown and forgotten. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 原本被用于空荡礼堂内部的标志性建造材料。这种建筑风格的起源早已被人遗忘。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: Find all flame shrines and sanctums in the Albaneve Summits.
cn: 找到阿尔班耶夫山脉中的所有灵火神龛与神殿。
包装精美的礼品盒，仅供装饰用途。

en: The <npc>Blacksmith</npc> Oswald Anders crafts and upgrades armors and weapons.
cn: <npc>铁匠</npc>奥斯瓦尔德·安德斯能够制作和升级各类护甲与武器。

en: Hear me. I need a Tanning Station to preserve fur. Perhaps someone in the Nomad Highlands could have one. Preparing fur and leather is far easier in those sun-bleached lands... without the blizzards I'm used to. Maybe Hunters from the area would have a Tanning Station. Ask around for a lead!
cn: 有件事需要麻烦你。我需要制皮台来保存毛皮。也许游牧高地那会有这东西。我猜对于那些终日洒满阳光的土地来说，鞣制毛草与皮革应该不成问题……不像是我习惯的冰天雪地。也许那里的猎人会有制皮台。能不能帮我去打听一下？

en: A mace that easily cleaves through foes like a pack of starving wolves.
cn: 能够像饿狼扑食一般打倒敌人的钉锤。

en: My hands are tied without some <keyitem>Scientific Instruments</keyitem>!
cn: 没有<keyitem>科研设备</keyitem>的话，我什么也做不了！

en: Gold coins, ideal for bedazzling, boasting, and bribing.
cn: 适合挪用、炫耀与贿赂的金币。

en: An epic drum with finely painted blue lines on it. The pattern on top resembles a symmetrical star.
cn: 表面拥有精心绘制的蓝色线条的史诗鼓。顶部的图案会让人联想到对称的星星。

en: Sodden boots that strode through the knee-high snow of Albaneve Summits under foreboding northern lights. After marching through countless midnight hours, Lord <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename> finally reached the gates of <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>, weapon raised high.
cn: 在充满不详意味的极光之下，这些沾满泥泞的靴子曾在阿尔班耶夫山脉齐膝深的积雪中艰难前进。经历了无数深夜跋涉之后，高举武器的<lorename>沃格斯</lorename>领主终于来到了<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>门前。

en: Dingo the Smug Beloved camp mom Lelldon Drowned in clutter Sereene Maker of Silly Villages Galaxy Lychita One grain of sand, one world. Ella Lapêche Didn’t stick the landing.
cn: Dingo the Smug 挚爱的营地母亲 Lelldon 被杂物所淹没 Sereene 傻乎乎村庄创始人 Galaxy Lychita 一粒尘埃，一个世界。 Ella Lapêche 很遗憾着陆失败。

en: Very simple fishing bait made out of Critter Parts. Can be used to catch common fish, but not many will like the taste of that one.
cn: 使用甲虫部位制作的简易鱼饵。能够用于捕获常见鱼，只有极少的鱼会喜欢这种鱼饵。

en: All Fell enemies within %k meters take %k Fire damage per Intelligence per second.
cn: %k米范围内的所有瘴气魔敌人每秒承受等同于智力的%k火焰伤害。

en: Reach The City Behind The Mountain Range
Scales the speed of production for workshop items.
cn: 调整工坊物品的生产时间。

en: This collectible is found in the Springlands.
cn: 此收藏品在 春日平原 中找到。

en: This is a showcase for Hollow Artifact Collection Items usually found in the Hollow Halls.
cn: 一个展示柜，用于存放空荡礼堂中常见的空荡工艺品藏品。

en: A strong, herbal tea. It increases your mana and stamina.
cn: 一份强效草药茶。提高你的法力与体力。

en: Find The Highly Polished Stone Blocks

cn: 找到所有卓克浮雕碎片

en: Adjust the frequency of harsh weather occurrences.
cn: 调整恶劣天气的发生频率。

en: Fall damage is halved. Climbing speed for walls and ladders is doubled.
cn: 坠落伤害减半。攀爬墙面与梯子的速度加倍。

en:
The liquified essence of the Shroud, harvested from enshrouded growths of the Springlands biome.

The brown fluid emits a violet vapor and is used for many powerful alchemical purposes.
cn:
瘴气的液化精华，采自春日平原环境中被瘴气侵蚀的植物。

棕色液体散发出紫色蒸汽，可用于多种强大的炼金术。

en:
Notes from the researcher <lorename>Loraine Crim</lorename> detail the location of obelisks in the Revelwood, Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes.

Read the obelisk in the Nomad Highlands to proceed!

Read all the above-mentioned obelisks to finish the quest!
cn:
研究者<lorename>洛琳·克里姆</lorename>的笔记详细记载了喧嚣森林，游牧高地以及燃火荒原中的方尖碑位置。

查看游牧高地中的方尖碑以推进任务！

en:
The light and dark facets of polished rock. Together, they remind of stone masonry, or more tragically, graveyard sculptures.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
cn:
抛光石材的暗面与亮面。两者的组合让人想起了精美的宏伟石楼，或者是散发着悲剧气息的陵墓雕塑。

可以使用春日平原材料制作这种调色板。

en: Dear little Brother: Calm your heart — I'm safe and sound. The border between Rimgard and Meldore had plenty of openings to sneak through. I made it out of Veilwater and reached the Revelwood before my comrades even knew I was gone. Lord Vorgoth has gone mad, Talion. His mind has fallen to the Shroud, infected by that Wanderer's whispers! He lied to us. King Gormander is no threat! I can't fight for this, and my scars are proof of that. I wear them with pride, knowing I did the right thing. Please come. Wave the war goodbye. Turn your back on all this. I miss you, munchkin. — Athalan
cn: 亲爱的弟弟：请不用担心，我没有事。里姆加德与梅尔多尔之剑的边境有很多能够悄悄穿越的漏洞。我设法逃出了幕水，并且赶在那些战友们反应过来之前到了喧嚣森林。 塔里昂，沃格斯领主已经彻底疯了！他的心智已经被旅人的低语中裹挟的瘴气控制！他骗了我们。戈曼德国王根本不是我们的威胁！我拒绝参与这种战争，我身上的伤疤就是证明。我绝不会掩盖这些伤痕，因为它们证明了我做的是对的。 来找我吧。不要再理会这场战争。是时候该退出了。 我想你了，矮冬瓜。 — 阿萨兰

en: Increases the skill level of Vile Concoction
cn: 提高阴险调和物的技能等级

en: A building block made from polished marble. It's as dark as the night sky.
cn: 使用抛光大理石制作的建筑方块。和夜空一样黑暗。

en: Embervale has fallen, consumed by the "Shroud". Bring back the light and reclaim the land by establishing a Flame Altar in the wilds! A promising site to establish a Flame Altar is marked on your map. Reach the location to proceed.
cn:
薪谷已被“瘴气”吞噬。在荒野中建立灵火祭坛，让光明重回大地！

您的地图上标出了有望建立灵火祭坛的地点。到达该地点后继续前进。

en: <lorename>Gormander</lorename>'s Treasure is rumored to have been buried somewhere in the Imperial Gardens of <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>. Find it!
cn: 据说<lorename>戈曼德</lorename>的宝藏就被埋在了<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>的帝国园林中。快去找！

en: Enhancing an item unlocks new perks.
cn: 强化物品以解锁全新特性。

en: A sturdy helmet that protects the wearer from slashes, cuts, and scars.
cn: 坚固的头盔可以保护佩戴者抵御刀砍、切割和疤痕。

en: Select the shape you want to build with.
Your attacks apply a poisoned debuff to enemies.
cn: 你的攻击将对敌人施加中毒减益效果。

en: Your shots will always find their mark with these gloves.
cn: 有了这双手套，你的箭就永远能命中目标。

en: My brother, all hope seems lost for me. The nurse, Helên, says there's nothing for me to do but rest... But I won't have it. The people of the Kindlewastes speak of the Ancients as if they're all-mighty. Do you recall the obelisk? That Ancient monument that captured our childish minds so, so long ago? I will make my way there, no matter what. Perhaps there's a cure for me yet. Do not follow — you can't stop me. — Vettel
cn: 我的兄弟，我似乎已经真正到了无药可救的地步。护士海伦说我现在能做的就是好好休息然后等待……但是我拒绝接受这种事。 燃火荒原的当地人说过远古者神通广大。还记得那个方尖碑吗？当我们还是孩子的时候，那个远古者的纪念碑给我们留下了深刻的印象，这么一想都已经是那么久之前的事了？ 我决定接下来要去那里。 也许那里能找到治好我的方法。不要跟过来，我心意已决。 —维特尔

en: Use the Flame to change your Skills and refund your Skills Points.
cn: 使用灵火调整技能并返还技能点。

en:
8.2.1	
Keen shall have unlimited liability for intent and gross negligence, as well as for damages arising from injury to life, body, or health.
cn:
8.2.1	
对于故意或重大过失行为，以及因造成生命、身体或健康损害而产生的损害赔偿，Keen 承担无限责任。

en: Warm, light, and agile. This piece of armor is a great fit for adventurers! The red scarf is especially daring.
cn: 保暖、轻便、灵活。这件护甲非常适合冒险者！红色围巾尤其亮眼。

en: The Carpenter borrowed the Blacksmith's chest. He took it to an old campsite to finish some projects.
cn: 原来是木匠借走了铁匠的箱子。他想要完成一些项目，所以就把箱子带到了一处旧营地。

en: Archaic power sleeps within this blade. It resonates, whispers and sings to those who dare to listen.
cn: 远古的力量正在这柄利刃中沉睡。当感应到愿意勇敢倾听之人，它便会在共鸣中低语吟唱。

en: The realm has fallen, consumed by the Shroud. The old world lies in ruin. You have been awakened by the enduring Flame. There is much to learn, child. Go forth.
cn: 王国已经陷入瘴气的魔爪。旧世界只剩下残垣断壁。现在你被永恒的灵火重新唤醒。你有很多要学的，孩子。前进吧。

en: A Bright Light In The Sky

The wild spirit of the Blackmire remains untamed. 

Winding roots entangle us, twist around all efforts of our kin. Everything fades into the sounds of the night, a symphony of sweet and somber melodies. 

We drown in them like bugs in the blackwater bog, dragged below by the vines. Such unbound energy, shining bright like the stars.
cn:
黑沼的狂野灵魂依旧无拘无束。

蔓延的根须禁锢着我们，它们扭曲了我们的同胞所做出的的一切努力。万物都坠入了暗夜的声音，那是甜美又肃穆的交响乐。

我们沉浸其中，就像是黑水沼泽中的蚊蝇，一步步被藤蔓拉入深渊。肆意奔放的能量，就像是星辰一般闪耀。

en: Ah, you've brought some spicy herbal tea with you. The color is... familiar. What is that? Saff- no, don't tell me. Saffron, the bright red spice, of course! Mhhh... bright red, huh? That sounds like a lovely new color to make! Oh, thank the stars! And you, of course! Take the tea and sit down in my salon chair! You should enjoy the flavors as I work my color magic on you!
cn: 啊，你给我带来了香料茶。这个颜色……倒是很熟悉。是什么？藏……不，别提醒我。藏红花，亮红色的香料！嗯……亮红色？听起来像是我在寻找的新色彩！哦，感谢群星！还有你！快端上茶，然后坐在我的沙龙椅子上！好好享受美味的茶饮吧，我将对你的头发施展不可思议的魔力！

en: I'm Not Cut Out For This

A magical staff, utilizing the power of darkness to cast stronger magic spells. A mighty tool feared by every sorcerer. Staffs can cast spells by using spell charges and mana. Equip spell charges to cast.
cn: 这柄蕴含着黑暗之力的法杖能够施放更为强大的法术。这是一种让所有术士都感到敬畏有加的强大工具。 法杖能够通过消耗法术充能与法力施放法术。装备法术充能以施放法术。

en: The edge of these daggers is shaped like the beak of a soaring eagle, willing to strike down toward its enemies. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 这套匕首的刀刃就像是遨游天际的雄鹰之喙一样锐利，随时能够扑向自己的敌人。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Ahhh, I feel refreshed! Sort of like I slept for ages! Oh, my name is Anton Godwin! It's good to meet you, my new friend!
cn: 啊，我感觉焕然一新！就像是睡了好几年一样！哦，对了，我是安东·戈德温！很高兴认识你，我的新朋友！

en: Is that one of my aunts I see? Fantastic! Marvelous! And not just any aunt - Braelyn, my favorite! Thank you, Flameborn! When I tasked you to search for my family, I was half joking!
cn: 那是我的姑姑吗？太棒了！干得好！而且还是我最喜欢的布莱林姑姑！谢谢你，火之子！说实话之前拜托你去寻找我的家人，我原以为这事不可能成功！

en: In A World Destined for Ruin
Trousers that were made from a very stiff material.
cn: 用非常硬的材料制成的裤子。
编辑现有自定义控制方案

en:
You've reached the spooky tomb. Inside are the scattered pieces of a frightening cosmetic armor set!

Investigate the inside to reclaim all the pieces! There are 5 in total.
cn:
你找到了恐怖墓穴。里面散落着一套恐怖的盔甲外观物品！

调查内部以拿走所有套装部件！总共有5个部件。

en: Increases the damage multiplier of Merciless Attacks by %k.

You've reached the city by the lake. A part of the port has been swallowed by the Shroud, but a keen eye can spot the tip of a lighthouse not far away.

Reach the lighthouse and search the inside for a new source of wisdom!
cn:
你已经抵达了湖畔的城市。这里的港口的一部分已经被瘴气吞没，但是只需要稍加观察就能发现不远处的灯塔。

抵达灯塔并在其中寻找新的智慧来源！

en: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the floor.
cn: 这个排水口会移除其上方的任意水体。能够放置在地板上。

en:
You've found a note saying that the owner of a house in <location>Sapphire Strand</location> planned on adding a shingle-rooftop. Since his partner was against it, the Building Blocks still have to be around there somewhere.

Search for the Desert Shingle Roof Block.
cn:
根据你找到的一张纸条，<location>蓝石湾</location>中的一栋房子的主人原本打算添加一层瓦片顶屋顶。但是因为遭到伴侣反对，准备好的建筑方块仍然原封不动地存放在某个位置。

寻找沙漠瓦片屋顶方块。

en: The faded cool hue of these pants provides stark contrast to the flaming accents on the rest of the armor set.
cn: 这些裤子上黯淡的冷色调与护甲套装其他部分的火焰主题形成了鲜明对比。

en: Ahh... so many souls... so little time... If I only had a fellow shepherd to aid me. Someone whose life and face have washed away, a shell I can fill — an all too human lump of clay I can re-shape. I can sense it: It's lingering in the interim between this world and the next. Bring it here!
cn: 啊……那么多的灵魂……那么少的时间……如果有一位亲爱的牧羊人能够帮助我。一个过去的人生与面孔都已经洗刷掉，一具可以让我填满的空壳……一块能够任由我重新塑造的人形黏土。我已经感应到了：它就徘徊在这个世界与彼界的间隙之中。快把它带来这里！

en: "Morwenna" would be as quiet and peaceful as my late aunt, I imagine... if it weren't for those pests! They gnaw at everything I build! From barn to edifice, monument to manor... ripped to shreds by wild beasts! It's as if they're laughing at my artistry! They weren't always so ferocious. Forced to leave their natural habitats, maybe? Is it this spreading blight people whisper about? Aunt Irvetta says they seem "scared" more than anything. Back then, I couldn't see her point... which she blamed on my one remaining eye. I did not find this jest to be funny. I planned to name a town after you, too, dear Irvetta. Once. Now, perhaps I'd consider a village. Maybe a hamlet. Or a hovel. You're my least favorite aunt for a reason, Irvetta! Cade Hawthorn, 500 D.A.
cn: “莫文纳”本应该会是个和我故去的姑姑那样静谧祥和的地方……都怪那些害虫！ 这些家伙从未放过我造的任何东西！不管是谷仓还是高楼，纪念碑或者是豪宅……统统被那些野兽给撕成了碎片！我甚至感觉它们是故意在嘲笑我的作品！ 以前野兽们并没有如此凶猛。也许是因为被迫离开了天然栖息地才让它们如此暴躁？也许是因为大家提到的瘟疫？艾薇塔姑姑说野兽们都很“害怕“。那时候我并不明白她的意思……而她则指责说这是因为我比正常人少了只眼睛。我并不认为这种玩笑有趣。 亲爱的艾薇塔，曾经我打算用你的名字给一座城镇取名。但现在我最多愿意给你一座村庄，或者是小村落，就算是茅草屋也不为过。 你是我最不喜欢的姑姑，而且这完全是你咎由自取，艾薇塔！ 卡迪·霍桑，500 D.A.

en: For Crew & Loaders INCOMING / OUTGOING CARGO: Princess Sue (ETA: Tuesday) - Load 12 crates (nails & lumber) from Left-Hand Storage Room Dainty Beluga (Arriving Today – Short Layover) - Transfer grain sacks directly upon arrival Oceanwasp (ETA: Unknown) - Small vessel. Special Order: 1x Handpan – Currently on elevator platform (Note: Platform stuck again – maintenance needed ASAP) Gormander's Seascaper (Awaiting arrival – date TBD) - Needs, and I quote: "As many coffee beans as the damn thing will hold – I have a kingdom to run here!" - Additional materials to be stored until arrival. Right-Hand Storage Room. - Dave & Darrel assigned to storage handling NOTE: Anyone seen Dave or Darrel lately? They’re supposed to be managing storage, but haven’t been spotted on the dock in days. If found, send ‘em our way. – Dock Office
cn: 给船员&装卸工 进/出货物： 苏公主号（预计时间：周二） - 装载从左侧仓库送来的12个货箱（钉子&木材） 娇小白鲸号（今日抵达 - 中转时间短） - 抵达后立即转移谷物袋 海蜂号（预计时间：未知） - 小型船只。特别订单：1x手碟 - 目前正存放在升降平台（注：平台又卡住了 - 急需维护） 戈曼德海景号（等待抵达 - 日期待定） - 需要，以下是原话：“把这艘船上的每一个货仓都装得水泄不通的咖啡豆 - 我的王国需要这些东西！” - 在船只抵港前先行储存所有材料。右侧仓库。 - 已安排大卫&戴瑞尔处理仓储事宜 注： 最近有人看见大卫或戴瑞尔吗？他们本该负责管理仓库，但是港口里已经好几天没人看见过他们了。如果找到这两个家伙，请叫他们立刻来报告。 - 港口办公室
提高在瘴气中的停留时间。

en: This server has unlocked the crafting recipe for this terrain material. Craft or obtain the material to complete your set!
cn: 当前服务器已解锁这种地形材料的制作配方。 制作或获取地形材料以完成你的套装！

en:
Gather 'round, we're drinkin'! An ode to the Queen, once young! 
3 babes on 'er arm, cup filled to the brim
Thinkin' out loud, she'd sung: 

Rather mead in my cup, 
or my cup filled with rum
drink too much,
rather than be done!

Can't only have some,
So share some around,
drink too much,
rather than drink one!

Rather mead in my head,
and my head on the run
Than my head on a pike
with none!

Get the rum, and the mead
Get the mead, in the cup
Get the cup to your head
drink up!
cn:
一起来，畅饮酒！此歌敬女王，曾经颜如花！
一手抱三娃，一手持满杯
斟酌片刻她便唱：

杯中蜜酒好，
朗姆酒亦佳，
要喝就尽兴，
莫要半吊子！

喝酒莫吝啬，
伴友齐分享，
要喝就尽兴，
莫要三口倒！

口中蜜酒香，
双眼直打转，
沙场不如酒场爽！

先朗姆，再蜜酒，
杯中尽是好蜜酒，
举起酒杯对准嘴，
喝！

en: Your last fight against the Fell left you scarred. You cannot grasp the situation yet, but whenever you enter the Shroud, the choking fog suffocates you much quicker. You should ask the Alchemist about a cure to ensure this new ailment doesn't impact your vitality long-term.
cn: 之前与瘴气魔的战斗为你带来了后遗症。虽然你无法理解这是怎么一回事，但是每次进入瘴气之后，你感觉自己很快便会在无处不在的迷雾中窒息。 你应该询问炼金术士是否能够调配一种解药来应对这种新出现的病症，以免这种问题为你带来永久性的负面影响。

en: Lately, I can't help but wonder... the Vukah were always somber beasts — bound to their caves. But they've been traveling east, aggravated... Perhaps this warrants an investigation. Maybe at their gathering location, you can find some answers. It would help to know what they're up to...
cn: 最近我一直在想……沃卡一直都是居住在洞窟中的温顺野兽。但是我发现它们正在往东部前进，而且都非常狂躁……也许我们应该去调查这件事。说不定你能够在它们的聚集地点找到答案。我们得弄清楚这到底是怎么一回事……

en: This server has unlocked the crafting recipe for this building block. Craft or obtain the block to complete your set! Blocks can be crafted at the workbench.
cn: 当前服务器已解锁这种建筑方块的制作配方。 制作或获取方块以完成你的套装！你可以在工作台制作方块。

en: Investigate the second stop on Kaori's shipment's route to find the next hat!
cn: 调查嘉里的货运路线上的第二个停靠点以寻找下一顶帽子！
将建造区域扩展至75米x75米。

en: An explosive mine, that explodes upon touch from friend or foe. Better handled with care.
cn: 一枚爆炸地雷，无论敌友一接触就会起爆。处理时千万要小心。

en: A Regular Sandstone Block. It's very cost-efficient.
cn: 造价低廉的普通砂岩方块。

en: You are currently repeating a World Quest. Some map markers won't be visible until you discover them or leave the personal progression mode.
cn: 你目前正在重复执行一项世界任务。在你自行探索或者是离开个人进度模式之前，部分地图标记将维持隐藏状态。

en: Thrust yourself into battle and glory with the protection of this shield!
cn: 身先士卒，凭借盾牌的守护斩获荣耀！

en:
My suspicions about Helga are correct – she has been unfaithful. And with Rodrick, that buffoon of a criminal! 

They aim to take my fortune, so I will lead Helga into a trap. I placed an advert in The Pike Weekly, imploring her to meet for a drink in the private chambers of the boarding house where we first met. There she will find what she cannot resist: a cup of wine laced with poison. I shall be done with that wretched woman!
cn:
我对海尔加的怀疑果然是对的，她背叛了我。而且还是和那个愚蠢的罪犯罗德里克！

他们已经盯上了我的家产，所以我决定给海尔加设一个圈套。我已经在崇山城周报上刊登了一篇公告，呼吁她前往我们第一次见面时的那个旅馆秘密房间一起共饮。等到了那里之后，她将会发现自己无法拒绝的诱惑：一杯掺有毒药的红酒。我终于能够彻底摆脱那个可恶的女人了！

en: A poisonous substance, nowadays considered rare due to its dangerous extraction process.
cn: 有毒物质，因为提取过程有着致命危险而十分稀有。

en: Your inner Flame protects you from the Shroud, but not indefinitely. Watch your remaining time whilst enshrouded and leave to recover. When your time runs out, you perish. Search for glowing hourglass capsules inside the Shroud for a momentary boost and replenishment. Hourglass capsules are consumed upon interaction, and cannot be picked up or carried around.
cn: 你的内在灵火将保护你免受瘴气伤害，但是这种保护也存在极限。时刻留意你的剩余停留时间，在彻底被瘴气侵蚀之前离开才能恢复。当停留时间彻底耗尽，你将就此倒下。 在瘴气中找到的闪光沙漏胶囊将能够暂时延长并补充你的停留时间。沙漏胶囊将在交互时消耗，因此无法被放入物品栏带走。

en: May you have a pleasant voyage.

Gunther told you about a ripped wall tapestry he worked on before being stationed at his final post. The first piece should be hidden in a Balefire Garrison.

Reach the Balefire Garrison and look for the wall tapestry piece!
cn:
冈瑟告诉你说在前往最后一处哨所驻扎前，他曾经制作过一块挂毯，但挂毯已经被撕成了几块。第一块碎片应该就藏在一处篝火兵营里。

前往篝火兵营并寻找挂毯碎片！

en: A scaffold that lets you reach higher points while building your base.
cn: 脚手架能够帮助你在建设基地期间前往高处。

en: If we adopt a Capybara, I'll name it Carmyn. Or Captain Capybara? Or maybe Capoodle the Oodle? Ah, so many options...
cn: 如果我们要收养一只水豚，我要给它起名叫卡敏。或者是水豚队长？或者直接叫卡比巴拉？啊，好多选择……

en: At least one role must be enabled to start a multiplayer session!
cn: 如果要开始多人游戏进程，你必须启用至少一种身份！

en: You've reached the Vukah settlement by the giant tree. Climb to the top of the tree and search the settlement to find the lost hand drum!
cn: 你已经抵达大树旁的沃卡村落。设法爬到树顶，并在村落中寻找遗失的手鼓！

en: The Strangest Of Visitors, Midyear, 498 D.A.

cn: 浮标击中了一处障碍物。

en: Find All Hidden Crafting Recipes In The Blackmire
cn: 找到黑沼中的所有隐藏制作配方

en: Improved magical ammunition that creates a single bolt of ice, damaging enemies upon impact and slowing them afterward. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 改进后的魔法弹药，使用时将创造一枚寒冰箭，命中时对敌人造成伤害并使其减速。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: This garment is held together by oakwood buttons, a woven belt, and magic itself! The buttons are doing most of the work, though.
cn: 橡木纽扣、编织腰带和魔法联手出击，才勉强让这件衣服不散架。不过，纽扣功劳最大，魔法可能偷懒去了。

en: A note reported unsettling sounds from a nearby water well in Ocean's Heart, prompting a person carrying a large hammer to investigate. Discover the well and find the hammer!
cn: 这份笔记中记载着海洋之心中某处水井里传来了令人不安的声响，并且还提到有人带着大锤进去调查异响。 探索水井并找到锤子！

en:
An impressively big ammonite fossil. The remains of this marine cephalopod once housed a large, tentacled, sea-bound creature. In Embervale superstition, every identifiable rim extending from the spiral's core is said to bestow a day of good luck.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.
cn:
令人印象深刻的大型鲑鱼化石。这种海洋头足类动物的遗骸曾经栖息着一种大型触手海生生物。在安伯维尔迷信中，据说从螺旋核心延伸出来的每一条可识别的边缘都会带来一天的好运。

此收藏品在 春日平原 中找到。

en: The sun won't drown in the darkness of night. It will rise again.
cn: 哪怕黑夜再深也无法淹没朝阳。黎明终将再次到来。

en: If set, players entering your world for the first time will spawn at this Flame Altar.
cn: 激活之后，这个灵火祭坛将成为首次进入你的世界的玩家的出生点。

en: Dear Sir, You test the will of the Mysterious Wanderer. The specter knows your mind to be fickle. My proposal was fair, but your silence speaks volumes. Even though I sought your home out with peaceful intentions, you threatened me with violence! I bring a message from the gods, you fool! No matter your response — I must recover the precious resource that lies inside the soil. It will be your ground no more! You will see what my retribution looks like! The phantom will intertwine your string of fate with darkness itself. You cannot turn back. The thread has been woven. You've brought this upon yourself. - Costner Meyers
cn: 亲爱的先生， 你在考验神秘旅人的意志。幽灵知道你的心思善变。 我的提议很公平，但你的沉默说明了一切。尽管我是抱着和平的目的寻找你的家园，但你却用暴力威胁我！我带来了诸神的讯息，你这个傻瓜！无论你如何回应，我都必须收回土壤里的珍贵资源。它将不再是你的土地！你会感受到我的怒火！ 魅影会把你的命运和黑暗交织在一起。你无法回头。命运的丝线已然编织好了。 一切皆是你咎由自取， 科斯特纳·迈耶斯

en: This scales the mining damage. A higher mining damage leads to increased terraforming and more yield of resources per hit.
cn: 调整采矿伤害。调高伤害将提高地形改造效率，并且使你每次进行采集动作时能够获得更多资源。

en: This world contains more entities and/or water than the hardware can reliably handle. Please contact the customer support.
cn: 这个世界中包含的实体以及/或水体已经超出了硬件能够稳定处理的极限。请联系客服支持。

en: Shroud Depthdweller, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud
cn: 瘴气深渊行者，首次出现：游牧高地瘴气区

en:
No matter what they say, I cannot give up on you. I know you're still out there, Sophie, captured by the heart of the Shroud.

This tower is no home without you. My fingertips trace the rotting pages we swore to keep safe. Their fading words slip my mind like your memory as the mist draws near.
But unlike you, I can't escape. I can never run from the things I said to you... because every time I look into the mirror, you gaze back at me, sister. 

When all is silent in the dead of night, I hear your cries reverberate throughout these empty halls.
Maybe your ghost will return to haunt me. And perhaps I deserve that.

You're my other half. My mirror image. My twin, my biggest regret, and loss.
I miss you, Sophie. Come back.

Your Willow
cn:
不管他们怎么说，我绝不会放弃。我知道你还在那里，索菲，被瘴气之心所禁锢。

没有你，这座高塔便不再是我的家。我的指尖划过了我们发誓要守护的那些腐烂书页。随着迷雾逐渐逼近，那些褪色的文字就像关于你的回忆那样正逐渐从我的脑海中消失。
但是和你不一样，我无法逃脱。我永远无法忘记自己对你说过的那些话……因为每次看着镜子里面，我就会看见你，我的姐妹。

当夜深人静时，我能够在这些空荡的房间中听见你回荡的啜泣声。
也许你的幽灵将回来折磨我，而那也许是我罪有应得的下场。

你是我的另一半。就像镜中的字迹。双胞胎中的另一个，我这辈子最大的愧疚与失去。
我想你，索菲。回来吧。

你的薇洛

en: The raiders have besieged us these past two days, attacking from the bridge. Their eyes... such madness... We have withheld so far, but only just. We may not survive the next assault. I've ordered to rig the pass with our last munitions. If those Scavengers return, WE ARE PREPARED. — Captain Arkwright
cn: 在过去的两天时间里面，强盗们一直在围攻我们这一侧的大桥。那些人的眼神里面尽是……纯粹的疯狂…… 虽然我们坚守到了现在，但也已经是强弩之末。我们很有可能挺不过下一次的攻击。我已经命令部队用最后的弹药布下陷阱。如果那些拾荒者再来，我们将做个了断。 — 阿克怀特队长

en: Descend The Well In Ocean's Heart
cn: 进入位于海洋之心的魔药之井的底部

en: A very durable and long-lasting source of light made from wax. Equip this before starting your expeditions into the unknown!
cn: 使用蜡制作的照明用具，十分耐用而且可以提供持久照明。探索未知领域之前记得一定要装备上它！

en: This cute plushy makes the fearsome critters much more approachable.
cn: 这个可爱的毛绒玩具能够让最可爱的怪物也变得可爱起来。

en: The Flame has alerted you to a newly opened path into a desolate part of the Revelwood. Visit the area marked on your map to discover a widely untamed wilderness!
cn: 灵火提醒你说有一条通往喧嚣森林无人问津的区域的新道路已经开启。拜访地图上标记的区域，探索大自然的狂野！

en: Breathing? Check. Legs? Intact. Kickable, even. Nose? No longer broken. Head... possibly hallucinating! Are ya real? Nice to meet ya! I'm Braelyn Hawthorn — a traveler, carpenter, and proud aunt. Did ya build this place...? The stonework's marvelous! I picked up some techniques on my travels. If ya need a hand, buildin' — just holler!
cn: 呼吸？有。腿？完好无缺。甚至还可以走动。鼻子？已经好了。脑袋……说不定是出现幻觉了？你是真的吗？很高兴见到你！我是布莱林·霍桑，一名旅行者，木匠兼骄傲的姑姑。这地方是你造的吗……？你的石工技术可真不错！之前我在旅途中学到了一些技巧。如果你在建造方面需要帮助，尽管来找我！

en: A Rake enhanced with scrap metal to increase its durability and speed. A decent tool to level hilly ground.
cn: 通过使用金属废料提高耐久与速度的耙。用于平整起伏地形的方便工具。

en:
7.5	
No ranking beyond the parameters described above takes place. In particular, as an Uploader, you have no means of influencing the ranking by paying Keen a direct or indirect fee.
cn:
7.5	
除上述参数外，不进行其他任何形式的排名。特别是，作为上传者，您无法通过向 Keen 支付直接或间接费用来影响排名。

en: Lutes are a classic instrument of choice for bards. They can be used to play beautiful melodies with friends or alone.
cn: 鲁特琴的吟游诗人的经典乐器之一。无论是独奏还是与三五好友一起都能演奏出动听的旋律。

en: On a critical hit with a ranged weapon, you do double the damage.
cn: 使用远程武器暴击时造成双倍伤害。

en: The Blacksmith, Oswald Anders, explained that eating and resting in a sheltered and warm environment is crucial to prepare for adventure. Spending time in a comfortable home will trigger the well rested buff.
cn: 据铁匠奥斯瓦尔德·安德斯所说，在温暖安全的庇护所中进食与休息是筹备冒险的重要一环。 在舒适的家中停留一段时间即可触发精力旺盛加成。

en: A miner's helmet with an attached light.
cn: 安装有灯具的矿工头盔。

en: Place items from your inventory here to make them available for the factory.
cn: 将物品栏中的物品放置在这里，然后工坊就能使用这些物品。

en: Fell Enemies, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔敌人，首次出现：游牧高地瘴气区

en: You gain 5 minutes of the Rested buff. This can only be used every 30 minutes.
cn: 获得持续5分钟的休息良好加成。此效果仅可每隔30分钟触发1次。

en: You see it before your inner eyes: A giant, submerged in the deep ocean blue, controlling the tides with each laboring, drawn-out exhale. The depths are calling. Will you answer?
cn: 你的内心之眼已经看见了：一个巨人，沉没在深海之蓝中，它的每一次呼吸都是在操纵着潮汐波动。你愿意回应深渊的召唤吗？

en: Automatically rotate and adjust the camera based on the player's movement when no controller camera input is detected.
cn: 未检测到控制器镜头输入时，根据玩家的动作自动旋转与调整镜头。
灵体正在低语。用心聆听。

en:
A bright green color palette, reminiscent of algae, shrubbery, and Drak cuisine.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
让人联想到藻类、灌木丛还有卓克美食的亮绿配色。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: I know you are busy, friend. But, my <craftingstation>Mortar</craftingstation>... what a help it could be!
cn: 我知道你很忙，我的朋友。但是我的<craftingstation>磨臼</craftingstation>……请务必尽快帮我找回来！

en: Facing their downfall, Ancients and humans united to forge the Flameborn.
cn: 毁灭注定无法避免，于是人类便联合远古者，一同缔造了火之子。

en: A rudimentary set of daggers, the secondary weapon of choice for archers. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 一套简易匕首，弓手们往往会用这种副武器防身。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en:
You've learned that an enslaved worker planned to escape the Camellia Lake Marble Quarry.

His escape was surely apprehended. Search the area marked on your map to find the escapist!
cn:
你得知曾经有一名奴隶试图逃离卡米拉湖大理石矿场。

但是他的逃跑计划最终还是失败了。搜索地图上标记的区域并找到想要逃跑的奴隶！

en: These spires stretch to the firmament and deny entry to those who are unworthy. The ancient breed enters, but I never see them leave... I've 2 theories: 1. The Ancient Spires are somehow connected to another, and the silent ones travel between them as they please. 2. The Ancient Spires serve as a burial site, similar to the Flame Shrines. The Ancients store all knowledge of the land in the Flame here when they leave the mortal plane. One way or another, I cannot enter. When I step on the ornate plate, nothing occurs. What a shame. — Balthazar, 507 D.A.
cn: 这些高耸入云的尖塔回绝着所有不被认可之人。虽然我看见过远古者走进去，但是它们从来没有离开过……关于这点我有两个理论： 1. 远古者的尖塔其实是相互连接在一起的，因此那些沉默的远古者们能够随心所欲穿行于各个尖塔。 2. 远古者的尖塔其实是一种墓地，类似灵火神龛。远古者会在离开尘世的时候将自己对于周遭大地的所有知识储存在里面的灵火中。 无论真相如何，我没有找到进去的方法。当我踩在精心装饰的面板上时，什么也没有发生。实在是遗憾。 — 巴尔萨扎，507 D.A.

en: 4.5 Cross-Platform Sharing: By uploading User Content, you consent to your User Content being displayed and downloaded across platforms—in particular by users on Steam and other platforms alike. For users on other platforms, the respective terms of the Platform through which they use Enshrouded shall additionally apply.
cn:
4.5	
跨平台分享：上传用户内容，即表示您同意跨平台展示和下载您的用户内容，特别是被 Steam 及其他类似平台上的用户所访问。对于其他平台的用户，其使用 Enshrouded 所通过的平台的条款也适用。

en: You have awakened your kin! The Flame is pleased. Seek out more survivors slumbering in the Springlands.
cn: 你已经唤醒了自己的同胞！灵火对你的进展十分满意。寻找更多正在春日平原中沉睡的幸存者。

en:
• Old Fen stole back his own offering. He's growing greedy.
• I saw the Scholar leave town again. He was not alone—and he was not with his wife.
• Eldon doesn't pray anymore. Only pretends when others are watching.
• Mira no longer—

(The entry ends abruptly. There are blood spatters on the page.)
cn:
• 老芬恩把交出去的贡品又偷了回去。
• 我之前看见学者又出去了。他不是一个人，而且那个女人并不是他的妻子。
• 阿尔登已经不再祈祷。他只会在其他人看着时装装样子。
• 米拉已经不再是……

（信件到这里突然结束。纸上沾满了血迹。）

en: The Flame wants to help you turn your base into a proper home. A home will need furniture. Adding furniture and decoration to your base will also grant you more Comfort, which is necessary for becoming Rested. Furniture allows you to sit or lie down. Lying down at night will pass the time faster until sunrise, and will forgo the challenge of fighting tough enemies in the dark. Craft or obtain a bed to add comfort to your home and to pass dangerous nights! A necessary mattress can be crafted at the Workbench!
cn: 灵火想要帮助你把基地变为一个像样的家园。 一个合格的家需要家具。为基地添加家具与装饰品还能够为你提供更多舒适度，这也是获得休息良好状态的必要条件之一。 家具将允许你坐下或躺下。在夜晚躺下将能够快速度过时间直到日出，这么做还可以帮助你避免与夜间的强悍敌人交战。 制作或获取一张床来提高你的家园的舒适度并度过危险的夜晚！你可以在工作台制作必需的床垫！

en: A music sheet for a somber song to play in the moonlight. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 这张乐谱中记载着适合在月下演奏的忧郁乐曲。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: You've touched a slimy substance. You're slowed down and receive damage over time.
cn: 你触碰了某种黏糊糊的物质。降低移动速度，并且持续承受伤害。

en: Investigate The Source Of The Lightning Strikes
So many fossils! Look at this beauty... ancient little remnants from forgotten times... how exciting!
cn: 好多好多化石！简直就是一份艺术品……曾经消失在历史长河中的远古碎片……真是太不可思议了！

en: A crude industrial oven for sintering and heating.
cn: 粗糙的工业炉子，能够用于烧制加热材料。

en: I think it's about time you face your fears and clear the Shroud out of one of them Elixir Wells. Let's fight back!
cn: 我觉得是时候该让你克服自己的恐惧了，快去清理魔药之井的瘴气吧。反击的时候到了！

en: As a kid, I didn't have much, so I made do with whatever was around me. My favorite pastime was to collect stones and paint them in pretty colors, but some were too pretty blank. Red marble, quartz, or even basalt possess a natural beauty, don't you think? I'd like a color palette that reflects that quiet serenity. Where would there be an abundance of rock...? Maybe in the Albaneve Summits!
cn: 我小时候家境并不富裕，所以很多时候我只能寻找现成的玩具。当时我最喜欢的游戏就是收集路边的石头，然后给它们涂上好看的颜色，但是有些石头不用上色就很好看。红色的大理石、石英、甚至是平淡无奇的玄武岩都散发着一种天然的美感，你说呢？我想要一块能够反映那种平淡静谧的调色板。问题是哪里能够找到那么多的岩石……？也许阿尔班耶夫山脉那里有合适的地方！

en: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort which increases the duration of the rested buff.
cn: 能够放置在家中的照明物品。 提供舒适度，还能延长“休息良好”增益的持续时间。

en: You've survived the water temple, but you still haven't found its final treasure. Look around in the upper layer of the temple to find its hidden gold chest!
cn: 你成功逃出了淹没神殿中的机关，但你还没有找到最后的宝藏。 在神殿上层寻找秘密的黄金宝箱！

en: Limestone is an abundant resource often used in architecture.
cn: 石灰石是一种常被用于建筑用途的常见资源。
红色大理石柱底座 I

en: My spirit is broken. Can I really blame the people for turning away from my potions in their desperation? Most of my visitors these days are rats and other sad pests... so far, they have not proven to be great patrons, let alone lab partners. There must be a better way to withstand the Shroud... to overcome it. Perhaps I should reconsider my efforts. — Balthazar, Midyear, 505 D.A.
cn: 这一切实在是让我大受打击。 但是我又怎么能够怪罪人们在绝望中抛弃了我的药水？现在来拜访我的就只有偶尔出没的老鼠和其他害虫……很可惜，到目前为止，他们并算不上合格的顾客，更别说是实验室搭档了。 一定能找到更好的办法来抵御瘴气……一定有办法能够战胜那些东西。也许我只是需要调整研究方向。 —巴尔萨扎，岁中，505 D.A.

en: Use the ingame photomode to create screenshots
cn: 使用游戏内拍照模式来创作截图

en: Enable automatic framing of enemies and bosses during combat.
cn: 允许在战斗中自动框选敌人与头目。
看来你好像抓到了什么……

en: When you kill an enemy with a magic weapon, you gain 20% more experience.
cn: 使用魔法武器击杀敌人时额外获得20%经验。

en: This bow has great tension, making it exhausting to use. It does great damage in exchange.
cn: 这把弓的弓弦张力极高，这意味着使用起来颇为费力，但以此同时，这也意味着能够造成可观的伤害。
大型阿尔班耶夫山脉火盆

en:
Like the morning sun, reflected in the still water of an ivory bowl.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
就像是在象牙白的碗中盛放着清水中反射的朝阳。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。

en: Gathering an Orb restores 10% of the respective resource.
cn: 收集恢复球将恢复10%的对应资源。

en: Your gem effect is on cooldown before it can be triggered again.
