cn: 冷却期间无法再次发动宝石效果。

en: Increases the skill level of Vitality Surge
cn: 提高活力澎湃的技能等级

en: I can smith all kinds of helpful things for ya, but not out in the open like this!
cn: 我可以帮你打造各种各样有用的物件，但总不能露天工作吧！

en: Gold ground to powder. It sparkles even more beautifully than before.
cn: 碾成粉末状的黄金。散发着比以往更美丽的光辉。

en:
A worker from the "Maelstrom" Construction Site suffered severe hallucinations and documented them as he descended into the Shroud.

Follow his footsteps and find out where he went!
cn:
在深入瘴气的过程中，一名来自“旋涡”建筑工地的工人出现了严重的幻觉，并且还将看见的景象记录了下来。

跟随他的脚步并查明工人的去向！

en:
No recently used materials detected.

Build something or use the Material Catalog.
cn:
未检测到近期使用的材料。

请建造任意物品或使用材料目录。
这些布料散发着腐朽的恶臭。
能够悄无声息移动的潜行裤子。

en: Dearest Lupa — When we got separated, I was beside myself with fear. I searched and searched for what felt like days... only to encounter Rodalton, a thief from Umber Hollow who said you'd been taken by the Contractor. Why is he taking children down into that wretched place? Despite his cruelty, this thief assured me you were still alive — albeit a prisoner. He promised to slip you this note. Sister! I know you well enough to say that you will not remain shackled for long. When you do escape, return home, and we shall have our revenge! Lovingly, Kendal
cn: 致最亲爱的卢帕…… 当我们走散的时候，我整个人都快被吓坏了。我四处打听你的消息，也不知道过了多久……但我最后只是遇到了一个叫洛达尔顿的褐赭空洞盗贼，他告诉我说你已经被契约人带走了。为什么他要把孩子带去那个丑恶的地方？尽管冷酷无情，但是那个小偷还是告诉我说你还活着，虽然你现在已经成为了囚犯。 他答应我会把这张字条偷偷递给你。姐姐！我知道那里的枷锁肯定无法困住你太久。等你逃出来的时候，请你一定要回家，到时候我们再一起复仇！ 爱你的， 肯戴尔

en: Hits restore a percentage of damage dealt as Stamina
cn: 命中时恢复等同于部分伤害量的体力

en: All hope is fickle, a mirage on the horizon. This staff makes its bearer reject all convictions to walk into the abyss.
cn: 所谓希望不过是转瞬即逝的海市蜃楼。法杖将使持有者拒绝一切加入深渊的诱惑。

en: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.
cn: 用于美化住宅的装饰物品。

en:
The scales are heavy with muck and grime, dulling its glow. Hard to believe such a being once illuminated the water lilies under <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s glorious rule.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
cn:
沾满泥泞污秽的鳞片已经没有了当初的光芒。难以想象自从<lorename>派克米德</lorename>的荣耀统治时代，那个不可思议的闪烁就已经沉睡于睡莲之下。

收集数个瘴气魔荧龙头颅以制作青铜战利品。

en: Don't call me vain, but I miss the fashion of the old world. Bright colors, luxurious fabric, the pretty people wearing them, and their even prettier riches... Maybe you can still find some garments out there? It wouldn't hurt to look!
cn: 请不要认为我是个爱慕虚荣的人，但我真的很怀念旧世界的华丽风光。明亮的色彩、奢华的服装、还有那些美人俊杰、以及他们鼓鼓囊囊的钱包……也许你可以找到一些以前留下来的衣服？没关系，有时间的话顺路看一眼就行！

en: Magic weapon Critical Strike chance is increased by %k.
A washed version of the Rough Stone Block. Exposed to the weather, the stones have lost their rough features over time.
cn: 已经褪色的粗糙石方块。长时间的风吹日晒已经将原本粗糙的表面打磨光滑。

en: I hear Cade sent you to my rescue. He's an old friend and customer who'd admire my wares whenever I'd visit the Low Meadows. He even purchased a lantern from me once. If I could have another look at it, I could fashion more of them. Please ask Cade about this.
cn: 听说是卡迪派你来救我的。他是我的老朋友，也是一位老顾客，以前每次拜访低矮草原的时候，他都会来捧场。他甚至还在我这里买过一个灯笼。如果能让我再看一看那件东西的模样，我应该就知道如何制作更多的灯笼了。还请麻烦你去问一下卡迪。

en: The lightning sets the skies ablaze. It's my only source of light since the fire was doused by this merciless downpour. Of course, I had seen the clouds gather before I left to search the hidden tomb. I had tasted the threat in the breeze. Despite the warning signs, he pushed me to venture forth. You can wait out the storm, but the water may smother our treasure in mud! Can you bear to see our empire wash away, Gerith? Oh, that silver-tongued devil. The tomb is close by, but wind and rain bar me from venturing further! These creaking trees scarcely shelter me, so I'll surely be soak— (The text ends abruptly.)
cn: 闪电将天空点燃。自从大火被无情的暴雨浇灭后，这是我唯一的光源。当然，在我出发去寻找隐藏的古墓之前，我已经看到乌云密布。我在微风中感受到了威胁。尽管有种种警示，他还是催促我冒险前行。 你大可以等待暴风雨停歇，但大水可能会把我们的宝藏覆盖在泥土中！你忍心看着我们的帝国被冲走吗，格里斯？哦，那个舌灿莲花的魔鬼。坟墓就在附近，但风雨阻挡了我前进的脚步！这些吱吱作响的树木几乎无法为我遮风挡雨，我一定会被淋湿-- （文字戛然而止。）

en: Here you can find the requirements and ingredients for each recipe.
cn: 你可以在这里查看每种配方的需求与材料。

en: You know as well as I that the last haul was too good to share. Those cutthroats wouldn't know a good blade till it slit through 'em. We're doing 'em a favor if you ask me. I stashed the sword in the last place anybody would look… You know the cave well enough. Let's keep it between you and me, alright?
cn: 我们都明白，上一批拿来跟其他人分就太可惜了。 那帮强盗根本分辨不出什么才是好的武器。要我说这么做反而是在帮他们。我已经把剑藏在一个谁也不会去找的地方……不过你应该很熟悉那个洞窟。 不要把这件事告诉其他人，知道了吗？

en: Ground yourself, and feel the earth beneath your feet. Connect to the magical core of the world with these graceful boots and stand firm against your adversaries.
cn: 接地气，感受脚下的大地。穿上这双优雅的靴子，与世界魔法的核心相连并坚定对抗你的敌人。

en:
Ever since I started using my father’s old fishing rod, I’ve been catching… strange things.

Treasure chests. Glitter and gold. Artifacts, soaked but alive, begging to be rescued from the deep. Is it the water or the rod?

I’ve been pulling in more wet boots, too. On bad days, I come home with a dozen of them. Who here keeps losing all their shoes? I’ve started stacking them up, pairing them when I can, but I’m tired of the sight.

My father held his tools in high honor, and I’ve tried to do the same — but this rod… I ought to throw it out. I can’t afford to wait for every big haul... I prefer to return to predictable, reliable results. I've packed it up and stashed it in the basement of my house. One day, I'll return to it... in a time of need, perhaps.
cn:
自从我开始使用父亲的旧鱼竿之后，我就钓上了许多……奇怪的东西。

宝箱。金碧辉煌。许多被彻底打湿但仍然拥有生命力的神器，它们祈求着有人将自己从深海之中解救出来。到底是水还是鱼竿的问题？

近来我也钓到了好多湿靴子。如果遇到运气不好，有可能我一天会钓上十几只。到底是谁在水里面丢了那么多靴子？我开始想办法将这些靴子好好堆叠起来并尽可能给它们配好对，但是看见那些东西我就精疲力竭。

我的父亲曾经将自己的工具视若瑰宝，我也努力想要效仿——但是这根鱼竿……也许我该把它丢出去。我不指望每次都有惊人收获……我只想回到原来那种可以预见的稳定结果。我已经把那根鱼竿打包，并且藏在了我家的地下室里面。总有一天，我会回去找他……如果有必要的话。

en: Simple shoes with flat heels that pair well with dark stockings.
cn: 简单的平底鞋，和黑色长袜搭配在一起很好看。

en: You've placed the goat. Now, you should craft and place the necessary amenities. To satisfy your animal's needs, it will need a Common Goat feeder and a farm animal pillow. If you have 2 happy animals close to each other and an extra spare bed, the animals can reproduce. Craft a goat feeder and a farm animal pillow!
cn: 你已经放置山羊。现在你应该为其制作并放置配套设施。 为了满足动物的需求，你需要准备一个普通山羊喂食器以及一个农场动物枕头。 如果拥有2头快乐且相互靠近的动物，而且它们附近还有一张额外的床，动物们就会进行繁殖。 制作一个山羊喂食器与一个农场动物枕头！

en: Trees, mainly stumps and red-leaved trees
cn: 树木，主要为树桩与红叶树木

en: Market days were my favorite. That fateful day, I traded the farm vegetables for stories and secrets until a familiar melody made me pause. The same tune that called me into the forest so long ago was beckoning me once more. I dropped my sacks of grain and followed it. I found a bard surrounded by a swaying crowd, playing the bewitching symphony on flute. Something inside of me blossomed like a forgotten seed. "Get 'yer head out of the clouds!" My father yelled that evening, spitting his mashed potatoes onto the dinner table. "You got the wrong blood! Look at 'yer hands — They're bulky and strong, not made to fiddle around!" He stuffed his mouth with a dry piece of bread and washed it down with well water. "'Yer a farmer, kid. Can't change it." Valory
cn: 赶集是我最喜欢的日子。在那个命运的日子里，我用农场里种出来的蔬菜交换着其他人的故事与秘密，直到我听见了那个熟悉的旋律。很久很久以前，正是那段旋律带着我走进了森林，这次它又在向我招手。我立刻扔下装满谷物的麻袋并跟了上去。 人们正围聚在一位吟游诗人的旁边，她正在用笛子演奏着令人陶醉的乐曲。那一刻，我感觉自己心中有一颗早已被遗忘的种子突然绽放了。 “你给我清醒一点吧！”那天晚上，我父亲在饭桌上对我大发雷霆，他嘴里的土豆泥喷得到处都是。 “你不想想我们是干什么的！你看看你的手，粗大而且有力，你觉得适合拿去搞那种乱七八糟的事吗！”父亲用力啃下了一块干巴巴的面包，接着又吞了一大口之前打来的井水。 “孩子，你就是个农民。这点是不会改变的。” 瓦罗里

en: Pierce Enemies in the back with arrows shot from this precise Fell Impaler Bow, perfect for those who prefer their enemies dealt with from a comfortable distance.
cn: 使用这把精准的瘴气魔穿刺者弓的箭矢射击从背后穿透敌人，最适合那些喜好从安全距离打击敌人的家伙。

en: An axe with a very sturdy iron head. It's more efficient!
cn: 这把斧子安装有牢固的铁制斧刃，因此能够发挥出更高的效率！

en: This server has unlocked the crafting recipe for this color palette. Craft or obtain the palette to complete your set! Color palettes can be crafted at the Coloring Station.
cn: 当前服务器已解锁这种调色板的制作配方。 制作或获取调色板以完成你的套装！你可以在染色站制作调色板。
重新组装<lorename>派克米德</lorename>雕像

en: Here Lie The Winners Of The Summer Games

The Flame can be strengthened at the Flame Altar. This empowers you to pierce the Shroud further, and to construct more bases to protect Embervale from its reach. In order to strengthen the Flame, Sparks and other materials are needed. Find Sparks in Flame Sanctums and Flame Shrines.
cn: 灵火可以在灵火祭坛得到加强。这样，您就可以进一步抵御瘴气，并建造更多的基地，保护薪谷不受其影响。 强化灵火，需要余火和其他材料。在灵火神殿和灵火神殿中寻找余火。

en: You can blink while being stunned. This will break the stunned state.
cn: 你可以在晕眩状态下发动闪现，这么做将解除晕眩状态。

en:
You've found a plushy of a Fell Critter.

Now talk to the Farmer, Emily, to alleviate her fears!
cn:
你找到了一个瘴气魔虫的毛绒玩偶。

现在与农民艾米丽交谈以帮助她克服恐惧！
装备稀有度、拆解以及特性

en: ...just swept across the border and all the way to the plaza, its mellow waves foaming at the great stairs. "An eager tide", they said. "A blockage must've loosened upstream"... But I beg to differ. The water tastes different. It whips against our outer walls, rising... during Queen Pikemead's rule, this would've never happened. Our kingdom erodes under Gormander... we've become weak.
cn: ……直接横扫边境并冲进了中心广场，掀起的水花拍打着楼梯。“涨潮了”，人们说。“肯定是哪里堵塞导致上游被冲垮了”……我并不这么想。这次的水的味道不对劲。不光是已经冲击到外墙，现在水位还在不断攀升……要是派克米德女王还在根本不可能发生这种事。我们的王国要被戈曼德给毁了……瞧瞧我们现在这副软弱的样子。

en: Hitting an unaware enemy will cause %k more damage.
cn: 击中未警觉的敌人会造成额外%k伤害。

en: A building block crafted from White Glowing Substance. Its radiance brightens up any space. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 使用白色荧光物质制作的建筑方块。明亮的光芒能够照亮所有空间。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en:
Ages ago, they were many — soaring across snowy peaks and through painterly valleys. Now, there is only one. Oh, how far you fall when flying high.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
cn:
多年以前，不计其数的同胞曾在白雪皑皑的山峰与风景如画的山谷中穿梭。但现在只剩下它自己了。飞得越高，掉下来的时候就越惨痛。

收集多个瘴气魔幼龙头颅以制作青铜战利品。

en: The Alchemist explained that the Ancients and humans came together to create "Flameborn", beings forged in fire. They are protected by their Flame Soul and can therefore enter the Shroud without longterm consequences. The protection of the Flame does not last forever, and needs to recover outside of the Shroud.
cn: 炼金术士解释说远古者与人类可以通过灵火的锻造结合为“火之子”。这些全新的存在将受到灵火之魂的保护，因此能够在不需要担心任何长期影响的情况下进入瘴气。但是灵火提供的保护也有限度，需要在瘴气之外进行恢复。

en: The bard Valory wants you to search all of Embervale for fossils. There are three fossils in the Kindlewastes. Each fossil can be found multiple times in different places. The Bard advised searching mines, dig sites, and ore deposits to find all fossils.
cn: 吟游诗人瓦罗里希望你寻找遍布在薪谷中的化石。燃火荒原中总共有3种化石。你可以在不同地点反复找到各种化石。如果要找到所有种类的化石，吟游诗人建议前往各地的矿井、挖掘场以及矿点搜索。
找到村民并为其提供庇护所

en: Increases Magic damage by 5% per Attribute Point.
cn: 每点属性点增加5%的魔法伤害。

en: "Gaze into the orb," the Oracle said, eyes fixated on her staff. "It shows the past, the present, and the future — and they're all veiled in blue rot". Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
cn: “凝视宝珠”，先知如是说道，她的眼睛牢牢盯住了自己的法杖。“它能够展示过去、现在与未来……而且一切都笼罩在蓝色的腐化中”。 瘴气附魔： 这把武器已经被瘴气侵蚀，并且能够造成大量瘴气伤害。只能够在瘴气巢穴中找到。

en: The location of the Queen's hidden tomb was found. Her remains and treasures must be behind the central door, but it's locked. There must be a way to open the door.
cn: 王后陵墓的位置找到了。她的遗体和宝藏一定在中门后面，但门是锁着的。一定有办法打开这扇门。

en: Burst into flames upon ritual completion. Horrible howling. Stench? Even worse. Skeleton is still useful, though. Conclusion: No ever-burning candles. Use regular instead.
cn: 在仪式完成时突然燃烧了起来。那些可怕的嚎叫声。还有烧焦的恶臭。真的让人无法忍受。不过骷髅倒是挺有用的。结论：不要用永燃蜡烛。常规蜡烛就行。

en: Oh wow, just look at that! You’ve found something that mirrors the water, sparkling in the sun so beautifully! Ugh, I could gaze at this crystal forever… I feel so inspired — let’s get to it!
cn: 哇哦，好好看看！你找到了能够与阳光下波光粼粼的水面一样美丽的东西！哦，我真希望能够永远欣赏这个水晶……我感觉脑海中充满了灵感，让我们开始吧！

en: Being a "Scavenger" is so limiting, dull, and... grimy. Perhaps you shouldn't have to spend all day drinking and fighting. What if a man wants to take a bath instead? A pure, beautiful, calm, scented soak in the Cromville Hot Spring? I don't want to cut and tear, I yearn to splish and splash — to enjoy a steamy bubble bath with my lads, at a comfortable yet sensible distance! We could even dive for treasure! That's "manly", no? It would be fun! People propose that my rugged physique ought to dictate my tastes, but why be covered in grease when you could smell like rose water? I refuse to yield to such a pretense!
cn: 当“拾荒者”真的是太沉闷乏味而且……肮脏。 也许你不应该把所有精力都花在喝酒和打架上。说不定有人会想要好好泡个澡呢？安安静静地在克罗姆威尔温泉美美地泡个澡？ 我对那些刀口舔血的活不感兴趣，我只想好好在水里泡着——和伙计们一起享受热气腾腾的泡泡浴，当然，所有人都得保持舒服合理的距离！我们甚至可以潜水寻找宝藏！这种事很有“男人味”，对吗？说不定会很有趣！ 也许有人会觉得我的粗犷体格已经决定了我的品味，但是当你能够闻上去像是玫瑰水一样香喷喷的，为什么还要忍受那种满身污秽的恶臭？我拒绝接受那种刻板印象！

en:
It reeks of foulness and rot, so best ventilate your halls properly.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Trophy.
cn:
这东西散发着恶臭和腐烂的气味，所以最好放置在通风处。

收集多份拾荒者主母来制作战利品。

en: Critical Strike chance is increased by %k. Critical Strike damage is increased by %k.
cn: 暴击率提高%k。 暴击伤害提高%k。

en: Throw out the fishing line and wait for a fish to bite. Once a fish bit, quickly press %k to start reeling it in.
cn: 抛竿并等待鱼上钩。当有鱼咬钩后，快速按%k开始收线。

en: Gold coins! Finally! Let's fill the whole basin with gold and dive in!
cn: 金币！终于！现在我们可以给水池里装满金币，然后跳进去游泳啦！

en: By now, you've encountered the Hollow. Skeletal husks, animated by ire and the curse of the Flame. Legends say they were banished into grand underground halls of unknown origin... I discovered one such hall during my studies, but I could not enter. Maybe you can. Best assemble a team if you have one to descend!
cn: 现在你已经遇见过空荡。仇恨与灵火的诅咒驱使着那些只剩下森森白骨的躯壳。传说它们都被封印在了神秘的巨型地下礼堂之中……我在研究期间发现了其中一处礼堂，但是我无法进入其中。不过也许你可以办到。如果可以的话，我建议你最好先组建一支队伍然后再前去探索！

en: Bushes can conceal you. When you're within them, press %k to crouch and hide. Use them to sneak up on enemies.
cn: 你可以藏在灌木丛中。当你进入灌木丛时，按下%k键即可蹲下并隐藏。利用灌木丛潜行至敌人身边。

en: These gloves are a bit stiff and barely functional. The most important thing is that they look impressive to peasants. You won't need to do manual labor, anyway.
cn: 这些手套十分僵硬，戴上去会让人感觉十分笨拙。不过好在华丽的外形足以打动那些少见多怪的乡下人。毕竟能拥有这套手套的人自然不用去屈尊做体力活。

en: Call upon the forces of the underworld to summon projectiles that seek out enemies. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 呼唤冥府之力并召唤能够追踪敌人的投射物。 引导法术：在一段时间内维持按键以持续引导。装备法术并消耗法力来用 法杖施法。

en: It seems as though Aunt Braelyn ventured into the hidden temples of Blackmire to research the stonework. Perhaps you can find more traces of her in the other temples!
cn: 看来布莱林姑姑当年去了黑沼的隐藏神庙研究当地的石工技术。也许你可以在其他神庙中找到更多的线索！

en: Survivors may require shelter to unlock crafting recipes. Build shelters for your survivors and craft beds for them! Additionally, new crafting recipes may be unlocked by gathering key resources. Certain crafting recipes require crafting factories. The factories must be created and placed in the base before use. Key items needed for factories, or the factories themselves, can be aquired on certrain survivor quests. All known recipes can be reviewed in the Workshops tab in the journal. Important recipes can be pinned.
cn: 幸存者们有可能需要庇护所才能解锁制作配方。为你的幸存者建造庇护所与床铺！ 除此以外，收集关键资源将有可能解锁新的配方。特定制作配方需要对应的制作工坊。你必须先制作工坊并将其放置在基地中才能开始使用。工坊需要的关键物品或者是工坊本身都可以通过完成特定的幸存者任务来获取。 所有已知配方都可以在日志的工坊面板中查看。重要的配方可以标记。

en: The <npc>Blacksmith</npc> feels a dark presence at the capital, <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>. He worries the town's fate might have been sealed by war, or worse, a strange and otherworldly glow from the depths of the riverbed.
cn: <npc>铁匠</npc>感受到都城<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>中有一个黑暗的存在。他担心城镇有可能遭遇了战争或者更可怕存在的侵袭，一道怪异的光芒正在河底蠢蠢欲动。

en: It's easy if you keep practicing.
cn: 功夫不负有心人，继续练习。

en: These boots will still keep their shape even if you drop a hammer on them. Or tongs. Or an entire anvil. How handy!
cn: 这双靴子哪怕只被锤子狠狠打中也不会变形。换成是火钳砸下去也一样。就算你把完整的铁砧丢下去，靴子也仍然是纹丝不动。这么一想倒是真的很好用！

en: This mace is the bane and banisher of all undead creatures. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.
cn: 这把钉锤将毁灭一切不死生物。 空荡回音： 这把武器释放的不洁回响魔力能够延长攻击范围。

en: Artificial nails were added to these otherwise simple mage gloves to make them more imposing and fashionable.
cn: 在这些原本朴实无华的法师手套上还添加了假指甲，使其更加威风凛凛又能引领潮流。

en: Ah! I ache to create! Help me smelt some new materials, will you?
cn: 啊！我已经迫不及待想要创造了！帮助我熔炼一些新材料，好吗？

en: An eternal channeling spell which heals all allies in need. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 永恒的引导法术，能治疗所有需要帮助的盟友。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: This magical spellbreaker's hat has been adorned with an azure gem that attracts and stores scattered fragments of the Flame. Their power is later unleashed during heartpounding, close-quarter combat.
cn: 这顶蕴含魔力的破咒者帽子镶嵌有一枚能够吸引并储存散射的灵火碎片的天蓝宝石。这种力量之后可以在热血澎湃的近身战斗中尽数释放。

en: In old times these gloves were worn by the wisest scholars of the kingdom, often hiding wrinkled and gray flesh underneath.
cn: 古时候，王国里最聪明的学者都戴着这种手套，它们曾经遮盖着皱纹和灰白的双手。

en: Indicates how well your body copes with freezing environments.
cn: 代表你的身体对寒冷环境的抵御能力。

en: When told about the legend of Merphisz, Fyraszh sprung forth from the crowd of Drakling. "Why splash in water for eternity? Why adjust to the whims of the waves if you could forge your own path in fire?" He asked, red hot with rage. Determination to surpass his brother swelled in him, so Fyraszh travelled not far, but deep. He set off to claim the core of the mountain, to forge his glory in molten metal and liquid heat. When they saw him again, his scales had hardened like coal, and the skin underneath glowed like the sun. Adorned in ash and gold, he yelled from the mountaintop: "See? The mountain rumbles and spouts, it chants our name and that of our clan! Drak' Fyr! Drak'Fyr!" And as the mountain indeed sputtered and roared, a fountain as bright as the evening sun erupted behind him. The amber glow swallowed his body, but lifted his soul to Ark Morgo where he'd be a leader for all eternity.
cn: 聆听梅菲兹的传说时，菲拉兹从一众龙裔中站了出来。 “为什么要在水中寻找永恒？当你明明能够用火焰铸就自己的道路，为何还要去指望喜怒无常的海浪？”他如此问道，全身都因为愤怒而变得通红。他的心中充满了要超越自己兄弟的决心，于是菲拉兹决定向深处而不是远方旅行。他觉醒要征服山脉的核心，要用融化的金属与液体的热浪锻造自己的荣誉。 当再次现身时，他鳞片已经像煤炭一样坚硬，底下的皮肤就像太阳一样散发着光芒。在灰烬与黄金的点缀下，他站在山巅放声咆哮：“看见了吗？山峦也在晃动迸发，它在呼喊着我们与氏族的名字！卓克·法尔！卓克·法尔！” 山峦随即也开始了真正的崩裂与咆哮，一道像夕阳般明亮的喷泉在他身后迸发。琥珀色的光芒吞没了他的身体，但也将他的灵魂推进了魔戈方舟，在那里，他将成为一名永恒的领袖。

en:
3.1	
You are obliged to use Adventure Sharing as a freely available gameplay feature of Enshrouded in accordance with these Adventure Sharing Terms and the Terms of Use for Enshrouded, as well as in line with their respective intended purpose. In doing so, you are obliged not to impede or harass other users in their use and not to use Adventure Sharing for purposes other than those intended or in a manner that disrupts or overwhelms the technical operation of Adventure Sharing.
cn:
3.1	
您有义务根据本冒险分享条款及 Enshrouded 使用条款的规定，并遵循其各自的预期用途，将冒险分享作为 Enshrouded 的一个免费游戏功能来使用。在此过程中，您有义务不妨碍或骚扰其他用户的使用，不得将“冒险分享”用于预期用途之外的任何目的，也不得以干扰“冒险分享”技术运行或使其超出负荷的方式使用该功能。

en: 1.1 Keen Games GmbH, Dreieichstr. 59, 60594 Frankfurt am Main ("Keen"), operates the game Enshrouded ("Enshrouded"). Within Enshrouded, the "Adventure Sharing" feature may be used as a freely available gameplay feature subject to these Terms of Use for Enshrouded Adventure Sharing ("Adventure Sharing Terms") With Adventure Sharing, you can, in particular, upload environments from your save game that you have individually created and designed as worlds by building, terraforming, and placing in-game items, and make them available to the community of users for visiting, interacting with, or downloading ("Adventure Sharing").
cn:
1.1	
Keen Games GmbH, Dreieichstr.59, 60594 Frankfurt am Main（以下简称“Keen”）负责运营《雾锁王国》（Enshrouded）游戏（以下简称“Enshrouded”）。在 Enshrouded 中，冒险分享功能可作为一项免费游戏功能使用，并受本 Enshrouded 冒险分享使用条款（简称“冒险分享条款”）的约束。通过冒险分享功能，您尤其可以上传您存档中通过建造、地形改造及放置游戏内物品等方式独立创建并设计为世界的游戏环境，并将其提供给用户社区以供访问、互动或下载（“冒险分享”）。

en: This infested bow contains the mighty power of the Shroud.
cn: 这把被腐化的弓中蕴含着瘴气的强大力量。

en: Adds a 25% chance to spawn an additional Regular Arrow with your Flurry of Arrows from the Multi Shot skill. This additional Regular Arrow does not subtract from your ammunition.
cn: 使你的多重射击技能发射的箭雨有25%几率生成一枚额外的普通箭矢。 额外生成的普通箭矢不会消耗你的弹药。

en: Hide passages in your base behind this secret door.
cn: 使用这扇暗门掩盖基地中的秘密通道。

en: Remaining Time in the Shroud Threshold
Bring the Barber something blue and crystalline
cn: 为理发师提供某种蓝色的清澈之物

en: A comfortable, traditional garb suiting an upcoming alchemist.
cn: 为刚入门的炼金术士准备的传统服饰，穿着体验十分舒适。
提高所有魔法瘴气伤害

en:
The Bard told you about her desire to play a handpan. Handpans were common in the Veilwater Basin, and were sometimes shipped with other cargo through important trade routes.

There's a cargo lift in the Veilwater Basin that connected it to the Revelwood and <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>. Start your search there!
cn:
吟游诗人表示她渴望能够演奏手碟。曾经这种乐器在幕水盆地十分常见，而且有时候会与其他货物一起经过重要的贸易路线。

幕水盆地中有一座连接着喧嚣森林与<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>的货运梯。前往那里并开始搜索！

en: The Barber wants you to check abandoned trade outposts for leftover goods such as color palettes. He suggested looking into "Nomad's Drop", a trade outpost in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 理发师希望你前往废弃的贸易站去寻找类似调色板等遗留货物。 他建议你去调查“游牧集会所”，那是一座位于游牧高地的贸易站。

en: What a beautiful little soul you've brought. Don't worry about its life here... I will shape it into something useful.
cn: 你带来的灵魂是多么美丽。不用担心它在这里的生活……我将把它变成有用之物。

en: Increases the skill level of Soul Leech
cn: 提高灵魂汲取的技能等级

en:
I've been wandering the lands, fascinated by the rich and vibrant purples that nature so effortlessly weaves into petal and berry. Such depth, such brilliance — I must seize it for myself. I have boiled roots and crushed blossoms, mixed minerals and whispered spells, yet the color eludes me. The shade slips through my fingers like mist at dawn.

But I will not rest. Somewhere in earth or essence, the secret awaits. And when I seize it, it shall be more than mere pigment. It shall be power, beauty, and fortune itself.
cn:
我一直在探索这片大地，难以想象，大自然竟然能如此轻而易举地将那么浓郁又生动的紫色融入花瓣与浆果之中。如此不可思议的深邃与美妙，我必须将它们变成我的东西。我尝试过烹煮根茎、碾碎花瓣、调和矿物甚至是使用法术，但我迟迟无法得到满意的结果。就像是黎明时的雾气，我的手指总是无法抓住正确的颜色。

但是我绝不会轻言放弃。就在大地与缥缈的精华之间，紫色的秘密在等待着我。等到我将那色彩纳入囊中，它将超越简单的颜料。那紫色将成为权力、美丽与财富的化身。

en: Humanity dug the Elixir Wells, ripping apart the land and each other to quench their thirst.
cn: 人类挖掘魔药之井，撕裂了大地和彼此，只为满足自己的渴望。

en: Increases the skill level of Counter Strike

The deep blue hue that takes center stage in this palette can be found beyond rocky beaches, or on rainy days by the cliff.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
cn:
这种调色板的主色采用了在崎岖海岸或者是雨中悬崖附近随处可见的深蓝色调。

可以使用喧嚣森林材料制作这种调色板。

en: On The Flame And Its Murmurs
cn: 针对灵火与低语的研究

en: This setting controls the amount of enemies in the world.
cn: 该选项决定了游戏世界中出现的敌人数量。

en: This striped cat is a fearsome hunter, always on the prowl. It's quiet, graceful, independent — and proud to present its spoils of war to you after a successful hunt! After a long day of adventuring though, it loves nothing more than to snuggle and sleep.
cn: 这只条纹毛色的猫咪是一个令人敬畏的猎人，它永远在等待狩猎的时机。安静、优雅而且独立，在成功狩猎之后它还会骄傲地向你展示自己的战利品！不过在经历了漫长的冒险之后，它最爱的还是舒舒服服打个盹。

en:
The <craftingstation>Beehive Smoker</craftingstation> was stolen and brought to the Vukah Sacrifice Hill, alongside honey and wax. 

Follow the trail and eliminate the Vukah thief to retrieve the <craftingstation>Beehive Smoker</craftingstation>. This will unlock <craftingstation>Honey Beehive</craftingstation>s and honey production.
cn:
<craftingstation>熏蜂器</craftingstation>以及蜂蜜还有蜂蜡都被偷走并被带去了沃卡献祭陵。

跟随踪迹，消灭沃卡窃贼以取回<craftingstation>熏蜂器</craftingstation>。之后你将能够解锁<craftingstation>蜂巢</craftingstation>以及蜂蜜生产。
劳作的人们会穿的朴素靴子。

en: Your armor isn't sprinkled with cat hair yet, meaning you haven't concluded your search. This matter is dear to my heart. Please consider it!
cn: 你的护甲上找不到一根猫毛，这说明你还没有调查高塔。拜托了，这件事对我来说至关重要。还请务必去看一看！

en: Thor came back from that scouting mission last night. He chucked this dusty bag with scrolls at me, and said it's the only thing they could scavenge. I know that fool well enough to see when he's lying through his teeth! My old friend pocketed a treasure for himself, but I won't rat him out. Instead, we'll gift that almanac to the matron as a tribute. And the treasure — well, Thor will have to share. Whatever he looted from Queen Jezmina's tent will be stashed away at his favorite spot, I reckon. After all this time, he still hasn't found a better hiding place than the top of that old watchtower.
cn: 托尔昨晚执行完侦察任务回来了。 他给我扔了一袋装满卷轴的脏袋子 ，说这是他们唯一能搜刮到的东西。我太了解那个傻瓜了，一眼就能看出他在撒谎！ 我的老朋友私吞了宝藏，但我不会出卖他。相反，我们会把那本图鉴作为贡品送给夫人。 至于财宝嘛，托尔会分享的。我估计，不管他从杰兹米娜女王的帐篷里找到了什么，都会被藏在他最喜欢的地方。过了这么久，他还没有找到比那个老瞭望塔顶更好的藏宝处。

en: Opens doors in the Veilwater Basin Hollow Halls.
cn: 能够打开幕水盆地空荡礼堂的大门。

en: Why Must I Waste Time As A Squire?
cn: 为什么我要继续浪费时间做一名侍从？

en: An ore which contains traces of tin. Needed to create Tin Bars.
cn: 含有锡的原矿石。用于制作锡锭。

en: The best way to elevate your outfit is by extensively adding belts and straps to an inflationary degree, or so they say. A golden sigil on the chest signals your dedication to the Flame.
cn: 据说皮带与绑带的数量与一件衣服的美观程度成正比，也就是越多越好。胸口的金色徽章代表了你对灵火的忠诚奉献。

en: In the Inventory (Most Recent Tab) tab, put a weapon in your Action Bar and select it. Press %k to attack. Press %k to lock onto an enemy. Your camera and attacks will focus on them. Maneuver behind enemies to backstab them for increased damage. Unlock more fighting abilities in the skills menu.
cn: 在物品栏（最近打开的面板）界面中，将武器放入动作栏后选中它。按 %k键攻击。 按%k键锁定敌人。你的视角和攻击将集中在他们身上。 在敌人背后使用背刺来造成更多伤害。 在技能菜单中可以解锁更多战斗能力。

en: You can swim and dive through bodies of water. Be mindful of your Oxygen while submerged.
cn: 你可以在任意水体中游泳或潜水。潜水时请时刻留意自己的氧气储备。

en: Movement penalties from armor are reduced by 50%

Everyone relies on you because they trust you, but great courage inspires envy. I'm thinking about those... "Bony Fellows". Ah, I mean the "Hollow", of course. They're seething with envy, and their spooky glow has always enchanted me! When I was younger and more rebellious, I would even loiter around a graveyard near the capital to sneak a peek — but I never dared to enter the crypt. I wonder what's inside?
cn: 大家出于信任而依赖你，但勇气往往会催生出嫉妒。我指的是那些……“瘦骨嶙峋的家伙”。就是“空荡”，别搞错。它们浑身上下都散发着嫉妒的气息，而且那种恐怖的微光一直让我感到好奇！当我还是个年轻的浪荡子的时候，我甚至会故意在首都附近的陵园瞎逛，就为了偷偷窥视它们的模样，不过我一直都不敢真正走进墓穴。不知道那里面有什么东西？

en: Reached the ancient spire in the Albaneve Summits.
cn: 抵达阿尔班耶夫山脉的远古尖塔。

en:
The Alchemist wants you to discover a more efficient way to grind materials. Perhaps you can discover a machine that functions without such manual labor!

Take a look around when you enter the Veilwater Basin. The Flame calls you towards a certain town that holds the answers you seek.
cn:
炼金术士希望你寻找一种更为高效的方式来研磨材料。也许你可以发现一种不需要太多手工劳动就能运作的机器！

进入幕水盆地之后记得留意类似的机器。灵火正在召唤你前往一个小镇，那里有你在寻觅的答案。

en: Fallback control scheme is in use
cn: 正在使用备用控制方案

en: A music sheet for a soft song with heavenly tones. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 这张乐谱记载了犹如天籁般的温柔乐曲。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en:
Oscar Godwin is missing his cousin, Anton Godwin. Travel to the prison where he's held,  Gateway Outpost "Drifa", and search it!

Find Oscar's cousin and return him to his family!
cn:
奥斯卡·戈德温正在寻找自己的表亲安东·戈德温。安东被关押在了网道哨所“落雪”的监狱，前往那里并搜索监狱！

找到奥斯卡的表亲并让他们重新团聚！

en: A wand that deals significant fire damage, eradicating anything in its path. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 能够摧毁一切并造成大量火焰伤害的魔棒。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。
大型空荡之夜南瓜 II

en: Oh, sleeping under a real roof will do wonders for my creativity and mind! Thank you!
cn: 只要能够在结实牢固的屋顶下美美睡上一觉，我的才华与头脑就会立刻回来！谢谢！

en: The staff's material is engraved with countless labyrinthine lines reminiscent of the chaotic flow of battle. However, a metal halo encircles the negative space within, preserving a sense of calm, as if one were inside the eye of a storm.
cn: 构成法杖的材料上刻满的错综复杂的线条象征着混乱的战斗。不过一个金属的光环笼罩住了内部的负面空间，并保留了一丝平静的氛围，就像是风暴之眼中的那样。

en: The dusty remains of building materials.

en: Completing this set will unlock the following recipe(s)
cn: 完成此套装将解锁以下配方

en: A bitter tasting herb that can be found in dry areas. It's said to have enlightening abilities.
cn: 常见于干燥区域的苦涩药草。据说有提升智慧的效果。

en: Mine every valuable material in the Albaneve Summits.
cn: 开采阿尔班耶夫山脉中的所有贵重材料。

en: Flameborn! Some time ago, a curious thing happened... I received a note. Take a look. "From Reagan, courtesy of the Conways."... I've never met a Reagan, but I know the Conways. Couriers from the east. They must have traveled through Trade Outpost "Blazing Rock" to deliver the message. Can you investigate?
cn: 火之子！不久之前发生了一件奇怪的事……我收到了一张纸条。你看看。“来自里根，康威敬上。”……我不认识叫“里根”的人，但是我认得康威。他们是东部的信使，“炎石”贸易站是来这送信的必经之地。你能不能帮我去调查一下？

en: A farmbed which will yield Azure Russula.
cn: 能够产出天蓝红菇的农地。

en: The Vukah have created a champion at their camp. Defeat the Vukah Brawler at the Vukah Ceremony Hill to return peace!
cn: 沃卡在营地中推选出了一名冠军勇士。打败沃卡仪式陵中的沃卡斗士以让当地恢复和平！
大型墓穴棺材（架高） I
阿尔班耶夫山脉宝石锻炉

en: The Flame watches over the fallen land and provides the Flameborn with the power to defy the Shroud. Deepen your connection to the Flame with sacrificial resources, and its blessings shall further amplify.
cn: 灵火注视着陨落的大地，并为火之子提供着反抗瘴气的力量。通过献上特殊资源加深与灵火之间的联系，并进一步提高祝福的效果。

en: Ruin Has Come To Our Family
Increases the skill level of Primal Force
cn: 提高野性力量的技能等级

en: Upgrading the Flame Altar expands your protection range. Upgrading the Flame Altar requires a Shroud Core. Shroud Cores are aquired by smiting boss enemies. Sacrifices raise the Flame Level and add a point to all attributes of every Flameborn. They also increase your Shroud Passage Level, which is necessary to pierce the Shroud further. Sacrifices require Sparks. Find Sparks in Flame Sanctums and Flame Shrines.
cn: 升级灵火祭坛以扩展保护范围。升级灵火祭坛需要瘴气核心。打败首领敌人以获取瘴气核心。 献祭将提高灵火等级，并使所有火之子的全部属性提升1点。除此以外，这么做还将提高你的瘴气抵抗等级，让你可以进一步深入瘴气。献祭需要消耗余火。你可以在灵火神殿以及灵火神殿中搜集余火。

en:
The mountains are its cradle, the winds its lullaby
Howling Peak its womb, so eat your pumpkin pie

An egg inside will hatch and seek the child that doesn't eat
Finish what your parents cooked or you'll be its tasty treat

A desperate howl will call for you, the echoes know your name
So hurry up and eat your plate, or your death will be in vain
cn:
山脉就是它的摇篮，强风就是它的摇篮曲
呼啸崇山则是它的子宫，乖乖吃下南瓜派

等到巨蛋孵化，从里面爬出的怪物将抓走不乖乖吃饭的小孩
吃掉父母烧的饭菜，否则你将成为它的美味佳肴

绝望的咆哮将追寻你，无处不在的回音将知道你的名字
赶紧把饭菜统统吃干净，否则等待你的只有死亡

en:
This process is way faster outside of gameplay. 
We recommend letting it finish before playing.
cn:
这个过程在游戏之外会更快。 
我们建议让它完成后再进行游戏。

en: These pants were made from silky smooth cloth, gracing only the most esteemed magicians.
cn: 这条裤子由顺滑如丝的布料制成，只有最受尊敬的魔法师才能拥有。

en: Come here, Flameborn. I've got a request for you.
cn: 来吧，火之子。我有一项任务要交给你。

en: A resplendent white-and-gold cloak interwoven with iridescent threads. Worn by the "Scholars of the Young Flame", it symbolizes the burning desire to illuminate the unknown.
cn: 白金相间的华丽斗篷，每一根丝线都闪闪发光。作为“星火学者”的服饰，这种斗篷象征着照亮未知领域的热情渴望。

en:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison. 

This variant can be found in the Revelwood.
cn:
散发着光耀的能量旋涡，用于将宝石嵌入各类武器。

最初由远古者使用，之后又被瘴气魔据为己有并成为了怪物们的养料，直到最后才被你从有机物质的牢笼中解救出来。

可以在喧嚣森林中找到这种形态的能量。

en: The <npc>Hunter</npc> traveled through Revelwood to reach <location>Westcott</location>. Her <craftingstation>Hand Spindle</craftingstation> was left in a different camp.
cn: <npc>猎人</npc>在前往<location>维斯考特</location>的路上经过了喧嚣森林。她的<craftingstation>纺线锤</craftingstation>被遗落在了另一座营地中。
高大装饰圆形石制窗框

en: A nice snack for the way. The strength it takes to crack its shell, it gives back upon consumption.
cn: 不错的旅行零食。虽然撬开外壳很费力，但是食用后就能够提供恢复效果。

en: Duck, dodge, and roll out of harm's way with this lightweight vest.
cn: 穿上这件轻便背心，你就可以轻松翻滚躲闪并避开敌人的攻击。

en: When killing an enemy with a ranged weapon, your next attack will do critical damage.
cn: 使用远程武器击杀敌人后，你的下一次攻击将造成暴击伤害。

en: Retrieve The Millstone While The Waterflow Is Turned Off
cn: 在中断水流之后取回磨盘

en: The sharp edges of these gloves that stretch towards the wearer's fingertips jot out like viper fangs.
cn: 这些手套的锐利边缘就像是一根根毒牙一样伸向了穿戴者的手指。

en: A beautiful material known for its warm and bright color. Artisans around the world have turned towards it for centuries, due to its workable characteristics.
cn: 拥有温暖而明亮的特殊色彩的美丽材料。灵活的可塑性使其受到古往今来的工匠们的追捧。

en: A burning hot, meaty stew. Increases your resistance against extreme cold and improves your health and health regeneration.
cn: 滚烫的肉汤。提高抵御严寒环境的抗性，并提供生命值与生命值恢复。

en: The beast is mighty, but not invincible. Parry incoming projectiles or use stun arrows to force the dragon down.
cn: 怪物十分强大，但绝对不是刀枪不入。招架来袭投射物或者使用晕眩箭矢来击落巨龙。

en: An arrow with a copper tip.
You currently don't have any unfinished Quests
cn: 你目前没有任何未完成的任务

en: It seems we are complete. A meager group, far fewer than expected... our Cinder Vaults could only sentinel so few... but we stand strong nonetheless. Together, we will fan your flames, friend. May your light reach the farthest corners of the land!
cn: 看来现在全员到齐了。虽然说人数比我原先料想的要少太多……我们的余烬密室的庇护实在是太过有限……但是无论如何，我们将共渡难关。我们将为你的火焰添薪加柴，我的朋友。竭尽全力燃烧吧，愿你的光芒能够照亮四方！

en: Two mirrored Drak are represented on this mace. Despite being outwardly similar, they may not share the same fate — for the Broodmother's duality demands the weak become a feast for the strong.
cn: 这把钉锤上有两个镜像对立的卓克。尽管外表相似，它们的命运并不相同——育母的二元性意味着弱者将成为强者的盛宴。

en: Reliable gloves which shield the wearer's arms from claws.
cn: 可靠的手套能保护穿着者的手臂免受利爪的伤害。

en:
Base Critical Strike chance with any weapon. 
Can be increased for specific weapon types. 

Critical Strikes deal increased damage based on your total Critical Strike damage.
cn:
任意武器的基础暴击率。
特定武器类型能够获得暴击率提升。

暴击将根据你的总暴击伤害加成造成额外伤害。

en: Today, I Met The Elixir Well Architect
cn: 今天，我和魔药之井的建筑师见面了

en: Uncooked game. Must be roasted over a fire.
cn: 未煮熟的野味。必须在火上烤。

en: A leafy green plant material, naturally occurring in the Blackmire. It can be used for creating hedge mazes or garden artistry.
cn: 翠绿而且饱满的植物材料，通常生长在黑沼中。能够用于制作树篱迷宫或者是园艺雕塑。

en: Increases the skill level of Rebound
A pair of grey trousers. They layer well under the more elaborate cloth of the upper body armor.
cn: 一条灰色长裤。能够与上身护甲的精致面料完美地贴合在一起。

en: You discovered notes by Jezmina, Queen of Orindell, who left traces in the Blackmire. Follow her footsteps and see if she left any items behind!
cn: 你发现了奥林戴尔的杰兹米娜女王的笔记，里面提到她在黑沼中留下的踪迹。 跟随她的脚步并寻找她留下的物品！

en: An assortment of differently sized stones commonly found on fields.
cn: 大小不一的石块，常见于各种农田上。

en: A wig head that unlocks more haircuts once picked up. It can also be placed in your base as decoration.
cn: 捡起假发头部之后能够解锁更多发型。你也能够将其作为装饰品放置在基地中。

en: Increases the skill level of Water Aura
cn: 提高水之光环的技能等级

en: Did you forget about yer weaponry? I'm waiting. You need to be able to fight back — it's a frightening world out there, kid!
cn: 忘记武器的事了吗？别让我等太久。外面太过危险，就这么赤手空拳的不像话，孩子！

en: Enter The Temple And Loot The Lost Diver
cn: 进入神殿并搜刮迷失的潜水员

en:
6.1.9	
If Keen becomes aware of information giving rise to the suspicion that a criminal offense posing a threat to the life or safety of one or more persons has been committed, is being committed, or may be committed, Keen will promptly inform the competent law enforcement or judicial authorities of the suspicion and provide all available relevant information.
cn:
6.1.9	
如果 Keen 获悉相关信息，有理由怀疑已经发生、正在发生或可能发生危及一人或多人生命安全的刑事犯罪，Keen 将立即将该嫌疑情况告知主管的执法或司法机关，并提供所有可获得的相关信息。

en: This head armor combines a mask, cloth, and horns. For most foes, it will be the last thing they see when you catch them by surprise.
cn: 这件头具包含了面具、头巾还有犄角。对于绝大多数敌人来说，这将是他们遭受意外打击之前最后看见的东西。

en:
The Collector has entrusted you with a task. The Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls hide 3 magical artifacts inside. Find them to display them in your base!

There are multiple hiding spots for the artifacts. Search for secret passageways and keep your eyes open!

The location of the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls will appear on your map when you've found it through exploration or accepted the next Collector quest. The latter will become available once you're at a high enough level.
cn:
收藏家给了你一项任务。游牧高地的空荡礼堂之中藏着3件魔法工艺品。找到工艺品并在基地中进行展示！

你将需要寻找多个工艺品藏匿点。留意周围环境并寻找秘密通道！

当你发现游牧高地的空荡礼堂，或者是接受了收藏家的下一项任务之后，地图上将显示对应的位置。你需要达到一定等级之后才能领取收藏家的任务。

en: What To Do With The Prisoners?

cn: 自动填充各类木材建筑材料。

en: Sprint Speed is increased by %k and Stamina cost while sprinting is decreased by %k.
cn: 冲刺速度提高%k，冲刺时的体力消耗降低%k。

en:
The bard assistant, Chester Loft, wrote in a note about heading to the Lord's magnificent castle.

Perhaps you can find something interesting there that can be of use to you. Reach Lord Vorgoth's throne room and search it!
cn:
吟游诗人助手，切斯特·洛夫特写的纸条中提到他去了领主的宏伟城堡。

也许你可以在那里找到一些有趣的东西。抵达沃格斯领主的王座室并搜索那里！

en: These lovers sought refuge in the Flame, but it warms them no longer. Offer its Spark at the Flame Altar in your home.
cn: 这对爱人试图向灵火寻求庇护，但是火焰并无法继续温暖他们。将余火献给你的家园中的灵火祭坛。

en: My son, Jacob, recently started rambling about "a new friend" he'd made. He said a cloaked figure came to see him in the dead of night, and told him they should "dig" together. I was frightened, so I went to check all the entries and doors. But when I found nothing out of order, I chalked it up to my child's lively imagination... Still, I exchanged the locks and boarded up his window. Yes, I had grown paranoid, but perhaps not enough... Not a fortnight later, I saw it, too. It felt so real — a twisted man with a sickly, mangled face, hovering at the end of my bed... infesting my mind with one word: "Dig." I've joined the local contractors in building an Elixir Well. Soon, we will crack the ground open and see what we'll find. If I can't keep it out, I have to face it head-on. For Jacob. For everyone.
cn: 最近我的儿子杰克布突然开始说自己交了一位“新朋友”。 他说有一天夜里，一个披着斗篷的身影找到了他，并且邀请他一起去“挖掘”。听到这些话的时候我吓坏了，接着我立刻就去检查所有大门和可以进来的入口，但是我发现一切安然无恙，这让我认为那一切肯定只是孩子的想象力过于丰富…… 尽管如此，后来我还是更换了门锁并用木板把他房间的窗户彻底钉死。我知道自己这么做过于疑神疑鬼，但也许就算做到这种地步也不够…… 不到两周之后，我也看见了。那一切真实地不可思议，一个身形扭曲，形容枯槁的男人就飘浮在我的床头……他在我的脑海中灌输了一个念头：“挖”。 我已经加入了当地的建筑商并开始帮助建造魔药之井。很快我们就将掀开地表并发现隐藏在地下的东西。如果没办法把那家伙拒之门外，那我只能去直面他。为了杰克布，也是为了所有人。

en: A bow that's fueled by the dark shimmer of the Shroud.
cn: 这把弓闪烁着来自瘴气的黑暗光芒。

en: Flameborn, dear friend — the earth shakes with vitriol! Descend to snuff out that eternal rage!
cn: 火之子，我亲爱的朋友，我能感受到大地正在愤怒地颤抖！深入地下，平息永恒的怒火！

en: As your skills are honed, the power of the Flame grows. You must determine the best path for your skills in our grim endeavor against the Shroud.
cn: 随着你不断磨砺自身技艺，灵火的力量也开始与日俱增。在对抗瘴气的危险征途上，你必须寻找一条最适合自己的道路。

en: Master The Ancient Spire In The Albaneve Summits
cn: 完成阿尔班耶夫山脉中的远古尖塔

en: Weakens the effect of the Wet and Soaked debuffs. Stamina and Stamina Regeneration is reduced by 20% instead of 30%. Wet Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration. Soaked Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%. Soaked can be applied to enemies. Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.
cn: 削弱潮湿以及湿透的减益效果。 体力以及体力恢复降低20%而不是30%。 潮湿 体力与体力恢复降低30%，持续15分钟。温暖环境将能够缩短此效果的持续时间。 湿透 体力与体力恢复降低30%，持续30秒。同时使寒冰与电击抗性降低30%，但是火焰抗性将提高30%。 敌人也会进入湿透状态。 湿透的持续时间无法通过温暖环境缩短，并且等结束时将会变为潮湿减益。
瘴气 瘴气抵抗等级

en: Used at storage chests and some crafting stations
cn: 用于储存箱与部分制作站

en: I Had The Most Enthralling Time Today
cn: 今天我经历了一件最不可思议的事情

en:
Greatly increases the zoom while aiming with Bows.

To aim, hold down the %k while a Bow is selected in the Action bar.
(Alternatively, hold %k to aim your equipped Bow.)
cn:
大幅提高弓瞄准时的缩放幅度。

若要进行瞄准，首先选择动作栏中的弓，接着按住%k。
（或者长按%k使用当前装备的弓进行瞄准。）

en: Light boots. They're slightly pointed at the toes.

The wielder's energy melts inside the wand's empty husk and reforms to shoot forth a boundless stream of elemental energy. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 持有者的能量将会融化在魔棒的空壳之中，接着再转化为无穷无尽的元素能量并喷涌而出。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: Fenrig the Farmer explained that villagers need food and a warm, sheltered bed to do their best work and be happy. You can assign a spare bed to your followers by using the summoning staff and aiming it at a bed. Assign a sheltered bed to Fenrig to proceed!
cn: 农民芬里格解释说村民们需要食物与一张温暖的、受到庇护的床才能够安心工作。如果需要给追随者分配空闲床位，将召唤法杖瞄准床铺即可。 为芬里格提供一张受到庇护的床以继续！

en: Killing an enemy with no allied armored Hollow active has a chance to spawn an allied level %k armored Hollow.
cn: 击杀敌人（且不存在友方重装空荡）时有几率生成一名友方%k级重装空荡。

en:
The right leg of a wild Cyclops. The skeletal remains are intact.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
cn:
一头狂野独眼巨人的右腿。骷髅的部分仍然保存完好。

能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到此收集品。能够在独眼巨人战利品底座上重新组装为一套完整的独眼巨人骷髅。

en: You will return. They always do.
cn: 你会回来的。所有人都是。

en: This patch of leather has been made more sturdy and enduring.
cn: 这块经过特殊处理的皮革格外坚固耐用。

en: Add this pull anchor to your buildings to pull yourself forward and onto other platforms. Requires a Grappling Hook to activate.
cn: 为建筑添加牵引锚点之后，你将可以牵引移动并前往其他平台。需要使用抓钩激活。

en: A colorful pillow that will make any room cozier.
cn: 颜色鲜艳的枕头，能够让一切房间彰显温馨。

en: The sugar rush powers your stamina regeneration for a short amount of time.
cn: 摄入糖分能够为你提供暂时的体力恢复效果。

en: With Select / Use, hotkey functionality is two-fold. Unselected items in the action bar will be selected. Selected items will be used.
cn: 通过选择/使用，快捷键拥有双重功能。选中动作栏中未被选择的物品。使用已选中的物品。

en: A Special Guest On Hollow's Eve
Crafting a spinning machine shouldn't be hard. I can show you how to do it!
cn: 制作一台纺织机应该不难。我可以教你制作！
找到所有凛冬外观物品

en: The Farmer wants to make beehives and honey, but lacks a Beehive Smoker. Ages ago, she ordered a Beehive Smoker to her tavern in Brittlebush, but her shipment didn't arrive before she left. The Beehive Smoker unlocks the ability to craft a Honey Beehive. Search for Emily Fray's tavern in Brittlebush to look for clues and retrieve the Beehive Smoker.
cn: 农民想要制作蜂巢以收集蜂蜜，但是她缺少关键熏蜂器。多年以前，她曾经为自己在碎丛的酒馆订购了一批熏蜂器，但是还没等到货物抵达，她就已经离开。只要有了熏蜂器，她就能够制作出蜂巢。 搜寻艾米丽·弗莱在碎丛的酒馆，追查线索并取回熏蜂器。

en: Your submission of the Cyclops head will greatly benefit us, and your dedication was duly noted, Sergeant. We've ordered the head to be transported to the laboratory nearby. We've noticed your ask for additional gold payments, since two members of your troop were, as you described, "ripped apart by the Cyclops, leaving only entrails behind, damn it!!" We will consider your request with utmost diligence. Don't contact us, we will contact you. With regards, Office of Lieutenant Arlington, First Overseer of the Expansion Program
cn: 你上交的独眼巨人头颅将为我们提供莫大的帮助，我们不会忘记你做出的贡献，中士。我们已经派人将头颅带去附近的实验室。 我们已经收到额外黄金报酬的申请，并且已经得知有两名士兵已经“被独眼巨人彻底撕碎，他们只剩下了几块内脏，该死的！！” 我们将会认真考虑你的申请。 请勿联系我们，如有变化，我们将主动联系你。 此致， 探险项目首席主管，阿玲顿中尉办公室

en: An eerie silence hangs over The Pike. Investigate the castle to determine the source of our nightmares, and the lights from below.
cn: 崇山城笼罩在诡异的寂静之中。调查城堡以查明噩梦的来源，找到来自地下的闪光。

en: Increases the skill level of Heavy Handed
cn: 提高千钧之力的技能等级

en:
You found a note that mentioned a cursed fishing rod, which was stored by the fisher in a <location>Pondsworth</location> basement.

Find a way to access the underground and retrieve the fishing rod!
cn:
你找到的笔记中提到了一根被诅咒的鱼竿，渔夫将这件东西存放在了一处<location>彭斯沃斯</location>地下室中。

设法进入地下并取回鱼竿！

en: Have you found the paper lantern yet?

6.1.5	
Keen shall determine, free from arbitrariness and objectively on the basis of the information available at the relevant time, whether content constitutes Prohibited Content or whether conduct is prohibited. The measures to be taken shall depend in particular on the nature (e.g., whether a criminal offense is involved), the severity (e.g., threat of death or violence), the frequency of violations (in relation to the total number of reports and within a certain period), the consequences (e.g., whether and how many other users were harmed or impaired, whether marginalized groups were affected), and the discernible intent of the acting person, insofar as this is discernible. In doing so, Keen acts in an objective, non-discriminatory, and proportionate manner, and gives due consideration to the rights and legitimate interests of all parties involved.
cn:
6.1.5	
Keen 应依据相关时间点所掌握的信息，以非任意性且客观的方式判断内容是否构成禁止内容，或行为是否被禁止。拟采取的措施尤其取决于行为的性质（例如是否涉及刑事犯罪）、严重程度（例如是否存在死亡或暴力威胁）、违规频率（相对于特定时间段内的举报总数）、后果（例如是否有其他用户受到损害或影响及影响程度如何、边缘群体是否受到影响），以及行为人可识别的意图（如果该意图可识别）。在此过程中，Keen 应以客观、非歧视且相称的方式行事，并适当考虑所有相关方的权利及合法权益。

en: Your protection against magical attacks. Each point reduces incoming damage by 1.
cn: 抵御魔法攻击。每点可使受到的伤害降低1。

en: These boots were made by the most talented cobblers and are as expensive as they come.
cn: 这双靴子由最有才华的鞋匠制作，价格不菲。

en: Hot and spicy! The best drink for heated areas, refreshing and cooling the body at the same time.
cn: 又热又辣！很适合在炎热地区饮用，酣畅淋漓过后还能让身体迅速冷却。

en: On behalf of His Highness, Lord Vorgoth, Guard of the North and Ruler of Rimgard His Lordship hereby declares by executive order: All stationed units of the Expansion Program must refrain from referring to Lord Vorgoth in distasteful or creatively unbecoming ways. All stationed units of the Expansion Program ought to report gossip and common scolds so they may be brought to justice by a scold's bridle, or, upon repeated offense, a stay in the dungeons of variable length according to the overseer's best judgment. Additional punishment, most appropriately dealt with a sharpened wooden spear of appropriate diameter and length, may be carried out at will — (The rest of the decree is too tattered and ripped to decipher.)
cn: 谨代表沃格斯领主，北境守卫以及里姆加德的统治者 我在此宣布沃格斯大人的最高指令： 严禁扩张项目的任何驻扎部队以粗鄙或别出心裁的荒谬用词来指代沃格斯领主。 扩张项目的所有驻扎单位需要第一时间汇报窃窃私语或者是放肆谩骂的行为，作为惩罚，违反上述规定者将被套上口笼，屡教不改者将会被关入地牢，具体刑期将由相关主管自行决定。 除上述手段外，主管还可以自行使用额外的惩戒手段，例如用符合长度与宽度的削尖木棍插入…… （敕令的其他部分已经变得破烂不堪，因此无法看懂。）

en: This plantain, not to be confused with a common banana, cannot be eaten raw. It's high in starch and can be used as a staple in many foods once cooked.
cn: 与常规香蕉不同，大蕉无法直接生吃。这种果实富含淀粉，煮熟之后能够作为许多饮食中的主食。

en: King Gormander of Meldore, son of glorious Pikemead, grand patron of the Revelwood and Springlands, watches over all. His vigilant gaze unites us as one, shields us from calamity, and ushers us into a new age of prosperity.
cn: 戈曼德，梅尔多尔的过往，荣耀的派克米德之子，春日平原和喧嚣森林的守护者，注视着所有人。他那警惕的目光将我们团结为一体，为我们抵御灾难，将我们带入繁荣的新时代。

en: I wonder what happened to the royal guard, and if anything or anyone is left of them.
cn: 我想知道皇家卫队发生了什么事，他们是否还剩下什么东西或人。

en: Woodland boots made of carefully layered leather straps.
cn: 用精心缝制的皮革带制成的丛林靴，展现出精湛的工艺。

en: You got my dagger! Did you know this blade used to be a giant's toothpick before I borrowed it? Keep the dagger! It should see more of the world than the inside of a giant's mouth.
cn: 你找到我的匕首了！你知不知道，在到我手上之前，这把利刃曾经是一根巨人的牙签？匕首就留给你好了！与巨人的臭嘴相比，你应该让它多看看这个世界的美丽。

en:
The Barber Elio needs to soothe his coffee addiction and has asked you for help.

He's instructed you to retrieve a machine for roasting coffee beans and suspects that such a thing could be found in Stillwater Bay, a town with a large harbor and nearby coffee plantations.

Reach Stillwater Bay to begin your search!
cn:
理发师埃里奥需要缓解自己的咖啡瘾，他希望你能够提供帮助。

他已经指示你去取回一台专门用于烘焙咖啡豆的机器，并且表示你也许能够在静水湾找到这种设备，那是一座拥有大型港口的城镇，而且附近就是咖啡豆种植园。

抵达静水湾以开始搜索！

en: When conserved, the Dried Purple Berry do not regenerate as much Health as the Purple Berries. However, the duration lasts longer.
cn: 与新鲜紫色浆果相比，经过保存处理的紫色浆果干虽然无法提供同样多的生命值，但是能够持续更久。

en: With this chest piece, you can cut through the woods with ease, remaining undetected as you prepare your next strike.
cn: 穿上这件胸甲，你可以不费吹灰之力在林间砍杀，并且悄无声息地为下一次打击做好准备。

en: A forgotten realm filled with ruins, hidden in this thicket! My nephew, that design enthusiast, would open his one eye wide at the sight of this! The cut of these stones of unknown origin is rudimentary but clean. Did the local Vukah tribe create these... tributes? I shall not wait around to find out! — Braelyn
cn: 一个遍布着各种遗迹的被遗忘国度，就隐藏在这片树林之中！要是我那个痴迷设计的侄子看见这些景象，他那唯一的眼睛估计都要睁大了！ 这些来源不明的石块外表十分粗糙，但是切口处却是异常工整。难道是本地的沃卡部落创造了这些……贡品？ 我已经迫不及待想要去一探究竟了！ - 布莱林

en: You've reached the allegedly haunted place the Barber mentioned: The "Maelstrom" Construction Site. Investigate the area to gather information about the "curse" and the manic, bright blue eyes!
cn: 你已经抵达理发师提到的闹鬼地点：“旋涡”建筑工地。 调查区域以收集关于“诅咒”以及疯狂的亮蓝色眼睛的线索！

en:
A detailed trilobite imprint. The structure of its exoskeleton can still be made out clearly.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.
cn:
一个详细的三叶虫印记。它的外骨骼结构仍然清晰可见。

此收藏品在 喧嚣森林 中找到。

en: A basic magical staff that is powered by the wielder's spirituality. Staffs can cast spells by using spell charges and mana. Equip spell charges to cast.
cn: 由使用者的灵魂驱动的基础法杖。 法杖能够通过消耗法术充能与法力施放法术。装备法术充能以施放法术。

en:
I sharpened the knives, patched the hole in my pants, and most importantly, re-attached the little jingly-bells to my hat! The stage looks alright, too. I don't think that the throwing distance will be a big issue. Everything's ready for the performance.

I wish I'd had more time to practice, but what's the worst that could happen? I've done this number countless times, so I'm sure it'll be alright.
cn:
我重新打磨了飞刀，把裤子上的洞也给补上了，最重要的是，我还给帽子重新安上了那些小铃铛！这里的舞台看着还不错。我觉得投掷距离应该不成问题。一切准备就绪，只等好戏开场。

真希望我有更多时间来练习，不过应该不会有问题的。毕竟我之前已经做过无数遍了，这次肯定不会出什么差错。

en: Flameborn, soften your voice. Can you hear the quiet ebb and flow of the encroaching waves, first minute, then crushing? Can you taste the salt of the sea and sweat? Hidden inside an evergreen basin, I spy a hint of blue. But there is a ripple in these still waters: A drop of blood from yonder years taints the sea and now laps at our shores, summoning vengeful spirits... forgotten, yet known. To persevere, we'll need someone to steer us forward — and sharpened blades.
cn: 火之子，请压低自己的嗓音。你能够听见包围一切的海浪的流淌声吗？那声音先是遥远模糊，接着立刻变得响彻天地？你能够尝到空气中那股海水独有的咸腥味吗？隐藏在一片永远碧绿的盆地中，我看见了一抹蓝色。但是那些平静的水面上出现了一道涟漪：来自遥远过去的一滴鲜血玷污了大海，如今被污染的汪洋正在拍打我们的海岸，并召唤着复仇的灵魂……它们被遗忘，但是从未离开。为了坚持下去，我们需要有人引导我们前进……并磨砺我们的剑刃。

en:
Conjuring Spirits

After dealing critical magic damage a mana orb is spawned at the target.
cn:
召唤灵体

造成魔法暴击伤害后将在目标位置创造一枚法力球。

en: A basic short sword designed for fights in narrow areas. Remarkably agile with a sharp tip.
cn: 用于在狭窄空间内战斗的普通短剑。十分锐利，而且挥舞起来也是异常轻松。

en: Expand your home by upgrading the Flame Altar to increase your protection range. Upgrading the Flame Altar requires a Shroud Core, which is aquired by defeating boss enemies. Increasing the range will give you more space to build in.
cn: 扩展你的家园，升级灵火祭坛以扩大保护范围。升级灵火祭坛需要用到首领掉落的瘴气核心。 扩大范围将提供更多的建造空间。
阿尔班耶夫山脉 瘴气巢穴

en: You found a letter which mentions mysterious catacombs. Reach the underground cemetery and investigate the entry!
cn: 你找到的一封信件里提到了神秘的地下墓穴。前往地下墓穴并调查那里的入口！

en: A dense, swirling vapor extracted from Fell casters. It is imbued with ethereal Shroud magic, making it invaluable for crafting magical armor and powering devastating spells. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Sicklescythes, initially found in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 从瘴气魔术士身上提取出来的蒸汽，浓厚而且旋转不停。里面蕴含着虚无缥缈的瘴气魔法，这种特性使其成为了制作魔法盔甲以及毁灭性法术的关键材料。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于燃火荒原中的瘴气魔镰鼬。

en: Show The Barber Some Enshrouded Ice
cn: 为理发师展示一些瘴气寒冰

en: Remember to look for those music sheets... if you're not too busy with the "rebuilding the realm" gig.
cn: 不要忘记留意乐谱……前提是你没有忙着在“重建王国”的话。
阿尔班耶夫山脉，驯服的绒毛山羊

en:
The Vukah hold inhumane rituals at <location>Fort Kelvin</location>. Marianne Reed reported that the Vukah regularly push the townsfolk off the cliff, and she wants to learn more.

Investigate the sacrificial pit!
cn:
沃卡正在<location>凯尔文要塞</location>举行诡异的仪式。玛丽安娜·里德汇报说沃卡会把抓住的居民推下悬崖，她想要弄清楚这背后的原因。

调查献祭坑！

en:
Their queen has fallen. Elixir and blood taint the mud. A soothing silence finally veils the night.

Collect multiple Scavenger Matron Helmets to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
女王业已驾崩，魔药与鲜血洒满泥泞。令人舒心的寂静笼罩了夜空。

收集多份拾荒者主母头盔以制作黑铁战利品。

en: A wanderer's boots, worn but still sturdy enough to carry your burdens on your journey.
cn: 一位旅人的靴子，虽然磨损严重但依旧结实，足以支持你负重前行。

en:
This Elixir of the Shroud contains great power... at a cost.

Increases your Damage against Fell but reduces your Time in the Shroud.
cn:
这瓶源自瘴气的魔药蕴含着巨大的力量……与代价。

提高你对瘴气魔造成的伤害，但同时减少你在瘴气中的停留时间。

en: You've read a note that referred to a nearby hunting party from the Kindlewastes! Look for remnants of the hunting party to search for its members!
cn: 你找到了一张字条，上面提到附近曾有一支来自燃火荒原的狩猎队！寻找狩猎队的营地并寻找其中的成员！

en: The earth becomes drier by the day. It crumbles betwixt my fingers into sand. I wipe beads of sweat from my forehead. Pale, sorrowful droplets stain the field. I doubt they'll find their way into the depths to feed the crops. I pray, silently, for my lips are too dry to speak... but I muster a smile when I serve the little I have. I built this tavern with my own hands... therefore, I cannot rest, nor leave. I will work this soil until the end, as my ancestors did before me. — Emily Fray
cn: 每一天，大地都变得愈发干涸。就在我的指间，极度干燥的土壤粉碎成了沙粒。我伸手擦去了额头上的汗珠。惨白又可怜的水珠落在了地上。但是恐怕它们也将转瞬即逝，根本无法去滋养植物在底下的根须。 我沉默地祈祷着，因为我的嘴唇已经干渴到无法张口说话……但是当接待客人的时候，我还是会努力微笑。这是我亲手打造的酒馆……我不能放弃，更不能离开。我会继续在这片土地上劳作直至终结，就像是在我之前的祖祖辈辈一样。 — 艾米丽·弗莱

en: You do not have the permission to upgrade the Flame.
cn: 缺少权限，无法升级灵火。

en: Just enough to protect the wearer from sparks.
cn: 能够勉强帮助穿戴者抵御火花。

en: So the ghastly catacombs that house the Hollow are real? My aunt <lorename>Elin</lorename> used to tell stories — but well, you know her. Always a tale-teller, that one. If ol' Balthazar has seen them himself.... then it is true. Oh, think of the materials! The architecture! The treasures!! I wish my little legs could take me there, too!
cn: 这么说那些潜藏着空荡的可怕墓穴是真的？以前我姑姑<lorename>艾琳</lorename>经常提到各种各样的故事，不过她这个人确实喜欢编故事。不过如果巴尔萨扎亲眼见过那些东西……那说明那一切都是真的。想想我们能从那里得到多少有用的材料！还有建筑构造方面的知识！那可都是真正的宝藏！！要不是我这双短腿，我真想亲自去那里看看！

en: Out of all the realms under the ever-stretching skies, I've been burdened with the wildest. Half my dominion lies strangled in vines; every root and rock conspires against my claim. My men are too weak-hearted to gain control of the old ruins. A trap laid in a watery tomb sends them scattering like vermin. Not one among them dares lay hammer to the temples, to grind them to dust so that order may reign once more. It may be wiser to turn eastward... the peaks aren't haunted by memory. Meanwhile, my dear siblings have summoned me to the annual ball — a tiresome charade of civility, forcing me to leave my throne unguarded. Do they not see the peril? My borders serve as the only defense against the conniving trickster gods! Mayhaps their invitation is yet another trap, another tomb to drown in...! ...Foolish thought. The vines enrapture my mind, wrapping me in paranoia. I shall attend, as duty commands — and I will urge them to build ballistas, not "Night Sanctums". Offering wisdom to a wordless horde... Truly, my kin have grown indulgent, bewitched by the Ancients’ secrecy. I must rest. Before dawn, I shall attend the audience of a wanderer who's wormed his way into my court. He claims to bear a gift from beyond. I will hear him. He promises diversion. — Lord Vorgoth, Guard of the North
cn: 纵观浩瀚苍穹之下的所有国度，唯独我被赋予了最疯狂的重担。我的半数领土已被藤蔓扼杀，每一处的根须与岩石都在试图颠覆我的统治。 我的手下们缺乏勇气，他们不敢尝试夺回古老的废墟。被淹没的墓穴中区区一道陷阱就足以把他们吓得魂飞魄散。没有一个人敢朝神殿举起锤子，但只有将那些地方碾成齑粉，秩序才有有可能回归。也许我应该将目光转向东方……那里的山峰还没有被过去的回忆所笼罩。 与此同时，我亲爱的兄弟姐妹们已经在呼唤我参与每年一度的舞会——我不得不参与那令人厌烦的社交会晤并抛下我的王座。难道他们意识不到眼前的危险吗？我的边境是抵抗那些阴险狡诈的诡计诸神的唯一屏障！也许他们的邀请也是一个陷阱，一个企图将我淹没的墓穴……！ ……这个想法太荒诞了。都怪那些藤蔓搅得我心神不安，让我有了这些不切实际的猜忌。我将参加舞会，这是我的职责所在——然后我会呼吁大家建造弩炮，而不是什么“黑夜圣所”。为那些无言的群众提供智慧……我的同胞们都已经被远古者的秘密蛊惑而放任自流。 现在我必须休息。在黎明到来前，我需要接见一位设法挤进我的宫廷的旅人。他宣称自己想要献上一份来自彼界的礼物。我打算会会这个人。说不定这能够让我稍稍放松一些。 ——沃格斯领主，北境守卫

en: A ghastly visage is carved into the mace, looking down on your foes as you smash them into the ground.
cn: 钉锤表面雕刻着的恐怖形象将在你轰击敌人时对他们投入蔑视。

en: Use Fast Travel And Speak To The Flame Of The Ancient Spire
cn: 使用快速移动并与远古尖塔的灵火交谈

en: A potion that enhances your vision in the Shroud.
cn: 服用后能够强化你在瘴气中的视野。
强制允许公开好友身份

en: Instantly restores a great amount of stamina.
Part of the Eagle Eye Armor.
A hood that provides additional protection from the sun, allowing you to focus your gaze undisturbed.
cn: 兜帽提供额外的遮阳设计，让你不受烈日干扰，专注于前方。

en: Face your enemy, one on one, and prove your domination once and for all.
cn: 单枪匹马直面你的敌人，向所有人证明你当之无愧的霸主地位。

en:
A standard, carved bow that reminds you of forgotten temples and overgrown tombs. Makes you want to go exploring for hidden riches!

Grave robbing is bad, and you shouldn't do it while anyone is looking.
cn:
让你想到被遗忘的神殿或者是荒废墓穴的标准雕纹弓。拿着这件武器你会情不自禁想要去探索隐藏的宝藏！

盗墓是一件有违道德的事，至少别在有人看见的时候做。

en: Adjust indirect light quality. A lower value improves performance.
cn: 调整间接光照品质。降低此数值以提升性能。

en: A fully grown Round-Billed Sailer, willing to donate fresh feathers for your cause.
cn: 一只完全成熟的圆喙水手，它已经准备好为你贡献新长出来的羽毛。

en: A useful frame that can hold the pieces of a Flame mosaic. It must be placed on the ground.
cn: 能够用来摆放火焰马赛克艺术品的框架。必须放置在地面上。
个人%k + 灵火祝福：%k + 临时加成：%k

en: This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
cn: 可以使用春日平原材料制作这种调色板。

en: It's not properly cooked. Eating this raw would cause nausea.
cn: 需要先进行烹调。生吃只会导致反胃。
新神的诞生 - 菲拉兹

en: A shield that will provide safety and aid. For a price.
cn: 这块盾牌能够提供良好的保护与帮助，但记住天下没有免费的午餐。

en:
You've found one piece of the wall tapestry. The second piece is not far away.
Reach the second location to obtain the other wall tapestry piece!
cn:
你已经找到了一块挂毯碎片。第二块碎片就在不远处。
抵达第二处位置并取回另一块挂毯碎片！

en: Health regeneration is increased by nearby Water Aura.
cn: 附近的水之光环提高了生命恢复速度。

en: It was written by the Ancients. Their strange and melodic call pierces the deafening void and brings forth those who are worthy and just. I cannot read it. I only see a blur... the message is not for me, I fear. I try to study it, to understand it... But the more I learn, the more I discover how much I do not know. I can observe the Sunken City from here, but not entirely in peace. Someone disturbed my research with an agonizing whistle recently. I thought it was a scavenger at first, but thankfully, I was wrong. Perhaps they will learn the star message's meaning. To all who've followed the call: Take my arrows, and let them guide you.
cn: 不过是远古者写的。它们那种奇怪而又优美的呼唤穿透了吞噬一切的虚空，并给那些公正与和合格之人指引着方向。但是我没办法看懂上面的内容。我的眼前只有一片模糊……恐怕这并不是留给我的讯息。我试图研究这份东西，努力想要弄明白其中的意思……但是就算我绞尽脑汁，我也只是愈发意识到自己的无知。 从这个位置，我可以观察沉没的城市，但我的内心却静不下来。最近总是有人在用难听的口哨干扰我的研究。我原本以为是某个拾荒者，幸好我猜错了。也许那个人能够搞懂星辰中蕴含的信息。 致所有跟随召唤之人：拿上我的箭矢，愿它们能够指引你

en: The metal plates provide added protection against jagged or poisoned arrows.
cn: 金属板可提供额外的保护，抵御锯齿箭头或毒箭。

en:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Humanity is shown as victorious! They drive the attackers back, and the Drak are forced to retreat overseas to an archipelago.
cn:
详细记载着卓克的历史的浮雕。

在这块浮雕的画面中，人类获得了胜利！他们击退了袭击者，于是卓克便被迫撤退到了海外的一片群岛中。

en: Does One Enjoy One Last Embrace?

Nutritious Dog food for tame pets.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
cn:
为已经驯服的宠物准备的营养狗粮。

必须被放置在对应的喂食器中。

en: Oh dear, just where can she be? My daughter, I've lost my little Marianne! I couldn't find her anywhere, she's gone with the winds! Please help me!
cn: 唉，她到底去哪了、我的女儿，我弄丢了我的玛丽安娜！哪里都找不到她，玛丽安娜就像是凭空蒸发了一样！求求你帮助我！
触发隐秘攻击将恢复10%体力。
中型空荡之夜南瓜 I

en: I will pray for your safety!

The Barber, Elio Ricci, wants to see a color palette that represents the former abundance of the Kindlewastes. The Farmer, Emily Fray, mentioned to him that such palettes could be found near farms or towns where people often dyed their own clothing. Elio wants you to explore such a farm to possibly find a color palette!
cn: 理发师埃里奥·里奇想要看看代表燃火荒原往日绚烂的调色板。 农民艾米丽·弗莱告诉他说可以在农场或者城镇附近寻找这种调色板，过去人们会用这些东西来给自己的衣服染色。 埃里奥希望你去探索符合条件的农场并寻找调色板！

en:
Ramone Jones used to be a reporter in <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>, writing about the failings of the newest King Gormander, son of Pikemead. He told you that King Gormander had a statue of Queen Pikemead dismantled and replaced, but parts of the statue might still be around. Ramone Jones has a lead that will guide you to the location of one such piece. 

Follow Ramone's lead and find the first piece of the statue!
cn:
雷蒙·琼斯曾是<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>的一名记者，他正在记录派克米德之子，戈曼德国王的陨落。雷蒙表示戈曼德国王曾命人拆除并替换了一尊派克米德女王的雕像，不过雕像的碎片有可能还在。现在雷蒙·琼斯手上正好有一条线索，你说不定能够借此找到其中一块碎片。

跟随雷蒙的线索并找到第一块雕像碎片！

en: Increases the skill level of Veteran
Increases the skill level of Warrior's Path
cn: 提高战士之道的技能等级

en: Shroud infused soil seems dangerous at first glance. However, when used in a controlled environment, it can create a potent bioactive environment that encourages rapid growth. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
cn: 乍一看，这些与瘴气融为一体的土壤似乎非常危险。不过在可控的环境下，这种物质就能够展现出强大的生物活性能力，并促进快速生长。 排水 这种材料会在溢出时排放少量水。

en: A savage weapon of black glass. The blade seems almost alive, dark as the void and sharp as Drak scales.
cn: 使用黑曜石打造的残暴武器。刃身宛若活物，色泽漆黑如渊，锐利如卓克鳞片。

en:
This well is deep enough to tap into even the most hidden water reservoirs. 

It was improved and can reach the groundwater quicker.
cn:
这口井的深度足以到达地下最深处的蓄水点。

这个改良后的建筑能够更快速汲取地下水。

en: A club with long, protruding spikes forged from moon-bathed steel. Spilled blood is easily visible on this weapon.
cn: 这把连枷的顶部安装有使用被月光渗透的钢铁打造而成的长长尖刺。表面仍然能够看见血迹。

en:
In a note, you read that a strange fisherman picked countless gloomberries in the Revelwood and disturbed the nearby visitors. You wonder what use the fisherman had for the gloomberries and where he resides.

Follow the river downstream towards the village of the fisherman and look for valuables there!
cn:
根据找到的一张纸条，你得知有一名古怪的渔夫曾经在喧嚣森林采摘了不计其数的暗夜果，而且他的奇怪举止也吓到了附近的其他访客。你不知道渔夫为什么需要这么多的暗夜果，也不知道他到底住在什么地方。

顺着河流前往下游区域，在渔民居住的村庄中寻找宝物！

en: We're not supposed to linger in wild waters! Who knows what dangers lie beneath the surface?
cn: 我们不能在野外水域中逗留太久！谁知道水面下潜藏着什么危险？

en: The boots of a wanderer were found alongside a body, seemingly handcrafted a long time ago. Weathered and worn, but still holding up.
cn: 被发现放在一具尸体旁的旅人靴子，似乎是很久以前手工制作的。虽然饱经风霜，但是依旧非常结实。

en: You’ve done well uncovering those eternal spells.
cn: 能够找到那些永恒法术，你做得很好。

en: Damage against Wildlife is increased by %k.
cn: 对野生动物的伤害提高%k。

en: A ritualistic staff that was cleansed in a still rivulet under a crescent moon. It serves the wielder to guide the undead back to the beyond.
cn: 这把原本用于举行仪式的法杖已经在新月之下的静河中得到净化。现在它将帮助使用者引导亡灵回归彼界。

en: Interact with campfires to cook food or sit near them with %k to become Rested in the wilds.
cn: 与篝火互动，烹饪食物，或按下%k坐在篝火旁，这么做将使你在野外也能获得休息良好。

en: Read all obelisks in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 查看燃火荒原中的所有方尖碑。

en: A delightful milkshake. Be careful with the sugar rush! It will regenerate your health and stamina.
cn: 一份美味奶昔。饮用后将会获得糖分冲击效果！这将恢复你的生命值与体力。
调整玩家的最大生命值。

en: An ice-cold axe with a central, vibrant gem. Its blades are adorned with small spikes to cause maximum damage. When this axe rains down on its enemies, it beautifully reflects the sun's light.
cn: 这把冰冷刺骨的斧子中央嵌有一枚颜色亮丽的宝石。斧刃上装有小型尖刺，因此攻击时能够造成最大化杀伤。将这把斧子挥向敌人时，斧刃将折射出美丽的日光。

en: When we were brought here to dig, the task was clear as day — despite the blueprints for our build arriving in stages, and without annotations. I've never worked in construction as a surveyor without knowing the architect until now. I did not inquire into their identity, since many architects prefer solitude, and some don't want their name attached to something distasteful — say, a dungeon for prisoners of war. Even dungeons have sick bays. Whatever we are building does not, but we were assigned many nurses instructed to archive any "unusual" incidents, and "symptoms"... I've since learned why. More workers are falling victim to strange accidents. Instead of entering the new century with a celebration, we worked long hours to transform the storage unit below into a temporary, but well-needed infirmary. I can keep quiet about many things. I know my place. But when breaching an enshrouded cavern and being told to continue onward, it's impossible to keep the workers from asking questions. What are we building? What are we reaching towards? I cannot answer, but whatever it is, it captures and imprisons the minds of my workers worse than any dungeon could.
cn: 最初被带过来挖掘的时候，安排给我们的都是很明显的任务，虽然建筑蓝图是分批次提供的，而且都没有注解。作为一名测量员，说实话这是我第一次遇到这种古怪的建筑项目。我并没有去过多追问其他人的身份，考虑到大部分建筑师都是独来独往，而且有些人并不希望让自己的名字跟这种见不得人的项目挂钩，说不定这是个用来关押战犯的地牢。 就算是地牢也应该有专门的医务室但我们现在在造的就没有，不过项目组倒是分配了很多护士，他们被要求记录所有“不同寻常”的事故，还有“症状”……后来我才知道原因。这段时间有越来越多的工人遇到了难以解释的事故， 所以我们没有在欢声笑语中庆祝一个新的百年的到来，而是加班加点将底下的仓库改造成了一座迫切需要的临时医务室。 我是个擅长保守秘密的人。我知道自己该做什么，不该做什么。但是当上级要求我们凿开一处被瘴气侵蚀的洞穴，并继续挖掘，工人们难免会有问题。我们到底在造什么东西？我们究竟在寻找什么？我不知道这些问题的答案，但无论我们在造的是什么，这个地方已经对我的工人们的心灵产生了远超地牢的破坏与禁锢。

en:
Faulty control scheme detected.
Please correct it before playing.
cn:
检测到控制方案存在问题。
请先修复问题，然后再开始游玩。

en: Rodrick was a fool and has exposed our affair. Florian, my simple-minded husband, must die so Rodrick and I can finally be at peace! I responded to the advert he obviously put in The Pike Weekly and know he plans to kill me. I will meet him at that chamber with a dagger in my bodice!
cn: 罗德里克这个傻瓜害得我们的外遇暴露了。现在我那个头脑简单的丈夫弗洛里安必须死，只有这样我跟罗德里克才能获得自由！我已经回应了他在崇山城周报上刊登的公告，很明显他是盯上了我的性命。不过他不知道的是，在前往秘密房间与他见面之前，我会在连衣裙里藏上一把匕首！

en: A delicate flute, decorated with swift aquamarine brushstrokes that carry the tones forth like silvery winds.
cn: 一个做工精美的笛子，漂移的海蓝色装饰条纹能够让吹奏的曲调像清风一样悠扬回响。

en: First, you were my savior. The other kids laughed at me when I couldn't read or write. You pushed them into the dirt, laughing back, and read me tales until I learned the words. You were smarter and braver. Later, you were my love. Holding hands by the riverbed, I confessed. You broke my heart, fiery whirlwind you are. I forgave you. How could I not? At least you were honest with me. Now, what are you? A hollowed-out husk, burnt up by anger. There's nothing left of the woman I once held dear. In the end, I told you not to do it. But you never listen, do you?
cn: 最初，你是我的拯救者。知道我不识字之后，其他孩子纷纷嘲笑我。但是你用力将他们统统推倒帮我出气，还一直给我读故事，直到最后我终于学会了识字。你比所有人都要聪明而且勇敢。 后来，你成了我的爱人。在河边牵着你的手的时候，我向你表白了。但是你就像一道凶猛的飓风一样撕碎了我的心。不过我很快便原谅了你。我有什么资格不这么做呢？至少你从来没有欺骗过我。 但是现在？你已经成为了一具被愤怒吞噬的空壳。我过去珍视的那个女人已经消失了。 在最后的那一刻，我明明叫你住手。但你就是不愿意听，对吗？

en: We could play more music if you found some music sheets! Maybe you'll get lucky and find some while exploring towns and taverns!
cn: 如果能够找到乐谱，我们就能够演奏更多音乐了！如果运气不错，说不定你可以在探索城镇与酒馆的时候找到散落的乐谱！

en:
I’ve been working in the nearby mine every day, but lately, I haven't been able to stop thinking that there might be more to be made from those aquamarine crystals than just hauling them out of the rock. I ground some down with a small grinder and ended up with the finest, most brilliant powder I’ve ever seen.

After mixing it with a few ingredients I had at home, I think I’ve created the perfect pigment. Tomorrow, I’ll prepare a small batch and show it to Casper.

Maybe this is my chance to leave the mine for good. This could be the start of something much bigger.
cn:
每天我都在附近的矿井里埋头苦干，但是最近我一直在不由自主地思考，也许那些海蓝宝石有着更多的用处，而不只是需要从石材里挑出来的废料。我使用一台小型研磨器将一些宝石磨成了我有史以来见到过最璀璨的粉末。

将粉末与我家里的几样原料混合起来之后，我认为我有可能已经创造出了最完美的颜料。明天，我会准备一小批颜料然后带给贾斯帕。

也许这是我离开矿井的机会。说不定这将是大事业的开端。

en: Fast Travel to last visited Altar
cn: 快速移动至最后拜访过的祭坛
理发就是我的激情所在。

en: This bow's natural resistance to fire makes it perfect for firing volleys of flaming arrows.
cn: 因为拥有着对于火焰的抗性，这把弓最适合用于发射密集的火焰箭矢。

en: A mystical pair of blades used for unspeakable divinations held under the full moon. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 在满月之下举行不可告人的占卜仪式时需要使用的神秘匕首。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Flint, Carter — Patient Data, Archived — Report Nr. A.053
cn: 卡特·弗林特 — 患者数据，已归档 — 病历号A.053

en: This improved tool will lose durability more slowly thanks to its steel cutting blade. Be careful with your fingers while woodworking!
cn: 钢制的斧刃能够有效减缓这种改良型工具的耐久度损失。伐木的时候小心不要切到手指！

en: A breezy tunic that's perfect for a day by the shore.
cn: 这款微风外衣非常适合在海边度过美好的一天。

en:
I knew something was up when I picked her up last! My little girl, Pompom, is pregnant! 

I've set up a small, cozy space in my basement for her. She looks tired, but I trust everything will go well. I still remember when I took care of her mother, picking scrap metal from her spotted fur. Her family is hardy, and they've survived worse! With some luck, they'll even outlive little old me! 

I'll have to set out many more doggy bowls. I want them to be safe and sound long after I'm gone!
cn:
抱起她的时候我就知道有什么地方不太对劲！原来我的绒球怀孕了！

我已经在地下室专门给她准备了一个温馨的小窝。她看上去累坏了，只希望接下来一切顺利。我还记得当初收养她妈妈的时候，那条斑点狗身上全是金属碎片。绒球一家都很顽强，再艰难的环境都无法打倒它们！说不定啊，它们甚至会比我这个小老太活得还要久！

我得多准备一批狗碗了。希望等我走了之后，它们也能够健健康康地生活下去！

en: These boots are perfect for keeping a stable stance while aiming, shooting, and killing.
cn: 这双靴子非常适合在瞄准、射击和杀戮时保持稳定的姿势。

en: A complex oven used by scholars of the alchemical mysteries.
cn: 研究炼金术奥秘的学者会使用的复杂炉子。

en: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain
cn: 在阿尔班耶夫山脉的一具巨龙骸骨上找到的藏宝图碎片。如果找齐所有碎片，也许你就可以拼凑出完整的地图。 地图碎片的背面写着字： 俄耳甫斯的回忆录： 生为旅人，我寻觅着炽热与极乐 现在我冰冻于时间之中，我的身体被锁链束缚 习惯了暗影之海与底层的深渊 这明亮之地刺痛了我的双眼，愿所有光芒消逝

en: A delicious jug of milk. Drinking it will grant you stamina and recharge your stamina faster!
cn: 一罐美味的奶。饮用后能够提供体力并加快体力恢复速度！

en: When killing an enemy with a Magic weapon, you have a %k chance to summon a friendly Skull Companion.
cn: 使用魔法武器杀死敌人时，有%k的几率召唤一个友好的骷髅同伴。

en: The Blacksmith wants a proper shop to smith and work in. Once he has a sheltered bed inside his workshop, he can craft more items. A Workbench, some Building Blocks and a Construction Hammer are needed to build a shop for the Blacksmith. You will first need a Workbench. Craft and place a Workbench from your Manual Crafting tab. Crafting a Workbench requires String and Wood Logs.
cn: 铁匠需要一处合适的工坊来进行锻造。当工坊里面有一张受到庇护的床之后，他就可以制作更多道具。 你需要一个工作台，一些建筑方块外加一个建筑锤才能为铁匠建造工坊。 首先你需要一个工作台。在手工制作面板中制作并放置一个工作台。制作工作台需要线绳以及圆木。

en: Could not find core resource package. Please reinstall the game.
cn: 无法找到核心资源包。请重新安装游戏。

en: Some buttons may be out of reach. Shoot them with an arrow to activate them.
cn: 有些按钮有可能位于无法触及的位置。使用箭矢射击来激活它们。

en: The Ancient Spire looms over the blighted land. There must be a way inside.
cn: 远古尖塔俯瞰着饱受摧残的大地。肯定有办法进入高塔。

en: You're exposed and feel cold. Equip clothing to protect yourself.
cn: 你已经暴露在外并且十分寒冷。装备服饰以保护自己。

en: The four-way cage around the mace's core forms an outward radiating crown when raised above the wielder's head. This serves as a final fanfare to victims before they're crushed at their ruler's feet. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
cn: 假如将武器高举至头顶，笼罩钉锤核心的四向笼便构成了一顶向外延展的璀璨王冠。这对于受害者来说将是最后的警示，因为下一刻他们就倒在统治者的脚下。 瘴气附魔： 这把武器已经被瘴气侵蚀，并且能够造成大量瘴气伤害。只能够在瘴气巢穴中找到。

en: You've found a piece of loungewear in the Nomad Highlands. Find every piece of the outfit to complete your set!
cn: 你在游牧高地找到了一件明媚便装的部件。找到所有部件以完成你的套装！
瘴气魔独眼巨人，阿尔班耶夫山脉瘴气区

en: A small organic gland that secretes a sticky liquid with a pungent smell.
cn: 小型腺体，能够分泌一种气味难闻的粘稠液体。

en: Look beyond yourself, into the fire. All will be revealed. Now go forth and explore.
cn: 凝视火焰，洞悉身外。一切都将被揭示。出发探索这个世界吧。

en:
Increases your Intelligence attribute by 1.

Increases Magic damage by 5% per Attribute Point.
cn:
令智力属性提升1点。

每点属性点增加5%的魔法伤害。

en:
With the rescue of the Lunar New Year Trader, you've unlocked the ability to craft the Serpent Warrior armor. Each piece is increasingly difficult to make.

Complete your set of the Serpent Warrior armor!
cn:
解救春节商人之后，你已经解锁了制作毒蛇战士护甲的能力。这种护甲的部件制作难度将逐步攀升。

设法完成你的毒蛇战士护甲套装！

en: Shoot down beehives from trees to retrieve honey and wax. Be careful! The hives are usually protected by their swarm.
cn: 将树上的蜂巢击落即可获取蜂蜜和蜡。不过要小心！蜂巢往往受到蜂群的保护。

en:
3.6	
You are also prohibited from any actions that are equivalent in effect to the foregoing prohibitions.
cn:
3.6	
此外，禁止您采取任何在效力上与上述禁止行为等同的行为。

en: You've heard rumors of a mystical dragon cave in the Nomad Highlands. Explore the area marked on your map to investigate!
cn: 你听说了有关游牧高地中的一处神秘龙穴的传闻。探索地图上的标记区域并一探究竟！

en:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison. 

This variant can be found in the Albaneve Summits.
cn:
散发着光耀的能量旋涡，用于将宝石嵌入各类武器。

最初由远古者使用，之后又被瘴气魔据为己有并成为了怪物们的养料，直到最后才被你从有机物质的牢笼中解救出来。

可以在阿尔班耶夫山脉中找到这种形态的能量。

en: Some scratched up Mercenary Boots. Kick your enemies when they're down!
cn: 有些划痕的佣兵靴子。在敌人倒地时补上最后一击！

en: The tough and scaly skin of a reptile.
cn: 取自蜥蜴的皮革，柔韧而且布满鳞片。
艾米丽·弗莱遗失的戒指

en: A blade forged from the pure, reflective copper commonly found in the Revelwood. While you can spy a hint of patina across its body, there's no noticeable discoloration.
cn: 使用常见于喧嚣森林的纯净而且明亮的铜矿锻造而成。虽然剑身上已经浮起了一丝铜锈的色泽，但除此以外并没有任何明显的褪色。

en: Simple Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes I
cn: 简易热带木制篱笆（绳索） I

en: Psst, my stylish friend. Come closer. I need to share a secret!
cn: 喂，华丽时尚的朋友。过来。我有个秘密要告诉你！

en: Hey there! Was that you I saw holding a fish? Thought so. I have a useful tip for you.
cn: 你好！刚刚我是看见你举着一条鱼吗？我猜就是。我有一个实用的建议。

en: I must've fallen asleep, because when I woke up, I was here. Had the taste of blood in my mouth, so I pulled another rotten tooth from my jaw and crushed it under my heel. I hate them all. Wish I could crush their throats, too. "Image is everything — Look, don't lose your cool!" "Daniel, you freak! Calm down! You'll upset everyone!" "Good fortune is all around, friend! Just don't be miserable!" Everyone's always yapping! Do this, do that! One more, and I'll bash their heads in with my Hand Drum! Especially Chester's! By the Flame, I hate Chester! His stupid luck will soon run out... That old fool's headed straight toward a Scavenger fort on his way up North. What an idiot... his luck won't save him this time!!
cn: 之前我肯定是睡着了，醒来的时候就发现自己来到了这个地方。我嘴里有一股血腥味，接着我就从下巴里拔出了另一颗烂掉的牙齿，然后又丢到地上用鞋跟踩碎。我讨厌他们每一个人。真希望我能把他们的脑袋也踩在脚下碾碎。 “一个乐手的形象最重要，所以千万不能在表演时失控！” “丹尼尔，你这个怪胎！冷静！大家都被你吓坏了！” “运气这种事不是随随便便的嘛，朋友！别整天闷闷不乐的了！” 每个人都在喋喋不休说个不停！做这个，做那个！要是再有人敢对我指手画脚，看我不拿手鼓砸烂他们的脑袋！尤其是切斯特！灵火在上，我最讨厌的就是切斯特！他的运气早晚有一天会用光……现在那个老傻瓜已经去北面的拾荒者要塞了。真是个蠢货……这回运气再好也救不了他！
提高所有魔法火焰伤害

en: A steel axe, decorated with gold accents. It makes you feel much stronger, although the blade itself is most likely not improved by much.
cn: 一把使用黄金点缀的钢斧。虽然武器本身的性能并没有得到太多提升，但是将它拿在手里的时候，你感觉自己无比强大。

en: The base duration for the Rested buff is increased by %k minutes. Rested The Rested buff increases your Stamina Maximum and Regeneration significantly. It requires shelter, sitting or sleeping, as well as warmth from a heat source. The buff can be refreshed anywhere. Surrounding comfort items further increase its duration.
cn: 休息良好增益的基础持续时间延长%k分钟。 休息良好 休息良好增益将大幅提高你的体力上限与恢复。 你需要准备能够坐下或睡觉的庇护所，以及一处热源来提供温暖。 增益能够在任意位置刷新。 在周围放置舒适度物品可以进一步延长增益持续时间。

en:
A great snack that stimulates the brain.

Increases your magic damage by a small amount.
cn:
能够激发智慧的上等零食。

小幅提升你的魔法伤害。

en: A throwable light that activates upon landing, even underwater. Not as strong as other light sources.
cn: 可投掷的光源，落地时将激活，就算在水下也能正常使用。与其他光源相比强度较弱。

en: You cannot take more photos. Delete a photo to take a new one.
cn: 你无法拍摄更多照片。在拍照前请先删除一张照片。

en: Maybe they can be used as strings? They seem to be pretty robust.
cn: 也许能够当成天然绳索使用？看上去倒是挺结实的。

en: Those who wield the Chief Drak'Dal Axe command great awe — one swing is enough to bring a tribe to its knees. It's taken many lives, and lusts for countless more.
cn: 那些挥舞卓克·达尔酋长斧子之人往往令人生畏——只需要挥舞一次就足以征服整个部落。这把武器曾经夺走过许多生命，但它的嗜血渴望从未被满足。

en: (The writing is faded, as though the note was written a long time ago.) They knocked on your door again today while you were away. I hid as you told me, but I heard their muttering from upstairs. The guards said they'd return. Sheltering me brings you suffering, I know it. I've decided I no longer wish to hide. I'll go willingly to the Hollow Halls beneath East Lapis. If I don't comply soon, the guards will do more than knock. Thank you for everything. I'm sorry it wasn't enough. You cannot protect me from the guards, or atonement.
cn: （字迹已经褪色，上面的内容似乎是很久以前写下的。） 今天你出门的时候，他们又来敲门了。我照你说的那样藏了起来，但是我在楼上听见了他们的谈话。守卫们说他们还会回来。 我知道包庇我让你感到痛苦。所以我决定了，我不会再躲起来。我会自愿去东之岩下面的空荡礼堂。我知道如果我再不认罪，守卫们要做的就不仅仅是敲门了。 谢谢你为我做的一切。对不起最后还是变成了这样。虽然你想方设法保护我，但说到底我还是必须自己去面对守卫并赎罪。

en: Allows you to catch a critter from the Shroud.
cn: 允许你捕获瘴气中的昆虫。

en:
You've reached the Farmer's spot near the caravan stop and gathered Calla Lunas.

Return to the Barber with the Calla Lunas in your inventory to show him their vibrancy!
cn:
你已经去过农民提到的在车队营地附近的位置，并且采集了月之莲。

回去找理发师时确保物品栏中拥有对应的物品，让他感受到这些植物的鲜艳！

en: It contains ice and gentian — a failed attempt at herbal iced tea? Its strengths certainly do not lie in its taste.
cn: 里面含有冰以及龙胆，也许是某种失败的草药冰茶？不过强烈的味道说明它的效果确实不容小觑。

en: Shelter, my friend. My potions, my tools — useless without shelter. Please build me a room where I can work properly and include a bed!
cn: 我需要庇护所，朋友。我的药水还有工具……没有庇护所的话那些东西根本派不上用处。请给我建造一个放着床的房间，这样我才能开始工作！

en: Critical Strikes with Bows restore %k Mana.
cn: 使用弓造成暴击将恢复%k法力。

en: A <craftingstation>Black Cauldron</craftingstation>! Fantastic, my friend! Together, we will prosper!
cn: <craftingstation>黑坩埚</craftingstation>！太好了，我的朋友！只要齐心协力，我们必能发展壮大！

en: The Fisher thinks that defeating a Drak leader in a duel will weaken your foes. To challenge one of their commanders, you will have to prove yourself first. Defeat 25 Drak to gain the attention of their leaders. You can find Drak anywhere in the heart of the Veilwater Basin, or further out West. They're only found above the Shroud. A convenient place is marked on the map.
cn: 渔夫认为在决斗中打败一个卓克首领将能够削弱你们的对手。但是为了有机会挑战它们的指挥官，首先你得设法证明自己。 打败25个卓克以获得它们的首领们的注意。 你可以在幕水盆地腹地的任意地点或者是更远的西方找到卓克。它们只会出现在瘴气上方。地图上已经标记了一处合适的地点。

en: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!
cn: 不可思议的炼金术带来的烟花！

en:
The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.

Collect multiple Fell Wispwyvern Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
潮汐的变化对这只生物并不友好。也许它终于可以休息了。

收集多个瘴气魔荧龙头颅来制作战利品。

en: I see you managed to clear that Elixir Well. Keep it up and you might start to become popular around here!
cn: 看来你已经成功清理了魔药之井。再接再厉，要不了多久你就能打响自己的名声了！

en: Deep blue pants made from opaque material. With these, warmth will embrace you like a cocoon.
cn: 使用厚实材料制作的深蓝色裤子。它们将像虫茧一样温暖地包裹住你。

en: Here you can place items in your action bar to quickly access them in the game.
cn: 您可以在动作栏中放置物品，以便在游戏中快速使用它们。

en: Martha's Diary, Second Entry of Midyear, 503 D.A.
cn: 玛莎的日记，岁中第二篇，503 D.A.

en: A heavy blade that's split alongside the central ridge. Caution is advised, as some believe it to be a forked-tongued omen that taints the wielder's heart with lies. Yet, their caution spells weakness, and their words drip with envy... They would wield it if they could. Why shouldn't you? Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
cn: 沿着中心剑脊分开的沉重剑刃。有人认为这种充满不祥意味的蛇舌形象会让使用者的心灵被谎言所玷污。 但那种言论不过是来自软弱之人的嫉妒……只要有机会，他们会毫不犹豫地拿起这把武器。你也一样，对吗？ 瘴气附魔： 这把武器已经被瘴气侵蚀，并且能够造成大量瘴气伤害。只能够在瘴气巢穴中找到。

en: Stamina cost for sprinting on dirt roads is reduced from 90% to 80%. Stamina cost for sprinting on stone roads is reduced from 75% to 50%.
