cn: 在土路上冲刺的体力消耗从90%降低至80%。 在石路上冲刺的体力消耗从75%降低至50%。

en: Fell Enemies, Nomad Highlands Shroud, Kindlewastes Shroud and Albaneve Summits Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔敌人，游牧高地、燃火荒原以及阿尔班耶夫山脉瘴气区
欢迎来到《雾锁王国》试玩版！

en: Build A Sheltered Bed For Balthazar
cn: 为巴尔萨扎建造一张受到庇护的床

en: The cold and heartless depths of the Hollow Halls have been my home for long enough. Furthermore, in the far reaches of my memory, in a time before the descent, I remember the pulse of the shimmering north winds... I've had my share of shivers and shackles. I beg you for a fine roof and a hearth to light this old soul ablaze, my friend.
cn: 空荡礼堂寒冷与死寂的深处一直是我的家。我依稀记得，在深入地下之前，我曾经感受过凛冽北风的吹拂……但我现在已经厌倦了寒冷与枷锁。我恳请你为我寻找一处能够遮风挡雨的屋檐与温暖的炉火，重新点燃我垂垂老矣的灵魂吧，朋友。

en: Seems as though your blade has found the neck of a Drak leader. Where one falls, countless others will strive to take their place, locked in a dance for dominance, chained to its tact. Tomorrow, fresh hatchlings will rise from this spilled blood, but today, it shall strengthen us.
cn: 看来你的剑刃已经与一位卓克首领的脖颈相遇。但就算它倒下了，无数的替代者仍然将前仆后继，它们已经被困在了争夺霸权的舞蹈中，动弹不得。明天，新一批幼崽将从挥洒的鲜血中崛起，但是今天，这些鲜血使我们变得更加强大。

en: Care to look at my craft?

The fabric of this coat is thick enough to protect against incoming blows. Additionally, the inner lining follows the direction of the body's veins, allowing the wearer to unleash short-range magic more easily.
cn: 这件外套的厚实布料能够有效抵抗来袭打击。除此以外，衣物的内衬还能够跟随体内血管的流向，允许穿戴者更轻松地释放近距离魔法。
探索被遗忘的灵火神殿

en: A fur hood that protects the wearer's face from the strong, cutting mountain winds.
cn: 毛皮兜帽将保护穿戴者的脸庞不会受到山间的凛冽寒风侵扰。

en: Increases your Ice Resistance by %k, which reduces the amount of Ice damage received.
cn: 使你的寒冷抗性提高%k，这将降低你承受的寒冷伤害。

en: Defeating an enemy with a Magic weapon restores Health equal to 3 times your Intelligence to all players within 15 meters of the target.
cn: 使用魔法武器击杀一名敌人时，目标周围15米范围内的所有玩家将获得等同于你的智力3倍的生命值。

en: A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 用于汲取日食之力的魔棒。当被黑暗笼罩的太阳只能散发微弱的光芒时，魔棒将发挥最强大的力量。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。 虚空复制： 魔棒的独特魔法使其有30%的几率制造出额外的射弹。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: NVIDIA Reflex reduces system latency and increases PC responsiveness
cn: NVIDIA Reflex将降低系统延迟并提高PC设备的响应速度

en: A long furry coat, often worn by the citizens of the Albaneve Summits. It's very cozy.
cn: 一件毛茸茸的长外套，属于阿尔班耶夫山脉居民们的常见穿着。穿上去十分舒服。

en: How can the night sky stay calm when it faces a sea of liars? I feel like I'm seeing the stars for the first time. As if a dark, velvet blanket has been lifted from my eyes, allowing me to bear witness. There was never an ancient weapon here. We were always intruders. What else do they not want me to know? All these years, wasted by blindness Sneaking past the rules of the physical world, not realizing my mind was captured just the same I considered myself cunning while betting blindly on the cards I was handed... but it's a fool's game to share the table with liars and cheats. I have to disappear I have to stop this madness, this indoctrination And I can't leave any clues or witnesses They always spell trouble I know that much at least Darya
cn: 在面对像这样无边无际的谎言之海时，为什么夜空还能如此平静？ 此时此刻，我感觉像是有生以来第一次真正看见了头顶的星辰。就像是原本蒙在眼前的黑暗天鹅绒布被揭开了一样，我终于看清了真相。 这里从来就没有什么“远古武器”。 自始至终，我们才是唯一的入侵者。 还有什么他们在瞒着我的？ 这么多年的光阴 就在无法用肉眼捕捉的枷锁中蹉跎殆尽，我甚至没有意识到，我的意识也早已成为囚徒 我自以为聪明过人，但其实我只是在预先塞给我的扑克牌上胡乱下注……在这张充斥着骗子与作弊之人的赌桌上，我根本毫无胜算。 我必须离开 我必须制止这疯狂，这种洗脑式的谎言 但是我不能留下任何线索或目击证人 我必须杜绝后顾之忧 至少这一部分是我确定的 达亚

en: May the wind be with you.
Scales the value of the plant growth speed.
This bow is so precise that it can split a faraway snowflake in two.
cn: 这把精准无比的弓甚至能够粉碎远方飘落的雪花。

en: This armor provides perfect protection when venturing out into the forest.
cn: 在森林中冒险时，这件盔甲将为你提供完美的保护。

en: Solid gold bars that serve as both a crafting material and a status symbol.
cn: 即是制作材料又是一种身份象征的实心金条。

en: To all who set their eyes upon my wonderous — no, allow me to begin again. To the people of Meldore, and all of Embervale — I have conquered this terrain with my greatness! I'm afraid that's not right, either... The bridge is nearly finished, and I cannot find the words to express my joy, confound it! How lucky we had a bountiful mine so close by for materials and ore! One thing I do know: I'll name this bridge Braelyn, after my 5th Aunt! Though I'm not sure she would be flattered... for her and the bridge share not just the name, but a brash nature. Signed, Cade Hawthorn, Yearwake, 490 D.A.
cn: 致所有有机会亲眼目睹我的神奇……不不，我得换个说法。 致梅尔多尔以及薪谷的所有人民，我已经凭借自己的聪明才智征服了这片土地！好像也不太对…… 大桥已经接近竣工，但我却不知道该如何表达自己的喜悦，唉！感谢上天赐给我们这座丰饶的矿井，各种材料与矿石都唾手可及！ 不过有一件事我可以确定：我要给这座桥起名叫布莱林，这是我的五姑姑的名字！不过我不确定她会不会喜欢我这么做……因为我那个姑姑和大桥一样，都很“聒噪”。 此致， 卡迪·霍桑， 岁初，490 D.A.

en: An elegant dual dagger set with extravagant gold detailing. It's slim enough to be smuggled underneath a nightgown unseen into any chamber. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 使用奢华镀金装饰的优雅匕首。狭长的外形使得它能够轻而易举地藏在睡衣之下并确保不会被任何人发现。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Do you celebrate the Lunar New Year? Maybe you're in the market for some new furnishings? On my way to the valley, I sold a few decorative plants to the people of <location>Fort Kelvin</location>, but their beauty will go to waste without any eyes to feast on them. We could change that!
cn: 你们这里会庆祝农历新年吗？也许你需要一些新的家具？在来山谷的路上，我卖了不少装饰植物给<location>凯尔文要塞</location>的人们，但现在他们都已经不在了，如果那些美丽的植物就这么白白浪费实在是太可惜了。好在我们有办法拯救它们！

en: Get a cut! Gain a new perspective!
cn: 来换个发型！尝试不一样的角度！

en: A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with small pieces of flint at the tip.
cn: 略微改良后的木箭，箭尖加装了一小块燧石。

en: A nice, cream-colored hood to keep you warm and snug. The droopy little ears are purely fashionable, but aren't they cute?
cn: 温暖的奶白色兜帽，能够为你提供温暖与舒适。耸拉着的小耳朵纯粹是用来装饰的，不过看上去是不是很可爱？

en: Craft Or Obtain A Construction Hammer
cn: 制作或获取一把建筑锤
增加对飞行敌人的伤害。

en: The Flame doesn't give ya wings, kid! Craft a Glider at the Workbench — it'll make getting around a little easier. Perfect for brave ones like you. Don't forget that using a Glider drains Stamina — but from what I've seen, you've got it in ya!
cn: 灵火不会给你翅膀，孩子！在工作台处制作一个滑翔翼 - 它会让你的行动更加方便。非常适合像你这样勇敢的人。别忘了，使用滑翔翼会消耗体力 - 但我觉得你一定没问题的！

en: In order to rest, one must be sheltered, sitting or sleeping in a safe and warm environment. The duration of the Rested Buff will charge while resting. While being rested, your stamina and stamina regeneration are improved.
cn: 如果想要休息，你必须在安全与温暖的环境中受到庇护，并且处于坐着或者睡着的状态。 在休息时，休息良好加成的持续时间将会自动提升。休息良好加成将能够改善你的体力与体力恢复。

en: You haven't seen the last of me.
When wounded warriors see this hat peak up from the horizon, they know salvation is near. Then they notice that the hat is a little bit cone-shaped. They usually don't say anything about it, though.
cn: 一旦看见远方出现了这顶高耸帽子，受伤的战士们就知道自己即将得到救赎。但是凑近之后，人们会意识到这顶帽子的形状有点像一个傻傻的圆锥。不过欣然得救的战士们通常不会对这种小事发表意见。

en: The captain seems to have lost his clothing in Stillwater Bay at some point. Find his lost coat and claim it as your own!
cn: 船长以前似乎曾在静水湾丢了一件衣服。 找到他遗失的外套并将其据为己有！

en: Duu, duu, duu, du-du-du, duu, duu, duu... Ah, I didn't notice you there! Welcome to my jam. Maybe you could help me? I don't have the right instrument for this flow, but I believe a handpan would be perfect! They're local to the Veilwater Basin, so they're hard to obtain elsewhere. Maybe you can find one in a trade hub?
cn: 嘟、嘟、嘟、嘟嘟嘟、嘟、嘟、嘟……啊，我刚刚没注意到你在这里！欢迎倾听我的即兴表演。也许你可以帮我个小忙？我缺少演奏这段旋律需要的乐器，我认为一个手碟应该再合适不过！那是幕水盆地的本土乐器，所以其他地方都很难找到。也许你可以在某个交易中心找到它们？

en: I can't believe it! My daughter, you've brought me my daughter!
cn: 难以置信！我的女儿，你找到了我的女儿！

en: When you kill an enemy with a melee weapon, you gain 20% more experience.
cn: 使用近战武器击杀敌人时额外获得20%经验。

en: Increases the skill level of Heavy Plates
cn: 提高重型甲胄的技能等级

en: The Fell took the Archaic Essence I into a winding, enshrouded cave. What purpose are they after? Explore the depths of the Shroud Lair to proceed! Consider gathering more Archaic Essence I as you go forth to reclaim it from the Shroud!
cn: 瘴气魔将远古精华 I带进了一座被瘴气侵蚀的曲折洞穴。他们到底有什么目的？ 探索瘴气巢穴的深处以继续！前进途中记得从瘴气那里取回额外的远古精华 I！

en: The Huntress told me about your first catch! What a great achievement. You know, you should grill them to bring out the best benefits. I’ve even heard they can boost your oxygen while diving!
cn: 女猎人告诉我说你钓上了第一条鱼！这可是一项了不起的成就。知道吗，你应该试着将它们做成烤鱼，这样你就能够得到最好的效果。我甚至听说它们能够让你在潜水时拥有更多氧气！

en:
The Bard told you to search in the ruins of Ocean's Heart for the final instrument. A Queen named Jezmina learned how to play the harp from Valory there. 

Go to the location and search for the instrument!
cn:
吟游诗人表示你应该前往海洋之心的废墟寻找最后的乐器。以前，一位名叫杰兹米娜的女王曾在那里向瓦罗里学习竖琴的演奏技巧。

前往标记位置并寻找乐器！

en: WE BROKE THROUGH the wall! Lupa tore the stones apart, and behind the rubble, there REALLY WAS a cave! As the dust settled, we were met with the ravenous glares of a Vukah clan... but nothing could phase us with the matron by our side! She grovelled and roared, spat and crushed — In her blighted rampage, she nearly skinned them alive! The way is clear, the skies are bright! We won't stop here! We'll claim the world! Raven's Keep is only the beginning! Lupa's sister will take Surat's Rest whilst we build a LAIR of our own to eclipse Umber Hollow! The Nomad Highlands, no, perhaps all of Orindell will be ours! GLORY to matron Lupa!
cn: 我们逃到墙外了！ 卢帕直接掀翻了砖石，果然和她说的一样，瓦砾废墟之后赫然有一座洞窟！灰尘散去之后，我们遇到了一支饥肠辘辘的沃卡氏族……但是有夫人在我们身边，这帮家伙根本不是我们的对手！ 只见卢帕咆哮暴走， 所到之处尽是酸液唾沫与被压扁的敌人，在毫无理智的狂暴状态下，卢帕几乎要将对手们活活扒皮！ 前进的道路已经畅通，天空可真亮啊！但我们并不会止步于此，这个世界属于我们！渡鸦堡只是一切的开始！卢帕的姐妹将拿下苏拉特之息，与此同时我们将在这里打造一个足以让褐赭空洞相形见绌的巢穴！ 游牧高地，不，也许整个奥林戴尔都将属于我们！ 荣耀归于卢帕夫人！

en: When equipped with a Melee weapon, you can perform a Kick by attacking while blocking. Kicking deals little damage, but hits the target with massive force and pushes them back, filling their Stun Bar. Stun Bar increase scales with Dexterity. Stun time depends on the enemy's size. Overpower Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered. Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.
cn: 装备近战武器时，你可以通过在格挡状态下攻击来发动一次踢击。 踢击只能造成较少的伤害，但是巨大的冲击力将使敌人的晕眩条上涨并将其击退。 晕眩条增长幅度受你的敏捷影响。 晕眩时间取决于敌人的大小。 压制 攻击格挡中的敌人或者是招架敌人的攻击都会使他们的晕眩条上涨，直到最后进入被压制状态。 被压制的敌人将毫无防备，这种时候你可以对其发动残酷打击。

en: Does One Enjoy The Fruit Of The Vine?
Glowing flies that fly in swarms
Some Roles have the same password.
Deleting this savegame will prohibit future editing of this Shared World entry.
cn: 删除此游戏存档将使你无法继续编辑这个共享世界条目。

en:
A mesmerizing display of overwhelming power, and little intelligence.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
cn:
这件令人印象深刻的战利品展示着超乎想象的力量与少得可悲的智慧。

收集多个瘴气魔独眼巨人头颅以制作青铜战利品。

en: Stalking prey in these boots makes barely any sound. None will hear you coming.
cn: 穿着这双靴子跟踪猎物几乎不会发出任何声音。没有人会听到你的脚步声。

en: "What a hovel", I thought. Bunch of bandits, rotten crooks, and half-wits, itching to shank another over a game of cards. The crew is rowdy, but a few days of digging in the mine mellow even the toughest of brigands. A single promise binds us together. "Elixir for all". I hope Sameth is a man of his word.
cn: “什么鬼地方”我心里想着。这里尽是些心狠手辣的恶棍和蠢货，为了点鸡毛蒜皮的小事就准备打个你死我活。这些家伙确实不好管教，但是在矿井里面挖上几天之后，就算是再桀骜不驯的强盗都会立刻服帖起来。 我们所有人都是为了同一个目标。“取之不尽的魔药”。 希望赛姆斯不要食言。

en: A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 原本覆盖在灰烬之中的奇怪魔棒。尽管已经严重扭曲变形，但仍然丝毫没有断裂的迹象。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn: 可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: These gauntlets shield your arms as you chase through the undergrowth, striking foes from afar.
cn: 这些臂铠能够保护你的双臂，你将能够在茂密的灌木中安全追逐猎物并狩猎远方的敌人。

en: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to keep your head from getting wet. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 用于建造茅草屋顶。虽然原始却十分可靠，能够让你不被雨水打湿。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en:
A tiny flame, a tiny light
banishes the darkness and all its blight
cn:
渺小的火焰与微小的光芒
驱散黑暗与徘徊其中的痛苦

en: A lotion that protects you from the cold seeping in. It grants its user +1 ice armor per character level.
cn: 这种药水能够帮助你抵御寒冷。使用后每个角色等级+2寒冰护甲。

en: Here Lie The Creators Of Fantastic Waterworlds
cn: 奇妙水世界的创作者们长眠于此

en: These daggers are sleek and swift. The blade is sharp as ever. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 拥有着细长外形的迅捷匕首。刀刃仍然锋利无比。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: The Barber claims he is once again in desperate need of inspiration. He asks you to gather something that reminds him of the orange-tinted sky at sunrise. Collect orange Daylilies from Veilwater Basin and bring them back to him.
cn: 理发师表示他再一次迫切需要灵感。他请求你去收集一些能够让他想到日出时分的橘色天空的东西。 从幕水盆地收集橘色日光百合并带给他。

en: The Nomad Highlands, laced with forgotten promises of adventure and riches. Its underbelly is a wasteland, a hunting ground for the condemned. Those below gaze up at the glistening dawn above, tracing the faraway gold streaks of morning light with their fingertips. "Enough" is always out of reach.
cn: 游牧高地之中充斥着被遗忘的挑战与财富。但其实浓雾之下不过是一片荒芜废土，被诅咒者们在其中徘徊寻找着猎物。每逢清晨来临，他们的目光便会追逐起头顶的黎明，每根手指都徒劳地想要抓握住那一缕遥不可及的金光。但是对于那些人来说，这是永远无法得到满足的渴望。

en: Keep practising, one day you will be able to catch bigger fish!
cn: 继续练习，总有一天你能够钓上更大的鱼！

en: Wearing these gloves makes the pulse slow down mysteriously before going in for the kill, thus steadying the hands.
cn: 戴上这副手套后，脉搏会在致命一击前神秘地减慢，保持双手稳定。

en: Damage against flying enemies is increased by %k.
cn: 对飞行敌人造成的伤害提高%k。

en: Fossil Showcase (3 Small and 2 Medium Slots)
cn: 化石展示柜（小型栏位x3 & 中型栏位x2）

en: A glimmering ring, plucked from the remains of someone who got more than they bargained for.
cn: 一枚闪闪发光的戒指，从一位沦为自身贪欲牺牲品之人的尸骸上搜刮而来。

en: Scholar of the Young Flame Cloak
When equipped with a Two-Handed weapon, trigger a whirl attack at the end of an attack chain. Cost: 75 stamina
cn: 装备双手武器时，在攻击连招结束时触发一次回旋攻击。 消耗：75点体力

en: This pair of trousers looks plain at first glance, but the craftsmanship allows the wearer to produce and retain more warmth from within.
cn: 这条长裤乍看平淡无奇，但精湛的工艺却能让穿着者由内而外感到温暖。

en: Flameborn, our home is blooming. It awakens new hope in me — Do you remember the mysterious letter and the tools you retrieved for me? Only one person could've tried to reach me from beyond Umber Hollow. I know it might all be for nothing... but if my daughter Rochelle is out there, I must ask you to search for her.
cn: 火之子，如今我们的家已经生机勃勃。这给我带来了新的希望，你还记不记得，之前帮我找到的神秘信件和那些工具？我想来想去，只有一个人可能会试图从褐赭空洞之外联系我。我知道希望渺茫……但如果我女儿罗茜真的还活着，我必须求你去找她。

en: Fell Sicklescythe, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔镰鼬，首次出现：游牧高地瘴气区

en: Aye, hauled me up from the deep, did ya?
cn: 哦，是你把我从海底捞了出来吗？

en: Big and bulky gloves, usually worn when wielding large weaponry and shields.
cn: 大而笨重的手套，通常在挥舞大型武器和盾牌时佩戴。

en: An axe forged from shadowy steel crowned with a single, slim gemstone. The grip is mantled with boreal wood.
cn: 使用暗钢锻造而成的斧子，嵌有一枚细长的宝石。斧柄使用了北地木材进行加固。

en: You've found the Hollow Halls in the Kindlewastes. Descend and reach the end to please the <npc>Collector</npc>.
cn: 你已经找到了燃火荒原中的空荡礼堂。前往最深处并完成<npc>收藏家</npc>的任务。

en: A small amount of essence from the Flame! By feeding it back to the Flame Altar maybe it could become stronger and burn even brighter.
cn: 来自灵火的少量精华！将其重新投入灵火祭坛将能使其中的灵火变得更加强大明亮。

en: With a roof over my head, I could make tools for survival. I'd prefer a cave... but I'll consider regular shelter. For now.
cn: 有了自己的房间之后，我就可以制作各类生存工具。虽然我倾向于天然洞窟……但是普通的庇护所也够用了，目前而言。

en: ChristopherD Flameborne O.G. Ec the Goblin Forever in stone Jonar-Pal Passal’Akwa Husband, father, artist Stephen the Explorer Adventurer until death Kneppig the Crazy Baunk’s mischief took its toll Llop Ferotge Blew hard, vanished harder Leise Never got the glider to work Titus Volcatius Ascended to the Stars Traaajhgsne The rest is silence Dominicus Wallarian Lord Masonry of Long Keep
cn: ChristopherD Flameborne O.G. Ec the Goblin 永在石中 Jonar-Pal Passal’Akwa 丈夫、父亲、艺术家 Stephen the Explorer 冒险，直至死亡 Kneppig the Crazy Baunk的恶作剧之祸 Llop Ferotge 活得精彩、死得出彩 Leise 滑翔翼到底有什么用 Titus Volcatius 飞升群星 Traaajhgsne 唯余寂静 Dominicus Wallarian 长堡石匠领主

en: These conserved banana chips do not regenerate as much health as the raw fruit. However, the duration of their effect lasts longer — and the crunch is nice, too.
cn: 这些进行过保存处理的香蕉片无法像新鲜水果一样恢复许多生命值。但是这些食物的效果持续更长久，而且脆脆的口感也很不错。

en: A truly spirited garb for magicians and casters. The fabric was laboriously dyed with deep cobalt pigment derived from imported nightblooms.
cn: 最适合魔法师和施法者的服饰。布料是用从进口夜来香中提取的深钴色颜料精心染制而成。

en: Choose one attribute from the collection to be increased by $$arg0$$.
cn: 选择一项属性并使其提高$$arg0$$。

en: A farmbed that will yield Penny Bun mushrooms.
cn: 可产出美味牛肝菌的农田。

en: Add available ingredients with these buttons to produce the recipe 1 or 10 times.
cn: 在这些按钮中添加对应原料以生产配方物品1次或10次。

en: It feels cruel to remove even gills from these defenseless fish, but the ends will justify the means.
cn: 从这些毫无防备的鱼身上将它们的鳃取下来让人感觉十分残忍，但这么做都是为了正义的事业。

en: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. This plant needs to be placed in water, so that the roots are always covered.
cn: 在合适的土壤中种下后，这枚种子将成长为一株稻谷。稻谷需要种在水中以确保根系不会与空气接触。

en: Overpowered enemies receive %k increased Melee physical damage for 3 seconds. Overpower Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered. Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.
cn: 被压制的敌人将承受额外%k的近战物理伤害，此效果持续3秒。 压制 攻击格挡中的敌人或者是招架敌人的攻击都会使他们的晕眩条上涨，直到最后进入被压制状态。 被压制的敌人将毫无防备，这种时候你可以对其发动残酷打击。

en:
9.2	
Keen may ordinarily terminate these Adventure Sharing Terms by giving a two week notice.
cn:
9.2	
Keen 通常可终止本冒险分享条款，但需提前两周通知。

en: The Grappling Hook must be crafted and equipped before use. To use a Grappling Hook, position yourself near an Anchor Point and press %k to zip or swing across. Using the Grappling Hook requires stamina. Crafting a Grappling Hook requires Metal Scraps. Obtain Metal Scraps from Scavengers.
cn: 你需要装备制作好的抓钩才能开始使用。若要使用抓钩，靠近锚点然后按%k开始穿梭或摆荡。使用抓钩将消耗体力。 制作抓钩需要金属废料。从拾荒者身上获取金属废料。

en: Flameborn! I've made the greatest of discoveries! Yes, friend, the stars smile upon us at last! A legendary Glider to rise above and beyond the windcurrents, more valuable than any other! Search it and sail like the bluejays, friend!
cn: 火之子！我完成了有史以来最惊人的发现！没错，我的朋友，群星终于对我们微笑了！能够御风而行的传奇滑翔翼，此物蕴含着超乎想象的宝贵价值！只要找到它，你就可以像蓝松鸦一样自由翱翔天际了！

en: A soaked boot, damaged through years of water exposure. Perhaps the fur on it could be useful.
cn: 一只被泡烂的靴子，因为多年来泡在水中已经惨不忍睹。也许上面的毛皮仍然有用。

en:
The trader Mei told you she once sold a paper lantern to the carpenter, Cade. If she saw the lantern's design again, she could recreate them and offer them for crafting. 

Talk to the Carpenter and ask him about the lantern!
cn:
商人梅说她曾经给木匠卡迪卖了一个纸灯笼。如果能让梅再看一下灯笼的构造，她认为自己应该能够复刻出灯笼的制作配方。

向木匠询问灯笼的事情！

en: Are you sure you want to remove %k from your server?
cn: 确定想要将%k从你的服务器中移除？

en: The Ancient Vaults contain voices silenced by the Shroud. Yet some sparks still linger, flickering in the dark. A <npc>Hunter</npc>, once the fiercest in the land, and an <npc>Alchemist</npc>, with knowledge of the ages. Awaken them, for they will help you along your journey.
cn: 远古密室中回荡着被瘴气掩盖的声音。但是就算在黑暗之中，依旧有火花在闪耀。一位曾经纵横四方的<npc>猎人</npc>以及一位掌握着古往今来智慧的<npc>炼金术士</npc>。去唤醒这二人，他们将帮助你完成自己的旅程。

en: An assortment of fine instruments and tools to enhance the options of an <npc>Alchemist</npc>.
cn: 能够让<npc>炼金术士</npc>大显身手的一系列精细工具与器械。

en: Ride as swift as the bluejays with these sturdy leather boots.
cn: 穿上这双结实的皮靴，就能像蓝松鸦一样敏捷地飞翔。

en: They let you sprint through the thicket with the swiftness of wings.
cn: 你将能够像长着翅膀的飞鸟一样迅速穿越茂密的灌木丛。

en: Embervale protects the companions around you.
cn: 薪谷保护你周围的同伴。

en: The camp the Alchemist mentioned is right by an ancient Sun Temple. The legendary Glider must be inside.
cn: 炼金术士提到的营地就在一座远古者太阳神殿旁。传奇滑翔翼一定就在那里面。

en: Oh my oh my! You've brought me THE Chester Loft? I'm such a fan of his work in The Honeydews! Now we can make a new band together!
cn: 哦我的天！你把切斯特·洛夫特带到我这了？我可是他在蜜露的作品的忠实粉丝！现在我们可以一起组建新的乐队了！

en: I've grown weary of being a one-woman band. I'm looking for someone to play alongside me! A fellow professional, if you will. It can't be too hard to find folk with rhythm in Veilwater Basin. I know there were plenty of musicians in Cromville, busking on the streets. That's what I did before I was called to serenade the Lord! But that's a story for another day...
cn: 我已经厌倦了当单人乐团的感觉。我想要找其他人和我一起演奏音乐！如果可以的话最好是一位专业的同行。在幕水盆地里面寻找有节奏感的人应该不难吧。我知道克罗姆威尔曾经有很多音乐家，那些人平常就会在大街小巷上演奏。以前我也过着那样的生活，直到后来我被召去给领主演奏小夜曲了！不过那个故事就留到下次再说吧……

en: Low-cut shoes. Exposing one's ankles is quite enchanting!
cn: 低帮鞋。露出脚踝相当迷人！
大型空荡之夜南瓜 III

en: Both spells and smiting blows are easily dealt with these marvelous warlock gloves.
cn: 有了这双神奇的术士手套，无论是法术还是攻击都能轻松施展。

en: You have unlocked the following recipe(s)
Just as I said! More survivors. Good. Strength in numbers. Do not rest. Push on.
cn: 我果然没有猜错！很好，更多的幸存者。人多力量大。现在还能休息，继续努力。

en: Remember that woman, Kaori Conway? Remember how I told you not to entrust our shipment to her? Well, she sent a messenger today — yes, her office is close by, but she wouldn't dare to show her face — and the messenger told me that our clothing shipment was "lost somehow". So that order of hats is gone. We better prepare a new batch... and next time, you listen to me and spend REAL MONEY on a REAL COURIER! I hope that woman gets eaten by rats.
cn: 还记得那个叫嘉里·康威的女人么？记不记得我跟你说过，不要让她来送货？ 今天她已经派了个信使过来 -没错，她的办公室就在附近，但那娘们明显是没脸来见我们了，信使告诉我说，我们的布料货物“意外弄丢”了。换言之，帽子是拿不到了。我们最好赶紧做一批新的出来……还有，下一次拜托你听我的劝，多花点钱雇个靠谱的邮差行嘛！ 咒那娘们被老鼠啃死。

en: It hangs over the breeze — with each fresh breath I take, an unknown foulness settles in my lungs. What is this? Another curse? The Shroud, you say? A malignant fog to suffocate the foolish and brave... such mortal matters hardly phase those who rise beyond. You and I, flame-touched as we are, will carry on nonetheless.
cn: 我能够在风中感受到异样，每一次吸入清新的空气时，某种陌生的恶臭都会深入肺腑。这到底是怎么回事？另一种诅咒吗？瘴气？无论是愚蠢还是勇敢之人都将被这种充满恶意的迷雾扼杀……不过这种俗世之物并不会撼动超越彼界之人。像你我这样被灵火触碰过的人们将能够继续前行。

en: You've found the entrance to the Ancient Vault. The survivor must be inside somewhere. Reach the end of the Ancient Vault to reach the sleeping survivor!
cn: 你已经找到了远古密室的入口。幸存者肯定就躲在里面。 抵达远古密室的尽头并找到沉睡的幸存者！

en:
The Farmer has recipes for different animal food baits needed to tame animals. Make goat food baits with the Farmer to tame your first farming animal!

You will most likely need at least 3 goat food baits to proceed meaningfully.
cn:
农民知道用于驯服各类动物的不同动物饲料配方。帮助农民制作山羊饲料诱饵并驯服一头动物！

你需要至少3份山羊饲料诱饵才能继续。

en: When you are hit by non melee damage you have a 20% chance to ignore that damage and lose 15 mana instead.
cn: 承受非近战伤害时，有20%几率无视伤害并转而损失15点法力。

en:
Anybody would find it hard to rest inside such a rickety tent at night. The wind howls without mercy, unconvinced by my pleas for peace and quiet. Still, I drag myself to the quarry every morn' to haul the rocks about.

My exhaustion finally got the better of me when I was operating the pulley, lifting a marble block. I couldn't keep my concentration and slipped into a momentary slumber, letting the marble chunk drop to the ground.
A loud thud ripped me from my sleep and drew my attention to the now partially pulverized rock. In my half-dreaming state, the shimmering powder at my feet mezmerized me, but I quickly withdrew from that feeling as I was coming to my senses.

I was excused from the quarry to get some rest, but I've been spending my off hours grinding rocks to dust. I find it strangely calming to gaze at the different resulting shades of gray.
cn:
恐怕没有人会想要在这种简陋帐篷中过夜。破洞的帆布根本无法抵御呼啸而来的狂风，无论我再怎么恳求抱怨都无法得到片刻的安宁。尽管如此，每天一大早，我都会强撑着疲倦的身体去采石场搬运石头。

终于，有一天在我操作滑轮抬起一块大理石时，我终于被疲劳所打败。我无法再保持专注，接着便陷入了片刻的沉睡，这使得大理石块直接猛地砸到了地上。
一声巨响吵醒了睡梦中的我，我将目光转向了如今已经部分粉碎的石块上。就在这种半梦半醒的状态下，脚边闪烁发光的粉末几乎有了一种催眠的魔力，但是我迅速摆脱了那种感觉并振作了起来。

之后我被安排暂时离开采石场去好好休息，可我只是将来之不易的休息时间用在了研磨矿石粉末上。这些拥有与众不同的灰色质感的粉末让我有了一种超脱的平静。

en: Locate and Explore the Next Tomb
cn: 找到并探索下一处墓穴

en: Indicates how long you can swim underwater.
cn: 显示可以在水下游泳的时长。

en: Summons a swarm of bugs that fights by your side. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 召唤虫群为你而战。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: Brother! You betray me with the rest. You are all cowards — I shall dig my OWN Elixir Wells and have all the Elixir in Embervale! I will no longer rely on the old ways, the old names. This is the dawning of a new age: The Age Of <lorename>Sameth</lorename>!
cn: 兄弟！你和其他人一起背叛了我。你们这些胆小鬼，那我就自己挖魔药之井，到时候全薪谷的魔药都是我的！从此以后我将放弃过去的方法与过去的名字。这是一个新时代的黎明：<lorename>赛姆斯</lorename>的时代到来了！

en: These are the buds of an algae plant. They're inedible when raw, but can be dried.
cn: 这些是藻类植物的球茎，刚摘下来的状态无法食用，但是能够被干燥加工。

en: The research site within the Pillars of Creation houses a gigantic, strange structure. Excavation camps are scattered about. One of these camps must contain <craftingstation>Masonry Tools</craftingstation>.
cn: 创世之柱的研究点内有一个巨大的奇怪建筑。<craftingstation>石匠工具</craftingstation>肯定就在周围的其中一处挖掘营地中。

en:
Food for attracting and taming a Yak.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
cn:
用于吸引与驯服牦牛的饲料。

若要驯服动物，请在潜行状态下小心靠近目标。在动物身边投掷诱饵食物以吸引其注意。在动物进食时抚摸它，重复过程直到动物被驯服。被驯服之后，你将可以捡起动物。

en: The flesh of giant mushrooms that grow in the Blackmire. It's a bit spongy, but otherwise solid enough for building.
cn: 生长在黑沼的巨型蘑菇的肉质部分。虽然表面像海绵一样布满小孔，但其实十分结实，是一种合格的建造材料。

en: Requires the Overgrowth Tool from the Farmer
cn: 需要农民提供 增殖工具

en: Perfect to build a provisional house in hot areas. Palm wood is a great alternative to conventional wood, mimicking its charm and durability.
cn: 在炎热区域制作简易居所的完美选择。棕榈木拥有不逊于常规木材的美观与耐久性能。

en: Cloth pants that are ripped and torn. A keen eye can spot sprinkles of dried blood on them.
cn: 破得不成样子的布裤。观察力敏锐的人一眼就能看见上面早已干涸的点点血渍。

en: With this potion, it'll be much easier to keep yourself safe.
cn: 有了这种药水，你应该能够更方便地保护自己。

en: Continuously heal a target in a beam up to 20 meters away. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 发射一条最远20米的光束，并持续治疗单独目标。 引导法术：在一段时间内维持按键以持续引导。装备法术并消耗法力来用 法杖施法。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: It's unclear if this Scavenger Miner Axe was ever meant to pry ore from stone or if it was only meant to pierce traitors’ backs.
cn: 不确定这把拾荒者矿工斧子的用途究竟是用来挖掘矿石还是凿穿叛徒的后背。

en: Ever since the company ramped up production, I’ve noticed something off about the water. There's a strange motion in the current. An unnatural one — heavier, slower. A purple haze dances at the edge of my vision whenever I focus my eyes on the stream. I used to drink from it without a second thought. We all did. Now, we’ve been strongly discouraged from drinking the river water. Management says it’s “a precaution,” but Timberwolf Logging & Co. started offering bottled water themselves — for a price. Not up front, of course. They just dock it from our pay. Quietly, automatically. Like it’s part of the cost of doing business. I keep thinking: if I can’t drink from the land I work, if I have to buy water from the same people possibly spoiling it, what kind of freedom is that? What kind of future?
cn: 自从公司产量激增之后，我注意到这里的水不太一样了。 水流里面有一种奇怪的动静。不自然——感觉更沉重而且迟缓。每次我聚精会神看着溪流的时候，我都会感觉视野边缘出现一些跳动的紫色迷雾。 以前我喝水之前根本不会犹豫。大家都是随便喝的。 但现在，他们强烈建议我们不要直接饮用河水。管理层说这是为了“以防万一”，但另一方面森林狼公司又开始自己兜售瓶装水了——而且不便宜。虽然不是先付钱再给那样，但他们也是直接从我们的工资里面扣的，而且也不会有事先声明，一切都是自动进行的。搞得这像是做生意的成本一样。 我一直在想：假如我没办法从我工作的地方喝水，还必须向可能污染水的那些人手里买水喝，这算是哪门子的自由？我们的未来在哪里？

en: You do not have the permission to extinguish Altars.
cn: 缺少权限，无法熄灭祭坛。
瘴气魔敌人，幕水盆地瘴气区
阿尔班耶夫山脉 魔药之井

en:
You've found one piece of the cosmetic Fluffy armor set. All pieces are scattered throughout various goat farms within the Albaneve Summits. Search for chests near goat farms to find the other pieces of the cosmetic armor set!

You can obtain this clothing set through gameplay or by supporting creators on external platforms during an event.
cn:
你找到了绒毛护甲外观套装的其中一个部件。套装的部件就散落在阿尔班耶夫山脉中的各个山羊农场里面。搜索山羊农场附近的宝箱并获取完整的护甲外观套装！

你可以通过游玩游戏，或者是于活动期间在外部平台支持创作者来获取该套服饰。

en: Scales how fast your weapons break.
A wonderfully inviting fireplace made from red bricks.
cn: 用红砖砌成的火炉十分诱人。

en: Praise the Ancients, you got my Kettle! How is Raúl? ...Oh. Their time ran out as mine stood still. So we really are the last... how cold. Let's light a fire in their honor. Crafting a fireplace with that Kettle will warm us right up.
cn: 赞美远古者，你拿到了我的烧水壶！劳尔还好吗？……怎么会发生这种事。所以我们真的就是最后仅存的……我突然感觉好冷。让我们点燃炉火，纪念逝去的人们吧。使用烧水壶制作的火炉应该能够让我们立刻暖和起来。

en:
Countless cankerous growths sprout from this leather armor, thus forging it in a new image.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
皮甲表面布满了不计其数的溃烂增殖物，以至于最终形成了一种截然不同的形象。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: 1... 2... 3... 4... It's not working! Counting does not calm me down. I'm furious. I am the Scholar of this village. It's my duty to collect the letters, the books, any offerings people wish to leave in the Night Sanctums. But Garrick... every single time I come by he hands me a stack of letters. I know he is a true believer—desperate for the goodwill of the Ancients. I also know it's strictly forbidden to open the letters entrusted to me. But I'm only human — and today I gave in. And guess what I found? Garrick has been spilling everything to the Ancients! Every little whisper he hears, every private moment he's not supposed to witness. And now comes the best part: he wrote that I have been cheating on my wife. Yes, it's true. I know it's wrong, but HOW DARE HE write it down? What if that letter had fallen into the wrong hands? Unbelievable. I need to take care of this...
cn: 1……2……3……4…… 没作用！在心里默数也无法让我平静。我现在已经出离愤怒。 我是这座村庄的学者。我的使命是收集文字、书籍以及人们想要放入黑夜圣所中的贡品。但是盖瑞克……每次我过来的时候，他都会给我一沓厚厚的信件。我知道他是一位真正的信徒，他渴望着得到远古者的祝福。 我也明白，按照规定我没有权利打开交给我的任何信件。 但我也是人，今天我终于忍受不住诱惑犯忌了。 但是猜猜我发现了什么？ 原来盖瑞克一直在跟远古者打小报告！信里面详细记录着他听见的所有窃窃私语，还有无意间撞见的那些私密景象。然后最棒的是：他的信里写到我背叛了自己的妻子。 对，我是出轨了。 我也知道这么做不对，但是他怎么敢把这种东西也往上写?要是那封信落到错误之人手中怎么办？ 真是疯了。我得处理好这个问题……

en: This creamy coconut milk makes for a great refreshment on a sunny day by the shore! It can also be used as an ingredient in cooking.
cn: 这种奶白色的椰浆最适合作为神清气爽的饮品在阳光明媚的海岸边享用！同时还可以作为烹饪食材使用。

en: A comfortable and noble doublet with a little cape attached to it. Every design element was carefully chosen to create an honorable look.
cn: 舒适而且尊贵的短上衣，背后还配有一件小斗篷。精心设计的细节营造出了一种无比尊贵的外观。

en: Craft A Spinning Machine With The Huntress
cn: 为女猎人制作一台纺织机

en: A simplified wand, shaped by the resurgence of the Drak. Weapons such as these would've held great power in the past, but the primal knowledge surrounding their creation was lost. Recently crafted wands are therefore more primitive, and mere imitations of the once undeniable power and dominion of the beasts. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 随着卓克卷土重来一起出现的简易魔棒。像这样的武器在过去曾经蕴含着强大的力量，但是关于制作这些武器的原始知识已经遗失，因此如今仿制出来的魔棒的力量更为粗糙，只能称得上是对于过去那些巨兽无可比拟的霸权的拙劣模仿。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: Critical Strikes with Melee weapons heal you for %k of your maximum Health.
cn: 近战武器暴击将恢复你的最大生命值的%k。

en: Collect Night Plants At The Farmer's Hideaway, Or Elsewhere
cn: 在农民的秘密地点或者是其他地点收集暗夜植物

en: A simple magical staff made from calcified bone. Rudimentary, but effective. Staffs can cast spells by using spell charges and mana. Equip spell charges to cast.
cn: 使用钙化骸骨打造的简朴魔法长杖。原始却有效。 法杖能够通过消耗法术充能与法力施放法术。装备法术充能以施放法术。

en: Increases the skill level of Terror
Continuously heal a target in a beam up to 20 meters away. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 发射一条最远20米的光束，并持续治疗单独目标。 引导法术：在一段时间内维持按键以持续引导。装备法术并消耗法力来用 法杖施法。

en: This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn: 可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en:
A radiant whirl of energy that is needed to insert gems into weaponry. 

While initially used by the Ancients, it was claimed by the Fell to fuel their brood until you freed it from its newly organic prison. 

This variant can be found in the Veilwater Basin.
cn:
散发着光耀的能量旋涡，用于将宝石嵌入各类武器。

最初由远古者使用，之后又被瘴气魔据为己有并成为了怪物们的养料，直到最后才被你从有机物质的牢笼中解救出来。

可以在幕水盆地中找到这种形态的能量。

en: This handpan is a true rarity, ornamented with striking red tones.
cn: 这个表面装饰着艳丽红色花纹的手碟是一份真正稀有的宝物。

en: Remain keen-eyed as a hawk with this eerie hood.
cn: 戴上这顶诡异的兜帽，你的视野将如飞鹰般敏锐，洞察一切。

en: Mine every valuable material in the Springlands.
cn: 开采春日平原中的所有贵重材料。

en: A vast world awaits you, filled with secrets and peril. Press %k and navigate to the map to track your discoveries.
cn: 充满着秘密与危险的广袤世界在等待着你。按%k，随后打开地图，查看你发现的地点。

en: The Flame wants you to conquer the Ancient Spire in the Veilwater Basin. Reach the top of the Ancient Spire to unlock a Fast Travel point in the region and new points of interest on your map.
cn: 灵火希望你征服幕水盆地中的远古尖塔。 到达远古尖塔的顶端可解锁区域的快速移动点和地图上的新兴趣点。

en:
A townsfolk told you about the inventory of a strange fisher in <location>Pondsworth</location>. He always sold both trash and treasures, but rarely fish. Perhaps there is something strange about this fisherman that requires an investigation.

Reach <location>Pondsworth</location> and look for clues there!
cn:
有一位村民告诉你，<location>彭斯沃斯</location>那边有一位奇怪的渔夫，他的库存与众不同。这个人每次都会出售垃圾与宝藏，但却鲜少卖鱼。也许这个渔夫的古怪行径值得调查一番。

前往<location>彭斯沃斯</location>并在那里寻找线索！
希望能很快收到你的好消息！

en: A Refined Stone Block, that plastered countless aristocratic buildings back in the day.
cn: 精致石头方块，能工巧匠们就是用这种石材建造出无数上流建筑。

en: Select a survivor while this item is in use.
cn: 使用此物品时选择一名幸存者。

en: A brightly burning visage graces this helmet, setting both the battlefield and hearts alike ablaze.
cn: 炽热燃烧的面容使这顶头盔熠熠生辉，让战场和人心都为之沸腾。

en: Allows you to perform an evasive dash while swimming or diving. Cost: 40 Stamina
cn: 允许你在游泳或潜水时进行闪避猛冲。 消耗：40点体力

en:
12.3	
An amendment to an essential primary performance obligation is excluded. Changes to the scope of functions of Enshrouded and Adventure Sharing as game content of Enshrouded are governed by the Terms of Use for Enshrouded and do not constitute changes to essential primary performance obligations.
cn:
12.3	
不允许对基本主要履行义务进行修改。Enshrouded 及作为其游戏内容的冒险分享的功能范围变更受到 Enshrouded 使用条款的制约，且不构成基本主要履行义务的变更。

en: The letter written by <lorename>Rochelle Anders</lorename> was handed to her father, Oswald Anders. The <npc>Blacksmith</npc> will cherish the gift.
cn: <lorename>罗茜·安德斯</lorename>写的信已经被送到了她父亲奥斯瓦尔德·安德斯的手上。<npc>铁匠</npc>将会珍惜这份迟来的礼物。

en: Somewhere in the kingdom of Orindell, naked feet dance upon hot marble floors. The pain is temporary, but the memory will last. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 在奥林戴尔王国的某个地方，赤裸的双足正在滚烫的大理石地板上翩翩起舞。痛苦只是暂时的，但回忆将成为永恒。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: A rare gem famous for its magical properties as a catalyst. It's great for channeling and shielding!
cn: 一种稀有的宝石，因其作为催化剂的神奇特性而闻名于世。十分适合用来引导与抵御魔法！

en: These creeping sprouts have entirely wrecked my yard!! They burst through the soil faster than I can cut them down! Vile things, spitting bile and brine! All the fields rot, and the decay spreads ever deeper... There's no saving this pasture! Blast it all! I'll pass this problem on to Otto, that foolish fledgling, and start anew elsewhere. Never liked him much anyway... snotty brat.
cn: 这些无处不在的芽孢已经彻底毁了我的农场！！ 那些东西在泥土里疯狂扎根，我根本来不及砍倒它们！这些邪恶的东西还会喷吐脓汁与盐水！现在所有庄稼都已经腐烂，而且那种腐败的影响已经深入地下……农场已经彻底没救了！ 算了，去他的吧！就让那个头脑空空的小鬼奥托来接受这个烂摊子吧，我要去其他地方另起炉灶。说实话我一直都挺讨厌他的……那个趾高气昂的小兔崽子。

en: Oh, the aromas of our foods turned out great! And they'll protect you from the cold, too!
cn: 哦，对了，我们的食物都芳香扑鼻！而且它们还可以帮助你抵御寒冷！

en: Flameborn, gift me a minute of your time.
Have You Seen The Royal Messenger?

Since our caravan has split into two, every day raises desperation. How I wish Queen Jezmina had stayed — her grace and beauty would be a much-needed balm. Just yesterday, I heard Lazlo sobbing in his tent. He misses home... As do I.

We saw signs of survivors at a Flame Sanctum. It was a whole day's diversion — and for nothing. Despite the Shroud encroaching on them, these fools do not feel the need to join our ranks. They believe this to be a divine Ancient punishment, a curse that may yet be lifted if they atone enough.

Let's see how long their prayers may feed them. We must stay on track... Pikemead's Reach is still miles away.

— Commander Cyrus, 507 D.A.
cn:
自从车队一分为二后，绝望的氛围正在日益加剧。真希望杰兹米娜女王能够留下来，她的智慧与美貌就是我们现在急需的一剂灵药。就在昨天，我听见拉兹罗一个人在帐篷中偷偷啜泣。他想家了……我也是。

我们在一处灵火神殿看见了生还者的迹象。但是折腾了一整天之后，我们却毫无收获。尽管瘴气步步紧逼，但是那些傻瓜依旧拒绝加入我们。他们认为这意味都是远古者降下的天罚，某种只需要虔诚赎罪就有机会消除的诅咒。

算了，就让我们看看祈祷能够支持他们多久吧。无论如何，我们必须继续前进……派克米德之地仍然距离我们十分遥远。

— 指挥官赛鲁斯，507 D.A.

en:
The Bard would like an assistant to play duets.

She believes that Cromville, a town in the Veilwater Basin, should house many musicians who could be promising candidates.

Reach Cromville to proceed!
cn:
吟游诗人希望拥有一位助手以表演二重奏。

她认为幕水盆地中的城镇克罗姆威尔曾经居住着许多音乐家，那里也许能够找到合适的人选。

抵达克罗姆威尔以继续！

en: We've updated the Skill Tree with new options and features! Due to the rework, your skills may have been reset. Navigate to the Skill Tree to spend your Skill Points once more.
cn: 我们已经更新技能树，并且加入了全新选项与功能！因为系统改动，你的技能已经重置。请前往技能树并再次花费技能点。

en: With these weighted soles, even shaky or uneven ground will not disturb your aim.
cn: 加重的鞋底，即使在崎岖不平的地面上也能保持精准射击。

en: You cannot refund a node that others depend on.
cn: 无法返还，此节点为其他技能的前置技能。

en:
Food for attracting and taming a Dog.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
cn:
用于吸引与驯服狗的饲料。

若要驯服动物，请在潜行状态下小心靠近目标。在动物身边投掷诱饵食物以吸引其注意。在动物进食时抚摸它，重复过程直到动物被驯服。被驯服之后，你将可以捡起动物。

en: A shield that was washed into a grotto by the river. It must have belonged to a valiant hero.
cn: 被河水冲进洞窟的盾牌。想必曾经属于某位旧日的英雄。

en: %k chance and %k of maximum Mana per level
Here Lie The Winners Of The Summer Games
Master The Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls
cn: 完成游牧高地空荡礼堂

en: A smoky grilled mushroom that temporarily amplifies your magical power when eaten.
cn: 烟熏口味的烤蘑菇，吃下后能够暂时提高你的魔法力量。

en: Find The Color Palette In The Smuggler's Camp
cn: 在走私者营地中寻找调色板

en:
These boots are always damp, even on the inside. Walking in them feels like wading through a bog.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
无论内外都永远湿漉漉的靴子。穿着它们走路会让你感觉自己正在沼泽中艰难前行。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: The Shroud springs forth from Elixir Wells throughout Embervale. Fell the Shroud Root at their depths to receive skillpoints for all nearby Flameborn. Flameborn who have harvested a Shroud Root once cannot gain additional skill points from the same root after it respawns. Elixir Wells are always enshrouded and challenging. Prepare yourself accordingly.
cn: 瘴气从薪谷的各个魔药之井中涌出。在魔药之井的深处砍伐瘴气根后，附近所有的火之子即可获得技能点。 一位火之子通过一个瘴气根获得技能点后，就无法再从刷新后的同一个瘴气根上获得更多技能点。 魔药之井总是被瘴气笼罩，充满挑战。请做好相应的准备。

en: You know what? I'm really tired of fish soup. I'm ready to broaden my culinary horizons and try other seafood. Could you hunt down some other sea creatures for me? Maybe crabs? That way, I'll know what kind of meat I'm working with.
cn: 你猜怎么着？我已经厌倦了鱼汤。我已经准备好继续拓展我的烹饪履历并尝试其他海鲜。也许你可以帮我寻找一些其他的海洋生物？比如螃蟹？那样的话，我就能够真正理解自己在烹饪的肉品了。

en:
After performing an evade action, the next hit deals %k additional cutting damage and replenishes 
%k stamina on the next hit.
cn:
发动闪避后，下一次命中敌人将造成%k额外劈砍伤害，除此以外，下一次命中将恢复
%k。

en: All melee Cutting damage is increased by 20%.
cn: 所有近战劈砍伤害额外增加20%。

en: Find all flame shrines and sanctums in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 找到燃火荒原中的所有灵火神龛与神殿。

en: Love your hair. Are you loving it?
cn: 我真的超爱你的发型。喜欢吗？

en: Not enough space to create new save data.
cn: 空间不足，无法创建新的存档数据。

en: A flute carved from bone. You can use it to make music.
cn: 用骨头雕刻的笛子。您可以用它来演奏音乐。

en: No matter how they may wear and tear, these pants can always be patched up again! That makes them suitable for bold explorers.
cn: 无论如何磨损，这条裤子都可以重新修补！因此，它适合大胆的探险家。

en: When you are targeted by an attack, Vukah within 50 meters will attack the enemy.
cn: 当你受到攻击时，周围50米范围内的沃卡将对攻击者发起进攻。

en: Opens all doors in the "The Pike", the castle within <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>.
cn: 能够在“崇山城”使用，开启位于<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>城堡中的所有大门。

en: Your inner fire has grown beyond your comprehension. You've brought back a crafting assistant, untouched by the Shroud or the Elixir. Summon them with a Summoning Staff to rebuild this world and rule justly!
cn: 你体内的灵火已经拥有着超乎想象的力量。你已经成功复活了一位未被瘴气与魔药玷污的制作助手。使用召唤法杖召唤纯洁灵魂来重建这个世界并公正统治！

en: Can edit terrain and props in bases
cn: 能够编辑地形以及基地中的道具

en: A light source that can be thrown to ping a location for other players, and to light up dark areas that lie ahead. Lasts for 24 seconds.
cn: 可以投掷的光源，用于为其他玩家定位，并照亮前方的黑暗区域。可持续 24 秒。

en: A staff that imbues the wielder with the ability to melt ice caps and frozen streams. The resulting fresh water is considered exceptionally pure and healing.
cn: 这把法杖将为持有者带来融化冰川与冻结溪流的能力。创造出的清水则会带来超乎想象的纯洁治愈。

en:
Many hands, outstretched 

Grasping, clutching, clawing 

At meaning, at remembrance 

At everything, at nothingness
cn:
无数双手向外伸展

挣扎、抓取与攀附

为了意义，为了回忆

为了一切，为了虚无

en: Select an active blueprint before first use.
cn: 首次使用前请先选择一份已经激活的蓝图。

en: The Friend role requires a password.

A little feeding bowl for your Dog.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.
cn:
为狗狗准备的喂食碗。

装满对应的食物后将喂食你的动物。
为了我们不断扩大的家庭

en: When you are targeted by an attack, Wild Animals within 50 meters will attack the enemy.
cn: 当你受到攻击时，50米内的野生动物将攻击敌人。

en: Increases Melee damage by 5% per Attribute Point.
cn: 每点属性点增加5%的近战伤害。

en: There are more pumpkin farms around. Visit the next location to retrieve a medium-sized carved pumpkin!
cn: 还有更多未被找到的南瓜农场。拜访下一个地点并取回中型雕刻南瓜！

en: A lore note revealed to you the boundless beauty of the ocean.
cn: 你找到的一份笔记中提到了大海的无尽美丽。

en: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.
cn: 闪闪发光的绿色长剑，让人一眼就能联想到蛇年的主题风格。

en: Selects the item rarity that asks for confirmation when deleting or salvaging items. Can be turned off.
cn: 选择删除或挽救物品时要求确认的物品稀有度。可以关闭。

en: A healthy protein rich snack. The color looks just perfect...
cn: 富含蛋白质的健康小食。色泽看上去十分诱人……

en: Its teeth tear my flesh evermore. The first bite was but a bitter prelude to the many more that followed. I fear my time is near. My muscles tighten, my skin stretches. I can see them under candlelight, eagerly pushing outward... The catacomb's stones have cursed me, for the hollow of my ribcage is home to a thousand hungering maws.
cn: 它的牙齿继续撕裂着我的肉体。 最初的那一下只是后续啃噬的序曲。恐怕我的时间不多了。 我感觉自己全身肌肉紧绷，皮肤也鼓胀难忍。借着烛光我能够清楚地看见它们的形状，它们迫切想要钻出来……我遭到了墓穴之石的诅咒，我的胸膛将成为无数贪婪巨口的家。

en: Equipped armor grants %k increased Magical Armor.
cn: 装备的护甲提供额外%k的魔法护甲。

en: A comforting heat emanates from the rocks, so I won't need a fire tonight. I hear them in the distance, searching, howling. It's the wind that carries their madness my way, a draft from the mines. What are they digging for? Their screams rip through the night and scare away all prey. I'm starving. Should I have stocked up on resources when I was near Glennwood's End? No.The entire town reeks of blood and betrayal... a scent I know too well. I'll walk with hunger in my heart if I must.
cn: 石头散发着舒适的温度，看来今晚我不需要再特意生火了。我听见了它们的声音，就在远方寻觅咆哮着。我在风中感受到了他们的疯狂，就在矿井之中。他们到底在挖掘什么？尖叫声划破夜空，吓跑了所有猎物。看来今晚只能饿肚子了。 也许我当时应该在格伦伍德之末附近囤积物资？不。那座小镇散发着鲜血和背叛的味道。那种气味对于我来说太熟悉了。所以我就算忍饥挨饿也要离开。

en:
After rescuing Bard Valory, you've opened the opportunity to craft an explorer outfit. 

Craft the outfit to complete your set!
cn:
在解救吟游诗人瓦罗里之后，你获得了制作探险家套装的机会。

制作所有部件并完成你的套装！

en:
I thought we had nothin' to lose when we ripped our way into the mire. Now, with the cave collapsing behind us, I ain't sure anymore.

Our whole mission is screwed. Already lost a couple of scouts who meant to return two nights ago. They ain't coming back. Something got 'em and dragged 'em away. The only ones draggin' anyone around should be us!! 
I ain't scared of nothin'... but somethin' ain't right. Is it this bloody swamp or withdrawal giving me shivers...?

Let's just grab our people and dip. Forget the scouting mission. I wanna drown myself in strawberry wine from good ol' <location>Glennwood's End</location>.
cn:
当我们进入沼泽的时候，我原本以为我们已经无所畏惧。但现在，我们身后的洞穴正在不断崩塌，我有点犹豫。

我们这次的任务注定失败。我们已经损失好几位斥候，按照原定的计划，他们两天前就应该回到这里。但是我们再也没有看见过他们。有某种东西把他们一个个拖走了。这明明是我们该做的事情！！
我什么也不怕……但这地方不对劲。不知道是这该死的沼泽还是戒断反应，我一直在打寒颤……

我们还是叫上所有人赶紧先走吧。别去管什么侦查任务了。我现在只想拿上几桶<location>格伦伍德之末</location>的草莓酒一醉方休。

en: A fine mortar. This should enable an <npc>Alchemist</npc> to broaden their crafting spectrum when placed within their reach.
cn: 一个上等磨臼。放置在<npc>炼金术士</npc>身旁将允许其制作更多配方。

en: This air helmet you've brought back seems like an interesting contraption. Perhaps I will borrow it sometime.
cn: 你带回来的这顶供氧头盔看上去十分有趣。也许之后可以借我研究一段时间。

en: Defeating an enemy with a Bow has a %k chance to spawn a Stamina Orb. Gathering an Orb restores 10%% of the respective resource.
cn: 使用弓打败敌人时有%k几率生成1个体力恢复球。 收集恢复球将恢复10%%的对应资源。

en: Oh, you have a pretty skin.
A radiant headpiece that can be spotted from afar. Not only when the burning sun reflects off of it.
cn: 哪怕是相隔甚远，人们也能够一眼认出这种璀璨的头盔。哪怕是在看不见阳光的地方，头盔的光芒也不会有丝毫黯淡。
找到掘墓人的安息之地

en: I'll see you in your dreams.

This bottom-dwelling fish is known for its long whiskers, which it uses to sense movement and food in the water. Apparently, it sensed your bait, too.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
这种底栖鱼类以长长的胡须出名，它们会使用这些胡须来感知水里的动作与食物，除此以外似乎也能感知你抛出的鱼饵。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。

en: Increases the skill level of Fire Resistance
cn: 提高火焰抗性的技能等级

en: There are many items to discover in Embervale, some of which belong to sets. Gather all set items to receive an XP reward. Some sets will even unlock new recipes when completed!
cn: 薪谷有许多有待发现的物品，其中有些为套装物品。集齐套装中的所有物品将为你提供经验值奖励。部分套装在完成时甚至还会解锁新的配方！

en:
"Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night.

It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.
cn:
“闪光龙胆”是仅在夜间的阿尔班耶夫山脉出现的龙胆亚种。

这种植物会释放亮粉色的光芒，并且可以用于创造各种明亮的调色板。

en: This mace is unstoppable once in motion.
cn: 这根狼牙棒一旦动起来就势不可挡。

en: This small chest offers increased storage space for items.
cn: 这口小箱子能够提供更多的物品储存空间。

en: Survivors allow you to craft more diverse and advanced items. They are vital for improving your equipment, supplies, and storage. The survivors must be recovered from Ancient Vaults and summoned using a Summoning Staff. The Summoning Staff can be crafted in the Manual Crafting tab.
cn: 幸存者让你可以制作种类更多的高级物品。他们将是你改善装备、补给以及存储空间的关键。 使用召唤法杖即可召唤从远古密室中苏醒的幸存者。你能够在手工制作面板制作召唤法杖。

en: Simple layered gloves that allow for optimal versatility and swiftness when spellcasting.
cn: 质朴的多层手套能够为施法者提供优良的活动性。

en: Instantly restores a small amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.
cn: 立即恢复少量法力并提供10秒的持续恢复效果。

en:
Repeated exposure to poison has thickened your blood, causing uncontrollable clotting. Health regeneration is halted.

This long-term debuff affects you permanently until removed with a hemotoxin antidote.
cn:
反复接触毒素使得你的血液变得异常黏稠，并且引发了难以根治的凝血症。中断生命值恢复。

这是一种永久性的长期减益，只有通过毒血解毒剂才能够解除。

en:
Your Shroud protection depleted. 
Remember to let it recover outside of the Shroud.
cn:
你的瘴气保护时间已耗尽。
请记住在时间耗尽前离开瘴气，等待其恢复。
我永远愿意为大家表演！

en:
Who is scared of flying horrors? 
Winged beasts, up in the sky!

Who is scared of flying horrors? 
Behind clouds, they're hiding high!

Who is scared of flying horrors?
Is it you, or is it me?

Those who fear will sleep in sorrow
And the brave will sleep in peace!
cn:
有谁畏惧飞天的怪物？
长着翅膀，在天空中飞舞的怪物！

有谁畏惧飞天的怪物？
躲在云层之中，它高高在上！

有谁畏惧飞天的怪物？
是你，还是我？

心怀恐惧之人将在哀愁中辗转反侧
只有勇敢之人才能安心入睡！
我们能不能找一些新的颜色？

en: It glows in the dark. A moody light source often found in or around caves.
cn: 能够在黑暗中发光。洞穴内外经常能够看见此类物质散发的幽暗光芒。

en: You got a heart of steel, kid.
cn: 你有一颗钢铁般的心，孩子

en:
7.3	
The "New" list displays the most recently uploaded or updated worlds in chronological order. The most recently uploaded world is shown first. In the "Most Downloaded" list, worlds are ranked according to the total number of their downloads. The more downloads that are recorded for a world, the higher it will appear in this list. In the "Trending" list, worlds are ranked according to their relative change in popularity within a certain review period. The determining parameter is the increase in Likes in relation to the respective review period. The more a world gains popularity during this period, the higher it will appear in the "Trending" list. As an Uploader, you can influence the placement of your world in the "Most Downloaded" or "Trending" list by offering high-quality, attractively described, and well-categorized worlds. It is not possible to influence this order by means of filters or different sorting.
cn:
7.3	
“最新”列表按时间顺序显示最近上传或更新的世界。最近上传的世界显示在最前面。在“下载最多”列表中，世界按照其总下载次数进行排名。一个世界的下载次数越多，它在列表中显示的排名位置就越高。在“趋势”列表中，根据世界在特定审查期内受欢迎程度的相对变化对其进行排名。决定性的参数是在相应审查期内点赞数量的增长情况。一个世界在此期间越受欢迎，它在“趋势”列表中显示的排名位置就越高。作为上传者，您可以通过提供高质量、描述吸引人且分类得当的世界来影响您的世界在“下载最多”或“趋势”列表中的排名位置。无法通过筛选器或不同的排序方式来影响此顺序。

en: This colossal axe draws strength from those it wounds, stealing their vitality with each strike.
cn: 这把巨大的斧子能够从伤口中汲取力量，每一次的打击都能够偷走对手的生命力。

en: Wand attacks have a 30% chance to spawn double the amount of projectiles. Extra projectiles spawned deal 50% less damage.
cn: 魔棒攻击有30%几率生成双倍数量的投射物。额外生成的投射物只会造成50%的伤害。

en: The shoulder pads on this Sharpshooter Vest are exceptionally sharp and pointed like the tip of an arrow.
cn: 射击专家背心上的肩甲锋利如箭尖，令人望而生畏。

en: Black Mold Behind A Dry Wall
A pair of pants with leather greaves. They don't rustle while moving and muffle every little sound while sneaking around.
cn: 配有皮革护胫的长裤。移动时不会发出任何声响，潜行时也能够降低产生的动静。

en: Don't forget the magical artifacts, keeper of the Flame... They call for you.
cn: 火焰守护者，别忘了寻找魔法工艺品……它们正在召唤你。

en: Ranged weapon damage is increased by 20%.

Location: Submerged Temple Ruins – Coordinates Confirmed Estimated Dive Time: 008 Hours, surfacing possible Pre-Dive Briefing Time: Before dusk. Docking went smoothly despite dense growths and scattered debris below. Place: Abandoned, half-swallowed by the lake. Ideal for exploration! Observing the parameters of the ruin confirms earlier reports. Multiple moss-ridden stairwells lay upwards, toward the gaping mouth of the temple. Structural integrity is questionable. Best we make good time and beat our own record! I'm sure we'll find the first chamber as described by the previous team: waterlogged, more seaweed than stone, sealing the flooded pathways beyond. A mechanism or puzzle kept them from breaching the tunnels. That’s where we come in! The team’s solid. Spirits are high. I’ve got confidence in Edd Exley — he’s sharp, steady, and knows how to handle tight spaces. Timing’s crucial. We’ll begin the descent at first light. With luck, the sun will be high enough to pierce through the grates and mark the resurfacing zones. We won't skip breakfast prep, though. Caught a few fish en route; they’ll be fine once roasted!
cn: 地点：沉没的神殿废墟——已确认坐标 预计潜水时间：008小时，可能存在上浮机会 下潜前简报 时间：黄昏之前。尽管存在密集的植被以及下方散落的瓦砾，停靠流程已经顺利完成。 位置：彻底荒废，而且有一半已经沉入湖中。适合探索的好选择！ 对废墟的观察确认了之前收到的报告信息。这里存在多处长满苔藓的垂直楼梯井，而且都通往神殿的巨大开口。结构稳定性存疑。我们最好抓紧时间速战速决！ 我确定我们能够找到先前队伍描述的第一房间：彻底浸泡在水中，水草比石头还要多，并且堵住了前进的淹没通道。某种机关或谜题阻挡住了想要进入隧道的人们，而这就是我们要来解决的问题！ 这次的队伍成员都是佼佼者。所有人的士气都很高昂。我对于艾德·埃克斯里十分有信心——他头脑敏锐而且沉稳，并且知道如何应对狭窄的环境。 时间紧迫。我们将在黎明时分开始下潜。如果运气不错，太阳的光芒将能够穿透栅栏并标记能够重新上浮的区域。 不过我们不会跳过早餐的准备工作。来的路上抓到了几条鱼，应该只需要稍微烤一烤就能吃了！

en: Carved Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes I
cn: 雕刻热带木制篱笆（绳索） I

en: Ugh, I'm bored out of my mind! I need a valiant hero to save me from all this boredom!
cn: 啊，好无聊！我需要一位勇敢的英雄来帮助我摆脱这苦闷！

en: Use this staff to burn a path for your herd through the frozen wastes and help them conquer the iciest rivulets and rockiest cliffs.
cn: 使用此法杖在冰封废土为你的追随者开辟一条道路，帮助他们征服冻结的溪谷与高不可攀的悬崖。

en: Perfect, my friend! You always rise to the task. If we manage to build a Laboratory with the Scientific Instruments, then we can craft healing items beyond any imagination!
cn: 干得漂亮，我的朋友！你从来没有让我失望过。只要我们想办法用科研设备建造一座实验室，之后我们就可以制作超乎想象的治疗品了！

en: Mine every valuable material in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 开采燃火荒原中的所有贵重材料。

en: The Hunter, Athalan Skree, examined the Animal Fur. She believes that even healthy creatures might be influenced by the Shroud, as it reaches further than the eye can see. She shared the location of her hidden hunting grounds and said to hunt in her stead.
cn: 猎人阿萨兰·斯克里检查了手上的动物毛皮。她认为就连健康的动物们也有可能已经被影响，瘴气的危害会触及肉眼无法发现的深度。之后她分享了自己的秘密狩猎场的位置，并且希望有人能够代她狩猎猎物。

en: A weird demonstration of the expansion force of water vapor. The use-cases are not quite clear... or are they?
cn: 运用蒸气之力的奇怪设备。实际用途尚不……“清晰”？
黄金瘴气魔怪物战利品

en: Ugh, I need water! My throat feels like I've been parched for years... By <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s honor, I forgot to introduce myself to my savior. I'm Ramone Jones, editor of "The Pike Weekly". Maybe you've read my work?
cn: 咳，我需要水！喉咙简直像是火烧了一般，好渴好渴……以<lorename>派克米德</lorename>的荣誉起誓，我甚至都忘记向自己的拯救者介绍自己了。我是雷蒙·琼斯，《崇山城周报》的编辑。也许你之前有看过我的作品？
这里就是一个遍布着失落建筑的奇迹之地！

en: A traditional and excellently carved wooden hammer made by Vukah craftsmen. Resembles a large tooth and is very good at removing such.
cn: 由沃卡工匠雕刻而成的传统木槌，做工异常精美。这种武器的外形酷似一颗巨大的木头牙齿，能够轻松把敌人揍得屁滚尿流。

en: A robust chest piece, adorned with the fur of a white wolf. The colors blend in well with snowed-in, grey mountains.
cn: 牢固的胸甲上缝有白狼的毛皮。穿上这件装备，你将能够与白雪皑皑的灰色山脉融为一体。

en: I bet you can't stop eating grilled fish now.
cn: 我敢打赌你现在已经彻底爱上烤鱼的滋味了。

en: This world is no longer available.
Increases the skill level of Bash
Keep looking for the remnants of that madman’s magic.
cn: 继续寻找那个疯子的魔法残留。

en: Increases the skill level of Blood Rage
cn: 提高鲜血狂暴的技能等级

en:
A cozy Cyclops ribcage with enough room for you and your best mate to snuggle up in.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
cn:
温馨的独眼巨人胸部骨架，宽敞的空间甚至能够放进两个人。

能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到此收集品。能够在独眼巨人战利品底座上重新组装为一套完整的独眼巨人骷髅。
黄金拾荒者主母战利品

en: Logs of a freshly cut palm, ready to be processed to an item of choosing.
cn: 刚砍伐不久的棕榈原木，已经准备好被加工成其他物品。

en:
First, it was a rumor. Then, a dark premonition. Now, we cannot deny reality any longer: Reports from beneath Fort Kelvin are true! 
Creatures unseen burrow here and threaten our survival! They dig upwards, shaking the ground... Do we abandon our post for the shrouded wilds outside our walls — or stand and fight the beasts coming from below?

We must keep this place safe! After all, Fort Kelvin is our last retreat!
cn:
一开始那只是个传闻，接着就变成了黑暗的鱼竿。如今我们已经无法再否认真相：关于凯尔文要塞地下的报告是真的！
潜藏在地下的野兽们已经威胁到了我们的生存！它们不断向上挖掘并且已经导致地基不稳……我们是该放弃这里，转而去围墙之外的迷雾之地寻求生机，还是留下来对抗地下的野兽？

我们必须守住这个地方！凯尔文要塞是我们最后的希望！

en: I used to live in <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>, like so many others... I've got a dark feeling about it. I think something dreadful might be there now.
cn: 我以前住在<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>里面，但是和很多人一样……我对那个地方有种不好的预感。也许现在那里真的发生了什么不好的事情。

en: Striking in the blink of an eye, these daggers can slash any throat quickly and quietly. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 这套匕首能够在片刻之间悄无声息地割断敌人的咽喉。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。
哪里有火，哪里就有希望。

en: Spawns a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster. Increases the stun bar of Shroud enemies based on your intelligence attribute.
cn: 释放一道强烈闪光并击退施法者周围的敌人。 根据你的智力属性提高被瘴气腐化的敌人的晕眩条。

en: Water is a great source of vitality. Drink it to enhance your stamina and regenerate it faster.
cn: 水是重要的生命之源。饮下后能够强化你的体力并帮助其快速恢复。

en: An eternal spell that releases a powerful lightning strike that shocks enemies and jumps to others nearby, dealing additional stamina damage. Stamina damage fills the enemy's stun bar. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 永恒法术，释放强大的雷击，震飞敌人并跳到附近的其他人身上，造成额外的体力伤害。 体力伤害会充满敌人的眩晕条。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: A green flower that only grows in the deepest parts of the Shroud. A rare ingredient that only the mightiest of warriors might see.
cn: 只在瘴气最深处生长的绿色花朵。只有最强大的战士才有机会获取这种稀有原料。

en: A breezy vest layered on top of a long shirt. The additional belt buckle strapped across the chest holds some spare blades.
cn: 套在长袖衬衣上的背心。横放在胸前的皮带扣能够用来存放额外的武器。

en: Mining resources has a 10% chance to grant one additional resource.
cn: 开采时有10%几率获得一份额外资源。

en: A workplace for the <npc>Carpenter</npc> to do masonry work.
cn: 供<npc>木匠</npc>处理石工的工坊。

en: A dangerous alchemical substance used to produce explosives. Better watch out!
cn: 用于制作爆炸物的危险炼金物质。千万要小心使用！

en: A sweet fruit that grows in dry areas, needing little water. Despite that, it's quite refreshing!
cn: 生长在干燥地区的甜美果实，只需要些许水源便可以茁壮成长。吃起来有股不可思议的爽口感！

en: Asymmetrical bangles that aid viewers in visually differentiating your arm movements as you dash past them towards the finish line.
cn: 非对称的手镯，这种设计将允许观众们更清楚地看着朝着终点线猛冲的你的手臂动作。

en: Bring The Gem Of Lycanthropy To The Collector Assistant
cn: 将狼化宝石带给收藏家助手
查看其他玩家的建设作品

en: Gold veins flow through these gloves like sun-kissed rivers emerging after an icy slumber. The color of the underlying cloth changes from blue to green, symbolizing an awakening — a reach toward the light above the water's surface.
cn: 流淌在手套表面的金线纹理就像是寒冬过后波光粼粼的河流。内衬布料的颜色从蓝到绿，这象征着万物苏醒，一切都在向往着水面上跃动的日光。

en: You've always been my favorite nephew — young and spry! Otto, my old bones rattle. I can hardly care for the Lush Pasture anymore... a shame! Such sprawling fields, ripe and bountiful! Perfect for a young lad like yourself. I will leave this peaceful homestead in your caring hands!
cn: 你一直都是我最喜欢的那个侄子……年轻有活力！奥托，我已经是把老骨头了。我已经快没力气打理翠绿牧场了……实在是可惜咯！不过这里一望无际的田野丰饶又瑰丽！我觉得很适合像你这样的年轻小伙子。 从今往后，这片祥和的农场就交给你来照顾了！

en: You found an old <craftingstation>Black Cauldron</craftingstation>. Use it to make an <craftingstation>Alchemy Station</craftingstation> and place it in your base to unlock more crafting possibilities.
cn: 您发现了一个旧的<craftingstation>黑坩埚</craftingstation>。用它来制作一个<craftingstation>炼金台</craftingstation>，并把它放在您的基地里，以解锁更多的制作配方。

en: The weapon of choice for the deceitful.

When you read this, I'll have already slipped away under the cover of night. I can never be the daughter you wanted, Father. Obedient, silent, and dull... I've no apologies left to give. I'm born for greater things! For people to call out to me! For glamor and gold! For adventure! I want to be more than "Eryn the farmhand"... I want to be remembered! So, you will hear from me again! You must, I will make sure of it! I'll become a bright light in the night sky, a dazzling star in the dark, dripping in jewels — while you'll be digging in the dirt all yearwake. Once I find something dear to me, something beautiful as morning dew —... I won't let go! I hope 503 D.A. will be a good year for you — Nay, for all of us! — Formerly yours, Eryn.
cn: 当你读到这封信的时候，我已经趁着夜幕逃走了。 我永远也无法成为你心目的那个女儿，父亲。你想要的只是顺从、沉默与乏味……我并不会为自己的行为道歉。我有着更远大的志向！我希望名流千古！我想要的事荣华富贵！我渴望冒险！我不想一辈子只是“农妇艾琳”……我想要被人记住！ 所以，将来你一定会再次听见我的事迹！我向你发誓！我将成为夜空中最亮的星，黑暗之中璀璨生辉的星星，沐浴在珠光宝气之中……而你则只能岁初时在田间地头劳作。 因为当我发现值得珍视的宝物，像是清晨的露水一般特殊而又美丽……我永远也不会放手！ 希望503 D.A.对你，不，是对我们两来说都是一个好年份！ —曾经属于你的，艾琳。

en: We have lots of faces 'round here now. Makes me feel right at home — I have 7 aunts, ya know? Aunt Braelyn was my favorite. She used to send me the most beautiful architectural sketches of temples, bridges, and towers from her travels! One day, she went to the Blackmire when I was little, I mean, real little, and never returned... She should come back and help out! I got 7 aunts, lotta work, and only one hand, after all! Ha!
cn: 我们这里逐渐变得热闹了起来。这让我有种家的感觉，话说你知道吗，我其实有七个姑姑。我最喜欢的是布莱林姑姑。以前她会给我寄各式各样神庙、桥梁还有高塔的建筑素描，画的可好了，都是她在旅行过程中见到的！后来有一天，她去了黑沼，那时候我还很小很小，然后布莱林姑姑就再也没有回来……她其实应该回来帮助大家的！我有七个姑姑，那么多的活只靠一个人可干不过来！哈！

en: A music sheet for a song to play by the fireplace while telling adventure stories. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 这张乐谱中记载着适合在篝火旁讲述冒险故事时功烘托气氛的乐曲。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。
制作或获取一个工作台

en: The Blacksmith is curious about the Albaneve Summits region. The North once expanded there to build more Elixir Well and crafted weapons from the local materials to protect them. These materials can only be smelted with the heat produced by a proper forge. Find the forge and claim its heat source! This will enable you to craft a blast furnace.
cn: 铁匠对阿尔班耶夫山脉地区十分感兴趣。北境的居民们曾经扩张到了那里，他们在那里建造了更多的魔药之井，并且还利用当地的材料打造了许多武器来保护自己。只有符合条件的锻炉产生的高温才可以熔炼这些材料。 找到锻炉并拿走其中的热源！之后你将可以制作一个高炉。

en: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with improved firepower.
cn: 一枚能够带来“爆炸惊喜”的特殊箭矢。能够造成更大的威力。

en: Heavy boots with metal caps, perfect for kicking down doors or crushing skulls under your heel.
cn: 安装有金属鞋尖的重型靴子，非常适合用来踹门或者是碾碎敌人的头骨。

en: We got caught in a snowstorm on our way to the obelisk. I pushed through the howling winds, possessed by my goal, but when I turned back to drag my new assistant along, her rosy face vanished behind specks of white. "Fran!" I yelled. Her response echoed, sounding miles away. Then, a horrible screech shook me to my core. I rushed towards her, piercing the veil of snow. When I finally spotted her again, she was cowering beneath a vulture that hid inside the whirling winds. I found my freezing fingers wrapped around a stone and tossed it with all my might. The vulture tumbled down, disoriented, and I stomped it until I felt its skull give in. Then, I froze. I think Fran spoke to me as she took a bone sample, frantically brushing her hand across its wing, but I heard nothing. I looked at her face and saw her rosy cheeks gushing blood, ripped apart by claws. "She will never be the same," I thought. "And neither will I." — Loraine Crim, Yearfall, 508 D.A.
cn: 在前往方尖碑的路上，我们遇到了异常暴风雪。想到一直在追寻的目标就在眼前，我像发了狂一样冲进了呼啸的狂风之中，但是当我回头想要把自己的新助手一起拉上的时候，我才发现她那张冻得通红的脸蛋已经消失在了漫无边际的白雪之中。 “弗兰！”我大喊着。她回应了我，但是那声音像是从很远的地方飘来的回音一样微弱。紧接着，我就听见了一阵撕心裂肺的尖叫。我立刻迎着风雪朝她的声音冲了过去。当我终于找到她的时候，弗兰已经倒在了一头之前隐藏在呼啸风雪之中的秃鹫身下。 我已经冻僵的手指不由自主地拿起了一块石头，我用尽全身力气朝秃鹫的脑袋丢了过去。秃鹫被突如其来的冲击砸晕了过去，我冲上去疯狂踩烂了野兽的脑袋。之后我感觉整个人都呆住了。 我觉得弗兰接着便一边收集骨头样本一边在跟我说话，她的手不停地在秃鹫的翅膀上擦拭着，但是我什么也没有听清。我只是呆呆地看着她的脸庞，被冻得通红的脸颊上，之前被秃鹫爪子撕裂的口子正在不停地渗着鲜血。“她永远不再是以前的那个弗兰了，”我心里想着。“而我也一样。” - 洛琳·克里姆，岁末，508 D.A.

en: Footwork is the most important skill of swordsmanship. These boots should make learning the first steps easier.
cn: 脚法是剑术的重要考量标准之一。这双靴子应该能够帮助你踏出第一步。

en: With it came power, mistrust, and a longing for more.
cn: 随之而来的是力量、猜忌和无尽的渴望。

en:
Nutritious bird food for tame animals on your farm. It can be fed to both Flightless Redtails and Round-Billed Sailers.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
cn:
为农场中已经驯服的鸟类准备的营养饲料。能够给陆行红尾与圆喙水手食用。

必须被放置在对应的喂食器中。

en:
Leather pants with noticeable grain that morphs into fine fungal tendrils.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
这条皮革长裤的表面已经长满了真菌触须。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: Traverse Through The Veilwater Basin Passage
My trusty Mortar is lost. I suspect it is in my tower in Lone Thistle, in the deepest depths. ... Please find it for me. My abilities will be much greater with it in hand!
cn: 我可靠的磨臼不见了。我怀疑东西就在孤蓟镇的高塔最深处。拜托请你一定要帮我找到它，只有这样我才能够真正发挥全力！

en:
You've found all the pieces of the <lorename>Pikemead</lorename> statue.
You can reassemble the pieces by using a statue showcase.

Completing the collection will unlock new crafting recipes!
cn:
你已经找到了<lorename>派克米德</lorename>雕像的全部碎片。
你可以使用雕像展示柜来重新组装碎片。

完成雕像将解锁全新的制作配方！

en:
Dra'Nak die with honor. 
So his claws, his scales, his blood — they go into totem. 
Old way of Drak. Always been. 
We keep the strong ones close — even when breath is gone. He stand with us, watch guard. 
Drak proud to become totem. Chief Drak'Dal will be Wood Totem, Hydrak'Dal Stone.
Means they will join Dalszul in afterlife. 
But if die with shame.. no gold, no name.. no afterlife... just forget.
cn:
卓·纳克的光荣赴死。
于是他的爪子、鳞片还有鲜血——统统融入了图腾之中。
这是卓克的古老之道。从古至今都是这样。
我们将石雕者留在身边——哪怕它们的呼吸早已停止。他仍然与我们同在，仍然在守望。
能够成为图腾是龙裔的骄傲。卓克·达尔酋长将成为木图腾，海卓克·达尔则是石图腾。
这意味着它们将去往彼世与达尔斯祖尔团聚。
但如果死得不光彩……没有黄金，没有名字……没有彼世……只有遗忘。

en: We heard them last night! It's not just in my head... the inscription, the bones— the Vukah are coming back up from the depths of their cave! We must flee our dig site... this is getting too dangerous to continue... We'll leave all relics behind, as well. I do not wish to anger them! — Loraine Crim
cn: 昨天我们听见了他们的声音！那并不是我一个人的幻想……铭文，还有骸骨，那些沃卡正在从洞穴深处走出来！我们必须逃离挖掘场……这里太过危险，不能继续逗留下去……我们选择了放弃找到的所有遗物。 我可不想要激怒那些东西！ — 洛琳·克里姆

en: You didn't forget about my aunt <lorename>Elin</lorename> and her story, right? There's something foul in that Haunted Sun Temple!
cn: 你没忘了我姨妈<lorename>艾琳</lorename>和她的故事吧？那个闹鬼太阳神殿有问题！

en: Simple but reliable protection for hands.
cn: 朴素却可靠的手部防护。

en: Your Steam client is not running!

6.1 Moderation of Content For the enforcement of the provisions under Section 3, in particular, the provisions on Prohibited Content under Section 3.5, as well as these Adventure Sharing Terms, Keen may take the moderation measures described below with respect to User Content and the activities of Uploaders.
cn:
6.1	内容审核
为执行第 3 条的各项规定（特别是第 3.5 条关于禁止内容的规定）以及本冒险分享条款，Keen 可就用户内容及上传者的活动采取下述审核措施。

en: The Flame has tasked you to slay the corrupted beast that dwells inside Howling Peak. Triumphing over this being will bring peace to the region and enable a new Flame upgrade, allowing Flame Altars to keep the cold at bay when building. To wake and draw out the beast, you must light the signal fires ("Balefires") that circle the innermost mountain. The first balefire is marked on your map. Reach the location to proceed!
cn: 灵火要求你杀死盘踞在呼啸崇山深处的腐化之兽。 战胜这个怪物将为该地区带来和平并解锁一项全新的灵火升级，届时灵火祭坛将能够在你进行建造时帮助抵御寒冷。 为了唤醒并引出这头怪物，你必须点燃环绕内层山脉的篝火。 你的地图上已经标记了第一处篝火的位置。抵达标记位置以继续！
黄金空荡独眼巨人战利品

en: A mill that can be used to grind materials to a fine powder. This mill only works when there is a force generator nearby. Either windmill sails or a partially submerged water wheel counts as a generator. The force generator doesn't have to be connected to the mill; it can be placed freely nearby.
cn: 能够将材料研磨成细粉的石磨。 这种石磨只会在附近有动力来源时运作。风车帆或者是部分沉入水中的水轮都可以作为石磨的动力来源。 动力来源不需要与石磨直接相连并且可以自由放置在附近。

en: When placed in competent hands, this horned bow can fire a shot so powerful that it may loosen an avalanche, and bury the valleys in everlasting snow.
cn: 在熟练弓手的手中，这把角弓的猛烈射击将用犹如雪崩一般的漫天箭雨淹没整个山谷。

en: A golden jewel scarab beetle. It can be found in the Kindlewastes, and is used as fishing bait, especially useful to catch rare fish.
cn: 奢华璀璨的金龟子。可以在燃火荒原中找到，能够作为鱼饵使用，在尝试捕获稀有鱼时尤其有用。

en:
Its head alone weighs a monstrous amount. The shimmering scales are ice-cold.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
光是这个脑袋就沉得吓人。闪烁的鳞片摸上去十分冰冷。

收集多个瘴气魔幼龙头颅以制作战利品。

en: Opens doors in the Revelwood Hollow Halls.
cn: 能够打开喧嚣森林空荡礼堂的大门。

en:
A small part of a shattered Flame mosaic. Perhaps you can piece it together if you find all the shards!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.
cn:
一副火焰马赛克艺术品的碎片找齐所有碎片以拼凑出完整的艺术品！

能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到此收集品。完整系列包括8件物品。可以在火焰马赛克框架中重新组装为一套完整的马赛克艺术品。框架必须放置在地面上。

en: You've discovered that the color palette in the smuggler's camp is stored high up and away from the ground. Search for the color palette at a higher elevation!
cn: 你发现走私者营地中的调色板位于远离地面的高处。 前往更高的位置并寻找调色板！

en: You've found signs of Athalan Skree's travels through the Revelwood. She must have a camp nearby. Explore the <npc>Hunter</npc> camp and look around!
cn: 你在喧嚣森林中找到了阿萨兰·斯克里留下的踪迹。附近肯定有她的营地。探索<npc>猎人</npc>营地！

en: A large water wheel. It can be placed in water to generate force for a mill. Must be placed near the mill.
cn: 一个大型水轮。能够放置在水中以驱动石磨。 必须放置在石磨附近。
巨大、牢固而且刺骨寒冷。

en:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The beasts stand victorious, their supremacy uncontested. They are locked in a constant fight for leadership, spilling blood in a desperate attempt to gain the Ancient's favor and become gods in the afterlife.
cn:
详细记载着卓克的历史的浮雕。

野兽们赢得了胜利，他们的霸权无可争议。他们陷入了对于统治权的持续争斗中，他们绝望地挥洒着鲜血，只为了赢得远古者的青睐并在死后成为新的诸神。

en: An orange daylily flower. The petals are vibrant enough to be used for dyes.
cn: 一株橘色的日光百合花。颜色鲜艳的花瓣能够用于制作染料。

en: If you accidentally get caught in it, it will hurt a little and the shock will stun you for a short time. Better watch your step with these!
cn: 如果不小心踩中，你将会👌少量伤害并暂时晕眩。小心脚下！

en: I've been around for long, kid. Nothing much scares me anymore, and the <npc>Collector</npc> is no different. A strong ally, no matter their secrets. All that talk about the veil, about life and death... Can they bring someone back from beyond? I'd pay any price...
cn: 我已经活了很久很久，孩子。这世上已经没有多少能够吓到我的东西，就算是<npc>收藏家</npc>也不例外。无论究竟藏着什么样的秘密，此人依旧是一位强大的伙伴。我听说了很多关于帷幕，还有有关生命与死亡的事情……难道此人真的拥有起死回生的力量？如果是那样，无论要我付出多大的代价……

en: Parrying with a ward has a 20% chance to increase the stun time.
cn: 使用结界招架时有20%几率延长晕眩时间。

en: Hooray, new hair colors! Ugh, life is finally worth living again!
cn: 万岁，新的发色！啊，人生再一次有了意义！

en:
8.2.4	
In the case of Section 8.2.2, liability for damages due to data loss is limited to the amount required to restore the data that would also have been incurred if you had regularly backed up the data in a manner appropriate to the risk.
cn:
8.2.4	
在第 8.2.2 条所述情形下，因数据丢失所产生的损害赔偿责任，其金额限于恢复该等数据所需的费用，且以您若按照与风险相适应的方式定期备份数据时同样会发生的费用为限。

en: A large hammer, made from a combination of rock and steel. The mix of materials makes it especially heavy.
cn: 使用岩石与钢铁打造的大锤。不同材料之间的组合使得这把武器格外沉重。

en:
I've worked tirelessly for so long... I was the last to stay and try to hold on to anything... 

Dear Grandfather, I was a fool. I can't save the home you once built by hand... Fumes from the river make the stone brittle... my bones decay. A deep sorrow has crept inside me... It's attached to my spine, convulsing in my ribcage... 

I must sit... rest... only a moment of respite.
cn:
我已经想尽了一切办法……我留到了最后，想要抢救一些东西出来……

亲爱的祖父，我实在是太傻了。我没办法拯救你亲手建造的家……从河水里浮起的浓雾侵蚀了石头……我感觉自己的骨头都被腐蚀了。我只感觉内心中出现了一种难以言喻的悲伤……就附在我的脊梁上，在我的胸腔中涌动着……

我得坐下来……休息……我累了。

en: Contains a higher concentration of Shroud compared to Shroud Particles.
cn: 与瘴气粒子相比拥有更高浓度的瘴气。

en: The path of the scout is a little easier on quiet soles.
cn: 悄无声息的鞋底将帮助斥候前进。

en: A breezy roof made from natural materials. It makes you want to take a tropical vacation.
cn: 使用天然材料制作而成的透气屋顶。看见它就让你想要去热带度假。

en: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
Raw wool. It's fluffy, easily knotted, and smells vaguely earthy. It needs to be processed further to be used for garments and armor.
cn: 刚剪下来的毛料。蓬松而且十分容易打结，散发着一种泥泞的气味。需要进一步加工才能用于制作各类服饰与护甲。

en: Aye, small fry! I see you've been fishin'. Catching fish is all well and good, but sometimes, it's exciting to get your hook in a treasure, no? Makes you feel like some pirate, diggin' up gold! Well, if you ever want more of that feelin', I know the location of an old mariner's cache. Let me point you to it...
cn: 喂，小虾米！我看见你一直在钓鱼。能够抓到鱼固然很不错，但是有时候，钓上宝藏才是最刺激的，对吗？要是能钓上来几枚金币，你肯定会觉得自己就像海盗一样！总而言之，如果想要再次体验那种感觉的话，我可以告诉你哪里能找到老水手的宝藏。来，我指给你看……

en: You've reached the forge, but it's teeming with Scavengers defending their equipment. Reach the heart of the forge and defeat the enemies there!
cn: 你已经抵达锻炉，但是里面的拾荒者似乎一心想要守护自己的设备。抵达锻炉腹地并打败那里的敌人！

en: Thank you for playing the Enshrouded demo!
cn: 感谢您体验《雾锁王国》试玩版！

en: This section contains completed World Quests. You can replay them to experience the storylines by yourself and receive the rewards these quests grant. Activating a missed World Quest will temporarily reset your quest goals and map markers to your personal knowledge state. Activate a World Quest or deactivate the missed World Quests to return to the server knowledge state. If no missed quests are available, you've caught up with the quest progression of the server. Activate a regular World Quest to switch back to the server knowledge state or do Player Quests to proceed.
cn: 这里涵盖着已完成的世界任务。 你可以独自重新游玩以体验剧情并获得对应的奖励。 激活未完成过的世界任务将暂时把你的任务目标与地图标记重置为你个人已经掌握的情报状态。 激活世界任务，或者是关闭未完成过的世界任务以返回服务器的情报状态。 如果没有未完成的任务，那说明你已经跟上服务器的任务进度。激活常规世界任务以切换回服务器的情报状态，或者完成玩家任务以继续。

en: A light tunic, as majestic in appearance as the powers it bestows when you spread your arms wide.
cn: 一件轻便的短上衣，不光看上去威严雄伟，当你展开双臂时还能够获得不同寻常的力量。

en: The time required to shoot with the bow is reduced by 50%
cn: 弓的射击准备时间缩短50%

en:
Back off a bit.
Repeat the process until the animal fully trusts you.
cn:
现在稍稍退后一段距离。
重复此过程直到动物完全信任你。

en:
Mount it inside your halls to honor the Flame!

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
将其放置在大厅内，以纪念灵火！

收集多个瘴气魔雷兽头颅来制作战利品。

en: You have already uploaded these worlds.

Modified to increase the mana control, this wand shoots ice projectiles with a bit more force. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 这把改造后的魔棒能够更好地控制法力，因此能够发射较为强大的寒冰射弹。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。
醉酒的顾客与奇怪的报酬

en: This ring will increase your mana and its replenishment.
cn: 这枚戒指将提高你的法力与法力恢复。

en: Releases a ball of fire that delivers an explosive surprise. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 施放一团火球，为敌人带去爆炸惊喜。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: Call shivering icicles down on your foes. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 呼唤冰冷刺骨的冰锥打击敌人。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。
小型空荡之夜南瓜 I

en: Obsidian easily splinters off in sharp edges. Depending on the size, the splinter can be used for crafting purposes or shaped into arrowheads.
cn: 被敲碎的小块黑曜石，边缘十分锐利。根据尺寸不同，这些碎片可以用于制作其他物体或者是箭头。

en: Whenever an enemy within 30 meters targets an ally within 30 meters, there is a 30% chance the enemy will target you instead.
cn: 如果30米范围内有一名敌人准备攻击同样处于30米范围内的一名同伴，则该敌人有30%几率转而攻击你。

en: A weapon often used by the Vukah in ritualistic fights.
cn: 沃卡经常会在仪式战斗中使用这种武器。

en: Critical Strikes with Daggers increase damage dealt to the enemy by %k for %k seconds.
cn: 使用匕首造成暴击将使你对敌人造成额外%k伤害，持续%k秒。

en: Don't know how long I slept. In my dreams, I saw velvety, blue waves while voices serenaded me to join them in the deep. Weird dream. Must be because I hit my head in the fall. Yelling for help. I'm starving. Ate paper. Stomach hurts. Can't feel my arm. Day 5 My voice is gone. Throat feels like it's closing up. Something tastes rotten Can't tell if it's the paper or my tongue Day 6 Tried climbing out again. Fell. Hands blistered. The sun burns me. The voices cry. For a moment I thought the elevator was moving My head spins Day What day is today I don't know Still hungry I long to eat flesh ?? It's in the air All around me The voices, the rot There's no escape There's no air I'm sinking forever
cn: 我不知道自己睡了多久。在梦里面，我看见了像天鹅绒一般细腻的蓝色波浪，有好多动听的声音在恳求我前往深渊加入它们。这个梦真的太诡异了。肯定是因为之前掉下来的时候撞到了脑袋。我试着大声呼救，但是没有效果。我真的好饿。试着吃了几张纸。但只是害得肚子疼。我的手臂也没知觉。 第五天 我已经说不出话了。嗓子感觉要彻底堵死了。 嘴里总是有股腐烂的味道 不知道是之前吃的纸还是我的舌头 第6天 再一次试着爬出去。摔了下来。手上全是水疱。 阳光好烫。那些声音都在哭喊。 有那么一瞬间，我以为升降梯动了 我的脑袋好晕 第 今天是第几天了 我不知道 还是很饿 我想吃肉 ？？ 就在空气里 在我身边 那些声音，还有腐烂 逃不了 无法呼吸 我陷入了永恒的坠落

en: A six-edged mace made from heavy metal. The head of this weapon resembles a star.
cn: 使用沉重金属打造而成的六棱钉锤。武器的头部被做成了星星的造型。

en:
You've found both wall tapestry pieces. You can place them in a frame at your base to repair the tapestry. 

Completing the collection will unlock new crafting recipes!
cn:
你已经找到了两块挂毯碎片。回到基地后，你可以将碎片放置在框架中并修复挂毯。

完成挂毯将解锁全新的制作配方！

en:
Changing settings during play is currently disabled.
Please change settings in the main menu.
cn:
目前无法在游戏过程中更改设置。
请在主菜单中更改设置。

en: A precisely formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.
cn: 严格按照配方调制的魔力药水，使用时能够瞬间恢复巨量魔力。

en: They hide their horror with pungent cologne, barely masking the underlying stench of sweat. None revealed why. Only an older lady, with gray hair carelessly fallen into her kind face, would dare to name what they all feared. A "tremble in the earth" they feel at night keeps them awake. They've reported it to Pikemead's Reach, but to no avail. As a son of the glorious capital myself, I admit I've never heard of this story, either. Acknowledging it beyond a report would set their fears in stone, so most prefer to remain silent. In my deep slumber, the unnerving sounds don't reach me — still, I am restless. The light from my dreams burns brighter here. I've closed the salon for a few days to recover and have spent my time mixing pigments. The red dye I've concocted glistens in the sun like fresh blood. I hope it's not a bad omen. Did the stars call me here to suffer different carnage more to their liking? - Elio, forever pondering!
cn: 他们试图用刺鼻的古龙香水掩饰自己的恐惧，但其实根本无法盖住汗水的酸臭。没有人解释这其中的原因。最后还是一名上了年纪的女士说出了真相，凌乱的灰发散落在她慈祥的面容上，是她鼓起勇气说出了人们畏惧的真相。 有一股“大地深处的震动”吓得人们夜不能寐。虽然人们向派克米德之地汇报了此事，但并没有得到任何回应。身为一名光荣的首都子民，我承认我从未听说过类似的事情。倘若在报告以外的地方承认它的存在，就无异于承认了自己的恐惧，因此绝大多数人都选择了保持沉默。 虽然那些令人不安的声响从未打扰过我的沉睡，但我仍然感觉到了焦躁。在这个地方，梦中的月光似乎更为明亮。 我决定关闭沙龙歇业几天，并用这段时间来调配颜料。在阳光下，我调制出的红色染料就像是鲜血一样。希望这不是什么噩兆。难道星辰将我召唤至这里，是为了让我承受更符合它们喜好的屠杀？ - 埃里奥，我永远在沉思！

en: Firm ground beneath my feet? Clear skies above? No screeching and cawing? What devilry brought me here?
cn: 脚下的扎实大地？头顶的晴空万里？不再有尖叫与啸鸣？是什么恶魔的把戏将我带到了这里？
黑铁空荡独眼巨人 战利品

en: The bluejays no longer drift so carelessly through the air. Something is changing. A nebula flows towards us, springs from the abyss like a tidal wave. They call it the Shroud. It carries disease and suffering, changes soil and people. I must understand this madness, but discovering a remedy may prove difficult. Many trade routes between kingdoms have ceased operation... it seems that both materials and trust are in low supply. — Balthazar, 500 D.A.
cn: 蓝松鸦无忧无虑的身影从天空中消失了。有什么东西不一样了。 一片云海正向我们飘来，就像是从深渊中崛起的波涛。人们将之称为瘴气。带着瘟疫与痛苦的迷雾会扭曲土壤与人类。 我必须弄清楚这种疯狂背后的真相，但是研制解药恐怕十分苦难。诸王国之间的贸易路线都已经彻底停摆……看来物资与人们彼此间的信任都已所剩无几。 — 巴尔萨扎，500 D.A.

en: Your players will have a subpar experience.
cn: 您的玩家将获得低于标准的体验。

en: A very healthy soup made by boiling chicken for a period of time. An old house maiden's dish to help protect the body from illness.
cn: 长时间烹煮鸡肉获得的营养肉汤。用于治愈病痛的传统家常菜。

en:
You've followed the trail of the bandits who robbed Mei. Your investigation has led you to a note that revealed the presumed locations of each stolen weapon.

The Lunar New Year sword was planned to be handed to a buyer in a quiet corner of <location>Willow Crush</location>. Reach the location and look for clues there!
cn:
你跟随着抢劫梅的强盗们留下的踪迹。在调查时，你找到了一张纸条，上面记载着失窃的每一种武器的大概位置。

强盗们原本打算在<location>碎柳镇</location>的某个安静角落将春节刀剑交给一位买家。抵达纸条上记载的位置并寻找线索！

en: A loud, energetic dog with sunny fur that yearns for connection. Its tail hasn't stopped wagging ever since you freed it from its cage. The Scavengers that owned this dog previously called it "Ruffles".
cn: 一只精力充沛且爱闹的狗狗，像阳光一样灿烂的毛皮渴望着主人的关怀。自从你将它从笼子里救出来之后，它的尾巴就在不停甩来甩去。之前养这只狗的拾荒者管它叫“毛毛”。

en: Instantly restores a large amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.
cn: 立即恢复大量法力并提供10秒的持续恢复效果。
