en: The Blacksmith asked to investigate a strange letter he received, signed by someone he doesn't recognize. The note was shipped by the Conways, couriers from the Nomad Highlands. Their shipment must've gone through the Trade Outpost "Blazing Rock". Solving this mystery will allow you to craft better armor.
cn: 铁匠收到了一封奇怪的信件，署名还是个不认识的陌生名字。最初是来自游牧高地的信使康威投递了信件。他们在送信的路上肯定经过了“炎石”贸易站。 解决这个谜团就能制作更好的护甲。

en:
None can deny your authority when you're dressed in sacred white and royal lavender.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn:
在圣洁的白色与尊贵的紫罗兰色的加持下，没有人能够拒绝你的权威。

可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en: You have read a note which describes how the Draklings need a warm light source to hatch and how they create this fiery glow with daylilies. Go back to the Carpenter and tell him about your findings.
cn: 你找到的一份笔记上提到龙裔需要温暖的光源来孵化，而且还记录了他们是如何使用日光百合创造这种火焰般的光芒。 回去将你的发现告诉木匠。

en: Your PC is below the minimum system requirements and you may crash or experience bad performance. Do you still want to continue?
cn: 您的电脑低于最低系统要求，可能会出现死机或性能不佳的情况。您还想继续吗？

en: The Shadowbloom is one of the few plants resistant to the Kindlewastes heat. Their bright orange glowing petals are only visible at night and are used to make vibrant colors.
cn: 暗影花是少数能够抵御燃火荒原的炎热环境的植物。散发着亮橙色光芒的花瓣只会在夜晚现身，并且能够用于制作各种亮丽的色彩。

en: Dealing damage with One-Handed Melee weapons and Daggers has a %k chance to restore 1 durability to that weapon.
cn: 单手近战武器与匕首造成伤害后有%k几率为武器恢复1点耐久。

en: It's said that the original owner of this helmet wore it to hide his many facial scars. Whether this is true is uncertain.
cn: 据说，这顶头盔的原主人戴上它是为了掩盖自己脸上的许多伤疤。这是否属实尚不确定。

en: This special arrow deals little damage on its own but hits the target with massive force to increase the enemies' Stun Bar. Stun Bar increase scales with dexterity. Stun time depends on the enemy's size. Overpower Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered. Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.
cn: 这枚特殊箭矢本身的伤害微乎其微，但是它能够以巨大的力量大幅提高敌人的晕眩条。 晕眩条增长幅度受到敏捷属性影响。 晕眩时间取决于敌人的体型。 压制 攻击格挡中的敌人或者是招架敌人的攻击都会使他们的晕眩条上涨，直到最后进入被压制状态。 被压制的敌人将毫无防备，这种时候你可以对其发动残酷打击。

en: A metal used to create bronze. It can be found in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 用于制作青铜的金属。分布于游牧高地。

en: The lingering presence of the Flame can be felt strongly in this weapon. It gleams with power.
cn: 能够感受到这种武器中存在着灵火的强烈印记。武器闪烁着力量的光芒。

en: Increases Critical Strike damage against Soaked enemies
cn: 提高对湿透敌人的暴击伤害

en: Two heavy millstones used to pulverize things. Perfect to grind flour.
cn: 用于碾碎物体的两块沉重石磨。制作面粉的最佳选择。

en: Use this showcase to reassemble the Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename> statue.
cn: 使用这个展示柜来重新组装<lorename>派克米德</lorename>女王的雕像。

en: Advanced magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 高级魔法弹药，使用时将施放一个强力火球，火球将在撞击时爆炸，并对中等范围内的目标造成伤害。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: You look sick, Flameborn! Are you unwell? Let me help you!
cn: 你看上去不太对劲，火之子！是生病了吗？让我来帮你吧！

en: What we do in life echoes in eternity.
cn: 生前的所作所为将在永恒中回荡。

en: You've found all the music sheets! You're a true musician at heart, mh?
cn: 你已经找到了所有乐谱！看来你是一位真正的音乐家。

en:
A flower with star-shaped petals. It fills the moonlit valleys of the Albaneve Summits with the smell of death.

Its deep, dark color can be used to make pitch-black pigments.
cn:
一种长着星形花瓣的花卉。这种植物会在月光照耀下的阿尔班耶夫山脉山谷中散播死亡的恶臭。

深沉无比的色彩能够用于制作同样漆黑的颜料。
点燃最冰冷的魔药之井

en: Knightly pants. The cloth attached brandishes a glorious golden thread.
cn: 裤子上绣着金色的花纹，彰显着骑士的高贵气质。
制作或获取一个工作台

en: Joining failed. The game session is already full.
cn: 加入失败。游戏房间已满。

en: A small campfire to cook food that can give many bonuses. It's a great spot to take a rest and relax.
cn: 小型营火能够用于烹饪有益身体的食物，同时也是休息放松的好选择。
可以请你帮忙找东西吗？

en: The Barber wants to remember how to create the perfect blue hair dye. He's unsure what he's looking for but thinks he needs an "indigo-colored" hint. Perhaps bringing him an indigo plant will help him remember!
cn: 理发师想要重新回忆制作完美的蓝色染发剂的方法。虽然不确定具体需要什么，但是理发师觉得自己需要某种“靛青颜色”的灵感。 也许只需要看见靛青植物，他就能够重新回想起来！

en: Reinforced with Metal Scraps for better protection.
cn: 使用金属废料加固以提供更好的防护效果。

en:
Sometimes, when the tropical winds of the Veilwater Basin roll towards the cold air of the mountains, a thundersnow is born. 
The snowfall softens its roars, but it leaves traces in the freshly cracked surfaces of frozen ponds.
cn:
有时候当幕水盆地的热带强风冲向山间的冰冷寒风，一场雷打雪就会发生。
虽然地上的落雪能够减轻天空中的咆哮声，但是雷暴仍然会在冰封池塘刚刚破裂的表面留下痕迹。

en: Ground up coals, creating a highly flammable powder.
cn: 将木炭碾碎后获得的易燃粉末。
搜索布莱林之桥的支柱

en: Find All Guard Of The North Armor Pieces
cn: 找齐所有“北境守卫”护甲部件

en: Scales the amount of XP received by exploring and completing quests.
cn: 调整探索以及完成任务时获得的经验值数量。
哦，我需要振奋人心的清爽！

en: We gotta get movin'. Time waits for no one, aye?
cn: 我们得动起来。时间不等人，对吗？

en: A crafting material that's been infused or overtaken by acidic Shroud.
cn: 融合了酸性或者是被酸性瘴气侵蚀的制作材料。

en:
The Sunscale's name is derived from the distinctive shimmer of its scales, which catch the sunlight.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
阳鳞的名字来源于它们的鳞片在阳光下展现出的独特闪烁。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。

en: Perhaps "Architect" is too grand a term — the blueprints were provided by the traveler, after all. The engineers and builders only have to fall in line. The monolithic structure is twofold, stretching both towards the setting sun and the sleeping core. A hollow crown reigns above to imprison within it the light of the fading moon. Its shadow is as black as its stone. From below rises the fabled mist. Most don't see it, or pretend not to. When I brought attention to it, the workers fell silent. The "Architect" stuttered under his breath, gaze averted... his lowered head betrayed his words. He mistakes me for a madman. My wanderer came forth from my right side and spoke to break the silence. "A bit of mist is to be expected. No harm will come from it. In fact, we may welcome its arrival." The words echo in my head. We may welcome its arrival. Yes, perhaps it will guide us. Guide our hands. Our shaking hands Ever shaking, leaving traces. Traces of a ghostly silhouette, reverberating A wraith chained to its own afterimage, chasing it, spinning a vignette of fading blue With eyelids pulled towards the moon Telling truth from lies, a floating spiral of the past and present, and future, and eternity We may welcome its arrival — Lord Vorgoth, Guard of the North, Ruler of Rimgard
cn: 也许“建筑师”这个词有点过了——说到底，是旅人给我们提供了蓝图。工程师与工人们只需要照着做就行。 巨大的建筑分为两部分，一个方向直至落日，另一个方向则指向沉睡的地核。高悬在顶部的空荡王冠能够囚禁消逝的月光。王冠的阴影和本体的石材一样漆黑。 传说中的迷雾从地下深处冉冉升起。绝大多数人都没有看见，或者是假装没有看见。当我提到这件事的时候，工人们都陷入了沉默。“建筑师”说话时支支吾吾，眼神也在到处躲闪……低垂的头颅已经出卖了他的真实想法。他误以为我是个疯子。 这时候旅人从我的右侧身后走上前并打破了沉默。 “我们早已预料到会有些许迷雾渗出。不过它们不会带来危害，恰恰相反，我们欢迎它们的到来。”这些话一直回荡在我的脑海里。我们欢迎它们的到来。 没错，也许它们将为我们带来指引，指引着我们颤抖的双手 永远在颤抖的双手留下痕迹。一个鬼魅身影的痕迹，不断震动 一个被自己的残影给禁锢的幽灵，追逐着它，并掀起了淡蓝色的剪影 那个幽灵的双眼被月亮所吸引 在谎言中分辨真相，一道漂浮着的螺旋融合了过去 现在、将来以及永恒 我们永远欢迎它们的到来 — 沃格斯领主，北境守卫，里姆加德的统治者

en: Tasty and fresh berries, stimulating the bodily regeneration abilities with fresh vitamins for a short duration.
cn: 新鲜可口的浆果，大量维他命能够使身体暂时激活自我愈合能力。

en: Fossils have such lyrical names... Am-mo-nite... tri-lo-bite... Pretty sure I knew a bard once named Trillobythe. He was old, too.
cn: 化石的学名真是富有诗意……比如说菊石……或者是三叶虫……说起来，我记得以前认识一个叫三叶的吟游诗人。那老头的名字古怪的很。

en: A dark and dreary set of gloves. They make spellcasting feel ominous!
cn: 充满黑暗气息的手套，让你的法术释放显得更加神秘莫测！

en: A farmbed which will yield Purple Berries.
cn: 能够产出紫色浆果的农地。

en: Increases the skill level of Necromancer
cn: 提高死灵法师的技能等级

en: Looks like rain is gonna fall...

Before I was, uh, vacationing behind bars, I was a jester and knife-throwing circus artist! My cousin supported me with my sets, but sadly, my jokes and knives didn't quite land how I wanted them to. Especially the latter... I don't want to dwell on it, but I had a little accident during one of the shows. First, we laughed. Then, they threw us in jail. Ah, good ol' days. Wish I still had that jester hat, though.
cn: 在我……呃……去监狱度假之前，我其实是一名宫廷小丑兼飞刀杂耍艺人！我的表亲一直在支持我的工作，但是很不幸，我的笑话与飞刀并不总是能达到理想化的效果。尤其是飞刀……照理说过去的事情不该再提，但是我到现在还记得一次表演期间出现的小事故。一开始大家都捧腹大笑。但是很快我们就统统被关进了大牢。啊，真是美好的过去。要是我的那顶小丑帽子还在就好了。

en:
We trekked through mud, stalks, and marshland until we reached a clearing. Beyond, the tar turned to water, and the reeds gave way to bamboo and palm trees.

I lowered myself to wash my hands by a pond lined with daylilies, which reached towards vines and mossy stumps further out. Their vibrancy and scent reminded me of my love. Perhaps this moment of carelessness spelled my demise.

A family of frogs sprang from the thicket, each more panicked than the last. I looked up, and my gaze was met by a spear's tip that rushed from the shadowy overgrowth — its reflection below broken by the water's wake.
The rumors rang true. The Drak had returned... and in this moment, I was facing their hunger for blood.

As I held my breath, the spear-wielding Drak let his eyes wander. When his gaze found that of the Ancients around, he straightened his stance, shouted, and dropped his weapon with a splash. His body coiled into a prayer pose, sinking to his knees in the tarn before me. I rushed backwards, grasping a sharp rock as a makeshift defense tool as I stumbled — needlessly, for the beasts revere my fellow travelers as messengers of their gods and gatekeepers of Ark Morgo, their land of the dead.

How this fateful misconception was born, I am not privy to. But today, it saved me from crossing into Ark Morgo myself. Had I been alone, I wouldn't have been so lucky.

— Queen Jezmina of Orindell
cn:
我们在泥泞、茎秆与湿地中艰难跋涉，直到最后来到了一处空地。在另一侧，焦油变为了清水，芦苇则变成了竹子与棕榈树。

我俯下身用池塘中的清水洗净了双手，旁边的日光百合延伸向了远处的藤蔓与苔藓。鲜亮的色彩与清新的气味让我想起了自己的爱人。也许是这一刻的大意为我招致了灾难。

一群青蛙从灌木丛中跳了出来，而且它们看上去满脸惊恐。当我抬起头，我的视线与一个从布满阴影的草丛中戳出的长矛相遇了——它在下方的倒影刺穿了原本平静的水面。
看来传闻是真的。龙裔已经归来……在这一刻，我才首次见到了它们对于鲜血的渴望。

就当我屏住呼吸时，手持长矛的龙裔的眼神却开始游走。当他终于发现附近有远古者的身影，他立刻挺直了身子大叫了起来，他丢下的武器伴随着一阵声响掉入了水中。他的身体也蜷曲成了祈祷的姿态，他跪倒在了我面前的小水洼中。我立刻向后退了回去，在跌跌撞撞的过程中我随手抓起来一块尖锐的石头作为临时性的防御——不过其实并不需要如此，要知道那些野兽都将我的同行者们视作他们信奉诸神的信使，以及魔戈方舟，他们的亡者之地的看门人。

这种奇妙的误解究竟是从何而来，这我并不知晓。但是在今天，这使得我避免了亲自进入魔戈方舟。如果只是我孤身一人，恐怕就不会有那么幸运了。

 — 奥林戴尔的杰兹米娜女王

en: Reached the ancient spire in the Revelwoods.
cn: 抵达喧嚣森林的远古尖塔。

en: A block made out of Palm Leaves, spreading a warm atmosphere. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 使用棕榈叶做成的方块，散发着一股温暖的氛围。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: Critical Strikes with Magic weapons will automatically hit a second enemy within 15 meters for 5 Shock damage per Intelligence.
cn: 使用魔法武器造成暴击时，攻击将自动命中15米范围内的另外一名敌人，每点智力造成5点电击伤害。

en: Switch between the recipes you have unlocked for this factory here.
cn: 你可以在这里为工坊切换已经解锁的配方。

en: You've found a note which explains that a man named Otto inherited some farmlands. Find the farm and investigate it!
cn: 你找到了一张字条，上面说一个名叫奥托的男人继承了一些农田。找到并调查字条中的农场！

en:
Fenrig the Farmer believes that life is utterly meaningless without some garden gnomes. He wasn't allowed to have any, but other farms might have had garden gnomes as decorations.

Visit one such farm and find a garden gnome!
cn:
农民芬里格觉得没有花园小矮人的生活毫无意义。之前芬里格的妻子不允许他在家里放小矮人，但是其他农场说不定有装饰用的花园小矮人。

拜访农场并寻找花园小矮人！

en: Hey Davis, I hope you're well. I have an urgent request. Do you know the hermit from the mountain behind the ravine who comes by sometimes? The strange old fellow, dressed in pelts, that trades amethysts for supplies? He came by again but didn't ask for herbs, spices, or vegetables. The man was pleading for medicine, but we were all out. Even the bag of amethysts he clutched in his wrinkly hands couldn't change that. Once we receive new stock, could you put some tinctures aside for him? Our soldiers take priority, but the old chap was desperate, so let's reserve some when we see him again. Or rather, if we see him again. Such a journey cannot be easy on his old bones.
cn: 你好戴维斯，希望你一切安好。我现在有一件要事相求。 你认识那个偶尔会来的隐士么，就是住在溪谷后面的山上的那个人？那个奇怪的老人总是穿着一身皮草，而且会用紫水晶交换各种补给？ 之前他又来了，但这次他要的不是药草、香料或者是蔬菜。他想要药品，但问题是当时我们一点存货也没有了。虽然他用长满皱纹的双手拿出了一整袋紫水晶，但我们是真的没办法给他。 等我们这里补货的时候，能不能麻烦你给他留一点药剂？我知道我们需要优先照顾士兵们的需求，但是这老家伙看上去太可怜了，就给他留一点吧，下次见面的时候给他。 只希望这不是我们最后一次看见他。瞧他那副垂垂老矣的模样，要来这里恐怕十分困难。

en: You said they'd arrive by Monday noon! Well, I waited AGES to receive the parcel for Oswald Anders... prepared a wagon and everything, since you said it'd be heavy. All for nothing! Tell the Conway brothers to send a raven, should they want to reschedule. Although... if they tried to take a shortcut through Umber Hollow, we've shirked them for good. In my defense: I told them to avoid that route. It might be their last.
cn: 你不是说他们周一中午就能到么！为了取奥斯瓦尔德·安德斯的包裹我都不知道等了多久……我甚至还特意备了辆马车。还说什么货物很沉。搞了半天白等！ 告诉康威兄弟，如果想要改签的话就寄渡鸦信过来。不过……如果他们想从褐赭空洞走捷径的话，我们估计就不用等他们出现了。这不能怪我：我明明告诉过他们别走那里。所以无论出什么事只能怪他们活该。
让我们把这里翻修一遍！

en: When killing an enemy with a melee weapon, all players within 15 meters of the target gain 20 Stamina.
cn: 使用近战武器击杀敌人时，目标周围15米范围内的所有玩家获得20点体力。

en: Salvation! The people of East Lapis have gathered survivors for a caravan... led by queen Jezmina herself. When I heard her speech, saw the wind in her hair... I knew I'd follow. With the flame of devotion and courage, a light shines brightly towards new beginnings. The queen is a marvel, determined, and enduring. Radiant. Beautiful. I aspire to be like her... to inspire people and lift them like she does. It pains me to leave my tavern, but as long as my heart beats, I'll build. I'll grow.... and hold on. Especially with my queen bravely leading the way. — Emily Fray
cn: 希望！东之岩的幸存者们已经组建起了一个车队……由杰兹米娜女王本人带领。在台下听她的演讲的时候，我看见了她的秀发迎风飞舞的样子……那一刻我就知道自己将追随她。伴随着虔诚与勇气的火焰，一道闪耀的光芒将照亮全新的开始。 女王陛下的美貌光彩夺目，而且她有着超凡脱俗的坚韧不拔精神。我希望有一天自己能够像她一样……去激励和引导身边的人们。要离开自己的酒馆我很是难过，但是只要我还活着，那么我就能继续建造与耕作……我一定要坚持下去。我的女王将勇敢地带领我们前进。 — 艾米丽·弗莱

en: Even in the simplest setting, this skewer comes together easily with meat, a tomato, and a small flame.
cn: 哪怕条件再简陋，你只需要肉、番茄以及一处火苗就可以烹饪这种美味烤串。

en: I want to smith with new materials! Come on, bring me some gold!
cn: 我想要尝试全新的冶炼材料！加油，给我带点黄金回来！

en: Back in my school days, I was taught that Captain Melville liked to tell stories. Tall ones. The kind of tales that smell more like old boots than truth. As a working man, I’ve always known his tavern, "Ol’ Salt ’N Pepper", was named not just for his sea-worn beard, but because you’re supposed to take everything he says with a pinch, nay, a load of salt. And yet, people lap it up. They crowd around him like he’s some sea-born prophet, hanging on every crooked word. Why? The man’s a liar. A fossil. He hasn’t been out past the bay in years. Why trust a word he says — even worse, why buy his fish? Especially when we sell better catch, cheaper, and without the song and dance! Just last week, he burst into the square, hair all tangled, shouting, "The Drak! I saw 'em, they're back!" Theatrics. Always theatrics with him. It’s just another one of his tales, spun for coin and glory. And yet, folks eat it up. Fools, the lot of 'em.
cn: 还在上学的时候，我就已经知道梅尔维船长喜欢讲故事。不过都是些荒诞离奇的故事，比起真相更像是老人的幻想。如今有了工作，我也已经知道，他的酒馆“椒盐”的名字并不是来源于那被海水泡烂的面包，而是因为那个老家伙说的每一句话都像是拌入胡椒的食盐一样半真半假。 尽管如此，人们仍然对那些故事乐此不彼。 人们会像对待一位海洋的先知那样聚精会神地聆听他的每一句话。为什么？那个男人就是个骗子，而且还是个老古董，他已经很多年没有离开过海湾了。为什么会有人愿意相信他说的话——更糟糕的，买他的鱼？尤其是当我们这里明明出售更便宜、品质更好的渔获，而且也不会鬼话连篇去欺骗顾客！ 就在上周，那个男人突然闯进了广场，他的头发全都扭结缠绕在了一起，但他只是一个劲地喊着，“卓克！我看见了，它们回来了！”明摆是在演戏。那个男人真的太浮夸了。 这肯定又是他为了骗取钱币和荣誉而使的把戏。但尽管如此，人们还是深信不疑。 蠢货，全都是蠢货。

en: Here you can track the production process. The factory will produce the selected recipe until no ingredients are left or the factories inventory is full.
cn: 您可以在这里跟踪生产过程。工坊会一直生产所选配方，直到原料用完或工坊物品栏满了为止。

en: A Rare Handpan For The Bard
cn: 为吟游诗人准备的稀有手碟

en: This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. The full collection includes 8 pieces. They can be reassembled into a mosaic inside a Flame Mosaic Frame. The Frame must be placed on the ground.
cn: 能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到此收集品。完整系列包括8件物品。可以在火焰马赛克框架中重新组装为一套完整的马赛克艺术品。框架必须放置在地面上。

en: Forge A Path Through The Wild
Once concealed by the Ancients, its might had been set free.
cn: 它曾被远古者隐藏，如今又重回世人眼前。

en: Weapons containing a gem cannot be destroyed!
cn: 镶嵌有宝石的武器无法被摧毁！

en: Hmm… maybe if I cast this spell on myself long enough, I can shock-freeze my body — and then thaw whenever I wish. That way, I could extend my life… right? Right?! I’ve done it! I made it!
cn: 嗯……也许如果我对自己持续使用这种法术，我可以将自己的身体急冻起来——之后还可以随时随地解冻。那样的话，我应该能够延长自己的生命……对吗？对吗？！ 我做到了！我成功了！

en:
There wasn't much substance to begin with, but now only the empty shell remains. Show off your pride with this golden trophy.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
cn:
虽然原本就所剩无几，但现在只剩下了一具空壳。使用黄金战利品展示你的骄傲。

收集多个瘴气魔独眼巨人头颅以制作黄金战利品。

en: My Mortar! You brought it with you. It didn't cause you any trouble, right? Please, place it in our base for me, will you?
cn: 我的磨臼！你把它带回来了。希望你没有遇上太多麻烦。拜托了，帮我放在我们的基地里面，好吗？

en: Tongs, Tony — Patient Data, Archived — Report Nr. A.051
cn: 托尼·通斯 — 患者数据，已归档 — 病历号A.051

en: Where did you come from? Get down! DOWN! There are vultures everywhere — hand me an arrow! I'll bring 'em down, and you finish 'em off! ...Wait, the skies are clear. I'm not in that dreadful nest... thanks to you. The name's Galen. I hunt. I'll be your bow if you'll be my shelter.
cn: 你是从哪里来的？趴下！快趴下！这里到处是秃鹫，我需要一支箭！等我把它们打下来，你就冲上去！……等等，这里的天空很晴朗。我已经不在那个可怕的巢穴里了……谢谢你。我叫盖伦。我是个猎人。如果你愿意提供庇护所，我将成为你的弓箭。

en: A fun little hat for fun little parties!
cn: 为好玩的派对准备的有趣帽子！

en: Stop asking until the next time I open this menu.
cn: 在我下次打开此菜单之前不再提问。

en: A heavy breastplate that has lost its shine, but not its notoriety.
cn: 虽然失去光泽，但威名依然不减的沉重胸甲。

en: What a wonderful hidden temple! This room is foreboding and dusty, but I find myself most intrigued by its entry... Did the Ancients craft these incredibly gigantic doors for their breed? Or does their origin surpass that of the Ancients...? Were the people living here eons ago just... very tall or something? Tall fellows are overrated. I'd love a stout, short king instead. With a build like that, they'd fit perfectly into the rest of our family. There must be many more temples! I wonder what else I can find...? I'm sore from my travels, but just one more venture won't hurt! — Braelyn
cn: 真是一座不可思议的隐藏神庙！内室虽然宏伟巨大，但是因为无人打理已经满是灰尘，不过我最感兴趣的，还是这里的门厅…… 难道是因为当年的远古者们身形庞大，所以才必须要建造这种令人叹为观止的巨大门扉？还是说这些建筑要早于远古者本身……？也有可能只是因为亘古之前在这里生活过的人们……本身就极其高大？不过谁在乎高大。我反正更喜欢短小精悍的国王。只有那样子才符合我们家族的标准。 - 肯定还有更多的神庙！就是不知道该去哪里寻找……？漫长的旅行已经让我疲惫不堪，不过再来一次冒险应该也无妨！ - 布莱林

en: A little archaic, but better than cloth.
cn: 虽然穿上去略显陈旧，但其实比布料更好。

en: The Hunter explained that a Spinning Wheel can be used to create linen and string in more cost-effective ways. Craft a Spinning Wheel at the Huntress and place it to enable more cost-effective crafting options.
cn: 猎人解释说纺车制作亚麻布与线绳的效率更高。 在女猎人处制作一台纺车，放置纺车以开启更为高效的制作选项。

en: Silver-framed metal gloves with elaborate finger plates. The fingertip covers sharpen at the end into claw-like points.
cn: 嵌有银边的金属手套上还安装有造型精美的指部板甲。指尖部分经过特意打磨，已经变得像是乌鸦的利爪一般尖锐。

en:
Armors, Shields, and Rings can now be enhanced with Runes! Upgrading them unlocks powerful perks and increases armor points.

Due to these changes, armor points have been rebalanced. Make sure to increase your armor points again by enhancing your gear.
cn:
现在护甲、盾牌与戒指都可以使用符文进行强化！升级这些装备将解锁强大特性并提高它们的护甲值。

因为机制改动，我们已对护甲点进行了平衡调整。请通过强化装备来重新提高护甲点。

en: A jagged tusk that's been tainted by the Shroud. Pulsing with faint traces of toxic energy Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Boar, initially found in the Revelwood.
cn: 表面参差不齐的獠牙，已经被瘴气彻底腐化。仍然在散发着隐约的毒素能量 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于喧嚣森林中的野猪。

en: Stride forth in these shoes, as swiftly as your mana regenerates.
cn: 踩着这些靴子踏浪前行并感受迅捷的法力恢复。

en: Took you long enough. Let's get to work.
This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 此收藏品在 燃火荒原 中找到。

en: A collection of conical teeth. The Drak lose them aplenty throughout their lives, and fill the more permanent holes with gold implants or rage.
cn: 一把锥状齿。卓克的一生中会失去很多牙齿，它们会选择用黄金填充物或者怒火去填充那些永久性的缺损位置。

en: Opens doors in the Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls.
cn: 能够打开阿尔班耶夫山脉空荡礼堂的大门。

en: A pair of thick gloves, stuffed with warm, white fur. The area around the back of the wrist is shielded with a small metal plate.
cn: 一双厚实的手套，里面填充有温暖的白色皮草。手腕部分安装有一块用于保护的小型金属板。

en: Why am I not on my post? And who are you? "A Flameborn"? Greetings, then! I'm Gunther Galeforth, a "soldier", I suppose. I fancy myself more of a poet, maybe a gardener. Let me know if I can help with anything!
cn: 这里不是我的岗哨？你是谁？你说自己是“火之子”？明白了，你好！我是冈瑟·盖尔福斯，算是一名“士兵”。不过说实话我认为自己更像是一名诗人，或者是园丁。如果有什么需要帮忙的地方尽管叫我！

en: Equipped armor grants %k increased Physical Armor.
cn: 装备的护甲提供额外%k的物理护甲。

en: So, you find out anythin' 'bout them Drak's secret tricks yet?
cn: 所以你找到卓克的秘密了吗？

en: Build A Sheltered Bed For Oswald Anders
cn: 为奥斯瓦尔德·安德斯建造一张受到庇护的床

en: Whoa, what a great catch! I underestimated you Fishborn- err I mean Flameborn har har!
cn: 哇哦，这可是个好东西！看来是我低估了你，渔之子……呃我是说火之子哈哈！

en: A crisp, vibrant red bell pepper with a sweet, juicy flavor and a glossy skin.
cn: 口感清脆而且颜色鲜艳的红色甜椒，汁水饱满且甜美，外皮则十分光滑。

en: All the forgotten knowledge of the world will be at your fingertips with these highly sought-after gloves.
cn: 有了这副备受追捧的手套，世界上所有被遗忘的知识都将触手可及。

en: An organic growth that glows brightly in the deep, dark waters.
cn: 能够在黑暗的深水区绽放明亮光芒的有机增殖物。
我们的呼唤得到了回应！

en: Find all forgotten "guard of the north" armor pieces.
cn: 找齐所有被遗忘的“北境守卫”护甲部件。

en: When gazing upon the crystal's surface, you feel the mirror image warp and shift into something... unsettling.
cn: 凝视水晶表面时，你会发现自己的镜像扭曲变形为了……某种令人不安的东西。

en: I’ve never seen anything so dark, yet mesmerizing. It feels as if it’s whispering to me, begging me to claim it. I have to possess the Obsidian Blocks, it’s a craving I can’t ignore. But where to keep them safe? Perhaps above the lava pools — who would dare risk their life to reach it? Only a fool would try. Whether I get caught or not, taking these blocks is bound to be my path to darkness — but at least I’ll have what I desire.
cn: 我从未见过如此黑暗又让人难以忘怀的东西。感觉它就像是在悄悄乞求我将自己带走。我必须拿到黑曜石方块，我无法控制心中的渴望。 但是哪里才能安全地储存这些东西？也许岩浆池上方的位置吧 — 因为不会有人为此去冒生命危险？只有傻瓜才会做那种事。 无论这么做是否会被发现，拿走这些方块注定将我带上一条黑暗的道路，但这就是我想做的。

en: Every apprentice knows that the Blackened Staff hides dark secrets. Trying to uncover them leads to migraines, nausea, and paranoia.
cn: 所有学徒都知道黑色法杖之中藏着黑暗的秘密。但是试图了解那些事只会引来头疼、恶心与精神错乱的后果。
浮标击中了一处障碍物。

en: The Carpenter has embedded a small treasure within the middle pillar of <lorename>Braelyn</lorename> Bridge as a signature. The Bridge itself is in the Springlands.
cn: 作为自己的“标志”，木匠在<lorename>布莱林</lorename>大桥中央的柱子中藏了一份小宝藏。大桥就在春日平原中。

en: The Alchemist gave a lecture regarding "Mycelium." It's the flesh of the fungi that spreads the Shroud throughout the world. People once believed it could bring salvation, but instead, it turned the world to ruin.
cn: 炼金术士讲解了“菌丝”的知识。这种物质是在各地散播瘴气的真菌的肉质部分。曾经人们以为这些东西能够带来救赎，但最后它们却毁灭了整个世界。

en: A plant commonly found in the Albaneve Summits. It has healing properties.
cn: 一种常见于阿尔班耶夫山脉的植物。拥有治疗效用。

en: Combine The Pieces In A Frame
This item is linked to an important quest. Follow the instructions in your journal to proceed!
cn: 此物品关乎一项重要人物。 跟随日志中的指示以继续！

en: You've found the Hollow Halls in the Nomad Highlands. Descend and reach the end to please the <npc>Collector</npc>.
cn: 你已经找到了游牧高地中的空荡礼堂。前往最深处并完成<npc>收藏家</npc>的任务。

en: Your body is regenerating over time
cn: 你的身体正在不断再生

en: We're not done yet, are we?

You found a note that mentions a Cyclops cave near a bridge. 

Investigate the cave and defeat the Cyclops within!
cn:
你找到的一张纸条上提到一座大桥旁有一个独眼巨人洞穴。

调查洞穴并打败里面的独眼巨人！

en: Striking with staggering force, this hammer obliterates the Hollow by grinding their bones to dust. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.
cn: 这把锤子摧枯拉朽一般的打击能够把所有空荡挫骨扬灰。 空荡回音： 这把武器释放的不洁回响魔力能够延长攻击范围。

en:
You've reached the location that Rochelle spoke of.

Enter the tomb and search it to retrieve the cosmetic blacksmith outfit!
cn:
你已经抵达罗茜提到的地点。

进入墓穴并找到铁匠外观服饰！
空荡礼堂 展示柜（小型栏位x2）

en: The route through Umber Hollow was a bad call, but we had no choice! Hank, that laggard, wasted time snoozin', so we had to take a shortcut if we wanted to reach "Blazing Rock" on time! If we're late again, I'm bound to lose out on a lot of coinage. We can't have that, ya see? So we descended and set up camp in the Jasper Isles come dusk. First nightwatch was supposed to be Hank's, but of course, that buffoon slept through it. Stupid! Reckless! Some shrouded folk crept up on us...and we lost the parcel upon fleeing. No matter. We'll write our own letter! And the gift, well... Oswald Anders won't know it's missing. I'll sign something lovely, and get my creative juices flowin'... Hank can help. Guy will be none the wiser. Easy, ya see?
cn: 借道褐赭空洞实在是个糟糕至极的选择，但我们没得选！都怪汉克那个懒鬼一直在呼呼大睡，这害得我们损失了许多时间，如果想要准时抵达“炎石”的话我们只能选择走捷径！如果这次再迟到，我肯定就要损失一大笔钱。要是真那样就糟了，你明白吗？ 所以我们决定往下走，等到黄昏来临便在贾斯帕群岛扎营过夜。本来应该是汉克来负责第一班守夜，但那蠢货直接睡过去了。这个鲁莽的傻瓜！ 半夜我们遭遇了瘴气民的偷袭，然后……我们在逃跑的过程中不小心丢了包裹。不过没事，大不了我们自己写一封信就行了！至于礼物嘛……反正奥斯瓦尔德·安德斯也不知道有这东西。 到时候我会尽可能写个爱意满满的签名，然后发挥一下自己的创作才华……汉克可以帮忙。到时候绝对能够以假乱真。这事轻而易举，你说呢？

en: Increases the skill level of Marksman

If the data samples didn't match, I'd pass this theory off as a bad joke. But they do. The structure of these giant bones is similar to that of the Whitewing Vulture sample we took during that snowstorm. There's a historical relation here, the same ancestral blood. Not just the skeletons here, but in the Kindlewastes, too. It's all pointing towards dragons. All this distracts my obelisk research, but I hope to return to deciphering those soon. Only if the dragons don't get me first, that is. — Loraine Crim, Yearfall, 508 D.A.
cn: 如果数据样本不匹配，这种理论最多算是个糟糕的笑话。问题是两份样本几乎一模一样。 这些巨型骷髅的结构与我们在暴风雪中无意间找到的白翼秃鹫样本别无二致。两者享有相同的历史联系，而且来自同一种古老的血统。不光是这里的骷髅，燃火荒原那里的样本也一样。 一切都指向了龙。 说实话这些发现与我的方尖碑研究并无关系，但我希望能够尽快回去研究这其中的秘密。前提是我不会在方尖碑那里遇到活着的龙。 —洛琳·克里姆，岁末，508 D.A.

en:
The color of red wine, dried blood, and broken promises.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
红酒、干涸血渍与破碎诺言的颜色。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。

en: The world is its own magic.

cn: 寻找一名吟游诗人助手

en: These improved archery gloves make it easier to shoot birds straight out of the sky! There are hardly any birds these days, though.
cn: 这些经过改良的弓箭手手套能让你更轻松地射下天空中的鸟儿！不过，现在天上基本没有鸟了。
调查位于<location>碎丛</location>的艾米丽·弗莱的酒馆

en: BUILD HIGHER! The tower must reach the zenith and rival the grace of the sun itself! Matron Leandra demands so! I've procured the finest castle stone — find it at the tower's back. Only the best for Matron Leandra!
cn: 往高里造！高塔必须到达天顶，遮光蔽日！这是莉安德拉夫人的命令！我已经找到了最精美的城堡石材……就在高塔背后。 莉安德拉夫人的一切都必须是最好的！

en: With this footwear, the healing power of the earth flows straight through you — can you feel it?
cn: 穿上这件足具后，大地的治愈之力将直接流入你的体内……你感受到了吗？

en: Blood Rage Increases Melee weapon damage by 20% for 10 seconds.
cn: 鲜血狂暴 近战武器伤害提高20%，持续10秒。

en: This voice surely deserves an award.
cn: 这种美丽的声音确实应该得到嘉奖。

en: It's a fine roof! Can't be choosy these days. Anyway, maybe we can do some woodworkin', eh?
cn: 这屋顶真不错！说实话这时候也没办法挑三拣四了。总而言之，现在我们应该可以开始做一些真正的木工活了吧！

en: You've crafted the cat food needed to tame a stray cat. Now go to <location>Lone Thistle</location> and search the Alchemist's tower above the Shroud to find and tame a cat!
cn: 你已经制作了驯服野猫要用到的猫粮。现在前往<location>孤蓟镇</location>，搜索瘴气之上的炼金术士高塔并设法驯服一只野猫！

en: An antidote that instantly cures any poison effect.
cn: 能够瞬间治愈所有中毒效果的解毒剂。

en: Large ribs of the most vile Fell Monster. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Monstrosity, first found in the Nomad Highlands biome.
cn: 从最可怕的瘴气魔物身上采集到的大型肋排。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于游牧高地中的瘴气魔怪物。

en: Catching a backhand from these spiked gloves will bring even the most vigilant attacker to their knees.
cn: 如果被这些嵌有尖刺的手套打中，就算是最顽强的敌人也将跪倒在地。

en:
As you were fighting the Fell Dragon Youngling time and time again, you could observe how its hope got whittled down to despair.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
cn:
当你一次又一次与瘴气魔幼龙战斗的时候，你亲眼看着它的希望被一步步打成绝望。

收集多个瘴气魔幼龙头颅以制作黄金战利品。

en: A cozy bed for large tamed farm animals, such as Yaks or Dune Armadillos.
cn: 为牦牛或者是沙丘犰狳等已经驯服的大型动物准备的温馨床铺。
游牧高地 瘴气魔敌人

en: This baby Dune Armadillo is already starting to form its horn, later used for digging tunnels — never when you're looking, though. It's strange how that works.
cn: 这只沙丘犰狳宝宝已经开始长角，它会趁你不注意的时候挖掘隧道。说实话你想不通它到底是如何办到的。

en: A cup full of mead, and a heart full of song!

cn: 搜索采石场的秃鹫巢穴

en: The Alchemist wants to craft a Spiritual Cane. Staffs use spell charges, channels, or eternal spells as ammunition and are powerful magical weapons. Crafting the staff requires Shroud Wood, which can be found beneath the Shroud.
cn: 炼金术士想要制造一个灵魂之杖。法杖是一种强大的魔法武器，并且使用法术充能、引导或者是永恒法术作为弹药。你可以在瘴气之下找到制作法杖需要的瘴气木材。

en: As Quetzals no longer roam Embervale, dyed palm leaves are used in place of their feathers to recreate the look.
cn: 鉴于棕榈叶中已经见不到绿咬鹃的身影，人们只能够用染色的棕榈叶来模仿它们的羽毛。

en: We are specks of dust in a whirlwind of stars, my friend. Do you dare to reach out, wishing to grasp a piece of eternity? Perhaps obtaining an eternal spell would suit you! I know one was buried in an underground tomb alongside its dreadful master. You could use it to do a lot of good!
cn: 朋友，我们只是星空旋风中的一粒尘埃。你敢伸出手，尝试抓住一片永恒吗？也许一个永恒法术会适合你！我知道有个法术和它可怕的主人一起被埋在了地下坟墓里。它能助你一臂之力！

en: The Blacksmith wants to fight against the Shroud, the ruinous fog that has overtaken Embervale from the depths of the Elixir Wells. Reach the nearby Elixir Well to learn more about the Shroud! It is recommended to equip sufficient gear, such as fur armor, for example. Eat food and rest in your base to acquire buffs before heading out.
cn: 铁匠希望能够驱散从魔药之井深处散溢而出的瘴气，如今不祥的浓雾已经彻底吞没薪谷。 前往附近的魔药之井以进一步调查瘴气！ 安全起见建议提前准备好合适的装备，例如毛皮护甲。出发前记得在基地中进食并休息以获得有用的增益。

en: Over the years, untouched by anyone, the bones of all kind of magical creatures have hardened and turned to stone. A rare material due to its limited availibility and high magical capacity.
cn: 随着岁月的累积，从未被惊扰的各类魔法生物的骸骨逐渐硬化成了矿石。难以获取并且蕴含强大魔力的稀有材料。

en: A new light reaches out. My bright eyes see beyond the horizon, past the ever-winding roots of the Revelwood. My keen ears hear whispers from below, a soft voice dances in the breeze like wind chimes. Travel across the sea of our lost civilization and free the trapped songbird below it!
cn: 新的光芒已经到来。我炽烈的眼睛看见了地平线之外的景象，直达喧嚣森林那里错综复杂的根须。我敏锐的耳朵听见了来自地下的低语，风中的声音无比温柔，就像是风铃一般曼妙。穿越我们失落文明的海洋，释放被困在深处的鸣鸟！

en: A Flightless Redtail with colorful feathers and a strong, regal beak. You can keep it in captivity indefinitely for eggs, and it can't even fly away.
cn: 长满鲜艳羽毛与强有力的尊贵之喙的陆行红尾。你可以让它变成一名永远为你产蛋的囚徒，而且它甚至没办法飞走。

en: A delicious meal with an earthy taste.
cn: 由自然风味构成的美味食物。

en: Attacking an unaware enemy with a ranged weapon will increase your chance of a critical hit by 30%.
cn: 使用远程武器攻击未警觉的敌人时，你的暴击率将提高30%。

en: The Shroud is a ruinous fog that has corrupted nearly all of Embervale. Extended contact with the Shroud is deadly, even for you. Venturing into the Shroud is dangerous, but rewarding. The treasures and materials found inside the Shroud are rare and valuable. The Shroud becomes more dense and deadly in later areas of Embervale. A higher Shroud Passage Level is required to pass.
cn: 瘴气是一种带来灾难的浓雾，薪谷几乎已经彻底沦陷其中。哪怕是你，与瘴气接触过久都将带来致命的后果。 瘴气之中异常凶险，但是也潜藏着机遇。你将能够在瘴气中找到稀有且宝贵的物品与各类材料。 随着你深入薪谷，瘴气将变得更加浓密致命。在这种情况下，你将需要更高的瘴气抵抗等级才能安全通过。

en: ONLY TODAY: The Fabulous Godwin's "Impalement Act!"
cn: 仅限今天：不可思议的戈德温的“穿刺杂技！”

en: If you love a challenging combat experience, this preset is for you. There are more enemies in the game world, they attack more often and deal more damage.
cn: 为热爱富有挑战的战斗体验之人准备的设定。游戏世界中有更多敌人，敌人的攻击更为频繁而且会造成更多伤害。

en: Your gift to me is the sweetest treat! Let's place that <craftingstation>Beehive Smoker</craftingstation> and maybe craft some <craftingstation>Honey Beehive</craftingstation>s! When it's time for harvest, we can cook up something really special! I hope you like glazed yucca?
cn: 你给我带来了最甜美的礼物！我们现在可以用<craftingstation>熏蜂器</craftingstation>制作<craftingstation>蜂巢</craftingstation>了！等到收获的时间来临，我们就可以烹饪出独一无二的美味佳肴！希望你会喜欢糖渍丝兰果。

en: You've found a note that described a secret chest on the roof of Gateway Outpost "Alba". Behind the gong on the roof there should be a small room only accessible by jumping and reaching a secret door. Find the room and open the chest inside!
cn: 根据找到的一份笔记上的内容，网道哨所“黎明”的屋顶上应该有一个隐藏箱子。 就在屋顶的大锣背面，那里有一个只能跳跃抵达的小房间，而且还有一扇隐藏门。找到隐藏房间并打开里面的宝箱！

en: Increases the skill level of Quick Charge
cn: 提高快速充能的技能等级

en:
You've found the gravestone of a dog named Ikko. The inscription read: 

"Your memory will live on forever. "
cn:
你已经找到了名叫“伊科”的狗的墓碑。上面可这一句话：

“你的回忆将永垂不朽。”

en: Decide if actions such as attack, block etc. should be executed in the direction the character is facing or in the direction the camera is pointing.
cn: 决定攻击、格挡等动作应按角色面向的方向执行，还是按摄像头朝向的方向执行。

en: They can barely be called boots.

cn: 只有你想不到，没有我做不到！
将所有自定义键位重置为：
新顾客们让人感到不安

en: Mine every valuable material in the Veilwater Basin.
cn: 开采幕水盆地中的所有贵重材料。

en: Fine powder made from grinding critter carapaces.
cn: 研磨昆虫甲壳后得到的精细粉末。

en: Greatly regenerates Stamina upon consumption. Delightful and sweet.
cn: 食用后大幅恢复体力。甜美小零食。

en: Increases the skill level of Blessed Arrows
cn: 提高祝福箭矢的技能等级

en:
An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the sea floor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.

It can be found beneath the water in the Veilwater Basin.
cn:
只会在月光洒满海底的位置生长的水下植物。诱人的光芒将吸引鲁莽追逐海底微光的潜水者陷入万劫不复之地。

能够在幕水盆地的水下找到。

en: Search For A Plushy In <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>
cn: 在<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>寻找毛绒玩偶

en: Gloves which were worn by the most talented, renowned and successful mages of the kingdom.
cn: 这双手套属于王国中最有天赋、最负盛名、最成功的法师。

en:
You read a story about a mysterious old woman, living alone as an herbalist near Driftwood Wake. Something about her doesn't seem quite right. 

Visit her abode and search it to find valuables!
cn:
你读到了关于一个神秘老妇人的故事，她作为一名草药师孤独地住在浮木领附近。关于她的那些事让你觉得有点不太对劲。

拜访她的住处并寻找宝物！

en: I never told you about the cats around my tower, did I? They were quite useful for cleaning up the living rats — the dead ones, too. Bunch of little tigers, they were!
cn: 我有跟你说过我的高塔还有那些猫的故事吗？那些家伙很擅长捉老鼠，而且还能够帮忙解决死掉的老鼠。他们就像是一头头小老虎！

en: Finally, fresh air. Not heavy with the scent of pollen or sweet, sickening decay. My head spins. I haven't slept in days. Not since I left my spindle in the Revelwood atop that cliffside. So far away now... but I can't turn back. I had to flee. Something sinister is buried in that thicket... spreads through the undergrowth like roots. It embraces and entangles, squeezes, and suffocates. Shimmering in the darkness, between the branches, under the skin: the silky web of a two-clawed hunting spider. Nightmares like these are forged by man, I've learned.
cn: 终于呼吸到新鲜空气了。没有浓重的花粉味，也没有令人作呕的腐烂甜味。我头晕目眩。自从把纺锤留在悬崖边的喧嚣森林，我已经好几天没睡了。现在离得这么远......但我不能回头。 我必须逃离。灌木丛中埋藏着某种邪恶的东西......像树根一样在灌木丛中蔓延。它拥抱、缠绕、挤压、窒息在黑暗中，在树枝间，在皮肤下，闪烁着双爪狩猎蜘蛛的丝网。 我知道，这样的噩梦是人类制造的。

en: A natural way to decorate a roof. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 一种天然的屋顶装饰选择。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: A common ore needed to create Copper Bars.
cn: 用于制作铜锭的常见矿石。

en: You've learned that a lonely cat used to roam the Alchemist's tower. Adopt it and give it a new, loving home! This animal is linked to an important quest. Follow the instructions in your journal to proceed!
cn: 你得知有一只孤独的猫咪曾在炼金术士的高塔中游荡。收养猫咪并为它提供一个充满爱的新家！ 这只动物关乎一项重要任务。 跟随日志中的指示以继续！

en:
8.2.6	
Any liability of Keen for guarantees given (which must be expressly designated as such) and for claims under the Product Liability Act shall remain unaffected.
cn:
8.2.6	
Keen 对所明示作出的保证以及根据《产品责任法》提出的索赔所承担的任何责任，均不受前述条款的影响。

en: Successfully parrying an enemy's attack restores %k Mana. Parry A well-timed block with any Melee weapon or Shield will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
cn: 成功招架敌人的攻击将恢复%k法力。 招架 看准时机使用任意近战武器或盾牌进行格挡将招架来袭攻击并使对手的晕眩条增长。

en: A refined chest piece that lets you fade into the dark and strike from the shadows.
cn: 精致的胸甲，让你融入黑暗，从阴影中发起致命一击。

en: Minimizes dynamic camera movement and FOV changes that enhance the immersion but can also induce motion sickness.
cn: 最小化镜头动态移动与FOV变动，这些功能可以增强沉浸感，但是也可能导致晕动症。

en: Wrapped in darkened leather and shrouded in mystery, these boots carry the wearer as if on clouds.
cn: 包裹在黝黑的皮革与神秘之中，这些靴子能够让穿戴者身轻如燕。

en: Increases your Poison Resistance by %k, which reduces the amount of Poison damage received. Poison damage bypasses armor and can only be mitigated by Poison Resistance.
cn: 使你的毒素抗性增加%k，这将降低你承受的毒素伤害。 毒素伤害无视护甲，并且只能够通过毒素抗性减免。

en: Lord Vorgoth, you're a blighted, demented beast rotten by distrust. A withered man, a raving shadow of a leader, lulled by a roaming snake! You don't serve your people, you serve the white mold — The thralls of twilight, the call of the wanderer. Having ever followed your orders makes me sick; a toll I paid in blood. No army shall protect you. I will cross every chasm, scale every mountain, and brace against the bitter cold. I will push myself beyond the capacity of man to find you. And when I do, my aim will be true. I swear on my brother's honor. — Athalan Skree, 3rd day of Yearwake, 503 D.A.
cn: 沃格斯领主，你这个昏庸无度，神志不清的恶棍。如今的你不过是个胡言乱语、形容枯槁的空壳，像你这样被那条肆虐的毒蛇所蛊惑的家伙根本不配担任领袖！ 你的心中没有自己的人名，只有那些白色的霉菌……那些暮光的仆从还有旅人的呼唤。 我想让你知道，追随你只让我感到恶心，我已经为此付出了鲜血的代价。 就算再多的军队也无法保护你。我将跨越一切山谷、攀爬每一座高山并面对凌冽寒风。在找到你之前，我绝对不会放弃。等我发现你之后，我也绝不会心慈手软。我以我兄弟的荣誉发誓。 — 阿萨兰·斯克里，岁初第3日，503 D.A.

en: Improved magical ammunition that releases a healing wave and jumps to nearby friends. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 改进后的魔法弹药，使用时将施放一道能够弹射至周遭同伴的治疗之波。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: These are your personal Player Quests. They can lead you to hidden treasures or places in the world!
cn: 这些是你个人的玩家任务。它们将指引你找到世界上的隐藏宝藏或地点！

en: Instantly restores a small amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.
cn: 立即恢复少量生命值并提供10秒的持续治疗效果。

en: My name is Kaori Conway. I'm a courier by trade. You saved me, didn't you? I'd gift you something nice, but it seems like I died, so I've got nothing to my name... we should change that!
cn: 我的名字是嘉里·康威。我是一名邮差。是你救了我，对吗？照理说我应该给你提供奖励，但我之前应该是死了，所以现在身上什么也没有……不过我们可以改变这一点！

en: A note you've found reveals the existence of a small secret brewing room in the Elixir Production Site. Find the room and plunder it for valuables!
cn: 根据找到的一张笔记，你得知魔药生产点中存在一个秘密的小型酿酒间。找到房间并拿走里面的宝物！

en: This animal can supply you with fresh milk.
cn: 这头动物能够为你提供新鲜的奶。

en: Queen Jezmina was here, and her Ancient allies summoned the light that led me! What a strange reunion! I still remember her as a little birdie in her mother's lap. Her frail hands could barely hold my lyre. She cried when she broke the middlemost string... I forgave her. She wanted to be friends forever and to seal that promise with blood. What a strange Kindlewaste custom I thought, but why not adopt it? I remember making a shallow cut. Then, I restrung the lyre, and she continued to play — cheeks wet from tears and palm spotted with cherry red specks. I still have the scar from that day. Our paths cross again, separated by time. Her goal is mine, and my scar is hers. I trust that my journey won't end when I enter that vessel... There are so many more adventures to be had, after all! Valory
cn: 杰兹米娜女王来过这里，是她的远古者盟友召唤了一直在引导我的光芒！ 没想到我们竟然会以这种方式相聚！在我的记忆里，她还是一只坐在母亲膝头上的雏鸟。那时候，她娇嫩的小手甚至没办法握住我的里尔琴。当时她不小心弄断了中间的琴弦，然后就吓得嗷嗷大哭了起来……不过没事，我已经原谅她了。 那时候她说自己想跟我当永远的好朋友，还说要用鲜血来起誓。薪火荒原的习俗可真是奇怪我当时还在想，不过就当成是入乡随俗好了。我还记得当时在自己手上划了一道浅浅的口子。完成之后，我就重新接上了琴弦，而她也继续弹奏了起来，小姑娘的脸颊上还挂着泪珠，手掌上还有星星点点的红色血渍。现在摊开手掌，我还能看见当时留下的伤疤。 虽然物是人非，但我们的道路却再次交汇。她的目标就是我的目标，我的伤疤就是她的伤疤。我相信当我走近那个器皿之后，我的旅程并不会就此结束……毕竟还有无数的冒险在等待着我！ 瓦罗里

en: We need a <craftingstation>Tanning Station</craftingstation>. Can't be hard to obtain one, no?
cn: 我们需要一个<craftingstation>制皮台</craftingstation>。这东西应该不难弄到，你说呢？

en: I believe you can drink up to 21 coffees a day without any negative consequences! Oh, I have no proof. It's more of a personal affirmation. This is a judgment-free space, right?
cn: 我相信只要一天喝不超过21杯咖啡，你就完全不需要担心任何负面影响！哦，我没有实际证据。这更像是一种个人见解。在这里所有人都可以各抒己见，对吗？

en: You've discovered a note that referred to a farmer called Fenrig. Follow him to the wolf cave he ventured to and explore the area!
cn: 你发现了一张字条，上面的内容指向了一位名叫“芬里格”的农民。跟随他前往狼穴并探索区域！

en: This body feels unreal... D- D- Dreamlike. P- Plucked from a void. Who are you? What am I? They call you the F- Flameborn? I don't understand. I'm sorry, I think — I d- don't have a name. The Collector s- s- said... s- servants d-don't need n-names. D- Don't send me back to the d-dark, please...
cn: 这具身体感觉好奇怪……就、就、就像是在做梦一样。像是凭、凭空变出来的一样。你是谁？我到底是什么？他、他们管你叫火、火之子？我不明白。对不起，我觉得……我、我好像没有名字。收藏家说、说、说过……仆、仆人不、不需要名、名字。请、请不要把我送回黑、黑暗中去，拜托了……

en: You've reached the Kindlewastes farm. Explore the location to find a color palette!
cn: 你已经抵达燃火荒原农场。 探索此地并寻找调色板！

en: Covering the wounds, allowing the body to heal.
cn: 覆盖伤口来帮助身体愈合。

en: Share your creations with other players!
cn: 与其他玩家分享你的创造！

en:
Their faces are frightening, but they mostly just want to herd goats and yaks. People only make up a small portion of their diet. 

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
cn:
虽然面容狰狞，但它们其实一心只想圈养山羊与牦牛。人类在它们的饮食结构中只占了很小的一部分。

收集多个独眼巨人头颅以制作青铜战利品。

en: Who Is Scared Of Flying Horrors?

Burning reds, crimson as a passionate kiss — or the blood of a weeping heart, pierced by a lance.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
就像热情的吻那样灼热的猩红……或者是被长枪刺穿的泣血之心。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: Choose a preset to base your custom binding on
cn: 选择一个预设方案作为自定义键位的模板

en: I've entered the thicket. Plenty of cover, but too much mud — I'm leaving footprints. I miss the solid, rocky mountain paths and kicking pebbles down chasms to wait for the echo. A strange odor hangs over the bog. Foul and fermented, it reminds me of the distilleries near Howling Peak. I decided to avoid Glennwood's End... Too much activity and I taste copper in the water... Bad omens. I'll drift away from here as soon as possible.
cn: 我已经进入了林地。这里有很多掩护，但是地上太过泥泞，走到哪都会留下脚印。我想念崎岖又扎实的山路，想念把石子踢进山谷后传来的回声。 沼泽中弥漫着一种奇怪的气味。那是一种发酵的恶臭，甚至让我想起了呼啸崇山附近的酿造坊。我决定尽可能避开格伦伍德之末……那里太过嘈杂，而且我发现水里有股铜味……这往往是一种不好的预兆。我得尽快远离这个地方。

en:
You've crafted some animal baits! Now it's time to find a goat.

To tame an animal, you must approach it carefully. Sneak to avoid alerting the animal. Select the food bait and throw it close to the animal to gain its attention. Wait for the goat to eat, and try to pet it while it is feeding to establish a bond. You will need to be close to pet the animal. 

Repeat the process until the animal begins to trust you. Once it is comfortable, you can pick it up.
cn:
你已经制作了一些动物诱饵！现在是时候寻找一只山羊了。

若要驯服动物，你需要小心靠近目标。进入潜行状态以避免惊扰动物。选择食物诱饵然后投掷在动物身边以吸引其注意。等待山羊进食，然后在动物进食时尝试抚摸它并与其建立友好关系。你需要靠近动物才能进行抚摸。

重复步骤直到动物开始信任你。驯服之后，你可以捡起动物。

en:
9.4	
The statutory right to extraordinary termination without notice for good cause shall remain unaffected.
cn:
9.4	
基于正当理由无需通知而解除合同的法定权利不受影响。

en: We Won't Share Our Breath With You
cn: 我们将不会与你们同在
隐藏制作配方：空荡礼堂

en: Increasing Your Follower Amount And Flame Level
cn: 提高你的追随者数量与灵火等级

en: Skillshot Striking enemy weak points, such as heads or exposed hearts, is considered a Skillshot.
cn: 爆头射击 打击敌人的弱点，例如头部或者是暴露在外的心脏都会被视为爆头射击。

en: Clear the Springlands of all shroud roots.
cn: 清除春日平原中的所有瘴气根。

en:
"Hold the chamber to your last breath." These were the words of the Ancient one, before he entered with a handful of our best warriors. It was the first time I'd seen one of his kind, and I expect it will be the last. His face is burned in my mind. My life, and those of my remaining soldiers, are pledged to this sacred duty. 
— <lorename>Captain Arkwright</lorename>
cn:
“不惜一切代价守住密室”。说完这句话之后，远古者就带领着我们之中最强大的战士走了进去。在这之前我从来没有亲眼见过这些人，恐怕以后也没有机会了。但是他的面孔已经深深烙印在了我的脑海中。我和剩下来的士兵将誓死捍卫这一神圣的职责。
— <lorename>阿克怀特队长</lorename>

en: I saw it from afar inside the cave — glowing gold in the dark, it called to me. I don't know what this plant is, but it's beautiful. Unnatural. And the way it glows... it almost feels like it wants to be found. I've never seen anything like it. I have to know more. I'm heading in now. If it's dangerous — so be it. Some things are worth the risk.
cn: 在洞穴里面，我隔了老远就看见了，黑暗中的金色光芒在召唤着我。 虽然认不出这是什么植物，但我知道它真的很美。美得不自然。还有它发光的样子……感觉就像是它想要被我找到一样。 我从来没有见过类似的东西。我感觉我必须去了解它。 我准备立刻出发。就算这很危险也无所谓。有些事情值得去冒险。

en: A creamy and delectable tomato soup, made more aromatic with a fish filet.
cn: 口感绵密的美味番茄汤，加入了鱼排之后更是香气逼人。

en: Increases the skill level of Thrust
Scales the length of nighttime. A smaller value equals a shorter nighttime.
cn: 调整夜晚的持续时间。调低数值将减少夜晚时长。

en: The reinforced soles allow the wearer to skulk through the overgrowth undisturbed, and to reach vantage points quickly. Perfect for an ambush!
cn: 加固的鞋底让你能悄无声息地穿过茂密植被，并迅速抵达狙击点。完美的伏击利器！

en:
This color palette is energetic and festive, evoking lush foliage and joyful celebrations.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
这种配色充满了活力与节庆氛围，能够让人联想到翠绿的大自然与欢乐的庆典。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: A mature Frizzy Goat that can provide milk.
cn: 一只成年绒毛山羊，能够提供奶。

en: Mine every valuable material in the Revelwoods.
cn: 开采喧嚣森林中的所有贵重材料。

en: This powder was derived from the Gleam Root plant, which only grows at night in the Veilwater Basin.
cn: 从只会在幕水盆地的夜间生长的微光根植物中提取出来的粉末。

en:
You've discovered the location that the Fisher told you about.

Look around to find the hidden chest with the fishing gear!
cn:
你找到了渔夫跟你提到的位置。

寻找藏在附近的渔具宝箱！

en: Increases the skill level of Arachnoid
cn: 提高蜘蛛人的技能等级

en: Hey Flameborn, want to learn something new?
cn: 嘿火之子，有兴趣学点新东西么？

en: This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
cn: 可以使用游牧高地材料制作这种调色板。

en: I keep thinking about the "Bony Fellows". They're so spooky!
cn: 我一直在想那些“瘦骨嶙峋的家伙”。它们真的好吓人哦！

en: The Circular Sawblades had been taken away by Scavengers to a nearby camp. Now, the Circular Sawblades must be crafted into a Table Saw. The Carpenter knows how.
cn: 圆形锯片被拾荒者带去了附近的一座营地。圆形锯片需要被制作成锯台。木匠应该知道具体的做法。
喧嚣森林 瘴气魔敌人

en: %k Speed and %k cost reduction per level
A carefully layered tunic, tied over the chest with gold string. The cloth is thick, but flowy. It will enable quick magical dashes while protecting you from the bitter cold.
cn: 使用金色丝线小心翼翼固定起来的多层式短上衣。这件衣服使用的面料厚实却无比轻盈。能够保护你免受刺骨寒冷的侵扰，同时还能允许你进行快速的魔法冲刺。

en:
1. Controller and contact

Keen Games GmbH Dreieichstr. 59 60594 Frankfurt am Main If you have any questions or suggestions on the subject of data protection, please feel free to contact us by e-mail at the following address:
cn:
1. Controller and contact

Keen Games GmbH Dreieichstr. 59 60594 Frankfurt am Main If you have any questions or suggestions on the subject of data protection, please feel free to contact us by e-mail at the following address:
完成你的专属空荡套装

en: Can't I Slack Off In Peace?
cn: 就不能让我安心偷懒么？

en: Beneath this ancient bridge lay a bow, littered amongst the corpses of this battlefield. It must have belonged to an unfortunate commander consumed by the Shroud.
cn: 在这座远古大桥之下，由无数尸骸构成的战场遗址中有一把弓。这肯定属于某位被瘴气吞噬的不幸指挥官。

en: Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: Queen Jezmina has discarded her old travel gear near the Sunken City. Discover all pieces to complete your set! You can obtain this clothing set through gameplay or by supporting creators on external platforms during an event.
cn: 杰兹米娜女王将自己的旧旅行装备丢弃在了沉没的城市附近。 发现所有部件以完成你的套装！ 你可以通过游玩游戏，或者是于活动期间在外部平台支持创作者来获取该套服饰。
搜索附近的海蓝宝石矿井

en: They came in droves again yesterday. Sunburnt heathens. They twist and mangle their bodies whenever they bow to their gods, their idols, the Ancients. They bring too many mouths to feed, and hold out their hands for alms instead of getting to work! I'd send them back to the Kindlewastes... why would Orindell's drought be my problem? The Kingdom of Meldore belongs to us! These are my crops, my riches! They won't fool me. I buried my treasure in the fenced lot underneath the small shelter, not far from here. They won't find it when it's hidden beneath the mud. Tonight, I'll sleep deeply.
cn: 昨天，他们又成群结队地来了。被太阳灼伤的异教徒。每次膜拜他们的神灵与偶像，也就是远古者的时候，这些人都会用力扭动身体。 他们几乎全都拖家带口，但比起老实工作养活自己，他们只会伸手讨要施舍！要我说，就该把他们送回燃火荒原……明明是奥林戴尔那边闹旱灾，凭什么要我来救助那些灾民？梅尔多尔王国是我们的！这都是我的庄稼，我的宝藏！ 他们骗不了我。我把财宝埋在离这里不远的小庇护所下面的围栏里。藏在泥土下面，他们就找不到了。今晚，我将沉沉睡去。

en: A popular plant due to its strong fibers. It can be used to make linen.
cn: 拥有坚韧纤维的高人气植物。能够用于制作亚麻布。

en: Classic herbalist garb with widened pockets for storing healing tinctures.
cn: 经典的草药师服装，口袋加宽，可存放治疗酊剂。

en: Designed after the fletching of an arrow, this weapon shows true brutality when smiting friend or foe.
cn: 外形模仿箭矢的武器，无论敌友都能感受到其中蕴含的真正残暴之力。

en: You've discovered the location of the Springlands Hollow Halls. Descend — when you're ready — to reveal what lies below. Gathering a team is advised if you are not playing alone.
cn: 你已经发现了春日平原空荡礼堂的位置。准备好之后就深入其中，揭示深处的秘密。如果有机会的话建议你在出发前先组建一支队伍，避免独自深入。

en: We should cook something nice and warm, dontcha think?
cn: 我们应该烹饪一些暖呼呼的美食，你说呢？

en: The pants might not look like much, but they actually do their job of protecting your life in battle.
cn: 虽然这条裤子看上去平淡无奇，但是它们其实能够在激烈的战斗中保护你的性命。

en: Increases the skill level of Radiant Aura
cn: 提高璀璨光环的技能等级

en: Stamina Regeneration of sweets is increased by 50%.
cn: 甜食的体力恢复效果提高50%。

en: Speak To Emily Fray About <lorename>Elin</lorename>'s Curse
cn: 和艾米丽·弗莱讨论<lorename>艾琳</lorename>的诅咒

en: XeSS is an advanced antialiasing technique. Reducing the quality will increase performance.
cn: XeSS 是一种先进的抗锯齿技术。降低品质可提高性能。

en: Hitting an enemy puts a mark on them for %k. Hitting a marked enemy sends a lightning bolt to another marked enemy, dealing %k damage. The attack can chain to more marked enemies. After lightning triggers, the effect has a %k cooldown before it can retrigger from the same enemy. After the cooldown, the mark is refreshed.
cn: 命中敌人将对其施加标记，持续%k。命中一名被标记的敌人时，你将向另一名被标记的敌人发射一道闪电并造成%k伤害。此攻击能够连锁至更多被标记的敌人。 在一名敌人身上触发闪电后，需要等待%k冷却时间结束才能在同一名敌人身上再次触发效果。冷却结束后，标记将被刷新。

en: A light pair of boots that allow for swift movements when wading through snow and blizzards. You can scout the frozen fringes of the mountains for miles when wearing these shoes!
cn: 这双轻便的靴子将允许你在风雪之中灵活穿行。穿上这双靴子之后，你将可以尽情探索山脉之间的冰冻荒原！

en: Extract the gem at a Gem Forge before deleting or salvaging it.
cn: 首先前往宝石锻炉提取宝石，然后再进行删除或回收。

en: Increases how much Health is replenished when healing a character.
cn: 增加治疗角色时补充的健康值。

en: Music that evokes flaming rays of sunlight, and the burning soles of a 1000-mile walk. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 让人联想到酷暑下的灼热日光以及长途跋涉后疲惫不堪的双脚。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: The Farmer Emily seems to be scared of Fell Critter. Her friend, your Barber Elio, wants to alleviate her fears! He thinks that these creatures may not be so scary if represented as fluffy cuddlebuddies, and mentioned that he often saw children play with toys like that in the capital. Reach the main city and search for a plushy there to show it to Emily!
cn: 农民艾米丽似乎很害怕瘴气魔虫。不过她的朋友，也就是你们的理发师埃里奥想要帮助她克服恐惧！ 埃里奥觉得如果变成毛茸茸的可爱玩偶的形象，这些生物就不会显得那么可怕，除此以外他还提到说自己曾经在首都看见过许多孩子在玩类似的玩具。 抵达主城并在那里寻找毛绒玩偶，之后将其带给艾米丽！

en: Fell Sporehead, Kindlewastes Shroud and Albaneve Summits Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔孢子头，燃火荒原以及阿尔班耶夫山脉瘴气区

en: When you receive Magic damage, you have a %k chance to restore 1 Mana per Health point lost.
cn: 承受魔法伤害时，你有%k的几率恢复等同于损失生命值的法力。

en: Your memory will live on forever.
I could spruce this place up... If I had some <craftingstation>Masonry Tools</craftingstation>! But I can't, 'cause I'm standing here empty handed! Help me out, will ya?
cn: 要是我有<craftingstation>石匠工具</craftingstation>，立马就能让这里焕然一新！但问题是我现在什么也没有，所以只能站着干等！帮帮我，好吗？

en: Increases the skill level of Arcane Deflection
cn: 提高奥术偏转的技能等级

en: A dagger set of old-timey Eastern craftsmanship. Rogues of that era would swing this short cutlass around during battle, causing nearby sand to swirl up and blind the enemy. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 出自古代东方工匠之手的匕首。过去的游荡者会在战斗中挥舞这种短弯刀，并利用掀起的沙尘来使敌人无法看清自己的动作。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: I don't know how to reach you, Ramone. You've disappeared from the face of the Earth... but you know where to find me, at least, so I'm leaving you this. The statue of our former ruler, Queen Pikemead, will be tossed unceremoniously into the sea and sink to the bottom of the ocean when the clock strikes twelve. I can't stop this madness, but I saved a piece. The harbor workers did, too. King Gormander won't listen to my requests. He wants her likeness erased from his new "gardens". Please burn this letter after reading it, and take the statue piece. I can't let our correspondence get me in trouble. Best luck to you. Glory to Queen Pikemead, forever.
cn:
我不知道该怎么联系你，雷蒙。你现在就像是人间蒸发一样……但无论如何，你应该知道该怎么找到我，所以我特意给你留下了这封信。

等到明天，我们的上一任统治者<lorename>派克米德</lorename>女王的雕像将会粗鲁地丢入大海并沉入最深处。我无法阻止这种疯狂的行径，但我设法抢下了一块碎片。其他的港口工人们也做了同样的事。戈曼德国王不愿意听从我们的劝说。他希望从自己的新“花园”中彻底抹除女王留下的一切痕迹。

看完信件后记得烧掉，还请你帮我保管好这块雕像碎片。要是被别人发现这些信件，我会有麻烦的。祝你好运。荣耀归于<lorename>派克米德</lorename>女王，直至永恒。

en: Step only where you remain unseen, strike those whose eyes are blinded by your glint in the half-light. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 穿梭于无人知晓的阴影，对那些被你在昏暗中的闪烁所炫目之人发动致命打击。 瘴气附魔： 这把武器已经被瘴气侵蚀，并且能够造成大量瘴气伤害。只能够在瘴气巢穴中找到。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en:
Possessing this golden trophy proves that you dodged every sword blow and defeated your opponent with concentrated force.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
cn:
拥有这个黄金战利品证明你成功躲过了刀剑的每一次打击，并且凭借摧枯拉朽的力量摧毁了自己的敌人。

收集多个瘴气魔雷兽头颅以制作黄金战利品。

en: With these sturdy shingles, your house is well protected.
cn: 这些牢固的瓦片顶将守护你的家。

en: Flameborn! You carry the Elixir. Please, I beg you to be careful. It brings corruption and death! I've seen it happen. At first, it seems to strengthen the body, but it rots the mind! Please, do not drink the Elixir!
cn: 火之子！我注意到你带着魔药。拜托了，还请你千万要小心。这种东西会带来腐化与死亡！我亲眼见过它们的力量。一开始，人们只是将之看成是强化肉体的方法，但是要不了多久就连心智也会被扭曲！求求你千万不要喝下魔药！

en: You have a %k chance to receive the damage you deal as Mana.
cn: 你有%k几率将您造成的伤害转化为法力。

en: I won't even complain about being "cursed to suffer and rot in the bitter cold". I've been behind bars before, I get it. But can we please add some lights? I can't see further than five feet, and I keep tripping over scattered bones. Don't know if I can hurt my ankle, but I still get a fright every time. Just because we're doomed doesn't mean we can't get some more torches in here, right?
cn: 我甚至都不想抱怨“被诅咒永远在刺骨寒冷中受尽折磨”这种事了。以前我也做过坏事，所以我明白这是对我的惩罚。 但是我们能不能稍微添点亮光？现在这地方真的伸手不见五指，一不小心就会被地上的骨头给绊倒。虽然我不确定这种状态还需不需要担心摔伤，但每次还是要被吓一跳。 虽然我们已经大难临头，但是添一些火炬这种要求应该不算过分吧？

en: A Grave For All That Are Lost
cn: 为所有逝去之人准备的坟墓

en: Do you wanna hear a song?
The Alchemist warned about the use of the Elixir One mustn't drink it, despite its benefits.
cn: 炼金术士劝诫不要使用魔药。尽管能够带来帮助，但是饮用这种物质得不偿失。

en: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.
cn: 喧嚣森林地区的传统食材。食用后会让人感觉精力满满。

en: The current Host Settings are invalid. Please configure them before starting a session.
cn: 当前主机设置无效。请先更改设置，然后再开始进程。

en: Defeat The Tendril Of The Abyss
This shield, imbued by the Flame, allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
cn: 蕴含着灵火之力的盾牌将允许你格挡物理攻击。格挡将消耗体力。

en: Target a plant to see its status.
cn: 瞄准一株作物以查看状态。

en: These simple, comfortable boots are perfect for taking a stroll on a warm summer's day.
cn: 这双简单舒适的靴子非常适合在温暖的夏日散步。

en: A colorful and flashy hat, often worn by poets, minstrels, or traders of luxurious goods.
cn: 一顶俗艳花哨的帽子，常见于诗人、吟游诗人或者是奢侈品商人的头顶。

en: Stay on the path, lest the Shroud's kin take you. Salvation lies straight ahead.
cn: 不要迷失道路，否则瘴气的子嗣将带走你。救赎就在前方。

en: A rare and valuable metal thanks to its thermal conductivity. It's often used to create things that require a lot of heat.
cn: 良好的导热性使得这种稀有金属变得格外宝贵。往往被用于制作需要大量热能的物品。

en:
A statue of the late queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>. An engraving on the bottom reads: 

Gather 'round, we're drinkin'! 
An ode to the Queen, once young! 
3 babes on 'er arm, cup filled to the brim. 
Thinkin' out loud, she'd sung!
cn:
已故女王<lorename>派克米德</lorename>的雕像。底座上刻着一段话：

齐聚一堂，痛饮美酒！
献给曾经风华正茂的女王！
养育了3个孩子，她一生无憾。
聆听陷入沉思的女王放声歌唱！

en: The second half of a wall hanging, visualizing the complex symbiosis of the natural, and magical. When paired with the other half, perhaps this ancient wisdom can be understood.
cn: 某块壁画的第二部分，上面描绘着自然与魔法的复杂共生关系。与另外一块壁画碎片组合起来之后，你说不定就能够理解其中蕴含的远古智慧。

en:
Although you have been exposed to this sight countless times, it still exudes a sense of menace and excitement at the same time.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
cn:
尽管你已经无数次面对过这个眼神，但它仍然散发着恶意与激动的气息。

收集多个瘴气魔怪物头颅以制作黄金战利品。

en:
You've followed the trail of the bandits who robbed Mei. Your investigation has led you to a note that revealed the presumed locations of each stolen weapon.

The staff of the serpent is stored under the big house in <location>Netherton</location> inside a hidden cellar close to the water, accessible from the outside. 

Find the location and retrieve the staff!
cn:
你跟随着抢劫梅的强盗们留下的踪迹。在调查时，你找到了一张纸条，上面记载着失窃的每一种武器的大概位置。

毒蛇法杖被放在了<location>洼地镇</location>的一栋大房子里，那栋房子有一处靠近水边的隐蔽地窖，而且入口就在房子外部。

找到隐蔽地窖并取回法杖！

en: Find the Alchemist's Mortar in order to unlock more crafting recipes. It's hidden in the Alchemist Tower in Lone Thistle, somewhere below the surface.
cn: 找到炼金术士的磨臼以解锁更多配方。你要寻找的物件就隐藏在孤蓟镇的炼金术士之塔中，留意地面之下的空间。
增加对远程敌人的伤害。

en: Scholar of the Young Flame Pants
Some shelter from the elements would really do me some good. When you have a chance, I'd sure appreciate it.
cn: 我需要一个能够遮风挡雨的庇护所。如果有空的话还请你帮我这个忙。

en: Pierce your foes through the heart — using your horns isn’t necessary.
cn: 狠狠刺穿敌人的心脏 - 不过你并不一定要使用头盔的尖角。

en: My savior, I've seen the whole wide world — but right now, I'd love to lay eyes on a warm bed under a dry roof. I'm sure you could fashion something fabulous for me!
cn: 我的拯救者啊，虽然我曾经浪迹天涯，但现在我只求一屋避雨，还有一张暖和的床铺。相信凭你的本事，肯定能给我找到最完美的住处！

en: A sporty headband with gold accents. It matches the set's belt and makes you feel like the ruler of the Summer Games!
cn: 夹杂着金色的运动头带。与套装的腰带搭配在一起，这将让你感觉自己是夏日游戏的统治者！

en: Enables hunger and starvation. You will need to regularly eat or drink to survive.
cn: 开启饥饿与濒临饿死机制。你需要定期进食或饮水才能维持生存。

en: Master The Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls
cn: 完成阿尔班耶夫山脉空荡礼堂

en: A workplace that will enable new crafting possibilities for the <npc>Blacksmith</npc>.
cn: 能够为<npc>铁匠</npc>开启全新制造配方的工坊。

en: Even after many weeks on the road, these pants will still be comfortable and in good shape.
cn: 哪怕经过了漫长旅途，这些裤子依旧能够提供舒适的穿着体验与良好的外形。

en: I bet you're gonna catch a big one!
cn: 我敢打赌，你今天一定能抓到大鱼！

en: Does One Enjoy The Romance Of A Stormy Day?
Expertly crafted boots. They've been embellished with flame-spouting shields, a roaring inferno only kept at bay through vigilance.
cn: 工艺精湛的靴子。靴子上点缀着喷火盾牌，只有保持警惕，才能隔绝咆哮的地狱之火。

en: These bones are far larger than normal and are exceptionally sturdy.
cn: 这些异常巨大的骨头拥有着超乎寻常的牢固性。

en: You've lit the Flame atop the Ancient Spire. You learned that, despite their remoteness, the frozen barrens did not remain untouched. Northern soldiers expanded their territory here and built Elixir Wells tainting the mountain's snow and archaic inhabitants. You must seek the main Elixir Well and destroy the corrupted evil hiding within to reclaim the mountains! Don't go unprepared. You will need warm clothes, food, or torches to provide warmth in the harsh cold. Wool and warm padding kits would be useful for crafting warm armor.
cn: 你已经点亮远古尖塔顶部的灵火。你了解到这些地处偏远的冰封荒原并非是之前想象的那样人迹罕至之地。北境士兵们已经扩张到了这里，他们建造的魔药之井已经腐化了山脉中的白雪与古老的居民们。 你必须找到主魔药之井，摧毁盘踞其中的腐化邪恶力量并重新夺回山脉！ 出发之前一定要做好万全准备。你需要暖和的衣服、食物或者是火把来提供温暖并抵御严寒。 毛料与温暖衬垫应该能够用于制作暖和的护甲。

en: Read The Springlands Obelisk Of The Flame
cn: 阅读春日平原的灵火方尖碑

en: A fresh coconut, plucked directly from a palm tree. The water inside can be drunk as is or processed into milk.
cn: 直接从棕榈树上摘下来的新鲜椰子。里面的椰子汁可以直接饮用或者加工成椰浆。

en: After hitting an unaware enemy with a ranged attack, you have a 50% chance to avoid an alert. 100% if the target is killed.
cn: 使用远程攻击命中未警觉的敌人时，有50%的几率不会触发警报。成功击杀目标则必定不会触发警报。

en: The Hunter shared the location of her hidden hunting grounds with you. Investigate the area to see what lies there!
cn: 猎人与你分享了她的秘密狩猎场位置。去那里一探究竟！

en: Early in the morn', I was manning the grindmill... T'was creaking all wicked. I pushed harder — something blocked the mill. To my horror, some fool had climbed inside, buried by roots! His body was swollen and bloated. The juice of the plant flesh leaked from his lips. I fished out what was left of 'im and brushed it under the floorboards next to the grindmill before the morning bell rang. If the head of sanitation finds out, I can kiss my bonus goodbye! Even worse — I may be banned from Elixir production work in all of Meldore!
cn: 清晨的时候，我在磨坊中推磨子……但是刚想用力，就听见一阵吱嘎作响。我用力一推……接着便感觉有什么东西卡住了。 我怎么也没有想到，竟然是有个傻瓜之前爬了进去，直接被根须给掩盖了起来！他的尸体已经变得肿胀无比。植物的汁液直接从他嘴里溢了出来。 我把剩下来的尸块捡了出来，并且赶在早上敲钟之前都藏在了磨坊旁的地板下面。要是被卫生部门的人发现，我的奖金可就泡汤了！更糟糕的是，我有可能会被禁止在梅尔多尔境内进行任何与魔药生产有关的工作！

en: Let's get our hands on a plushy!
cn: 我们去找一个毛绒玩具吧！

en: Modify or Reset the Skill Tree
Fantastic gloves for digging up secrets, uncovering treasures, or cartographing never-before-seen lands!
cn: 这套华丽的手套最适合用来挖掘各种秘密、宝藏或者是测绘无人踏足的神秘之地！

en:
Olric always had a strange way of seeing things. Where I saw danger, he saw wonder. Especially with those damn plants — the Vicious Vines. Venomous things, full of poison, shooting god-knows-what at anything that moves.
He dragged me all the way out here, grinning like a kid. Said he'd never seen so many in one place. Told me to watch – then he let one hit him. Right on the head. Laughed it off like it was nothing.
I thought he was crazy. But he looked… fine. Better than fine, like he'd gained something from it.
I was going to try it too. Really, I was.
I couldn't bring myself to — maybe I am just a coward.
cn:
奥睿克一直是个与众不同的人。我眼中的危险，在他看来却是不可思议的奇迹。尤其是那些该死的恶毒藤蔓植物。这些家伙剧毒无比，而且会朝任何移动物体乱射一通。
之前他非要拽着我来这里，而且还笑得跟看见糖果的孩子一样开心。他说自己从来没有在一个地方看见过这么多植物。他叫我好好看着，然后就让一株植物袭击了自己。就打在他的脑门上。可是他只是像个没事人一样哈哈大笑。
我原本以为他是疯了。但他看上去……并无大碍。不光如此，看上去植物的攻击给他带来了意想不到的好处。
这让我也忍不住想要试一试。真的，我没开玩笑。
我只是不敢真的那么做，也许我才是胆小鬼吧。

en: The church in Woodgard hides a chest inside. The villagers wanted to use materials stored inside to repair the roof. Find the chest and claim its contents for yourself!
cn: 伍德加德里的教堂藏着一个箱子。村民们原本打算用箱子里材料来修理屋顶。 找到箱子并拿走里面的东西！

en:
In <location>Brightwich</location>, you found a note that details Gabrielle Fairburn's duel with the "Scourge of <location>Brightwich</location>".

The note describes that whoever loses the duel is bound to never "see the light of day" ever again. Gabrielle told you she won the duel, but added that her adversary wouldn't stay dead. 

Search for where the enemy is hiding in <location>Brightwich</location>!
cn:
你在<location>光芒女巫</location>找到了一张纸条，上面详细记录着加布里埃尔·菲尔伯恩与“<location>光芒女巫</location>的灾祸”之间的决斗条款。

根据纸条上的描述，在决斗中落败的哪一方将“永无重见天日的机会”。加布里埃尔告诉你会所她赢得了决斗，但又因为无法杀死自己的仇敌而深感困恼。

在<location>光芒女巫</location>寻找敌人的藏身地点！

en: So, what are you waiting for? Try grilling a fish and see how good it tastes!
cn: 所以你还在等什么？快去试试烤一条鱼并亲自品尝吧！

en: I research the positive impacts of symphonies! I hypothesize that the rarity and prestige of the instrument have a psychological effect on — ah, it doesn't matter. I want you to find epic instruments! I heard rumors about the Kindlewastes temples hiding some. I know the locations, but not which ones have instruments in them... please help!
cn: 我一直在研究交响乐给人带来的正面影响！根据我的推测，乐器的稀有度与音质会带来一种心理上的影响，并导致……不，现在你只需要知道这些就行。总而言之，我希望你能够找到一些史诗乐器！我听说燃火荒原神庙里面就藏了一些。我知道那些神庙的位置，但我不清楚具体哪座神庙里面藏着乐器……就拜托你多走几趟了！

en: A two-handed weapon with an unceasing swing. It holds the power to perpetually renew itself and the wielder, like the self-nourishing winds of a cyclone.
cn: 一旦挥舞起来便势不可挡的双手武器。就像永不停歇的飓风一般，它能够为自身与使用者提供源源不断的力量。

en: Powdery, lily-white snow. The way it drowns out the sounds of chaos makes the world seem just a little more peaceful. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
cn: 粉末状的白雪。在白雪皑皑的世界中，再喧嚣的混乱也会变得无比平静。 排水 这种材料会在溢出时排放少量水。

en: Even a simple shield such as this can save your life when you get surrounded, or surprised.
cn: 当你腹背受敌或是遭遇偷袭，哪怕是像这样一块简单的盾牌也能救人一命。

en: An arrow tipped with a sharp shard of Obsidian.
cn: 使用了尖锐的黑曜石碎片作为箭头。

en: You can also access your Manual Crafting recipes and your backpack at crafting stations.
cn: 你还可以在制造台使用手工制作配方与背包。

en: A rather adventurous landing, but I'm quite satisfied otherwise. After all, I found a Flame Shrine. I postulate that the Ancients leave behind a Spark after they expire. In fact, the spark may be their entire being, their soul — a mystical core, a fragment of the Flame! Normally, their light joins the Flame and imbues all knowledge collected throughout their lifespan. At times, however, they rest in these shrines instead, atop cliffs or amidst faraway caves... especially recently. To "protect" us, as the people of Orindell would believe. Or to "survey" us, as a Rimgardian would say. What whispers of wisdom are they hiding? ...Also, how does one get down from here? — Balthazar, 507 D.A.
cn: 这次的着陆说实话让人捏了一把冷汗，不过除此以外的结果还是让我十分满意。我终于找到了一处灵火神龛。 我认为远古者在消亡时留下了一份火苗。而且很有可能，那火苗就是他们的存在本身，或者说是他们的灵魂，那是一个神秘的核心，灵火的一份碎片！ 通常来说，他们的光芒会加入灵火并向其灌输自己一生获得的所有知识。但是有些时候，它们也会栖身在位于悬崖峭壁或者遥远洞窟的神殿中……这种做法在近些年尤其常见。奥林戴尔的人们认为这是远古者在“守护”我们，而里姆加德人则认为这是在“监视”我们。 谁知道这些地方隐藏着什么样的智慧低语？ ……还有一个挺麻烦的问题，接下来我该怎么下去？ — 巴尔萨扎，507 D.A.

en: The cooking station was just the first piece of equipment the farmer requested. It’s perfect for simple tasks like grilling or preparing single ingredients. But to truly unlock her full culinary potential, you’ll need to craft her a kitchen. There, she’ll be able to cook any dish you desire. Craft and place a kitchen to complete the quest.
cn: 烹饪站是农民需要的第一种设备，烹饪站能够完美满足像是煎烤或者是处理单独食材等简单的工作。不过如果想要真正解锁农民的所有料理天赋，你需要为她打造一个厨房。之后她将能够在那里尽情烹饪任意料理。 制作并放置一个厨房以完成任务。

en: Damage with Bows is increased by %k.
Tools for making sketches. This should be placed in arms reach of a <npc>Carpenter</npc>.
cn: 用于绘制设计草图的工具，需要被放置在<npc>木匠</npc>附近。

en: Useful for alchemical and magical purposes.
cn: 在炼金术与魔法中有着多种运用。

en: I sometimes feel like a fish out of water.
cn: 有时候我感觉就像是离开了水的鱼。

en: This place could use a tavern!
cn: 我觉得这个地方需要一间酒馆！

en:
This bomb contains a highly flammable liquid, setting a large area on fire when deployed.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.
cn:
这枚炸弹中储存有极度易燃的液体，投放后能够点燃一大片区域。

这种投掷物造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。

en: Inspect plants inside a Flame-protected area.
cn: 在受灵火保护的区域中查看植物。

en: May I be vulnerable for a moment? When I was thrown over that ledge in <location>Fort Kelvin</location>, I hit my head, so my mind is fuzzy. I remember my name, my craft, and crawling toward a..."celestial light"? That's it. The worst part: I forgot how to make hair dyes! I can't even remember how to make a basic "red"! If you find any mentions of hair colors, relay them to me, will you?
cn: 有时间听一下我的困扰吗？之前在<location>凯尔文要塞</location>被丢下悬崖之后，我在坠落的过程中撞到了脑袋，之后就一直感觉晕头转向。我记得自己的名字，记得自己是做什么的，我还记得自己曾经挣扎着爬向了一道……“天国的光芒”？但除此以外什么也记不清。而且最糟糕的是：我忘记如何制作染发剂了！我甚至都不记得如何制作最基础的“红色”！如果你找到了任何跟发色有关的东西，一定要带回来给我，拜托了？

en: Dropped by Fell Thunderbrute in the Shroud
cn: 由瘴气的瘴气魔雷兽掉落

en: A <craftingstation>Smelter</craftingstation> which has been upgraded with bellows to create better metals.
cn: 加装了风箱的<craftingstation>冶炼炉</craftingstation>，能够用于制作更高级的金属。

en: A decent tool forged out of copper. At least working does not become a hassle because of bad equipment.
cn: 铜制的上等工具。有了良好的工具就能事半功倍。

en: Nothing is Sacred. Three arrows inside Casper's rib — and Marcus' spine is surely splintered... we carried him to safety, corruption raining down on us... It happened as we were surveying the aftermath of Vorgoth's crusade. We knew of the destruction, but not of the decay that followed. The rot had left no survivors, nor bodies to bury. Nightfall came swiftly. Without warning, the Fell sprang from the mist and sundered us from Commander Cyrus. We were forced to seek shelter here, but despite our negligence, we are blessed beyond all. While veiled in the holy light of the Flame, the Fell won't come near... Or perhaps our refuge is the result of Emily's blessing. I pray their southern caravan route is less perilous than ours. I must set down the pen. Casper cries. He needs soothing. — Raúl, 508 D.A.
cn: 也许世间不存在真正的圣域，三根箭矢穿透了贾斯帕的肋骨，马库斯的脊椎也被打断了……我们最后设法在漫天腐化下将他带到了安全地点。 当时我们正在观察沃格斯的远征所留下的痕迹。我们知道他们造成的破坏，但我们并不知晓随之而来的腐化。那种腐化不会留下任何幸存者，也没有可以埋葬的尸体。 夜幕很快便降临。瘴气魔突然从迷雾之中鱼贯而出并将我们与指挥官赛鲁斯分隔了开来。我们被迫就此寻找庇护，但是尽管我们出师不利，命运还是眷顾了我们。在灵火的神圣光芒笼罩下，那些瘴气魔根本不敢靠近……或者也有可能，是艾米丽的祝福让我们得到了庇护。 我祈祷他们的南部车队的遭遇不会有我们这样凶险。我只能暂时写到这里。贾斯帕在哭，我得去安抚他。 — 劳尔，508 D.A.

en: You got a good eye, Flameborn!
Very good. Never underestimate thread! When strong enough, it can patch any wound... or close any throat. Place the <craftingstation>Loom</craftingstation> if you want to cut to the chase.
cn: 非常好。永远不要低估丝线的力量！足够强韧的丝线能够轻松缝合伤口……或者是割开敌人的咽喉。不要拖沓，尽快放置<craftingstation>织布机</craftingstation>。

en: A scrumptious curry with lots of heat and depth of flavor. It will make you feel warm and cozy!
cn: 热得滋滋冒泡的美味咖喱。吃下去能够让你立刻感到温暖舒心！

en: A volatile, acidic fluid harvested from weak Fell Foes. Its corrosive properties make it a valuable ingredient in crafting repair kits, where its unique chemistry is harnessed to restore the durability of worn-out items. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Lurkers, initially found in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 从弱小的瘴气魔敌人身上采集而来的酸性液体，十分不稳定。独特的腐蚀性质使得这种液体成为了制作修理工具的关键材料，只要经过妥善处理，其中蕴含的特殊化学性质就能够恢复损坏物品的耐久度。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于游牧高地中的瘴气魔徘徊者。

en: Some <keyitem>Circular Sawblades</keyitem> were found. They can be crafted into a <craftingstation>Table Saw</craftingstation> with the <npc>Carpenter</npc> to enable more advanced crafting recipes.
cn: 已找到一些<keyitem>圆形锯片</keyitem>。在<npc>木匠</npc>处将其制作为<craftingstation>锯台</craftingstation>以解锁更多高级制作配方。

en: Come a bit closer, will ya? See, I've gotta ask... those flooded temple ruins: why build in the wildest tangle and deepest lakes if you don't have something to hide? Maybe... oh, I don't know: gold coins, wink wink? I have to say "wink wink" out loud 'cause I've only got one eye. Might look like I'm blinkin'. Also, I heard all the businessmen wink. I don't make the rules!
cn: 过来点，好吗？是这样，我有件事想问你……那些被淹没的神殿废墟：如果不是想要隐瞒什么的话，他们为什么要建在无人涉足的丛林深处和湖底？也许……嗯也不确定，说不定是藏了金币什么的？我现在很想给你使个眼神，但我只有一只眼睛，你有可能以为我单纯只是在眨眼睛。然后我听说所有生意人都喜欢做那种事。规矩不是我定的！

en:
You've reached the nesting location of the vultures. The second half of the wall hanging cannot be far.

Search the vulture nests marked on your map!
cn:
你已经抵达了秃鹫们的巢穴。另外一半的壁画肯定就在附近。

搜索地图上标记的秃鹫巢穴！

en:
Phillychick: Blocks to legacy

TimberBuilds: Inspired Great Builders

Homebody the Stonewright: Builder of quiet places
cn:
Phillychick：方块即遗产

TimberBuilds：灵感迸发的伟大建筑师

Homebody the Stonewright：静谧之地的建造者

en: A ripe, yellow banana. It can be eaten raw or used in another dish — without the peel, of course.
cn: 成熟的黄色香蕉。能够直接生吃或者是作为料理食材……当然无论如何都要先剥皮。

en: Place The Dog In Your Home

You've found the location of the long-forgotten snake temple. There must be valuables inside. 

Search the temple and loot it to obtain the bow of the serpent!
cn:
你找到了早已被遗忘的毒蛇神殿。里面肯定藏着不少宝物。

搜索神殿并寻找毒蛇之弓！

en:
It took me three days to patch Old Olson's floors. I offered to fix the wheels on his wagon instead, but he was determined to stay until the end.

It started in his garden. The ground softened, shifted, and was finally swallowed alongside the dying weeds by a small rift. When morning light hit, his backyard had been replaced by a gaping maw. I rushed to build fences and reinforced structures, but when the sun lay to rest, even they sank below. The hole had grown bigger. I should've sent him away then, broken wagon or not.

This morning, Olson's cottage was gone without a trace, devoured by the darkness. First, I hoped he escaped — since I heard no crying or screaming. But as it turns out, the maw swallows even sound.

I'm putting down the hammer and packing my bags. I won't wait to be swallowed like Olson and the weeds.
cn:
我花了三天时间才修好老奥尔森的地板。我本来只想帮他修好车轮，但他一定要留到最后。

一切是从他的花园开始的。那里的地面突然就松动了，最后一道小小的裂缝把濒死的杂草和所有东西都吞进去了。等到第二天早上的时候，他家的后院只剩下了一个巨坑。我立刻着手建造篱笆并巩固旁边的建筑，但是等到太阳下山的时候，就连那些东西也沉下去了。地洞变得越来越大。不管车轮有没有坏，我当时都应该叫他赶紧走的。

今天早上，奥尔森的小屋已经彻底消失在黑暗中。起初我还祈祷他已经及时逃出来了，因为我没有听见哭喊或者尖叫。但没想到，就连声音也逃不出那个深渊巨口。

我现在放下了锤子，并且正在打包我的东西。我可不想和奥尔森还有那些杂草一样掉下去。

en: Seeing this helmet makes others feel safe and secure.
cn: 坚固的头盔带来安全感，让队友无后顾之忧。

en: Do you want to add this server?
cn: 您想添加这个服务器吗？

en: These belted pants will create a perfect fit no matter if you've had venison or porridge for dinner.
cn: 裤子上附带松紧功能的皮带能够完美适应你的体型，无论晚餐是吃鹿肉大餐还是朴素米粥都不用担心。

en: Shush! Be quiet, dear! I must make the perfect, sanguine red!
cn: 嘘！安静，亲爱的！我必须创造出最完美的鲜红之色！
找到布莱林姑姑去过的下一座神庙

en: A mysterious old book that cannot be opened. No matter how hard you pull at the petrified covers, the tome doesn't seem willing to spill its secrets.
cn: 一本无法打开的神秘古书。哪怕用尽全力撬已经石化的封面，这本典籍都纹丝不动。

en: The harder the setting, the more enemy spawn locations appear in the game world.
cn: 高难度意味着游戏世界中将会有更多的敌人生成点。

en: I am terrified. We came to investigate the Flame Sanctum, but while crossing the caverns, we found what appeared to be Vukah markings on the walls... along with loose tusks and bone scraps, despite this not historically being Vukah territory! I translated some of the inscriptions... they concern the great Pillars of Creation that can be seen far and wide. According to Vukah lore, Ancients tore open one of the Pillars with a great explosion. The Vukah offer their tusks in a special ceremony to avoid another eruption. I do not know what these inscriptions mean, but I pray to those same Ancients that those creatures do not interrupt our dig site! — Loraine Crim, Yearwake, 506 D.A.
cn: 我真的吓坏了。原本我们是来调查灵火神殿的，但是在穿越洞窟的过程中，我们在岩壁上发现了沃卡的标记……除此以外还有散落的獠牙和骨片，但是以前这里明明不是沃卡的领地！ 我设法翻译了一部分铭文……上面提到了随处都能看见的巨大创世之柱。按照沃卡的说法，远古者利用一次巨大的爆炸打开了其中一根柱子。为了避免发生另一次火山喷发，沃卡会在特殊的仪式中献上自己的獠牙。 我不知道这些铭文到底代表了什么，但是我只能向祈祷，希望那些野兽不会来打搅我们的挖掘场！— — 洛琳·克里姆，岁初，506 D.A.

en: Mandatory: A wand. The incantation (found below). A clear visual of the dead person you wish to speak to. Optional: Clementine scented candles. (When you return from the afterlife, you'll smell like burnt flesh.) Speak the following words slowly: One hour 'till dawn, and I share it with you Twice the time on this Earth won't prove my love true Death cannot part us, I will find you wherever Breach thrice the darkness, so we're blind together Sands of time flee me, I fall to your waves Stretch out your hands, let reality cave I sacrifice light, countless breaths that I waste Just pull me in once, for that final embrace Please note: If the person you take into the afterlife does not LET GO of the dead's embrace, you disintegrate into ashes. The clementine candles won't help, then. Take care!
cn: 必备条件： 魔棒。咒语（已写在下方）。一张你想要见的逝者的清晰画像。 可选条件：柑橘味香薰蜡烛。（当你从冥界归来之后，你身上会散发肉体烧焦的恶臭。） 准备好之后缓慢说出以下语句： 在黎明到来的一个小时前，我将与你进行分享 哪怕在凡间走两遭也无法表明我对你的爱 死亡无法将我们分离，无论你在哪我都将找到你 三次突破黑暗，让我们一起陷入盲目 时间之沙离我而去，我将坠入你的波浪 伸出你的手，让现实崩塌 我将献祭光明，我将浪费无数的光阴 求你再次拉住我的手，只为了最后的拥抱 请注意： 如果被带入灵界之人不愿意挣脱亡者的拥抱，你将立刻化为灰烬。到时候就算是柑橘味香薰蜡烛也不管用。千万小心！

en:
8.2.3	
Liability pursuant to Section 8.2.2 is limited to the damage foreseeable at the time the agreement was concluded and whose occurrence would typically be expected.
cn:
8.2.3	
根据第 8.2.2 条规定的赔偿责任，仅限于在订立本协议时可预见的、且通常预期会发生的损害。

en: These gloves prevent the bowstring from digging into the skin while lining up shots.
cn: 特殊设计的手套，防止拉弓时弓弦磨破皮肤，瞄准射击更精准。

en: This draconic-looking bow was often feared for its crooked horns of unknown origin. Villagers believed that horns so twisted would always bring bad luck.
cn: 让人联想到龙的可怕长弓，安装有不明来源的弯曲犄角。村民们认为那种扭曲的犄角是不详之物。

en: Old friend, step closer. I've a tale to tell.
cn: 老朋友，过来点。我有个故事要告诉你。
找到波莱特·雷克莱尔的地下室

en: A rake made of the simplest materials. A basic tool used to flatten the ground for upcoming construction works.
cn: 使用最简单的材料制作的耙子。这种基础工具能够平整地面，为后续的建造做好准备。

en: A <craftingstation>Smelter</craftingstation> could come in handy. Trust me, it's worth finding my <keyitem>Crucible</keyitem> to make it.
cn: <craftingstation>冶炼炉</craftingstation>应该能够派上用场。相信我，找到我的<keyitem>熔炉</keyitem>绝对物超所值。

en:
A tiny flame, a tiny light
banishes the darkness and all its blight
cn:
渺小的火焰与微小的光芒
驱散黑暗与徘徊其中的痛苦

en: You've encountered lore about the siege on the capital. Based on what was written, you can predict where the warlord Vorgoth moved to on his quest to take the city.
cn: 你找到了有关首都围城战的知识。根据笔记上的内容，你可以推断出军阀沃格斯当时在征服城市期间的行动轨迹。

en: Search For Haircolor Inspiration In <location>Fort Kelvin</location>
cn: 在<location>凯尔文要塞</location>寻找发色灵感

en: The simplicity of this sword is deceiving! A faint, magical power radiates from the pastel blue stone forged into the blade. This craftsmanship was very popular with young spell slingers and battle mages.
cn: 不要被这把剑的质朴外表给骗了！剑身上镶嵌的淡蓝色宝石蕴含着一股微妙的魔法能量。这是一种受到年轻的魔法研习者与战斗法师青睐的工艺。

en:
6.1.8	
Keen may also take measures against Uploaders or User Content that violate applicable law if the competent national judicial or administrative authorities have issued an order under applicable law to act against specific User Content or against Uploaders.
cn:
6.1.8	
如果主管的国家司法或行政机关根据适用法律已针对特定用户内容或上传者发布了采取行动的命令，Keen 也可针对违反适用法律的上传者或用户内容采取相应措施。

en: You've found a hidden crafting recipe in the Blackmire! Obtain all 5 recipes scattered throughout the area to unlock traversal options for your home, as well as buffs and decorations!
cn: 你已经找到了黑沼中的一份隐藏制作配方！获取散落在区域中的5份配方，为自己的家园解锁全新的穿行选择，同时获取全新的增益与装饰品！

en: I can finally examine Mei's wares again! Let's look at the craftsmanship together, yes? I love window shopping!
cn: 我终于有机会再去欣赏梅的货物了！让我们一起去看看她的手艺吧？我最喜欢逛街了！

en: A weird brew emitting a blue glow... Nobody quite knows why.
cn: 这种奇怪的浓汤散发着蓝色的光芒……没有人知道这是为什么。

en: You have the sharpest gaze around. Keep your keen eyes open for my brother, will you? I haven't heard from Gerith since the storm. Last time we spoke, he planned to loot this hidden tomb. I don't know where exactly, but he said it wasn't too far from here. So please, if you spot a scrawny lad on the horizon, don't shoot! Notify me instead. It might be my brother Gerith!
cn: 你的目光是最敏锐的。帮我找到弟弟，好吗？暴风雨之后我就没有杰瑞斯的消息了。上次他说要去抢劫一个隐蔽的坟墓。我不知道具体地点，但他说离这里不远。 所以，如果你发现一个瘦弱的小伙子，请不要攻击他！通知我。那可能是我弟弟格里斯！

en:
Log NR. 01
Last Fed: Monday, Hand (accidental) 
Note: Has a nasty bite. Remind Rafael to get some pliers. Might need to remove teeth.
cn:
1号日志
最后喂食时间：周一，徒手（意外）
记录：被狠狠咬伤了。提醒拉斐尔搞一些钳子。有可能需要拔牙。

en: You’ve done splendidly in recovering all those spells. I must say, I’m impressed! Now that I’ve studied them firsthand, I can attempt to recreate their magic for you.
cn: 干得漂亮，你已经找到了所有法术。不得不说，这让我对你刮目相看！现在我已经对它们进行了研究，我可以试着为你复刻那些魔法。

en:
I see now that this is the end.
I saw my sisters die. I saw them get torn apart, swallowed by one of those horrendous beasts. I can still hear their screams. I think they will haunt me in death.

They warned me of the risks. I went anyway, pushing the doubts aside.
Even now, surrounded by blood, I cannot say that standing with them was wrong. I would rather die knowing that I did not abandon my sisters than live knowing that I had.

Our cause was just, and our intentions were pure. Be certain, I would choose this path again. 
At last, we are reunited with our true queen. 
Glory to Queen Pikemead. 

- Celia, Guard of the Blood Rose
cn:
我终于明白，这便是终点。
我亲眼目睹姐妹们死去。看着她们被撕碎，被那些可怖的野兽吞噬。至今仍能听见她们的惨叫。我想她们的亡魂将永世萦绕我心。

她们曾警告过风险。我仍毅然前行，将疑虑抛诸脑后。
