en: This is an elevated version of the Boreal Axe. Its head boasts an intricate design, typical for northern craftsmanship.
cn: 升级版的北地斧。斧刃采用了常见于北境工艺品的精美设计。

en: Acidic Mycelium mined in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 在游牧高地中采集到的酸性菌丝。

en: Critical Strikes with Two-Handed weapons increase your Critical Strike chance by %k for the next hit.
cn: 使用双手武器造成暴击伤害后，你的下一次攻击的暴击率将提高%k。

en:
An arrangement of warm grays and browns, reminiscent of a muddy brook lined by hazelnut bushes.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
cn:
温暖灰色与褐色之间的搭配，让人联想起榛树林间的泥泞溪流。

可以使用春日平原材料制作这种调色板。

en:
The Waveleaper dances atop the waves with unmatched agility, a living embodiment of the waters untamed spirit.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
浪跃者会凭借无与伦比的灵巧性随波舞蹈，它们就是桀骜不驯的大海精神的化身。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。

en: This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.
cn: 仅能在灵火祭坛附近的建造区域内放置此工具。之后你将能够使用预制结构快速建造基地。

en: Unlocks Special Abilities of Felling Axes. Press %k to unleash a powerful Special Ability after generating enough Focus. Focus Generate Focus by attacking. Focus can be built up with any weapon type and is used to trigger Special Abilities of weapons.
cn: 解锁伐木斧的特殊能力。 拥有充足专注时按%k释放强大的特殊能力。 专注 攻击将生成专注。所有类型的武器都可以积累专注，你可以花费专注来发动武器的特殊能力。

en: An ingredient used in crafting recipes.
A red and juicy Tomato! If handled with care, it can have enhancing effects.
cn: 鲜红而且多汁的番茄！只要料理妥当就能够提供强化效果。

en: These granite shingles bring a mountain flair to your cozy homestead.
cn: 花岗岩瓦片将为你的温馨宅邸带来一丝山间的氛围。

en: You've reached the abandoned watchtower. Look for tameable dogs!
cn: 你已经抵达废弃瞭望塔。寻找可驯服的狗！

en: Increases the skill level of Swiftshot Sustenance
cn: 提高速射给养的技能等级

en:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.
cn:
能够投掷出去的爆炸物，威力巨大。

这种投掷物造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。

en: Ah, my savior has arrived! Thank you again for lifting me from that muddy tomb! I promise to never burden you again, and I'll seal that in blood! Now, where are my... oh, right... I left my favorite daggers in the Tar Pits after escaping a vicious beast! Would you get them back to me? This will be the last thing I'll ever ask of you! Probably...
cn: 啊，是我的救命恩人！再次感谢你帮助我摆脱了那个泥泞的坟墓！我发誓永远不会再给你添麻烦，我愿意用鲜血起誓！好了，让我先找找我的……哦，我想起来了……之前在逃脱一头凶猛野兽的追杀时，我不小心把自己最喜欢的匕首落在了焦油坑里面！能不能拜托你帮我把它们取回来？我保证之后不会再麻烦你了！应该……

en: To fish is to hold a mirror to nature.
cn: 钓鱼就是在与自然融为一体。

en: An important material and basic chemical ingredient found in nature. It can be used to make bright orange and red dyes. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Explosive Fell Critters, initially found in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 一种重要材料，是大自然中常见的基础化学物质之一。能够用于制作亮橙色与红色染料。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于燃火荒原中的爆炸瘴气魔虫。
触发残酷打击将恢复10%法力。

en: Roads provide comfortable travel and reduce the stamina needed for sprinting.
cn: 道路提供了舒适的旅行条件，因此能够减少冲刺所需的体力。

en: I have a most urgent request for you!
cn: 我有一件要紧事必须拜托你！

en: Overpower Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered. Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.
cn: 压制 攻击格挡中的敌人或者是招架敌人的攻击都会使他们的晕眩条上涨，直到最后进入被压制状态。 被压制的敌人将毫无防备，这种时候你可以对其发动残酷打击。

en: Flameborn, over here! I've got a business proposal for ya! Wink wink!
cn: 火之子，这边！我有一个大好的生意机会要告诉你！快来快来！

en: A facetted gemstone made from refined frozen ectoplasm.
cn: 使用精炼过的冰冻灵质打造而成的璀璨宝石。

en: This spell is fueled by the eternal Flame and serves as unlimited magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a large area. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 蕴含永恒之力的法术灵火能够作为无限魔法弹药，使用时发射一枚强力火球，火球将在撞击后爆炸，对大范围内的目标造成伤害。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: The Carpenter wants some helping hands around the base. He mentioned his aunt Braelyn and wondered if she could be brought back from the dead like the villagers. He used to receive mail from her whenever she was out on adventures, but she went missing ages ago while scouting the Blackmire for interesting architecture. She seemed especially interested in temples, towers, and bridges. There's plenty of hidden temples in the Blackmire region, so start your search there!
cn: 木匠需要一些帮手来改造基地。他提到说自己有一个叫布莱林的姑姑，说不定你可以像复活其他村民一样让布莱林死而复生。以前布莱林出去冒险的时候都会给木匠写信，但是很久以前，她在调查黑沼的建筑时失踪了。 布莱林似乎对神庙、高塔以及桥梁十分感兴趣。黑沼地区有许多隐藏的神庙，也许你可以从那里开始搜索！

en:
A helmet made from petrified insectoid critter legs assembled to grasp at the wearer's face like claws.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
使用化石化的昆虫腿部打造而成的头盔，会像爪子一样牢牢攀附在穿戴者的面部。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: Sandstone mainly consists of big sand particles - a beautiful natural material and another wonder of nature to admire.
cn: 砂岩是主要由大块砂砾构成的岩石，这种大自然的神奇产物同时也是一种美丽的天然材料。

en: Copper adds a certain industrial warmth to your home with its characteristic color and shine.
cn: 铜独有的金属光泽将为你的家带来一丝非同凡响的工业暖色色调。

en: Surviving is important. Thriving is elegant.
cn: 生存很重要。但不能忘记保持优雅。

en: A small variant of the water wheel. It can be placed in water to generate force for a mill. Must be placed near the mill.
cn: 小型尺寸的水轮。能够放置在水中以驱动石磨。 必须放置在石磨附近。

en: The Shroud slumbers inside. Rotblood is molded by it, changed, and its essence forever tainted.
cn: 在瘴气的塑造与改变下，腐血已经彻底被腐化。

en: Phew, what a journey. You must've saved me from that... "pod"! I'm Elio Ricci, a barber and hairstylist! I'd invite you to my temporary salon in <location>Fort Kelvin</location>, but I fear it didn't last. Not since I was thrown over a cliff by some, uh... "dog-bear-beasts"? Luckily for you, my rugged hero, I lived — only slightly disoriented, but still just as radiant as before! My services will help your idyllic commune shine!
cn: 咻，太惊险了。肯定是你把我从那个……“东西”里面救出来的吧！在下埃里奥·里奇，我是一名理发师与发型顾问！虽然我很想要邀请你去我在<location>凯尔文要塞</location>的临时沙龙做客，但是恐怕那里早已不复存在。之前我被一群呃……“像狗又像熊的野兽”给丢下了悬崖、好在运气不错，粗犷的英雄，我还活着……虽然有一点点晕头转向，但还是和往常一样光彩夺目！相信我的服务将能够帮助你充满田园风情的社区大放异彩！

en:
The bright silver tone of this color palette decorated many of the realm's opulent chalices. It's known to pair well with the sanguine red of wine or the treacherous green glow of deceit and poison.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
cn:
这种调色板的明亮银色曾经点缀过许多奢华酒杯。这种颜色与美酒的鲜红色或者是闪耀着背叛与毒药的绿色都十分相配。

可以使用游牧高地材料制作这种调色板。

en: Shooting Regular Arrows has a 20% chance to spawn a Flurry of Arrows that spreads slightly. Regular Arrows fired this way will subtract from your ammunition. Flurry of Arrows does not trigger on Special Arrows.
cn: 发射普通箭矢有20%几率生成会略微散射的箭雨。 通过这种方式发射的普通箭矢将消耗你的弹药。 使用特殊箭矢时无法触发箭雨。

en: Automatically rotate and adjust the camera based on the player's movement when no mouse camera input is detected.
cn: 未检测到鼠标镜头输入时，根据玩家的动作自动旋转与调整镜头。

en: A Bronze Block commonly utilized in art and science. It inspires greatness when used as a building material.
cn: 常见于艺术品与科研设备中的青铜方块。这种材料能够让一切建筑显得磅礴大气。

en: A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake.
cn: 一把威严的法杖，顶部嵌有翡翠雕刻而成的衔尾蛇装饰。最适合用来庆祝蛇年的到来。

en: If you're headed towards <location>Thornhold</location>, watch out. I have intel that the town was ravaged by stray, starving dogs ages ago. It was so bad that the townsfolk almost ate them during meager harvests. Would be a shame to eat such a valuable hunting partner... and friend. If there are any dogs left, bring them here!
cn: 如果打算去<location>荆棘堡</location>的话，还请多加小心。根据我掌握到的情报，那座城镇在很多年前就已经被一大群饥肠辘辘的野狗给摧毁了。当年因为收成惨淡，当地的居民们差点就把那些狗给宰了吃。希望它们有活下来，狗其实是打猎时的好帮手……也是人类的朋友。如果那里还有活着的狗，请把它们带回来！

en: Wearing these boots makes each step feel like you're being carried on silver wings.
cn: 穿上这双靴子，每走一步都像是插上了银色的翅膀。

en: A root brimming with energy, but not very effective in its raw form. Improves the Dexterity of the consumer.
cn: 它是一种充满能量的根茎，但其原始形态并不十分有效。可提高食用者的敏捷。

en: You've brought the Barber two different ingredients that represent the nature of green. Talk to the Barber a final time to unlock the new hair color!
cn: 你已经为理发师找到了两种能够代表绿色本质的原料。 最后再与理发师交谈以解锁全新发色！

en: Inspired by the Quetzal, a magnificent bird that once graced the skies of Embervale, this beautiful armor set lets you feel the freedom and precision of flight when you wear it.
cn: 灵感源自曾经在薪谷的天空中遨游的雄伟绿咬鹃，这套美轮美奂的护甲将让你感受到自由自在的精准飞翔。

en: Increases the skill level of Life Essences
cn: 提高生命精华的技能等级

en: Gloves made from rotting, undead matter. They claw at their wearer's upper arms as if to grow upwards.
cn: 使用亡灵生物留下的腐烂物质制作而成的手套。它们紧紧攀附着穿戴者的上臂，就像是仍然在不断生长延展一般。

en:
I finally understand why the obelisk glyphs gave me so much trouble. 
Their language changed. It split into different dialects, one young, one old. Two factions within the Ancient breed, and two ideals: 

The young Ancients chose to come to our aid — they chose to help us fight the Shroud. To share their fire so humanity could withstand what they accidentally awoke. 
Despite this, the elder Ancients still clung to stoic elevation, segregation, and neutrality... thus, sealing themselves away and ascending to preserve the Flame's purity.

I've gone so far... Survived the Shroud, the heat, the cold... now, what else is there to do but validate my hypothesis? If I can read their signs, walk their path... I can speak their language... ask questions... and get answers.

— <lorename>Loraine Crim</lorename>, Yearfall, 508 D.A.
cn:
我终于知道为什么之前一直无法破译方尖碑上的符号了。
原来是他们的语言发生了改变。原本的语言分裂成了新老两种方言。这证明远古者的族群出现了两种派系，两种理念：

年轻一派的远古者不愿意抛下我们，他们决定帮助我们对抗瘴气。这些远古者分享了自己的火焰，这样人类才能够抵御那些被意外唤醒的存在。
尽管如此，远古者中的长老们仍然坚持着那种高高在上、冷漠而且中立的区别对待……这些远古者选择了飞升并封印自己来保存火焰的纯洁。

一路走来……我经历了瘴气、酷热还有严寒……如今我只剩下一个使命：验证我的假设。如果我能够亲眼看见他们的印记，重走他们的旅途……我能够掌握他们的语言……我可以说出一直以来憋在心中的问题……并得到答案。

— <lorename>洛琳·克里姆</lorename>，岁末，508 D.A.

en: My stomach is grumbling. If only one of the nearby food stations would be filled up!
cn: 我的肚子在咕噜噜叫。真希望能有人去把附近的食物站填满！

en: The bandits took my most esteemed wares when they fell upon my wagon like hawks. After their arrows ripped me away from my cart and pinned me to the ground, they rummaged through the cargo and emerged with my staff, among other things. Writhing in pain, I was forced to watch them run as everything faded... but I remember where they fled to.
cn: 强盗们抢走了我的宝贵商品，他们就像一群秃鹫一样袭击了我的马车。飞来的箭矢直接将我射下马车并钉在了地上，之后他们便将所有货物洗劫一空，我的所有家当和我的法杖都不见了。难以忍受的痛楚让我无法动弹，我只能眼睁睁地看着他们扬长而去，接着我的眼前便一片漆黑……不过我还记得他们离开时的方向。

en: Instantly restores a medium amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.
cn: 立即恢复适量法力并提供10秒的持续恢复效果。

en: Created in the pursuit of immortality, it cost countless lives and promises more to follow.
cn: 诞生自对于不朽的追寻，无数人为此献出生命，而今后也注定会有更多牺牲。

en: Craft A Farming Animal Feeder And Bed
cn: 制作农场动物喂食器与床

en: "Never let the coals die", they say. Look for more like us!
cn: “星星之火可以燎原”。肯定还有像我们一样的幸存者！

en: My daughter Rochelle might still be out there. If you find my little rock, my sweet pebble of a daughter... bring her here. At least retrieve her remains. I'd bury her if nothing else.
cn: 我的女儿罗茜也许还活着。她是我的小石头，我最美丽的鹅卵石，如果你能找到我的女儿……请把她带来这里。如果她已经……至少请把她的遗体带回来。我将亲手埋葬她。

en: Damage against ranged enemies is increased by %k.
cn: 对远程敌人的伤害提高%k。

en: I'll need a fresh set of clothes to change into. There's lots of blood, sweat, and tears in my profession. Mostly sweat! I had others before arriving at the farm, but I ripped them off during an expedition when I saw spiders crawling all over!! I can't go back there. No no no. You do it!
cn: 我得换一套新衣服了。干我这行的难免会沾到鲜血、汗水与泪水。当然，绝大多数还是汗水！来农场之前我本来有几套衣服，但是在一次探险期间我看见衣服上爬满了蜘蛛，就把它们全扯下来了！我反正是不会再去那个地方了。打死我也不去，就拜托你了！

en: We can do more. Become stronger. I've got an idea... but I'll need some help and a <craftingstation>Tanning Station</craftingstation>!
cn: 我们还没有发挥全部潜力。我们需要变得更强大。我有个想法……但是我需要一些帮助以及一台<craftingstation>制皮台</craftingstation>！

en: The Carpenter needs Masonry Tools to unlock more crafting stations. The Masonry Tools can be gathered from a research site at the Pillars of Creation.
cn: 木匠需要石匠工具来解锁更多制作台。石匠工具能够在创世之柱的一处研究点中找到。

en: I have a task that I can only entrust to a friend... come a little closer, so I may share it with you.
cn: 现在我有一项只能托付给信任之人的任务……靠近一点，我的朋友，让我来给你说明一下。

en:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The image encapsulates a moment of change: A shipwreck on faraway shores foretells humanity's demise. They see the Ancient Lands rise above the horizon— a sign of the gods turning away from humanity at last. For the Drak, the time to strike back has come.
cn:
详细记载着卓克的历史的浮雕。

这块浮雕的画面描绘着变革的时刻：遥远海岸上的船只残骸预示了人类的灭亡。他们看见了飘浮在地平线上方的远古者之地——这是诸神最终背弃人类的迹象。对于卓克来说，这是他们反攻的时机。

en: You've proven yourself to be trustworthy and capable. Perhaps I can bestow you with another challenge. Originally, the serpent weapons were a set of three, but I could never obtain the bow — the last of the triad. It still slumbers inside a Nomad Highlands temple. The temple of the snake is treacherous, but you're ready. Go forth.
cn: 你已经证明自己可靠又可信。也许是时候给你一个全新的挑战了。毒蛇武器最初其实有三件，而弓则是这套武器的最后一件，只是我从来没有拿到过这件武器。现在它仍然沉睡在一座游牧高地神殿中。蛇之神殿里面十分危险，但我相信你已经做好准备。快出发吧。

en: A Regular Stone Block used for everyday construction.
cn: 建筑中常用的普通石头方块。

en: Find The Hidden Chest In Alba
cn: 找到黎明哨所中的隐藏宝箱

en: Suppressed by a more permissive public role
cn: 已被权限更高的公共身份覆盖

en: The fire of the Flame burns within you.
cn: 灵火之火在你内心燃烧。

en: Jezmina's Journey Through The Veilwater Basin
cn: 杰兹米娜穿越幕水盆地的旅程

en: Refined wool. It can be used for weaving garments and warm padding.
cn: 加工后的毛料。能够用于制作服饰与温暖衬垫。

en:
Such big building! Tall spire! Bright light!

Can only be made by Descendants of Ark Morgo, yes — Ancients must be messengers! Connect to Ark Morgo above! Beam to the sky beyond the clouds! A pathway for the worthy! 

But glowy platform don't work right! Rah! 
Drak'Dal will prove themselves anyway! Will enter! Squish Flame in battle! Win favor of gods!
cn:
如此巨大的建筑！高耸的尖塔！耀眼的光芒！

只有魔戈方舟的后裔能够打造那样的存在，没错——远古者肯定是信使！与天空中的魔戈方舟存在联系！他们的光束通往远端之外的天空！那是只有合格之人才能走上的道路！

但是发光的平台不起作用！啊！
卓克·达尔将证明自己！必将进入！在战斗中熄灭火焰！赢得诸神的青睐！

en: A fireplace that will provide warmth once placed in your home. It's simple, but sufficient for cooking simple meals and gaining the Rested buff.
cn: 一个火炉，放置在家园中便能够提供温暖。构造简单，但足以用来烹饪简单的料理并获取休息良好加成。

en: If you are killed, you will trigger a devastating explosion damaging all enemies within 50 meters.
cn: 你在死亡时将触发一次毁灭性的爆炸，对周围50米范围内的所有敌人造成伤害。

en: This one-handed axe crackles with electrifying energy since it was charged by lightning during a rare desert storm.
cn: 因为在一次罕见的沙漠风暴期间获得了闪电之力加持，这柄单手斧便拥有了电闪雷鸣之力。

en: Read all obelisks in the Veilwater Basin.
cn: 查看幕水盆地中的所有方尖碑。

en: A farmbed which will yield Corn.
You came in contact with a Shroud Muck, causing Shroud damage.
cn: 因为与瘴气黏液接触，你受到了瘴气伤害。

en: You've reached a location known as a "Night Sanctum". The barrier you've set out to investigate revealed itself to be a door. However, the star and moon ensemble decorating its facade indicates this to be no ordinary door, and it doesn't seem susceptible to force. Find a way to open the night door and explore the inside of the temple!
cn: 你已经抵达一处被称为“黑夜圣所”的地点。原来屏障的真身是这里的一扇大门。但是从点缀表面的星辰与月亮来看，这绝非是一扇寻常的门，你无法用暴力强行打开大门。 设法打开黑夜之门并探索神殿内部！

en: It's g- good... to have you b- back...
cn: 很、很高兴看见……你回、回来了……
由固定的瘴气魔敌人掉落

en: You can swing across some chasms using a Grappling Hook. Be on the lookout for these places.
cn: 你可以使用抓钩来穿越崎岖地形。留意类似的地点。

en: A building block crafted from purified slime. It illuminates the room with a ghostly green glow. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 使用纯净黏液制作的建筑方块。充满诡魅感的绿色荧光将照亮整个房间。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: Increases the skill level of Wand Mastery
cn: 提高魔棒精通的技能等级

en: Grinding the Fossilized Bone into dust frees its inherent magical attributes and makes it more handy for further production steps.
cn: 研磨成粉后，化石骨蕴含的魔力便得以释放，因此能够更方便地进行下一步加工。

en:
Gunther Galeforth, an old soldier, is convinced that we should improve our defenses. He wishes he had better weapons to help, and mentioned that one of his ancestors was buried with a great weapon. 

Investigate the area marked on your map and retrieve the weapon!
cn:
来自过去的士兵冈瑟·盖尔福斯确信我们应该进一步改进基地的防御。他认为我们需要更好的武器，并且提到说自己的一位祖先的陪葬品中有一把强力武器。

调查地图上标记的区域并取回武器！

en: To The Guard Of The North

Hey Steph, I couldn't meet you at our spot, so I'm leaving this note. Grindmill duty's got me in a chokehold, you know? Sorry to bring up work, but do you know a man named "Loft"? We found him wandering around in the snow. He said he was from a lumber team and that he got lost. He's fixing the roof on the tower now, but he seems... distracted. I requested a list from Everfrore Keep for all lumberers currently employed, but they're swamped with paperwork again. Remember John? He works there now. Dead inside, I assume. No matter. Do you like the beer I left you? It's got a "kick", huh? It's my new secret ingredient. I've got more in our hidden brewery. Don't worry, no one's caught on yet. Should we invite the new lad for a drink? - Kent
cn: 嘿，斯蒂芬，我没办法去那里了，所以才给你留了这封信。磨坊的工作太忙了，没办法。 抱歉被工作给耽搁了，话说你认识一个叫“洛夫特”的人么？之前我们发现这家伙正在雪地上乱转。他说自己是一个伐木队的人，但是半路上迷路了。洛夫特这段时间正在帮忙修理高塔的屋顶，但是我感觉他有点……心不在焉。 我已经向永霜堡申请了一份所有在职伐木工的名单，不过他们那边也是忙得不可开交，估计一时半会拿不出来。 还记得约翰么？他现在就在那里工作。说不定已经死在里面了。 总而言之，喜欢我给你留的啤酒吗？是不是“劲头很足”？我在里面加了一种新的秘密原料。我在秘密酿酒厂里面藏了更多。别担心，还没有被其他人发现。也许我们可以邀请新来的家伙一起去喝一杯？ - 肯特

en:
Still waters are deep, so they say. These serene blue hues remind us that things aren't always as they seem — for both depths and dewdropped thicket hide fateful encounters.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
俗话说静水流深。这些静谧的蓝色提醒着我们事物并不总是表面上看上去的那么简单——水底与沾满露水的灌木丛都隐藏着命运委任的遭遇。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en:
This color palette's combination of light green and vibrant purple takes inspiration from extinct orchids.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
这种调色板中淡绿色与亮紫色组合的灵感源自现今早已灭绝的兰花。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。

en: Scales how long you can survive in a cold environment.
cn: 调整你可以在寒冷环境中坚持的时间。

en: I trust my scientific instincts, but no one else will. The others don't believe in the existence of the Dragon Sword. They think it's just a fable from a bygone era. But the existence of real dragons would explain the origin of our large fossilized bone deposits and could fill the gaps in our proposed ancestry of the Draconian Vulture. If I found the Dragon Sword and retrieved it from it's forgotten cavern, I could add credence to my theory. Until then, I'd be the laughingstock of my peers if I revealed my true thesis...
cn: 我相信自己的科学直觉，但只有我一个人是这样。 其他人并不相信龙剑的存在。他们认为那不过是过去的传说罢了。但是只要证明过去真的存在龙这种生物，我们就可以解释之前发现的大型化石骨的来源，并且进一步填补目前对于残酷秃鹫的进化演变过程的空白。 只要能在那个神秘的洞穴中找到龙剑并将它带回来，我的理论就有了最确凿的证据支持。不过在那之前，我还不能展示自己的真正论文，不然我肯定会变成同行们的笑柄……

en:
Dark chestnut-colored pants. They're less frayed and battered than the remainder of the Omen's armor.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
一条深褐色长裤。与噩兆套装的其他部件相比，这条裤子看上去倒是相对完好而且整洁。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: Heh, good work on your part. Guess it’s on me now to get these lamps built.
cn: 嘿嘿，干得不错。接下来就让我来建造这些灯具吧。

en: The entire Skill Tree will be reset, and Skill Points refunded (%k). This action is irreversible!
cn: 重置全部技能树并返还技能点（%k）。此操作不可逆！

en: Uncover The Secrets Of The Hidden Tomb

I can't keep up. I quit! I QUIT! 

Approval form B12, not form 812
Follow-up needed, signature left blank, everything is past due
New Gateway Outpost D's building design isn't rule-conform. No one cares, they just build whatever
Why does everyone need burial certificates? Truly, why
There are at least 12 official requests every day
7 from Alba, 4 from Bora, 2 from Celeste
How can Outpost A even send 7 Requests 
And TWO OF THEM are for not having enough socks?! MAKE YOUR OWN SOCKS and cease your whining, why is that even a bureaucratic issue?

This desk job will be the death of me. It doesn't matter what they pay me! Im leaving! And I'm THROWING THE LOST & FOUND CHEST from the balcony, too!
cn:
我受不了了。我要辞职，辞职！

审批表格B12，不是812
需要跟进，签名栏空置，所有东西都已经过时效了
新的网道哨所D的建筑设计不符合规定。没有人在乎规定，他们想到什么就造什么
为什么所有人都需要埋葬凭证？我搞不懂了真的是
每天至少有12份官方申请
黎明7个，海风4个，星辰2个
哨所A为什么会需要7个申请
而且其中两份申请还是因为袜子不够？！没袜子就自己织两双，一帮蠢货，这种事有必要推给行政么？

早晚被这份坐办公室的工作给害死。我才不在乎他们给我多少钱！而且我要把失物招领箱从阳台上扔下去！

en: An adorable little Frizzy Goat. Its hair gets easily tangled, but it doesn't seem to mind.
cn: 一只可爱的小绒毛山羊。它身上的毛发总是打结，不过它自己好像并不在意。

en: What is that? Eeek! Get it away from me! Oh, it's not real? It's just a little plushy... These critters are not so scary when they're all fluffy and warm! Aww, they're actually quite adorable, aren't they? Let's set this little guy down somewhere. I want everyone to see how cute he is!
cn: 那是什么？噫！快拿开！哦，那不是真的？只是一个小小的毛绒玩偶……现在它们看上去毛茸茸暖呼呼的，一点也不吓人！哦，它们真的好可爱，对吗？给这小家伙找个地方放起来吧。我想让所有人看见他的可爱模样！

en: This workplace will enable the <npc>Hunter</npc> to mass produce leather.
cn: 允许<npc>猎人</npc>批量生产皮革的工作地点。

en: A soft pillow for your cat.
cn: 为猫咪准备的柔软枕头。

en: Allows jumping a second time while airborne. Cost: 10 Stamina
cn: 允许在空中进行第二次跳跃。 消耗：10点体力

en: I wish I had more instruments to play... a good drum beat would be great near the fireplace, no?
cn: 要是能有更多乐器就好了……围在篝火旁敲鼓奏乐应该挺不错的，你说呢？

en: The fearsome metal mask is only partially covered by the hood, leaving most of its sharp edges and lines visible to your prey.
cn: 兜帽无法完全罩住可怕的金属面具，这是为了确保你的猎物能够清楚地看见面具充满不详意味的尖锐轮廓。
春日平原与喧嚣森林 空荡礼堂

en: You've obtained a bed, making your shelter feel more comfortable. Resting in an environment with high Comfort will increase the duration of your Rested Buff. After a good night's sleep, you will need proper food to face the sunrise head-on. Eating food grants you a Food Buff specific to the meal's type. Such Food Buffs are paramount to increase your stats or boost their regeneration. Before eating food, you must first prepare it. Raw ingredients must be processed over an open flame or cooking station to become edible or unlock their full potential. A refined meal made of multiple elements is more effective than a single roasted ingredient. A Skewer, for example, has greater impact than plain game or vegetables. It must be assembled in your Manual Crafting menu before cooking. For now, process a skewer or any other raw food over a flame to proceed. Take care not to roast it for too long, or it will burn.
cn: 你已经获得一张床，这使得你的庇护所变得更加舒适。在高舒适度的环境中休息将延长你的休息良好加成的持续时间。 在酣睡一晚之后，你将需要像样的食物来迎接崭新的一天。 进食将根据料理的类型来提供对应的食物加成。食物加成将能够为你提供至关重要的数值提升或者恢复强化。在进食之前，你需要先加工食材。 只需要在明火或者是烹饪站进行简单的处理，许多生的食材就能够变成可食用的料理，或者是释放真正的潜力。比起简单烤制的单一食材食物，使用多种食材加工而成的精致料理能够提供更有效的增益。 例如烤串就能够带来比未经加工的肉或者蔬菜更强大的效果。 你需要先在手工制作菜单中将其组合，然后再进行烹饪。 现在，先将生烤串或任意其他生食物置于明火上方以继续。注意食材的烧烤时间，太久的话会烤焦。

en: Captain's Journal, Day Twenty of Midyear, 512 D.A.
cn: 队长的日志，岁中第20日，512 D.A.

en: Dive headfirst into battle with this Warrior Helmet!
cn: 装备战士头盔，勇敢地冲入敌阵！

en: A forgotten sword from long gone days. Commonly found among the ashes of Embervale.
cn: 许久之前被人遗弃的旧剑。常见于薪谷的灰烬中。

en: A bow that sparks blazing joy in firebugs and aspiring pyromaniacs.
cn: 这把弓能够让那些喜爱看着一切熊熊燃烧的纵火狂们欣喜若狂。

en: Search Under The Grindmill Floorboards In <location>Willow Crush</location>
cn: 调查<location>碎柳镇</location>磨坊地板下方的空间

en: When your Mana drops below 20%, you restore up to 35% of your maximum Mana at the cost of 1 Health per Mana restored. This effect stops at 1 Health. Cooldown: 2 minutes
cn: 当法力值低于20%时，你将恢复至多35%的最大法力值，但与此同时，你将损失等同于恢复法力值的生命值。 当生命值仅剩1点时，此效果将暂停。 冷却时间：2分钟

en: Only a prestigious castle can be built from such sturdy stone.
cn: 只有这种牢不可破的石头才能够建造出显赫城堡。

en: When you are killed by an enemy, all allies within 30 meters are healed for 50% of their maximum Health. They also receive a Final Blessing buff, increasing their maximum Health by 100 points for 15 minutes.
cn: 当你被敌人杀死时，30米范围内的所有友军将恢复最大生命值的50%。 除此以外，范围内的友军将获得临别祝福增益并使他们的最大生命值提高100点，持续15分钟。

en: A bow with the color of sunny amber or dunes. Its shots can pierce anything.
cn: 颜色犹如日光琥珀或者是沙丘一样的弓。发射的弓箭能够穿透一切物体。

en: Now, this! This is what I call a brilliant blue! It's as clear as a sky without clouds or a freshwater spring! Right, I remember how to create this hair color now. Thank you so much! Do you want to try the new look right away? I'm ready when you are!
cn: 没错！这才是真正的蓝色绚烂！晴空万里或者是清澈泉水的色彩！很好，我已经想起来如何制作这种发色了。太谢谢你了！要不要来尝试一下全新的颜色？有兴趣的话就告诉我！

en: Indicates how well you use magic items.
Bark from the giant trees in the Blackmire. It feels rough but could look quite cozy.
cn: 来自黑沼中生长着的巨大树木的树皮。质地粗糙，不过外观看上去让人感到温馨。

en: The Alchemist Assistant Paulette wants to greet all sorts of spirits during Hollow's Eve by adding carved pumpkins to your base! You should find some pumpkin farms in the Albaneve Summits to learn how to make them!
cn: 炼金术士的助手波莱特希望能够在空荡之夜欢迎各路幽灵，他打算在你的基地中安放一些雕刻好的南瓜！你应该能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到南瓜农场，找到南瓜以学习如何制作南瓜雕塑！

en: Spend the Skill Points you aquired on your journey in the Skill Tree.
cn: 在技能树中花费一路上得到的技能点。

en: An archer's hood. The leather trim provides additional protection and camouflages the wearer between the trees.
cn: 箭手专用的兜帽，皮革装饰提供额外保护，也让佩戴者隐身于树林间。

en: Interacting with this shrine will grant you the Vuk'ahrrrrr buff. It grants + 20% Damage against Scavenger and + 10% Poison Resistance for 30 minutes.
cn: 与神龛互动将赋予你沃卡沃卡加成。 提供+20%对拾荒者伤害以及 +10%毒素抗性，持续30分钟。
科斯特纳·迈耶斯的强大魔药

en: Stop asking until the next time I open the inventory.
cn: 在下次打开物品栏之前不再询问。
在雪地上行走时不会减速。

en: Find The Color Palette In The Quarry
cn: 在采石场中寻找调色板

en: If this setting is switched off, weapons don't break anymore.
cn: 如果关闭该选项，武器将不会损坏。

en: The <keyitem>Scientific Instruments</keyitem> were retrieved! They must be brought back to the <npc>Alchemist</npc> and crafted into a Laboratory to unlock more recipes and better healing.
cn: 找到<keyitem>科研设备</keyitem>了！现在得把这些设备带给<npc>炼金术士</npc>，这样才能建造实验室并解锁更多配方与更强力的治疗手段。

en:
The Crimsonback, once a common Silverback that survived countless migrations, has scales that burn with a deep red hue. It is said to embody strength and endurance, and it is prized by seasoned anglers for its power and beauty.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
虽然原本只是普通的银背，但是在经历了无数次的迁徙后，它便成为了长着暗红色鳞片的红背鱼。据说这种鱼是力量与坚毅的化身，它们的强大与美丽备受老练垂钓者们的青睐。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。
远古密室 — 吟游诗人

en: A gleeful and jingly hat. The little bells make frolicking around more joyous.
cn: 一动就会叮当响的可笑帽子。上面挂着的小铃铛让人看着忍俊不禁。

en: A headwrap that protects your sensitive skull from traumatic injury. Enough to postpone the inevitable for a while.
cn: 这头巾不会让你刀枪不入，但至少能帮你的脑袋多挨几下。
大型空荡之夜南瓜 I

en:
A mix of umber and gray, exhibiting both wisdom and solidity.

This color palette can be made with Springlands materials.
cn:
灰褐色相间的色彩彰显着智慧与沉稳。

可以使用春日平原材料制作这种调色板。

en: This sword illuminates the depths of the Shroud, defiant to the end.
cn: 这把永不屈服的利剑将照亮瘴气的深渊。

en: Ahhh... so beautiful... so serene... I feel seen. As if I was used to s- sleeping... under the moonlight's glow... with n- n- nothing... and n- no one around... thank you.
cn: 啊……太美了……充满静谧……我仿佛正在被注视着。就像是以前在、在……月光下安睡……周围空、空……空无一物也没有人……谢谢你。

en:
Shadowy reds make this palette ideal for a moody night-time journey.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
影影绰绰的红色让这种配色成为了在月下阴郁旅行的绝佳选择。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: When hosting a world with a subscribed session, quest progression, terraforming, and accessing storage are disabled for you and other players.
cn: 使用订阅进程主持世界期间，你和其他玩家将禁用任务进度、地形改造以及仓库使用。

en: The spiral pulls inwards Winding down Unknowable configuration, each curve more twisted than the last A corkscrew slowly digging into flesh A snake eating the world And devouring itself, until it can feast no longer Again, and again, and again. Until the world forgets, for it leaves no trace of itself but a lingering allure. The pressure mounts as I travel below. A world that's no longer mine towers above me, suffocates me, pushes me down. I press my hand against the walls of the spiral so I don't lose myself in the descent. Its sides are moist and glistening. It twists more with every turn, uneven, irregular, and mangled around itself. It leads me ever downwards. The deeper I dive, the more I understand its rhythm. It's fleshy, breathing, vibrating. It becomes alive at depth.
cn: 螺旋不断向内延展 蜿蜒向下 捉摸不透的模式，每一道弯弧都愈发扭曲 就像是一把不断刺入肉体的钻头 吞噬世界的巨蟒 也在同时吞噬自身，直到它无法继续啖食 一遍又一遍。直到世界遗忘这一切，因为它唯一留下的，就只有徘徊不散的诱惑。 随着我不断向下，周围的压力也开始积累。已经不再属于我的世界伫立在头顶，压迫着我，让我无法呼吸。我用手抵住螺旋的高墙，只有这样我才能在下降的过程中避免迷失。 墙壁上湿润而且闪烁着微光。 每一次的转角过后，墙壁都会变得更加扭曲、崎岖、畸形而且破碎。我顺着墙壁不断向下。在下潜的过程中，我逐渐理解了它的旋律。血肉、呼吸与振动的旋律。在深渊中，它拥有了生命。

en: Would you look at that — you salvaged some items. Now you can use some Runes to enhance your equipment. Want to try?
cn: 很好，看来你已经拆解了一些物品。现在你可以使用一些符文来强化你的装备。要不来试试？

en: Ridges line the base of this sword, adding weight to each swing. The uneven silhouette is reminiscent of protruding vertebrae.
cn: 这把剑的刃柄上布满了崎岖纹路，这使得每一次的挥舞都格外有力。凹凸不平的形象会让人想到凸出的脊椎骨。

en: It's an alluring tunnel, a cave, a mouth wide open. It's a warm and enveloping darkness that promises a sacred inner light. Mankind is but children, young to the Earth, fresh-faced and naive, eager to explore. We are moths to a blue flame, drawn to go in. We strut where we should walk, and tower when we ought to crawl. Whoever allowed us to breach the darkness? To travel in and downwards evermore, a never-ending spiral slick with liquid shadow, down, a tiny splinter of time and matter sliding into the belly of a beast? I see this again, and again, and again. Sometimes, I am the child, blissfully ignorant until the end. Other times, I am the darkness. Greedy and waiting, observing the still waters from below — the silent predator crowded with invisible bodies at the bottom of a sunless sea. Calm, and so, so far away. Again, and again, and again.
cn: 这是一条无比诱人的隧道，一座洞窟，一个张开的嘴巴。温暖又无处不在的黑暗承诺着将带来神圣的内心之光。人类还只是稚嫩的孩子，在这片大地上，稚气未脱的他们天真又充满了探索的激情。我们不过是不由自主被蓝色火焰吸引的飞蛾。 我们错误地选择了疾驰狂奔，于是最终便迎来了崩塌的结局。究竟是谁允许我们闯入这黑暗？深入内部并继续向下，永无止境的漩涡沾满了液体的阴影，不断向下，时间与物质微不足道的分支就这么滑入了野兽的腹部？ 我一次又一次看见这个图案。 有时候，我就是那个孩子，在极乐的无知中迎来了终结。 其他时候，我则化身为黑暗。贪婪又耐心，我在深渊中观察着上方的平静水面，无光之海的最深处挤满了无数拥有隐形躯体的沉默捕食者。平静，但又间隔甚远。 一遍又一遍。
服饰 - 阿尔班耶夫山脉

en: Ahh, my bones are so sore. If only a benevolent savior would create some shelter for me, I'd be forever grateful!
cn: 唉，我真是太累了。假如有一位善良的拯救者能够帮我准备一处庇护所，我必将感激不尽！

en: A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out! Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 一对杂耍飞刀，在未经训练之人的手中会造成很严重的伤害！千万小心！ 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: A fast and stable internet connection and higher PC performance are recommended for hosting many players.
cn: 如果需要建立支持较多玩家数量的房间，推荐使用快速稳定的网络连接与高性能电脑。

en: A stack of old parchments, worn and torn by the ravages of time. A wise man could salvage something from the remnants.
cn: 一叠古老的羊皮纸，在岁月的摧残下已经破旧不堪，不过睿智者仍然能够从残骸中回收一些有用的东西。

en: A long, flowing garment. The lower seam effortlessly hovers around the ankles while you walk.
cn: 外形流畅细长的服饰。底部的缝线完美贴合脚踝，穿着行走十分舒适。

en: A hard lump of coal. It makes for great fuel!
cn: 一块坚硬的煤炭。很适合当做燃料！

en: Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.
cn: 新鲜的生姜，最适合用来泡煮拥有御寒功效的热茶。

en: A horned staff that has been embellished with alabaster fur. It is soft to the touch.
cn: 犄角形状的法杖上安装有雪白的毛皮。表面摸上去十分柔软。

en: Fell Vicious Vine, Veilwater Basin Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔恶毒藤蔓，幕水盆地瘴气区

en: Don't be shy — any more I can do for you?
cn: 不用害羞……还有什么需要吗？

en: A lumpy ball of snow. It's harmless enough as long as you don't put any rocks inside!
cn: 一团雪。不具备任何实际的杀伤力，但是千万不要使坏往里面塞石子！

en: Sturdy, bendy, and regenerative: Bamboo is an ideal material for any Flameborn looking to build a tropical home.
cn: 牢固、柔韧而且能够再生：对于想要建造热带家园的火之子来说，竹子将是一种最理想的材料。

en: Increases your Fire Resistance by %k, which reduces the amount of Fire damage received.
cn: 使你的火焰抗性提高%k，这将降低你承受的火焰伤害。

en: Do you know about Hollow's Eve? It's the season of the undead, the damned, and the daring! We welcome spirits from beyond with carved pumpkins and lights during the festivities! What? You're saying we're supposed to drive them away? I'd rather invite them in! Let's find some pumpkins, shall we?
cn: 你知道空荡之夜吗？这是属于亡者、被诅咒者与勇敢之人的季节！在节日期间，我们将使用精心雕刻的南瓜与烛火欢迎来自彼界的幽灵！什么？你说我们应该把它们赶走？那怎么行，过节就得邀请幽灵来才对！好了，让我们去找一些南瓜吧。
灵体们已经预见了你的到来。

en: These bellows are needed to craft a blast furnace.
cn: 用于制作高炉的材料之一。
阿尔班耶夫山脉 空荡礼堂

en: The hardest material known to mankind. Difficult to work with, but worth the effort!
cn: 已知硬度最高的材料。加工难度极高，但是拥有着惊人的性能！

en: Status: Horrendous. Impacts today: 17 (The section below is hastily scribbled) It's gone. Torn apart like cotton. Their catapults — pure devilry. Blighted fire, bright blue and hazy. A rotting stench. Numbers unknown. Too many. Lead by Vorgoth. He's coming. Heavy boots. Smashed Caden's skull. Lost below. Sludge and mud. All red. A wave of steel, flooding towards market square. My brothers below — yelling. No way down. Everything is loud — the screams. I cannot bear this. Dear lords. Please. I'm just a squire. Please don't crush my head Caden, I'm so sorry
cn: 状态：惨不忍睹。今日遭袭：17 （以下部分似乎是匆忙完成的，笔迹十分潦草） 没了。就像棉花一样被彻底撕碎了。他们的投石车简直就是恶魔的武器。那种腐化的火焰闪烁着明亮的蓝光，而且还伴随着重重浓雾。所到之处全是腐烂恶臭。具体人数不确定，根本数不清。带头的是沃格斯。他来找我们了。 那些沉重的靴子直接踩碎了凯登的脑袋。掉在下面了。那里全是泥泞。只能看见满眼的红色。钢铁的寒光，就像潮水一般涌向了市场区。我的兄弟们就在下面嚎叫着。根本没办法下去。周围的一切都震耳欲聋，我只能听见尖叫声。我受不了了。神灵在上。 拜托了，我只是一介侍从。请不要踩碎我的脑袋 凯登，对不起

en: Remarkable pants. What makes them remarkable? The wearer, mostly.
cn: 是什么让这些裤子与众不同？主要是穿着者本人。

en:
8.2	
To the extent Keen is otherwise directly liable, in particular for damage caused by Keen, Keen's liability under these Adventure Sharing Terms shall ultimately be governed by the following provisions:
cn:
8.2	
在 Keen 需另行承担直接责任（尤其是因 Keen 自身造成的损害）的范围内，Keen 根据本冒险分享条款的规定承担的责任最终应受以下条款的约束：

en: So that's it. My Honeydews are no more... We've split up many times, but something tells me last night was final. What's worse is that those bastards at the tavern wouldn't give me a room after my oh-so-kind bandmates — former bandmates, I suppose — made a mess of the place while fighting. Harper and Daniel never got along, but this was something else entirely. I should've tried to stop Harper from storming off towards that keep, but I was so busy dodging Dan's swings that I could hardly focus on anything else. As it stands, I've got no band, no payment, and no bed. The bartender even insulted me. ME! Miles Rapore! Don't they know I'm a musical genius? Fools. In the morning, I'll set out again. Seems I needn't pack my flute. Perhaps I should give cobbling another try.
cn: 一切都结束了。我的乐队“蜜露”已经结束了……虽然之前我们解散过很多次，但是我有预感，昨晚就是我们最后一次在一起演出。更糟糕的是，酒馆里的那些混蛋甚至不愿意给我开房间，理由是我那些“善良的”乐队成员，“前”乐队成员们在酒馆里大闹了一场。哈珀和丹尼尔一直都相互看不顺眼，但是这次……这次不一样。现在想想我那时候就应该阻止哈珀，不让他气冲冲地去那座要塞，但是我当时正忙着躲避丹尼尔的拳头，根本没工夫顾得上其他人。 总而言之，现在我已经没有乐队，没有薪水也没有睡觉的地方。酒保甚至还对我冷嘲热讽。我！迈尔斯·拉波利！难道他们不知道我可是个音乐奇才？一群蠢货。我决定明天一早就动身启程。看来我还没有收拾自己的笛子。也许我该再回去试试做修鞋匠。

en: Let the fire in your veins guide you!
cn: 血液中的火焰将指引你前进！

en:
Food for attracting and taming a Dune Armadillo.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
cn:
用于吸引与驯服沙丘犰狳的饲料。

若要驯服动物，请在潜行状态下小心靠近目标。在动物身边投掷诱饵食物以吸引其注意。在动物进食时抚摸它，重复过程直到动物被驯服。被驯服之后，你将可以捡起动物。

en:
This left Cyclops leg is much taller than you. You barely reach the kneecaps.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
cn:
独眼巨人的左腿就比你还要高。你只能勉强触碰到膝盖骨的位置。

能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到此收集品。能够在独眼巨人战利品底座上重新组装为一套完整的独眼巨人骷髅。

en:
Hello Emma. It was strange meeting you in the market — somewhere you should not have been in the first place. But I managed to slip this note into the shipment to Umber Hollow and hope you find it before someone else does. Even though we only spoke briefly, I could tell you are a decent woman. So the rumors of Umber Hollow being a deplorable place where cruelty abounds cannot be true, can they? I have heard so many stories of thievery and corruption... 

I sincerely hope we can both come to understand one another now that the world is changing before our very eyes. We might just need one another to survive. Please write me back.

From Carlos
cn:
艾玛你好。说实话在市场里看见你的时候我有点诧异，没想到你竟然会出现在这种地方。我设法将这张纸条塞进了送往褐赭空洞的货物里，希望你能赶在其他人之前找到。虽然我们之前只短暂聊过几句，但我能看得出来你是个善良的女人。所以关于褐赭空洞是乌烟瘴气的残酷之地的传闻肯定不是真的，对吗？人们都说你们那里腐败和盗窃肆虐……

无论如何，这个世界正在发生天翻地覆的变化，我真心希望我们双方都已经意识到这一点。也许只有齐心协力，我们才能共渡难关。还请你一定要答复我的信件。

卡洛斯启

en: When you drop below 20 % of your stamina you automatically gain 20% max stamina at the cost of 1 mana per stamina.
cn: 当体力低于20%时，你自动恢复最大体力的20%，但是将损失等同于获得体力的法力。

en: The scroll summons a Fire Wisp that follows, assists you in battle and provides light.
cn: 使用卷轴将召唤一个火灵，火灵将跟随你并在战斗中提供支援，除此以外它还能够提供照明。

en: Good on ya bringin' me back, but we can't get to fishin' with those... things lurkin' in the water. I tried to warn 'em, ya know? But none believed me... Have you seen 'em? Maws like snapjaws, talons like vultures, and a thirst for blood like the mad lord himself! We gotta drive 'em back — I owe that. But first, we ought to see what we're up against! A keepsake from 'em will do!
cn: 谢谢你把我带回来，但是我们恐怕没办法去钓鱼，毕竟那些……东西仍然在水下徘徊。我不是没有警告过其他人，你知道吗？但是没有人愿意相信我……你有看见那些东西的模样了吗？像大白鲨一样的巨颚，爪子像秃鹫，而且还像疯王一样嗜血！我们得把那些怪物赶回去……这是我欠所有人的。但是首先，我们得先摸清楚对手的底细！从它们身上弄一个纪念品应该就够了！
设置为偏好的出生祭坛

en: Hope they will be biting today.

cn: 炼金术士被撕裂的壁画

en: My father was a soldier, but I am far from that. Who am I kidding, being stationed here alongside those broad-shouldered, valiant, violent men? Their eyes show no light. The obsidian pits simply swallow me whole, reflecting my own weakness back at me, mixed with disdain. They don't possess kindness... their only known emotion is radiating anger, an inner heat that eats them up and warms their husks while blazing through snow and ice. When my father passed, the heart of this outpost was ripped away. And so was mine. They know me. They know I'll run and hide at the first sign of trouble. It's in the way they scoff at me, in the way they snarl my name. That's why they force lookout duty upon me... even that frightens me. Perhaps it's not so bad. Father always said "Cowards live longer."
cn: 我的父亲是一名士兵，但我并不是。虽然现在我已经被安排与这些身材魁梧的凶狠男人驻扎在一起。他们的眼睛里面没有一丝光芒。那些像黑曜石一般的深坑仿佛要将我吞噬，他们的双眼映射着我自身的软弱与对我的厌恶。 他们的心中没有一丝善良……他们唯一的情感就是无法遏制的怒火，那种内心的火焰驱使着他们的躯体穿过了冰雪覆盖的大地。 父亲走了之后，这间哨所就像是失去了自己的心脏一样。我也是。 这些人都很了解我。他们知道一旦遇到麻烦，我就会躲起来当个缩头乌龟。他们因此对我嗤之以鼻，我的名字成了他们口中的胆小鬼。所以他们才强行要我肩负起岗哨的职责……虽然我其实已经吓得不行。 不过也许这样也没什么问题。记得父亲生前一直说“胆小鬼往往活得最久。”

en: A steel arrow laced with poison, perfect for hunting. Poisoned Arrow: Wildlife and Wild Beast hit by this arrow are poisoned and receive 20 damage per second for 5 seconds.
cn: 一根淬毒的钢箭，最适合用来狩猎。 淬毒箭：被此箭射中的野生生物将中毒，并且将每秒承受20点伤害，持续5秒。

en: The last thing I know is that I was leaning over one of those ominous bouncy things, trying to get a better look. I'm pretty sure that Jeff, that moron, pushed me — because suddenly, I was catapulted through the air, spinning and turning. Then, I hit the ground, feet first. My ankles cracked and gave out, I felt a shiver of pain crawl through my whole body... and passed out. When I woke up, I was covered in splashes of tar... I wiped the droplets from my face and yelled for Jeff, but it was for naught. Turns out he must've jumped after me but hit the puddle. He's not lifting his stupid empty head from the tar... serves him right. I'll nurse my ankles and leave as soon as I can move my feet again.
cn: 我当时想要凑近看清楚那些弹性十足的怪东西，然后就冒险靠近了。我确定是杰夫那个蠢货推了我一把，我突然就发现自己被抛到了半空，整个人都在不停旋转。过了一会，我就重重地摔到了地上，而且是脚先着地。我的脚踝啪的一下就断掉了，我立刻疼得直冒冷汗……然后就晕了过去。 等我醒过来的时候，我发现自己全身都是焦油……我抬起手擦掉了脸上的污渍，然后大声向杰夫呼救，但是根本没有人回应我。估计他肯定是也跳进去了，但是这傻瓜直接栽进了池子里。他就这么头朝下漂在焦油里面……这个傻瓜真的是活该。 我得先处理一下脚踝，等缓过来我就想办法回去。

en: I used to have a rat infestation in my old tower. First, it was useful for experiments, but the rat population quickly exceeded my control. I soon saw some stray cats attracted by my test subjects... Chances are slim, but maybe they still populate the area. I could use a new lab partner!
cn: 我以前待的高塔里面老鼠泛滥。一开始，我把那些老鼠当成了不错的实验对象，但是很快老鼠的数量便开始不受控制地膨胀了。过了一段时间，我发现高塔附近总是有一些被我的实验对象吸引来的野猫……虽然机会渺茫，但说不定它们仍然生活在高塔附近。我需要一个新的实验搭档！

en: Blocking an enemy blow with a shield will drain stamina. The drain is reduced by your shield's block value.
cn: 用盾牌格挡敌人的攻击会消耗体力。消耗的体力会根据盾牌的格挡值减少。

en: This tool can be used to comb raw wool. It can be integrated into the spinning processes.
cn: 这种工具能够用来加工粗毛料。加工后的毛料能够用于制造其他物品。

en: A small extension for distilling vessels to separate chemicals while heating them.
cn: 额外的蒸馏设备，能够分离并加热化学物质。

en: Seared on the grill to perfection, enjoy this exquisite piece of fish filet.
cn: 已在烤架上完美炙烤，尽情享受这份精致的鱼片吧。

en: Your steps will be quick and quiet, and your strikes will be deadly.
cn: 脚步轻盈无声，攻击迅猛致命。

en: You've picked up the stray cat from the Alchemist's tower! Place it in your home to welcome it!
cn: 你已经拿起了炼金术士高塔中的野猫！将其放置在家中以欢迎新成员的到来！

en: Uncover The <craftingstation>Masonry Tools</craftingstation> In The Research Camps

The maw was famished as it called my name. Lonely. Yearning, like me. I had no choice, and it knew.

Caught between teeth, sharp as razor blades — my sides cut, and split apart. I slipped under its tongue, spinning. Suffocating in its warmth. It holds me inside. We are the same. We are one.

Why is my flesh hollow?
A pit. I am a pit, empty, starved
I am nothingness, the absence, the void
The few, the many, the all
Pulled into the spiral's core, feeding the cycle
Breeding ground today
Harbinger tomorrow, unravelled anew
I am the abyss itself, awoken once more
cn:
喊叫着我的名字的巨口饥肠辘辘。它和我一样孤独而又渴望着。我别无选择，而它也知道这一点。

夹杂在锐利如锯刃的牙齿之间，我的身体被一分为二。接着我便顺着它的舌头不断旋转着滑了进去。它的温暖让我感到窒息，让我感到被包裹。我们成为了一样的存在。我们成为了一体。

为什么我的血肉空空荡荡
一个深坑。我是一个无底洞，空虚又饥饿
我什么也不是，我是无，是虚无
既是少数，又是多数，更是全部
被拉进螺旋的核心，成为循环的食粮
今天的滋生之地
明天便成为崭新的先驱
我即是深渊，我已再度苏醒。

en: Select freely from a variety of weapons, skills and armors to choose your own path. You are not restricted by a set of predefined character classes and can craft your adventure according to your own wishes.
cn: 自由选择各式各样的武器、技能与护甲，开辟一条只属于自己的道路。无须担心被预设的角色职业所束缚，随心所欲写就你的冒险故事。

en: You gain one additional Food slot.
cn: 额外获得一个食物栏位。

en: You've reached the Drak temple that you suspect houses the legendary handpan. Search the temple and find the instrument to proceed!
cn: 你已经抵达疑似藏有传奇手碟的卓克神殿。 搜索神殿并找到乐器以继续！

en: Craft or obtain a grappling hook.
I heard whispers of a powerful wizard who lost his mind. I can tell you more about him.
cn: 我曾经听见过一个发狂的强大巫师的低语。我可以跟你多说一些那个人的事。

en: An ordinary shirt, covered partially by a more sophisticated jacket.
cn: 一件普通的衬衫，被一件更考究的外套遮住了一部分。

en: <lorename>Jezmina</lorename>'s Apotheosis was found after defeating the Vukah Brawler in the Pillars of Creation.
cn: 已在打败创世之柱的沃卡后找到了<lorename>杰兹米娜</lorename>的神斧。

en: Increases the skill level of Dagger Mastery
cn: 提高匕首精通的技能等级

en: Flameborn, come here! I have a message for you! I have reason to believe there might be hounds nearby!
cn: 火之子，快来！我有个消息要告诉你！我有理由相信，这附近说不定还有活着的猎犬！

en: A small, round Flightless Redtail baby. Even at this age, their beak can cause some damage. Don't get pecked!
cn: 一只圆滚滚的陆行红尾宝宝。不过虽然还未成年，它的喙仍然十分尖锐。小心别被啄伤！

en: The Pike Weekly, Issue 344 - Nothing Grand About Gormander! 5th week of Yearfall, 502 D.A.
cn: 《崇山城周刊》，第344期 - 戈曼德颜面扫地！岁末第5周，502 D.A.

en: You spot sunken stone pillars on the horizon, obscured by mounds of dirt. They stretch towards the sky like a titan's stone-cold fingerbones. The mark of a hidden tomb! The stairs inside lead into darkness. Torch in hand, you slip down into uncertainty. Into dread. Yet, your search drives you deeper. A morbid treasure calls for you, left to rot in the dust! Is it family jewels? Heirlooms from faraway shores? Whatever it is, my friend, it'll be the foundation of our empire! The cornerstone to a fortress raised from spilled blood! Sounds good? I know the rough location. If you take up the search, Gerith, I'll split the goods. Deal?
cn: 你在地平线上发现了被土堆遮住的沉没石柱。它们像泰坦巨人冰冷的指骨一样伸向天空。这是一座隐秘坟墓的标志！里面的楼梯通向黑暗。手持火把，你滑入不确定之中，陷入恐惧。然而，探索欲让你越陷越深，一个病态的宝藏在呼唤着你，在尘土中腐烂！是家族珠宝吗？来自遥远海岸的传家宝？ 不管是什么，我的朋友，它都将是 我们帝国的基石！ 用鲜血筑起的堡垒的基石！ 听起来不错吧？我知道大概的位置。如果你去找，我，格里斯，就把钱分给你。成交吗？

en: The host has kicked you from the session.
cn: 主机已经将你移出进程。

en: Filling up enemy Stun Bars is increased by %k when attacking blocking enemies with Melee weapons. Overpower Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered. Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.
cn: 使用近战武器攻击处于格挡状态的敌人将使目标的晕眩条提高%k。 压制 攻击格挡中的敌人或者是招架敌人的攻击都会使他们的晕眩条上涨，直到最后进入被压制状态。 被压制的敌人将毫无防备，这种时候你可以对其发动残酷打击。

en: An exquisite mystical coat made of fine, dyed material. The metal clasps alone are highly valuable.
cn: 一件精致的神秘外衣，由上等染色材料制成。光是金属搭扣就价值不菲。

en: Do you have a rhyme for "Flameborn"…?

Can you believe it? I wanted to chomp down on my roasted meat when suddenly, out of nowhere, this cat appeared and snatched my food! 

I swear, it attacked me with the viciousness of a sabertooth! I ran after it for some time, but that damn thing was way too quick. Plus, I'm not running after a cat all the way to <location>Sapphire Strand</location>! I'm not THAT hungry! 
So basically, I'm asking: Can I get another ration...?
cn:
说出来简直难以置信。当时我正准备吃烤肉，突然就有一只不知道从哪里钻出来的猫抢走了我的食物！

我发誓，那小东西凶狠极了，我还以为是来了头剑齿虎呢！等反应过来之后我立刻就追了上去，但是那家伙跑的太快了。而且我可不会为了那只猫追到<location>蓝石湾</location>去！虽然我很饿，但我还是爱惜生命的！
所以总而言之，我想问一下：能不能再给我补一份口粮……？

en: The needles of this spiked club can tenderize countless meat bags to mush.
cn: 这柄尖刺棍棒能够将无数敌人打成肉泥。

en: No Grappling Hook Pull Anchor within reach.
cn: 附近没有可用的抓钩牵引锚点。

en: The barber wants you to search a Miner's House for traces of inspiration — notes, writings, or thoughts once left by its creative residents.
cn: 理发师希望你去一处矿工之家寻找灵感的痕迹 - 任何形式的文字记录或者是当地富有创造力的居民们留下的思绪都可以。

en: Blessed by the Flame, this Enflamed Bow will be of great help in the fight against the Shroud.
cn: 这把受到灵火祝福的火焰弓能够有效对抗瘴气。

en: You've discovered Ramone's supposed place of hiding. In a note, he talks about living in his friend's hidden cellar. Search the basement below the house to find Ramone!
cn: 你已经发现了雷蒙之前躲藏的地方。你在那里找到了雷蒙的笔记，他说自己正住在一位朋友的隐藏地窖中。搜索房屋地下室并找到雷蒙！

en: Start a public game, saved locally
cn: 开始本地保存的公共游戏

en:
One of the worlds you shared has been removed from Adventure Sharing because it was found to violate our Terms of Use.
You can share your world again after making the necessary adjustments to comply with the Terms of Use. Please note that repeated violations may result in a revocation of your ability to share worlds via Adventure Sharing.
cn:
你分享的其中一个世界已被移出冒险分享，原因：世界违反使用条款。
如果想要重新分享世界，请进行必需调整并确保其符合使用条款规定。请注意，重复违反规定有可能导致你被剥夺通过冒险分享共享世界的权利。

en: Here, you can see howling wolves, and the ties that bind them to the moon above — all depicted in allegory through simple design choices.
cn: 你可以在这把武器中感受到咆哮的狼群，以及将它们与头顶的月亮联系在一起的纽带……质朴的设计已经通过比喻描绘了一切。

en: Mh? An ambush? But I hid my tracks! How could the soldiers...? Ah, spiders, you say? ...Ignore me, then. Place that Hand Spindle, and we'll move on. Hush now whilst we craft. My secrets are mine to keep.
cn: 什么？埋伏？但我隐藏了行踪！士兵们怎么会......？啊，你说蜘蛛？ ......那就别理我。 把那个 纺线锤放好，然后我们继续前进。请在制作时保持安静。我需要保护我的秘密。

en: The Shroud Root inside the Elixir Well will spread uncontrollably and harm Embervale. You have to put a stop to this. Destroy the Shroud Root with a Felling Axe! It is recommended to equip sufficient gear, such as fur armor, for example. Eat food and rest in your base to acquire buffs before heading out.
cn: 魔药之井内部的瘴气根将会不受控制地扩散并伤害薪谷。你需要阻止那种事发生。 使用伐木斧摧毁瘴气根！ 安全起见建议提前准备好合适的装备，例如毛皮护甲。出发前记得在基地中进食并休息以获得有用的增益。

en: I... I n-need a gem... that rivals the moon's beauty... I d-don't know why... it calls to me. Please... help. Please show it to me... Thank you, master.
cn: 我……我需、需要一枚宝石……能够媲美月亮的美丽……我不、不知道为什么……它在呼唤我。求求你……帮帮我。请把它带给我……谢谢你，主人。

en: The Barber still can't remember how to concoct blue hair dye, but something was roused within his memory. He remembers a "keep" he often passed through when gathering ingredients, and showed you the location. Visit the keep and find the ingredients to trigger the Barber's memory! You can also gather the ingredients elsewhere in the Revelwood and return them to the Barber while having them in your inventory.
cn: 理发师还是无法想起蓝色染发剂的配方，但他还是想起了一件事。他想起了以前在采集原料时经常会路过的一座“要塞”，并且将那里的具体位置告诉了你。 拜访要要塞并找到原料以唤醒理发师的记忆！ 你也可以在其他地方收集原料，回去找理发师时记得确保原料就在物品栏中。

en: A hefty two-handed axe, usually wielded by champions of the ring! Axes like these are often a status symbol and represent triumph.
cn: 沉甸甸的双手斧，通常属于竞技场中的冠军！类似这样的斧子往往是地位与胜利的象征。
失踪人员：罗尔夫·曼塔科

en: Flameborn, come talk to me — I'm in need of inspiration once more, and only you can help!
cn: 火之子，来跟我聊聊吧——我再一次亟需灵感，只有你可以帮助我！

en: On the first day, the great Lord Vorgoth set his sights on the Albaneve Summits. He said, "Such peaks befit the greatness of our nation. Such valleys will bear the fruits of our Elixir Wells." On the second day, the Lord marched toward the horizon, carving a path through the treacherous beauty of the wild mountains for his kin. On the third day, shadows awaited him at Howling Peak. The dragons had awoken to keep our King from making his rightful claim! Lord Vorgoth raised his hand against the winged beasts and roared, "You're no match for the red eagle, and you shall die to our valor and steel!" On the fourth day, he split the skull of the mother dragon, leaving his axe between her eyes as she fell from the skies. Thus, the summits were liberated from evil, and the kingdom rejoiced.
cn: 第一天，伟大的沃格斯领主看见了阿尔班耶夫山脉。 于是他便说道，“这些高山将让我们的国家变得更为伟大。这些峡谷将为我们的魔药之井带来丰饶收获。” 第二天，沃格斯领主便大步流星走向了地平线的尽头，就这样，在危机四伏却又美不胜收的蛮荒群山中，他为自己的同胞们开辟出了一条新的道路。 第三天，无数阴影在呼啸崇山虎视眈眈。苏醒的巨龙们意图阻挠我们的国王拿走自己应有的领土！ 只见沃格斯指向那些长着翅膀的恶兽并大声怒吼，“你们不是红鹰的对手，你们将死在我们的勇气与钢铁之下！” 第四天，沃格斯领主劈开了龙母的头颅，他的神斧卡在了巨兽的双眼之间，于是巨龙之母便从高空坠落。就这样，原本肆虐山巅的邪恶不复存在，整个王国的子民都欢呼雀跃。

en:
Lately, Maynard has made a habit of bathing during his break. 

I don't mind so much — I prefer him smelling of rosewater and candlewax to his usual grime and gruff. But he takes HOURS in there, leaving me alone to herd the poor sods in the cells! 

He thinks he's such a sly fox, too — as if I don't see the book he hides under his towel whenever he sets off. I don't care what smut he reads, but can't he hurry with it?
cn:
最近，梅纳德突然养成了在休息时洗澡的习惯。

我倒是不介意——比起平常那种满身油污的臭味，我宁愿他散发着玫瑰水和石蜡的香味。但问题是他在浴室里一待就是好几个小时，这种时候我只能一个人去照料地窖里的那些可怜虫！

他还以为自己隐藏得很好，他以为我看不见他每次藏在毛巾底下的那些书。我不介意他喜欢看那些下流的东西，但能不能速战速决？

en: You've found the buried tomb home to an eternal spell. Enter the tomb and find the spell to make its power yours!
cn: 你找到了存放着永恒法术的墓穴。进入墓穴，找到并将法术的力量为你所用！

en: Blocking feels effortless in these gloves, and the crystals catch the sun with every move.
cn: 戴上这些手套，格挡对你来说就是家常便饭，而且上面的水晶将使你无时无刻映射着太阳的光辉。

en: You can either keep or lose all items from your backpack when dying. In the default setting, you only lose materials. Lost items are stored in a tombstone and can be recovered there.
cn: 死亡时掉落或者是保留背包中的所有物品。在默认设置下，你在死亡时仅会损失材料。死亡损失的物品都被保存在一个墓碑中，并且之后可以取回。

en: A special crafting station that allows its devious users to create otherworldly ingredients.
cn: 这种特殊的制作站能够允许狡猾的使用者创造不同寻常的材料。

en:
The Fisher told you an unlikely story of how he once grew fins to swim faster. While he's probably exaggerating greatly, there might be a hint of truth in his story.

His tale took place near Goldrock Saddle. Head there to proceed!
cn:
渔夫跟你讲述了一个他是如何通过长出鱼鳍来游得更快的离奇故事。虽然很明显他是在夸大其词，但他的故事中也许仍然有一部分真相。

他的故事就发生在金石鞍附近。前往此地以继续！

en: There's contraband stashed somewhere in Surat's Rest. Find the spot and retrieve the loot!
cn: 苏拉特之息中藏有违禁品。找到确切地点并取回战利品！

en:
Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter — of sanity and sanctum.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
在里面，你可以看到虚无。没有物质 — 没有理智和圣洁。

收集多个瘴气魔怪物头颅来制作战利品。

en: Defeat The Specter In The Haunted Sun Temple
cn: 击败闹鬼太阳神殿中的幽灵

en: These spiked boots can cause a lot of damage when used to pierce arteries in one, swift swinging kick.
cn: 这些尖刺靴能够造成大量伤害，每一次的迅猛踢击都能够撕裂对手的动脉。

en:
Softspoken, sandy browns, and bright ash colors give this palette a dusty, but distinguished look.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
cn:
柔和的浅褐色与明亮的灰色为这种调色板赋予了一种风尘仆仆的独特观感。

可以使用喧嚣森林材料制作这种调色板。

en: A safe possibility to expose things to heat without burning them.
cn: 允许你在可控的温度范围内安全加热物体。

en: This survivor will be a worthy addition to our cause. Place them into the world with a Summoning Staff, which you can craft from simple Twigs.
cn: 这位幸存者将帮助我们达成使命。使用召唤法杖将其安置在选定的位置，你可以使用简单的树枝制作此物品。

en:
You've found a note that reveals Queen Jezmina traveled through the Veilwater Basin.

Follow her steps on this journey and uncover all her camps! Some of her leftover supplies can still aid you.
cn:
你找到的纸条中提到杰兹米娜女王曾经穿过了幕水盆地。

跟随她在这段旅程中的足迹并找到她的所有营地！她留下的一部分补给仍然能够帮助你。

en: Oh my! That sweet scent... You carry some berries with you! Oh, I would die for a gorgeous berry bowl right about now... say, could you perhaps get me some strawberries, at least? It would brighten my day! I'd even share a little secret with you!
cn: 我的天！那股香甜的味道……你身上带着浆果！唉，真想要吃一盆鲜嫩可口的浆果……能不能拜托你帮我摘一些草莓！那样子的话我会很开心的！我甚至会与你分享一个小秘密！

en: A merchant's hat that will draw attention in the market square when paired with A LOUD ENOUGH VOICE and good deals!
cn: 搭配上一个大嗓门和优惠的价格，这顶商人帽子绝对能够在集市中招引络绎不绝的客人！

en: I can't believe it! I have created a healing spell — finally! But... it heals others?! Can you believe it? What am I supposed to do with this? What good is it to me if others live longer? .. but at least I am on the right track. The next tomb awaits. I've heard stories of young folk daring to race through it, braving its challenges. Whoever makes it to the other side… well, they live. Its supposed to be close to the Mining Rift towards the Blackmire.
cn: 难以置信！我总算是创造出了一种治疗法术！但是……它只能治疗其他人？！这是某种玩笑嘛？我要这种法术有何用？别人能否活得更久跟我有什么关系？……无论如何，至少这说明我的方向没错。下一处墓穴在等待着我。我听说有不少年轻人曾勇敢面对那个地方的挑战并比赛穿过那里。无论最后是谁坚持到了最后……那些人肯定是活下来了。据说那个墓穴就在靠近黑沼的采矿裂隙附近。

en:
You've found the soul of Melville Fontane, a retired captain turned innkeeper and fisher. 

Summon him to learn more about the Veilwater Basin!
cn:
你已经找到了梅尔维·冯塔内的灵魂，这是退休的船长还是一位酒馆老板兼渔夫。

召唤他以了解更多幕水盆地的事！

en: These fingerless gloves allow the wearer to feel each leaf and root before picking, allowing a proper assessment.
cn: 露指设计让佩戴者可以触碰每一片叶子，感受根茎纹理，精准判断药草品质。

en: Emily Fray says she lost her mother's ring somewhere in the Kindlewastes. Help her find it by searching the area marked on the map.
cn: 艾米丽·弗莱说她把母亲留给自己的戒指掉在了燃火荒原中。帮助她找到戒指，搜索地图上的标记区域。

en: The cold seeps through my very being. Every fiber, every aspect of my soul is covered in morning dew. Please, create shelter for your new friend, flamebearer. Consider it.
cn: 我感到寒冷无处不在。我的身体乃至是灵魂都已经彻底被清晨的寒露浸湿。请为你的新朋友搭建一处庇护所，持有火焰之人，拜托了。

en:
A timid little fellow with spotted fur. It was found in an empty Kindlewastes home. 

The woman that lived in the house before had many dogs, and her favorite was called "Pompom". Maybe this dog is one of its descendants!
cn:
长着一身斑点毛皮的胆小鬼。你在燃火荒原里的一栋废弃住宅中找到了它。

以前住在那里的女人养了很多狗，她最喜欢的一条叫“绒球”。也许这条狗就是绒球的后代！

en: Marked through hundreds of hours of enduring the force of fire, this wand has a connection to the element and is able to utilize it. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 在火焰中经历了无尽试炼之后，这根魔棒已经与之缔结纽带并且能够发挥火焰之力。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: Researchers left Vukah relics at a Flame Sanctum in the Nomad Highlands. Search the location and retrieve the Vukah relics!
cn: 研究者在游牧高地的一处灵火神殿中留下了沃卡遗物。搜索那里并取回沃卡遗物！

en: Increases the skill level of Sniper
cn: 提高狙击手的技能等级

en: A tiny Capybara. It enjoys headpats, chewing on daylilies, soaking in hot springs, and being held tightly in your warm arms.
cn: 一只小小的水豚。它喜欢被人摸摸头，啃日光百合、在温泉里泡澡，以及被你温暖的双臂紧紧抱住。

en: An expensive-looking, resource-intensive block of silver. Impress your friends with all your wealth through this shiny, metallic block!
cn: 耗费大量资源制作而成的昂贵银方块。使用这种闪亮的金属方块向朋友们炫耀你的财富！

en:
I've got something new for you, boss.
One of the new slaves, that Oscar guy — I think he's planning an escape from the quarry! I saw him slip a piece of marble into his shoe a few days back to smuggle it past your guards. I thought he just wanted to trade it in, you know, for some herbal tea or a clean shave. But I awoke last night to the sound of stone banging against metal shackles. He's trying to rid himself of your chains!

That's all I can tell you. Surely, it's worth a reward, right? Please, will you let me go now? Haven't I done enough for you?
cn:
有件事要告诉你，老大
新来的奴隶里面有个叫奥斯卡的，我觉得这家伙有可能想从采石场逃跑！前几天我看见他偷偷摸摸往鞋子里塞了一块大理石，还骗过了你安排在那里的守卫。我原本以为他只是想拿石头去换草药茶或者是拿来当刮胡子的剃刀。但是昨晚半夜我被一阵石头敲击金属镣铐的声音给吵醒了。这家伙是想要弄断你装的锁链！

我要说的都说完了。这应该能换点奖励吧？也许你愿意大发慈悲放我走？拜托了，我为你做的事情已经够多了吧？

en: Are you sure you want to delete this photo?
My old friend, share your fire with the needy, will you?
cn: 我的老朋友，请与有需要之人分享你的火焰，好吗？

en: Obtain The Castle Wall Stone Blocks
cn: 获取城堡墙壁石头方块

en: To pierce the heart with a magical arrow... I don't need to see it up close again, but I do want to hear more about it!
cn: 如果用魔法箭矢穿透敌人的心脏……我不想再看见它，但是我很想了解这件宝贝的故事！

en: Go to the settings to adjust which item rarity needs a confirmation to delete or salvage.
cn: 进入设置，调整需要确认才能删除或挽救的物品稀有度。

en: Looks like we've struck a chord!

A happy and carefree dog that likes to sleep in. It loves belly rubs and madly dashing in your general direction every time it sees you. 

You found this dog in a tower ruled by Hollow hounds, and a Hollow Warlock. The Warlock seemingly tried to create a vessel for a companion named "Ikko". You interrupted their ritual — but the name stuck.
cn:
一条活泼而且无忧无虑的狗，它最喜欢的就是睡懒觉。它很爱被人摸肚皮，而且每次看见你的时候都会激动地雀跃不已。

之前你在一座由空荡猎犬以及一名空荡邪术师统治的高塔中找到了这条狗。邪术师当时似乎是在尝试为一个名叫“伊科”的同伴创造一个灵魂容器。你设法制止了邪术师的仪式，但是这个名字却留了下来。

en: The Carpenter is interested in how the Elixir Wells were built. He suggested exploring an Elixir Well in the Kindlewastes. Perhaps some useful building material can be found there.
cn: 木匠想知道魔药之井的建造方法。他建议前去探索燃火荒原中的魔药之井。也许那里能够找到一些有用的建造材料。

en: A simple but reliable helmet. You might still get a bump or two if you get hit, but that's part of the fun.
cn: 一款简单而可靠的头盔。在受到伤害时，你可能还会有一两处磕伤，但这也是乐趣的一部分。

en: The cells don't just contaminate. They absorb. By breaking down natural matter, they create a cycle for energy and growth! I must understand it... Experiment more with the Shroud Spores and comprehend their ways. It's tiresome, sure, but I'd rather be in my laboratory than with the villagers... they drain my energy. The fluid in the Black Cauldron spins and spins — it forms a vortex that draws me in... The spores dissolve anything I add, slowly eating away at flesh and bone. Changing them, as if the liquid were lapping up genetic strands to twist them anew. Once, I gazed into it too long as it spun... and I thought I felt it glare back. Perhaps I've grown batty with age. Or lonely. — Ikora
cn: 那些细胞并不是单纯地在散播感染。它们是在吸收。它们能够分解天然物质，然后借此不断创造能量并增值！我必须弄明白这背后的原理……我必须用瘴气孢子进行更多实验并弄清楚它们的运作方式。说实话这并不是一份轻松的工作，但是我宁愿留在实验室也不想去应付那些村民……那些人只会浪费我的精力。 黑色坩埚里的液体不停旋转……并形成了一个不可思议的漩涡……无论往里面倒入了什么物质，那些孢子都能够将其分解，它们慢条斯理地啃食着血肉与骨骼，并且转化着一切，那些液体仿佛能够将基因束重叠扭曲成全新的存在。 有一次，我不知道盯着里面的旋涡看了多久……我突然感觉它也瞪了我一眼。也许是我上了年纪喜欢胡思乱想吧，或者是因为一个人待太久了。 — 依科拉

en: An advanced torch that provides light for a longer period. Use this to explore deeper into the abyss!
cn: 能够提供持久照明的高级火把。高举火把勇闯深渊！

en: My Flame-touched friend, anger brews within me. It needs soothing... it needs spilled blood and the white of bone.
cn: 被灵火触碰的朋友啊，我心中的怒火再一次被点燃了。那份怒火渴望被安抚……它渴望着挥洒的鲜血与惨白的骨头。

en: Clear the Kindlewastes of all shroud roots.
cn: 清除燃火荒原中的所有瘴气根。

en: Perform defensive actions to prevent or reduce incoming damage. Most of them cost stamina, so keep an eye on your stamina ring. Perform a Dodge Roll by pressing %k to evade enemy attacks. While equipped with a shield, block attacks with %k. A well-timed block will parry the enemy's attack. A parry requires no stamina, interrupts the enemy's attack, and fills their stun bar. Once full, the enemy becomes overpowered and is stunned temporarily.
cn: 采取防御操作可以防止或减少受到伤害。其中大部分操作都需要消耗体力，因此请留意您的 体力条。 按%k键进行 翻滚来闪避敌人的攻击。 装备盾牌时，使用%k键格挡攻击。时机恰当的格挡可以招架敌人的攻击。招架不需要体力，可以打断敌人的攻击，还能增加敌人的晕眩条。 晕眩条填满后，敌人就会被压制，并暂时眩晕。
杂草已经算不上问题了！

en: Increases Health by %k per Attribute Point.
cn: 每点属性点增加%k点生命。

en: Ever since we started building this Elixir Well, the ground has been prone to shaking violently. The snow is gray. Echoes whisper words that were never spoken out loud. We can hear something inside the mountain. I think we're corrupting something we don't even understand yet. Whatever it is, I don't want to be around when it wakes... I just hope the outposts finish their ballistae.
cn: 自从我们开始建造这座魔药之井，周围的地方就一直在剧烈颤动。 这里的血都是灰色的。回声低语着我们不敢大声说出的词语。有时候我们能够听见山中传来的怪声。 我觉得我们正在腐化我们不理解的存在。无论那是什么东西，我只希望它苏醒的时候我已经逃之夭夭……希望哨所能够及时完成弩炮的建造。

en: The items stored here can be used for crafting purposes from anywhere in the base!
cn: 你将可以在基地任意位置使用存放在这里面的物品进行制造！

en: This Mining Sieve will let you mine ore underwater! What do you want to use it for? Armor? A sword? A crown? Give me the word and I'll make it for you!
cn: 这个矿筛将允许开采水下的矿石！你想要用那些材料做什么？护甲？武器？王冠？只要你一句话，我统统都可以做！

en: You can be revived by another player.
A rose-colored piece of fresh mushroom meat. It has various applications.
cn: 玫瑰色的新鲜蘑菇肉。有着各式各样的用途。

en: Recommended bindings are missing. Without those, the game experience may be negativly impacted.
cn: 缺少推荐键位。这将对游戏体验造成负面体验。

en: Craft All Pieces Of The Explorer Outfit
cn: 制作探险家套装的所有部件

en: Stone of the dungeon prisons. It has become yellow over time due to the gasses extruded by the rotting bodies of its residents.
cn: 地牢监狱所用的石头。因为长年累年受到囚犯们腐烂尸体所产生的气体侵蚀而逐渐变成了黄色。

en:
Thank you for playing the Enshrouded demo! 
You have reached the end of the quest progression available for the demo. 
You can continue playing until the timer runs out, or until we remove the demo on the 22nd of October.
If you liked what you've seen so far, add Enshrouded to your wishlist to be kept up to date about the Early Access release and other news!
cn:
感谢您体验《雾锁王国》试玩版！ 
您已到达试玩版任务进程的终点。
您可以继续游戏，直到计时器计时结束。我们将于10月22日删除试玩版。
如果您喜欢目前所看到的内容，请将《雾锁王国》添加到您的愿望清单，以便随时了解有关《雾锁王国》抢先体验版本的最新信息和其他新闻！

en: When falling from great heights, you can perform a special melee attack with %k. A successful hit will do double damage and reduce fall damage by 50%
cn: 从高处落下时，你可以按%k发动一次特殊的近战攻击。成功命中将造成双倍伤害并且使自身承受的坠落伤害减少50%

en: So you've met the "Drak". They plagued these lands ages ago before we drove them off our shores and back into the blue, where they belong... But they're vengeful beasts, so when they smelled our blood, fear, and rot, they returned. Worst thing about it? I get it. If someone had disgraced my tribe, I'd avenge them, too. To beat them, we have to get under their skin... and spill the same blood as them!
cn: 所以你已经见过“卓克”了。在我们将它们驱离我们的海岸，迫使它们逃回头顶的蓝天之前，它们曾在许久之前肆虐这片大地……但这些家伙都是复仇心切的野兽，当它们闻到我们的鲜血、恐惧与腐烂后，它们便卷土重来。最糟糕的事？我理解它们这么做的原因。如果有人让我的部落蒙羞，我肯定也会想要复仇。为了打败这些家伙，我们必须理解它们的想法……并和它们挥洒相同的鲜血！
沙漠瓦片屋顶搜索区域

en: What a difference a roof makes.
You've reached the passage leading to the nearby Veilwater Basin. Proceed through the passage and reach the other side to gain a glimpse of the new, glistening blue horizons beyond!
cn: 你已经抵达通往附近幕水盆地的通道。 穿过通道并抵达另一侧即可领略全新的蔚蓝天空！

en: Used by a smith to melt and alloy metals.
cn: 供铁匠用来熔炼金属与合金。

en: This is a very sophisticated bow with high tension.
cn: 这是一种非常复杂的弓，张力很高。

en: Fleshy and tough. Better not eat it like this.
cn: 鲜血淋漓而且肉质过于坚韧。最好先烹饪再食用。

en: All my life, the sea has been by my side. Her face glistened during the day, decorated by twirling specs of light, gently brushed by the sun. My troubles would fade at the sight. Even as she rose and billowed over the edge... She swept away all old troubles and pains. Now, the light in my eyes fades. I hear the waves echo in my ear, like whispers of a conch shell. They grow closer. I've hid all I've left below for her to take. My parting gift to an old friend.
cn: 这辈子我一直是傍海而生。 每当白天来临，大海便在阳光的温柔照耀下变得波光粼粼，海面之上就像是一场华美的灯光表演。每次一看到那景象，所有的烦恼便都烟消云散。哪怕遇到涨潮扑打海岸……她也能带走一切过去的困扰与痛苦。我知道自己的时间不多了。我听见耳旁又传来了波浪的回声，就像是海螺中的低语。那些声音愈发响亮。 我把自己的全部都留在了底下，这将是我给那位老朋友的临别馈赠。

en: The past, present, and future all unfold in front of your eyes like blooming aureolins when observed through this helmet.
cn: 戴上这顶头盔，过去、现在和未来就像绽放的金花，在你眼前徐徐展开。

en: You found the Wailing Blade! It's branded by the capital's master blacksmith. Speak to Oswald Anders to find out more.
cn: 你找到了恸哭之刃！上面带着首都的铁匠大师的印记。与奥斯瓦尔德·安德斯交谈以了解更多。

en: A Wooden Arrow made of the most basic ingredients.
cn: 一枚使用最简单的材料制作的木箭。

en:
You've found two pieces of the statue, but the rest was thrown into the nearby waters. Reach the farthest corners of the harbor to retrieve the final piece of the Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename> statue.

Go there and retrieve it from its watery tomb!
cn:
你已经找到了两块雕像碎片，但是其他的碎片都已经被丢入了附近的水域。抵达港口最远端以取回<lorename>派克米德</lorename>女王雕像的最后一块碎片。

前往标记位置并从水中取回雕像碎片！

en: Build A Sheltered Bed For The <npc>Collector</npc>
cn: 为<npc>收藏家</npc>建造一张受到庇护的床

en: This steel pickaxe has been further refined through the addition of gold ornaments.
cn: 额外的黄金点缀使得这把钢镐拥有了更加优雅的气质。

en:
You've learned that the owner of the attic attempted to cross the threshold between life and death to reunite someone with a dead loved one. The "Ritual of Reunion" that was conducted seems to be the invention of "Lady Leclair" of <location>Glennwood's End</location>. 

Search for Lady Leclair's home in <location>Glennwood's End</location> and investigate it!
cn:
你了解到阁楼的主人曾试图打破生与死的界限并使某人与早已死去的爱人团聚。他们当时似乎是使用了<location>格伦伍德之末</location>的“雷克莱尔夫人”创造的“团聚仪式”。

寻找并调查雷克莱尔夫人在<location>格伦伍德之末</location>的住宅！

en: My kind are simple folk. All we need is some food and a warm, sheltered bed! If you have a spare one, I'd gladly take it. Pick one and assign it to me with your Summoning Staff!
cn: 我们都是普通人。我们只想要一些食物和一张温暖的、受到庇护的床！如果你这边有多余的床铺就再好不过了。挑选一张床，然后使用你的召唤法杖将它分配给我！

en: When enabled, other players are allowed to download the world as a savegame and use it to play.
cn: 开启此选项后，其他玩家将能够将世界下载为存档并游玩。

en: Adjust the quality of the Shroud. Reducing the quality will increase performance.
cn: 调整瘴气的质量。降低质量可提高性能。

en: The door to the Alchemist's underground laboratory seems to be locked, but his Mortar should be inside. There must be some sort of hidden mechanism to open it somewhere in the tower.
cn: 通往炼金术士的地下实验室的大门似乎被锁上了，他的磨臼应该就在里面。高塔中一定能够找到开门的隐藏机关。

en: The Flame calls you to seek the awakening chamber which hides a powerful artifact within. This will be your final voyage for now, but you're still free to play the demo afterward if you so desire.
cn: 灵火呼唤你去寻找一个余烬密室，里面藏着一件强大的法器。这将是你目前的最后一次旅行，但如果你愿意，也可以继续体验试玩版。

en: The exposed wooden beams create a beautiful contrast to the rough surface, creating a feeling of warmth.
cn: 暴露在外的木梁与粗糙的表面形成了富有美感的对比，并且营造出了温暖的氛围。

en: Instantly restores a medium amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.
cn: 立即恢复适量生命值并提供10秒的持续治疗效果。

en: Grave digging has its perks. Under the family tree in Lone Thistle, a cursed family heirloom was found. A strange energy radiates through it.
cn: 没想到做盗墓贼也能有所收获。就在孤蓟镇的家族之树脚下，一个被诅咒的传家宝出土了。奇怪的能量在剑身奔涌着。

en:
Climb upon the highest mountain and peer over the snow-blessed rim. Gaze into the swirling white, into the spiraling void. Just across the horizon, illuminated by the rising sun's light, is our land — and our gate to the stars, now barred.

Hear this: We aim to ascend, to rise, to flee — to leave the rotting lands below, corrupted by the spreading roots and blossoms of a familiar seed.
We yearn to return to the celestial light and purity of our cosmic blood.

Anything — or anyone — untamed, impure, or foolish must remain, even our youngest flames. Our doors are locked to you.
Do not pry them open.
cn:
攀爬最高的山峰并俯瞰白雪皑皑的边界。凝视覆盖万物的白色，凝视旋转不息的虚空。在地平线之外，崛起的太阳照亮了我们的大地 — 但我们通往星辰的大门已经紧闭不开。

听好：我们的目标是飞升，是崛起，是逃离 — 离开脚下的这片腐化大地，一枚熟悉的种子不断扩散的根须与花朵正在腐化一切。
我们渴望回归到星辰的光芒与宇宙血脉的纯洁之中。

一切桀骜不驯、不纯洁或愚昧之物与人都必须留下来，哪怕是我们最年幼的火苗。我们的大门将永远向你们关闭。
不要试图撬开那些大门。

en: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is surprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.
cn: 草药师的头饰。当你看不到人时，治疗会变得异常困难。

en: A gigantic hammer that can only be wielded with both hands. The head was forged from one solid block of steel, requiring advanced crafting techniques.
cn: 必须要用双手举起的巨型大锤。锤头使用整块钢铁锻造而成，只有娴熟的工匠才能创造出这样的精品。
青铜瘴气魔独眼巨人战利品

en:
Ancients. Yes. From Ark Morgo, they descend. Sent as messengers from gods. Vesztah! Merphisz! Fyraszh! Arisztar! Dalszul! To choose new gods, yes. The strongest among us!

But fools! Fools!
They choose humans! Weak Skulls, break easily! Squishy bellies, soft and flabby! Tiny fire-makers. Pah! Fire is weak. 
We stomp out spark, we swallow flame, we bring rise with storm of violet blood! 

But humans tricked us. Beat us in battle — with machines and devilry! Not fair! 

We bathed in shame and shadow for too long! Human flame is weak now! Should not burn near Ark Morgo! Their bodies are rotting. Bones soft, flesh spoiled — Time comes. Drak rise. Drak'Dal take chance in pitiful basin. Throne waits. Ark Morgo ours again!
cn:
远古者。没错。他们从魔戈方舟而来，他们是诸神的信使。维兹塔阿！梅菲兹！菲拉兹！阿里斯塔尔！达尔斯祖尔！为了挑选出新神，没错。我们之中最强大之人！

但是愚蠢！一群蠢货！
他们竟然选择了人类！那些软弱的头骨轻而易举就会断裂！还有那些软弱无力的腹部！微不足道的造火者。呸！火焰软弱。
我们会践踏火星，我们吞噬火焰，我们将随紫色鲜血的风暴一同崛起！

但是人类骗了我们。他们打败了我们——用机器和诡计！不公平！

我们已经在羞辱与阴影中沉沦太久！现在人类的火焰已经变弱！它们无法在魔戈方舟附近燃烧！他们的身体正在腐烂。骨头软化，血肉腐败——我们的时机已经到来。卓克崛起。卓克·达尔将在可悲的盆地中挑战命运。王座在等待。魔戈方舟将再次属于我们！

en: A reconstructed map, consisting of 4 former map pieces. It depicts a lake with an island, a river, an obelisk, and parts of a large skeleton. The full writing on the back now reads: Mae's Memoir: The first day of yearwake is unlike the rest The peaks lay quiet, licking yearfall's wounds As the sunlight sets in the faraway west On fields where sleeping buds awoke to blooms Ony's' Memoir: I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain Polaris' Memoir: I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky To find your path, you must look to me only Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely
cn: 由4块碎片重新拼凑而成的完整地图。上面描绘着一处湖泊、一座岛屿、一条河流、一座方尖碑还有某种大型骸骨的部位。藏宝图背面还有一段完整的文字： 梅依的回忆录： 岁初的第一天与众不同 沉默的山巅舔舐着岁末的伤口 当日光落在最遥远的西方 就在沉睡的花苞终于怒放的田野 奥尼的回忆录： 在高空飞翔的我永远不会坠落 在太阳上翩翩起舞，我的身体就是熊熊烈焰 我的杯中永远满溢，我将痛饮直至淹没 在光芒之水与爱恋之中，直到那一切让我眩晕 俄耳甫斯的回忆录： 生为旅人，我寻觅着炽热与极乐 现在我冰冻于时间之中，我的身体被锁链束缚 习惯了暗影之海与底层的深渊 这明亮之地刺痛了我的双眼，愿所有光芒消逝 北极星的回忆录： 我是高悬在天空的闪亮星星 为了找到前进的道路，你的眼中只能容得下我 低头俯瞰世界，难以否认 无依无靠，我的心中只有孤寂

en: You've crafted or obtained a Construction Hammer. The Construction Hammer can be used to build structures with Building Blocks around your Flame Altar. Place the Construction Hammer in your Action Bar and select it. Enter Building Mode and select the desired "Blueprint" and Building Block. "Roof" structures require roof material blocks. Use the Construction Hammer to build something around your Flame Altar!
cn: 你已经制作或获取一把建筑锤。 拥有建筑锤之后，你就可以在灵火祭坛周围使用建筑方块打造建筑。 将建筑锤放入你的动作栏然后选择它。首先进入建造模式，然后选择想要使用的“蓝图”以及建筑方块。 “屋顶”结构需要专门的屋顶材料方块。 使用建筑锤在灵火祭坛周围进行建造！

en: I was out huntin' when I saw a pretty bluejay up in the sky. Been a while since I had some chicken stew, so I readied my bow, and — wham! What a shot! The bird tumbled downwards, flailing and chirping. When I went to retrieve my prey, I saw its claws were grasping something strange... So I pried 'em open. I found this scrap, nay, this letter! Unbelievable, isn't it?
cn: 在外面狩猎的时候，我在天上看见了一只很漂亮的蓝松鸦。正好我已经有段时间没尝过炖鸡了，所以我便拉弓瞄准……咻！ 正中靶心！飞鸟直接叽喳着从天空中顺势落下。 但是当我准备取走猎物的时候，我注意到它的爪子里捏着一样奇怪的东西……掰开一看，原来是一片碎纸，不，应该说是一封信！太不可思议了，是不是？

en: An eternal spell which distributes great healing that jumps to nearby friends. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 这个永恒法术能让巨大的治疗效果在附近盟友身上跳跃。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: Firing or aiming your Bow while airborne slows down your fall briefly. Every shot lifts you slightly, granting more airtime. Cost: 10 Stamina per second
cn: 在空中瞄准或是射箭都会暂时延缓你的下降速度。每次射击都将会使你略微升起，延长你的滞空时间。 消耗：每秒10点体力

en:
A note revealed the weapons trade went sour when the buyer stormed off with the goods. They went in the direction of a town called <location>Glennwood's End</location>.

Go to <location>Glennwood's End</location> and retrieve the stolen goods from there!
cn:
根据你找到的字条，强盗们的武器交易中途发生了变故，买家带着商品逃走了。此人最后逃向了一个叫做<location>格伦伍德之末</location>的镇子。

前往<location>格伦伍德之末</location>并取回失窃的货物！

en: Dearest Jezmina, Everything was perfect last night. I'm beyond excited to know that you enjoyed my cooking! And since you requested the recipe, I figured I would leave it here before tending to the caravan's many hungry mouths... THE QUEEN'S GLAZED & GRILLED YUCCA 1 Yucca Salt Oil Honey Trim off the ends. Cut them into pieces about the size of a thumb. Boil in salted water. Reuse the same pot, but remove all the water. Add a bit of oil. Fry until they are a medium golden brown. Add honey for glazing and sprinkle with a pinch of salt before serving. (The salt reduces the bitterness and enhances the sweetness of the honey!) Ta-da! Perfectly grilled yucca! The trick is to serve them hot... and with love!
cn: 致最亲爱的杰兹米娜， 昨晚实在是美妙至极。知道你喜欢我的厨艺，我实在是高兴得都快说不出话了！然后考虑到你对配方很感兴趣，我决定把它留在这里，接下来我还得去喂饱车队中那些饥饿的人们…… 女王的糖烤丝兰果 1份丝兰果 盐 油 蜂蜜 切掉丝兰果的两头，接着切成拇指大小的小块。之后放入盐水中煮熟。 将锅中水滤干，接着加入少许油。翻炒直到丝兰果变成半熟的金褐色。加入蜂蜜挂糖浆，最后上菜前撒一撮盐。（盐能够中和苦味并彰显蜂蜜的甜美！） 哒哒！一盘完美的烤丝兰果就好了！ 这道菜的秘诀在于趁热吃……而且烧的时候一定要加入满满的爱！

en: Wow, you're so talented! I wouldn't dare get too close to those claws! I think we need a grill to make delicious, crispy crab cakes. You're good with weapons and tools. I can show you how to make a grill easily! I have a vision for a beautiful, fish-themed one. I'll show you my vision, and you can bring it to life. Deal?
cn: 哇哦，你真的太有天赋了！换做是我根本不敢靠近那些吓人的鳌钳！我觉得我们需要一个烤架来制作美味香脆的蟹肉饼。我知道你在武器和工具方面都很得心应手。我可以教你如何制作烤架！我已经构思好了一个美丽的鱼类主题烤架。我负责出创意，你负责制造烤架。成交？

en: Feel the rhythm of life and the heat of battle with this energizing melody. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 在激昂的乐曲声中感受生命的节奏与战斗的灼热。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en:
Usually, Willow Crush is quiet when I slip out of my bedroom window. The town is in deep slumber as I descend the vines on the south wall, carefully avoiding the window to my parents' chambers.

Sneaking around has become second nature to me. Today, that came in handy.

Between the tree branches, I caught a glimpse of two shapes illuminated by the pale light of the waning moon. 
The smaller figure pulled an item from their waistcoat, wrapped in cloth to shield it from spying eyes. As the larger silhouette peeked under the covers, a metallic reflection danced across its face. The tall figure nodded and pulled out a small sack.

Something went awry. The smaller shade threw the sack to the ground to reveal dozens of glistening coins, clamoring — but their voice was silenced when the tall one picked them up by the throat.

The large figure left towards Glennwood's End, but I won't follow. Let sleeping dogs lie, I say...
cn:
平常从卧室窗户溜出去的时候，<location>碎柳镇</location>都是静悄悄的。顺着南侧墙壁的藤蔓爬下去的时候，整座城镇的人们都还在酣睡之中，我小心翼翼地避开了父母房间的窗户。

我现在已经很擅长悄无声息地行动。今天这个能力终于派上用处了。

在树枝的缝隙之间，我看见了被残月的光芒照亮的两个身影。
其中的小个子从背心里掏出了一样东西，也许是为了避免被人发现，那东西被一层布料紧紧地裹了起来。当另外的那个大个子揭开布料的时候，我看见它的脸上多了一道金属才有的泛光。大个子点了点头，然后便掏出了一个小袋子。

这时候突然就出现了变故。小个子将袋子一把扔在地上，几十个闪闪发亮的金币哐当作响地掉了出来，他想要喊叫，但一把便被大个子掐住了喉咙。

之后大个子便朝着<location>格伦伍德之末</location>走去，我没有跟上去。有时候最好不要吵醒睡着的恶犬。

en: Find Cyclops Skeleton Parts In The Albaneve Summits
cn: 在阿尔班耶夫山脉寻找独眼巨人骷髅部件
找到喧嚣森林空荡礼堂

en: Argon, Take care with this new shipment from the valley. The Merchant said it is highly volatile. Apparently, the "explosives explode" if jostled or tossed about. Who would have known? Anyway, I paid a pretty penny for this. DO NOT mess around in here. I can't afford to fix another hole in the wall!
cn: 厄冈， 好好处理山谷运来的新货。商人说里面非常不稳定。据说用力摇晃或者是倾倒都有可能会“引发爆炸”。谁能想到还有这种事？ 总而言之，这批货可是我花了大价钱的。所以绝对不要乱来。我可没钱再去请人补墙了！

en: You've entered the lighthouse and found half of a wall hanging. Its imagery depicts the makeup of complex alchemical solutions... or so you think. Without the other half, you can't fully decipher the meaning, but combining both pieces will reveal many new crafting recipes, including purple fabric for crafting better mage armor! The lighthouse was seemingly attacked by vultures. Perhaps they took part of the wall hanging to their nests. Reach the vulture nests to find the second half of the schematic!
cn: 进入灯塔之后，你找到了半幅壁画。上面描绘了某种复杂的炼金药水的调配过程……至少你是这么觉得的。 因为缺乏另一半的壁画，你们无法完全破译其中的信息，但是只要将两块碎片重新组合起来，壁画将揭示许多全新的制作配方，其中包括了用于制作更好的法师护甲需要的紫色布料！ 灯塔似乎收到了秃鹫的袭击。也许它们已经将另外一半的壁画带回了自己的巢穴。 抵达秃鹫巢穴以寻找另外一半的设计图纸！

en:
A <keyitem>Kettle</keyitem> was uncovered, laying among remains in a Flame Sanctum. An etching at the bottom reads "Keep safe, <lorename>Raúl</lorename>! — Emily Fray". 

The <keyitem>Kettle</keyitem> must be used to craft a <craftingstation>Cooking Station</craftingstation>. This will enable more cooking recipes.
cn:
一座灵火神殿中的残骸旁有一个<keyitem>烧水壶</keyitem>。物品的底部刻着一行字：“保重，<lorename>劳尔</lorename>！— 艾米丽·弗莱”。

<keyitem>烧水壶</keyitem>能够用于制作<craftingstation>烹饪站</craftingstation>，这将解锁更多烹饪配方。

en: We've announced our arrival in the Albaneve Summits, and claimed their deepest Elixir Well... but something sinister yet brews inside Howling Peak. A corrupted being, yearning to destroy, and to be destroyed. We must draw it out by lighting the balefires circling the mountain, thus waking its ire. I will show you the way.
cn: 我们已经在阿尔班耶夫山脉宣告自己的到来并夺走了他们最深的魔药之井……但是邪恶力量仍然在呼啸崇山中蠢蠢欲动。一个被腐化的存在正渴望着摧毁万物，我们必须将其消灭。只有点燃环绕群山的篝火才能将它引出来。我将向你展示道路。

en: I could tell they were advancing from the smoke that was on the horizon. Many fled, but I stayed. They are snarling outside the door. I will hold this house, as my ancestors would have done. I hid our treasure under the stone stairs. It will be safe and sound, far away from their clutches. When they come, I will be prepared.
cn: 从地平线外的浓烟来看，那些家伙肯定在推进。很多人选择了逃跑，但是我决定留下来。 门外传来了怪物的嘶吼声。说什么我也不会放弃这间房子，我不能让祖宗蒙羞。我已经把宝贝藏在石头楼梯下面了。那个位置很安全，不用担心被人抢走。 让它们来吧，我不怕它们。

en:
Possessing this trophy shows everyone that you are not on the Cyclops' menu — it's the other way around!

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
cn:
这个战利品将让所有人明白，你并不是独眼巨人的猎物——事实恰恰相反！

收集多个独眼巨人头颅以制作黄金战利品。

en: Amazing, you really did it! This Tanning Station will be key to our survival! Come on, place it down so we can get to work!
cn: 不可思议，你真的做到了！这个制皮台将是我们生存的关键！来吧，赶紧放置设备，这样我们就可以开工了！

en: These spiky daggers were often worn by soldiers around their belts during parades as a show of force. Sometimes, children are gifted a simpler version as their first weapon. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 在军队游行期间，士兵们的腰带上经常会别着这种尖刺匕首。有时候，孩子们也会得到简易版本的匕首作为他们的第一把武器。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Don't let your hair grow too long.

They are more than legends after all. The Hollow Halls exist, and inside them echo the melodies of a bygone age... memories of a time where clear skies reigned, and the Shroud was still slumbering below. These Halls of unknown origin have existed for millennia, but their architecture differs from that of the Ancients. Most curious. It's said that these crypts served as banishment grounds for the lowest of Embervale. I wonder if the cursed inhabitants still walk this earthly plane... - Balthazar
cn: 看来传说确有其事。 空荡礼堂确实存在，而且里面依旧能够感受到来自过去的回响……那时候的天空仍然清澈无比，瘴气也仍然在地下沉睡。 这些来源不明的礼堂距今已有千年，但是其中的建筑风格与远古者的截然不同。这点甚是不可思议。 据说这些墓穴曾经是用于放逐薪谷中罪大恶极之人的监狱。不知道那些被诅咒之人是否还在其中徘徊…… - 巴尔萨扎

en: An amazing work of art, beauty and power.
cn: 集美观、工艺与力量于一体的惊人造物。

en: Oh lords, I can move freely! You've unshackled me! Thank goodness those Scavengers aren't around... I remember rancid liquid seeping in from above, dripping into my cell... Keep them away, and I'll do anything!
cn: 老天爷啊，我又可以走路了！你解开了我的枷锁！谢天谢地，幸好那些拾荒者都消失了……我还记得从牢房天花板上渗出来的那些酸臭液体……只要别让我再回那个地方，要我做什么都行！

en:
The thumping leads the way! A bold, beautiful heartbeat beckons me! It rattles my bones, but whets my palate!
