My shy compatriots have no taste for riches — or so it seems — as they departed while I slept. We had just broken into the tunnel where, deep at the end, the wonderful buzzing seems to sing.

No matter! More for Bertram, I say! Forward ho!

BERTRAM
cn:
碰撞声在指引着我！美丽而且响亮的心跳声在召唤我！虽然让我这把老骨头累得够呛，但是我已经感受到了！

那几个小毛头根本不识货，不知道怎么回事，之前他们趁着我睡着的时候一个个都溜走了。我们明明才刚刚打通地道，就在那里的最深处，美妙的嗡鸣声正在放声歌唱。

无所谓了！这样正好让我捡了便宜！前进！

伯特拉姆

en: Glistening rivers, sunken ships... I wonder what riches the water hides? Perhaps we could find gold in the deep! But we'd need the right tools to mine it... If I'm not mistaken, most of the gold shipments we received in the Capital had the same emblem. A large pearl, with the letters "Orville" below. Perhaps that helps?
cn: 波光粼粼的河流与沉没的船只……不知道水面之下隐藏着多少宝藏？也许我们可以在深海之中找到黄金！但是我们需要正确的工具才能开始开采……如果我没有记错的话，当年我们在首都收到的绝大多数黄金货箱上都印着相同的标志。一个巨大的珍珠，底下则是字母“奥威尔”。也许你可以把这当成线索？
已丢失与服务器的连接。

en: Allows you to channel a stream of water in combat. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 允许你在战斗中发射水流。 引导法术：在一段时间内维持按键以持续引导。装备法术并消耗法力来用 法杖施法。

en: The Drak decorate their settlements with such trophies. It's impressive that they even washed off the blood — they surely reuse it for other purposes...
cn: 卓克会使用这种战利品来装饰自己的聚落。让人惊讶的是，他们甚至设法洗去了头骨表面的血渍——这东西肯定还有其他用途……
喧嚣森林 瘴气巢穴

en: Sir Flummi Fell to death while building Vonza Loved the architecture Solstrem Liked huts, disliked haggis Cleo the MinPin, Age 16 The bestest girl in town Chiselchip The Cozy Builder Areelanir von den Lunituns Tear down, build again! Bibes Mc Salty Lilibat the Witch CistaDusa Not all souls are forgotten Old Bear Blue A loyal and beloved companion
cn: Sir Flummi 在建造时不慎跌落身亡 Vonza 热爱建筑 Solstrem 喜欢小屋，不喜欢哈吉斯 Cleo the MinPin，16岁 全镇最棒的女孩 Chiselchip 慵懒的建筑工 Areelanir von den Lunituns 拆掉再建！ Bibes Mc Salty Lilibat the Witch CistaDusa 并不是所有灵魂都被遗忘 Old Bear Blue 忠诚而且备受爱戴的伙伴

en: When you would suffer poison damage you will heal the amount instead.
cn: 将原本应该承受的毒素伤害转化为生命值恢复。

en: The pieces that cover the sides of these pants have been carefully forged to defend against flanking attacks.
cn: 仔细锻造的裤腿护甲，可以抵御来自侧面的攻击，让你无后顾之忧。

en: A miracle! I join the living once more. I am Balthazar, an alchemist. I craft potions and other fare.
cn: 奇迹降临了！我再一次感受到了生者的陪伴。我叫巴尔萨扎，是一名炼金术士。我可以为你制作药水与其他物品。

en: Hefty boots. They will leave considerable footprints in the ground when you defend those in need.
cn: 厚重的靴子。当你保卫需要帮助的人时，它们会在地面上留下沉重的足迹。

en: Remember our three rules for workplace safety and productivity: 1. Follow the schedule! 2. Lift with your legs, not your back! Support each other with heavy cargo! 3. In case of elevator malfunction, report to the shift overseer! (The fine print reads: If you're early, you're on time. If you're on time, you're late. If you're late, you're fired. No paid overtime. Fruit basket refilled biweekly.)
cn: 关于工作场所的安全与生产，有三个规矩不能忘： 1.遵循时间表！ 2.用腿发力，别用背！抬重物的时候要互相帮忙！ 3.如果遭遇升降梯故障，及时向值班主管报告！ （下面还印着一段小字：早来就是准时。准时就是迟到。迟到就等着被开除吧。没有加班工资。果篮每两周补货一次）

en:
Anton Godwin told you about his old job as a knife-throwing jester. He wishes he still had his jester hat.

Reach the outpost marked on your map and search for the jester hat!
cn:
安东·戈德温告诉你说他以前曾是一个表演飞刀杂技的小丑。他想要找回自己的小丑帽子。

抵达地图上标记的哨所并寻找小丑帽子！

en: Despair, hatred, loneliness... it grasps at anything to fill the void and leaves nothing but dust.
cn: 绝望、仇恨、孤独……它不顾一切地想要填补心中的空虚，所到之处只剩荒芜。

en: The metal adornment on this hood faintly resembles the beak of a hawk.
cn: 头罩上的金属装饰物隐约像一只鹰的喙。

en: Two-Handed Greatsword damage is increased by %k.
Place a Flame Altar and take some screenshots before uploading your world! You can take screenshots with the Camera item.
cn: 上传世界前请先放置一座灵火祭坛并拍摄一些截图！你可以使用镜头功能来拍摄截图。

en: Bonus protection against blunt physical damage, in addition to the general physical resistance.
cn: 除了常规物理抗性外，提供针对物理钝击伤害的额外防御。

en: Clear the Albaneve Summits of all shroud roots.
cn: 清理阿尔班耶夫山脉中的所有瘴气根。

en: Nobody really knows what it is. They just call it the "Spice". It makes food much more delicious though, so it is highly sought after!
cn: 没人知道其中的具体成分，只知道这种粉末被叫做“香料”。无论如何，因为能够让食物变得超乎想象的美味，这种粉末让所有人趋之若鹜。

en: Finely ground Aquamarine crystals that sparkle beautifully.
cn: 被研磨成粉末状的海蓝宝石，折射着美丽的光芒。

en: A blinding sandstorm struck my camp yesterday and buried my supplies!! Such horrific winds... unprecedented! I'm still coughing up sand, and I'm not sure where I've landed... everything was swept away! It's all gone, but I can't turn back already! I sold everything I had to find that Oasis! What’s this…? There seems to be a shimmering in the distance. I could turn back, but I might be closer to my goal than I thought! Did the winds bring me near here...? A blessing in disguise? I'm unafraid! I will investigate what will either be my salvation or my demise!
cn: 就在昨天，一场遮天蔽日的沙尘暴经过了我的营地，我的补给都被埋在了沙海之下！！如此可怕的强风……简直是史无前例！到现在我还在往外咳沙子，而且我根本不知道自己被吹飞到了哪里……所有东西都被卷走了！现在什么都没了，但是我也已经没办法回头了！为了找到绿洲，我已经卖掉了自己的全部家当！ 怎么回事？看上去远方似乎有一道闪光。虽然我现在可以选择回头，但说不定我苦苦寻觅的目标就在眼前！难道是沙尘暴其实把我带到了更近的位置……？塞翁失马焉知非福？ 我无所畏惧！我将调查前方，直面我的救赎或者是终结！

en: You emit a healing aura that heals you and all injured allies within %k meters. The healing scales with your Intelligence attribute and restores 1 Health per 2 points of Intelligence.
cn: 你散发出治愈光环。它能治疗%k米内所有受伤的盟友。 治疗效果与智力属性成比例（每2点智力增加1点生命值）。

en: These boots repeat the same weaving technique from the Mountain's Shadow Gloves. They cover the knees and provide ideal protection when stumbling through dark, icy caves or forgotten fortresses.
cn: 这些靴子采用了与山影手套相同的缝纫技术。无论是在黑暗且冰冷的洞窟还是被遗忘的要塞中跋涉，覆盖膝部的长靴子将能够为你提供绝佳的保护。

en: Refill item stacks in your inventory.
cn: 补充您物品栏中的物品堆叠。

en: You've obtained Drak Scales while adventuring. They will serve as a good keepsake and proof of victory. Speak to the fisher to proceed.
cn: 你在冒险期间获得了卓克鳞片。这种东西将成为不错的纪念品与胜利的证明。 与渔夫交谈以继续。

en: Magical ammunition that ignites a fireball, erupting upon impact and dealing damage in a small area. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 魔法弹药，使用时将施放一个火球，火球将在撞击时迸发并对小范围造成伤害。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: You haven't failed me yet! This <craftingstation>Forge</craftingstation> will be worth your while, on my word.
cn: 你果然没有让我失望！相信我，这个<craftingstation>锻炉</craftingstation>绝对能够帮上大忙。

en: Flameborn, there are barriers beyond our comprehension that shield the chambers within from illumination. Pitch black temples, dreamt up by the elder Ancients — shrouded in mystery. Their secrecy obscures my vision, but it shan't restrict yours. Dive in and lift the cover of darkness!
cn: 火之子，有难以名状的屏障隔绝着这里内部的房间，并使得火焰的光芒无法照亮那些地方。伸手不见五指的神殿，那些诞生自远古者长老梦境的产物……统统笼罩在神秘之中。虽然那些玄秘的力量遮蔽了我的视野，但是你并不会受到束缚。潜入最深处，揭开黑暗的面纱！

en: These blades were corroded by being submerged in poison for too long. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 因为长年浸泡在毒素之中，刀刃已经被严重腐蚀。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: The Hunter needs a Loom to craft padding kits for better armor. She suggests looking for a weaver's cottage in East Lapis. The general area is marked on the map. The cottage should be easy to spot since its decorated with banners.
cn: 猎人需要一台织布机来制作填充工具与更好的护甲。她认为东之岩中的编织匠的小屋是个很好的搜索地点。地图上已经标记了对应的区域。小屋上面挂着旗帜装饰，因此应该一眼就能分辨出来。

en: The Farmer has found new inspiration for seafood dishes. She’s shown you how to craft a Seafood Grill. Craft and place a Seafood Grill so she can begin preparing even better dishes.
cn: 农民已经找到了海鲜料理的新灵感。她已经向你展示了制作海鲜烤架的方法。 制作并放置一个海鲜烤架好让她开始准备更高级的料理。

en: To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
cn: 若要驯服动物，请在潜行状态下小心靠近目标。在动物身边投掷诱饵食物以吸引其注意。在动物进食时抚摸它，重复过程直到动物被驯服。被驯服之后，你将可以捡起动物。

en: Find The Chest Under The Stairs

Life still blooms everywhere around.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
cn:
生命永远能找到出路。

可以使用游牧高地材料制作这种调色板。

en: You've found a scattered song in the Albaneve Summits! Visit the next location marked on your map to discover more music sheets!
cn: 你已经在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到了一首遗失的曲目！拜访地图上标记的下一个位置以发现更多乐谱！

en: Use the name of your character in the world. When turned off, your account name will be shown instead.
cn: 使用你在这个世界中的角色名称。关闭后将转而显示你的账号名称。

en: A refreshing bottle of Water that grants more Stamina. Stay hydrated.
cn: 一瓶清新爽口的水，服下后能够提供更多体力。记得多补水。

en: This hide is sleek and water-resistant. It's commonly procured from amphibians that prefer wet or water-filled environments.
cn: 光滑而且防水的兽皮。通常取自那些喜好潮湿或者是水中环境的两栖生物。

en: Fresh, healthy, fun to eat, and good for the soul. What more could you want from a meal?
cn: 新鲜、健康、有趣而且有益灵魂。这难道不是最棒的美食吗？

en:
Food for attracting and taming a Cat.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
cn:
用于吸引与驯服猫的饲料。

若要驯服动物，请在潜行状态下小心靠近目标。在动物身边投掷诱饵食物以吸引其注意。在动物进食时抚摸它，重复过程直到动物被驯服。被驯服之后，你将可以捡起动物。

en: The wood of Shroud infested trees. Its structure and properties are changed forever.
cn: 受瘴气污染树木的木材。它的结构和特性永久地改变了。

en: You've successfully turned off the water flow in Riverreach. This enables you to retrieve the millstone. Head inside to take the grind mill component. Remember that all water flow needs to be stopped to keep the machine turned off.
cn: 你已经成功中断了河畔的水流。现在你可以取回磨盘了。 进入建筑并取回石磨部件。不要忘记，你需要确保所有水流都已经中断才能关闭机器。

en: Infuse your Ranged Explosives with Mana. They now stun enemies for 2 seconds. Cost: %k Mana per stunned enemy
cn: 为你的远程爆炸物融入魔法之力。现在它们将能够晕眩敌人至多2秒。 消耗：每晕眩1名敌人消耗%k点法力

en: The originator of the "Ritual of Reunion", Lady Leclair, made changes to the incantation to slip into the realm of the dead and find eternal life. In her note, she mentions a basement. Find the entry to her basement and retrieve Lady Leclair!
cn: “团聚仪式”的发明者雷克莱尔夫人对咒语进行了调整，她试图通过这种方式来潜入亡者的国度以寻求永生。雷克莱尔留下的笔记中提到了一处地下室。设法进入地下室并找到雷克莱尔夫人！

en: You've found the Drak temple the Huntress mentioned. Find a way inside and prove your prowess. A part of the temple seems to be flooded. Increasing your maximum oxygen before entering is recommended. Once you're inside the temple, you must discover the fate of those who dove here before you and retrieve their gear.
cn: 你已经找到了女猎人提到的卓克神殿。设法进入其中并证明自己的能力。 神殿的一部分区域似乎被淹没了。建议在进入前先设法提高自己的最大氧气量。 进入神殿后，你必须探索在你之前潜入到这里的人们的命运并取回他们的装备。

en: The differences between these creatures are to be contextualized not as natural variance, but as the markings of a common gene pool, split apart into new and isolated strands carried by the tribes. Said isolation, alongside constant interracial conflict and assumed increased rates of inbreeding, may explain the perceived cognitive and linguistic degeneration of the Drak. Cultural and linguistic degeneration: The Drak texts recovered from more recent layers of sediment — often dredged from coastal waters or shipwrecks — tend to exhibit simpler structures, reduced vocabulary, and degraded syntax when compared to earlier samples unearthed in local temples. This suggests a loss of linguistic complexity over time. It appears that the trajectory of their societal evolution may have stagnated — or even regressed. Additionally, if I interpret correctly, it is to be assumed that they hold a grudge or a somewhat natural aversion to technological advancements and engineering. They perceive most modern human inventions as admissions of weakness rather than solutions. Further research is required.
cn: 这些生物之间的差异并不能用自然变化这种概念来简单地一言蔽之，确切来说，是原本来自相同基因库的标记分裂成了各个部落所携带的崭新与相互隔离的分支。 也许正是这种隔离性，以及持续不断的族群冲突外加更高的近亲繁殖率，才导致了卓克的认知与语言能力的退化。 文化与语言退化： 从距今最近的沉积层中找到的卓克文献——通常打捞自海岸附近的水域或船只残骸 ——展现出了十分简单的语言结构、更少的词汇量，以及与从当地神殿中出土的早期样本相比严重的语法退化。这些迹象暗示了它们的语言复杂程度随着时间流逝呈衰退趋势。 似乎他们的社会计划轨迹已经停滞不前——或者甚至出现了倒退的迹象。除此以外，如果我没有理解错误，他们似乎对于科技进步以及工程学抱有巨大的怨恨或者是天生的抗拒。他们将现代人类的绝大多数发明视作软弱而不是答案。在这一点上有待进一步研究。

en: You've reached the Hidden Hollow Tomb mentioned by the Barber. Descend into the depths of the crypt to search for color inspiration!
cn: 你已经抵达理发师提到的隐藏空荡墓穴。 潜入墓穴深处并为他寻找发色灵感！

en: Ignore all movement penalties from armor.
cn: 无视护甲导致的一切移动惩罚。

en:
The waters have receded and our ships are no longer worth the rivets that hold them together. I remember the days when I could fish for hours with father. How we bonded, how we laughed. The world was plentiful and kept us alive. Now we will surely tear one another to shreds. 

When will this wasteland cease its cruelty against us?
cn:
水位降低了，我们的船现在甚至还没有船上的那些钉子值钱。我还记得曾经与父亲尽情钓鱼的时光。我想起了我们当时的快乐与欢笑。那个丰饶的世界养活了我们。但现在我们为了生存只能自相残杀。

这片残忍的废土究竟什么时候才愿意放过我们？

en: You do not have the permission to upgrade Altars.
cn: 缺少权限，无法升级祭坛。

en: A Trap Fireball which can be used as spell ammunition. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 能够充当魔法弹药的陷阱火球。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: Resistance indicates the percentage by which the incoming damage type is mitigated.
cn: 抗性代表了特定伤害类型的减伤百分比。

en: With these shoes, maintain your stance and recover before launching your next attack.
cn: 有了这些靴子，你将能够在每次发动攻击后维持姿态并迅速恢复。

en: Search For Clues To Find A Guiding Soul

By climbing the Ancient Spire, you've unlocked the ability to fast travel there.

Use Fast Travel and speak to the Flame atop the Ancient Spire in the Springlands afterwards to proceed.

You can fast travel to any Ancient Spires you've climbed and your own Flame Altars.
cn:
成功攀爬远古尖塔之后，你已经解锁了快速移动至那里的能力。

使用快速移动，之后与春日平原的远古尖塔顶部的灵火交谈以继续。

你可以在自己的灵火祭坛与已经成功登顶的任意远古尖塔之间进行快速移动。

en: Find The Second Wall Tapestry Piece
This stone block is commonly used in Veilwater Basin.
cn: 幕水盆地中常用的石头方块。

en: Find A Way To Enter The Ancient Spire
When parrying an enemy blow, you will fill the enemy's stun bar. The amount depends on the parry value of your shield or two-handed weapon.
cn: 招架敌人的攻击时，敌人的晕眩条会增长。增长的量取决于盾牌或双手武器的招架值。

en: After drying the Animal Fur on the Drying Rack, it becomes sturdier and more durable for a longer period of time.
cn: 将动物毛皮在烘干架晾干之后，这种材料就会变得更加结实而且耐用。

en: Ritual of Reunion — by Lady Leclair of <location>Glennwood's End</location>
cn: 团聚仪式 - <location>格伦伍德之末</location>的雷克莱尔夫人

en: The bigger the battle, the grander the tale!
cn: 只有伟大的战斗才能启迪伟大的传说！

en: If you fall, you will rise again at your last Return Beacon.
cn: 如果倒下，你将能够在最后的回归信标重新复苏。

en: A broadsword almost too big to be comfortably swung. The original owner must have been gigantic.
cn: 大得让人难以顺畅挥舞的阔剑。这把剑的原主人想必身形魁梧。

en: A direction sign that you can write on.
You have been disconnected from the server.
cn: 你已经与服务器断开连接。

en: Another survivor could be uncovered! A <npc>Farmer</npc> will be helpful for food production once placed in the base.
cn: 另一名幸存者正等待着被唤醒！<npc>农民</npc>将能够帮助基地耕种粮食。

en: %k chance and %k reflected damage per level
A slimy broth made from crushed ectoplasm crystals. It's "safe to consume".
cn: 使用碾碎的灵质水晶炖煮而成的粘稠肉汤。专门供人“享用”。

en: The Flame spoke of "Ancient Obelisk" which reveal information about the world. The Obelisks show hidden truths, and some are connected to the Flame. The location of one such Obelisk is marked on the map. Seek out the Obelisk and discover the secrets it holds. The Obelisk's secrets will only be revealed to those who seek them.
cn: 灵火说“古代方尖碑”将揭示关于这个世界的信息。方尖碑将展现隐藏的真相，而且其中有一些还与灵火存在着关联。 已在地图上标记其中一处方尖碑的位置。找到方尖碑并解开其隐藏的秘密。只有勇于探寻之人才能够解开方尖碑的秘密。
护发素需要额外收费哦。

en:
Double-tap the block button to create an all-around shield, which will absorb 1 hit. The casting player may not move or perform any other action or the shield will be dissolved.
Cost: 50 mana
Cooldown: 30 seconds
cn:
双击“格挡”按钮将创造一面能够吸收1次打击的全方位护盾。施放技能时玩家不能移动或执行其他操作，否则护盾将消散。
消耗：50点法力
冷却时间：30秒

en: You can take screenshots with this item.
cn: 你可以使用此物品拍摄屏幕截图。

en: Scales how fast areas refresh if no player is near.
cn: 调整当玩家不在附近时，各个区域的刷新速度。

en: You found my camp near <location>Morwenna</location>? Blissful, no...? We tried to make those lands habitable. Lush lakes and a pretty great view... But when we came to settle, the wildlife fought back — hard. Eventually, we abandoned our efforts. The world was already falling apart... and I decided to enter the Cinder Vaults to build the future, not just repair the present.
cn: 你找到了我在<location>莫文纳</location>附近的营地？那里的景色真的很美，你说呢……？我们原本想要在那里定居。旁边就是碧绿的湖水还有美景……但是当地的野生动物不答应，可以说是强烈反对。最后迫于无奈我们只好放弃。当时世界已经走向了末日……所以我就决定进入余烬密室，我想要创造未来而不是修补现在。

en: What are ya waiting around for? Craft a Grappling Hook if you want to further explore Embervale.
cn: 在磨蹭什么呢？快制作一个抓钩，然后你才能够进一步探索薪谷。

en: Bonus protection against piercing physical damage, in addition to the general physical resistance.
cn: 除了常规物理抗性外，提供针对物理穿刺伤害的额外防御。

en: These two lovers met a tragic end – his throat slit and her mouth foaming with poison.
cn: 这对爱人双双丧命，男子的喉咙被割开了，而女子的嘴角则溅满了毒酒。
阿尔班耶夫山脉占星者

en: You'll make people shake in their boots when you approach in these spooky shoes!
cn: 穿上这些可怕的靴子，人们看见你就会瑟瑟发抖！

en: Increases the skill level of Shroud Filter
cn: 提高瘴气过滤的技能等级

en: Time in the Shroud is increased by 5 minutes, allowing you to explore for longer. Time in the Shroud Should this time run out, the Shroud will consume you.
cn: 瘴气停留时间延长5分钟，让你能探索更久。 瘴气停留时间 如果停留时间耗尽，你将被瘴气吞噬。

en: Craft A Revelwood Hollow Halls Key
cn: 制作一把喧嚣森林空荡礼堂钥匙

en: It's not about the destination, it's about the journey.
cn: 重要的是过程，而不是结果。

en: A sturdy tool that can help to cross many chasms along the way.
cn: 能够帮助跨越各类沟壑的可靠工具。

en: Find The Stray Cat In <location>Sapphire Strand</location>
Designed for stealth, these neutral pants make sneaking through the thicket effortless.
cn: 专为潜行设计，这些质朴的裤子能够让你轻而易举潜入灌木丛中。

en: It's oozing, unaturally enlarged, and still beating whenever you dare to look away. This heart's potent essence is a key ingredient in crafting resilient armor.
cn: 这颗异常巨大的心脏仍然在渗着脓汁，而且当你挪开眼神的时候它就会恢复跳动。这颗心脏中蕴含的强力精华是制作强韧盔甲的关键原料。

en: 4.1.2 You may revoke the use of your User Content for marketing purposes as provided in Section 4.1.1 d) at any time by selecting the option "I object to the use of my uploaded content for marketing purposes" when uploading the User Content or later in the management section for your User Content. Keen is not required to retroactively remove materials that have already been published.
cn:
4.1.2	
您可以随时撤销出于营销目的对您的用户内容的使用（如第4.1.1  条 d) 项所规定），只需在上传用户内容时或之后在您的用户内容的管理部分选择“我反对将我上传的内容用于营销目的”选项即可。Keen 没有义务追溯性地删除已发布的材料。

en: I so fondly recall my clueless years, foolishly venturing further than the rest. The depths piqued my interest, full of wonder and awe. I reached out, yearning for knowledge, veiled in the warmth of the Flame. I was young and feared no mistakes. In the abyss, I felt eternity. I feel it no more. The sand in my hourglass slips away. When I hear the Flame call the name of the eldest — my name — I am filled with regret. Our planet's core has changed... the ripple effect of my discoveries tore the valleys and our youngest apart. Failure should have scared me, not change. The abyss is all that remains, and it means oblivion. I've branded my name into the stone — recorded all my failures on the Obelisks, burdened to outlast me. Fearing to be forgotten, I signed my name on the last... how very human of me. Curious, this final feeling. So hollow. So cold. — Manathor
cn: 回首一生，我最珍视的，还是年少轻狂的冒险时光。那时候的我对深渊无比好奇，我的心中满是向往与敬畏。在灵火温暖的包围下，我决定出发去寻找知识。当时的我意气风发，但是真正到了深渊，我却感觉度日如年。 不过现在我已经没有了当初的激情。我的人生即将画上句点。当我听见灵火呼唤着最古老之人，也就是我的名字时，我的心中只剩下了愧疚。我们这颗星球的核心已经彻底改变……我当初的发现所引发的影响撕裂了山谷，也断绝了我们与年轻同胞之间的联系。我本该害怕失败，而不是改变。现在一切只剩下了代表湮灭的深渊。 我将自己的名字刻在了石头中，方尖碑将记录下我的所有失败，它们将在我离开之后继续坚守。出于对被遗忘的恐惧，我在最后签下了自己的名字……想想这种做法与人类十分相像。没想到生命的尽头竟然会是这种感觉。如此空洞，如此冰冷。 — 马纳索尔

en: %k Dexterity and Endurance per level. %k Stamina Regeneration per level.
cn: %k敏捷以及耐力/每级。 %k体力恢复/每级。

en: While there are three or more enemies within 20 meters, you receive %k increased Magical Resistance.
cn: 如果20米范围内存在至少三名敌人，你的魔法抗性将提高%k。

en: These boots are stuffed with extra fluff, thus keeping your feet nice and warm in the snow.
cn: 这些靴子里面缝有额外皮草，能够让你的双脚在雪中也能保持温暖。

en: I've exhausted my knowledge. We must go further, and uncover new knowledge somehow...
cn: 我已经耗尽了自己的全部智慧。如果想要寻找新的知识，我们必须更进一步……

en: When you kill an enemy with a ranged weapon, you can hold interact for 2 seconds to teleport to the enemy's position.
cn: 使用远程武器击杀敌人时，你可以长按“互动”按钮2秒并传送至敌人位置。

en: Your skin emits heat, granting you 2 Ice Armor per Constitution.
cn: 你的皮肤正在散发热量，每点体质提供2点寒冰护甲。
将建造区域扩展至175米x175米。

en: First, there was nothing. The winds and waters were still, the land lay dormant and unclaimed. But soon, a breeze arose, and the silence crescendoed into a fanfare. A storm cloud, spouting thunder and lightning, spread across the skies — and from its heart began to pour a waterfall of violet blood. As the droplets laid siege to the wilds below, they tore down every blossom and vine, marking their fragility. The downpour turned the flatlands into a battlefield first, and later, an ocean. Once weakness was purged, the storm subsided, but the sea of blood left in its wake became a primordial soup that gave rise to a victor in the chaos. The Broodmother Vesztah was born. She, the first Drak, reigned over all — but sitting lonely on her throne, she spoke, "What is greed if not a pit to drown in? What is dominance without dominion?" and chose to share her realm and blood. Our Mother laid 100 eggs under the canopy of stars, and as the first Drakling awoke, she watched them break from their shells... and fed the weakest to the strong, so they may bring forth a storm of blood forevermore.
cn: 起初，这个世上什么也没有。风与水都毫无波澜，大地也在沉睡中荒废。 但是很快刮起了一阵轻风，原本的沉默逐渐成为了喧嚣。一片散播电闪雷鸣的风暴之云笼罩天空——紧接着一道紫色鲜血的瀑布便从风暴的心脏中奔涌而出。 当那些雨滴包围了下方的旷野，它们摧毁了所有脆弱的鲜花与藤蔓。暴雨先是将平地变成了一片战场，之后又将那里变成了汪洋。 当一切软弱之物都已被清除，风暴终于平息，但是它留下的鲜血之海成为了一片生命的源初之汤，一名胜利者从那里的混乱中崛起了。育母维兹塔阿就此诞生。 作为最初的卓克，她统治着世间万物——但她只是孤独地坐在王座之上，接着她便开口说道，“难道贪婪不就是一个用于淹溺自身的无底深坑吗？没有子民的统治又有何意义？”，她决定分享自己的国度与鲜血。 在星辰的荫庇下，我们的母亲产下了100枚蛋，随着首个龙裔觉醒，她见证着它们钻出自己的蛋壳……并将弱者作为强者的食粮，只有这样，它们才能够带来一场永恒的鲜血风暴。

en: These pants are nothing special on the outside, but inside, they're lined with a fur layer.
cn: 从外面看这些裤子稀松平常，但其实内侧缝有一层毛皮。

en: I’m actually impressed — I didn’t expect you to catch your first fish so easily. You won’t forget that one. Keep practicing, though — harder fish will come, and you’ll need every bit of skill you can muster.
cn: 了不起，没有想到你竟然这么轻松就钓上了第一条鱼。你永远不会忘记这次的经历的。不过你还需要继续练习——之后你还会遇到更难钓的鱼，那时候你将用尽浑身解数。

en: Character attributes can be observed in the character menu. The primary attributes are Constitution for more Health, Spirit which affects Mana, and Endurance which provides Stamina. Strength affects Melee Damage, Dexterity affects Ranged Damage, and Intelligence relates to Magic Damage. The character screen lists your resistances, Shroud Passage Level and Time in the Shroud in the Shroud. Hover over the attributes to learn more.
cn: 你可以在角色菜单中查看角色属性。主要属性：体质能够提高生命值，精神影响法力，而耐力则对应体力。 力量影响近战伤害，敏捷影响远程伤害，而智力则对应魔法伤害。 角色界面中罗列着你的抗性、瘴气抵抗等级以及瘴气中的瘴气停留时间。将光标移动至属性上以了解更多。

en: Ah, there you are! Have you found something yet — an item to spark my next creation?
cn: 啊，你来了！你有找到什么东西可以激发我的下一个杰作吗？

en: Such a bustle here lately, and yet I feel lonely. I can't stop thinking of my family... can you help?
cn: 最近这里忙得热火朝天，但我仍然感觉十分孤独。我总是不由自主地想到自己的家人……你能不能帮帮我？

en: Remain unseen and strike from the shadows with this formidable archer's hood.
cn: 戴上这个威风凛凛的弓箭手兜帽，就能神不知鬼不觉地从暗处发动攻击。

en: A grappling hook that can be used underwater.
cn: 能够在水下使用的抓钩。

en: Simple Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes II
cn: 简易热带木制篱笆（绳索） II

en: Look at what I have to offer!
This laboratory was improved by adding a retort.
cn: 添加了曲颈瓶的改良版实验室。

en: Have you found some hair coloring inspiration? Come on, I'm dying to dye hair!
cn: 你有找到关于发色的灵感了吗？拜托，我已经迫不及待想要给大家染头发了！

en:
You've found a note that mentioned a goat farm by a basin with a spider infestation.
The Scavengers don't want to go near it but know that the farm has an attic with loot inside.

Explore the farm and gather the loot from the attic!
cn:
你找到的一张纸条上提到了一座位于盆地旁边的山羊农场，那里蜘蛛泛滥成灾。
虽然知道农场的阁楼里有很多战利品，但是拾荒者仍然不愿意靠近那里。

探索农场并收集阁楼中的战利品！

en: You found a sleeping survivor in the bowels of the Night Sanctum! Summon the survivor with a Summoning Staff to continue!
cn: 在黑夜圣所的最深处，你发现了一位沉睡着的幸存者！ 使用召唤法杖召唤幸存者以继续！

en: 3.4 Prohibited Conduct The following is prohibited in connection with Adventure Sharing in particular: a) The use of measures, mechanisms, or software that may interfere with the function and operation of Adventure Sharing. b) Measures that could result in an unreasonable or excessive burden on the technical capacities of Adventure Sharing. c) Blocking, overwriting, or modifying content generated by Keen or otherwise interfering disruptively with gameplay. d) The use of bots or other similar tools. e) The use of scripts and programs that give you an advantage over other users or circumvent upload restrictions. f) Creating or using cheats, mods, hacks, and/or software that alters or impairs the operation of Adventure Sharing or the Adventure Sharing server. g) Blocking, overwriting, modifying, or reverse engineering the Adventure Sharing system, the Adventure Sharing server, or the file format used by Keen.
cn:
3.4	禁止行为
在使用冒险分享相关功能时，特别禁止以下行为：
a)	使用可能干扰冒险分享功能与运行的措施、机制或软件。
b)	可能导致冒险分享技术能力承受不合理或过度负荷的措施。
c)	阻止、覆盖或修改由 Keen 生成的内容，或以破坏性方式干扰游戏进程。
d)	使用机器人程序或其他类似工具。
e)	使用脚本和程序，以获得相对于其他用户的优势，或规避上传限制。
f)	创建或使用作弊程序、模组、黑客工具和/或软件来改变或损害冒险分享功能或冒险分享服务器的运行。
g)	阻止、覆盖、修改冒险分享系统、冒险分享服务器或 Keen 所使用的文件格式，或对其进行逆向工程。

en: Place a Flame Altar before sharing your world.
cn: 在共享世界前请先放置一座灵火祭坛。

en:
When you stand opposite this face, you remember its screams. "Zzzrrr Krrrraallllll Hrrrrggg" it echoes in your head, only this time you don't have to feel weak in the knees.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
站在这幅面孔前时，你立刻就会想起它的尖叫。“Zzzrrr Krrrraallllll Hrrrrggg”的声音在你的脑海中回响，不过这一次，你并没有因此心生恐惧。

收集多个海卓克·达尔头颅以制作黑铁战利品。

en: A dull set of daggers. Simple, but still efficient in a pinch. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 一套钝刀。简单却不失效率。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: The greatest trophy of them all is that which inspired awe... and fear. Well done, my friend. My anger is soothed.
cn: 这一功绩中最伟大的战利品就是给那些敌人带来的敬畏……与恐惧。做得好，我的朋友。我的愤怒已经平息。

en: We should improve our capabilities! My old bones are getting brittle.
cn: 我们应该提升自己的能力！我这把老骨头是越来越脆弱了。

en:
The brightness of the yellow tinge makes it appear almost fluorescent. While shining brighter than the sun, the thought of defeat becomes lost in the radiance.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
一抹明亮的黄色使得这种调色板拥有了类似荧光般的质感。在光辉胜过烈日，失败的念头随着这炽热消散。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。
赋予针对中毒的免疫效果。

en: A basic construction material. Not very pretty, but it gets the job done. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 一种基础的建筑材料。谈不上美观，但十分可靠。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en:
You've found a note that describes a hermit who trades amethysts for goods. 

He lives in a secluded area not far from Balefire Stronghold "Lance Point". 

Search for the hermit's cottage and look for valuables there!
cn:
你找到的一张纸条上提到了一名会用紫水晶交易生活用品的隐士。

他就住在距离篝火要塞“枪尖”不远处的一个偏僻位置。

寻找隐士的小屋以及藏在那里的宝物！

en: The <npc>Hunter</npc> is alive! Perhaps she can reveal a thing or two about survival in the Shrouded Lands.
cn: <npc>猎人</npc>苏醒了！也许她可以教会你如何在瘴气之地中生存。

en: Build A Sheltered Bed For Valory
cn: 为瓦罗里建造一张受到庇护的床

en:
The Farmer once saw bright green flowers near a caravan camp in the Nomad Highlands at night time. 

Reach the spot the Farmer mentioned and gather the plants before returning to the Barber with them in your inventory! You can also find the plants in other areas of the Nomad Highlands.
cn:
农民曾经在夜间的游牧高地中看见，有一处车队营地旁长满了亮绿色的鲜花。

抵达农民提到的地点并采集植物，回去找理发师时记得确保物品栏中拥有对应的物品！你也可以在游牧高地的其他区域中寻找他需要的植物。

en:
Do you want to delete this item stack?
It cannot be recovered!
cn:
您想删除这一堆物品吗？
此操作无法恢复！

en: Used in the Map and Skill Tree

You can avoid combat completely by sneaking. Crouch down by pressing %k and enter bushes to remain hidden from the enemy's sight. All bushes hide you. You can spend skill points to learn the Sneak Attack. Sneak up behind unsuspecting enemies and unleash a Sneak Attack by pressing %k while hidden.
cn: 你可以通过潜行避免战斗。按%k键蹲下并进入草丛即可避免被敌人发现。所有草丛都能提供掩蔽。 你可以花费技能点学习隐秘攻击。潜行至未警觉的敌人背后，接着在潜行状态按%k键发动隐秘攻击。

en: A heavy two-handed hammer that can break through any door thanks to the added front spikes. Bashing, tearing, and slashing are no problem for this weapon!
cn: 沉重的双手锤，能够使用前段安装的尖刺轻松打烂大门。无论是殴打、撕裂还是劈砍都难不倒这件武器！

en: Flameborn, I think we should open our arms and welcome more farm animals to our homestead! What do you say? I even have some naming ideas at the ready!
cn: 火之子，我认为我们应该张开怀抱欢迎更多农场动物来到我们的家园！意下如何？我甚至已经想好了一些名字！

en: Gray pants which have been refined with expertly crafted metal parts.
cn: 这件灰色裤子上巧妙地加装了牢固的金属部件。

en: Internal error. Please reinstall the game.
cn: 内部错误。请重新安装游戏。

en: Your arrows can no longer be blocked.

cn: 黑铁瘴气魔独眼巨人战利品

en: Acquired fresh, living subject. Will add notes once the ritual has been completed.
cn: 找了一个活着的实验对象。等仪式完成之后再记录额外的信息。

en: Your tale has only just begun!
Got my hands full but what do ya need?
cn: 我忙得不可开交，还需要什么？

en: The Skull Splitter gets its name from its merciless nature — cleaving skulls with every swing.
cn: 裂颅者得名于这把武器的无情本质——每一次的挥舞都会劈裂无数头颅。

en: An axe made out of scrap metal with improved durability and efficiency compared to the Axe.
cn: 用废金属制成的斧头，与斧子相比，耐用性和效率都有所提高。

en: Raw Wolf meat. Must be cooked for proper consumption.
cn: 生狼肉。食用前需要先充分烤熟。

en:
Increases your Strength attribute by 1.

Increases Melee damage by 5% per Attribute Point.
cn:
令力量属性提升1点。

每点属性点增加5%的近战伤害。

en: A striking, extravagant headpiece, just as broad as your magical abilities — but you might get stuck in the doorway.
cn: 一件令人印象深刻的华丽头具，几乎和你的魔法能力一样磅礴大气，只是要小心别被门框卡住。

en: Robust gloves that hide the wearer's palms and true intentions.
cn: 坚固的手套可以隐藏佩戴者的手掌和真实意图。

en:
Lush and lively like the Nomad Highlands flora before the drought.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
cn:
就像是旱灾降临前的游牧高地植被一样富有生机。

可以使用游牧高地材料制作这种调色板。

en: You have found a note left behind by the former resident. In it, he laments never finding the strength to repair the roof. The building blocks he had set aside for the task are said to still be in the attic.
cn: 你已经找到了一位以前的住户留下的笔记。在笔记中，他因为缺乏修理屋顶的力气而苦恼。原本用于修理的建筑方块应该仍然在阁楼中。

en: A burning sword, glowing with power. It burns hot enough to reduce the mana of its prey with every hit.
cn: 熊熊燃烧的强力宝剑。炽热的高温足以夺走猎物的法力。

en: The dawn that puts an end to even the darkest of nights. Raise your head up high. Your light cannot be extinguished.
cn: 破晓的光芒甚至能够驱散最深的黑夜。永远昂首挺胸，没有任何东西能够熄灭你的光芒。

en: You've obtained both parts of the wall hanging! To decipher the meaning of its depiction, you must return home and place both pieces inside a frame! Combining the pieces will reveal more crafting recipes and enable you to create better mage armor with mauveine and purple fabric! Completing the collection will unlock new crafting recipes. Since crafting recipes are shared serverwide, this collection must be assembled once per server to reap the benefits. This entry will be completed once the collection has been assembled on the server. XP rewards are only awarded once.
cn: 你已经拿到了完整壁画的全部碎片！ 为了破译其中的真正含义，你必须返回基地并在一个框架中组合两块碎片！组合碎片将揭示更多制作配方并允许你使用苯胺紫以及紫色布料制作更好的法师护甲！ 完成收藏将解锁新的制作配方。因为制作配方会全服务器共享，该收藏必须在每个服务器中集齐一次才能够解锁奖励。 服务器收藏完成后，该条目也将同时完成。经验值奖励只能够获得一次。

en: "What is greed if not a pit to drown in?"
cn: “难道贪婪不就是一个用于淹溺自身的无底深坑吗？”

en: Killing an enemy with a Sneak Attack or Merciless Attack has a %k chance to spawn a level %k companion skull.
cn: 使用隐秘攻击或残酷打击击杀敌人时有%k几率生成%k个级友方头骨。

en: My Lack Of Sleep Is Catching Up To Me

The Huntress asked you to gather some fireflies. She didn’t say what she plans to do with them, but it’s best to go along with it. Fireflies can be found in the Springlands at night. Return to her with the fireflies in your inventory.
cn: 女猎人要求你收集一些萤火虫。她并没有说打算要用这些东西做什么，但最好还是先满足她的要求。 你可以在夜间的春日平原找到萤火虫。 当物品栏中携带着萤火虫时回去找她。

en: Magical ammunition that ignites a firebolt, dealing damage to a single target. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 魔法弹药，使用时将施放一个火球并对单个目标造成伤害。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: Repair your equipment on the go. Gradually restores a small amount of durability over time.
cn: 允许你随时随地鼓捣自己的装备。逐步恢复少量耐久。

en: Pikemead's Reach's ability to admit more cargo for repairs has ceased. We must retain the overdue parcel until further notice... I've placed it on the crane platform.
cn: 派克米德之地已经无法接收更多修补用物资。我们必须设法存放额外的包裹并等待后续统治……我已经把东西放在吊车平台上了。

en:
You've been cursed by the Fell. Your Time in the Shroud is reduced significantly.

This long-term debuff affects you permanently until removed with a cleansing tonic.
cn:
你已经被瘴气魔诅咒。你在瘴气中的停留时间已严重缩短。

这是一种永久性的长期减益，只有通过净化药剂才能够解除。

en: A block of an ancient style, representing the architectural elements of the desert temples.
cn: 远古风格的方块，代表着沙漠神殿的建筑元素。

en: Perfect for wading through ash and moldy earth.
cn: 在覆满灰烬与霉菌的泥泞中跋涉时的最佳选择。

en: Find Hints To Aunt Braelyn's Whereabouts
cn: 寻找有关布莱林姑姑下落的线索

en: You cannot add more markers. Remove a marker to add a new one.
cn: 无法添加更多标记。移除一个现有标记以添加新的标记。

en: Massive, hardened scales. Lightweight yet incredibly tough, they are prime materials for crafting durable and flexible armor. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Critter Queens, initially found in the Revelwood.
cn: 巨大无比的硬化鳞片。轻盈无比却又异常坚忍，这是用于制作牢固与灵活的护甲的首选材料。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于喧嚣森林中的瘴气魔女王虫。

en: There's plenty of fish in the sea!

Shelter and warmth will be the backbone of your new kingdom, but that shan't suffice. Grand halls will keep you dry, but will they carry your memories? Your soul? You must fill them with life. A warm bed and the scent of food will transform your house into a home!
cn: 庇护所与温暖将成为你的新国度的基石，但光凭这两者还远远不够。宏伟的厅堂能够为你遮风挡雨，但它们是否能够承载你的记忆？或者是你的灵魂？你必须让殿堂之中充满盎然生机。温暖的床榻与食物的香气将让你的房子变为真正的家园！

en: A delicious aggregate-accessory fruit, predominantly found in the Revelwood.
cn: 一种美味的聚合果，主要分布于喧嚣森林。

en: These Halls look so drab... who said that eternal suffering had to be so stale? We could easily add some pazazz, right? I have an idea: A throne made from Bones. Imagine it. Fearsome. Intimidating. Gothic. Yes, it's a little on the nose... but why leave room for subtlety when you could be lounging on the remains of your rivals? Ah, I'm brilliant. I missed my calling as an interior decorator. Sure wish I wasn't undead.
cn: 这些房间实在是太过沉闷……谁规定永恒的折磨一定要如此乏味？我们大可以稍稍装饰一番，你说呢？ 我有个想法：使用骸骨制作的王座。想象一下那种画面。庄严又可怕。充满哥特风。 当然，我猜这一点已经很明显了……不过当你能够把敌人的残骸充当座椅的时候，为什么还要拘谨隐忍？啊，我真是佩服自己的聪明才智。我情不自禁想起以前想要当室内设计师的那个梦想了。此时此刻我真希望自己并没有变成现在这样的不死族。

en: Upon traversing these lands, I have discovered a great and varied amount of flora and fauna. However, none as adorable and resilient as the small rodents jumping to and fro across this landscape, which I have come to call "Jumper Mice." Perhaps it is the dire state of Embervale which has created a space in my heart for these fragile little ones... watching them devour small insects and evade other predators brings me joy where there is otherwise sadness.
cn: 在穿越这片大地的旅途中，我发现了数量让人惊叹的各种动植物。但是在这之中，我从来没有见到过遍布于各地的一种小型啮齿类动物那般可爱又坚韧不拔的存在，我已经将它们起名为“跳跳鼠”。也许是薪谷中的恶劣环境，让我情不自禁对这些脆弱的小家伙们怜爱有加……看着它们努力吞噬小昆虫还有躲避其他猎食者的样子，让我原本充满悲伤的内心中重新浮起了一丝温暖。

en:
His Excellency, the benevolent King Gormander of Meldore, demands justice for the murder of Royal Inquisitor Lachlan. 

The delivery of his severed head to the King's Court was an act of aggression that is punishable by death. May the King's retribution be a swift lesson that the laws of Meldore and all of Embervale still prevail!

From the King's royal advisery, 50th of Yearfall, 502 D.A.
cn:
戈曼德陛下，梅尔多尔王国的仁慈统治者，要求为皇家审讯官拉克兰的谋杀案讨回公道。

将他的头颅送到国王的宫廷是一种应该被处以死刑的挑衅行为。国王的惩罚将成为深刻的教训，梅尔多尔与薪谷绝非法外之地！

国王谋臣亲启，岁末第50日，502 D.A.

en: Ah, the sweetness reminds me of the botanical paradise I called home before the drought... we barely got by while other cities were rumored to have too much. Glennwood's End, for example, was known for abundance. Even their landfills were speckled with riches. It's a shame the villagers went a little looney. They made great strawberry wine!
cn: 啊，香甜的滋味让我想起了干旱到来之前，被我称为家的植物天堂…… 那时候我们一直在为了生存而挣扎，但其他城市却是截然不同。比如说格伦伍德之末就以丰饶富裕而闻名。就连他们的垃圾场中也遍布着各类财宝。只可惜那里的村民们后来后发疯了。不过那里的草莓酒真的是一绝！

en: Increases the skill level of Battle Heal
cn: 提高战斗治疗的技能等级

en: Not very pretty, but useful when it comes to creating protection from the elements.
cn: 虽然不甚美观，但是拥有着抵挡风雨的优良特性。

en: Silver is a precious metal often found in combination with other minerals. This raw silver ore will need to be processed to become useful.
cn: 银是一种贵金属，自然条件下的绝大部分银都是以化合态存在于银矿石中。这种开采出来的银矿石需要经过加工才能进一步使用。

en: Gloves adorned with glowing, green gems. No matter what you're rebuilding or tearing down — you'll always look fashionable with these!
cn: 手套上镶嵌有闪闪发光的绿宝石。无论是在进行重建还是拆除工作，这双手套会让你永远光彩夺目！

en: Our family worked tirelessly to chisel ever-winding shafts into the stone, though all of them are gray and dull. It's hard for me to imagine a different life, lest I gaze at the water nearby and remember my youth. I remember reading about a mermaid: A lonely maiden whose heart melted into the waves as she turned to seafoam. Years in the mine made me forget, made me grow up. But not all let go of such fairytales. Once, I met a man with legs that should've been fins. The Siren Seeker, they called him — always caressing the sea as if it were his lover, letting the tide envelop him as he dove for treasures below. He was collecting sun-bleached seashells by the shore as I asked: "What do you seek in the water that you can't find on land? Shouldn't you take up proper work and settle down?" Without looking up, he mumbled through a smile: "I seek the kiss of a mermaid — one who hides her voice in conch shells and words in bottled messages. I'll save her from turning to foam, and me from falling to gray. " Today, I recall the Seeker's words, retrace the pages of that fairytale book in my mind. I understand now. Our family worked tirelessly to chisel ever-winding shafts into the stone, all of which are gray and dull. I wish I hadn't forgotten the magic from yonder years. I wish I had carved my own path and set sail.
cn: 我们的家族一直坚持不懈地在岩石中凿刻蜿蜒曲折的坑道，尽管那些地方永远是灰蒙蒙的。我很难想象不一样的人生，但是每当我看向旁边的水面，我总会想起年轻时候的事。 我记得曾经看到过人鱼的故事：一个孤独的人鱼化成了泡沫，而她的心也熔入了海浪之中。在矿井的那些年让我忘记了过去的那些事，也让我得到了成长。但并不是所有人都会放下那些童话。 曾经，我遇到一个双腿犹如鱼鳍一般的男人。“塞壬探寻者”，人们如此称呼他，那个男人将大海当成了自己的爱人一般呵护，他会坦然让潮汐笼罩自己，接着潜入水下寻找深处的宝藏。 有次趁着那个男人在岸边收集被太阳晒褪色的贝壳时，我有问过他： “水中是有什么你在陆地上找不到的东西吗？为什么你不愿意找一份正经的工作然后安定下来？” 男人微微一笑，他头也不抬地继续翻找着：“我在寻找一个人鱼的吻——她将自己的声音藏在了海螺中以及瓶中信上的文字里。我将拯救她，让她不用化为泡沫，而这反过来也将使我不用陷入灰白。“ 今天，我重新想起了探寻者的话，我在脑海中回忆着看过的那些童话故事书的书页。我现在明白了。我们的家族一直坚持不懈地在岩石中凿刻蜿蜒曲折的坑道，尽管那些地方永远是灰蒙蒙的。真希望我没有忘掉那么多年前的魔力。真希望我能够刻画出自己的道路并扬帆起航。

en: Bones Buried Under Sands Of Time
cn: 掩埋在时间之沙下的骸骨

en: When visiting a shared world, quest progression, terraforming, accessing storage, and all other changes to the world are disabled.
cn: 访问共享世界期间将禁用任务进度、地形改造、仓库使用以及其他所有对世界进行的改动。

en:
<lorename>Captain Arkwright</lorename>'s ring was found. It was carried by a strange figure lurking through the valleys, distorted by the Shroud.

The ring was plucked from its half rotten hand, amidst a sea of fallen soldiers.
cn:
<lorename>阿克怀特队长</lorename>的戒指被找到了。就在山谷中，一个被瘴气扭曲得面目全非的陌生身影身上。

戒指就一直挂在怪物半腐烂的手上，在它周围，无数陨落的士兵尸横遍野。

en: A refined steel-tipped arrow embellished with gold. With this, you can fight in style.
cn: 使用黄金装饰的精钢箭矢。有了此物，你战斗时的身影也将变得无比华丽。

en: Created through years of petrification, it has become a beautiful material used for production.
cn: 无数年的石化过程的产物，这种美丽的材料能够用于制作物品。

en: Hugo Vanderhall wants to research the effects of playing music with epic instruments! He thinks that more advanced instruments have a higher impact on people's morale. He suspects that some epic instruments may be scattered in the hidden temples of the Kindlewastes, but he doesn't know in which. He revealed the locations of the hidden temples to you. Search the hidden temples marked on your map one by one to gather the epic instruments!
cn: 雨果·旺德霍尔想要研究使用史诗乐器演奏音乐带来的影响！他认为高级的乐器能够对人的精神带来正面影响。 雨果怀疑有些史诗乐器就藏在燃火荒原的隐藏神庙中，但是他不确定具体是哪一座神庙。他已经告诉了你那些隐藏神庙的位置。 搜索地图上标记的隐藏神庙并收集史诗乐器！

en: Grants a %k base chance to spawn a health orb when defeating an enemy. Collecting a health orb grants %k additional cutting damage to attacks and increases the chance for health orbs by %k for %k.
cn: 打败敌人时有%k基础几率生成一个生命球。收集生命球将使你的攻击造成额外%k劈砍伤害，并且使生命球的掉落率提高%k，持续%k。

en: An arrow with a steel tip.

Thank you again for reminding me how to dye hair red. Lately, I've been in love with... what's the word? "Indigoon"? No... "Indigo"! Blue Brilliance! Oceanic Ostentatiousness! I reckon I could make blue hair dye if I had a little inspiration, a hint — an indigo-colored one!
cn: 再次感谢你帮助我回想起制作红色染发剂的方法。不过最近我感觉自己又爱上了……怎么说来着？“电情”？不对……啊，是“靛青”！蓝色绚烂！海洋之彩！只需要一点点靛青色的灵感或者是小小提醒，我就能够想起制作蓝色染发剂的方法！

en:
You have reached the location where the dissenters of the Blood Rose fought their last battle. If anything, you can find lost armor here.

Find the complete Blood Rose Armor Set.
cn:
您已到达血玫瑰的异议者们进行最后一战的地方。如果有的话，您可以在这里找到遗失的盔甲。

找到完整的血玫瑰盔甲套装。

en: This weapon you've returned with makes me think. I'm not much of a fighter. I'm too soft-spoken, too sensitive. But I could be helpful in other ways! I started this wall tapestry when I was stationed in my old posts. Let me show you where the pieces are!
cn: 看见你带回来的这把武器，我突然想到了一件事。我其实算不上是个合格的战士。我太软弱敏感了。不过就算是这样，我觉得还是有其他能够帮助你的地方！以前驻扎在哨所的时候，我有在那里编织过一副挂毯。我可以告诉你挂毯的碎片都在哪！

en: I am restless. A nightly groan from behind the walls strains my ears. A rattle, grinding and dull. A whimper from a throat dry as the Kindlewastes sands. A hollow knock on my skull... attached to my spine and shaking my core with every vibration. I cannot bear it. I've brought timber and nails. Whatever it is... it will not enter.
cn: 我感觉心神不宁。 夜晚墙壁中的一声吱叫把我吵醒了。那是一种让人难以忍受的低声刮挠。就像是燃火荒原的砂砾一样干涸的喉咙中发出的呜咽。空洞的声响不停叩击着我的脑袋……感觉每一次的颤动都牵扯这我的脊椎乃至整个身体。我受不了了。 我已经找到了木料还有钉子。不管那到底是什么东西……它休想进来。

en:
I saw the Ancients as a monolith. A web of lights, like stars in the night sky, connected through wisdom and Flame... but they're far more split than I believed.

The "young" Ancients alongside me explained that this Night Sanctum is the creation of their elders, the "empyrian". It predates the Shroud and used to contain a wealth of human knowledge offered as sacrifice, or for trade. Neither Flame nor sunlight can reach, making it perfect for one of our emergency Cinder Vessels. We've rigged the traps to activate after the vessel is filled. Hopefully, that should protect it even as the Shroud fills the valley.

When I trace the constellations on the door, I sense a desperate longing — a pull towards the firmament. I cannot read my fellow traveler's expressions, but their silence betrays them. They feel it, too. A shame I won't see another Night Sanctum so soon. The Ancients speak of an even more hidden haven... deep within the Blackmire, a stretch of land I thought forsaken.

The more I learn, the less I seem to understand...

— Queen Jezmina of Orindell, 509 D.A.
cn:
在我看来，远古者就像是一座巨石柱。一片由光芒连接而成的蛛网，就像是夜空中的星星一样，通过智慧与火焰相互连接……但其实，他们比我原先设想的要更加分裂。

在我身边的“年轻人”远古者解释说这座黑夜圣所是他们的长老们“苍穹学者”所造。早在瘴气诞生以前，这里便已经存在，圣所中储存着大量人类自愿献上或交易得来的知识。无论是火焰还是日光都无法触及这里，这使得这些地方成为了存放应急
的绝佳地点。在器皿填充完毕之后，我们便激活了布置在里面的陷阱。哪怕有一天瘴气吞噬了整座山谷，希望这些举措也足以保障圣所的安全。

当我勾勒大门上的星座图案时，我感受到了一种绝望的乞求，似乎有一种力量在吸引着我前往头顶的星辰。虽然我看不见身旁同伴的表情，但是那股沉默已经表露出它的心意。它也同样感受到了。只可惜我暂时无法看见其他的黑夜圣所。远古者提到了一座比这里还要隐秘的庇护所……就在黑沼的深处，我原本以为那篇偏远之地早已被人遗忘。

当我对他们的了解愈发深刻，我反而觉得自己什么也不懂……

 — 奥林戴尔的杰兹米娜女王， 509 D.A.

en: You have reached the end of the demo quest progression
cn: 您已到达试玩版任务进度的终点

en: An <craftingstation>Alchemy Station</craftingstation> offering all needed tools to craft better alchemical products.
cn: <craftingstation>炼金台</craftingstation>能够提供制作更高级的炼金产物需要的所有工具。

en: Defeat The "Evil Eye" Inside The Elixir Well
cn: 打败魔药之井中的“邪眼”

en: Come, look at what I got - isn't this fossil just inspiring? Oh, the stories it could tell...
cn: 快看我找到了什么，这块化石是不是很不同寻常？啊，难以想象里面蕴含着多少故事……

en: You've crafted a potion that allows you to fight against the Drak more effectively. Drink the potion before or during battle to feel its empowering effects. After consumption, you will also be able to read the written word of the Drak.
cn: 你已经制作了一份能够帮助你更有效对抗卓克的药水。 在战斗期间或者之前喝下药水以感受强化效果。喝下药水后，你也能阅读卓克的文字。

en:
White like freshly fallen snow, somewhere on the edge of the world.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn:
像是初雪一般的白皙，只有世界的尽头才能看见此等色彩。

可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en: The people follow your lead, bright-eyed friend. Why? I see a pulsing light inside your ribcage, held by flesh and bone. Interesting. Perhaps you've done as I could not. Flameborn, they call you? So the Flame bestows both blessing and curse. Oh, how the thread of fate unwinds to bring us together, friend.
cn: 人们似乎自愿追随你，拥有闪耀眼眸的朋友。这是为什么？我看见你的血肉之躯中有一种跳动着的光芒。有意思。似乎你拥有某种超越我的能力。他们叫你火之子，对吗？看来灵火既是一种祝福，也是一种诅咒。啊，一定是命运之线将我们绑定在了一起，朋友。

en: Health gain from healing spells is increased by %k.
cn: 治疗法术额外提供%k生命值。

en: You've crafted a Spinning Machine. Now place it in your base to enable the wool refinement process! After that, you should create refined wool for warm padding kits and better armor!
cn: 你已经制造了一台纺织机。现在将纺车放置在基地中以开始加工毛料！ 放置好改良纺车后，创造加工毛料并制作温暖衬垫与更好的护甲！

en: Our last pair of socks was on Milton's feet when he got attacked by that snow sabertooth. Since then, he's lost his feet. And our socks. I've sent a report to Everfrore Keep — again — but I doubt they'll send more stock. There might be some in the hidden chest behind the gong on the roof, but jumping across to the planks and squeezing through that hidden door is such a pain... I'll just tell the others we're all out. It's not like Milton needs them, anyway.
cn: 我们最后一双袜子被弥尔顿穿去了，但是他受到了雪地剑齿虎的袭击。然后他就失去了自己的脚。还有我们最后的袜子。 我已经发送了一份报告给永霜堡— 而且是又一次 — 但是恐怕他们不会愿意送更多的袜子来了。 屋顶大锣后面的隐藏箱子里面肯定还有一些，但是要拿到的话，你得在板子上跳来跳去然后想办法挤进那扇隐藏门，太麻烦了…… 还是直接跟其他人说我们没袜子吧。反正现在弥尔顿也不需要袜子了。

en: The <craftingstation>Loom</craftingstation> was retrieved. It should be placed in the base to unlock padding kits for better armor.
cn: 已取回<craftingstation>织布机</craftingstation>，将其放置在基地中以解锁填充工具并制作更好的护甲。

en:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

Flames swallow a town, and the sky is set alight. Chaos reigns as the Drak reappear in the Veilwater Basin. No defenders are visible.
cn:
详细记载着卓克的历史的浮雕。

火焰吞噬了一座城镇，天空也被火光照亮了。卓克再度出现在幕水盆地并带来了混乱。这里看不到任何防守者。

en: We're all homesick, myself included... if you can build me a room, I could help you make the place feel a bit more like home. How about it?
cn: 我知道大家都想家了……不过如果你可以给我准备一个房间的话，我可以帮助你为这个地方带来更多家的氛围，怎么样？

en: Flameborn, I've been speaking to Emily and I'm in love! No, not with her, with the Kindlewastes! The fiery sunsets, the clear skies, the abundant harvests before the drought... I want to see this vibrancy myself! Emily thinks you could find such colors in a town or near a farm. Anywhere where people would dye their clothes or other fabrics! Maybe a color palette like that will bring us a little piece of the desert!
cn: 火之子，最近我一直在跟艾米丽聊天，我感觉我恋爱了！不不不，我没有爱上她，我是爱上燃火荒原了！火热的落日，万里无云的晴空，还有干旱来临前的丰饶收获……我想要亲眼见证那里的磅礴生机！艾米丽觉得你应该可以在城镇或者是农场附近寻找符合条件的色彩。留意过去的人们为衣服和布料染色的地方！也许像那样的调色板能够给我们带来一丝沙漠风情！
青铜海卓克·达尔战利品
青铜瘴气魔幼龙战利品

en: Hello! Is it me you're looking for?
cn: 你好！请问你是在找我吗？

en: No two haircuts are ever alike.
cn: 每一个发型都是独一无二。

en: Repair The Wall Tapestry With A Frame

A music sheet for a song that bestows a minor boost in morale. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 这张乐谱中记载了能够振奋士气的激昂乐曲。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: This plant is notable due to its stunning electrifying colorway, its delicate petals, and its deadly poison.
cn: 这种植物以其像闪电一般鲜亮的黄色、娇嫩的花朵以及其中蕴含的致命毒素而闻名于世。

en: Harvest Gloomberries At Night In The Revelwood
cn: 在夜晚的喧嚣森林采集暗夜果

en: Craft Or Obtain A Drak Soulward Flask
cn: 制作或获取一个卓克 御灵药水

en: A light shield that effortlessly allows the wearer to stay nimble whilst under fire.
cn: 这块轻便的盾牌能够帮助使用者在遭遇攻击时依旧灵活移动。

en: Fell Enemies, Springlands Shroud and Revelwood Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔敌人，春日平原与喧嚣森林瘴气区

en: Our Eye Towards The Stars, Forever Shut
cn: 我们向往星辰的眼睛永远阖上了

en:
A deep, royal purple dominates this color palette. The color seems to draw you in like the glimmering inside of an amethyst geode.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn:
深沉且尊贵的紫色是这种调色板中毋庸置疑的王者。就像是紫水晶晶洞的璀璨内核，你不有自主地便被这种迷人的色彩所吸引。

可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en: "Orville" must've been a nice place once. Wish I could've brought my daughter there for a vacation.
cn: “奥威尔”以前肯定是个很不错的地方。只可惜我没能带我的女儿去那里度过假。
提高所有魔法寒冰伤害

en: The foundation for every new adventure is a good night's sleep.
cn: 每一次新冒险都离不开一夜好眠。
淹没的地下室中的箱子

en: The added leather grants superior protection from jagged rocks, unruly tree bark, and incoming arrows.
cn: 加厚的皮革提供更强的防护，无论是崎岖的岩石、粗糙的树皮，还是射来的箭矢，都能为你抵挡一二。

en: Two-Handed Melee weapon damage is increased by %k.
cn: 双手近战武器伤害提高%k。

en: Increases the skill level of Veiled Vigor
cn: 提高隐蔽活力的技能等级

en: The delicious foods of the desert are quite underestimated due to the harsh environments that they need to survive in. The Yucca Fruit is known to prove all prejudices wrong. It is just as juicy as it looks!
cn: 因为生长在恶劣环境中而被人忽视，但其实这是一种十分美味的沙漠食物。鲜美多汁，只需咬下一口丝兰果就会让人欲罢不能！

1.2	
本协议涉及的内容为您使用冒险分享功能的相关事宜。冒险分享是 Enshrouded 内提供的免费游戏功能。因此，本冒险分享条款为独立条款，是对当前版本的 Enshrouded 使用条款（详见 https://enshrouded.com/eula）的补充。此外，使用冒险分享功能还应遵守购买 Enshrouded 时所通过的相关平台（例如 Steam 或任何类似平台，统称为“平台”）的条款。如果本《冒险分享条款》与相关平台条款之间存在任何冲突，应以平台条款为准。除非另有约定，当本冒险分享条款与其他协议发生任何冲突时，作为 Enshrouded 的免费游戏功能，使用冒险分享时所应遵循的条款的优先级如下：

-	Enshrouded 使用条款 
-	冒险分享条款

en: The north wind carried them downstream. They hail from the faraway crags, monolithic and stalwart — cyclopic gaze peering towards the dancing gusts of light on the horizon. Drawn to the shimmer like moths to a flame, and fatefully greedy. They fled once, burnt and hollowed by the curse. Do not show them mercy. They'd crush you to dust given the chance.
cn: 北风裹挟着它们。它们来自于遥远的深谷，巨大而又坚定的独眼窥视着地平线上跃动着的光芒。就像被火焰吸引的飞蛾一样，它们注定将贪婪地追随闪烁的光芒。在被诅咒灼伤并转化为空荡骸骨之后它们便逃到了深处。面对它们的时候不要手下留情，因为它们也绝不会对你展现出一丝的怜悯。
在执行动作时无法交互

en: The <craftingstation>Almanac of Plants and Seedlings</craftingstation> was looted by Scavengers. They took their loot to <location>Surat's Rest</location>.
cn: <craftingstation>植物与幼苗图鉴</craftingstation>被拾荒者拿走了。他们把战利品带到了<location>苏拉特之息</location>。

en:
The <npc>Collector</npc>, Alden Crowley, could sense something had changed in the upper world in their absence. The Shroud was a new phenomenon to them. 

They consider such "mortal matters" to be negligible and seem unimpressed by impending doom.
cn:
<npc>收藏家</npc>埃尔登·克劳利感受到自己不在的这段时间里，地面世界发生了巨大的变化。瘴气对于此人来说是一种全新的存在。

克劳利对于“这种俗世之物”不屑一顾，而且似乎并不担心即将来临的末日。

en: A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 散发着黯淡蓝光的扭曲魔棒。它渴望着新的主人！ 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: With their simplicity, these pants bring balance to the outfit and allow the wearer’s presence to shine.
cn: 这些设计简洁的裤子能够平衡整套打扮的氛围并让穿戴者展现出最闪耀的气质。

en: The spark of knowledge has erupted within. Ready yourself to unveil the secrets of our past. Find the Springlands obelisk to learn the world's fate, a story of rot and fire. Only those who seek the truth shall find it.
cn: 知识的火花已在内心迸发。准备好揭开我们过去的秘密吧。找到春日平原方尖碑，了解这个世界的命运，一个关于腐烂和火焰的故事。只有寻求真理的人才能找到它。

en: Haunted Sun Temples? Why, I lived near one — It was awful! See, our temples are hallowed halls and burial sites, honoring the Ancients! The Spark there is fed by prayer and shields our dead from harm! But as the Shroud spread, it's light dulled. Maybe our faith wavered when the catacombs came alive. Metal clanks! Dark whispers! I held my prayers inside the tavern ever since. So spooky!
cn: 闹鬼的太阳神殿？正好我就住在一个神庙附近，那真是太可怕了！我们的寺庙是神圣的殿堂和埋葬地，用来纪念远古者！那里的余火的力量源于祈祷，它们能保佑逝者不受伤害！但随着瘴气的扩散，它的光芒也暗淡了。也许当地下墓穴活过来的时候，我们的信仰就动摇了。金属撞击声！黑暗的低语！从那时起，我就一直在酒馆里祈祷。太诡异了！

en: As an alloy of both iron and carbon, steel possesses better resistance and therefore provides more protection when used in armor.
cn: 作为铁以及碳的合金，钢拥有更优越的耐腐蚀与牢固性，因此用钢制作的护甲往往能够提供更好的防护。

en: The Fisher spoke about a force that ravages the Veilwater Basin with maws like snapjaws, talons like vultures, and a thirst for blood. He wants you to slay one of these beasts and bring back a keepsake so you can better understand your new enemy. You can find these beasts anywhere, but a convenient location is marked on the map.
cn: 渔夫提到了肆虐幕水盆地的一股势力，它们拥有着像大白鲨一样的巨颚，像秃鹫一样的利爪以及嗜血渴望。 他希望你去杀掉一只怪物并将纪念品带回来，这样你们将可以更好地理解这些新出现的敌人。 你可以在任意地点找到这些野兽，但是地图上已经标记了一处合适的地点。

en: A head piece to keep your skull safe when diving into battle.
cn: 能够在战斗中保护你的脑壳的头盔。

en: Gabrielle Fairburn, ready to serve and protect! Give me a bad guy to beat — or better yet, a dragon to slay — and I'll take care of 'em to keep you safe!
cn: 加布里埃尔·菲尔伯恩，为你服务！无论是恶棍还是恶龙，我都将保护你！

en:
ARMOR
Each "Physical Armor" point reduces damage for all physical damage types by 1.

RESISTANCE
Each "Physical Resistance" percentage further reduces all physical damage.
cn:
护甲
每点“物理护甲”使所有物理类型的伤害减少1点。

抗性
“物理抗性”百分比将进一步减少所有物理伤害。

en: Something from below has awoken. An evil, a sickness... corruption from within. With shaking hands, I loosened a cobblestone from the dry basement wall, revealing a festering mold. The source of the rot... below all this time... I buried it under rubble and ash, but it shan't suffice... The blighted root lies too deep to dig out. It'll likely sprout again, and again, and again...
cn: 地下有某种东西苏醒了。某种疫病……腐化正从那邪恶之中崛起。当我颤抖着取下地下室干墙里的一块石头时，我发现底下已经长有腐烂的霉菌。原来腐烂的根源……一直以来就在这底下…… 我已经用碎石和灰烬将之掩埋，但恐怕这么做并不足够……腐化的根源还在无法挖掘的深处。它很有可能会再次发芽，永无止境……

en:
You've discovered that a group of Scavengers in the Nomad Highlands found a cat. They want to name it but also plan to eat it if their supplies run out.

Reach the next Scavengers camp and tame the cat to rescue it!
cn:
你得知游牧高地里的一群拾荒者找到了一只猫。他们想要给猫咪起名，但同时也准备在补给耗尽时将猫作为应急口粮。

抵达下一座拾荒者营地，然后驯服并解救里面的猫！

en: You’ve likely never worn foot armor this light, but give it a shot — the chest plate’s weight needs counterbalancing somewhere.
cn: 你从来没有穿过如此轻盈的足具，但是不用担心，这都是为了补偿胸甲的重量。

en: Simple leather boots — a perfect fit.
cn: 简朴的皮革靴子，踩进去十分合脚。

en: This stone serves as the centerpiece of a mill.
cn: 这块大石头是石磨的核心。

en: Ignited by the Flame itself, this bow pulses with the power of fire.
cn: 被灵火点燃的这把弓能够发挥火焰之力。

en:
One of the worlds you shared has been removed from Adventure Sharing, because its name violated our Terms of Use.
You can share your world again after changing its name to comply with the Terms of Use. Please note that repeated violations may result in a revocation of your ability to share worlds via Adventure Sharing.
cn:
你分享的其中一个世界已被移出冒险分享，原因：世界名称违反使用条款。
如果想要重新分享世界，请更改世界名称并确保其符合使用条款规定。请注意，重复违反规定有可能导致你被剥夺通过冒险分享分享世界的权利。

en: The pants were made from varied materials and protect all the most important areas adequately.
cn: 裤子由各种材料制成，能充分保护所有最重要的部位。

en: A refreshing jug of buttermilk. With its lightly sour flavor and silky texture, it's very refreshing.
cn: 一壶清爽的白脱牛奶。略带酸味的丝滑口感喝起来十分爽口。

en: The Ancient Spires And Fast Travel

The warm brown and dusty green hues remind you of old leather-bound books with frayed bookmarks and copper clasps.

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
cn:
温暖的褐色与风尘仆仆的绿色让你想起了皮革封面的陈旧书籍，上面还能看见被磨得起皮的书签与红铜书夹。

可以使用游牧高地材料制作这种调色板。

en: Change the active blueprint while this item is selected.
cn: 选定此物品时更改已激活的蓝图。

en: 13.3 Place of Jurisdiction: With respect to (i) users who are not consumers, (ii) consumers who have no residence in Germany at the time the agreement is concluded or who move their residence abroad after the agreement is concluded, and (iii) consumers whose habitual residence is unknown at the time an action is brought, the place of jurisdiction and place of performance shall be Frankfurt am Main. In all other respects, the place of jurisdiction shall be determined in accordance with the general rules.
cn:
13.3	
管辖地：对于 (i) 非消费者用户，(ii) 在订立本协议时在德国无住所或协议订立后将住所迁往国外的消费者，以及 (iii) 提起诉讼时常居地不明的消费者，管辖地和履行地为美因河畔法兰克福。在所有其他情况下，管辖地根据一般规则确定。
找到<location>狄亚德温</location>中的建筑方块

en: Craft A Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls Key
cn: 制作一把阿尔班耶夫山脉空荡礼堂钥匙

en: Make space in the factory inventory
cn: 在工坊物品栏中腾出空间

en:
The Collector has entrusted you with a task. The Kindlewastes Hollow Halls hide 3 magical artifacts inside. Find them to display them in your base!

There are multiple hiding spots for the artifacts. Search for secret passageways and keep your eyes open!

The location of the Kindlewastes Hollow Halls will appear on your map when you've found it through exploration or accepted the next Collector quest. The latter will become available once you're at a high enough level.
cn:
收藏家委托你一项任务。 燃火荒原 空荡礼堂 里面藏有 3 件魔法文物。找到它们并将它们展示在你的基地中！

神器有多个藏匿点。搜索秘密通道并睁大眼睛！

当您通过探索或接受下一个收藏家任务找到 燃火荒原 空荡礼堂 时，它的位置就会出现在您的地图上。后者将在您达到足够高的等级后出现。

en: Reached an ancient spire in the Veilwater Basin.
cn: 抵达幕水盆地的远古尖塔。

en: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Polaris' Memoir: I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky To find your path, you must look to me only Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely
cn: 在阿尔班耶夫山脉的一具巨龙骸骨上找到的藏宝图碎片。如果找齐所有碎片，也许你就可以拼凑出完整的地图。 地图碎片的背面写着字： 北极星的回忆录： 我是高悬在天空的闪亮星星 为了找到前进的道路，你的眼中只能容得下我 低头俯瞰世界，难以否认 无依无靠，我的心中只有孤寂

en: You've reached the designated spot for taming a Yak. Now tame a Yak with the food bait by carefully approaching, feeding, and petting it. Once the Yak is comfortable, it can be picked up and brought home for wool!
cn:
你已经抵达驯服牦牛的指定地点。现在使用食物诱饵来驯服一只牦牛，小心靠近目标，然后喂食并抚摸它。

当牦牛信任你之后，你可以将其捡起并带回家，之后就可以从它身上采集毛料！

en: Do you want to swim faster? You should visit Goldrock Saddle!
cn: 想要游得更快？你得去拜访金石鞍！

en: A natural plant, remains of the agriculture left behind, that grows in the world. It offers protection from the elements when used as building material.
cn: 一种四处生长的天然植物，是过去农业的遗产。当用作建筑材料时，它能抵御风雨。

en: Let me tell you a tale, traveler!
cn: 旅人啊，就让我来给你讲述一个故事吧！

en: With the farmer’s guidance, you can prepare refined meals at this kitchen station.
cn: 在农民的指导下，你将可以在这个厨房中准备精致料理。
阿尔班耶夫山脉骸骨钥匙

en: Sturdy gloves that protect the hands while exploring. The red markings on them represent bravery.
cn: 坚固的手套可以在探险时保护双手。上面的红色标记是勇敢的象征。

en:
8.2.2	
In cases of slight negligence, Keen shall be liable in the event of a breach of an essential contractual obligation. For the purposes of this Section, an essential contractual obligation is an obligation whose fulfillment is necessary to make the performance of the agreement possible in the first place and on whose fulfillment the contractual partner may therefore regularly rely.
cn:
8.2.2	
在存在轻微过失的情况下，若违反了一项基本合同义务，Keen 应承担相应责任。就本条而言，基本合同义务是指：其履行是合同得以实际履行的基本前提，因此合同方通常可以信赖该义务会得到履行。

en: You can expand your home in different ways. Upgrading the Flame Altar increases the building range. Strengthening the Flame increases your protection against the Shroud and allows you to build more bases. Build a second Flame Altar in the outer wilds, anywhere you'd like.
cn: 您可以通过不同的方式扩建房屋。升级灵火祭坛可以增加建造范围。强化灵火可以增加对瘴气的防护，并允许您建造更多的基地。 您可以在荒野的任何地方建造第二个灵火祭坛。
瘴气魔野猪，喧嚣森林瘴气区

en: A finely crafted helmet, usually worn by the kingdom's most feared warriors and generals.
cn: 精雕细琢的头盔，通常由王国最强大的战士和将军佩戴。

en:
The <npc>Alchemist</npc> is convinced that another Ancient Vault may house survivors which could help with base building and storage.

Find the Ancient Vault he mentioned!
cn:
<npc>炼金术士</npc>认为另一处远古密室中的幸存者也许能够帮助建造基地与仓库。

找到了他提到的远古密室！

en: These grilled algae buds can be sprinkled on your food to maximize flavor. They have added health benefits, too!
cn: 这些烤制好的藻球能够撒在食物上增添风味。它们还可以提供额外的生命值增益！

en: This golden, steel-tipped arrow has been dipped in poison. A strike with this will be most deadly. Poisoned Arrow: Wildlife and Wild Beast hit by this arrow are poisoned and receive 24 damage per second for 5 seconds.
cn: 淬有剧毒的金色钢箭，被此箭射中将产生致命危害。 毒箭：被此箭射中的野生生物将中毒，并且将每秒承受24点伤害，持续5秒。

en: The Elixir, A Flood Of Woe
Only players using this password can join.
cn: 只有使用此密码的玩家才能加入。

en: Here Lie The Greatest Waterscape Builders
cn: 最伟大的水景建造者们长眠于此

en: The Alchemist has informed you that you're suffering from Hemotoxins. To craft a cure for this ailment, you must acquire spider glands and moths. The moths can only be caught at night. Craft the hemotoxin antidote and use it!
cn: 炼金术士告诉你说，你已经患上了毒血。为了制作特效药，你需要设法获取蜘蛛腺体与飞蛾。 你只能够在夜间捕捉飞蛾。 制作并使用毒血解毒剂！

en: Lightning and ice fuse together to unleash a groundbreaking force. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 闪电与寒冰的结合将释放出惊天动地的力量。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: Even the most carefully cooked Ectoplasm Soup still tastes a little bit... fermented.
cn: 无论是经过多少道精细烹调工序，灵质浓汤依旧有股……发酵过度的怪味。

en: A building material made from Sandstone, fitting the colors of the desert. It was created for architectural monuments.
cn: 使用砂岩制作的建筑材料，拥有着与沙漠如出一辙的颜色。最初被用于制作各类建筑奇观。

en: These capybara bristles can be woven into your clothing to help you glide through the water more easily and prevent you from cooling down too quickly.
cn: 将这些水豚鬃毛缝入衣物之后，你就可以轻松自如地在水中游荡，而且温暖的鬃毛还可以减慢你的失温速度。

en:
Another binding uses the same inputs in a different order.

Use with caution.
cn:
有另一个绑定使用了与此相同的输入（顺序不同）。

请谨慎使用。

en: You are not alone. There are other survivors, drowsing in nearby Ancient Vaults. Find them so they may aid in your journey. Go gently — one beckons nearby, just outside of the Shroud's grasp.
cn: 你并不孤单。还有其他幸存者在附近的远古密室中休眠。找到他们，他们就能帮助你完成旅程。有一个就在不远处，瘴气之外。

en: A well-crafted shield marked by a golden sun. Strong, reliable, and radiant — built to hold the line when all else falters.
cn: 做工精美的盾牌，表面有一个黄金的太阳标记。强大、可靠而且金碧辉煌——哪怕周围的一切都分崩离析，它也永远屹立不倒。

en: Eons ago, our realm was barren. Endless wastes stretched out in every direction, and the skies above were coated in a thick, black tar. Then, the firmament cracked open to reveal a shimmering sea. A flood of shooting stars sprung forth, leaving trails of color and wind as they painted our horizon. On impact, they pushed and pulled our ground asunder. Soon, our wilds were marked by mountains, valleys, and water. But not all stars gave life. Some sought to claim it. Two swords rained down from above — one lesser, one greater — and struck our alabaster crests. One slumbered beneath fresh snow and gentian blooms, another was swallowed by the skyward maw of a cave. Were they bad omens? Relics from a duel in the endless expanse? A gift from the Ancients? We may never know.
cn: 亘古之前，我们的王国一片荒芜。无尽的荒原向四面八方延伸，密不透风的黑色焦油覆盖着头顶的天空。 当苍穹开裂，波光粼粼的汪洋便显露无疑。流星如洪水般涌出，在我们的地平线上留下色彩和风的痕迹。 从天而降的流星使得大地支离破碎。很快，我们的荒原中就出现了高山、峡谷与流水。但并不是所有的星星都能孕育生命，有些星星的目的恰恰相反。 两把宝剑从天而降，一大一小的双剑击中了我们的雪白山峰。一把沉睡在新雪和龙胆花下，另一把则被朝向天空的洞穴之口吞噬。 究竟它们是某种噩兆？来自无尽浩瀚之中的决斗的遗物？或者是远古者的馈赠？也许我们永远无从知晓。

en: Healing a target to full health has a %k chance to restore an equal amount of Mana.
cn: 为一个目标恢复全部生命值，有%k几率恢复等量法力。

en: This axe is eerily precise. The hair on your arms stands up as you wield it.
cn: 锋利到让人不寒而栗的斧子，拿着这把斧子的时候会感觉手上的毛发都立了起来。

en:
We've been split. Ripped apart like a twin-headed eel.

The discordance in our midsts sunders our youngest from the empyrean — a new chapter at last. They wish to protect the ephemeral flame, inspired by the hearthlights and fireflies of humankind.

We will all shift and fall. At last, we stumble.
cn:
我们被分裂了，就像双头鳗一样。

我们中间的差异阻断了年轻一代与宇宙的联系，新的篇章终于展开。他们希望保护受人类炉火和萤火虫激发的转瞬即逝的火焰。

我们都会蜕变与陨落。最后，我们蹒跚而行。

en: Emily Fray's Diary, End of Midyear, 505 D.A.
cn: 艾米丽·弗莱的日记，岁中之末，505 D.A.

en: Whatever it is, I can enchant it!
cn: 不管是什么，我都能为它附魔！

en: Remains of metal, which was present to witness humanity's downfall. They might turn out to be useful.
cn: 见证人类陨落过程的金属残骸。说不定能够派上其他的用处。

en: Bonus protection against Shroud type magic, in addition to the general magic resistance.
cn: 除了常规魔法抗性外，提供针对瘴气魔法的额外防御。

en: Do you know why I became a reporter? I saw all the mismanagement, the lies, the decay of my home — <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location> — after Gormander took over. He tried to wipe every trace of his mother away and even disassembled her statue! I have a lead on one of the pieces. Care to take back her legacy?
cn: 你知不知道我为什么选择当记者？当时我亲眼见证了腐败与谎言横行，我的家园就此一蹶不振……<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>……就在戈曼德继位之后。他试图抹除自己母亲生前的一切痕迹，甚至还派人拆毁了她的雕塑！现在我已经掌握了其中一块碎片的线索。有兴趣帮我重塑她的遗产吗？

en: This blade is razor-sharp like the fangs of the terrifying creatures that prowl the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 这把无比尖锐的利刃就像是在游牧高地中徘徊的可怕怪物们的獠牙。

en: The Shroud rolled over our hide-out like a tidal wave, frothing and thunderous! We rang the alarm, tried to save the shipment — but amidst the flurry, Reynauld froze in place and simply stared! Dismas reached out to him, shook him, tried to drag him off... they were both swept away... Eryn swung past me, diving into the blue to grab a chest of cheap trinkets! I turned to her, yelling her name as she flew by, but she was hellbent! With a breaking voice, I called out again, into the nothingness, the void... no response. I didn't stop running until my legs gave out.
cn: 瘴气就像是滔天巨浪一般席卷了我们的藏身点，那响声简直跟打雷一样！我们立刻拉响了警报并试着挽救货物……在混乱当中，雷纳德被吓得一动不动，就只是傻愣愣地盯着看！迪斯马斯伸手想要摇醒他，还想要把他给拖回来……但最后他们两个人都被卷走了…… 艾琳从我身边冲了出去，接着又潜入了那些蓝色瘴气中并试图拿走一个装满廉价饰品的箱子。我转过身想要把她喊回来，但她根本不愿意停下来！接着只听见一声巨响，之后我再次呼喊她的名字，可是那里只剩下了一片虚无……毫无回应。 我根本不敢回头，只是一个劲地往外跑到双腿软瘫。

en: A light and swift sword of beautiful color. It dulls quickly, though.
cn: 色泽美丽的剑，轻便好用，缺点在于很容易就会变钝。

en: Read all obelisks in the Springlands.
cn: 查看春日平原中的所有方尖碑。

en: An object that allows you to display your instruments.
cn: 此物件将允许你展示自己的乐器。

en: This ornate handpan is perfect. Now, what was the melody I planned to play? Duu, duu, duu, du-du-du, duu, duu, duu...
cn: 这个精美的手碟非常完美。好了，我之前打算演奏什么旋律来着？嘟、嘟、嘟、嘟嘟嘟、嘟、嘟、嘟……

en: A music sheet that contains a thought-provoking tune. Snow falls ever so slowly when pondering the past. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 这张乐谱上记载着一段发人深省的旋律。置身于飘雪之下并沉思过往。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: Perform a Sneak Attack by sneaking up to an unaware enemy and pressing %k. Sneak Attack deals +900%% increased damage.
cn: 潜行至未警觉的敌人的身后并按%k发动一次隐秘攻击。 隐秘攻击造成额外+900%%伤害。

en: A finely milled powder made from critter parts.
cn: 由甲虫部位精磨而成的粉末。

en: You've reached the first location that holds a balefire. Approach the fire atop the tower near the end of the garrison and light it to proceed!
cn: 你已经抵达了第一处篝火所在的位置。 抵达兵营尽头附近的高塔并点燃顶部的篝火以继续！

en: Despite its angelic looks, this sugary sweet cinnamon-colored cat is a gleeful little rascal who likes getting into trouble! You can never be too mad, though. Just look at those beautiful, sapphire blue eyes!
cn: 不要被纯洁的外表给欺骗，这只肉桂色的甜美小猫其实是一个喜欢惹麻烦的小捣蛋鬼！但是你永远也无法对它真正生气。看看那些像蓝宝石一样美丽的大眼睛！
一条平淡无奇的皮革长裤。

en: Find The Golden Ball In The Water

Colored like rusted metal, slate, and copper.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
锈蚀金属、石板与红铜的颜色。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。

en: A tender, raw slab of fatty meat. It is uncooked, and therefore not consumable.
cn: 一大块生的五花肉。还没有经过烹饪，因此无法食用。

en: A sturdy pair of pants that will take you wherever your heart desires.
cn: 这条牢固的裤子将陪伴着你前往心中向往之地。

en: 13.4 Transferability: Keen has the right to transfer the rights and obligations arising from this agreement to a third party. In such a case, you have the right to withdraw from the agreement.
cn:
13.4	
可转让性：Keen 有权将本协议规定的权利和义务转让给第三方。在此情况下，您有权解除本协议。

en:
8.2.7	
Any further liability of Keen is excluded.
cn:
8.2.7	
Keen 的任何追加责任均予以排除。

en: A little swig of hot tea will get my creative juices flowing, I just know it!
cn: 抿一口热茶应该就能够唤醒我的创意，肯定是这样！

en: Aye, small fry! Over 'ere! I got a story for ya!
cn: 喂小虾米！快过来！听我给你讲个故事！

en: Flame-touched friend, I must propose a task. Surely... surely, you hate them too. The Cyclops haunt both the highest highs and deepest halls. I want their bones, propped up on a little pedestal, shiny and white, chalky and pure. Stripped of flesh and sin. You've soothed my burning anger before, so I'm sure you can do it again.
cn: 被灵火触碰的朋友啊，我现在有一个不情之请。相信……你肯定也讨厌那些巨大的家伙。我指的是盘踞在高山与地牢之中的独眼巨人。我想要他们的骨头，用洁白闪亮的骨头搭起一座小小的祭坛。记得要剥离上面的血肉与罪孽。之前你曾经安抚了我熊熊燃烧的怒火，我相信这次你也不会让我失望。

en: These black and gold gloves once carried the knowledge and secrets of the humans. Don't be intimidated by the power they literally once held.
cn: 这些黑金色的手套曾经承载着人类的知识与奥秘。不要被它们曾经掌握的力量所吓到。

en: Miscreants, brutes, and evil doers of the past would often wield similar blades. Perhaps this weapon was forged in the shadows of a back alley and changed hands on the black market.
cn: 旧日的暴徒、恶棍与邪恶之人往往挥舞着类似的武器。也许这把大剑确实是在阴暗背街小巷之中锻造，并且还在黑市中几经转手。

en: Health gain from healing spells and skills is increased by %k.
cn: 治疗法术与技能额外提供%k生命值。

en: Used in the backpack, storage, equipment, and some crafting stations
cn: 用于背包、仓库、装备以及部分制作站

en: Here Lie The Creators Of Fantastic Waterworlds
cn: 奇妙水世界的创作者们长眠于此

en:
Rich, deep hues of green evoke the jungle and thickets you must navigate. A touch of red is added, like the red ginger flowers that appear here and there, breaking up the sea of green.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
浓郁而且深沉的绿色能够让你想起不得不跋涉穿越的灌木密林。些许的红色点缀则像是打破一成不变的碧海的红色姜花。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: Defeat an enemy to restore Durability
cn: 打败一名敌人以恢复耐久

en: You've placed the cat in your home! Now craft a cat bowl and a cat bed to make your new pet happy!
cn: 你已经将猫放置在你的家中！现在制作一个猫碗和一个猫窝，让你的新宠物能够在这里快乐生活！

en: I object to the use of my uploaded content for marketing purposes.
cn: 我反对将我上传的内容用于营销目的。

en: An old greatsword that's begun to decay. The steel's purity has been stripped away by rust.
cn: 已经开始腐朽的陈旧大剑。钢铁的纯洁性已经被锈蚀殆尽。
装备的物品（见装备菜单）

en: That cure worked wonders on you, friend! You seem back to your old self.
cn: 解药起作用了，我的朋友！你看上去已经焕然一新。

en: This wand hides a rare frozen core inside, enabling its owner to unleash massive ice damage against foes. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 这根魔棒内部隐藏着一个罕见的冰冻核心，使用时能够对敌人造成巨大的寒冰伤害。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: Critical Strikes with Cutting damage cause bleeding on the enemy, dealing %k damage per second for %k.
cn: 劈砍伤害造成暴击时，对敌人施加流血，对其每秒造成%k伤害，持续%k。

en: An advanced arrow with a bronze tip.
cn: 装有青铜尖头的高级箭矢。

en: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.
cn: 质朴的食物，食用后能够提供持久的近战伤害加成。与其他食材搭配起来风味更佳。

en: Replaces the Dodge Roll ability with a short-range teleport. Blink also replaces the sideways Dodge Roll of the Strategic Maneuver skill. Cost: 20 Stamina
cn: 用短距离传送取代翻滚能力。 将战术机动技能的侧向翻滚替换为闪现。 消耗：20点体力

en: A pair of charcoal black, loosely fitted pants. The larger silhouette stems from the extensive wool padding inside.
cn: 一条深黑色的宽松裤子。内侧缝制的大量毛料衬垫使得裤子的轮廓显得更大。

en: You've reached the entrance of the Haunted Sun Temple. Now it's time to step inside and lift the curse! Find whatever is haunting the Haunted Sun Temple and defeat it!
cn: 你已经抵达闹鬼太阳神殿的入口。现在是时候进去破解诅咒了！找到在闹鬼太阳神殿作祟的罪魁祸首并将其击败！

en:
A sleek fish with a vivid yellow fin, also known for its quick bursts of speed.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
长着鲜亮黄色鱼鳍的修长鱼类，同时也因为其迅猛的速度而出名。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。

en: They call this "Enshrouded Ice"? Marvelous. It doesn't melt or lose its shape, and it's forever tinged in this... breathing turquoise. Genius! Turquoise, of course! Alright, time to put this enshrouded ice away. It won't be a good addition to my tea — and I need my tea to focus, because dear, I'm about to mix the most refreshing color of the century!
cn: 他们管这叫“瘴气寒冰”？不可思议。拿在手上也不会融化或者变形，而且永远都带着这一抹……动人心弦的青绿色。太奇妙了！青绿色！好了，快把瘴气寒冰收起来吧。要是把这玩意加进茶里面就糟了，我需要集中精神，因为接下来我要调配的可是前所未有的清新色彩！

en: Unlock recipes by collecting items and gaining knowledge.
cn: 通过收集物品与知识解锁配方

en: Click-clack, click-clack — You hear the sound of her raised heel from a mile away, piercing the ground with unyielding staccato. As her steps quicken, so does your breath. Do not get caught in her path.
cn: 啪嗒、啪嗒 - 哪怕相隔甚远，你也能够听见她高高抬起的鞋跟有条不紊地刺穿地面时发出的声响。随着脚步声愈来愈近，你的呼吸也随之加快。千万不要阻挡她的去路。

en: Good. Even a small tool holds the power to create remedies... or poison. Let's craft some better gear.
cn: 很好。就算是小小的工具也蕴含着创造解药……或毒药的力量。让我们来制作更好的装备吧。

en: Tools have a %k chance to restore 1 durability on hit.
cn: 工具有%k几率在命中目标时恢复1点耐久。

en: The yellow color of flowers stored in a powder.
cn: 用黄色花朵加工而成的染料粉末。

en: A collection of tools — the heart of every smithy.
cn: 这些琳琅满目的工具便是每一座铁匠铺的心脏。

en: The time for glory is now. Bask in its glow. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 荣耀的时刻已经到来，感受那璀璨光芒吧。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: You've learned about an old sea captain. Perhaps this person could be ideal for guiding you through these unknown waters and the dangers that lie beneath. The captain often traveled to a nearby island. Reach the island and search for the remains of a pure soul there!
cn: 你了解到了一位老船长的存在。也许此人能够指引你穿越未知水域并避开隐藏在水面下的危险。 船长经常会去附近的一座岛屿。抵达岛屿并在那里寻找纯洁灵魂的残骸！

en: A mana potion with higher concentration, instantly restoring a great amount of mana upon use.
cn: 高浓度的法力药水，服用后能够立刻恢复大量法力。

en: Let me know what you need.
cn: 如果有什么需要的尽管告诉我。

en: The Shroud has torn Embervale asunder. Now that ya brought me back to life, I don't even recognize the place. Try to get a better view at the top of that Ancient Spire over yonder.
cn: 瘴气已经把薪谷变得面目全非。被你唤醒之后，我才意识到这里有多么陌生。试着爬上远古尖塔的顶部吧，那样你一定就能好好俯瞰周围的环境。

en:
When I thought it wise to stay overnight at the construction site, I thought wrong. 
I worked myself to the bone, heaving wooden beams all by myself long after the others had left. King Gormander wants this outpost finished afore Rimgard's troops breach the border... It won't change much, I reckon, but it's not my place to pipe up.

During a brief moment of rest, I dozed off. What followed was either a dream or a warning: The ground shook. A deep vibration, rhythmic and distant, reverberated into my ear and echoed through my head like a tidal wave.

While I could feel it, my eyes were blind in the dark. Is Vorgoth drawing near already, or has a different threat arrived? I could not say.

Tomorrow, I'll stay overnight once more... I'll have confirmation soon enough!
cn:
我原本还以为晚上留在工地是个明智的选择，谁想到真是大错特错。
我差点没把自己累死，因为其他人都走了，所以我只好一个人去搬那些沉甸甸的木梁。戈曼德国王希望我们在里姆加德的部队突破边境前完成这座哨所……我觉得这么做恐怕无济于事，但这事也轮不到我来决定。

中间休息的时候，我一不小心就打起了瞌睡。我不知道接下来的事情到底是自己在做梦，还是说是某种警告。总而言之我感觉大地都颤抖了起来，遥远、带有节奏的深沉震动一直在我耳旁回响，就像是潮汐波浪一样冲刷着我的脑海。

当时我的眼前一片漆黑，所以那一切都是我用身体感受到的。是沃格斯的军队已经逼近，还是说有一个截然不同的威胁已经来了？这我无法确定。

我决定明天继续熬夜工作……这样我肯定就能确定了！

en: A practical and quick bow made from humble pine wood. Its tension is weak, so using it requires little stamina.
cn: 使用朴实无华的松木制作而成的实用快弓。虽然弓弦张力不高，但反过来也意味着不需要消耗太多体力。

en:
Your search for a celebratory outfit has led you to a temple ruin. 

Investigate the structure to acquire the cosmetic items!
cn:
为了寻找节日装扮，你来到了一座神殿废墟。

调查这里的建筑以获取外观物品！

en: Enter And Loot The Locked Room
cn: 进入并搜刮上锁的房间

en: An ingredient used in crafting recipes.

Ikora's shop is empty, and Rattlebleak is filled with strange, calcified statues. Perhaps this is related to Ikora's experiments with the Black Cauldron. Following the trail of statues might lead to her.
cn: 依科拉的店铺空无一人，而荒啸镇之中则充斥着奇怪的钙化雕像。也许这跟依科拉的黑坩埚实验有关。说不定一路上的雕像就是找到她的线索。

en: When we found solace from the snowstorm here, we were simply glad to have shelter. The outcrops left and right looked like stone formations through the blurring winds. Only just now did I realize that we weren't surrounded by stone, but ribs. Real, giant, well-preserved, ivory ribs — lying amidst a set of 6 limbs. We've decided to settle and take samples, mostly because Fran is thrilled to research the skeleton. She calls it "Ony" because "the letters look like a tailed animal with 6 limbs, bowing down to drink." She's smiling ear to ear while brushing dust off the cartilage, but I can hardly look at her. The gashes on her face are still fresh, and I fear they're my fault. I might as well have scarred her face myself. Maybe letting her stay will allow me to repent. — Loraine Crim, Yearfall, 508 D.A.
cn: 当我们终于找到了一个能够躲避暴风雪侵扰的庇护所，我们感到无比庆幸。这个地方左右两侧的凸起部分就像是某种石头建筑一般抵御着外面呼啸而过的寒风。到现在我才意识到，其实我们身边不是石头，而是肋骨。 巨大的、保存良好的、象牙一般的肋骨，我数了数总共有6根。我们决定就地扎营并采集样本，主要是因为弗兰已经迫不及待想要研究这具骷髅。她决定给骷髅起名叫“奥尼”（onni），因为“这个名字看上去就像是一只长了6只脚的动物在趴着喝水。” 她边说边开心地擦拭着落满灰尘的骨头，但我并不忍心看她。弗兰脸上的伤口还没有完全愈合，这都是我的错。我担心我有可能害得她的脸被划花了。为了赎罪，也许我应该让她留在这里。 — 洛琳·克里姆岁末，508 D.A.

en: If you've seen me around, you might notice that I've changed into a fresh set of clothes! Look at these colors — you can only get this vibrancy from the Nomad Highlands. Maybe you could find more if you took a look! There are many abandoned outposts still filled with wares!
cn: 不知道你有没有留意到，我已经换了一套新衣服！你看看这颜色，只有游牧高地才能有这种绚烂的活力。如果用心寻找的话，你说不定还能找到更多衣服！有很多废弃的哨所里面还堆满了各式各样的货物！

en: Flameborn, come here! We should make a petting zoo!
cn: 火之子，快来！我觉得我们应该弄一个动物园！
提高对拾荒者造成的伤害。

en: This section contains Missed Quests. These are Quests that have been completed on this world, but not by you. Activating a Missed Quest will temporarily reset your quest goals and map markers to your personal knowledge state. This means that you will only see markers on your map that you've discovered yourself. Activating a Main or Side Quest instead of a Missed Quest will re-add the knowledge state of the world, its markers, and quests. If no Missed Quests are available, you've caught up with the quest progression of the server.
cn: 该部分包含未完成的任务。这些是当前世界已经完成，但你本人尚未完成的任务。 激活未完成的任务将根据你的个人信息状态重置你的任务目标与地图标记。这意味着你只能够在地图上看见自己亲自发现过的标记。 如果选择激活主线或支线任务，而不是未完成的任务，游戏将为你重新添加当前世界、世界地图标记与任务的知识状态。 如果没有可选的未完成的任务，这说明你已经跟上服务器的任务进度。

en: An azure gem, curved guard, and gold-patterened edge embellish this sword. All in all, it is both beautiful and deadly.
cn: 天蓝色的宝石、弯曲的护手以及剑刃边缘的金色图案点缀着这把武器。毫不夸张地说，这是美丽与危险并存的杰作。

en: Make Or Obtain 3 Goat Baits With The Farmer
cn: 在农民的帮助下制作或获取3份山羊诱饵

en: Change the terraforming action while this item is selected.
cn: 选择此物品时，更改地形改造操作。
我就知道我们能够产生共鸣！

en: My lost Hand Spindle — it should be in the Revelwood, near my last stop for rest. Go on! Together, we can beat the odds with better equipment!
cn: 我遗失的纺线锤应该就在喧嚣森林，靠近我之前沉睡的地方。出发吧！只要齐心协力，我们一定能够凭借优良装备排除万难！

en: There are more cosmetic items hidden in the Revelwood. If you've already visited The Pike, you could consider paying the location another visit.
cn: 喧嚣森林还隐藏着更多的饰品。如果你已经拜访过崇山城，你也许可以考虑再次故地重游。

en: This sword slices through the air like a sharp howl at midnight.
cn: 能够像划破夜空的尖锐嚎叫一般砍杀敌人的剑。

en: After a long and arduous journey, we've finally arrived at Rookmore. I'd hoped for a field hospital here, but instead, the only thing I found was tired faces, twisted by suspicion... I cannot blame them. The Kingdom of Meldore has many reasons to distrust Rimgard refugees, but the war affects us all, no matter the "side" we're on. They won't hesitate for long. Everyone bleeds the same, whether it's at the bottom of a muddy trench or on a makeshift cot. I'll take matters into my own hands, as I did at the front, and set up camp in Woodgard. Once I can start treatment, they'll open up to me... and they'll stop seeing me as some northern stranger, let alone enemy.
