There's one thing that makes me feel at home: The cold air, the gray skies... Yearfall here is not too different from a day in the Summits, though I miss the snow. - Helên
cn: 在经历长途跋涉过后，我们终于来到了卢克摩尔。 原本我希望能够在这里找到一处临时医院，但我在这里唯一找到的就只有精疲力竭的面孔，以及无处不在的怀疑……但是我并不怪那些人。梅尔多尔王国有很多理由去质疑里姆加德的难民，但无论我们处于“那一边”，我们都是战争的受害者。 不过相信他们的疑虑很快便会消散。所有人都流着相同的血，无论是在泥泞战壕的深处，还是在一张简易病床上。和在前线的时候一样，只能靠我亲自上阵了，我将在伍德加德建立营地。等我开始治疗患者，他们自然而然就会接纳我……到时候他们就不会把我看成是什么北方来的陌生人或者是敌人了。 不过有件事倒是让我在这里有了回家的感觉：寒风还有灰色的天空……这里的岁末跟山巅的天气几乎一模一样，不过像归像，我还是很想念那里的雪。 - 海伦

en: A road material made from limestone. It is much lighter and warmer-toned than similar road materials.
cn: 使用石灰石制作的道路材料。比其他类似的道路相比质地更轻，而且还拥有着温暖的色泽。

en: At long last — I return! I am a humble blacksmith, at your service. Let's prepare ya for what's to come.
cn: 终于，我回来了！我是一介平凡铁匠，愿效犬马之劳。让我们为即将到来的挑战做好准备。

en: It was customary in the far North to carry the dead to their graves while brandishing a steel mace. This presentation of stalwart strength in the face of death and terror would ward off evil spirits and guide the dead safely to the Northwinds of the afterlife.
cn: 在极北之地，当地居民会在下葬的尸体身边放一把钢制钉锤。这代表着面对死亡仍然坚毅不屈的勇气，因此能够驱散图谋不轨的恶灵并引导死者随北风安全去往来世。

en: I got my eye on ya! Ha!
Increases the skill level of Wizard

A note revealed that a mysterious guest visited a nearby enshrouded tomb in the Albaneve Summits. They seemed half dead, half alive.

Find the tomb and peer inside!
cn:
根据你找到的一份笔记，某个神秘访客之前拜访了阿尔班耶夫山脉中的一处被瘴气侵蚀的墓穴。那位访客似乎是某种介于生死之间的存在。

找到墓穴并一探究竟！

en: Cooking is a delicate art form. This basic puree will aid any person on their way to becoming an exquisite chef.
cn: 烹饪是一门精细的艺术。这种基础的蔬菜泥是所有人通往美食大厨的必经之路。

en: Finally, a break from the tedious work. My bones are sore... but some shelter, the warmth of a fire, and comfort should allow me to gather new energy. This old cot isn't the softest, but it'll do. I'll get some shut-eye here until I'm rested — ready and full of stamina for another sunrise. I hope I'll have sweet dreams despite the hunger... Food is getting scarce... I hear they're planning an expedition. Thankfully, I hid some rations behind my bed. They will make for a nice meal when cooked over fire.
cn: 枯燥的工作终于能够暂告一段落。我现在感觉全身酸痛……不过只要有了合适的庇护所、温暖的火焰以及舒适的环境，我肯定就能立刻焕然一新。 虽然这张旧床铺硬邦邦的，但勉强能用。我需要在这里睡一觉，直到彻底休息良好，到时候我就能够以充沛的体力去迎接新的一天。希望我能够美美睡上一觉，哪怕我现在饥肠辘辘…… 说实话食物越发稀少……听说他们正打算出去探索。幸好我在床后面藏了一些口粮。到时候只需要拿去火上烤一烤就是一顿每餐。

en:
A severed Cyclops Head, still wearing a helmet, although that's hardly needed now.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
一个独眼巨人的首级，上面仍然戴着一顶头盔，虽然它现在已经不需要这种东西了。

收集多个独眼巨人头颅以制作战利品。

en: A pair of boots which is covered in silvery scales. Your ankles will be safe and sound with these.
cn: 一双布满银色鳞片的靴子。穿上它，你的脚踝就会安全无恙。

en: The Flame has notified you about a disturbance in nearby waters. Unknown, new lands require your aid — but to understand the threat plaguing the shores, you will need help. First, you must reach the passage that leads into the newly opened valley!
cn: 灵火告诉你说附近的水域中出现了异变。未知的新区域需要你的帮助，但是为了理解肆虐海岸的威胁，你将需要寻求其他人的帮助。 首先，你必须抵达通往新开启的峡谷的通道！

en: Parrying enemy attacks bashes them for %k Blunt damage. Bash damage is increased by your Strength attribute. Parry A well-timed block with any Melee weapon or Shield will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar.
cn: 你的招架会对敌人造成%k钝击伤害。具体伤害将随你的力量属性一起提升。 招架 看准时机使用任意近战武器或盾牌进行格挡将招架来袭攻击并使对手的晕眩条增长。

en: So many things are green, and now your hair can be, too! What a joyous day!
cn: 现在你的头发也能够变成无处不在的绿色了！真是太高兴了！

en: Find The Full Scholar Of The Young Flame Set
cn: 找到完整的星火学者套装

en:
The Collector has entrusted you with a task. The Revelwood Hollow Halls hide 3 magical artifacts inside. Find them to display them in your base!

There are multiple hiding spots for the artifacts. Search for secret passageways and keep your eyes open!

The location of the Revelwood Hollow Halls will appear on your map when you've found it through exploration or accepted the next Collector quest. The latter will become available once you're at a high enough level.
cn:
收藏家给了你一项任务。喧嚣森林的空荡礼堂之中藏着3件魔法工艺品。找到工艺品并在基地中进行展示！

你将需要寻找多个工艺品藏匿点。留意周围环境并寻找秘密通道！

当你发现喧嚣森林的空荡礼堂，或者是接受了收藏家的下一项任务之后，地图上将显示对应的位置。你需要达到一定等级之后才能领取收藏家的任务。

en: An iron core lies hidden inside the blade's casing, peeking out from the silver curtains on the blade's flat.
cn: 剑身的最深处隐藏着纯铁打造的核心，就在平直剑刃的银色帷幕之后若隐若现。

en: Glass broken into pieces offers many sharp edges used to enhance weapons.
cn: 碎成小块的玻璃十分锐利，因此能够用于强化武器。

en: Hitting an enemy applies a mark that can stack up to 5 times. Marked enemies will emit an explosion when no new stack of mark has been added for %k or if the enemy dies. The explosion deals %k Shroud damage in a 1m radius. Each stack adds 0,5m and %k of the base damage to the explosion.
cn: 命中敌人时将施加标记，最多叠加5次。如果%k内没有叠加更多的标记，或者敌人死亡，被标记的敌人将会释放一次爆炸。爆炸将对1米范围内的所有目标造成%k瘴气伤害。每层标记将使爆炸的范围扩大0.5米，基础伤害提高%k。

en:
I'm right here before the entrance, trying to will myself forward. Pacing back and forth, but I just can't do it. 
As much as those glowing plants fascinate me — just as much does the dark terrify me. 
And it's not just the dark — the air feels thick with something I can't name.
Maybe I've stumbled onto a Shroud Lair.
I guess I'll never find out what it has to offer.
Maybe someone braver than me will dare to enter.
cn:
此刻我就站在入口前，努力想要鼓起勇气向前走去。但我只是来回踱步，我不敢继续向前。
虽然那些发光植物吸引着我，但我同样畏惧那片黑暗。
而且不仅仅是黑暗，这里的空气拥有着一种难以言喻的沉重。
也许我是落入了一处瘴气巢穴。
也许我永远无法知道另一侧有什么东西。
也许只有比我勇敢之人才有资格知道真相。
前往下一处旅行者营地

en: Plan's changed, Filbert. I can't get the staff to you without the guards noticing. This little note is all I can leave you. They've changed their routes, so I adapted. I stashed our haul from that trader's wagon below the big house by the canal. If you want the goods, you'll need to get them yourself. Don't get caught on the way! And don't fall into the water. Nasty currents, lately... By the way, I found buyers for the sword. Gonna meet with 'em tomorrow night. Come join us on the far side of Willow Crush if you wanna be around for the deal.
cn: 计划有变，费尔伯特。守卫盯得很紧，我没法背着他们把法杖给你。我能给你的就只有这张小纸条了。 他们改变了巡逻路线，所以我也只能随机应变。我已经把从那个商人的马车上搞到的货藏在运河旁的大屋子下面了。 如果你想要货，你得自己去拿。小心别被抓住！也别掉水里了。最近这里的水急得很…… 对了，我已经给刀剑找到买家了，准备明天晚上就去跟见面。如果想要来的话，就来碎柳镇的尽头找我们。

en: All I'm asking for is a room — no board, even! I can make those m'self. Get it?
cn: 我只求一间小屋，甚至都不用铺地板！毕竟那种东西我自己就能做，明白了吗？

en: Eureka! A mill will aid us greatly. Most of all, it will help my bad back. Thank you!
cn: 成功！石磨将能够为我们提供莫大的帮助。最重要的是，这能拯救我的老腰。谢谢你！

en: Instantly restores a lot of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.
cn: 立即恢复大量生命值并提供10秒的持续治疗效果。

en: The edges of this blade are indented and therefore resemble cuts made by razor-sharp fins or rows of shark teeth.
cn: 这把武器的剑刃故意被做成了崎岖不平的模样，目的是为了模仿锐利的鱼鳍或者是鲨鱼的血盆大口一般的可怕伤口。

en: Clear the Revelwood of all shroud roots.
cn: 清除喧嚣森林中的所有瘴气根。

en:
You've found a lore book that referenced two twin flame swords that fell into the mountain region from the stars. 

It mentions that one is slumbering inside a cave. Go there and search for the sword!
cn:
根据你找到的一本典籍上记载，有一对来自星辰的双子火焰剑坠入了山脉区域。

书中提到其中一把就沉睡在某个洞穴之中。前往洞穴并寻找宝剑！

en: Unyielding and unbroken, this staff resembles the realm's last bastion of hope.
cn: 这根杖坚不可摧，就像王国最后的希望堡垒。

en: You can use shortcuts to sort inventories and quickly transfer items.
cn: 你可以使用快捷键来整理物品栏并快速转移物品。

en:
What do we do with all these prisoners!?

I got an idea: We're running awfully low on food and fuel for the fire. Sounds like a solvable problem, no?
cn:
我们该怎么处置这些犯人？！

我有个想法：我们这里的食物与燃料都已经所剩无几。感觉一个现成的解决方法就摆在我们面前，对吗？

en: Find All Crafting Recipes In The Hollow Halls
cn: 找到空荡礼堂中的所有制作配方

en: Are you sure you want to cancel the report?
You are not allowed to share worlds.

The might of these gems is unlike any conventional magic, so what was their purpose? Well, the Ancients researched natural power sources such as lava and fire to fuel their constructs. Perhaps the gems are a sort of energy "storage" — vessels with a magnetic pull that cling to the naturally flowing energy around them, memorizing it, being molded by it... But what grand invention would need such powerful "fuel"?
cn: 这些宝石蕴含的力量与魔法截然不同，所以它们到底是用来做什么的？远古者当时已经掌握了使用岩浆与火焰等天然的能量源来驱动各种装置。也许宝石就像是某种能量“仓库”……这些设备会通过磁力吸附至附近天然存在的能量源，储存那些能量再进行对应的转化……问题是究竟是什么惊天动地的发明才需要如此强大的“燃料”？

en: A heavenly instrument, previously owned by Harper Langley of The Honeydews. Its body has a beautiful carved pattern reminiscent of a mermaid's fishtail, befitting Harper's image as a siren.
cn: 一把不同寻常的乐器，之前的主人是“蜜露”的哈珀·兰利。琴身上雕刻着像美人鱼尾巴一样的精美图案，十分符合哈珀堪比“塞壬”的形象。

en: Start a private game, saved locally
cn: 启动本地保存的私人游戏

en: You retrieved my clothes! Thank you, but... are there still spiders on there? No? You sure? Actually, why don't you just keep them? Go on. Keep them.  And... store them far away from me.
cn: 这是我的衣服！谢谢，但是……上面还有蜘蛛吗？没有了？你确定？那什么，要不还是你自己留着吧？没事的。给，都拿去。那什么……麻烦请放在离我很远的地方。

en:
The <npc>Blacksmith</npc> sees potential in the <npc>Collector</npc>, your new shared ally. 

He wonders about their connection to life and death and hopes they can bring people back to life.
cn:
<npc>铁匠</npc>看到了你们的新同伴<npc>收藏家</npc>蕴含的潜力。

铁匠在思考此人与生命以及死亡之间的联系，并且希望能够借助此人的力量来复活死去的人们。

en: No man is left to cage us. There's no rule, no law...The days of crime and punishment, of right and wrong, are over. All guards have fled, scurried away at the first sign of trouble like rats... leaving us to rot behind bars. Even I — ME! I said I was INNOCENT! Cowards. All of them. I pray they choke on dust! There'd be chaos without the matron, Lupa. Even the rowdiest brigand whimpers when she steps near — she spits acid with every howl, making them cower and weep. Always a hint of ethanol in the air... She's got a plan. There's no breaking through the gate, but.... hollow walls, she says — a cavern behind her cell. She's got help from outside... a sister, I hear. Perhaps we can break through!
cn: 没有人能够拘束我们。没有规矩，没有法律……是非对错的时代已经不复存在。 一发现有麻烦，所有守卫就立马抱头鼠窜……根本没有想过我们这些被关在牢笼中的人的死活。就连我……我也一并遭殃了！我明明说过我是无辜的！那些懦夫。一群胆小鬼。我咒他们被沙尘活活呛死！ 幸好有卢帕夫人在，要不然一切都得乱套，恐怕一切都要乱套了。有她在的时候，哪怕是最暴躁的强盗也会立马收声，她咆哮时喷吐的酸水足以让所有人畏缩啜泣。她周围的空气中总是带着一股酒精的气味…… 她有一个计划。我们无法冲破大门，但是……据卢帕说，她的牢房周围的墙壁都是空心的，而且后面就有一个洞窟。她说有外面的人在帮助自己……听说是她的一位姐妹。也许这次我们终于可以逃出生天！

en: Here Lie The Creators Of Fantastic Waterworlds
cn: 奇妙水世界的创作者们长眠于此

en: Harbor Log, Day 12 of Yearwake, 503 D.A.— Personal Notes
cn: 港口日志，岁初第12日， 503 D.A. — 个人记录

en: These comfortable and plain pants are perfect for apprentices who wish to gather some firsthand adventuring experience.
cn: 这条舒适朴素的裤子非常适合渴望积累第一手冒险经验的学徒。

en: The <npc>Hunter</npc> wants some Animal Fur, as a test of skill.
cn: 作为考验，<npc>猎人</npc>希望得到一些动物毛皮。

en:
The swimming pool's draining system has been acting up again. Whenever I try to lower the water levels, it takes ages for the flow to subside... It's like the tunnels below are blocked again.
I told myself I’d call in a technician, but truth be told, I’ve been putting it off. The men cling to that pool like it’s the last scrap of home we’ve got out here. Taking it away, even for repairs, would break morale in half.

And yet… there’s something off. A sound, low and constant, like stones shifting under the waterline. Probably a stone or a dead rat, bumping against the pipes. It's probably nothing. Just grit in the filters, I bet. But every night, when the rumble rouses me awake, I can’t shake the thought that something's down there.
cn:
游泳池的排水系统又出现故障了。每次想要调低水位的时候，里面的水需要好久才能消下去……感觉下面的管道有可能又堵塞了。
虽然我一直跟自己说要叫技师来检查，但事实上我一直在拖延。人们一直聚在水池边，就像是把这地方当成是我们的家园唯一留下的纪念品一样。要是把这一点夺走，就算是为了维修，也有可能让大家的士气大打折扣。

但是……我觉得有什么不太对劲。我听到了一个低沉而且持续的声响，就像是水位线下有石头在挪动一样。估计真的就是块石头或者是只死老鼠撞到管道了吧。应该没什么问题。就只是过滤器里进了脏东西，我猜。但是每天晚上，当我被响声吵醒的时候，我都忍不住想那下面有什么截然不同的存在。

en: Choose this difficulty if the "Hard" preset is too forgiving. In “Survival”, you will gain less XP and have lower health. Additional survival mechanics like hunger are introduced.
cn: 如果觉得当前游戏过于简单，你可以将难度调整为“困难”。在“生存”模式中，你的生命值以及获得的经验都将减少。除此以外，该模式还将加入饥饿等生存机制。

en: A sick patient journeyed from Woodgard to an Ancient Obelisk in the Springlands. Reach the Ancient Obelisk and discover what you can find there!
cn: 一位病人从伍德加德来到了春日平原的古代方尖碑。查看古代方尖碑并了解那里的情况！

en:
Please hold your tears and sit by my side. Let us gaze over the valley, as we've done before. The setting sun and falling leaves are like our brief and precious time. Let us share these hours before the Shroud whisks them away.

Come rest your head on my shoulder, my daffodil.

Yours forever,
Salim
cn:
请忍住泪水坐在我身旁。让我们一起俯瞰峡谷，就像之前做过的那样。夕阳与落叶就像是我们的信念与所剩无几的时间。让我们好好分享这些时光，在一切被瘴气席卷之前。

希望你愿意依靠在我的肩膀上，我的水仙。

永远爱你的，
萨利姆

en: Upgrades Radiant Aura to deal 2 Fire damage per Intelligence.
cn: 升级璀璨光环效果，每点智力造成2点火焰伤害。

en: An adult Fae Deer. It loves head pats!
cn: 一只成年仙鹿。它很喜欢被人摸脑袋！

en:
7.1	
Adventure Sharing uses several systems for displaying and prioritizing User Content. The following Sections explain the respective parameters as well as your options for influencing the display.
cn:
7.1	
冒险分享使用多个系统来展示用户内容并确定其优先顺序。以下各条将说明相应的参数以及可影响显示方式的选项。

en: No one will get through you whilst you stand your ground in these regal boots.
cn: 穿上这双尊贵长靴，谁也休想撼动你的地位。

en: While exploring, you may discover hints about set item locations. These can be found by talking to NPCs or reading notes scattered throughout the world.
cn: 在探索期间，你也许会发现有关套装物品地点的提示。通过与NPC交谈或者是查看散布在世界各地的文件笔记来获取线索。

en: This century-old wood is found beyond the bark of the giant Blackmire trees.
cn: 隐藏在巨大的黑沼树木的树皮之后的百年老木。

en: Whenever an ally draws the attention of an enemy, you draw twice as much.
cn: 当敌人发现一名同伴时，你将吸引两倍水平的仇恨。

en: No slot available in the Backpack.

Did you know that there once had been a faithful royal guard to former Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>? They were known as the "Blood Rose". After her death, things quieted down around them, but I heard that a small group rebelled against Lord <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>. I don't know what happened to them, but I know where their path led them. If you follow their tracks, you will surely find remnants that bear witness to their battle.
cn: 您知道前王后 <lorename>派克米德</lorename> 曾经有一支忠实的皇家卫队吗？他们被称为 "血玫瑰"。她死后，他们周围的一切都平静了下来，但我听说有一小群人反抗了 <lorename>沃格斯</lorename> 勋爵。我不知道他们发生了什么事，但我知道他们的去向。如果你沿着他们的足迹走下去，一定会找到见证他们战斗的遗迹。
提供针对近战伤害的保护。

en: This hood includes an iron facemask which was greatly inspired by owls.
cn: 这款兜帽包括一个铁质面罩，其灵感来自猫头鹰。

en: Ah, I live? Where am I? BACK OFF, I'm armed! Ah, who am I kidding...I'm no soldier like my father was.
cn: 啊，我又活过来了？这是哪？别过来，我手上拿着武器！唉，我这就是在自欺欺人……我父亲才是一位真正的士兵。

en: On a critical hit with a ranged weapon, all resistance values of the target are halved.
cn: 远程武器暴击将使目标的所有抗性值减半。

en: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting of vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.
cn: 沃格斯领主曾经信任的宝剑在战前被抛弃，取而代之的则是一把更符合那些邪恶行径的武器。此剑仍然散发着理智与光明的气息，并且会像北极星一样在黑暗中闪闪发光。

en: Designed in admiration of antlers, this bow has an imperial and awe-inspiring image.
cn: 一把威风凌凌的强弓，在设计时借鉴了鹿角的外形。

en: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.
cn: 看上去十分危险的鱼牙，现已构不成任何威胁。

en: Opening the door to the Night Sanctum was easy enough. They don't directly teach you about arcane trickery at the Cromville Institute, but the forbidden library section is never guarded... and why have a forbidden section, if not to allow curious students to make it the focus of their evening elective? I'm surprised not to have found Ancient weaponry here, but our adversary is slick. If my studies have taught me anything, their weapon must be hidden behind a different night door. They're gambling on wasting our time with riddles until we expire, drawing out the conflict... But I'd wager they didn't expect a graduate with a penchant for cracking codes. So bet it all on red. Darya
cn: 打开黑夜圣所的大门并不困难。虽然克罗姆威尔学院从来没有正式教授过任何奥法学识，但禁书库常年都处于无人看管的状态……如果不是为了让好奇的学生们有机会在晚上的课余时间钻研选修内容，为什么还要特意设立这种地方？ 让我惊讶的是，圣所里面并没有什么古代兵器，不过大敌们向来十分狡猾。根据我之前的研究，他们肯定把武器藏在了另一扇黑夜之门后面。 很明显，他们想要靠这些复杂的谜语来拖垮我们……但是我猜他们并没有料到会遇上我这个擅长破解密码的毕业生。 一不做二不休，全赌红色吧。 达亚

en: A farmbed which will yield Beets.

Good job there! You really figured out what those creatures were usin'. While you were off, Emily wouldn’t stop talkin' about them pink passionflowers growin' all over the Veilwater Basin. I reckon their pigment will work just as well as the one from the daylilies. I'll give it a try!
cn: 你干得很好！现在我们终于知道这些家伙的秘密了。在你离开的这段时间，艾米丽一直跟我说幕水盆地遍地生长的紫色西番莲。我猜那些东西做成的染料应该能够跟日光百合拥有相同的效果。我觉得可以一试！

en: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.
cn: 曾经属于北境守卫指挥官的弓。其中蕴含的能量将强化持有者，加快他们的反应速度，让他们能更快地射击。

en:
Unforeseen — Humanity is ephemeral! Nothing but a brief moment in time, a breath long taken, the blink of an eye! 

Yet — despite their mortal nature — they have created fire. 

A Flame of their own to brighten their impending dawn.
cn:
不可思议，人类明明是转瞬即逝的存在！他们不过是眨眼呼吸之间便消散的尘埃！

但是……尽管只是肉体凡胎，他们却创造了火焰。

他们创造的灵火将照亮即将来临的黎明。

en: Follow The Vultures To Their Nest
cn: 跟随秃鹫前往它们的巢穴

en: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.
cn: 别费劲擦亮这双靴子了，血迹会是它们最好的装饰，你的队友会很乐意帮你为其点缀。

en:
The Barber struggles to remember haircuts and coloring techniques since he awoke. He kindly asked you to relay any recipes you find on your journey to him. 
He mentioned staying in <location>Fort Kelvin</location> before waking in the nearby "Night Sanctum". 

Perhaps <location>Fort Kelvin</location> would be a good area to search for hair color inspiration!
cn:
自从理发师苏醒之后，他就一直在努力回想过去的发型知识还有染发技巧。因此，他希望你能够在冒险途中帮忙留意相关配方。
他提到说在附近的“黑夜圣所”苏醒之前，他曾经在<location>凯尔文要塞</location>待过一阵子。

也许你能够在<location>凯尔文要塞</location>中为理发师寻找新发色的灵感！

en: A twig, as insignificant as it might seem, has a lot of potential. Everything starts somewhere...
cn: 千里之行始于足下，哪怕是再不起眼的树枝也有着无限的潜能……

en:
No suitable weapons available.
Fully upgrade a weapon with a locked Gem slot to insert a gem.
cn:
没有可用的武器。
完全升级一把拥有宝石栏位的武器以嵌入宝石。

en: Investigate the fourth stop on Kaori's shipment's route to find the next hat!
cn: 调查嘉里的货运路线上的第四个停靠点以寻找下一顶帽子！

en: In ancient times, these blocks were used to build dungeons and catacombs. Nowadays, they are in bad condition, but still serve their purpose.
cn: 在古代，类似这样的石块会被用来当做建造地牢与墓穴的材料。虽然现在受到了岁月的摧残，但并不妨碍使用。

en: Please wait patiently in line. Note that citizens without an appointment cannot submit requests. Thank you kindly for understanding.
cn: 请有序排队并耐心等待。请注意，未提前预约的公民无法提交申请。感谢大家的理解。

en:
A mushroom that is commonly found beneath the Shroud. 
It's inedible but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
cn:
一种常见于 瘴气地下的蘑菇。 
它不能食用，但可以加工成不同的制作材料。
瘴气魔孢子头，幕水盆地瘴气区

en: Someone should've come by, but the outpost is empty. No one answers my calls for help. Even worse, I think I hear something shuffling beneath me. At first, I felt it was the bandits from the south port again but the noises didn't sound human. Come to think of it, the overseer mentioned something about the rising Shroud. Maybe they shut down the site until further notice? It's no use. I'll have to rescue myself! I moved one of the carts to the platform's edge and stockpiled the cargo there. It wasn't quite high enough to climb out, so I started stacking loose books on top. I'm rapidly losing sunlight, so I won't try to climb out now. Scaling this unstable construction is dangerous enough, even without the encroaching darkness.
cn: 照理说应该有人来了，但是整座哨所都空空如也。没有人能听见我的呼救声。更糟糕的是，我好像听见下面有什么奇怪的动静。一开始，我还以为是南港的强盗们又来捣乱，但那些声音不像是人类发出来的。 仔细一想，主管之前好像说过瘴气水平在上升。也许他们是因为这件事暂时关闭了整座哨所？不行。这回只能靠我自己了！ 我设法将一辆货车推到了平台边缘，接着又把货物全都堆在了上面。不过如果想要爬出去的话还不够高，所以我又在顶上叠了一堆书。天马上就要黑了，所以我决定暂时先不尝试爬出去。从这摇摇晃晃的“楼梯”上爬出去本来就很危险，要是什么也看不见，那岂不是自寻死路。

en: Have you looked for my weapons? I cannot allow strangers to besmirch their purity with the blood of innocents!
cn: 请问你有去寻找我的武器了吗？我不希望被陌生人用无辜者的鲜血玷污那些纯洁的武器！

en: You're still ill. You should craft an antidote!
cn: 你的病症还没有好转。快去制作一份解毒剂吧！

en:
The trader Mei revealed that the final weapon must be inside a forgotten temple in the Nomad Highlands. 

To proceed, reach the location and investigate it!
cn:
商人梅告诉你说最后的武器肯定被藏在了游牧高地中的一处被遗忘的神殿里面。

抵达梅所说的地点并进行调查！

en:
The Fisher told you about a special hiding spot, rumored to contain a chest with mariner's gear.

Find the hiding spot he mentioned! The place is marked on the map.
cn:
渔夫跟你提到了一个特别的藏匿点，据说那里的宝箱中藏着水手的装备。

找到他提到的藏匿点！地图上已经标记了具体位置。

en: All these foods and potions... There must be a better way to avoid drowning while diving!
cn: 这些食物与药水……肯定有更好的方法能够避免在潜水时溺亡！

en:
%k has crashed!

A MiniDump has been created at

'%k'

Would you like to upload it?
cn:
%k发生崩溃！

已在位置

“%k”

创建一份MiniDump。上传崩溃日志？

en: The Wisdom In The Night Sanctums
You're affected by a heal beam
cn: 你正在受到治疗光束影响

en: You've found a note in the mountain hut from a father who dreamed of renovating his home for his family. The polished Granite Blocks he described still lie hidden under the stairs at Gateway Outpost "Bora", untouched. Retrieve them, so they can finally serve the purpose they were meant for!
cn: 你在山间小屋中找到某位父亲留下的字条，在里面他提到了自己想要为自己的房屋进行翻新的梦想。那位父亲提到的抛光花岗岩方块仍然完好无损地藏在网道哨所“海风”的楼梯下方。 取回方块，让它们完成自己本来的目的！

en: You currently don't have any unfinished Side Quests
cn: 当前没有尚未完成的支线任务

en: "My life can be measured in hours, I serve by being devoured. Thin, I am quick. Fat, I am slow. Wind is my foe. What am I?" Such was the riddle I solved to become a Scholar. And it was a simple riddle, really. "You’re a candle", I said without letting the question rest, eyes still fixated on the elder Ancient‘s lips. I was never a believer. Yes, I answered the Ancient's riddle — became a Scholar of the Empyrean. Perhaps I was curious. Enamored by the prospect of scouring the world for knowledge. But a devout follower of the Flame, I was not. Still, I followed the call and brought many a scroll and secret into the Night Sanctums, along with lit candles and reading glasses. The knowledge was said to vanish without a trace during the day, but I was certain this would prove to be a simple magic trick. A riddle to solve. A candle in the wind. I’ve lingered in the Sanctum, listened at the door, and observed the closed entrance as it stood dormant during the midday hours. I never saw an Ancient or trickery. Whatever wisdom I stored in the Sanctum was gone the next day. Every time, the only thing they leave is the candle. Snuffed out, sitting alone in the dark, and devoured. 45th of Yearfall, 383 D.A.
cn: “我的生命以小时计，我的使命就是被吞噬。轻薄如纸时，我健步如飞。风是我的敌人，我是谁？” 正是这个谜语的答案让我成为了一名学者。而且这其实是一个非常简单的谜语。 “你是蜡烛”，远古者长老话音刚落，我便不假思索地说出了答案。 说实话我并不是一个有信仰的人。我确实回答了远古者的谜语，并因此成为了一名苍穹学者。但那也许只是因为我的心中充满好奇。我想要掌握这个世界的所有知识。但我绝不是灵火的虔诚信徒。 尽管如此，我仍然响应号召，为黑夜圣所带去了许多卷轴秘密与蜡烛眼镜。 虽然他们说这些知识会在白天消失得无影无踪，但是我确信这不过是一种简单的魔法把戏。另一个需要解开的谜语。就像风中的烛火。 我在神殿中驻足停留，在门前用心聆听，还在正午目不转睛地观察着紧闭着的沉睡门扉。 但我从来没有看见过任何一个远古者或者是他们使用的魔法把戏。当第二天的黎明到来，我存入神殿中的智慧便会消失。 每一次都是如此，他们唯一会留下的就只有蜡烛。被彻底掐灭，孤独坐在黑暗中被吞噬殆尽。 岁末第45日，383 D.A.
提高对瘴气魔造成的伤害。

en:
New day, new me! 
My expedition into the Albaneve Summits is starting well! The air on this side of the mountains is refreshing, and I can travel without burdens after leaving my band and lute behind. I even found this abandoned watch tower and got my hands on some old armor and warm undergarments! These will prepare me well for the journey up ahead... and the armor makes me look just like a northling! 

I'll act like a lost soldier if a patrol catches me. That way, maybe my blood won't be spilled, and I'll live another day! Inspiring stuff... maybe I'll take up a pen and write that down... I'm no longer a songwriter, but old habits die hard!
cn:
新的一天，新的自己！
前往阿尔班耶夫山脉的探险一切顺利！这一侧山脉的空气很清新，而且离开了乐队和鲁特琴之后，我已经可以轻装上阵。我甚至还找到了一座废弃的瞭望塔，里面有一些旧的护甲和保暖内衣！这些东西应该能够帮助我完成接下来的旅程……而且穿上护甲之后，我看上去就像是北境人一样！

如果被巡逻队发现，我会假装自己是一个迷路的士兵。说不定这样他们会饶我一命！这给了我一个灵感……也许我得想办法记下来……虽然我已经不再写歌，但旧习难改！

en:
Large, in charge, and ready to barge in while you are busy scavenging caves.

Collect multiple Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
这些气势汹汹的庞然大物是你在探索洞穴时最危险的敌人。

收集多个独眼巨人头颅以制作黑铁战利品。

en: Take some screenshots before uploading your world! You can take screenshots with the Camera item.
cn: 上传世界前请先拍摄一些截图！你可以使用镜头功能来拍摄截图。

en:
11.1	
The terms of the Platform through which you purchased Enshrouded shall apply to the use of Adventure Sharing as a freely available gameplay feature of Enshrouded. In addition, the provisions of Section 11 shall apply insofar as they do not conflict with the Platform terms. In the event of such a conflict, the Platform terms shall prevail.
cn:
11.1	
作为 Enshrouded 的一项免费游戏功能，您购买 Enshrouded 时所通过的平台的条款应适用于冒险分享的使用。此外，第 11 条的规定在其与平台条款不冲突的条件下适用。若发生此类冲突，以平台条款为准。

en: CROMVILLE Institute of Imperial Defense Memorandum for General Rasmus Letter of Recommendation for C-25-1019-DA (DARYA ARKANOV). It is with great pleasure that we recommend student D. ARKANOV for the upcoming expedition to the Night Doors on the Albaneve Summits front. She's proven her loyalty and leadership capabilities on numerous field trips, and finished top of her class in "Imperial History" and "Ancients: Anatomy of the Adversary". She's even expressed an interest in the arcane magic of the Ancients outside of the classroom. Her (tolerated) doctrinal deviations may serve you well in your research. Therefore, we believe D. ARKANOV will be a useful addition to your squad. We remain available for any questions or requests. Blessed be Lord Vorgoth, the Guard of the North and Ruler of Rimgard J. Lincoln, Headmaster
cn: 克罗姆威尔帝国防御学院 致拉丝姆斯将军备忘录 推荐信：C-25-1019-DA（达亚·阿卡诺夫）。 怀着喜悦之情，我们希望推荐本院学生D·阿卡诺夫参加即将出发前往阿尔班耶夫山脉前线的黑夜之门远征队。 在不计其数的实地考察中，阿卡诺夫已经证明了自己的忠诚与领导能力，除此以外，她以班上名列前茅的成绩完成了“帝国历史”以及“远古者：大敌解剖学”的课程。 而在课堂之外，她甚至还展现出了对于远古者的玄奥法术的浓厚兴趣。愿阿卡诺夫（勉强被容忍）的“课余爱好”能够为你们的研究提供帮助。 综上所述，我们认为D·阿卡诺夫完全能够成为你们小队的重要帮手。如有任何疑问或请求，请随时联系我们。 祝福沃格斯大人，北境守卫与里姆加德的统治者 J·林肯，校长

en: Breathe in, and out. In, out. Be calm, Rochelle, be calm... clean breaths. No dust, no smoke? No fiery inferno? Dearest stranger, I don't know how you took me from those fires — but thank you. I'm a blacksmith — Ander's family trade. Come to me, and I'll be your shield.
cn: 呼吸，吐气。吸气，吐气。冷静，罗茜，冷静……深呼吸。那些尘埃与浓烟不见了？我已经不在那个燃烧的地狱里面了？亲爱的陌生人，我不知道你是如何把我从火海里救出来的，但是谢谢你。我是一名铁匠，我们家里世世代代都是干这个的。只要你需要帮助，我将成为你的坚盾。

en:
An arrangement of cool grays and blues, reminiscent of an icy brook on a cloudy day.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
cn:
冰冷的灰蓝色让人想起了阴天的冰封溪流。

可以使用喧嚣森林材料制作这种调色板。

en: Light brown pants. Comfortable and distinguished in their simplicity.
cn: 淡棕色长裤。穿着舒服而且简单干练。

en: Save data error. Data could not be overwritten.
cn: 存档数据错误。无法覆盖数据。

en: Let me share my light with you.
These boots have an intricate scale pattern on their green plating.
cn: 这些鞋子的绿色防护板上印有复杂的鳞片图案。

en: You've read a note that described how a local gravedigger in Pikemead's Reach wanted to be buried. He wished to be put underneath the old oak, next to his wife and son. The graveyard in question is in the Imperial Gardens area. Search for his grave and dig for valuables!
cn: 你找到了一张字条，上面描述了派克米德之地的一位掘墓人的葬礼要求。 他希望自己死后能被埋在老橡树下，和他的妻儿在一起。墓地就在帝国园林区域。寻找掘墓人的墓地并寻找有用的物品！

en: Mycelium of mushrooms that have been absorbing the magical properties of the Shroud. Could this be used for alchemical purposes?
cn: 不停吸收着瘴气魔力的蘑菇菌丝，也许能够当做炼金材料？

en: You've got your hands on some flippers! What? Were you expecting something different? A real mermaid's tail, perhaps? Har har har! Every story I tell should be taken with a grain of salt, don't ya know?
cn: 看来你弄到了一些脚蹼！怎么？你是期望着拿到别的东西吗？比如一条人鱼的尾巴？哈哈哈！你难道还没有明白吗？我说的那些故事并不全是真的！

en: You've retrieved the lantern! The light of the new year shines upon you.
cn: 你找到了灯笼！愿新年的烛火为你照亮前路。

en: You've found a survivor slumbering deep below the Sunken Ancient City. Awaken them with a Summoning Staff!
cn: 在沉没的远古城市的最深处，你找到了一位陷入沉睡的幸存者。使用召唤法杖唤醒幸存者！

en: Crafting a Glider will allow you to reach distant locations or to cross enshrouded valleys unharmed. It can be crafted at a Workbench from Shroud Wood. You can aquire Shroud Wood by venturing beneath the Shroud. Be wary of consuming Stamina while using the Glider to reach new locations.
cn: 制作一个滑翔翼可以让您到达遥远的地方，或安然无恙地穿越被笼罩的山谷。它可以在工作台处，使用 瘴气木材制作。 您可以在瘴气中获得 瘴气木材。 使用滑翔翼前往新地点时要小心体力消耗。

en: Raw Fae Deer milk. It has to be cooked to be consumed safely.
cn: 生仙鹿奶。必须煮沸后才能安全饮用。

en: A Spinning Machine For The Hunter
Read all obelisks in the Albaneve Summits.
cn: 查看阿尔班耶夫山脉中的所有方尖碑。

en: This reminds me of a tale — ever heard of the emperor's new clothes?
cn: 这让我想到了一个故事，你有听说过“皇帝的新衣”吗？

en:
A dagger's point coated in poison is often more effective than diplomacy.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn:
淬有剧毒的匕首往往比外交手段更具有威慑力。

可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en: Brown boots equipped with belt buckles and shoe laces. Perfect for a stroll through your wonderful village, castle, or underground bunker.
cn: 褐色的靴子上安装有搭扣与鞋带。在美丽的村庄、城堡或者是地堡中散步时的完美选择。

en: The Carpenter said that the Vukah have been behaving strangely for a long time. They left their caves before the Shroud broke out, and claimed parts of the Springlands and Nomad Highlands. They have a gathering location which should be investigated.
cn: 木匠说，长期以来，沃卡的行为都很不正常。它们在瘴气扩散之前就离开了自己的洞窟，并且转而在春日平原与游牧高地中定居。也许是时候去调查它们的集会地点了。

en: By the Flame! My head pounds as if a Vukah had used it to measure their throwing distance... and everything tastes like mud...
cn: 灵火在上！我的脑袋就像是被沃卡狠狠踢了好几脚……嘴里面全都是泥巴的味道……

en: A very healthy beverage that helps the body recover and prepare for the day to come.
cn: 非常健康的饮品，能够帮助恢复精力。

en: Before the fall, many guards and knights of Embervale would brandish swords such as these. Perhaps their spirit lives on through your righteous strikes.
cn: 在旧世界沦陷之前，许多守卫与薪谷的骑士都会携带这种武器。也许他们的灵魂仍然活在你的每一次正义打击中。

en: Oh dear, I'm glad to be back alive, but I don't recognize where I am at all! My chambers are nowhere to be seen. Could you show me to my new quarters? If I sleep outside without shelter, my hair will get frizzy.
cn: 天呐，活着的感觉真是太好了，不过我并不认得这个地方！这并不是我熟悉的那些房间。还请麻烦带我去新的寝室？要是整天睡在荒郊野外，我的头发可都要打结了。

en: Better to be the hammer than the anvil.
Flameborn, your might has grown. It is time to face your last endevour for the time being. Seek out your final Ancient Vault and recover the artefact within. Prove yourself to the glorious Flame!
cn: 火之子，你的力量已经增长。是时候面对你目前最后的挑战了。寻找你最后的远古密室，找回里面的法器。向光荣的灵火证明自己！

en: Praise the undead! A tear in the fabric of time — I'm back once more, alive and well! And far more fleshy than I had anticipated!
cn: 赞美不死者！时间的帷幕出现了一条裂缝，我又回来了，我又活了！而且比我想的要更加有血有肉！

en: Fell Enemies, Nomad Highlands and Kindlewastes Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔敌人，游牧高地以及燃火荒原瘴气区
提高对沃卡造成的伤害。

en: After receiving damage, there is a %k chance to reflect %k of the damage back to the attacker as Fire damage. This magical attack can trigger other skills.
cn: 受到伤害后，有%k几率将%k的伤害以火焰伤害的形式反射给攻击者。 这种魔法攻击可以触发其他技能。

en:
Large ship stranded on our shores.

Spoiled food, rotten wood. Merphisz would laugh at the state of it.

Clouds swirling around, misty blue like fog on the horizon, but murky. Humans inside, or something once human. Mushy and soft, rip open to reveal glowing hearts still beating in an unfamiliar rhythm. 

Weaklings! Ancients chose the wrong champions! Now is the time of the Drak! Drak'Dal will cross the open waters and squish the puny fleshlings! Rebuild the empire! 

For Dalszul!
cn:
大船搁浅在了我们的海岸上。

食物与木头都已经腐烂。梅菲兹肯定会嘲笑这种可悲的状态。

乌云绕着船只盘旋，地平线上升起了蓝色的迷雾，比平常的雾要更为浑浊。船里有人类，或者说曾经是人类的东西。已经全变得软乎乎，一撕开就能看见里面闪烁的心脏正以不同寻常的节奏跳动着。

软弱！远古者选择了错误的冠军！现在是卓克的时代！卓克·达尔将横跨开放海域并粉碎那些无能的血肉之躯！重建帝国！

为了达尔斯祖尔！

en:
The array of reds, oranges, and grays creates the ideal camouflage against the sundried mountains.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
错落的红、橙与灰将让你阳光下的群山融为一体。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。

en: You've found all the songs! Oh, and they're all by Chester Loft!? I'm such a fan! Oh, I'll faint! Catch me, will you?
cn: 你已经找到了所有曲目！哦，原来都是切斯特·洛夫特写的？！我可是他的头号粉丝！我的天，我都要晕倒了！麻烦托住我，谢谢。

en:
12.6	
At the start of the period, Keen will separately inform you of this legal consequence, i.e., the right to object, the objection period, and the significance of silence.
cn:
12.6	
在该期限开始时，Keen 将另行告知您此法律后果，即异议权、异议期限以及沉默所代表的含义。

en: My glow and warmth reach further into the darkness — thanks to you, Flameborn. I am strong enough to protect your home should you choose to expand it.
cn: 我的光芒与温暖驱散了更多黑暗，这一切多亏了你，火之子。我现在已经可以保护扩张后的基地。

en: Use your Grappling Hook to pull yourself towards large enemies during combat. Cost: 50 Stamina
cn: 在战斗中使用抓钩将自己拉向大型敌人。 消耗：50点体力

en: Increased Damage Reduction Limit from Magical Armor
cn: 提高魔法护甲的伤害减免上限

en: Ah, how good to see you healthy again! Remember to take good care of yourself, yes?
cn: 啊，很高兴看见你已经恢复健康！以后记得要照顾好自己，好吗？

en: Hope you don't die before we meet again.
cn: 希望你能够坚持到我们再度相会。

en: An algae salad that tastes fresh and vaguely salty, like the sea. Something so green and natural must be healthy.
cn: 口感清爽而且略带咸味的藻类沙拉，吃上去有股大海的味道。这种天然的绿色食物肯定有益健康。

en: Find all flame shrines and sanctums in the Revelwoods.
cn: 找到喧嚣森林中的所有灵火神龛与神殿。

en:
You have found a record of the experiments the mad wizard conducted. Sadly, his work in this tomb was unsuccessful, but he cryptically noted where his next experiment would take place:
"From the water, I cross Gateway Outpost "Darkwater" and venture into the jungle to seek the next tomb."

Venture to the next tomb and uncover its secrets.
cn:
你已经找到了疯狂巫师的实验记录。很遗憾，他在这处墓穴中失败了，但是他的笔记中隐约提到了下一场实验的地点：
“我将走水路穿越网道哨所“暗水”并进入丛林寻找下一处墓穴。”

前往下一处墓穴并解开那里的秘密。

en: He can be so demanding sometimes. "It still needs more shiny stones" he said. "It doesn't feel complete yet" he said. Does he have any idea what I've been through to acquire the ones we have so far? I've traveled across lands, bringing him gemstones from the East — from the kingdom of Orindell and beyond — and still, he's not satisfied. Ignorant, spoiled kid. Thinks flashing his gold coins makes up for everything. Now he won't be content until I get him at least one gem from the Hollow Halls. Rumor has it that each one holds a rare gem. Dangerous place, but of course, he doesn't care about that. I guess I don't have a choice. If I don't deliver, he'll just find another. The things you do for money...
cn: 有时候他实在是太咄咄逼人。 “还需要更多闪亮的石头”他说。 “感觉不够完整”他还说。 他究竟知不知道，我费了多大的功夫才找到这些？我不惜千里迢迢走遍各地，就为了给他从东面的奥林戴尔还有更远的地方找这些宝石，但就算是这样，他还是不满意。 这个被宠坏的小屁孩。 觉得只要拿几个臭钱出来就能够解决所有问题。 这次他非要我去从空荡礼堂弄一枚宝石回来。据说每一座礼堂里面都有一枚稀有的宝石。问题是那些地方真的很危险，可是这家伙根本不在乎。 我猜我也别无选择。如果不照他说的做，他只需要再换一个愿意干活的人就行了。 都是为了钱……

en: A farmbed which will yield plant fiber.
cn: 能够产出植物纤维的农地。

en: Finally! Oh, I can't wait to make myself a luxurious espresso. Maybe I'll prepare some coffee for the whole crew — A frappe for my bestie, black coffee for Athalan, mocha for Balthazar, hot cocoa for Cade, a sickly sweet swirly super latte for Mister Grumpy back there...
cn: 终于！哦，我已经迫不及待想要给自己来一杯奢华浓缩咖啡了。也许我还可以准备一些咖啡来款待大家：给我的好闺蜜的冰咖啡，给阿萨兰的黑咖啡，巴尔萨扎的摩卡、卡迪的热可可，还有给后面那位坏脾气先生的超甜漩涡超级拿铁……

en:
Failed to load subscriptions.
Cancel: Disable Base Sharing
Ok: Subscriptions will be reset.
cn:
上传描述失败。
取消：禁用基地共享
同意：接下来将重置订阅。

en: An axe to end any battle — quickly.
cn: 能够以迅雷不及掩耳之势终结一切战斗的斧子。

en: When receiving Melee damage, the attacker will be slowed down for %k.
cn: 受到近战伤害时，攻击者将承受持续%k秒的减速效果。
自动填充各类屋顶材料。

en: The ruby-red cloth, emerald-colored scales, and golden trim create a warm and regal cosmetic armor piece when combined.
cn: 鲜红的布料、翠绿色的鳞片以及金边组合在一起，便构成了一件温暖而且尊贵的外观护甲。

en: The Barber is in desperate search of something that captures the sparkle of sunlight dancing on water. Search the Veilwater Basin for something blue and crystalline.
cn: 理发师迫切渴望一种能够捕捉波光粼粼的水面之色的东西。 在幕水盆地寻找蓝色与清澈之物。

en: Failed to convert your base, too many flame altars found!
cn: 上传基地失败，原因：灵火祭坛过多！

en: Oh, you've found some bellows? We could use them for a blast furnace! Build one with me, why don't you?
cn: 哦，你已经找到了一些风箱？我们可以用这些东西来制作高炉！那就拜托你帮我造一个出来。

en: The Barber is tired of his current styling options and wants to create new exciting hair colors. He thinks drinking some spicy tea will spice up his boring day, and inspire him! Bring the Barber some spiced tea!
cn: 理发师厌倦了目前的选择，他想要尝试创造激动人心的新发色。理发师想要喝一些香料茶来为自己乏味的生活增添乐趣与灵感！ 为理发师提供一些香料茶！

en:
Despite wearing black bands over their eyes like bandits, they are relatively easy to catch.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
尽管像强盗一样在眼睛上涂抹着黑手的印记，这些家伙其实很容易被抓住。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。

en: You feel calm and guarded in this upper body armor — consider your next move carefully.
cn: 穿着这件上身护甲，你将感觉到平静与安全 - 谨慎规划你的下一步行动吧。

en: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked!
cn: 生的米粒。煮熟之后饱腹感极佳！

en: The forsaken mirage led me further astray!! I CURSE the man who sold me this map! Water! I need water! My brain has rotted! I see visions!! I spot another oasis, real or imagined, just over the ridge! If I hadn't sold my precious Glider, I could reach it!! Shadows overhead, spinning. A spiral, like an unwinding thread. I keep seeing a figure in the corner of my eye — some phantom, a ghost. Mocking me and my rotted brain!! CURSES! This cannot be my last written word! I must be remembered! Please, remember the name "Costner Meyers"! I don't want to fade away!
cn: 该死的海市蜃楼，我现在已经彻底迷失了方向！！都该那个该死的男人卖给了我这张地图！水！我需要水！ 我的脑子肯定是出问题了！我的眼前全是幻象！！我又看见了一处绿洲，不知道是真的还是我的幻觉，反正就在山脊的另一头！要是我没有卖掉自己的宝贵滑翔翼，我现在就能轻松到达那里了！！ 头顶的阴影正在不断旋转。就像是某种散乱丝线构成的螺旋。我一直感觉眼角仿佛能够看见一个声音，像是某种幻影或幽灵。它肯定是在嘲笑我和我愚蠢的脑子！！该死的！我决不能就这么倒下！我一定要让所有人记住我的名字！拜托了，请记住“科斯特纳·迈耶斯”这个名字！我不想就这么消失！

en: You've found all the instruments and even a beautiful harp? Amazing! This will be great for my research. Why not play a tune whilst I ponder? Go on, you've earned yourself a break!
cn: 你已经找到了所有乐器，甚至还找到了一个美丽的竖琴？太不可思议了！这一定能为我的研究提供巨大的帮助。我得好好思考一番，与此同时，不如来弹奏一首曲子吧？别客气，好好犒劳犒劳自己吧！

en:
The prized head of a cyclops, preserved in metal and made accessible to the common person. People can now gaze into its eye unafraid.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
独眼巨人的头颅，已经用金属改造成了一件供人们瞻仰的战利品。现在人们可以毫不畏惧地直视那只凶狠的独眼。

收集多个瘴气魔独眼巨人头颅以制作黑铁战利品。

en: Used to bind things together, String is an extremely important item.
cn: 用于捆绑各类东西，线绳是一种不可或缺的物品。

en: These gloves radiate warmth and safety as if they were forged in pure liquid light.
cn: 这双手套散发着温暖和安全的感觉，仿佛是在纯净的液态光辉中锻造而成。

en:
You've learned the existence of a new Nomad Highlands building block called the Mixed Sandstone Block. 

Search the area to obtain the building block!
cn:
你已经得知有一种叫做“混合砂岩方块”的新型游牧高地建造方块。

搜索区域并找到这种建筑方块！

en: I don't want to sleep outside! I get soaking wet every time it rains! Can you please build me a sheltered bed?
cn: 我讨厌在外面过夜！每次下雨的时候我都会全身湿透！能不能拜托你帮我造一张拥有庇护的床？

en: "Envy and immortality", yes. I know them well. They reflect off every crystal shard inside the Hollow Halls in the Nomad Highlands, twisting your gaze and intention, spitting it back at you with disdain. If you wish to see them for yourself, know the doors to the Hall open with a key of mine. However, I can only craft it if you've gathered ingredients in the previous Halls.
cn: “嫉妒与永生”，没错。我对此再熟悉不过。游牧高地的空荡礼堂中的每一块水晶碎片都在反射着它们的景象，它们扭曲着你看见的景象与意图，让一切都沾染上憎恶的色彩。如果你仍然想要面对那一切，我有一把能够打开礼堂大门的钥匙。但是，只有当你集齐先前厅堂中的材料之后，我才能够为你打造钥匙。

en: A lucky fishing rod that is quite strong and also more likely to catch treasures!
cn: 一根幸运鱼竿，非常强韧而且更有可能钓上宝藏！

en: This altar is deactivated. The afterglow of the Flame offers lingering protection that will wear off soon:
cn: 该祭坛未被激活。灵火残留的保护之光将迅速消散。

en: Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn: 提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: Many amethyst stones were used to forge this wand. They are needed to prevent combustion when this weapon inevitably overheats from the bundled energy inside! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 打造这把魔棒使用了许多紫水晶。只有大量的宝石才能避免这把武器在使用时因为积蓄在内部的能量引发过热自燃！ 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: In the bygone days, young men would carry maces like these to thrash and toil amongst one another like a dark, thundering storm. It helped to release anger and weed out the weak.
cn: 在过去，年轻的战士们会使用类似这样的武器彼此战斗，那场面就像是震耳欲聋的风暴乌云。残酷的战斗能够帮助人们宣泄心中的怒火并剔除弱小之辈。

en: You will deal 50% more poison damage.

Lady Leclair, the alchemist apprentice, has tasked you to find a "Gem of Bloodlust" in the Albaneve Summits. She said that the gem can sometimes be found on elite enemies above the Shroud. Defeat elite enemies from the Scavenger, Vukah or Hollow faction in the Albaneve Summits to have a chance of finding the gem.
cn: 炼金术士的学徒雷克莱尔夫人要求你前往阿尔班耶夫山脉寻找一枚“嗜血宝石”。 她说有时候宝石会出现在瘴气上方的精英敌人身上。打败阿尔班耶夫山脉中拾荒者、沃卡或空荡阵营的精英敌人，这些敌人将有概率掉落宝石。

en: Billowy pants that were made from the finest silks. They create an interesting and lavish silhouette.
cn: 使用最上等的丝绸制作的宽大裤子。能够为穿戴者营造出一种饶有趣味又富有奢华气质的外形。

en: A blue paste that can be used to color other objects such as clothing. It is created from the remains of bugs and other substances.
cn: 能够为服饰等物品染色的蓝色糊状物。使用昆虫残骸与其他物质制作。

en:
Our Scholar of the Empyrean is fading.
He walks slower now, can't make his rounds to the Night Sanctums like before. He's been our guide for decades—and for decades, we've made these offerings. But lately, doubt grows among us.
The Ancients have not returned. Not in many years. 
Their absence once felt sacred. Now, it feels like abandonment.

And today, left by the Ancients and burdened to make the choice alone, the Scholar named his successor.
His own son.

The announcement came without ceremony, without counsel—just a degree passed from fading lips.
But we've barely seen the boy. He's no elder. He's never stepped inside the Sanctums alone.

Some bowed their heads, still clinging to old reverence. But more kept their heads high—eyes filled with doubt.

Is this how it ends?
I fear the Ancients won't bless us with their presence again.
cn:
我们的苍穹学者恐怕时日无多。
他的步伐愈发沉重，甚至已经到了无法顺利前往各个黑夜圣所的地步。过去的数十年来，他一直引导着我们，与此同时，我们也一直在为他献上这些贡品。但是近来，我们的心中萌生起了疑虑。
这么多年过去之后，远古者们仍然没有归来。
他们的消失曾经带有一种神圣的意味。但现在，这只让我们感觉到被抛弃。

今天，学者被迫在没有远古者帮助下独自做出了选择，并定下了自己的继承者。
他的儿子。

这次的宣告没有任何仪式，也没有经过任何讨论，单纯只是一名垂垂老者下达的命令。
但我们根本不熟悉被选中的那个男孩。他并不是长老。他甚至没有独自进入过神殿。

有些人仍然保持着过去的敬畏并低下了头。但是更多的人选择了观望，他们的眼中充满怀疑。

难道一切就要到此为止了？
我害怕远古者们将不会再出现在我们面前。

en:
You've found a "Gem of Bloodlust" in the Albaneve Summits. Return to Lady Leclair to reap the rewards of your hunt!

You don't need to have the gem in your inventory to proceed.
cn:
你已经在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到了一枚“嗜血宝石”。回去找雷克莱尔夫人并领取狩猎的奖励！

就算宝石不在你的物品栏中，你也可以继续此任务。

en: A magical dust that can glow in the dark, consisting of the crushed remains of a Fire Fly.
cn: 能够在黑暗中发光的魔法粉末，通过将萤火虫碾碎而成。

en: Aster! I found Jax's note to you. Heed my warning — you are brave enough in my heart without attempting such foolish feats! I know you only just moved here from the Springlands and have much to learn about our home. First and foremost: never ever play amongst the rocks on the farm! For they are not rocks at all, but the protective plates of the Dune Armadillo! They'll snatch you up and pull you underground right quick! And who will take me to The Harvest Festival then? — Myrtle
cn: 阿斯特！我找到贾克斯给你的信了。听我一句劝，我相信你是个勇敢的人，所以你不需要做那种傻事！ 我知道你刚从春日平原搬来这里不久，所以对于我们的家园还有很多不了解的地方。但是有件事你一定要明白：坚决不要在农场边的石头上玩耍！那些东西其实并不是石头，而是沙丘犰狳用来保护自己的甲壳！要是惊动了它们，那些家伙会立刻把你拖进地下！如果你出事的话，到时候还有谁来带我去参加丰收节？ — 莫桃尔
可以在基地外编辑世界

en: I always thought this lookout job was the most boring thing in the world. Boy, was I wrong. I keep seeing something in the distance — shuffling between gusts of wind, clouded by fog and mist. It's near the valley's tomb, so I thought it was another Hollow. An aimless puppet, skeletal and frail... but that's not right. It looks towards me every night. I can't see it, but I feel it. It's half alive, half dead... some visitor from beyond for Hollow's Eve, maybe. My resignation letter has already been sent. I can't wait to get back to boring work.
cn: 我原本以为岗哨是全世界最无聊的工作。我真是大错特错。 我觉得远方肯定有什么东西 — 就在呼啸而至的强风与浓雾之间若隐若现。就在山谷墓穴附近，我觉得肯定是另一个空荡。照理说那些脆弱的骷髅只会像某种漫无目的木偶一样徘徊……但事实并非如此。 每天晚上，它都会看向这里。虽然我没办法看清，但我能够感觉到它的目光。那家伙介于生死之间……也许是为了空荡之夜而来的彼界访客。 我已经上交辞职信。我已经迫不及待想回到以前那种无聊乏味的工作中去了。

en: Girdles and cloth wrap tightly around the hilt, proposing the story of an unlikely protector having to adjust the grip on the weapon spontaneously.
cn: 各种绑带紧紧缠绕着握把，很有可能是某位意料之外的捍卫者为了适应这把武器的分量而自行捆绑的。

en: Read The Springlands Obelisk Of The Shroud
cn: 阅读春日平原的瘴气方尖碑

en:
We are hungry. We had to destroy the bridge — and with it our connection to supplies. But it worked: we haven't seen any more "Scavengers". The Cinder Vault — and those within it — are safe, and should remain so. 

If we are to avoid starvation in Yearfall, we may have to take our chances in the horrible Shroud. Either choice is certain death... 

Perhaps my men are right. In whispered words, they speak of the end times — of an end to the Dawn Age, the empire of man... But we must stand tall. There's no way but forward.
— <lorename>Captain Arkwright</lorename>
cn:
现在大家都饥肠辘辘。之前我们被迫摧毁了大桥，这导致我们的后勤补给也被一并切断了。但是这个方法起作用了：自那之后我们就再也没有看见过任何“拾荒者”。余烬密室还有里面的那些人已经安全了，而且以后也不用担心遇到危险。

如果不想在岁末饿死，我们只能冒险进入那片可怕的瘴气。但是无论怎么做，恐怕等待我们的就只有死亡……

也许我的手下是对的。他们压低嗓子说这是一切的终焉，黎明时代与人类的帝国将迎来灭亡……但我们决不能退缩，我们必须勇往直前。
— <lorename>阿克怀特队长</lorename>

en: Superior magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 卓越魔法弹药，使用时将施放一个强力火球，火球将在撞击时爆炸，并对中等范围内的目标造成伤害。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: The horror! Caught in a rainstorm, we were searching for a place to stay dry and rest... We heard them scratching and growling... they must have smelled us because they attacked unprovoked. One of them ripped Christophe's head clean off! His body dropped to the ground like a wet grain sack, and his club slipped out of his hands before he could use it. The beast was covered in thick, matted fur, with huge tusks jutting from its mouth. And when it roared, the sound was so strange and ear-shattering. VUKARRRRRR!!! I will be haunted by it for the rest of my days.
cn: 简直是一场噩梦！原本我们只是想要寻找一个干燥的落脚点躲避暴风雨……然后我们就听见了他们在洞窟中抓挠咆哮的声响……他们一定是嗅到了我们的气味，接着便毫无来由地对我们发起了攻击。其中一个家伙甚至直接拧断了克里斯托弗的脑袋！他无头的尸体就像是一袋谷子一样直挺挺倒了下去。他甚至没来得及用自己的棒子，武器就从他手里滑了出去。 那些野兽浑身长满了厚实缠结的毛发，巨大的獠牙就直挺挺地从嘴角戳了起来。它们不停咆哮着重复那个震耳欲聋的诡异词语。沃卡！！！恐怕我到死都忘不了那个声音。

en: Use climbing walls to reach higher levels of elevation. Climbing will consume Stamina.
cn: 通过攀爬墙壁前往高处。攀爬将消耗体力。

en: You've done it! The animals look so happy! What a joy! Thank you so much, Flameborn!
cn: 你成功了！动物们看上去也很开心！真是太好了！谢谢你，火之子！

en: If you continue on your path, you may discover new ways to customize your appearance.
cn: 在继续自己的旅途的过程中，你也许能够找到全新的方式来定制自己的外观。

en: You need to extract the current gem before inserting a new one.
cn: 你需要先提取当前宝石，之后才能镶嵌新的宝石。

en: Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
cn: 瘴气附魔： 这把武器已经被瘴气侵蚀。只能够在瘴气巢穴中找到。

en: The location of the Revelwood Hollow Halls were discovered. Fight your way to the end and smite down the one-eyed beast to obtain new crafting ingredients for the Collector. This will not be an easy task. Gather your strength and your allies, if present, to prepare yourself accordingly.
cn: 你已经发现喧嚣森林空荡礼堂的位置。前往深处并打倒独眼之兽，获取收藏家的全新制作原料。 这是一个极其危险的任务，出发前召集同伴并做好万全准备。

en: Do let me know if you need anything else!
cn: 如有其他需要，请告诉我！

en: Part of the Radiant Paladin Armor.
A formidable Glider which can cross even the deepest trenches, allowing you to rain death from above.
cn: 功能强大的滑翔翼，甚至能够飞跃深不见底的裂谷，你将能够从天而降，对敌人发起毁灭性攻击。

en: Phew, what a close call that was! You must be the rugged hero who saved me! Mh... you wear the "survivalist" look well. If you ever want to try another style, don't hesitate to ask for "Elio Ricci!"
cn: 咻，刚刚真是太惊险了！感谢你救了我一命，粗犷的英雄！嗯……你的“生存主义者”风格倒是很不错。不过如果想要尝试一下不同的造型，我“埃里奥·里奇”一定能够帮助你实现愿望！

en: Even simple strings can be a powerful tool in the right hands. Weave 'em tight, and you'll get padded armor that will break anyone's fall. A Loom is crucial, however.
cn: 在正确之人的手中，哪怕是简单的线绳也能变成强大的工具。只要想办法紧密编织起来，你的加固护甲就能够轻松抵挡坠落时的冲击力。不过首先你需要确保自己拥有一台织布机。

en:
I'm worried about Junior. 

I've worked so hard to create a good life for him — one that shields him from war and death... yet, whether it's childish defiance or a wish to follow his father's footsteps, Junior refuses to feel comforted by our quaint existence. 
He won't let go of this dream of becoming a soldier... a nightmare in disguise, I'm afraid. If he could just settle down and take over the salon instead, I'm certain he'd live a better, or at least, longer life!
cn:
我很担心孩子的情况。

我这么努力工作就是为了让他能过上好日子，让他能够远离战争和死亡……但是，不知道究竟是幼稚的叛逆还是想要跟随父亲的脚步，那小子就是不愿意接受我们现在这样的平静生活。
他总是放不下成为士兵的梦想……但他根本不明白那种生活有多么恐怖。只要他能够接管沙龙安心过日子，不说能过得多好，至少不用整天提心吊胆！

en: Here Lie The Greatest Builders Of The Night Of Horror
cn: “恐怖之夜”的伟大建设者们在此长眠

en: Carved from foraged dead wood and dusty roots, this axe was hardened in the sun to tear flesh and split bones.
cn: 经过烈日暴晒之后，这柄用枯木与老旧根须制作而成的斧子能够轻松劈裂血肉与骨头。

en: Can only be opened during the day
Failed to load details for shared world.
cn: 未能成功加载共享世界的细节。

en: Each perk costs Runes. Gather Runes by salvaging weapons and other equipments.
cn: 每个特性都需要消耗符文。拆解武器与装备以获取符文。

en: Bait that increases the chance of catching rare fish.
cn: 鱼饵，能够提高捕获稀有鱼的概率。

en: Your inner Flame illuminates paths, grants access to Ancient Spires and enables Fast Travel. The Flame can be strengthened at a Flame Altar.
cn: 你的内在灵火能够照亮道路，让您可以使用远古尖塔以及开启快速移动。 你可以在灵火祭坛强化灵火。
琴弦就像是人与人之间的关系，断了就不容易再弥补。

en:
This is a rare, midnight-black variant of the Stripetail. Its dark scales absorb light, making it nearly invisible underwater. This patient predator strikes from the depths when you least expect it.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
全身像深夜一样乌黑的稀有条纹尾变种。黑色的鳞片能够吸收光芒，使得它在水下几乎能够彻底隐身。当你放松警惕的时候，这种沉稳的捕食者便会从深海中出击。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。

en: A wondrous material. It is transparent and offers many potential applications, especially in building and crafting!
cn: 一种不可思议的透明材料，拥有着各式各样的用途，在建筑以及制作方面中尤其有用！

en: The defense tower at Fawnsong Frontier hides special Citywall Blocks. Explore the area around the tower and find the building blocks to unlock more material options!
cn: 鹿歌边疆的防御塔中藏有特殊的城墙方块。探索塔楼周遭区域并找到建筑方块以解锁更多材料选项！
维持以下条件以进行休息：

en: Increases the skill level of Snake Eater
cn: 提高食蛇者的技能等级

en: Flameborn, you're the "helpful" sort, correct? Well, I'm conducting some "tests" that would benefit from your support and discretion. I must ask you to retrieve a "Gem of Bloodlust" from the Albaneve Summits. It envigorates our foes above the Shroud with additional brutality and cunning — and there's no reason not to claim their advantage for ourselves. No need to hand it over, I only need to see the thirst in your eyes after you've found one.
cn: 火之子，如果我没有记错的话，你是个“乐于助人”的人，对吗？总而言之，眼下我正在进行一些“实验”，并且需要你的支持与保密。我需要你给我提供一枚来自阿尔班耶夫山脉的“嗜血宝石”。此物为位于瘴气之上的敌人们带来了远超平常的残暴与狡猾能力，既然如此，何不将这现成的优势占为己有。不用给我，我只是想看看宝石对你带来的影响。

en:
An animal, also blessed by the Flame, that spreads light in the dark.

Found at night in the Springlands.
Can be used as fishing bait, especially liked by common fish.
cn:
受到灵火祝福的生物，能够在黑暗中带来光明。

能够在夜间的春日平原找到。
能够作为鱼饵使用，尤其受到常见鱼类的青睐。
黄金海卓克·达尔战利品

en: Shooting Special Arrows now triggers a Flurry of Arrows from the Multi Shot skill. Special Arrows fired this way will subtract from your ammunition.
cn: 现在发射特殊箭矢将触发多重射击技能的箭雨。 通过这种方式发射的特殊箭矢将消耗你的弹药。

en: The Scavengers are taking their loot away in wagons. The Circular Sawblades must have been taken to a nearby encampment. Following the road should lead one there.
cn: 拾荒者正在用马车运输战利品。圆形锯片肯定已经被带去了附近的营地。沿着路走应该就能找到他们的营地。

en: I am far from home, but it feels good to walk this plane again. And without an arrow between my ribs, no less. My name is Mei-Yin. Tell me: Do you celebrate the Lunar New Year?
cn: 虽然离家甚远，但我很高兴能够再次行走在世间。而且这次没有箭插在我的肋骨里。我的名字是梅茵。我有个问题：你们这里会庆祝农历新年吗？

en: She is less fearsome without her helmet. The acidic scent lingers, however.
cn: 摘下头盔之后，她已经没有了原先的凶狠。但是那股酸腐的气息依旧挥之不去。

en: Walker, /  — Patient Data, Archived — Report Nr. A.052
cn: 沃克 — 患者数据，已归档 — 病历号A.052

en: A type of limestone derived from seashells.
cn: 从贝壳转变而来的石灰石。

en: Green pants which allow the wearer to glide through tall grass swiftly and silently.
cn: 绿色裤子能让穿着者在高高的草丛中悄无声息地穿梭。

en: The Admin role requires a password.
An electrified strand of nerves. It's a sought-after magical ingredient needed in some spell recipes.
cn: 一簇导电神经。一种抢手的魔法材料，能够用于特定法术配方。

en:
A bony Cyclops pelvis. It's eerie.

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
cn:
独眼巨人的盆骨。看上去十分诡异。

能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到此收集品。能够在独眼巨人战利品底座上重新组装为一套完整的独眼巨人骷髅。

en: We're ready to create better padding now. That should protect us from the cold!
cn: 现在我们已经准备好制作更好的衬垫。这应该能够帮助抵御寒冷！

en: To Commander Cyrus, Day 62 of Yearwake, 507 D.A.: Where is Queen Jezmina? I am in desperate need of her counsel! When she made the decision to split our caravan in half, there was so much confusion and chaos that my younger brother, Gustav, was placed in the southern caravan. He may look like a grown man, but he has the mind of a child and is confused easily!! I was under the impression that he was in the wagon behind me, sleeping... by the time we awoke, I realized he was gone. What will Gustav do without me to care for him? Please, Commander Cyrus, I must reunite with Gustav before we head towards Rattlebleak!
cn: 致指挥官赛鲁斯，岁初第62日，507 D.A.： 杰兹米娜女王到底去哪了？我现在急需她的指导！ 当初她决定把车队一分为二的时候，一切都乱得不可开交，在当时的混乱中，我的弟弟古斯塔夫被安排进了南部车队。虽然他看上去像是个成年人，但他的心智就跟个孩子一样，很容易就会被搞糊涂！！ 一开始我以为他还在我们身后的马车上睡觉……但是等我们醒过来的时候，我才意识到他已经走了。要是没有我来照顾他，古斯塔夫一个人该怎么办？拜托了，指挥官赛鲁斯，在我们出发前往荒啸镇之前，我必须要找到古斯塔夫！

en: You've obtained a new furry best friend. Bring them home to your base and place them there! Maybe they will let you pet them?
cn: 你已经得到了一位毛茸茸的新朋友。将它带回你的基地，并将它放置在基地中！也许你可以摸摸狗狗？

en: Silvery like the sea glass on long-forgotten shores. Something within this ring inspires hope.
cn: 银光闪闪，就像久远海岸上的海玻璃。这枚戒指中的某种东西激发了人们的希望。

en: A blade that devours foes easily. It carved its name into countless bodies in battle.
cn: 像恶狼般吞噬敌人的剑刃。此剑在战斗中夺取了无数条生命。
黑铁海卓克·达尔战利品

en: These boots must've previously been worn by a solemn noble quietly roaming through the church gardens.
cn: 这些靴子肯定曾经属于某位在教堂花园边沉默地来回踱步的肃穆贵族。

en: Elaborate armguards that shield the wearer from snow, rime, and grime. An amethyst has been inserted into the gem slot, enabling a better mana flow when spellcasting.
cn: 做工精美的护腕能够帮助穿戴者抵御冰雪、泥泞与血渍的侵扰。手套上嵌有一枚紫水晶，这能够帮助施法者引导魔力脉流。

en: You're ready to catch your first fish. Hook the bait onto your rod and head to any body of water large enough for fishing. Come back to show her what you’ve caught!
cn: 你已经准备好捕捞自己的第一条鱼。为鱼竿挂上鱼饵，然后前往大小合适的水体进行钓鱼。记得将你的成果带回去给她看！

en: You know that I can help you change your eye color, right? Eyes are the window to the soul, so they represent your "outlook" on life! Take it from my client — What was his name? Tony? Timo? He worked at a cursed construction site before an accident changed his course forever. When I first saw him, his eyes were bright blue and filled with mania, but his gaze and demeanor softened as he recovered from the incident. It's not just an old wives tale! It's true!
cn: 你应该知道我可以改变你的眼睛颜色吧？眼睛是通往灵魂的窗户，所以它们同样代表了你的人生“面貌”！就拿我以前的一位客人说吧……他叫什么名字来着？托尼？提莫？总而言之，他曾经在一个被诅咒的建筑工地工作，但是一场意外事故永远改变了他的人生。第一次看见他的时候，他的双眼闪耀着疯狂的亮蓝色，但是当他逐渐从事故的创伤中恢复过来之后，他的目光与举止都变得温和了许多。这可不是我在吹牛！都是真的！
写给<lorename>杰兹米娜</lorename>女王的情书

en: Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile.
cn: 虚空复制： 魔棒的独特魔法使其有30%的几率制造出额外的射弹。

en:
The <npc>Blacksmith</npc> needs a <craftingstation>Smelter</craftingstation> to craft better equipment. To craft a  <craftingstation>Smelter</craftingstation>, a <keyitem>Crucible</keyitem> is needed.

He suspects the Scavengers have his old <keyitem>Crucible</keyitem> at their mine in the Revelwood.
cn:
<npc>铁匠</npc>需要<craftingstation>冶炼炉</craftingstation>才能制作更优良的装备。但是制作<craftingstation>冶炼炉</craftingstation>之前首先需要找到一个<keyitem>熔炉</keyitem>。

<keyitem>熔炉</keyitem>应该在拾荒者的手里，他们在喧嚣森林有一处矿井。

en: We had to fill the carts with at least 6 pounds of salt for Saline Springs, so I was pulling extra hours after the sun had gone down. I went through the motions with a blank mind when my pickaxe suddenly struck something solid. As I pulled to loosen my tool, a large stone chunk was brought forth into the lantern's dim glow. The relief looked different from the shimmering salt surrounding it, but I could barely make it out in the low light. Squinting, I tried to focus on the shape. Nestled inside a lap of rubble sat a near-spherical object. I commanded my tired eyes to follow the swirling lines that drew toward its center, but became ever more drowsy. When I reached out to trace it, I felt a sharp pain in my shoulder. How long had I been digging? I decided to rest. It took some time to heal up. In my absence, they've opened a new mineshaft and boarded up the old one. Maybe it's for the better. We can't be distracted when there's a quota to meet.
cn: 我们得马车装上至少6磅的盐，盐泉需要那些东西，所以在太阳下山之后，我还在继续工作。 工作的时候，我一直处于放空的状态，直到我感觉我的镐子突然砸到了硬的东西。拿开工具之后，提灯的黯淡光芒便照亮了一块巨大的石头。这块石头的质地跟周围闪闪发光的盐块完全不一样，但是在昏暗的灯光下，我什么也看不清。我眯起眼睛想要看清楚这东西的形状。这时候我发现石块中间好像有一个球体一样的东西。 我努力打气精神想要查看通往球体中间的漩涡线条，但是我只感觉自己昏昏沉沉的。当我伸出手想要抚摸石头的时候，我突然感觉肩膀一阵剧痛。我到底在这里挖了多久？我决定要休息一下。 过了好一会我才喘过气来。在我离开的这段时间里面，他们打开了一条新的矿道，然后把旧的那条给堵死了。也许这么做才是最好的。我们得完成指标，不能被其他事情耽搁。

en: Healing spells can perform Critical Strikes that scale with your Critical Strike damage.
cn: 治疗法术能够造成暴击，具体治疗量受暴击伤害影响。

en: Instead of exploiting the ruins of forgotten times, you vow to protect them — to uphold their sanctity for reverence not only today, but tomorrow.
cn: 你没有选择去挖掘被时间遗忘的废墟，而是发誓要守护那些地方——守护那些圣洁之地并不是为了今日之人，而是未来的敬畏。

en: Reach The Far Side Of <location>Willow Crush</location>

cn: 阿尔班耶夫山脉的火花

en: Woven pants which keep the wearer from scraping their knees.
cn: 梭织裤，可防止穿着者刮伤膝盖。

en: Upload failed! There were no Flame Altars found in your world!
cn: 上传失败！未在你的世界中找到灵火祭坛！

en: Attention, weary travelers! Do not heed the violent rumors surrounding this land. Beneath the very ground lies a cure-all for what ails you! As the new owner of this land I, Costner Meyers, kindly invite you to sample my "Incredible Elixir" — which came to me in a miraculous vision! Anyone who comes by before the end of yearfall will get the first flask for half the prize! Try it, you will find yourself transformed! Come one, come all! — Costner Meyers
cn: 走过路过不要错过，欢迎各路疲惫旅人！不要听信关于这片土地的不实谣言。这里的地面之下埋藏着能够治愈一切的万能灵药！身为这里的新主人，我，科斯特纳·迈耶斯，诚挚邀请各位品鉴我的“神奇魔药” —这一切都来源于神灵给我带来的幻象！ 岁末结束前所有人都可以享受第一瓶半价优惠！ 很快你就会发现自己改头换面！千万不要错过大好机会！ — 科斯特纳·迈耶斯

en: I've Got My Eye On You
I've put them in a chest inside the forge. Careful when you take 'em out — they're hot. I'll take a break now. Don't look for me. I won't work on anything else until these burns clear up.
cn: 我已经将东西放在锻炉中的一个箱子里了。拿出来的时候一定要小心——它们很烫。 我要休息了。别来找我。在这些烧伤痊愈之前，我什么也干不了。

en: A dangerous, rotting substance, made half-liquid by its state of decay.
cn: 因为严重腐烂，这种危险的物质已经变成半液体状态。

en: Increases damage dealt with two-handed melee weapons.
cn: 增加双手近战武器的伤害。

en: Damage against Hollow is increased by %k.
Someone was planning a throwing knife act in New Cromville. Investigate the area to retrieve the leftover knives!
cn: 之前有人计划在新克罗姆威尔举行飞刀表演。调查区域并取回遗留的匕首！

en: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the wall.
cn: 这个排水口会移除其上方的任意水体。能够放置在墙壁上。

en: The Alchemist mentioned that his old home in Lone Thistle attracted cats because of a rat infestation. Even after all these years, there's a chance that some cats still populate the area. Craft cat food bait with the Farmer for taming a stray cat to proceed!
cn: 炼金术士提到说他在孤蓟镇的旧屋曾经老鼠泛滥成灾，因此吸引了不少野猫。虽然已经过去了许多年，但说不定那块区域中仍然能够找到野猫。 借助农民的帮助来制作猫粮诱饵并驯服一只野猫！

en: Finally, a Beehive Smoker! The bees will love it... and I can serve spicy-sweet grilled yucca at last! Let's place it so we may later craft a Honey Beehive and watch the little guys dance!
cn: 终于，一个熏蜂器！那些蜜蜂肯定会”爱死”这东西了……我现在终于能够做甜辣烤丝兰果了！现在我们需要给它找地方布置起来，这样我们就可以制作一个蜂巢，我已经迫不及待想看那些小家伙们跳舞了！

en: A block crafted from Luminous Growth material that glows in the dark. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 使用幽光土材料制作的方块，能够在黑暗中闪闪发光。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: The crown sent word. We ought to prepare a new vessel for its maiden voyage, but the ship’s to be sent off with cargo none of us are allowed to inspect. Strange business. Crates bear no marks, no writs, no tally for the ledger... and they're sealed shut. The Lord deems them of such weight that his own men were dispatched to see them stowed. Thought I’d see sharp-eyed veterans, but the lot that stumbled in yesterday looked half-dead, eyes glazed and dragging their boots. They’re fixing cannons to a merchant hull... my hull. Never seen the like. I know not the purpose of this lading, only that it sits ill with me. Shouldn't I know what shipments come and go like the back of my hand?
cn: 王室已经传过话了。 我们需要为一艘新的船只做好处女航的准备，但是所有人都不允许查看将被送上这艘船的货物。这件事真是充满古怪。货箱上没有任何标记或凭证，甚至连账本上也是空无一物……而且每个箱子都被封得死死的。 领主似乎十分重视此事，以至于他甚至派遣了自己的人来确保货物存放无误。我原本以为来的应该都是些能够凭眼神杀人的精英老兵，但昨天摇摇晃晃走进来的那群家伙看上去都一副半死不活的样子，两只眼睛空洞无神，走起路来也是有气无力。他们正在给一艘商船安装大炮……我的商船。从来没有见过这种事。 我不知道这么大费周折的目的是什么，我知道这一切感觉不对劲。难道我连知道自己要运什么货物的资格都没有吗？

en: Oh, you've found three epic instruments already! That's plenty for me to continue my research. It's strange... these instruments are so well crafted, they must've belonged to royals! Sadly, I don't know where to find the last instrument — but wasn't Valory the Bard the "balladeer of kings"? Maybe she'd know!
cn: 哦，你已经找到三件史诗乐器了！这些已经足以支撑我继续研究。好奇怪……这些乐器的做工异常精美，肯定原本是属于皇室成员的！但是很遗憾，我不知道该去哪里寻找最后的乐器，但我记得吟游诗人瓦罗里以前也被称为“诸王唱师”？说不定她知道！
增加对魔法敌人的伤害。

en: When the remaining time in the Shroud is below %k, defeated enemies drop time replenishing Orbs.
cn: 当瘴气停留时间低于%k时，击败敌人将使停留时间恢复恢复球秒。

en: Came back wrong. Had teeth growing all over. Organs were already rotted because the carcass was too old. Conclusion: Consider acquiring a living dog and killing it to have a fresh corpse for a vessel.
cn: 回来的时候不正常。身上长满了牙齿。因为躯壳太老，里面的器官都已经腐烂了。结论：考虑找一条活着的狗，用新鲜的尸体充当容器。

en: You've reached the Albaneve Summits! Extend the Flame's presence by igniting the Ancient Spire here so the light can guide you on your quest in these unknown lands!
cn: 你已经抵达阿尔班耶夫山脉！ 扩展灵火的影响力并点燃远古尖塔，光芒将指引你在这些未知的领域完成自己的使命！

en: Critical Strike Damage Vs Soaked Enemies
cn: 对湿透敌人的暴击伤害

en: Here Lie The Greatest Waterscape Builders
cn: 最伟大的水景建造者们长眠于此

en: The Azure Russula — an ancient mushroom, existing and consuming magic since the beginning of time. Unfortunately inedible if not cooked.
cn: 天蓝红菇是一种自古以来便存在着的魔法蘑菇，不过很可惜这种蘑菇只有在烹饪后才适合食用。

en: You've returned! What did you find? ... A man, stabbed by the Vukah? Baffling! And an old newspaper clipping, you say, written by a "Ramone Jones"? I've heard the name before... he was a writer from the capital! Seems like he rang the alarm bells for our Vukah pest ages ago. I wish I could thank him... despite the futility. Maybe I don't have to do this alone, after all... Thank you!
cn: 你回来了！你在那里有什么发现？一个被沃卡刺死的男人？真是令人费解！你说还有一份旧剪报，是“雷蒙·琼斯”写的？我听说过这个名字……这个人好像是首都的一位作家！看来他在多年以前就已经意识到了我们的沃卡问题。真该感谢他的警告才对……虽然我们最后还是失败了。不过也许有其他人可以帮助我……总之谢谢！

en: Simple but nourishing. Boosts Health and Stamina Regeneration.
cn: 朴实无华但富含营养的食物。提高生命值与体力恢复。

en: Pants fit for a midnight march. The metal plating is polished enough to reflect the moonlight.
cn: 适合在黑夜中前行的裤子。抛光打磨后的金属护板甚至能够反射冰冷的月光。

en: A excellently formulated mana potion that instantly restores a massive amount of mana upon use.
cn: 按照配方精心调制的魔力药水，使用时能够瞬间恢复巨量魔力。

en: Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.
cn: 空荡回音： 这把武器释放的不洁回响魔力能够延长攻击范围。

en: Remember always to provide your animals with food and sheltered beds. They might even make babies if we keep at least two happy animals together and have a spare bed nearby! Wouldn't that be nice?
cn: 记得要给动物们提供充足的食物与受到庇护的床。如果我们拥有两只快乐的动物，而且它们附近有空闲的床位，动物们说不定还会生宝宝！听起来是不是很不错？

en: A farmbed which will yield Saffron.
cn: 能够产出藏红花的农地。

en: A wand that especially talented scholars of the arcane forces favor. It's versatile and reflects the wielder's brilliance. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 天赋异禀的奥术学者们青睐的魔棒。这种全能型的武器象征着使用者本身的力量。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en:
No help has arrived
Without it, we are defenseless

There are too many of them, but we can't retreat
Scout says the passage collapsed
No way out
Only forward, into the trap... the maw of the beast

Lando, forgive me 
I never meant for things to end this way

Berhtolf
cn:
我们没有等到增援
孤立无援，我们注定灭亡

敌人无穷无尽，但我们无法逃跑
斥候汇报说通道已经崩塌
没有出去的路了
现在我们只能继续向前，哪怕那里是陷阱……是野兽之口

兰多，请原谅我
这绝不是我想要的结果

巴索夫

en: Pants which shield the legs from brambles and thorns while hunting down prey.
cn: 荆棘密布时也能保护双腿，助你追捕猎物。

en: The <npc>Barber</npc> needs a proper place to sleep. Build him a sheltered bed to progress!
cn: <npc>理发师</npc>需要一个合适的地方来睡觉。为他建造一处拥有庇护的床以继续！

en: Used to transfer items from your backpack to matching magic chest stacks nearby. Magic chests must be placed within a 24 m radius of this station.
cn: 能够将你的背包中的物品转移至附近对应的魔法箱并堆叠存放。魔法箱必须放置在该站点的24米范围内。

en: This liquid was created by crushing ectoplasm shards and gathering the resulting goo. It's been filtered and is technically sterile.
cn: 将灵质晶片彻底捣碎后获得的粘稠液体。理论上经过筛滤处理过后已经达到了无菌的标准。

en: Frank, I Won't Gather Gloomberries Anymore
cn: 弗兰克，我不想再去摘暗夜果了

en: You want to know about epic instruments? They were common in royal courts — I've played a tune or two with them, mostly when I taught my princess student to play the harp. Jezmina was her name! Lovely girl. That was ages ago. Maybe her instrument is still at her home in Ocean's Heart!
cn: 你想知道史诗乐器的事情？当年在宫廷里面其实很常见，我也用过那些乐器，不过当时主要还是在教向我拜师学艺的公主殿下弹奏里尔琴。公主殿下的名字是杰兹米娜！她是一个很可爱的女孩子。不过那已经是很多很多年以前的事情了。她以前的家就在海洋之心，说不定乐器还在那里！

en:
A collection of bright oranges that exhibit a warm and inviting glow.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
展现温暖与热情的暖光的明亮橙色。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。

en:
Nutritious Cat food for tame pets.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
cn:
为已经驯服的宠物准备的营养猫粮。

必须被放置在对应的喂食器中。

en: They say that dogs are man's best friend. Find and adopt a dog to test that hypothesis! This animal is linked to an important quest. Follow the instructions in your journal to proceed!
cn: 据说狗是人类最好的伙伴。寻找并收养一条狗以验证这个假设！ 这只动物关乎一项重要任务。 跟随日志中的指示以继续！

en: The Hand Spindle was left behind in an abandoned Hunter's camp. It needs to be returned to the Hunter and placed in the base.
cn: 纺线锤被遗落在了一处废弃的猎人营地中。将之归还给猎人并放置在基地中。

en: A perplexing wand, corrupted by the Shroud. It bends the mind of its bearer. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 被瘴气腐化的诡异魔棒。这把魔棒将会扭曲使用者的心智。 虚空复制： 魔棒的独特魔法使其有30%的几率制造出额外的射弹。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en:
Above and beyond, we rise
Solemn light shines upon thy face before candlelight roams
Behind the creaks and cracks of oak, it lies
A secret held by brittle bones
cn:
我们永远扶摇直上
徘徊的烛光将寂寞的光芒洒在了你的面孔上
就在吱嘎作响的橡木缝隙背后，它沉睡着
那是脆弱骸骨把守的秘密

en: When equipped with a Melee weapon, you can perform an evade attack, which dashes towards the enemy and deals more weapon damage with %k. Cost: 20 Stamina Block Breaker This special attack fills a blocking enemy's Stun Bar twice as much when hit.
cn: 当装备近战武器时，你可以进行闪避攻击，冲向敌人并用%k造成更多的武器伤害 。 消耗：20点体力 破防打击 这种特殊攻击将对格挡中的敌人施加两倍的晕眩条增长。

en: I'm getting that tingling sensation under my fingernails again... the unmistakable call of change! I feel the urge to try a daring new color. Bold, radiant hues in a sweeping gradient... just like the sky when the sun rises!
cn: 我又有那种指甲缝中隐隐作痛的感觉了……这毫无疑问是渴望改变的呼唤！我现在有一种强烈的渴望想要尝试一种大胆的新发色。大胆，璀璨，而且是横扫一切的明亮……就像是日出时的天空那样！

en: Your settings file is corrupt and must be fixed or reset to default to proceed.
cn: 你的设置文件已损坏，请先修复或重置为默认以继续。

en:
This sleek, silver-scaled fish is known for the distinctive metallic sheen along its back, which gives it its name.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
这种长着银色鳞片的细长鱼类最为显著的特点是脊背上独特的金属光泽，这也是它们的名字的由来。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。

en: Long ago, humans and a group of Ancients worked together to create a last safe haven for humanity. Humans were laid to rest in Cinder Vaults, which were meant to protect their bodies from falling to the Shroud. They've waited patiently to be woken from their dreamless slumber by those born from the flame.
cn: 很久以前，人类与一群远古者齐心协力为人类创造了最后的庇护所。残存的人类在余烬密室中休眠，在这种状态下，他们的身体将不用担心受到瘴气的影响。 无数的岁月过去，他们依旧在静静等待着诞生自火焰之人将自己从无梦的沉眠中唤醒。

en: The current temperature of your body. A low body heat can be deadly.
cn: 你当前的身体温度。体温过低会引发致命后果。

en: Celebrate The Pact Of The Flame

Select the NPC you want to place. 

After they are placed, NPCs must be assigned to sheltered beds. If left unassigned, they will automatically occupy a free bed within a 10-meter range at night.

You can manually assign them by pointing at a bed with the Summoning Staff while having an NPC selected.
cn:
选择要安置的 NPC。 

放置 NPC 后，必须将其分配到庇护所的床位上。如果不分配，他们会在夜间自动占据 10 米范围内的空床。

您可以在选中 NPC 的同时用 召唤法杖 指向床铺，手动分配它们。

en: Lush'Kyss: I beg thee, Sir Lancehart, avert thine eyes! As my form lies bare before thee under the moonlight's embrace, thine gaze fills me with shame! Sir Lancehart: Not shame, but desire swells in thee, my little Lush! Thine flushed strawberry cheeks betray thee! Lush'Kyss: Don't step closer! My waters run so deep and warm, they may swallow thee so and lock thee away until the golden glow of morn! Sir Lancehart: So locked away I must be! Sweep me under thine waves, for my heart yearns for naught more than to be held firm beneath thee, to gaze up at the crescent and the supple bosom it illuminates! Lush'Kyss: Oh, to join me in this river's dance wild and free, Sir Lancehart, thine spirit must truly be unchained — but must thee prod me so below with thine appetite? Sir Lancehart: Dearest Lush, what thee feels beneath is my lance's tip, to keep us safe whilst we drown in pleasure. I never set forth without protection! Lush'Kyss: Oh, how considerate! One should always bring such wards!
cn: 拉许·基斯： 我恳求你，兰斯哈特爵士，请移开你的目光！现在我的身体在月光的拥抱下暴露无遗，你的目光让我的心中充满了羞耻！ 兰斯哈特爵士： 不，不是羞耻，你的心中洋溢着的是欲望，我亲爱的拉许！看，那像草莓般嫣红的脸颊已经背叛了你！ 拉许·基斯： 不要过来！我体内的水域温润而深邃，它们有可能会直接将你吞噬囚禁，直到清晨的璀璨光芒到来！ 兰斯哈特爵士： 那就快把我带走吧！让你的波涛将我席卷，此刻我的心中只渴望着在你身下被紧紧攥住，我想要凝视那新月与它照亮的丰满怀抱！ 拉许·基斯： 哦，与我一起加入这场狂野自由的大河之舞吧，兰斯哈特爵士，你一定是拥有真正不羁的灵魂——但你难道非要用自己的欲望来搅动我的深邃吗？ 兰斯哈特爵士： 亲爱的拉许，你的身下感受到的不过是我的长枪的尖头，我这么做是为了在沉溺于欢愉之中时保证我们的安全。要知道我向来最注重安全！ 拉许·基斯： 哦，真是体贴！确实每一个人都应该随时戴好这样的守护！

en: Used to transfer items from your backpack to matching magic chest stacks nearby. Magic chests must be placed within a 16 m radius of this station.
cn: 能够将你的背包中的物品转移至附近对应的魔法箱并堆叠存放。魔法箱必须放置在该站点的16米范围内。

en: You've found both wall tapestry pieces. You can place them in a frame at your base to repair the tapestry. Completing the collection will unlock new crafting recipes. Since crafting recipes are shared serverwide, this collection must be assembled once per server to reap the benefits. This entry will be completed once the collection has been assembled on the server. XP rewards are only awarded once.
cn: 你已经找到了两块挂毯碎片。回到基地后，你可以将碎片放置在框架中并修复挂毯。 完成收藏将解锁新的制作配方。因为制作配方会全服务器共享，该收藏必须在每个服务器中集齐一次才能够解锁奖励。 服务器收藏完成后，该条目也将同时完成。经验值奖励只能够获得一次。

en: A bright, silvery white sand that mostly consists of crushed seashells.
cn: 银白明亮的细沙，主要由粉碎的贝壳构成。

en: Whether to use 1D target cycling or 2D target cycling.
cn: 决定以1D还是2D方式进行目标切换。

en: This simple fragment can be processed into a stunning Red Marble Block.
cn: 这块不起眼的碎片能够加工为让人惊艳的红色大理石方块。

en: This item will dispense water endlessly until it is submerged.
cn: 这件物品将会持续喷水，直到其自身已经浸没在水中。

en: Back in the day, I was a rowdy lad. I'd spent each school day by the beach instead of on the classroom bench, kicking strangers' sand castles and skipping rocks on the water. Once, I spotted a small boat in the distance, with a shadowy figure balancing on it. As I focused my attention there, their shapes toppled and morphed into one, disturbing the water around. Did someone slip into the lake? I waited to see the person resurface, but no one emerged. Moments later, a creature made from seaweed and saltwater rose from beneath the rippling waves by the shore. It was much closer than the boat had been, and as it neared, I began to spot a graying face below the heap of algae. It was the captain. I asked him how he was able to cross the waters between the sinking ship and the beach so quickly. He smiled, and said: "A mermaid's kiss gave me fins, dear boy!" and trotted off. Only later did I notice that his feet had left a strange imprint in the sand. Could his story have been true?
cn: 在过去，我是个惹是生非的混小子。我没有一天是老老实实坐在教室的板凳上听课的，平常我就会在沙滩上游荡，踹飞陌生人堆的沙堡或在水边打水漂。 有一次，我在远方看见了一艘小船，上面有一个晃晃悠悠的神秘身影。就当我集中注意看向那里的时候，小船上的身影突然倒了下去并在周围溅起了巨大的水花。是有人掉进湖里面了吗？我焦急地等待着那个人重新浮出水面，但一无所获。 过了一会，一个由海草与咸水构成的生物从岸边的涟漪之下钻了出来。那个东西要比小船更接近岸边，当它逐渐靠近，我发现成堆的藻类之下其实隐藏着一张灰白的面孔。是船长。 我立刻问他怎么能够在如此短的时间内从沉船直接游到了海滩边。男人只是笑了笑并说道：“是人鱼之吻让我长出了鱼鳍，亲爱的孩子！”之后他便大步流星走开了。 片刻之后，我才意识到他的脚掌在沙地里留下了奇怪的印记。难道他刚刚说的故事是真的？

en: Damage against Vukah is increased by %k.
A magical staff that gleams with hope, able to unleash powerful magical attacks. Staffs can cast spells by using spell charges and mana. Equip spell charges to cast.
cn: 闪烁着希望之光的法杖，能够释放强大的魔法攻击。 法杖能够通过消耗法术充能与法力施放法术。装备法术充能以施放法术。

en: The Bard has pointed you towards the location of a hand drum. Reach the location and acquire the instrument to unlock more songs! Once the instrument has been found on the server, it becomes craftable. Crafting the hand drum will also unlock the song in question.
cn: 吟游诗人为你指出了一处存在手鼓的地点。前往指定地点并获取乐器以解锁更多歌曲！ 只要服务器中有人发现过乐器，之后你就可以制作对应乐器。制作手鼓还将解锁歌曲。

en: Scales all enemy stamina by this value. It will take longer to stun enemies with a higher enemy stamina.
cn: 根据该数值调整所有敌人体力。提高敌人体力将使其更难被晕眩。

en: Save data error. Save data erase failed
cn: 存档数据损坏。删除存档数据失败

en: Gloves made for beginner fighters. Robust, but agile. They will mainly protect you from blisters when swinging your sword.
cn: 为初级斗士准备的手套。牢固而且灵活。主要用途在于避免双手因为过度挥剑而长水泡。

en: Ohh it's good to be back! Wow this place really fell apart without me, eh? Ha! Well, let's spruce things up a bit!
cn: 能回来真是太好了！唉哟，看来没有我这地方就不行了啊？哈哈！没事，是时候来做点整修工作了！

en: The map marks the location of the Alchemist, hidden in an Ancient Vault. They hold great knowledge and truth over potions and spells.
cn: 地图显示了炼金术士所处的远古密室位置。此人在药水与法术方面的造诣无人可及。

en: You can climb walls which are fitted with iron lattices. These Climbing Walls can be found out in the world or in dungeons. Walk up to the Climbing Wall to latch on to the iron lattice. Climbing requires stamina. When you run out of stamina while climbing, you fall.
cn: 您可以攀登装有铁格子的墙。 这些攀爬墙可以在世界或地牢中找到。走到攀爬墙前，抓住铁格子。 攀爬需要体力。当您在攀爬过程中耗尽体力时，您就会摔下来。

en: My cousin Rolf is missing! He went to Orville to work as a pearl diver but never returned. Rolf may have been a daredevil, but he'd always send word whenever he'd run off! To anyone who's seen him: let me know where he is or bring him back home! - Willy
cn: 我的表弟罗尔夫不见了！ 他之前去奥威尔当潜水采珠人，但是一直没有回来。 罗尔夫虽然是个鲁莽的家伙，但无论跑到哪里，他都至少会想办法叫人带信回来！ 如果有人看见他：请立刻告诉我他的位置，或者将他带回家！ - 威利

en: My friend, if I had a sheltered bed... I could really put my skills to work.
cn: 我的朋友，如果能够拥有受到庇护的床……我相信我一定能够发挥我的全部技术。

en: A cleaver coated with acid and bile. Its victims can mend the bleeding — but rarely stop the toxins from spreading.
cn: 一把涂满酸液和胆汁的菜刀。它的受害者可以止血，但很少能阻止毒素扩散。

en: A ring that radiates affluence and tragedy. Was it freed from the ivory finger of a friend, a brother, a child of fortune? Could its fealty have been betrayed, its blood promise broken? Whatever story this ring may tell, its former lords are long gone.
cn: 散发着富裕与悲剧气质的戒指。它是从某个朋友、兄弟或者是富有子嗣的白皙手指上被取下来的吗？也许这枚戒指的主人惨遭背叛，用鲜血发下的誓言也被打破？无论这枚戒指到底见证了什么样的故事，它的原主人都早已消失不见。

en: Increases the skill level of Well Rested
cn: 提高休息良好的技能等级

en:
The villager Hannah Reed is missing her daughter and hopes you can find her near the Vukah Ceremony Hill. 

Investigate the area and search for pure souls there!
cn:
村民汉娜·里德十分想念自己的女儿，并且希望你能够去沃卡仪式陵寻找她。

调查区域并寻找纯洁灵魂！

en: Peer beyond the veil with me.
cn: 与我一起窥视帷幕之外的画面。

en: Spooky season is upon us! Use this book to learn how to decorate your home with Halloween-themed Props.
cn: 恐怖的季节已经降临！使用这本书来学习如何通过万圣节主题的道具来装饰自己的家园。

en: Showcase your beaming soul of flames and cast out all evil once and for all! The light thunders and roars with every heartbeat.
cn: 展示你燃烧着的灵火之魂，一举驱除世间邪恶！每一次心跳都会发出雷鸣般的光芒和咆哮。

en: Flameborn, I've been all over the world — and I've picked up both trinkets and traditions on my travels! These keepsakes tell stories of a different time — the oldest is this fossil I found! If we had more, we could make a whole collection and showcase it properly!
cn: 火之子，在浪迹天涯的旅程中，我找到了许多形形色色的有趣小玩意和传统！这些纪念品就像是来自过去的一个个故事碎片，其中最古老的就是我找到的这块化石！如果能够找到更多化石，我们说不定可以拼凑出完整的展品，还可以给其他人展示！

en: A classic pair of gloves. Don't they make you want to throw a snowball?
cn: 一双经典款式的手套。穿上之后是不是很想要和朋友们打雪仗？

en:
The pinnacle of potioncraft. It gained its name after rescuing users from countless near-death situations.

Instantly restores an unbelievable amount of health.
cn:
药水炼制工艺的巅峰之作。因为无数次帮助服用者死里逃生而得名。

立刻恢复超乎想象的大量生命值。

en: The arrow's shadow darts across the battlefield. Its presence is swift and fleeting, a daydream carried by a gust of wind — but its impact is precisely devastating. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
cn: 箭矢的阴影穿过了战争。它的身影一闪而过，就像是被轻风裹挟着的一个白日梦……但事实上，箭矢将带来精准的毁灭。 瘴气附魔： 这把武器已经被瘴气侵蚀，并且能够造成大量瘴气伤害。只能够在瘴气巢穴中找到。

en: "Commander <lorename>Cyrus</lorename>"'s ring was found inside the mouth of a large creature in The Pike.
cn: 指挥官<lorename>赛鲁斯</lorename>的戒指被发现卡在了崇山城中的一头巨大怪物的口中。

en: The duration of your Rested Buff is increased by an additional %k.
cn: 休息增益的持续时间会额外增加 %k.
巴尔萨扎的空荡礼堂研究

en: The new arrivals have wasted no time breaking ground, building something. A Flame Sanctum, Salim says. Their determination to the Ancients and the Flame is... fanatical. To think that we were all one people just about 25 years ago astounds me. Some nights I've lingered near the caravan. Salim insists. Over the fire, they talk of their home, the sands, and the creeping ruin. I can't understand their devotion, but I feel their sorrow. Everyone bleeds the same, as I've said... Salim says I am like a daffodil, the first sign of yearwake. He is a fool... though a sweet one. - Helên
cn: 新来的人们没休息多久就立马开始动工建造了起来。萨利姆说他们在建造一座灵火神殿。这些人对于远古者以及灵火的信念实在是……只能用几乎狂热来形容。难以想象仅仅25年前，我们和他们还仍然是一衣带水的同胞。 有几个晚上我去造访了车队。萨利姆坚持要邀请我。围坐在火边，他们跟我描述了自己的家园，沙漠还有如影随形的废墟。我不理解他们的虔诚，但那些故事中的悲伤却是显而易见。正像我从前说过的，无论来自何方，我们都流着同样的血…… 萨利姆说我就像是一株水仙，象征着岁初的到来。真是个傻瓜……不过我很喜欢。 - 海伦

en: Find a Gem Forge to insert a Gem
cn: 找到一处宝石锻炉以嵌入宝石

en: One arrow alone can be broken, but many together are unbreakable. You should search for others to join us.
cn: 分则败，合则荣。你应该寻找其他同伴。
我是闻到鲜鱼的味道了吗？

en: The gleaming gold and vibrant green crystals adorning the chestplate make it a shield and a statement of enduring strength. Watch out for the spiked shoulder pads!
cn: 胸甲上点缀的璀璨黄金与鲜亮绿水晶让它成为了一块屹立不倒的盾牌与坚韧不拔的象征。小心肩甲部分的尖刺！

en: I can't wait to create new seafood dishes!
cn: 我已经迫不及待想要研发新的海鲜料理了！

en: You've reached the Albaneve Summits quarry. Search the quarry for clues to find a color palette!
cn: 你已经抵达阿尔班耶夫山脉采石场。 在采石场中寻找关于调色板的线索！

en: Find The Cosmetic Items In The Springlands
cn: 在春日平原中寻找饰品

en: You defeated the enemies inside the Gem Forge and discovered that they were holding onto a resource called "Archaic Essence I". While the Gem Forge is still intact, the rest of the little sanctum is ransacked. Perhaps the Fell came here to claim the Archaic Essence I used in weapon augmentation for themselves. Follow the footsteps of the Fell and find out where they took the stashed energy resource!
cn: 你打败了宝石锻炉中的敌人，并且发现它们携带着 一种被称为“远古精华 I”的资源。 虽然宝石锻炉完好无损，但这座小型神殿的其余部分已经被洗劫一空。也许瘴气魔想要拿走这里的远古精华 I以强化自己的武器。 跟随瘴气魔的踪迹并找到被他们偷走的秘密能量源！

en: All the other <npc>Carpenter</npc>s would be laughing at me if they knew I didn't have a <craftingstation>Table Saw</craftingstation>! Except they're all dead. Joke's on them, I guess.
