cn: 要是让其他的<npc>木匠</npc>知道我连<craftingstation>锯台</craftingstation>都没有，他们肯定会笑掉大牙的！不过好在我的同行们都死绝了，所以现在只有我笑到了最后。

en: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.
cn: 一个展示柜，用于存放各地的矿井、矿脉或者是挖掘场中常见的各类化石收藏品。

en: Crucial bindings are missing. The control scheme will revert to its original bindings until the issues are corrected.
cn: 缺少关键绑定。在解决问题前将恢复为原始绑定控制方案。

en: Captain's Journal, Day Six of Midyear, 512 D.A.
cn: 队长的日志，岁中第6日，512 D.A.

en: A gold-plated chest plate, heavy and imposing — piercing it would be no easy task.
cn: 真正金光灿烂的胸甲，沉重而且威压 - 任何敌人都休想轻易穿透它的防护。

en: For every target you hit with an Explosive Arrow, its damage is increased by 1%.
cn: 爆炸箭矢每击中1名目标，则伤害提高1%。

en: Reassemble a valuable wall tapestry using this showcase.
cn: 使用这个展示柜来重新组装价值连城的挂毯。

en:
Success!
Pick the animal up and bring it back home.
Build an enclosure, feed it, and provide a sleeping space.
cn:
成功！
捡起动物并将其带回基地。
建造一处围栏，同时为其提供食物以及睡觉的住所。

en: By now you've learned of the Farmer's former tavern in Brittlebush. She built her tavern on her own and might still have building materials stored there. Find her tavern at the heart of the city and look for leftover loot!
cn: 如今你了解到农民以前在碎丛开过一家酒馆。那座建筑是她当初一砖一瓦亲手建造的，因此也许还能在那里找到当时留下来的建筑材料。在城市中心找到她的酒馆并寻找没被拿走的战利品！
找到并拯救罗茜的灵魂

en: Open The Hidden Chest At The Harbor
An improved antidote that will cure poison and negate the next poisoning.
cn: 这种改良型的解毒剂能够治愈毒素并抵消下一次的中毒效果。

en: Derived from Frost Resistance. The effective time you have left before suffering Hypothermia.
cn: 源自 寒冷抗性。您在遭受 低温症 之前所剩的有效时间。

en: Faintly smells of grain, sweet summer days, and honey.
cn: 散发着谷物、美妙的夏日与蜂蜜的淡淡香味。

en: Flameborn, I must bother you. An <craftingstation>Almanac of Plants and Seedlings</craftingstation> would be most useful!
cn: 火之子，我有个不情之请。我需要一本<craftingstation>植物与幼苗图鉴</craftingstation>！

en: The cloth of these billowy pants falls in ripples like waves in the cerulean sea.
cn: 在蔚蓝色的大海中，这些宽大裤子的布料会像波浪一样泛起涟漪。

en: Completing the collection will unlock new crafting recipes. Since crafting recipes are shared serverwide, this collection must be assembled once per server to reap the benefits. This entry will be completed once the collection has been assembled on the server. XP rewards are only awarded once.
cn: 完成收藏将解锁新的制作配方。因为制作配方会全服务器共享，该收藏必须在每个服务器中集齐一次才能够解锁奖励。 服务器收藏完成后，该条目也将同时完成。经验值奖励只能够获得一次。

en: A simple, light chest piece to complement the rest of the armor.
cn: 简单轻便的胸甲，能够与其他部件组成完成一套护甲。

en:
12.4	
Keen will notify you of the amended Terms in text form at least six weeks before the planned entry into force and will separately draw your attention to the new provisions and the date on which they enter into force. At the same time, Keen will grant you a reasonable period of at least six weeks to declare whether you accept the amended Adventure Sharing Terms for the continued use of Adventure Sharing and its features.
cn:
12.4	
Keen 将以文本形式在计划生效日之前至少提前六周通知您修订后的条款，并单独提醒您注意新条款及其生效日期。同时，Keen 将给予您一段至少六周的合理期限，以便您声明是否接受修订后的冒险分享条款以继续使用冒险分享及其功能。

en: Increases the attack speed of all One-Handed Melee weapons by %k.
cn: 所有单手近战武器的攻击速度提高%k。
冷冰冰的回应，岁末，506 D.A.

en: A small caravan of refugees arrived from the Kindlewastes today. And I thought my journey had been long... I've never spoken with anyone from the Kingdom of Orindell, and the thought made me nervous, but there was no time to tattle. I dove into work, dressing the wounds. A battle for life and death, even now. Sadly, some lost. We put them to rest in the crypt below. May the northern winds guide them to the afterlife. There's one who might live despite it all. A deep leg wound — but maybe not too far gone. The wounded, Salim, smiles a lot. Says he owes me his life... just luck, I think. - Helên
cn: 今天，一小队难民从燃火荒原抵达。亏我还一直觉得我的旅程已经足够漫长艰辛…… 我从来没有与奥林戴尔王国以外的人们交谈过，一想到这事我就有点紧张，但现在可没工夫去闲聊。我投入工作，包扎伤口。一场生死之战，即使是现在。遗憾的是，有些人死了。我们把他们安葬在地下墓室。愿北风指引他们走向来生。 尽管如此，还有一个人可能会活下来。他腿上的伤口很深，但也许还没有太严重。伤者萨利姆笑得很开心。他说他欠我一条命......我想这只是运气。 - 海伦

en:
Welcome to the Enshrouded Demo! As a game in development, you might encounter bugs and performance issues.
If you do, please press F1 in-game to report them.
Thank you and have fun!
cn:
欢迎来到《雾锁王国》试玩版！作为一款正在开发中的游戏，您可能会遇到错误和性能问题。
如果遇到，请在游戏中按F1键报告。
谢谢您，祝您玩得愉快！

en: Gain one point of Endurance for every two levels of the Flame.
cn: 每两级灵火获得1点耐力。

en: You need better equipment, and I need a <craftingstation>Smelter</craftingstation> to make it for ya! If you had my old <keyitem>Crucible</keyitem>, you could craft a <craftingstation>Smelter</craftingstation>. I think we share some goals here, ye?
cn: 我知道你需要更好的装备，但是首先我需要一个<craftingstation>冶炼炉</craftingstation>才能帮你做东西！如果你能找到我以前的<keyitem>熔炉</keyitem>，你就可以制作一个<craftingstation>冶炼炉</craftingstation>。我们目标一致，不是吗？

en: A menacing axe that sends shivering chills down its victim's back with every heavy two-handed swing. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.
cn: 这把充满恶意的双头利斧将让所有敌人不寒而栗。 空荡回音： 这把武器释放的不洁回响魔力能够延长攻击范围。

en: You've triggered a trap. It's time to act! Find all the buttons to open a path out of the flooding temple! The upper levels will hold the treasure you seek!
cn: 你触发了一道陷阱。现在是时候行动起来了！ 找到所有按钮以打开离开淹没神殿的道路！你要找的宝藏一定就藏在神殿上层！

en: The Farmer wants a Kettle as her first cooking equipment. She suggests looking for her friend, a man named Raúl, in Pikemead's Reach to get her Kettle back. To reach Pikemead's Reach, Shroud Passage Level 3 is required. Increase the Passage Level by strengthening the Flame.
cn: 农民想要烧水壶作为自己的首个炊具。她建议你去找她的朋友，这位叫劳尔的男子居住在派克米德之地，农民的烧水壶就在他的手上。 如果想要前往派克米德之地，你得确保自己的瘴气抵抗等级已经达到3级。强化灵火以提高瘴气抵抗等级。
在<location>彭斯沃斯</location>找到被诅咒的渔夫

en: The wilderness will bend to your will in no time when you face it wearing these sturdy, bite-proof boots.
cn: 穿上这双牢不可破的靴子，纵使是荒野也将向你低头。

en:
Nutritious Fae Deer food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
cn:
为农场中已经驯服的仙鹿准备的营养饲料。

必须被放置在对应的喂食器中。

en: An update of the game is available. You need to download the latest version of the game in order to use online features.
cn: 有游戏更新可用。下载最新版本以使用在线功能。

en: The helmet of a long-forgotten knight. With a bit of polish, it will be as good as new.
cn: 稍加擦拭，这顶被遗忘的骑士头盔将重焕光彩。

en: Increases the skill level of Blood Magic
cn: 提高鲜血魔法的技能等级

en: A resident of the harbor district in Pikemead's Reach hid a chest somewhere in his near-flooded basement. Find the chest and open it!
cn: 派克米德之地港口区的一位居民在自家几乎被淹没的地下室中藏了一口箱子。找到并打开宝箱！

en: This gate can be lowered or raised to control the water flow around it. It's perfect for gardeners who want an efficient way to water their plants!
cn: 可以通过升降这扇门来控制周围的水流。最适合那些想要高效浇灌植物的园丁！

en: A neglected building material which is often used to building high and sturdy walls. This block protected the denizens of many cities before the fall.
cn: 以前常被用来建造牢固高墙的建筑材料，现在已经严重老化。曾经像这样的方块肩负着保护诸多城市居民的重担。

en:
Green and brown with a hint of gold, like raining leaves on a slow day in fall.

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
绿褐相见外加一抹金色，就像是悠长秋日的雨中落叶。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。
查看燃火荒原古代方尖碑

en: The weaver's cottage in East Lapis was found. The Loom for the Hunter should be somewhere inside. It must be recovered in order to craft padding kits and better armor.
cn: 已经找到东之岩中的编织匠的小屋。猎人需要的织布机应该就在里面。 找到工具之后才能制作填充工具与更好的护甲。

en: The Mortar was found inside the Alchemist's hidden laboratory behind a closed door. It should be returned to its rightful owner. Placing the Mortar in the base will enable new crafting recipes.
cn: 磨臼被藏在了炼金术士的秘密实验室的一扇上锁大门背后。是时候让这东西物归原主了。 在基地中放置磨臼将解锁全新制作配方。

en: The Collector wants to see the untainted bones of a real Cyclops. Visit their caves and camps in the Albaneve Summits to find the limbs of these giants, and re-assemble them into a full collection in your base!
cn: 收藏家想要看见一头货真价实的独眼巨人的纯净骨头。拜访它们在阿尔班耶夫山脉的洞窟与营地以寻找这些巨人的骸骨，然后将它们带回你的基地并重新组装成一套完整的骷髅！

en: A knight's chestplate. It has a fading heroic aura.
cn: 骑士胸甲。它的英雄光环正在褪去。

en: Taste their blood and bring them down, one by one.
cn: 品尝它们的鲜血然后将其陆续打倒。

en: Not enough disc space! Please free up space by deleting some of your downloaded worlds.
cn: 磁盘空间不足！请删除一些已经下载的世界以腾出空间。

en: This collectible is found in the Revelwood.
cn: 此收藏品在 喧嚣森林 中找到。

en:
The Veilwater Basin is rich in vibrant colors. The blue sky reflecting in the clear waters — and at night, the waters glow faintly, as if holding onto the memory of the day’s colors.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
幕水盆地不乏鲜亮色彩。蓝色的天空倒影在清澈的水中——到了晚上，水面将会微微发光，那样子仿佛就是在努力回忆白天的色彩一样。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en:
The villager Robert Gibson misses his fiancée, Kaori. She was last seen in <location>East Lapis</location>, awaiting a bundle of clothes and fabrics she planned to ship.

Investigate the Weaver's Cottage in <location>East Lapis</location> to search for clues!
cn:
村民罗伯特·吉布森十分想念自己的未婚妻嘉里。最后一次有人看见嘉里是在<location>东之岩</location>，当时她正在等待一捆要寄走的衣服与织物。

调查<location>东之岩</location>的编织匠人小屋以寻找线索！

en: Increases the skill level of Dark Arts
cn: 提高黑魔法的技能等级

en: Press %k to lock onto your foes. Press %k to dodge out of harm's way.
cn: 按%k锁定敌人。按%k躲避攻击。

en: Scales the frequency of enemy attacks.
A finely handcrafted bow, used by seasoned woodland hunters.
cn: 老练的森林猎人们会使用的弓，做工精良。

en: Trigger a Shockwave when you parry an attack or overpower an enemy. The Shockwave pushes back nearby enemies. It also fills their Stun Bar, scaling with your Strength attribute. Parry A well-timed block with any Melee weapon or Shield will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Overpower Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered. Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.
cn: 招架攻击或者压制一名敌人时触发冲击波。 冲击波将击退附近的敌人。这还将同时使敌人的晕眩条增长，具体幅度由你的力量属性决定。 招架 看准时机使用任意近战武器或盾牌进行格挡将招架来袭攻击并使对手的晕眩条增长。 压制 攻击格挡中的敌人或者是招架敌人的攻击都会使他们的晕眩条上涨，直到最后进入被压制状态。 被压制的敌人将毫无防备，这种时候你可以对其发动残酷打击。

en: I can't believe it! Aunt Braelyn, in the flesh! She looks just like I remembered! Well, a little taller, maybe.
cn: 难以置信！竟然是布莱林姑姑！她还是我记忆中的样子！最多是好像高了一点。

en: An extravagantly exaggerated tricorn hat that shields the caster's head from snowfall. The imposing antlers are a wearable trophy representing the wearer's spirit animal.
cn: 造型浮夸而且华丽的三角帽，能够帮助施法者的头部免受落雪的干扰。威武的犄角其实是一种可穿戴式的战利品，并且象征着穿戴者的灵兽。

en: As the offspring of the Broodmother Vesztah, all of us strive for glory. Only the greatest rise into the land beyond the storm after death: Ark Morgo. The first to embark on this journey was Merphisz. Hatched on a rocky shore, he was enamored by the waves from the beginning. "These untamed waters shape the coastline, determine where life may sprout! I will overcome this ever-shifting spectre that haunts us so with its indifference and whim! I will sail to faraway shores and spread our seed, to make all blue synonymous with the mother's embrace!" Shaped by the sea, he learned its language and began to understand its ebb and swell. Determined to usher his newly formed clan, the Drak'Mer, to fruitful shores, he set out towards the horizon — and found an archipelago nestled behind a fearsome storm. Raising his trident, he challenged the taiphun to a duel, but lightning struck, and Merphisz's spirit was called to Ark Morgo. His clan reached the archipelago unscathed and holds dominion over the open waters still.
cn: 作为育母维兹塔阿的后代，我们所有人都应当为了荣耀而奋发图强。只有最伟大的成员才能够在死后抵达风暴尽头的大地：魔戈方舟。 最初踏上这段旅程的是梅菲兹。在一片崎岖海岸孵化，他从诞生伊始便获得了海浪的眷顾。 “这些未被驯服的水域塑造了海岸线，并决定了生命将从何处诞生！我将征服这个在冷漠中肆意折磨我们的善变的幽灵！我将航向遥远的海岸并散播我们的种子，为了让所有的碧海都变为母亲的怀抱！” 在大海的塑造下，他学会了大海的语言并开始理解潮起潮落的含义。为了帮助自己新建立的卓克·莫尔氏族蓬勃发展，为了让氏族能够抵达丰饶海岸，他决定朝着地平线驰骋 — 并且发现了一片位于可怕风暴之后的岛群。 他高举着手里的三叉戟向飓风发起了决斗，但是一道闪电劈过，梅菲兹的灵魂就被召回了魔戈方舟。之后他的氏族安然无恙地抵达了群岛，并且自那之后便统治着那里的开放海域。

en: A phosphorizing yellow block that draws your eyes in with whispered promises of wealth and secrecy.
cn: 散发磷化黄光的方块，显眼的色彩能够让你联想到财富与秘密。

en: Citizens of Embervale would sometimes invest in silver in the hope it would hold its value during a crisis. A crisis did come, but the silver offered little help.
cn: 因为相信银作为硬通货在灾难来临时也能保价，薪谷的居民们有时候会囤积银锭。但是当毁灭世界的灾难来临时，再多的财富也无法保护他们。

en: - Till the fields - Clean up (get rid of cobwebs!) - Buy new candles -> grab coins from silver chest? - Need to fix the basement ladder - Move wine barrels back into place
cn: - 犁地 - 打扫卫生（处理蜘蛛网！） - 购买新的蜡烛-> 从银箱里拿钱币？ -> 需要修好地下室楼梯 - 将酒桶搬回原位

en:
7.4	
You can search for worlds by name and Creator using the search function and filter the results using tags that classify worlds into content-related categories. The search results are ordered according to the relevance of the tags to the search query. By selecting tags, you can actively narrow and customize the displayed search results.
cn:
7.4	
您可以使用搜索功能按名称和创建者搜索世界，并使用将世界归入内容相关类别的标签来筛选搜索结果。搜索结果按照标签与搜索查询的关联性进行排序。选择标签，您就可以主动缩小和自定义显示的搜索结果范围。

en:
Crude lifeblood is extracted, diluted, and alchemized. Transformed, transfigured. Molten and born anew.

Profound power, fueling the bodies of the youngest in Embervale, rotting them. We've failed, blinded by our stoicism.

Let us point our gaze back towards the sky — for this hollowed core cannot be saved.
cn:
原始的生命之血被提取、稀释并改变。彻底变形，面无全非。旧有的一切都被融化为了崭新的存在。

这种超乎想象的力量正在薪谷中最年轻的居民们中间散播，不断腐化着他们。我们失败了，被斯多葛主义蒙蔽了双眼。

让我们将目光重新望向天空，这个空洞的核心已经没救了。

en: You require happy Survivors to strengthen the Flame. Find lost souls and provide them with sheltered beds!
cn: 你需要快乐的幸存者才能强化火焰。寻找迷失的灵魂并为他们提供拥有庇护的床！
黄金瘴气魔荧龙战利品

en: A violet dye, often used in the creation of opulent garments for royals.
cn: 一种深紫色燃料，通常用于制作专供皇室使用的奢华服饰。

en: The mountains will be your tomb, Loraine. The Obelisks are not worth it. No matter what secrets you think they hide, they will lead you down a dark road. A cold, dark road, Loraine. The summits are still teeming with soldiers, and I doubt they'll let you warm your hands by their fire. But I don't just fear the people. I'm terrified of the winged beast. Didn't you read our colleague's research?! Don't you know the legends? They'll tear you apart before the bitter cold can freeze you blue! You can't even be certain that the Obelisks will lead you to the ancient kingdom. Please, stay here with me. Let's drink chamomile tea by the river like we used to! It's suicide, Loraine. That's all I have to say. Yours forever, Nala.
cn: 山脉将成为你的坟墓，洛林。 不要为了方尖碑去送死。无论你觉得那些东西里面隐藏着什么秘密，它们只会带你走上一条黑暗的不归路。摆在你面前的是一条冰冷而且黑暗的道路，洛林。峰顶之上全是士兵，恐怕他们并不会愿意放你过去。但是我害怕的不仅仅是人。还有那些可怕的飞天野兽。你难道没有读过我们同事们的研究记录吗？！你难道没听过相关的传说吗？就算刺骨的寒风不会把你冻僵，那些野兽也会把你生吞活剥！ 你甚至不确定方尖碑是否能够带你找到那个远古王国。拜托了，和我一起留在这里吧。我们可以像过去那样，一起坐在河边享用甘菊茶！ 你这么做就是在自杀，洛林。我要说的就只有这些。 永远属于你的，纳拉。

en: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!
cn: 如果白米饭对你来说太过普通，那么炒饭绝对能够满足你的味蕾。加鸡蛋炒能够打破米饭的单一口感，而蔬菜则为料理带来了独到的风味！

en: A scorching hot blade infused with the desert heart. It can melt both snow and skin.
cn: 注入沙漠之心的炙热之刃。它能融化积雪和皮肤。

en: A noble sabre that impresses with its golden glow and broad blade. Perhaps the former owner was compensating for something.
cn: 这把高贵的军刀拥有着令人叹为观止的金色辉煌与宽大剑刃。也许它的原主人是想要如此华丽的武器来补偿某些不足之处。
双手近战武器墙壁支架

en: Basic tools needed for a laboratory.

A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need! Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 一把能够轻而易举藏在华丽衣袖或裙子下摆中的匕首。小巧玲珑，有需要时可以随时拿出来！ 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: You've found a fairy tale about a princess dropping a golden ball into water, and being forced to marry a frog prince after he retrieves her toy for her. Perhaps there's more to the story than what meets the eye. Search underwater for treasure!
cn: 你发现了一个有关某位公主不小心将金秋掉入水中，之后又逼不得已嫁给了答应帮自己取回玩具的青蛙王子的童话故事。也许这个故事并没有表面看上去的那么简单。在水下寻找宝藏!

en: Find And Tame A Stray Cat
Your players might run into hiccups.
cn: 玩家可能会遇到一些小问题。

en: As far as I can remember, it's always been just the three of us. Andrew, Harriot, and I — and the fish, of course. Our little roost near the ice hole has been our home, and we never strayed far from it. The sun was setting, and Harriot was storing her newest trophy — a typical evening. As we were packing up, Andrew decided to stay behind to "fish" alone... but I saw that glint in his eye, that look towards the back of the cave. An explorative urge had struck him. Maybe he hoped for clearer waters, a catch of his own? Who knows... Ever since then, he's changed. Last I saw him, he had glossy eyes and a raspy cough. It made the fish elude him more than usual. Despite this, Harriot reeled in a big one — A slippery Crimsonback, almost too heavy for her frail arms to lift. Andrew ripped the fish out of her hands and, without hesitation, slid it off the hook and into his gullet. When Harriot protested, he swiftly silenced her with a push, nearly knocking her off our deck and into the water. We left early that day, without Andrew. Harriot sought to return and "make things right" between them, but I fear our friend is beyond help... something crept inside him as he wandered the bowels of this cave. I have to keep it out. For good.
cn: 自打我记事以来，我们三个人就一直亲密无间。安德鲁、哈略特还有我……以及那些鱼。靠近冰窟的那个小窝就是我们的家，而且我们也从来没有离开过这里。 太阳已经西斜，哈略特正在把自己最新的战利品储存起来，这可以说是一个再普通不过的夜晚。但是就在我们打包的过程中，安德鲁突然决定要留下来一个人“钓鱼”……不过我看到他光彩熠熠的眼神了，还有他看向洞窟深处时的表情。他渴望去探索。也许他是想要寻找更清澈的水域，好自己想办法钓些鱼？谁知道呢…… 自那之后，他就彻底变了。上次看见他的时候，安德鲁的眼睛就像是会发光一样明亮，而且他一直在沙哑咳嗽。这让鱼儿们都对他避犹不及。不过哈略特倒是钓上了一条大家伙，是一条滑溜溜的红背鱼，她瘦弱的胳膊几乎无法举起那个沉重的战利品。 安德鲁看见了之后直接把哈略特手上的鱼给抢了过去，接着又摘下鱼钩并将鱼整个吞进了肚子。哈略特想要拦住他，但是却被他一声不吭地推开了，力气之大，以至于哈略特差点就从甲板上被推进了水里。 那天我们很早就离开了，而且没有带上安德鲁。哈略特觉得过意不去，她想要回去和安德鲁“好好谈一谈”，但恐怕我们三个人的友情已经走到了尽头……一定是这个洞窟深处的什么东西悄无声息地改变了他。我需要摆脱那一切。彻彻底底。

en: Our Sanctum Amidst The Hollow, Blinded From Within
cn: 虚无之中的圣所与身处其中的盲目

en:
Townspeople, be warned! You must pray elsewhere, for these halls are haunted! I saw it with my own eye! 

I was marveling at the Spark when the Flame suddenly began to dance and whip around in a strange rhythm! I thought it to be a trick of the light, but once my eye adjusted, I saw a ghastly shape emerge from the ground! Twisting the fire was a nebulous horror, skeletal remains aflame in spectral glow! It shifted towards me through floorboards and Flame, its lips leaking curses and rot!! 

Let me tell you: I've never scampered so quickly all my life! Had I stayed, I swear on my sisters, I'd have lost my other eye! 
— <lorename>Elin</lorename>
cn:
镇民们，请注意你们必须到别处祈祷，因为我亲眼所见这些大厅闹鬼！

我正在惊叹余火的时候，灵火突然开始舞动起来，并以一种奇怪的节奏甩来甩去！我以为是光线的作用，但当我的眼睛适应了之后，我看到一个可怕的形状从地面上浮现出来！火光中扭曲着一具模糊的恐怖骸骨，散发着幽灵般的光芒！它穿过地板和灵火向我移动，嘴里发出咒骂和腐烂的声音！

让我告诉你：我这辈子从没逃得这么快过！如果我留下来，我以我姐妹的名义发誓，我会失去另一只眼睛！
- <lorename>艾琳</lorename>

en: Flameborn! I heard troubling rumors... something horrible and grotesque is happening in the Springlands... an abomination and abuse of the Elixir. Please, end this reign of terror before it's too late!
cn: 火之子！我听说了一些令人不安的传闻……据说春日平原之中发生了无法描述的恐怖……由于滥用魔药而诞生的畸物。拜托了，赶在为时已晚之前结束那个噩梦！

en: Simple black pants with delicate golden details. Inconspicuous on its own, but in perfect harmony with the other parts of this set. The hems have been rethreaded many times, worn thin by long journeys through Embervale. A quiet statement to the distance once walked by the "Scholars of the Empyrean".
cn: 朴素的黑色裤子，表面能看见低调但精致的金色花纹。虽然看上去毫不起眼，但与套装中的其他部件搭配起来确是相得益彰。在无数次穿越薪谷的漫长旅行中，这套裤子已经经历了不计其数的缝补。这些沉默无言的痕迹展示着“苍穹学者”们曾经走过的无尽道路。

en: The <craftingstation>Masonry Tools</craftingstation> were found in an excavation camp in the Pillars of Creation. They should be brought to the <npc>Carpenter</npc> so he can build more crafting stations.
cn: 在创世之柱的一处挖掘营地中找到了<craftingstation>石匠工具</craftingstation>。把物品带给<npc>木匠</npc>以建造更多制作台。

en: I awake at the bottom of the spiral, at the core of the Earth. Around me, a writhing mass, a mess of limbs, a mound of flesh. It forms the vortex that connects the here and the before. The mass gazes at me. I glare back, torn inside by the selection of faces, all broken, shattered, and realigned. It is a grotesque imitation of life where eyes melt to cheeks, lips liquify, and heads split to bloom into something new. One seems estranged, yet familiar — a fleeting thought, a newspaper clipping, a whispered word. He is one, but he is many. He is a wanderer, as I am. He is all around. Too humanoid to be born from the mist Too suffocated, too glistening to be human Or human, still He is like morning dew The dawn of a new day The start of every spiral, waiting to be found
cn: 在螺旋的底部，在大地的核心，我醒来了。无数扭动的肢体构成了笼罩我的血肉之山。这一切构成的漩涡连接着这里与过去。 那些肉体凝视着我。而我也望向了它们，我的目光撕裂了那些面孔，一切都被打破粉碎，接着又重新组合。 它就像是对于生命的拙劣模仿，双眼融化成为了脸颊，嘴唇变成了流动的液体，脑袋则像鲜花一样绽放成了全新的存在。 其中有一个存在让人感到陌生又熟悉……就像是一个转瞬即逝的念头，一份剪报或者是耳语的一个词。他是唯一的，但他同样是无数的。他是一名旅人，而我也同样是。他无处不在。 太像人类，因此不可能诞生自迷雾 但又太过窒息，太过闪耀因此不可能是人类 也不可能仍然是人类 他就像是清晨的露水 新的一天的黎明 每一道螺旋的起点，等待着被发现

en: It's still magic even if you know how it's done.
cn: 即使你对它的使用方法一清二楚，它依然是魔法。

en: Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the bones, but you can still enjoy it.
cn: 切成厚块的鱼肉，吃的时候要小心鱼刺。

en: These lightweight gloves are perfect for holding a quill and signing decrees.
cn: 无论是执笔写作还是签署法令，这些轻便的手套就是你的最佳选择。

en: Ah, so you can learn a thing or two. Don't underestimate our craftsmanship. It might save you out there!
cn: 啊，原来你们也能学到东西。别小看我们的手艺。它可能会救你一命

en: The Carpenter suspects that the Drak might be hiding all sorts of riches inside their sunken temples. He's sending you out to explore one of them in the hope of procuring some gold coins. With the gold coins, you will be able to decorate your base and show your wealth. Reach the temple and look around for treasures!
cn: 木匠怀疑卓克的沉没神殿里有可能藏着各式各样的宝藏。现在他希望你去探索这些神殿并寻找潜在的金币。 有了金币，你就能够装饰自己的基地并展现自己的财富。 抵达神殿并寻找其中的宝藏！

en: A cozy bed for farm animals.
cn: 为圈养的动物准备的温馨床铺。

en: When equipped with a Melee weapon, launch a powerful upward strike during the ascent of your jump. Use this skill to rapidly close the distance on flying enemies. Cost: 25 Stamina
cn: 装备近战武器时，你可以在跳跃的上升阶段发动一次强力上劈。 该技能能够帮助你快速接近飞行敌人。 消耗：25点体力

en: These gloves lock your hold on the bow — target the head with steady aim.
cn: 这些手套将能够允许你持久挽弓 - 平稳瞄准敌人的头部吧。
永恒荣耀归于<lorename>派克米德</lorename>

en: A pair of warm pants, tinged in a deep blue. It provides ample protection from the elements.
cn: 一条温暖的的裤子，上面缝有深蓝色的布料。能够有效帮助穿戴者抵御恶劣环境。

en:
Every thundering roar is a spectacle, a bloody sight to behold. They've sunk their tusks into now-forgotten lands... time to reclaim the kingdom.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
每一次震耳欲聋的怒吼都象征着新一轮的血腥表演。这些巨兽的獠牙深入被遗忘的大地……是时候重新夺回我们的王国了。

收集数个沃卡斗士头颅以制作黑铁战利品。

en: How To Build An Elixir Well

I might be alive, but without my daughter, there's no reason to live! Please, I beg of you, search for my daughter Marianne and bring her back to me! She left our home to research the Vukah before they raided <location>Fort Kelvin</location>! Oh, I should've never let her go... my little girl, please come back...!
cn: 虽然我还活着，但是没有我的女儿，活着也没有意思！拜托了，求求你去寻找我的女儿玛丽安娜，一定要把她带回来！她当时离开家去研究沃卡，但他们之后就袭击了<location>凯尔文要塞</location>！唉，我当初就不应该让她离开……我的女儿，请你快回来吧……！

en: Find The Barber's Salon In <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>
cn: 在<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>寻找理发师的沙龙

en: Dealing piercing damage applies puncturing to enemies. Punctured enemies receive %k bonus pierce damage from ANY pierce damage source for %k.
cn: 对敌人造成穿刺伤害时将同时施加穿透。穿透将使敌人在承受任意穿刺伤害时额外承受%k穿刺伤害，持续%k。

en:
Stupid, damnable books
Who even reads books anymore
This can't be real

I tried climbing out at the crack of dawn, but I fell off the darn stack

Fall was bad

Shoulder is aching, head is ringing
Even worse, the wagon is broken

If the overseer sees this, I can kiss my position goodbye

Trying again tomorrow
Or whenever I wake up
I have to lie down
Everything spins
cn:
这些该死的书
又不像是真的有人会去去看
我肯定是在做梦

黎明时分，我试着爬出去，但是最后却意外掉了下来

这下摔得不轻

肩膀很疼，而且脑袋也晕乎乎的
更糟糕的，推车也被我砸坏了

要是被主管看见这一幕，我恐怕就保不住现在的职位了

明天再试一次吧
或者等我睡醒之后
我得赶紧躺下来
眼前天旋地转

en: A wooden coaster to display drinks on a table.
cn: 用来在餐桌上盛放饮料的木制杯垫。

en: Your Food buffs persist through death, but they last half as long.
cn: 你的食物加成将不会因为死亡消失，但是持续时间仅为原先的一半。

en: A warm soup made from various vegetables. Full of vitamins and energy.
cn: 使用多种蔬菜熬制而成的温暖汤品。满满维他命与能量。

en: A scavenger in Surat's Rest complained about waking up with scribbles on his face and his struggle to wash them off. The colors used to permanently paint his visage could still be around. Search for the color palette in Surat's Rest!
cn: 苏拉特之息的一名拾荒者抱怨说醒来之后发现有人在他的脸上画了擦不掉的涂鸦。 当时被用来恶作剧的永久性颜料应该还在附近。寻找苏拉特之息中的调色板！

en:
The last dragon's head. The final nail in the coffin. The end of an era, and the start of something new.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
最后一条龙的头颅。这就是它们最后的结局。一个时代已经终结，但崭新的未来即将开始。

收集多个瘴气魔幼龙头颅以制作黑铁战利品

en: Carved Tropical Wood Fence with Ropes II
cn: 雕刻热带木制篱笆（绳索） II
什么风把你吹来了，朋友？

en: Block Breaker This special attack fills a blocking enemy's Stun Bar twice as much when hit.
cn: 破防打击 这种特殊攻击将对格挡中的敌人施加两倍的晕眩条增长。

en:
3.7	
If you discover a potentially exploitable error in Adventure Sharing that could be used to the detriment of other users or Keen, please report it to Keen without undue delay.
cn:
3.7	
如果您在冒险分享中发现可能被利用、且可能对其他用户或 Keen 造成损害的潜在漏洞，请立即向 Keen 报告，请勿无故拖延。

en:
Certain backpack <warning>items are dropped</warning> when you perish.
Return here to retrieve them.
cn:
当你死亡时，背包中的特定<warning>物品将掉落</warning>。
返回死亡地点以取回物品。

en: I agree to the Terms of Use
Adjust the quality of shadows. Reducing the quality or disabling it will increase performance.
cn: 调整阴影质量。降低质量或禁用此功能会提高性能。

en: The Low Meadows are drenched in sickness, flooded with bile and bitterness. Fight back the Shroud and unveil the peaceful glades lost beneath. Boundless wilds of untold beauty lie hidden under the decay.
cn: 低矮草原已经被憎恨与苦痛的瘟疫之潮所淹没。驱散瘴气以唤醒沉没在水下的宁静草原。净化腐朽，唤醒瑰丽的辽阔原野。

en:
12.1	
Keen may amend and adapt these Adventure Sharing Terms with effect for the future if there is a valid reason for the amendment and insofar as the amendments are reasonable, taking into account the interests of both contracting parties.
cn:
12.1	
若有正当理由，且考虑到双方利益后所作的修改是合理的，Keen 可对本冒险分享条款进行修订和调整，且即刻生效。

en: No one can stop us now from dressing like the kings! Let's reclaim some glamor! If you're the new ruler of the realm, you should look the part!
cn: 现在就算我们打扮得像过去的皇帝一样，也不会有人来指责我们！让我们重新拿回过去的美好时光吧！说到底，如果你是这个国度的新统治者，那肯定不能总是穿得破破烂烂的！

en: A critical hit with a ranged weapon will mark the target for 3 seconds. All players will do double damage against marked targets.
cn: 远程武器造成暴击将标记目标3秒。所有玩家攻击被标记的目标时将造成双倍伤害。

en: A traditionally brewed cup of coffee with a hint of sugar. The sweetness pairs well with the depth of flavor.
cn: 按照传统方式烹煮的咖啡外加一勺糖。甜味与咖啡深沉的滋味十分搭配。

en: Worn-out gloves with sun spots and a fur trim.
cn: 被太阳晒得褪色的陈旧手套，内侧衬有毛边。

en: Finding And Using A Gem Forge

cn: 阿尔班耶夫山脉 空荡礼堂敌人

en: Ah, finally! Now we can dye your hair blue! Thank you!
cn: 啊，终于！现在我可以把你的头发染成蓝色！谢谢！

en: Collect all resources to pick up
cn: 拾取前先拿走所有资源

en: People think gray is boring, but if they just took a moment to really look, they would see how graceful the color is!
cn: 人们觉得灰色是一种沉闷的颜色，但其实只需要仔细观察，他们就能够感受到灰色的优雅！

en: Use Metal Blocks to add decorative elements to your buildings. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 使用金属方块为建筑增添装饰元素。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en:
Remains of a wandering specter, doomed to wither on the mortal plane. It's lips are sealed, its eyes are forever shut. The evil has been cast out.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
注定被困在人间不得往生的游荡幽灵的残骸。它的嘴唇与双眼紧紧闭合。其中的恶灵终于消散。

收集数个瘴气魔镰鼬头颅以制作黑铁战利品。

en: A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 一把做工粗糙的匕首，曾经被沃卡用于执行鲜血仪式。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: You should only eat crab meat when it is grilled, as this is the best way to prepare it.
cn: 尽可能只吃烤好的蟹肉，因为那才是处理这些肉的最好方式。

en: A true blessing in the heat of battle. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 在激烈的战斗中救人一命。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: Teach a man to fish and you feed him for a lifetime!
cn: 授人以鱼不如授人以渔！

en: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. This plant needs to be placed in water and submerged completely.
cn: 能够在合适的土壤环境中成长的幼苗。 这种植物需要种在水中并且保持彻底浸没的状态。

en: Aunt Braelyn lies dead in the final hidden temple! Reach her body and rescue her soul so she can be summoned again inside your base!
cn: 你在最后的隐藏神庙中发现了布莱林姑姑的尸体！抵达她的遗体位置并拯救她的灵魂，之后你将可以在基地中重新召唤布莱林姑姑！

en: The Hunter needs her Hand Spindle back to craft better armors. She lost it near Westcott.
cn: 猎人需要拿回自己的纺线锤才能制作更好的护甲。当时她的工具就掉在了维斯考特附近。

en: Flameborn! I've been messing around with seeds and leftovers for a while now, and I think I've created some fantastic animal food! You could make some, give it to an animal until it's tamed, and bring it to our base! We'd have to make an enclosure, animal feeders, beds... should we vote on names, too?
cn: 火之子!最近我一直在研究我们手上的种子和多余的食物，我觉得我已经创造了一些品质很好的饲料！你应该可以亲自制作一些饲料，然后喂养野生动物，等它们被驯服之后，你就可以把野外的动物带回基地了！当然，我们还得为它们准备一些围栏，食槽，还有睡觉的窝……也许还可以给它们起名字？

en: The Lies Of A Wizened Man
Shelter, my friend. Keep my bones from growing evermore brittle, yes?
cn: 我需要庇护所，朋友。请不要让我这把老骨头继续承受风吹日晒之苦，拜托了。

en: A simple headscarf that will keep your scalp safe from the burning heat of the overhead sun.
cn: 这种简单的头巾能够避免你的头皮被正午的阳光晒伤。

en: Green dye to hide the grass stains on clothes.
cn: 绿色染料，能够让你的衣服与大自然融为一体。

en: I was carrying ammunition to the ballista with Connor when Howling Peak suddenly roared. Squinting towards the rising smoke, I saw something hiding inside, causing the vapor to swirl... When it broke from the veil of gray, I froze. Screams erupted. Amidst the chaos, a familiar voice called out. "George, get it together! I'll light the balefire, and you shoot!" Connor grabbed a torch and sped towards the bridge. The sky was darkened by wings. His silhouette was tinged in shadow as he vanished into black. With shaking hands, I fired a bolt. Then two. Three — all missed. Unbothered, the winged beast spewed a hot, foul cloud from its mouth that melted our walls. It caught Connor on his way up. That's the last thing I saw before I fainted. I want to go home, but they won't let me. We ain't in the barracks anymore. This is the real deal. — George
cn: 当时我正在跟康纳一起搬运弩炮弹药，接着突然之间就听见呼啸崇山中传来了巨大的咆哮。眯起眼睛观察远方升起的烟雾的时候，我看见有什么东西正躲在里面，周遭的蒸汽都被它搅得旋转了起来……当那个怪物从灰色的帷幕中冲出来的时候，我整个人都吓傻了。我只听见周围全是人们的尖叫。 在混乱之中，有一个熟悉的声音在呼唤着我。“乔治，给我振作一点！我去点燃篝火，你来负责射击！”康纳抓起火炬便冲向了大桥。巨大的翅膀甚至遮住了天空。乔治就像是阴影中的一个小小轮廓，接着便立刻被黑暗吞噬了。 我用颤抖的双手发射了弩箭。然后又发射了一次。接着第三次 — 但无一命中目标。长着翅膀的怪物毫不在意，它只是喷吐出了一大团恶臭的炽热雾团并融化了我们的围墙。之后怪物又回头抓走了奔跑中的康纳。这是我晕倒之前看见的最后一副景象。 我想要回家，但是他们不肯放我走。我们已经不在营房里面了。这才是真实的世界。 — 乔治

en: The color of life — a wonderful color for clothes.
cn: 用生命的色彩点缀你的服饰。

en: I won't sleep right with those things squirming 'bout. Let's get 'em out of our seas!
cn: 只要那些东西还在游来游去，我就没办法睡个安稳的觉。我们得把它们赶出我们的大海！

en: When killing an enemy with a magic weapon, you become invisible for 3 seconds.
cn: 使用魔法武器击杀敌人后进入隐身状态，持续3秒。

en: This wand practically vibrates with warmth and destructive energy. It becomes restless and twitchy when dormant for too long. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 这柄魔棒蕴含着永不停歇的温暖与毁灭之力。如果沉寂太久，魔棒就会变得焦躁不安。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: The bard Valory wants you to search all of Embervale for fossils. There are four fossils in the Nomad Highlands. Each fossil can be found multiple times in different places. The Bard advised searching mines, dig sites, and ore deposits to find all fossils.
cn: 吟游诗人瓦罗里希望你寻找遍布在薪谷中的化石。游牧高地中总共有4种化石。你可以在不同地点反复找到各种化石。如果要找到所有种类的化石，吟游诗人建议前往各地的矿井、挖掘场以及矿点搜索。

en: I am the reflection upon a slow river's surface that beckons you forth. Unknowable, yet familiar. Alike, yet different. An alluring call from the depths. You've enough spirit left in you to parse my words, unblinded by wrath. What an enticing mystery. Why don't you come to enlighten me, my new friend? Find me behind the mirror and dive into the deep. Bring me forth, towards the horizon — the light — the breeze. You shan't regret it. — Your new friend
cn: 我是徐徐流动的河面之上召唤着你的倒影。陌生却又熟悉。相似却又不同。这是来自深渊的魅惑呼唤。 你的灵魂尚且健全，因此能够在不被愤怒蒙蔽的情况下揣摩我的话语。 真是一个不可思议的神秘现象。有兴趣给我指点明津吗，新朋友？ 来镜子后面寻找我，潜入深渊，带我见证地平线，光芒还有轻风。我保证你不会后悔。 — 你的新朋友

en: The refined wool can be used to craft warm padding kits. These kits are essential for crafting warmer gear. Craft warm padding kits with the huntress to proceed!
cn: 使用加工毛料来制作温暖衬垫。这种填充工具是制造更温暖的护甲的关键材料。 在女猎人的帮助下制作温暖衬垫以继续！

en: A soft pillow for your dog.
cn: 为狗狗准备的柔软枕头。
属性加成/恢复处于激活状态。

en: Got caught in a bad one today. Sandstorm hit just past midday. No warning, just a wall of wind and dust. Visibility dropped to nothing in seconds. I wrapped up as tight as I could, but it didn't matter. The sand found every gap. My eyes are in bad shape. Feels like there's grit still grinding under the lids. They're so red, swollen—I can barely keep them open now. No more moving tonight. I need to wait for the wind to die and figure out if I can even see the next landmark.
cn: 今天真是不走运。一到下午就遇到了沙尘暴。狂风与黄沙的高墙突然迎面而来。几秒之内就到了伸手不见五指的地步。我尽可能抓紧衣角蜷缩了起来，但是根本没用。沙子从每个缝隙灌了进来。 我的眼睛很难受。感觉就像是还有许多粗糙的砂砾卡在了眼皮底下。现在两只眼睛都红肿无比，我几乎没办法睁开眼睛。 今晚看来是没办法走了。我得等风暴过去，然后再想办法尝试寻找下一处地标。

en: A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.
cn: 富含能够促进肌肉增长的蛋白质。最适合在锻炼前食用。

en: A curious, but shy Hophare. Their timid nature and quick reflexes protect them from predators!
cn: 充满好奇心的害羞跳脚兔。胆小的个性与极快的反应能够帮助它们避免被捕食者伤害！

en: I was naive to celebrate when the band broke up. Traveling alone is tiresome. I don't have anyone by my side to keep these drunkards off me! I'm no siren or toy! I only wish to make music in peace! If only that freak Daniel the Damned hadn't disturbed our audience at the tavern by losing his teeth everywhere during his interlude... He takes his "curse" gimmick too far... if it even still is a gimmick. It's time to rebrand. "Harper the Harpist" evokes an aura of illustrious allure that no longer suits me. I should've never succumbed to this image... when did I lose my way? I used to sing and dance for fun, not for money or to elevate a mediocre band... and not once did I love playing the harp as much as writing poetry by the window, or wandering the woods without waiting for nightfall to hide my face from fanatics. I'll throw it over this ledge and start fresh tomorrow!
cn: 之前我真的太傻了，还满心欢喜地觉得乐队解散是好事。一个人的旅行真的很艰辛。现在没有其他人能够帮我摆脱那些纠缠的醉鬼了！我不是什么“塞壬”也不是他们的玩具！我只想一个人安安静静创作音乐！都怪被诅咒的丹尼尔非要去吓唬酒馆的观众，轮到他上场的时候，这家伙的牙齿突然莫名其妙全掉光了。他那套“诅咒”的戏码玩得太过火了……虽然我不确定那到底是不是演出来的。 总而言之，也许是时候该让他换个形象了。还有“竖琴手哈珀”魅力非凡的形象，我其实早就不想做这种事了。从一开始我就不该答应他们……我到底是从什么时候开始失去了初心？以前我只是为了开心才去唱歌跳舞，我从来没想过去靠那些事来赚钱或者是去挽救一支中庸的乐队……比起弹奏竖琴，我更热爱倚在床边写诗，或者是在森林中自由漫步，而不是每次都必须要等到夜幕降临来躲避那些疯狂的粉丝。 我要把这破玩意丢出窗外，明天开始一切从头来过！

en: Rays of steel stretch outward from the sword handle's guard. They resemble the final light of the sun before an eclipse. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
cn: 这把剑的护手部分向外延伸出了无数道钢铁的光影。这些东西象征着日蚀之前最后的光芒。 瘴气附魔： 这把武器已经被瘴气侵蚀，并且能够造成大量瘴气伤害。只能够在瘴气巢穴中找到。

en: Keen Observations Of A Construction Worker
cn: 一名建筑工人的敏锐观察

en: If Mother were here, she'd hang up chandeliers, set candles in every corner, dust off the old books, and read me a story. Her warm, melodic voice would fill the room like a flood of candlelight. I'd listen for hours, cuddled up in her hand-woven orange blanket dyed with saffron. I'd take a sip of my sweetened chamomile tea and gleefully drift off to sleep. But Mother isn't here. The dark is my new home.
cn: 如果母亲还在的话，她肯定会挂起吊灯，在每个角落里都点上蜡烛，然后把旧故事书上的灰尘都抖干净并读故事给我听。 她那种充满温暖、像唱歌一般的动听声音会像烛光一样充盈整个房间。我会津津有味地听好几个小时，然后依偎在她用藏红花染色的手工橘色篮子里面。听累了之后，我会喝一口加了糖的甘菊茶，然后开开心心地入睡。 但现在母亲不在我身边。这片黑暗就是我的新家。

en: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.
cn: 摸上去冰冷的剑刃。使用这把武器将对心智产生极大负担。

en: Beautiful! These <keyitem>Scientific Instruments</keyitem> will work wonders when used for a Laboratory! Your spark shines brightly, Flameborn!
cn: 太漂亮了！这些<keyitem>科研设备</keyitem>绝对能给我的实验室派上大用处！没想到你的余火竟然也如此明亮，火之子！

en: In the Albaneve Summits quarry, you found a note in which a worker detailed his process for crushing rocks to create pigments. The color palette he created from crushed rock should still be in the quarry. Search for the color palette to proceed!
cn: 在阿尔班耶夫山脉采石场中，你找到了一张工人留下的纸条，里面详细记载着使用粉碎的矿石制作颜料的过程。 工人使用碎石制作的调色板应该仍然在采石场中。找到调色板以继续！

en: A soup made from various vegetables and calla luna flowers. It glows in the dark and extends your Time in the Shroud!
cn: 添加了各种蔬菜与月之莲花瓣的炖汤。除了在夜间闪闪发光之外，这种汤还能够延长你在瘴气中的停留时间！

en: The coloring of these pants allows the wearer to seamlessly blend into the foliage.
cn: 裤子的颜色与树叶巧妙融为一体，让穿着者完美地融入环境。

en: Some VFX might not be visible yet.
cn: 部分特效有可能还无法查看

en: Historic pants, formerly the centerpiece of ceremonial warlock clothing.
cn: 历史悠久的裤子，曾是术士仪式服装的关键部分。

en: This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
cn: 能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到此收集品。能够在独眼巨人战利品底座上重新组装为一套完整的独眼巨人骷髅。

en: A special berry that can only be harvested at night in the Revelwood. It can be used to enhance various dishes and to create deep blue color pigments.
cn: 只能够在夜晚的喧嚣森林采集的特殊浆果。能够用于强化多种料理的效果，并且还能够用来创造深蓝色颜料。

en: Daggers with many edges and sharp hooks. They can be whipped out in the blink of an eye to parry incoming attacks, thus defending your honor. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 布满倒钩与尖刺的匕首。能够以迅雷不及掩耳之势招架来袭攻击并守护你的荣誉。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Some plain herbalist pants. They smell like rosemary and thyme.
cn: 普通的草药师裤子。闻起来有迷迭香和百里香的味道。

en: Grants immunity to the Fell Curse.
cn: 赋予针对瘴气魔诅咒的免疫效果。

en: Ikora! Yes, I know her! Reserved. Said other people drained her... lonely, I think, but masterful at brewing potions! She had her shop in Rattlebleak. I'd love to marvel at her work... she could whip up any potion like it's nothing!
cn: 依科拉！没错，我认得她！她平常深居简出，说是不喜欢被其他人打扰，我是觉得那样子的生活太孤独了。不过说实话她调配药水的能力无人可及！她的工作室就在荒啸镇。真希望我能有机会亲眼观看她工作……那个人仿佛能够凭空变出药水一样！

en: This Was Not A Good Idea
Torn and tattered remains of cloth that were left behind and now serve the Scavengers as clothing.
cn: 千疮百孔的残破布料，现在已经被当成了拾荒者的衣服。

en: The Alchemist needs shelter to work. Build a home for the Alchemist and grant him access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already! To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed. This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.
cn: 炼金术士需要庇护所才能工作。为炼金术士搭建一个家，并且确保他的周围有能够使用的受到庇护的床！ 若要为幸存者提供庇护所，首先请制作合适的床。将床放置在幸存者能够方便使用，且拥有良好保护的区域内。放置后，床将自动分配给附近没有床铺的幸存者。如果想要重新分配床，装备召唤法杖然后使用它瞄准床铺。 如果幸存者缺乏庇护，此任务将重新开启。
燃火荒原 瘴气魔敌人

en: The highest concentration of shroud energy, even higher than shroud nexus.
cn: 拥有最高浓度的瘴气能量，甚至要高于瘴气核心。

en: You have made your way to the Shroud Lair. Now see what the author of the note didn't dare to claim.
cn: 你已经成功抵达瘴气巢穴。是时候看看让纸条的作者胆怯之物的真面目了。

en: Ya know, I grew up in the capital... they used to tell stories. Stories I shared with my daughter, as well. Sometimes at night, there's faint lights glowing beneath the waves... a sign of queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s gracious rule. My daughter said she saw them once. Children's tales, I thought. But who knows? Stranger things have happened in Embervale.
cn: 你知道么，我是都城里面土生土长的本地人……那里的人们最喜欢靠讲故事打发时间。以前我也会跟我的女儿讲这些东西。比如说有时候到了晚上，你会发现水面之下浮现起微弱的光芒……传说那就是<lorename>派克米德</lorename>女王的仁慈统治的象征。我女儿说她看见过那种光芒。当时我以为这不过是孩子随口说的。但现在谁知道呢？在薪谷，一切皆有可能。

en: Some recipes consist of a series of items. Switch between these items here.
cn: 部分配方中包含着多种物品。你可以在这里选择对应类别。

en:
Keep your nimble fingers close, don't venture into caves and cliffs
A dragon guards the lonely tunnels, sleeping, quiet, stiff

It holds a sword inside its maw, but do not grab it, little one
To keep your fingers, one through ten, you'd have to quickly run

For tiny hands and pockets, its sword's just way too big
And with bared fangs to block it, the dragon's just too quick

So keep away from Dragon's Maw, stay home and near the city
Do not take what isn't yours, and keep your fingers pretty
cn:
看好自己不安分的手指，不要乱闯洞穴和悬崖
龙看守着孤寂的隧道，它沉默地保持着沉睡

它的口中含着一把宝剑，但是千万不要妄想去拿，小家伙
如果想要保住自己的手指，你最好赶紧逃跑

对于你的小手和口袋来讲，宝剑实在太大太沉
尖锐无比的獠牙挡住了宝剑，而且龙的反应可不慢

远离巨龙之口，乖乖留在家里，不要远离城市
不要觊觎别人的东西，你的手指就不会有事

en: Craft Or Obtain The Building Block

This spell is fueled by the eternal Flame and serves as unlimited magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing great damage in a large area. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 蕴含永恒之力的法术灵火能够作为无限魔法弹药，使用时发射一枚强力火球，火球将在撞击后爆炸，对大范围内的目标造成大量伤害。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.
cn: 让人无法下口的黏液。强行吃下去之后将获得不同寻常的力量。

en: Defeat an enemy to gain a Stamina Regeneration Buff
cn: 击败敌人可获得体力恢复增益

en: A Cure For The Fell Curse
Briefly increases your Block value when blocking with Daggers, ensuring a near-miss parry reduces Stamina minimally.
cn: 使用匕首格挡时暂时提高格挡值，确保就算招架失败也只需要消耗最少的体力。

en: Increases the skill level of Athlete
cn: 提高运动员的技能等级

en: I see you've augmented your weapon with a gem! Would you mind if I borrowed it later? I'd like to conduct some experiments with it! ...No? Are you sure?
cn: 看来你已经使用宝石强化了自己的武器！不介意的话，晚点可以借我看一看吗？我想要用它做一些实验！……不行？真的不行吗？

en: The spark of knowledge has erupted within. Ready yourself to unveil the secrets of our past. Find the two Ancient Obelisk of the Springlands to learn the world's fate, a story of rot and fire. Only those who seek the truth shall find it.
cn: 知识的火花已经点燃。准备揭开来自我们过去的秘密。找到春日平原中的两座古代方尖碑以了解这个世界由腐败与火焰交织而成的命运。只有追寻真相之人才能得到答案。

en:
You've reached the cargo lift. 

Take a look around and investigate the shipments to find the handpan!
cn:
你已经抵达货运梯。

在附近搜索并调查货物以找到手碟！

en: The float didn't hit the water.
A pair of lightweight pants. They're simple and easily replaced, so it's not too bad if they become bleached by the sun or drenched with water.
cn: 一条轻便的裤子。裤子很简单，也很容易更换，即使被太阳晒黑或被水淋湿也不会太糟糕。

en: Glistening fish scales. Rainbows reflect in their surface as you shift them in the light. They're sturdy nature makes them ideal for crafting.
cn: 闪亮的鱼鳞。如果将它们拿到阳光下来回移动，你可以看见鱼鳞表面浮现出的彩虹。坚硬的质地使得鱼鳞成了理想的制作材料。

en: Instantly restores a good amount of stamina.
Ever wondered if there are more survivors? I've got a feeling there are.
cn: 有没有想过也许还有其他幸存者？我反正是这么觉得的。

en:
A fossilized tooth that has dulled through the ages. While these fossils used to be plentiful, many are now forever buried underneath a dense layer of Shroud-infested water.

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
cn:
经过岁月的洗礼已经变得暗淡无光的牙齿化石。虽然这些化石曾经非常多，但现在许多化石都被永远埋藏在 瘴气。

此收藏品在 游牧高地 中找到。

en: Time in the Shroud increased by 5 minutes, allowing you to explore for longer. Time in the Shroud Should this time run out, the Shroud will consume you.
cn: 瘴气停留时间延长5分钟，让你能探索更久。 瘴气停留时间 如果停留时间耗尽，你将被瘴气吞噬。

en:
The new blacksmith assistant, Rochelle Anders, wants a fresh set of clothes. She mentioned ripping her old set clean off during an expedition near Fanning Ranch when she saw spiders crawling on it.

Reach the area marked on your map and retrieve the clothing items for Rochelle!
cn:
新来的铁匠助手罗茜·安德斯想要一套新衣服。她提到说之前在芬宁牧场附近探险时，她因为讨厌蜘蛛而扯下了自己以前穿的那套衣服。

抵达地图上标记区域并帮助罗茜取回她的衣服！

en: Your inner Flame allows you to resist the Shroud — but if you linger, you will perish. Escape the Shroud to replenish your Time in the Shroud.
cn: 内在的灵火使你能抵抗瘴气的影响，但是如果逗留太久，你依旧会消亡。脱离瘴气以恢复你的瘴气停留时间。

en:
You've discovered in a text that the Hollow Halls in the Albaneve Summits were previously visited by a set of challengers.

Follow their path and retrieve what you can!
cn:
你通过一份文献得知曾经有一群挑战者拜访过阿尔班耶夫山脉中的空荡礼堂。

跟随挑战者的脚步并取回宝物！

en:
<lorename>Sameth</lorename> has been slain! 

His body rots, tied to the mycelium pillar as a warning to all! We will elect a new leader, one who will not rule by fear and gluttony... One who is just and truthful!

The Elixir will be OURS!
cn:
<lorename>赛姆斯</lorename>已经被砍倒！

就让他被绑在菌丝之柱上的腐烂尸体警示所有人！我们将会推选出一位新的首领，一位不会靠恐惧与贪婪统治的人……一个公正与诚实的首领！

魔药属于我们！

en: You've heard rumors of a collapsing cove near the capital. Explore the area and search for potential valuables!
cn: 你听说首都附近存在一处崩塌的海湾。探索那里并寻找潜在宝物！

en: I see you're connected to the Flame, my friend! Oh, glorious light! You must be capable of magic... why not try? Wands are simple to use, but staffs require spells as ammunition... I can teach you! Craft a staff with me from dead wood, and feel the light run through your veins!
cn: 我的朋友，我能够感受到你与灵火之间的连接！赞美光芒！这么说你肯定能够呼唤魔法的力量……不妨来试一试？魔棒使用起来十分方便，不过法杖则需要消耗法术弹药……不用担心，我来教你！用朽木和我一起制造一把法杖，那样你就可以发挥体内奔涌的光明之力了！

en: You've found what seems to be a piece of a treasure map while exploring the remains of a dragon skeleton! There's inconspicuous writing on the back of the parchment. Perhaps there are more pieces like this one in similar places. If you find all of them, you can combine them into a reconstructed treasure map! Find all of the treasure map pieces!
cn: 在探索巨龙骸骨的过程中，你似乎找到了一张藏宝图的碎片！卷轴碎片的背面能够看见一些模糊的字迹。 也许你能够类似的地方找到更多碎片。如果集齐所有碎片，你就可以将它们重新组合成一张完整的藏宝图！ 找到所有藏宝图碎片！

en: The perfect disguise — even in broad daylight.
cn: 完美的伪装，光天化日之下也不怕被发现。

en: Increases damage dealt with thrown explosives.
cn: 增加投掷爆炸物造成的伤害。

en: A creamy curry made from plantain, rice, coconut milk, and vegetables. It's tart, earthy, and quite filling.
cn: 使用大蕉、米、椰浆以及蔬菜烹饪的浓稠咖喱。略带泥土清香的酸味吃起来十分过瘾。

en: A deadly arrow tipped with an iron arrowhead, spreading fear among enemies.
cn: 装有铁箭头的致命箭矢，绝对能够让敌人抱头鼠窜。

en: This ring will increase your health and healing rate.
cn: 这枚戒指将提高你的生命值与治疗速率。

en: Oh, you've brought me a vibrant flower, have you? It's fluorescent as if all of nature's beauty flowed through its leaves. That's exactly what a good "green" should be! This is one ingredient I need to remember how to make the dye! Thank you!
cn: 哦，你给我带来了一束充满活力的鲜花？这鲜艳的色彩，每一片叶片中都仿佛充满着自然之美。没错，这才是“绿色”该有的样子！这肯定是能够帮助我想起染发剂配方的其中一种原料！谢谢！

en:
Food for attracting and taming a Hophare.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
cn:
用于吸引与驯服跳脚兔的饲料。

若要驯服动物，请在潜行状态下小心靠近目标。在动物身边投掷诱饵食物以吸引其注意。在动物进食时抚摸它，重复过程直到动物被驯服。被驯服之后，你将可以捡起动物。

en: Increases the skill level of Unity
cn: 提高身心统一的技能等级

en: They don't offer much protection, but enhance your magical abilities. The minimalist design also prevents you from getting sweaty hands.
cn: 虽然无法提供太多防御，但是这双手套能够强化你的魔法能力。除此以外极简风设计还能让你双手保持干爽。

en: Return Beacons replenish your Time in the Shroud. Stand near them to feel their effect.
cn: 回归信标能够恢复你的瘴气停留时间。站在附近就可以感受到它们的力量。

en: A pair of gauntlets that are as cold as snow on a sunless eve. Use them to freeze the hearts of your enemies!
cn: 像无光之夜的雪地一样冰冷的臂铠。用它们冻结你的敌人的心脏！

en: Increases the skill level of Sleight of Hand
cn: 提高拳打脚踢的技能等级

en: The Scavenger brood encroaches, and I fear we have backed ourselves into certain doom. Since we sought refuge in this temple, I have tried countless times — and failed just as many — to access the mysterious chamber below. It's as if the Ancients built it for someone beyond mortal, someone born of another purpose. How can I accept my fate when my faith wavers with every knock, every bump in the night? I am not meant to enter the chamber. I am meant to suffer a cruel death at the hands of those savages. What a bitter end for the faithful... what a waste of prayer.
cn: 拾荒者步步紧逼，我担心我们现在已经走投无路。 自从我们躲进这个神庙之后，我已经无数次尝试开启下方的神秘房间，但是每一次都无功而返。仿佛就像是远古者是为了某种超越凡人的另外一种存在而建造了这里。 当黑暗中的每一次挫折失败都在磨灭着我的信仰，我还怎么能安心接受自己的命运？ 我现在明白自己与那个房间命中无缘。我注定要在那些野蛮的疯子手中经历痛苦的折磨与死亡。一直以来坚定不移的信仰就换来这样的苦涩终结……我已经心灰意冷。

en: A fine fishing rod that makes catching fish as easy as possible. You can reel in fish faster and hold out longer if they put up a fight.
cn: 做工精美的鱼竿，能够轻而易举地钓鱼。你的收线速度更快，而且能够更长久地与鱼进行拉扯。

en: Landing after gliding creates an explosion that deals %k fire damage and leaves behind a trail of fire that applies burning to enemies, dealing %k damage per second for %k. After the initial impact, attacks deal %k additional fire damage for %k.
cn: 结束滑翔后在着陆时创造一次爆炸，造成%k火焰伤害并在你脚下生成一条火焰之径，对敌人施加燃烧，每秒造成%k伤害，持续%k。在最初的冲击结束后，攻击将造成额外%k火焰伤害，持续%k。

en: These pants are smeared with soot.
cn: 这条裤子上已经沾满煤灰。

en:
Look like a Fell foe, but make it fashion. This blue color palette mirrors the hues of the Shroud, with a touch of aquamarine added.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
虽然看上去跟瘴气魔敌人有点像，但是更为时尚。这种蓝色与瘴气的色彩如出一辙，而且还添加了一丝海蓝之彩。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: We're not in the barracks anymore. This is the real deal. The new frontline, fresh and freezing! Time to put on a tough face, or else my new mate Connor will pick on me. Everyone around me is a proper soldier, braving the cold for the motherland. How exciting!! Right now, I'm only chopping wood and shooing away rats, but that's gonna change, believe me! I overheard the others talk about some gigantic winged beast while sitting near the ballistae... They won't tell me what it is, but I'll soon see for myself. And when I do, I'll pierce its eye with a single shot! That's sure to impress Connor! — George
cn: 我们已经不在营房里面了。这才是真实的世界。新的边疆，让人心旷神怡的冰天雪地！我得努力装得凶悍一点，不然肯定要被我的新朋友康纳挑刺。 除了我以外，这里的所有人都是真正的士兵，为了祖国不惧严寒。这个地方真是太让人感到激动了！！ 虽然现在我还只能负责劈柴或者是赶老鼠这种小活，但很快就会不一样了，相信我！之前我坐在弩炮旁边的时候，我无意间听见其他人提到了某种长着翅膀的巨大野兽…… 他们不愿意告诉我那究竟是什么东西，不过相信我很快就能亲眼见到它的真面貌。到时候看我不一箭射穿那个怪物的脑袋！那样子康纳肯定就不会再看不起我了！ — 乔治

en: A strange flask exuding a feeling of power.
cn: 奇怪的小瓶，能够感受到其中蕴含的力量。
仍然使用存在问题的控制方案
阿尔班耶夫山脉的鼹鼠

en: A warm fireplace which you can put in your home. It can be used to cook simple dishes and is vital for receiving the Rested Buff.
cn: 能够在家中安放的温暖火炉，帮助获取休息良好加成。

en: What a kerfuffle... I simply meant to lean against the wall to rest, but somehow, I must have pressed a hidden button to open a secret door! Such a new-fangled, dumbfounding, surprising, and astonishing mechanism! Regular doors are intriguing enough, but secret doors are even more so! They are just so.... fancy. I find myself more interested in the craftsmanship, nay, the artistry of this door than the treasures it presumably hides. My nephew would be overwhelmed with joy. Perhaps if I send him a charcoal sketch, he'll be able to replicate this. I wonder if there are more temples like this one... and if they share similar architecture! I suppose I'll find out! — Braelyn
cn: 真是乱七八糟……我不过是想要靠在墙边休息一下，我肯定是无意间按到了一扇暗门的隐藏按钮！ 真是一种不可思议又耐人寻味的神奇机关！要知道普通的门里面就蕴藏了很多门道，暗门更是暗藏玄机！这种东西真的……太华丽了。 不过就我自己而言，我更关注的是这扇门本身的工艺和艺术价值，而不是门后可能藏着的宝藏。要是我侄子知道这件事非得高兴得跳起来。也许我该给他送一份炭笔素描，那样子他应该就能复制这些东西。不知道能不能找到其他类似这个地方的神庙……说不定它们都使用了相似的建筑设计！无论如何，只有看见才知道！ - 布莱林

en: Your protection against physical attacks. Each point reduces incoming damage by 1.
cn: 抵御物理攻击。每点可使受到的伤害降低1。

en: These sleek trousers are usually worn underneath more lavish dresses or tunics.
cn: 这些贴身长裤通常会搭配奢华严厉的裙子或者是罩袍。

en: Weapons deal different types of damage. Damage and ammunition affinities can be viewed when selecting the weapon in the Inventory (Most Recent Tab). Enemies have susceptibilities to certain damage types. Exploit an enemy's weakness to gain an advantage on the battlefield.
cn: 武器会造成不同类型的伤害。在物品栏（最近打开的面板）中选择武器时可以查看伤害和弹药属性。 某些类型的伤害对特定敌人会更加有效。利用敌人的弱点，在战场上取得优势。

en: A simple and sturdy ring, decorated with 3 azure gemstones. The engraving reads: "To <lorename>Cyrus</lorename>, my most loyal Commander and friend". It was found inside the maw of the creature that haunts The Pike.
cn: 简单却牢固的戒指，点缀有3枚天蓝色的宝石。上面刻着一段铭文：“致<lorename>赛鲁斯</lorename>，我最忠诚的指挥官与挚友”。最初在崇山城中徘徊的野兽口中找到。

en: A poisoned arrow, perfect for hunting. Poisoned Arrow: Wildlife and Wild Beast hit by this arrow are poisoned and receive 16 damage per second for 5 seconds.
cn: 淬有剧毒的箭矢，最适合用来狩猎。 淬毒箭：被此箭射中的野生生物将中毒，并且将每秒承受16点伤害，持续5秒。
瘴气魔敌人，阿尔班耶夫山脉瘴气

en: My Ancestors And I Grew Up In These Tunnels
cn: 我的祖辈与我都在这些隧道中出生长大

en: You've acquired the Farmer's lost ring. Return it to her to proceed!
cn: 你已经拿到了农民遗失的戒指，让戒指物归原主！

en:
Each percent of Poison Resistance reduces Poison damage taken.

Poison damage bypasses armor and can only be mitigated by Poison Resistance.
cn:
毒素抗性按百分数削减承受的毒素伤害。

毒素伤害无视护甲，并且只能够通过毒素抗性减免。

en: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.
cn: 握把旁装有多个狼头的重型棍棒。
贝壳灰岩瓦片屋顶方块

en: Slaying the Scavenger Matron at the Hill of Scavengers unlocked knowledge to craft an Improved Grappling Hook. The improved tool will require less stamina to use. Craft it with the help of the Carpenter.
cn: 杀死位于拾荒者山丘的拾荒者主母后，改良版抓钩的制作配方已解锁。 改良工具将消耗更少的体力。在木匠的帮助下制作这种工具。

en: The ice you brought the Barber, sadly, did not inspire him. He wants to send you out again to search the enshrouded valleys of the Albaneve Summits instead of the peaks. He's looking for ice that's more "imperfect" and tainted by a discoloration. Acquire enshrouded ice from the mushrooms in Albaneve Summits enshrouded valleys and show it to the Barber!
cn: 遗憾的是，你给理发师带来的冰块并没有激发他的灵感。他想再次派你出去寻找笼罩着的山谷 阿尔班耶夫山脉 而不是峰值。 他正在寻找更“不完美”且被变色污染的冰块。 获得 蘑菇的冰块 阿尔班耶夫山脉 笼罩的山谷 并把它拿给理发师看！

en: A magnificent aquamarine gleams upon this garment, said to amplify the wearer’s healing abilities
cn: 一枚壮丽璀璨的海蓝宝石点缀着这件服饰，据说能够强化穿戴者的治疗能力。

en: Legendary runes are infused with an immense amount of magical energy. These rare and powerful artifacts are required to enhance legendary weapons, shields, armors and rings, unlocking their full potential. Craftspeople and their assistants can use Runes to imbue said equipment with powerful bonuses and effects. Once used, legendary runes become an integral part of the imbued equipment and cannot be recovered. Choose wisely, for the power they bestow is both extraordinary and irreplaceable.
cn: 传奇符文中蕴含着超乎想象的魔法能量。这些罕见的强大工艺品能够用于强化传奇武器、盾牌、护甲以及戒指，并完全解锁其中的潜能。 工匠与他们的助手能够使用符文来为这些装备赋予强大的加成与效果。 传奇符文一旦使用便会与装备彻底融合，因此无法回收。镶嵌时一定要谨慎选择，传奇符文拥有非比寻常的力量，但同样也是独一无二的存在。

en: Time in the Shroud Should this time run out, the Shroud will consume you.
cn: 瘴气停留时间 如果停留时间耗尽，你将被瘴气吞噬。

en: Skimmer's Cove crumbles and roars. King Gormander's Imperial Guard suspects an impending collapse! Refrain from visiting the cove or venture forth at your own risk. Search and rescue operations cannot be performed until the war subsides! Furthermore: Stay clear of the coast at night! Reports confirm strange vibrations in the water, as well as moving lights. However, King Gormander, glorious ruler of Meldore, wants to reassure you personally that sightings of an aquatic beast remain unfounded. Pikemead's Reach is safe as can be! — Chief Higgs, 64th Day of Midyear, 503 D.A.
cn: 水兽湾发生垮塌，并伴有轰鸣。戈曼德国王的御林军怀疑其即将崩溃！请勿前往小海湾，否则后果自负。在战争平息之前，无法进行搜救行动。 此外：晚上不要靠近海岸！有报告证实水里有奇怪的震动，以及移动的光芒。不过，戈曼德国王，荣耀的梅尔多尔统治者，希望亲自向各位保证，关于水生野兽的目击事件仍然是没有根据的。 派克米德之地安全无虞！ - 希格斯总管，岁中第64日，503 D.A.

en: After placing a Survivor, target a bed to assign it.
cn: 放置一名NPC后，瞄准一张床并进行分配。

en: You've found a note that mentions the appearance of a fearless fighter in the arena of <location>Surat's Rest</location>. She was killed in an unfair fight and her body was dropped down the cliff. Find her body and save her soul!
cn: 你找到了一张字条，上面提到说<location>苏拉特之息</location>的竞技场中有一位勇敢无畏的战士。被对手的卑鄙伎俩害死之后，这位女战士的尸体被人扔下了悬崖。找到她的尸体并拯救她的灵魂！

en: Be the hunter, not the hunted!

The Kindlewastes' soul was drained long ago. Every grain of sand a silent prayer, each fruitless as the dead soil beneath. Past springs of life, now home to none — former hopes buried under dunes and dust.
cn: 燃火荒原早已沦为一具没有灵魂的巨大空壳。每一颗砂砾都是无声的祈祷，但回应的就只有像底下干涸土壤一样的死寂。此地曾经是生命的源泉，但现在已经彻底荒芜，曾经的一切希望都被掩埋在了漫无边际的黄沙之下。

en: Small orbs that grow inside shellfish, valued for their raw beauty.
cn: 长在贝壳体内的小圆球，因为其纯粹的美丽而大受追捧。

en: Wearing these gloves, the Northern Lord carved his way through the enshrouded valleys of Embervale. The scars he cut into people and soil can be traced from the bleak mountains to today's ruins of <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>.
cn: 凭借这种手套，北境领主成功在薪谷瘴气弥漫的深谷中开拓出了前行的道路。从荒芜的山脉到今日的<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>遗迹，随处可见那个男人给人民与土地带来的伤疤。

en: Perfectly crisp and buttery — a golden foundation for your sweetest baking experiments.
cn: 恰到好处的松脆与黄油般的口感，这种金色的饼皮将成为甜美烘焙实验的完美基底。

en: The delay after which regeneration becomes active.
You feel sick...your maximum health and stamina are reduced.
cn: 你感觉不太舒服……你的最大生命值与体力都降低了。

en: Trust me, live music will be great for your tavern! No, we'd never cause trouble! Think of all the mead you'll sell with The Honeydews serenading your customers! What a mess. That guy really had me wrapped around his little finger. I should've known that this band would cause trouble, they've such a bad reputation for stage fights, after all! But a live breakup? Come on, now! And this bastard Miles even tried to get a room here after his band RUINED my establishment! I threw him out, but I swear I can still hear his stupid flute being played somewhere nearby. It's so damned grating. He does it to mock me while I pick up shattered plates and flip tables back around!
cn: 相信我，你的酒馆现在最需要的就是有人来现场演奏音乐活跃气氛！不不不，我们绝对不会给你惹麻烦的！想象一下，只要让蜜露来负责烘托气氛，客人们一高兴你还怕卖不出蜜酒么！ 真是一塌糊涂。我算是彻底被那个家伙捏在手心里了。我早该知道这个乐队是个麻烦，毕竟他们是出了名的喜欢在台上打架！但是现场解散？拜托！ 迈尔斯这个混蛋更过分，他的乐队在我的店里面大闹一番之后，这家伙竟然还恬不知耻地想要我给他开房间！我直接把这家伙一脚踹出去了，我发誓我现在还能听见他正在附近吹他那个难听的笛子。这整件事都让我感到火冒三丈。 他肯定是故意在嘲笑我，到现在我还在收拾被他们打翻的桌子和满地的碎盘子！

en: Add this swing anchor to your buildings to swing across chasms. Requires a Grappling Hook to activate.
cn: 为建筑添加摆荡锚点之后，你将可以摆荡穿越沟壑。需要使用抓钩激活。

en: Select a recipe to show available resources in nearby magic chests.
cn: 选择一份配方以显示附近的魔法箱中的可用资源。

en: Blinking into an enemy triggers an explosion which deals Fire damage in a small radius. Damage and Mana cost scale with the Intelligence attribute.
cn: 闪现至敌人位置并触发爆炸，对小范围内的目标造成火焰伤害。 智力属性将提高伤害与法力消耗。

en:
We're celebrating Lord Vorgoth's successful securing of the summits! All glory to the Guard of the North!

Get your tickets now before they sell out! Check out the show in the upper grand hall on the 20th of Midyear, 496 D.A.— refreshments are not included!!
cn:
为庆祝沃格斯领主成功占领山顶，我们将举办盛大的庆祝活动！所有荣耀归于北境守卫！

走过路过别错过！记得在岁中第20日，496 D.A.来上层大殿观赏表演 — 不免费提供食物和饮料！！

en: An accurate bow imbued with the mysterious powers of the Shroud.
cn: 这把精准无比的弓中蕴含着来自瘴气的神秘力量。

en: Defeat And Loot The Fell Banshee

cn: 你是不是弄坏了什么东西?

en: This rod you've found seems like a lucky find! You should put it to use, mate!
cn: 看来你的运气不错，竟然能找到这样的鱼竿！你应该把它用起来，伙计！

en:
3. Provision of the game, download, payment processing

Our game is made available to you by the operator of the respective platform from which you obtain our game (Steam). We are not responsible for the processing of your personal data by these platforms, e.g. user accounts, provision and download of games or payment processing, but the respective platform is. You can find more information in the privacy policy of the respective platform.
cn:
3. Provision of the game, download, payment processing

Our game is made available to you by the operator of the respective platform from which you obtain our game (Steam). We are not responsible for the processing of your personal data by these platforms, e.g. user accounts, provision and download of games or payment processing, but the respective platform is. You can find more information in the privacy policy of the respective platform.

en: You need to upload at least one screenshot.
cn: 你需要上传至少一份截图。

en: You understand Drakian writing and have increased power against Drak.
cn: 你能够理解龙裔的文字，并且面对卓克时将造成额外伤害。

en: A farmbed, which grows seedlings into crops.
cn: 能够让种子成长为作物的农地。

en: Chance to poison enemies on hit
cn: 命中时有几率使敌人中毒

en: The Vukah are gathering in the Low Meadows. Something mysterious might be afoot. Find their camp and investigate!
cn: 沃卡正在低矮草原聚集。那里有可能正在发生某种神秘事件。去他们的营地进行调查！

en: Cloven, finely segmented boots. Their shape is reminiscent of Faedeer hooves.
cn: 紧密连接的蹄形靴子。这种靴子的造型效仿了仙鹿的蹄子。

en: Martha's Diary, First Entry of Midyear, 503 D.A.
cn: 玛莎的日记，岁中第一篇，503 D.A.

en: Those pants go perfectly with the tunic, creating a fluent transition. They allow enough air circulation to prevent overheating during battle.
cn: 作为短上衣的完美搭配，这种裤子能够带来行云流水般的过渡。除此以外良好的通风效果能够帮助你避免在战斗中过热。

en: There's so much more to explore! Let's climb another Ancient Spire and see what we can find!
cn: 还有很多东西等着我们去探索！让我们再爬上另一座远古尖塔，看看能找到什么！

en: I love to sail forbidden seas…
Modeled after Kindlewastes city walls. This block is an accurate replica.
cn: 采用了模仿燃火荒原城墙的外形风格。属于原品的精准复刻。

en: Scales the amount of XP received through combat.
cn: 调整通过战斗获得的经验值数量。
空荡礼堂 展示柜（小型栏位x3）

en: You've obtained a piece of clothing through gameplay or by supporting other creators on external platforms. Gather all pieces to complete your set! You can obtain this clothing set through gameplay or by supporting creators on external platforms during an event.
cn: 你已经通过游玩或者是支持外部平台的创作者获得了一件服饰。 集齐所有部件以完成你的套装！ 你可以通过游玩游戏，或者是于活动期间在外部平台支持创作者来获取该套服饰。

en: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gaping maw of a cave.
cn: 使用金丝装饰的精美长剑。最初是多年前随一颗流星从天而降并直接坠入了一处洞穴的深处。

en:
The chalky white and vibrant pink in this palette form a childlike innocence.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn:
松碎的白与跃动的粉为这种调色板带来了别样的童真氛围。

可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en: Elegant boots with blue accents. They exude glamour and grace.
cn: 蓝色点缀的优雅靴子。它们散发着魅力和优雅。
气泡能够恢复你的氧气量。

en: Dealing damage with Wand projectiles has a %k chance to restore 1 durability to that weapon.
cn: 魔棒投射物造成伤害后有%k几率为武器恢复1点耐久。

en: Watery and a little strange, this mushroom's odd taste comes from pure magic coursing throughout. Great power awaits the consumer.
cn: 异常多汁而且口感略显奇特，这种蘑菇的独特味道来源于其中蕴含的纯粹魔法。服用后能够获得强大的力量。
能够开启绝大多数上锁的门。

en: Scholar of the Young Flame Helmet
One of the survivors in your base has taken the Blacksmith's equipment chest. Ask around to find the culprit!
cn: 你的基地中的一位幸存者偷走了铁匠的装备箱。四处打听情况并找到罪魁祸首！
跟随布莱林姑姑的踪迹

en: I could talk to you all day! Anything else?
cn: 和你在一起聊什么都很开心！还有其他事吗？

en: I told them the truth, but they won't believe me! The dragon is real! I saw it while scavenging booze on the outer rims of our territory. When I stumbled into that cave and met its ferocious gaze, eyes glowing with mystical light — I turned 'round like a whirlwind and dashed off! The others spit and laugh at me! So what if I gulped down a little moonshine while out and about? I know what I saw!
cn: 我早就把真相告诉过他们，但是他们就是不信我！真的有龙！ 之前我在地盘外围找酒喝的时候看见了。当时我无意间闯进了那个洞穴，然后就和那双凶狠的眼睛对上了，它的眼睛闪烁着奇怪的光芒，我当时吓坏了，立刻掉头就跑！ 但是其他人只是把我嘲笑一通！虽然我当时确实是喝了点小酒，但那又怎么了？我真的看见了龙！

en: A shiny material with an interesting texture. Any garment made with this will appear very fashionable.
cn: 有着独特材质的闪亮金属。使用这种材料制作的服饰将会显得格外时尚。

en:
Here in the moonflower's bloom
My tears mirror yours 
As heart and casket lay bare
cn:
在盛开的月之花下
我与你的眼泪一同落下
心脏与棺木都被彻底撕开

en: Increases the skill level of Cull the Herd
cn: 提高弱肉强食的技能等级

en: Summons rescued survivors into your bases around a Flame Altar.
cn: 将被解救的幸存者召唤至灵火祭坛附近的基地。

en: Your bare fists can only do little damage. For survival, a weapon or shield would be preferable.
cn: 光凭赤手空拳并无法造成像样的伤害。寻找武器或盾牌以提高生存几率。
使用不完整的自定义键位方案
单手近战武器墙壁支架

en: Brew the ground beans in water as is custom, then soften the brew with milk until the bitterness fades. The result: a smooth, warm, and pleasant cup I'd like to call this creation: Latte
cn: 按照传统做法将研磨好的咖啡豆粉末泡入水中， 然后用牛奶中和咖啡的苦涩。 这一做法的结果：一杯入口柔和、温暖而且怡人 的杰作：拿铁

en: Time to revive an ally is reduced by %k seconds. Default revive time is 6 seconds.
cn: 复活同伴需要的时间缩短%k秒。 默认复活时间为6秒。

en: A decorative element that creates an explosive atmosphere, indeed.
cn: 能够创造爆炸性氛围的装饰元素。

en: A copper helmet that keeps your skull from harm while you protect your allies.
cn: 坚固的铜盔保护你的头颅，让你安心守护盟友。

en:
The <npc>Alchemist</npc> mentioned that certain spells are imbued with endless magical energy. Such spells are called eternal spells, and they don't deplete when used as staff ammunition. They can be used indefinitely.

These spells are scattered throughout the world, but one was buried alongside its former owner in an underground grave. Find the buried tomb and retrieve the eternal spell to use it.
cn:
<npc>炼金术士</npc>提到说特定法术中蕴藏着无尽的魔法能量。这些法术被称为“永恒法术”，作为法杖弹药使用时，这些法术将不会枯竭，并且可以持续不断使用。

这种法术散落在世界的各个角落，但有一种与自己原本的主人被埋葬在了一处地下墓穴中。找到掩埋的墓穴，然后取回并使用永恒法术。

en: Adjust the quality of reflections. Reducing the quality will increase performance.
cn: 调整反射质量。降低质量可提高性能。

en: Only nearby living players can receive items.
cn: 只有附近的存活玩家可以接收物品。

en: These Archer Gloves have been refined to be snug and effective.
cn: 改良后的弓箭手手套轻便贴合，能提供有效保护。
寒冰法师与他们的装备

en: Did you start building a shelter for me yet? I might look high-maintenance, but I'm not picky!
cn: 请问你有在为我搭建庇护所了吗？虽然我看上去很娇贵，但我并不是一个挑剔的人！

en: This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 此收藏品在 游牧高地 中找到。

en: An elegantly twisted metal headband, adorned with an eye-catching stone.
cn: 优雅婀娜的金属头箍，表面嵌有一块让人无法挪开视线的精致宝石。

en: Slippery fish eyes, freed from the sockets of a poor catch. It feels like they're looking at you with malice.
cn: 从某条被捕获的可怜鱼儿眼眶中挣脱的滑溜眼珠。它们看上去正在用充满恶意的眼神跟随着你。

en:
Your Flame Altar has protected this area for so long that some items cannot find their way to you anymore. 
The Flame has kept them safe for you to claim, so you can continue your journey.
cn:
虽然你的灵火祭坛一直在守护着这片区域，但是有些物品似乎无法找到回来的路了。
灵火已经为你保管这些迷路的物品，安心继续自己的旅程吧。

en: Music that illustrates the awe-inspiring first impression that the imposing mountain range leaves behind. All echoes are swallowed by fresh, pure snow. No one will hear you here. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 这首曲目描绘了远方崇山的威严景象给人带来的震撼。纯洁的白雪带走了所有的回音。在这里，没有人听得见你的声音。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: Antialiasing smooths the edges seen in images, making them look more natural.
cn: 抗锯齿能够使画面中的物体边缘变得更为平滑，并使画面看上去更为自然。

en: Wet Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration.
cn: 潮湿 体力与体力恢复降低30%，持续15分钟。温暖环境将能够缩短此效果的持续时间。

en: Focus Generate Focus by attacking. Focus can be built up with any weapon type and is used to trigger Special Abilities of weapons.
cn: 专注 攻击将生成专注。所有类型的武器都可以积累专注，你可以花费专注来发动武器的特殊能力。

en: Find The Cosmetic Blacksmith Clothing Set
Could You Save Some Medicine For The Hermit?
cn: 能否给那个隐士留点药品？

en:
Increases your Spirit attribute by 1.

Increases Mana by %k per Attribute Point.
cn:
令精神属性提升1点。

每点属性增加%k点法力。

en: No Honey Rootbeer, no Glazed & Grilled Yucca or Summer Spice Tea until my Beehive Smoker and honeycomb arrive from East Lapis! Until then: Creamy Tomato Soup, Stuffed Bellpeppers AND this week only: Draconian Vulture Wing Filet with varied vegetables! Get it while it's hot! — Emily Fray
cn: 在没有拿到东之岩发来的熏蜂器还有蜂巢之前，拜托各位跟蜂蜜根汁汽水，糖烤丝兰果还有夏日香料茶说再见吧！在收到货之前：奶油番茄汤，灯笼椒塞肉，以及本周特供菜品：残酷秃鹫翅排，配菜是各类时蔬！ 别等菜凉，趁热享用！ — 艾米丽·弗莱

en: Further increases the Critical Strike chance for magical weapons.
cn: 进一步提高魔法武器的暴击率。
特别行动 — 潜水员日志 — 条目032

en: Explore The Cyclops Cave Near The Bridge
cn: 探索桥边的独眼巨人洞穴

en: A ceremonial staff, used in part to melt frozen lakes into clear, drinkable water.
cn: 一把仪式法杖，用于融化冰冻的湖泊并为人们提供可以饮用的清水。

en: A fish rots from the head down.
cn: 所有鱼都是从头部最先开始腐烂的。

en: The Daylilies look marvelous — they’ll make a STUNNING new hair color! But I’ve also seen the most beautiful passionflowers at night… could you bring me some, pretty please?
cn: 日光百合看上去太美了……他们一定能够做出最震撼的新发色！但是我还在晚上见到了有史以来最漂亮的西番莲……能不能帮我摘一点来，拜托拜托？

en: Fish got too close to land.
Flameborn, come here! I have exciting news to share with you!
cn: 火之子，快来！我有重要的消息要告诉你！
物品栏（最近打开的面板）

en: Every aspect of this hammer's head is designed meticulously. The front and back boast a colorful yet distinguished design, while the sides share a row of spikes. Appealing, and functional.
cn: 锤头部分采用了一丝不苟的精细工艺。前后都拥有颜色鲜艳的特殊设计，两侧则安装有整排尖刺。可以说是兼具美观与功能性的典范。

en: Find A Color Palette In The Kindlewastes Farm
cn: 在燃火荒原农场找到一份调色板

en:
I know we can't afford new clothes for the Harvest Festival, so I improvised... but I need your help!

I'd like to freshen up the colors on my old dress, but I ran out of orange. Could you get more from the market and leave the dye in the bathroom for me? I'll use the tub there so I don't make a mess with the colors. Don't worry, I'll clean it after!!

Thank you!
cn:
我知道我们没办法为收获祭准备新的衣裳，所以我决定利用手头现有的东西……但是我需要你的帮助！

我想要给旧裙子重新上个色，但是我的橙色染料都已经用完了。能不能麻烦你去市场买一些，到时候把染料留在盥洗室就行了？我可以直接用那里面的浴缸来给衣服染色，这样就不用担心弄得到处都是了。别担心，我保证会收拾干净的！！

谢谢！

en: Find all flame shrines and sanctums in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 找到游牧高地中的所有灵火神龛与神殿。

en: A magic-powered punch that pushes back and stuns enemies. Replaces your unarmed attacks as long as you have the necessary Mana available. Cost: 30 Mana
cn: 能够推开并晕眩命中的敌人的魔法拳击。 拥有足够的法力时，替换原本的徒手攻击。 消耗：30点法力

en: This arena belongs to a warrior clan defined by violent conquest. They gather on this hillside to wage gladiator battles where the lone survivor is crowned — what I've come to call The Brawler. Despite sharing voracity, these Vukah conduct different rites from the ones who've overtaken Fort Kelvin. While their rituals of sacrifice may diverge, blood spilled is blood gained in the eyes of their deities: Proto-beasts that reign over earth and sky, born of flesh and made eternal through totems — able to bless, and to damn. Vukah... do your immolations seek to impress, or to appease? When you left your homes to haunt mine, was it to conquer, or to flee? What force of nature, what damnation, what faceless god brought you here? I have to uncover your secrets, but inching closer would be certain death. Perhaps, when the Brawler lay sleeping... I could spy further. Marianne Reed, 498 D.A.
cn: 这座竞技场属于一个尚武好战的战士氏族。他们会聚集在这片山坡上举行决斗，最后唯一胜出的幸存者将得到特别的身份……我决定将这些家伙称为斗士。 尽管都有着贪婪无度的习性，这些沃卡与占领凯尔文要塞的那些同胞举行着截然不同的仪式。虽然献祭仪式有所不同，但他们信奉的神祇都渴望着鲜血： 统治着大地与天空的始源巨兽，诞生自血肉之躯，而后又化为图腾成为永恒的象征，这些神祇能够庇佑，也能够破坏。 沃卡……你们的献祭的目的是为了取悦还是乞求？当初你们离开家乡来到我们的土地是为了征服还是逃亡？究竟是什么样的自然之力、毁灭或者是无名的神祇将你们带来了这里？ 我还没有解开你们的秘密，但是过于靠近只会带来死亡。也许等斗士睡着之后……我可以做进一步的打探。 玛丽安娜·里德，498 D.A.

en: Some doors are locked, but can be opened by finding and pressing the correct button.
cn: 有些大门是锁上的，但是找到并按下正确的按钮即可开启。

en: We need more space, Flameborn. And chests, don't you think?
cn: 我们需要更多空间，火之子。还有储物箱，你觉得呢？

en: Bonus protection against cutting physical damage, in addition to the general physical resistance.
cn: 除了常规物理抗性外，提供针对物理劈砍伤害的额外防御。

en:
ARMOR
Each "Magical Armor" point reduces damage for all magical damage types by 1.

RESISTANCE
Each "Magical Resistance" percentage further reduces all magical damage.
cn:
护甲
每点“魔法护甲”使所有魔法类型的伤害减少1点。

抗性
“魔法抗性”百分比将进一步减少所有魔法伤害。

en: You're weak, kid! A true Flameborn would arm themselves — let me show you how!
cn: 你太弱了，孩子！真正的火之子应该装备武器让自己变强，我来教你！

en:
Benny took my hat 
It's not phair that hee took my hat 
Hee put it in one of the little goat houses with the stinky goats 
I like the goats, but they are stinky, mom 
I don't want my hat to smell like a goat!

Please make me a neaw hat mommy?
cn:
本尼拿走了我的帽子
他凭什么抢我的帽子
他把帽子放在养那些臭烘烘的山羊的屋子里面了
我喜欢山羊，但是它们真的好臭啊，妈妈
我不想要我的帽子也和山羊一样臭烘烘的！

妈妈，能不能帮我做一顶新的帽子？

en: Dealing fire damage applies burning for %k which deals %k per second. After a successful trigger, it has a cooldown of %k.
cn: 造成火焰伤害时将施加燃烧，每秒造成%k伤害，持续%k。成功触发效果后需要%k的冷却时间。

en: A staff that was used by magical torchbearers of bygone days. They'd illuminate uncharted caves to claim even the furthest corners of the Albaneve Summits as parts of the northern empire. The scouting went well until the Cyclopes learned that the torchbearers were feeble mages whose light could be snuffed out easily with a decisive boulder toss.
cn: 在久远的过去，手持魔法火炬之人曾经使用过的法杖。这些先行者会用火炬的光芒照亮从未有人踏足过的洞穴，为北方王国勘探阿尔班耶夫山脉的遥远尽头。可惜当独眼巨人们意识到只需要一颗巨石就能砸死那些手持火炬的软弱法师之后，勘探工作便宣告终结。

en: Hot Plates that can be used to upgrade the oven.
cn: 能够用于升级炉子的陶土炉灶。

en: I am not just a barber, I am a style architect!
cn: 我不只是一名理发师那么简单，我可是风格的奠基者！

en: Defines how much taming progress you lose when you scare an animal.
cn: 决定动物受到惊讶时损失的驯服进度。

en: This makeshift wooden shield allows you to block physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
cn: 这面简易木盾能够允许你格挡物理攻击。格挡将消耗体力。

en: How Do I Tell The Boss?

Untouched by the Flame, and veiled in a lingering cold. This armor used to belong to Lord <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>, who was rumored to have a frozen heart that splinters and breaks with every tired beat.
cn: 丝毫没有受到灵火影响，而且永远笼罩在挥之不去的寒冷之中。这套盔甲曾经属于<lorename>沃格斯</lorename>领主，据说他那颗彻底冻结的心脏会随着每一次疲惫的跳动而愈发破碎。

en:
A gland that's seemingly dripping with poison. Don't think about it too much, or the visual will haunt your dreams.

Found on poison-spitting spiders and can be used in crafting to produce an antidote to Hemotoxin.
cn:
这个腺体似乎还在不停滴落毒液。如果一直盯着看晚上肯定会做噩梦。

能够从喷毒蜘蛛身上收集，可以进一步加工为治愈毒血的解毒剂。

en: Increases the skill level of Airborne
This enhanced equipment will aid you in your fight against the creatures of the Shroud. Enhancing equipment always requires Runes.
cn: 这件强化过的装备将帮助你对抗瘴气中的生物。符文是强化装备时必不可少的材料。

en: Fine sand that's been infused with Shroud spores. Commonly found in the Kindlewastes biome.
cn: 与瘴气孢子融为一体的细沙。常见于燃火荒原。

en: I should have been awake. I wasn't. They stormed our camp at night with unforeseen ferocity. Their fur coats were mottled with garnet flecks, now fading to matted rust. We had crossed into their new territory. About half of my brothers and sisters, gone. Absinthe; foul wormwood licorice, a coating vile and bitter, numbing my lips. I fought for them, I raised my axe for them. My armor, ripped away. My hands, forever stained red. We should never have passed through the Pillars of Creation. Mother. Please, don't lose hope in me. We share the same blood. I will persevere for them. And I'll never fail again. — Jezmina, 507 D.A.
cn: 我本该保持清醒。但我并没有。 在夜间，他们趁着我们没有防备突入了营地。它们的毛皮上挂满了已经缠绕锈蚀的彩色石子。原来是我们闯入了它们的新领地。 几乎有一半的同胞就此陨落。苦艾酒，这种气味难闻的草药烈酒，苦涩而又辛辣的液体麻木了我的嘴唇。我举起了手中的斧子为大家而战。我的护甲被掀开，我的双手沾满了洗不掉的红色。我们当初就不应该穿过创世之柱。 母亲啊。请你继续相信我。我们拥有着一脉相承的血液。为了他们，我将继续坚持下去。我将再也不会失败。 — 杰兹米娜，507 D.A.

en: Blocking damage has a %k chance to add %k bonus blunt damage to the next attack within the next few seconds and increases the pushback.
cn: 成功格挡伤害时，有%k%几率使你在接下来几秒时间内的下一次攻击造成%k额外钝击伤害，并且提高击退力。
双手近战伤害（瘴气侵蚀）

en: You've reached a mysterious new land named the Blackmire. The Flame's grasp is weak here, so you must strengthen its presence by igniting the Ancient Spire — Blackmire. Afterward, the Flame will be able to guide you more.
cn: 你已经抵达一片名为黑沼的神秘区域。这里几乎无法感受到灵火的存在，你必须点燃远古尖塔 — 黑沼以强化它的力量。完成之后，灵火将为你提供进一步的指引。

en: These algae may look inconspicuous, but they are highly versatile.
cn: 虽然看上去平淡无奇，但这些藻类其实用处多多。

en:
The muted gray and silvery sheen cannot hide the underlying seething emerald-green envy.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
cn:
黯淡的灰色与银色闪光无法隐藏最底下喷薄欲出的宝石之绿。

可以使用喧嚣森林材料制作这种调色板。

en: Well hello, Flameborn. Say, can you do me a favor? I'm distraught! My mother gifted me a very precious ring just before I left home to build my tavern in <location>Brittlebush</location>. Sadly, I was forced to flee a Dune Armadillo on my journey through the Kindlewastes and lost the ring! Please help me find it?
cn: 你好，火之子。可以请你帮我一个忙吗？我现在真的束手无策了！在我离开家前往<location>碎丛</location>建造酒馆之前，我的母亲送给了我一枚非常贵重的戒指。但遗憾的是，我在穿越燃火荒原的过程中遇到了沙丘犰狳袭击，戒指也在我逃命的时候弄丢了！你能够帮我把戒指找回来吗？

en: A floppy hat with red feathers.
cn: 插上红色羽毛点缀的软帽。

en: Read all obelisks in the Revelwoods.
cn: 查看喧嚣森林中的所有方尖碑。

en: Stop yer procrastinating! Climb that Ancient Spire in the distance to reveal important landmarks.
cn: 抓紧时间！爬上远处的那座远古尖塔就可以看到周围的重要地标。

en: The leaves of a palm — very useful as a building material thanks to their width and elasticity.
cn: 棕榈树的叶片，宽大而且弹性极佳，非常适合用来当做建筑材料。

en: An improved storage option with enhanced capacity.
cn: 改良过的储存容器，拥有更大的容量。

en: Only Draklings skilled enough earn the right to wield these adorned daggers. They often remain a trusted weapon for a lifetime. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 只有证明自己能力的龙裔才有资格挥舞这些精美的匕首。这些往往是伴随它们一生的可靠武器。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Craft and place a factory in your base to use it. If multiple crafting recipes are available or possible, select the desired recipe in the factory menu at the top with "browse recipes" before crafting. Select the items needed for processing and place them into the factory inventory. The factory will process the raw materials into higher quality ingredients or items once it receives the correct item input. Check your factory again after time has passed to retrieve the final product from the factory inventory.
cn: 制作工坊并将其放置在基地中以开始使用。如果存在多种制造配方可用，首先在“浏览配方”顶部的工坊菜单中选择想要使用的配方，然后再开始制作。 选择需要的物品并将其放入工坊物品栏。接收到正确的物品后，工坊将把原材料加工为更高品质的素材或物品。 之后只需要等待一段时间，你就可以再次查看工坊，并从工坊物品栏中取回最终成品。

en: You gave the Farmer strawberries. Their flavor reminded Emily of her old home, which used to be a bountiful oasis before disaster struck. In exchange for the berries, she revealed the location of a buried treasure in the trash pit of Glennwood's End. Explore the location and dig up the hidden riches!
cn: 你将草莓交给了农民。浆果的香甜滋味让艾米丽想起了自己的老家，在灾难事件到来之前，那里曾经是一片丰饶的绿洲。 作为对浆果的交换，她向你揭示格伦伍德之末的垃圾堆中一处埋藏着宝藏的位置。探索那里并挖掘隐藏的宝藏！

en: These boots are perfect for any terrain. Easy to clean, robust, and light.
cn: 这双靴子适合任何地形。易于清洁、结实轻便。

en: Embody golden grandeur with this ornate helm — and a gaze as unyielding as stone itself.
cn: 用这顶精美头盔展现金色光辉 - 以及像磐石一般巍峨不屈的凝视。

en:
Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user.

Must be taken before entering the Shroud. Extends the Time in the Shroud by 2 minutes. This effect will last for 45 minutes.
cn:
含有净化过的瘴气液体，使用后能够提高抗性。

进入瘴气之前必须先服下这种物品。使你在瘴气中能够坚持的时间延长2分钟。该效果能够持续45分钟。

en: A shadowy hood that hides a sinister skull mask underneath. Scary!
cn: 阴暗的兜帽隐藏着底下的邪恶骷髅面具。可怕！

en:
I see him when I wake
The tip of his little, devilish blue hat
And what a stupid hat it is
So pointy, and silly, and filled with hatred

I see him when I close my eyes
The wicked smile, the shaking shovel in his tiny, wrinkled hands

I see him dig, dig, dig in the fields
He wants to push me in
He wants to bury me under rocks and soil

I won't let him win, that fiend. That grave he digs in my smallest field will be his own tomb! And then when he is gone, I can finally sleep again, sleep tight, so tight, and no one will call me loopy no more
cn:
醒来的时候我就会看见他
就是那顶小小的蓝色帽子的尖尖
真是一顶愚蠢的帽子
那么尖，那么蠢，而且充满仇恨

我闭上眼也能看见他
那不怀好意的笑容，长满皱纹的手中握着那把颤抖不停的铲子

我亲眼看着他在田里不停地挖呀挖
他想要把我推进去
他想要把我埋在石头与泥土之下

但是我不会让那个恶鬼得逞的。他在我最小的田地角落挖的大坑将成为他自己的坟墓！等到解决他之后，我就可以重新睡个好觉了，到时候谁也不会说我是个疯子

en: A shield was found in a deep forest grotto. It's washed clean.
cn: 密林深处的洞窟中有一面盾牌。盾牌看上去一尘不染。

en: A cluster of ectoplasm crystals. It holds immense magical powers inside.
cn: 一簇灵质水晶。里面蕴含着磅礴的魔力。

en: This significant upgrade to the <craftingstation>Cooking Station</craftingstation> offers new food options that can be cooked passively.
cn: <craftingstation>烹饪站</craftingstation>的这项重要升级将带来大量全新的烹饪选择。

en: A Grappling Hook is vital for exploration. It can be used to swing across chasms or reach elevated locations. Look for Grappling Hook Pull Anchors in the world once you have crafted your Grappling Hook to use it. You can craft the Grappling Hook at a Workbench. The Grappling Hook is needed to climb the Ancient Spire!
cn: 抓钩对探索至关重要。它可以用来荡过峡谷或到达高处。制作好抓钩后，在世界范围内寻找 抓钩牵引锚点。 您可以在工作台制作 抓钩。攀爬远古尖塔需要 抓钩！

en: Reached the ancient spire in the Low Meadows.
cn: 抵达低矮草原的远古尖塔。

en: Grilled fish with coconut rice or baked taro wedges (12 gold coins) Tomato Fish Soup, rich and creamy (9 gold coins) Note: We got a lotta fish, just ask me to catch it and I'll make it for ya! For the leaf munchers: Algae Salad (8 gold coins) Plain vegetable taro curry with rice (10 gold coins)
