cn: 烤鱼配椰浆饭或烤芋头块（12金币） 番茄鱼汤，口感绵密滋味丰富（9金币） 注：我们这里鱼多的是，只需要叫我去抓一条，到时候我可以给你现做！ 对于素食主义者： 藻类沙拉（8金币） 纯蔬菜芋头咖喱配米饭（10金币）

en: I'm itching to try a new hair color on you... come over here! I'll give you a free consultation!
cn: 我已经迫不及待在你身上尝试新的发色……快来！这次是免费的！

en: Filled with ancient magic, this ring provides light to you in dark places.
cn: 这枚戒指充满古老的魔力，在黑暗中为您带来光明。

en: Work in progress. Not available in Closed Alpha.
cn: 开发中。封闭内测版本不可用。

en:
4.2.1	
By uploading User Content, you simultaneously grant other users of Enshrouded a worldwide, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable right to use the User Content within the scope of Adventure Sharing, in particular to reproduce and store the User Content to the extent required for local use in Visiting mode. This right includes:
a)	Downloading and storing the User Content to the extent required for Visiting mode.
b)	Entering and experiencing the User Content by way of Visiting mode, without changes to the User Content being saved.
cn:
4.2.1	
上传用户内容，即表示您同时授予 Enshrouded 的其他用户一项全球范围内、非独占、不可转让、不可再许可的权利，允许其在冒险分享范围内使用该用户内容，特别是允许其出于在访问模式下本地使用的目的而复制和存储该用户内容。此权利包括：
a)	在访问模式需要的范围内下载和存储用户内容。
b)	通过访问模式进入并体验用户内容，而不保存对该用户内容的更改。

en: This bow fires easily against creatures of the Shroud.
cn: 这把弓十分适合用来狩猎瘴气怪物。

en:
The <npc>Carpenter</npc> wants you to reach the hidden tomb of the former Queen to unearth her treasures. 

The location is marked on your map.
cn:
<npc>木匠</npc>希望您能到达隐藏的王后陵墓，发掘她的宝藏。

地点已标注在您的地图上。

en: A piece of leg armor that already looks like it has seen many years of use.
cn: 这件腿部护甲仿佛经历了无数战斗。

en: I miss bartering. There are certain pigments I can't source nor trade since society collapsed — but there's hope! If the trade outposts are gone, then so are the bandits and smugglers that besieged them. Oh, if only there were a good-looking hero who could travel to, say "Nomad's Drop" to look for color palettes, I would be ever grateful. Do you happen to know one?
cn: 我想念过去以物换物的习俗。自从社会崩溃之后，我就没办法找到或换取特定的颜料，但我觉得还是有希望的！假如贸易站都消失了，那原本围攻那些地方的强盗和走私者们肯定也早已离开。如果有一位风流倜傥的英雄愿意去“游牧集会所”寻找调色板，我必将感激不尽。话说你认识符合条件的人选吗？

en: This slimy soup was improved with some salt, slow-cooked broth, and the added aroma of fearing death.
cn: 食盐、文火炖煮的肉汤外加少许畏惧死亡的香气大大改善了黏液汤的品质。
找到雷蒙·琼斯的藏身点

en: A wooden plate to display cooked food on a table.
cn: 用来在餐桌上盛放料理的木盘子。

en:
The fossilized remains of a stranded prawn. Most of its tiny legs are not visible anymore, which is mournful for researchers — but enjoyable for squeamish Flameborn.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.
cn:
搁浅的对虾化石残骸。它的大部分小腿已经看不到了，这对研究人员来说是件悲哀的事，但对胆小的火焰人来说却是件愉快的事。

此收藏品在 燃火荒原 中找到。

en: This chapel is no longer peaceful. Gone are the days wherein silence and mindfulness would fill the halls. Now there's a faint rattling at night that I cannot unhear. Something is happening in the crypt... and I don't want to be around to see how it ends. I'm packing my bag and heading out. I pray nothing will follow me down the cliff, though I no longer believe my prayers will be heard. Maybe I'll take the secret path and my club to guarantee it.
cn: 昔日教堂的和平已经不复存在。这里的厅堂中再也无法感受到熟悉的沉默与深思。如今一到深夜，我就会听见那些隐隐约约的骚动。墓穴之中出现了变化……我不敢再继续逗留。 等打包好行囊，我就要离开这里。虽然我祈祷在爬下悬崖的过程中不会遇到追兵，但恐怕我的祈祷不会得到回应。也许我应该走那条秘密通道，为了以防万一，我还得带上自己的棍棒。

en: A sickly looking frog that is tinged blue by exposure to spores.
cn: 一只看上去病恹恹的青蛙，因为与孢子接触过而变成了蓝色。
提高穿刺护甲护甲数值
燃火荒原 瘴气巢穴

en:
12.2	
A valid reason exists in particular if the amendments are necessary (i) due to an unforeseeable, non-insignificant disruption of the contractual equilibrium for Keen at the time the agreement was concluded, (ii) due to changes in case law or legislation affecting the continued performance of the agreement, (iii) due to the gradual introduction of new freely available gameplay features in Adventure Sharing that were not yet available at the time these Adventure Sharing Terms were concluded, or (iv) due to changed technical requirements, or if the amendments are made in your favor.
cn:
12.2	
正当理由尤其存在于以下情形：该等修订是必要的，(i) 因在本协议订立时无法预见的、对 Keen 而言并非不重要的合同平衡状态被打破；(ii) 因影响协议继续履行的判例法或立法的变更；(iii) 因在冒险分享条款订立时尚未提供的、新的免费游戏功能逐步被引入冒险分享；或 (iv) 因技术要求的变更。或者，该修订对您有利。

en: The Barber wants you to find a color palette reminiscent of crushed rocks. He suggested visiting a Albaneve Summits quarry. Reach the Albaneve Summits quarry to look for a gray color palette!
cn: 理发师希望你去寻找一种能够让人想起碎石的调色板。他建议你去拜访一座阿尔班耶夫山脉采石场。 前往阿尔班耶夫山脉采石场寻找灰色调色板！

en: A Green That Represents Life And Renewal
Adjust the quality of shadows. A lower value improves performance.
cn: 调整阴影品质。降低此数值以提升性能。

en: You've found the piece of a beautiful mosaic! There might be more pieces around. Search in Everfrore Keep for more mosaic pieces to recreate the original image! There are 8 pieces in total. They can be reassembled in your base when placed in a frame.
cn: 你找到了一份精美的马赛克艺术的碎片！你应该能够找到其他部分。在永霜堡寻找更多的马赛克碎片并设法拼凑出完整的艺术品！ 马赛克艺术品被分成了8块碎片。将碎片放置在基地中的框架内以拼凑出完整的艺术品。
游牧高地 瘴气巢穴

en: I will keep this <keyitem>Kettle</keyitem> safe, and <lorename>Raúl</lorename>'s memory with it. Thank you, Flameborn.
cn: 我会好好保管这个<keyitem>烧水壶</keyitem>，还有<lorename>劳尔</lorename>的回忆。谢谢你，火之子。

en: Me was dozin' and snoozin', 'tis true, but me's senses 're sharp! Me can keep watch with eyes closed, no problem! Me was mindin' me's dream business when bad air and bad lads came creepy-crawling! So me shook Mathew awake, and we barrelled on out! While rushin' and dashin', we dropped the lassie's gift 'n note! Now me thinks: How can we make the moneys, if we don't have the goods? Me tired. Head hurty. Mathew said, "Time to improvise." Smart man. Good head, very good. "We'll write our own letter. Nice lookin' paper! Pristine! He won't know, ya see?" So we was draftin' and writin' and droolin' on that letter, but there came a catch: Gotta sign on the dotted line, but me don't remember lassie's name. Rachel? Reagan? Now head hurty again. And sleepy. Stupid letter, stupid Isles...
cn: 我之前确实打瞌睡了，但是我的观察力都很敏锐的！闭着眼睛也能守夜，完全没问题！ 本来我睡得好好的，突然有一股子臭气熏天的风还有一群坏东西偷偷摸过来了！吓得我直接把马修给摇醒了，然后我们就撒丫子跑了！ 当时我们一路跌跌撞撞，一不小心把原本要给那小姑娘的礼物还有信都弄丢了！现在我在想：如果要送的东西丢了，我们还怎么挣钱？我想了又想，只想的脑瓜子嗡嗡的。 马修说“那就随机应变咯”。那家伙真的聪明。脑袋好，好得很。“我们自己写信。找张好看的纸！崭新的！他又不会知道的，是不是？” 让我们就开始开动脑筋写起了信，但有一个问题：最后落款那里得写收件人的名字。可我不记得那姑娘叫什么了，瑞秋？里根？ 想得我脑袋又嗡嗡的，想睡觉。都怪这破信还有这岛屿……

en: FSR3 is an advanced antialiasing technique. Reducing the quality will increase performance.
cn: FSR3 是一种先进的抗锯齿技术。降低品质可提高性能。

en: You are soaking wet for a short duration.
cn: 你暂时处于彻底湿透的状态。

en: I really could help ya fix up this place if I had a room for m'self. Build me some shelter, will ya? Shouldn't be too much for a true Flameborn!
cn: 如果有单独的房间，我就能安心帮助你修补这个地方了。拜托给我造个庇护所吧。这种事对于火之子来说肯定不成问题！

en: A set of crystal eyes adorns this weapon, seeking the weak points of your foes. The handle has been decorated with overlapping leather straps.
cn: 这把武器上面镶嵌有一对水晶之眼，在时刻寻找你的对手们的弱点。握把处使用了多层皮带进行装饰。

en: A magical staff, brimming with the power of its former owner. Legend has it that the elder's soul is linked to it, sometimes humming at night. Staffs can cast spells by using spell charges and mana. Equip spell charges to cast.
cn: 上一任主人的力量依旧在法杖中奔涌。传说此杖与长老之魂连接，有时候会在夜晚发出嗡鸣声。 法杖能够通过消耗法术充能与法力施放法术。装备法术充能以施放法术。

en:
<location><lorename>Lupa</lorename>'s Lair</location> contained a valuable <craftingstation>Tanning Station</craftingstation>. The <npc>Hunter</npc> should be happy to learn about it. 

Place the <craftingstation>Tanning Station</craftingstation> to unlock more recipes.
cn:
<location><lorename>卢帕</lorename>之巢</location>里面有一个宝贵的<craftingstation>制皮台</craftingstation>。<npc>猎人</npc>知道这个消息应该会很高兴。

放置<craftingstation>制皮台</craftingstation>以解锁更多配方。

en: Still here? Lay it on me.

Very few people witnessed the sharp, crystalline breath escaping <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename> from under the helmet firsthand. They saw his howl dance in the haze and felt it shiver down their skin, creep into their mind, and twist around their bones. Many did not live to tell the tale.
cn: 很少有人亲眼看到过从<lorename>沃格斯</lorename>的头盔中向外喷吐的冷冽寒气。据说他的嚎叫声就在迷雾之中徘徊不去，那直入骨髓的尖嚎让人不寒而栗。只有寥寥无几的幸存者能够回来讲述这种遭遇。

en: Skillshot Striking enemy weak points, such as heads or exposed hearts, is considered a Skillshot.
cn: 爆头射击 打击敌人的弱点，例如头部或者是暴露在外的心脏都会被视为爆头射击。

en: To complement the sunrise, the barber wants a flower that resembles the sunset. Bring him pink Passionflowers from Veilwater Basin, which can be found at night.
cn: 作为对日出之色的补充，理发师想要一种代表日落的花朵。 将只能在夜晚的幕水盆地找到的粉色西番莲带给他。

en: Long ago, a wanderer brought an enthralling gift to the people of Embervale.
cn: 很久以前，一位流浪者给薪谷的人们带来了一份令人沉迷的礼物。

en: 1.5 For the purposes of these Adventure Sharing Terms, the following definitions apply: - "User Content" means all content that you upload or make available in Adventure Sharing, in particular worlds, i.e., game environments that you have individually created and designed in Enshrouded by building, terraforming, and placing objects and decorations, titles, descriptions, screenshots, and player-owned in-game text. - "Uploader" means a user, as a natural person, who uploads and makes User Content available in Adventure Sharing. - "Platform ID" means the unique user ID of the respective Platform, in particular, the Steam ID through which the Uploader accesses Enshrouded. - "Visiting" means the mode in which you can enter a world and interact with it without any changes being saved. Experience points earned, items picked up, or achievements unlocked are not saved to your profile.
cn:
1.5	
在本冒险分享条款中，下列定义适用：
-	“用户内容”指您在冒险分享中上传或提供的所有内容，特别是世界（即您在 Enshrouded 中通过建造、地形改造以及放置物品和装饰物等方式独立创建并设计的游戏环境）、标题、描述、截图以及玩家拥有的游戏内文本。
-	“上传者”指以自然人身份在冒险分享功能中上传及提供用户内容的用户。
-	“平台 ID”指用户在相关平台上的唯一用户 ID，特别是上传者访问 Enshrouded 所使用的 Steam ID。
-	“访问”指您进入某个世界并与之互动，但不保存任何更改的模式。获得的经验值、拾取的物品或解锁的成就会保存到您的玩家档案中。

en: These heavy boots provide excellent resistance and enable a stronger stance when facing various behemoths.
cn: 这些重型靴子能够提供绝佳的抗性，并且允许你使用更稳健的姿态去对抗各类巨兽。
休息增益的额外持续时间

en: The Blacksmith mentioned a way to mine gold underwater, but only the proper tools can facilitate this. He noted that many gold shipments sent to the Capital used to come from a town called Orville. Reach this town and have a look around!
cn: 铁匠提到说有办法能够在水下开采黄金，但是为此你们需要合适的工具。 他提到说以前首都曾经接收过许多来自一座叫做奥威尔的城镇送来的黄金。 抵达铁匠提到的城镇并调查那里！

en:
Whoever owns this trophy has shown that even the strongest Vukah Brawler is no competition to them.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Gold Trophy.
cn:
拥有这件战利品就已经证明，哪怕是最强大的沃卡斗士也无法与你相提并论。

收集多个沃卡斗士头颅以制作黄金战利品。

en: I'll make a musician out of you yet!
cn: 我一定会让你成为一名音乐家的！

en: A cluster of dark crystals, growing together. They reach into different directions like the finger bones of the undead, clawing themselves out of their graves.
cn: 一簇生长在一起的黑暗水晶。朝四面八方延伸的晶体就像是一根根不死亡灵的指骨一般，不顾一切地想要逃出坟墓的包围。

en: The Hunter told you about a town that used to be overrun by stray dogs. Perhaps some dogs are still there. Craft dog food bait to tame and rescue a dog!
cn: 猎人跟你提到了一座被流浪狗毁灭的小镇。也许那里仍然能够找到野狗。 制作狗粮诱饵，驯服并救援一条狗！

en: A formidable chest piece, decorated with many elements resembling nature, vines, and petals.
cn: 这是一件威风凛凛的胸甲，装饰有许多类似自然、藤蔓和花瓣的元素。

en: Mined from the deadly waste found in the Hollow Halls. Caution is advised!
cn: 从空荡礼堂中的致命残骸中开采而来。千万要小心处理！

en: The Elixir takes its toll. Your Time in the Shroud is reduced.
cn: 你感受到了魔药的代价。你的瘴气停留时间已经缩短。

en: You need to agree to the Terms of Use.

A dance of cerulean and powder blue.

This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.
cn:
天青色与浅蓝色的奇妙舞蹈。

可以使用喧嚣森林材料制作这种调色板。

en: Carved with a stone visage, this axe is as much relic as weapon.
cn: 表面刻有一个石制面容，与其说是武器，这把斧子更像是一个遗物。

en: Ah, perfect! The Daylilies and Passionflowers together… such a feast of color! Now, let me transform your hair into a sunrise-and-sunset masterpiece!
cn: 啊，完美！日光百合与西番莲一起……真是色彩的盛宴！现在让我将你的头发变成象征日落与日出的大师之作吧！

en: A near unlimited source of water.

cn: 中型空荡之夜南瓜 II
刘安有关无尽之海的内容

en:
The following letter was sent to the <npc>Blacksmith</npc>: 
Dear Oswald, you're special to me in ways I can't even describe. Tall! Strong! A <npc>Blacksmith</npc>! What else could you want? I miss you and think of you daily. So what if we're oceans apart? My heart belongs to you only, you see, no matter the distance. The struggle of putting my feelings for you on paper keeps me awake under star-fired nights. 

Reagan
cn:
以下是寄给<npc>铁匠</npc>的信件内容：
亲爱的奥斯瓦尔德，你在我的心中永远占据着无法言喻的特殊地位。高大而且强壮！能够拥有一位像你这样的<npc>铁匠</npc>实在是我三生有幸！我想你了，我日日夜夜无时不刻想着你。就算我们相隔再远也无所谓，无论你在何方，我的心永远只属于你。对你的想念让我夜不能寐，于是我决定努力在借着明亮的星光写下了这封信。

里根

en: Old fishing nets span across fabric, still carrying their spoils: Starfish, seashells, and strings of pearls are displayed proudly as accessories. Were they gifts from the mermaids and their folk, or simply lucky finds? It's hard to tell.
cn: 横跨在布料上的旧渔网仍然携带着过去的战利品：海星、贝壳还有一串串的珍珠都被作为饰品骄傲地展示着。这些东西都是来自人鱼和它们的子民的礼物，还是说单纯只是幸运的发现？恐怕真相难以分辨。

en: Have ya heard of Pikemead's Wisps? They're dancing lights in the sea. "Good omens", but merely a trick of the light, I thought. Until my daughter saw 'em. This strange glimmer in the water. Moving. Prowling. Now I see the same glow whilst I slumber, from within the castle. It haunts me. 'Tis no trick. It lives. Are you prepared to change that, kid?
cn: 你听说过派克米德的精灵吗？它们是在海里跳舞的光，我原以为这是某种“好兆头”，不过是光的把戏罢了。直到我女儿看到了它们。水中闪烁着奇异的光芒，移动、游弋着。现在，我在睡梦中也看到了同样的光芒，来自城堡内部。它困扰着我。它绝非什么光的把戏，而是活的生物。你准备好改变这一切了吗，孩子？

en: You're bright-eyed and naive, flamebearer, even in the face of encroaching darkness. You wish to save the realm — or perhaps, to preserve whatever beauty is left in it: The butterfly resting on an unmarked grave, the tattered leatherbound tome written in a forgotten language? Memories of the past, frozen in time... Well, your hope is my feast. From a fellow shepherd of souls, hear this: The abyss claws at our sepultures and swallows our fallen, leaving only a void. You cannot quench its thirst, but you can cut off its tendrils.
cn: 持有火焰之人，哪怕在行将笼罩一切的黑暗面前，你的眼睛中仍然闪耀着纯洁的光芒。你想要拯救这个国度，或者是守护这里仅剩的美丽：蝴蝶停留在无名的荒坟之上，残缺皮革包裹的典籍上写满了陌生的语言？来自过去的回忆，永远冻结在时间里……无论如何，你的希望就是我的盛宴。聆听灵魂牧者的话：深渊的魔爪伸向我们的坟冢并吞噬逝去的同胞，而留下的只有一片虚空。虽然无法满足它的饥渴，但你能够直接斩断它的触须。

en: This protective juice of trees has many functions. First and foremost, serving the cause of the trees!
cn: 树木分泌出来的这种汁液除了保护植物之外还有着多种多样的用途。

en: The Farmer, Emily Fray, wants you to conquer the Ancient Spire in the Revelwood. Reach the top of the Ancient Spire to unlock a Fast Travel point in the new region and new points of interest on your map.
cn: 农民，艾米丽·弗莱，希望您征服喧嚣森林中的远古尖塔。 到达远古尖塔的顶端可解锁新区域的快速移动点和地图上的新兴趣点。

en: This golden urn has multiple sigils inscribed on it. Their meaning far exceeds modern understanding, but scholars would presume these to be magical wards.
cn: 表面刻有大量符印的金瓮。这些符号的涵义早已失传，但学者们认为它们很有可能是某种魔法结界。

en: Have you gathered the flowers yet?

A crystalline frame lines the edges of these short blades. They shift incoming light and reflect it, bathing the daggers in the color of fresh mountain springs. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 这些短剑的边缘镶嵌着一圈结晶。匕首能够折射射来的光芒并展现出类似山泉一样的纯粹色彩。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Increases the skill level of Absorb
I want to dance under the fiery sun until my feet are blistered! Or at least, if I can't do that, I'd like to look at a color palette that reminds me of that!
cn: 这让我想要在烈日下舞蹈，直到双脚被磨起水泡才停歇！如果不能那么做的话，至少也让我看一眼能够让人想起那一切的调色板！
春日平原 瘴气巢穴
北极星瀑布独眼巨人洞穴

en: No mage armor set is complete without a large, brimmed hat.
cn: 没有大檐帽的法师护甲套装是不完整的。

en: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by four rows.
cn: 扩充背包，使物品栏空间扩展四排。

en: Our objective is in sight, but it may be for naught — Pikemead's Reach is nothing but a burnt-out pyre, still choking the horizon in blue smoke. If it's foolish to assume we'll find refugees there, then damn it all — a fool I'll be! If just one poor sod still hides out in the sewers, afraid to emerge... if one woman, one child continues to cower inside a locked tower... if any peasants have gathered to rebuild, reshape the heart of their land, their kingdom... we find them and gather them. We will forge onward and see what awaits us at the Pike. — Commander Cyrus, 508 D.A.
cn: 我们的目标近在咫尺，但也许我们的努力都是白费，派克米德之地如今已经沦为焦黑的残垣断壁，地平线上全是那里飘出的蓝烟。 也许试图在那里寻找难民是一种愚蠢之举，但无所谓，我愿意当那个傻瓜！哪怕只有一个瑟瑟发抖的可怜人正躲在下水道中……哪怕只是躲在被锁上的高塔里的孤儿寡母……只要还有农民能够被召集起来，重建并重塑自己的土地和王国的心脏……我们也要找到他们并将大家团结起来。 我们将亲手开拓前进的道路，并见证在崇山城等待着我们的未来。 — 指挥官赛鲁斯，508 D.A.

en:
We would pretend to read them as children... But now, the obelisks hide their truths.

I was a fool to think I could find salvation here. No one hears my prayers, and I feel so tired. I wish you were by my side, brother. 

Eternity beckons...

Forgive me.
— Vettel
cn:
小时候我们会幻想这些东西的真正含义……但是现在，我知道黑曜石将永远隐藏自己的真相……

我真是个傻瓜，竟然天真地以为能够在这里找到救赎。可是我的祈祷没有得到任何回应，我真的好累。真希望这时候有你在我身边，我的兄弟。

永恒正在呼唤我……

请原谅我。
—维特尔

en: The blessing of the Flame boosts your primary attributes by %k each.
cn: 灵火的祝福可将您的主要属性各提升%k。

en: The resident pearl divers of Orville tried to escape the invading Drak'Dal by swimming towards the shore opposite the bay. It was mentioned that, to remain hidden, the divers wouldn't be able to come up for air. They planned to hide in a collection of shipwrecks until the coast was clear to surface. Swim to the shipwrecks near Orville and search for the Mining Sieve there!
cn: 似乎镇上的潜水采珠人奥威尔试图通过游向海湾对岸来躲避入侵的卓克·达尔。为了避免被发现，潜水员们将无法在过程中上浮呼吸。他们打算躲藏在一系列船只残骸中等待危险平息。 游至奥威尔附近的船只残骸并在那里寻找矿筛！

en: A devious machine of destruction, spouting red hot flames upon command.
cn: 用心险恶的机械装置，能够喷吐赤红的烈焰。

en: The Carpenter left building blocks in Diadwyn. Find the location and pick up the blocks to obtain a new building material!
cn: 木匠在狄亚德温留下了建筑方块。前往那里并拿走方块以获取全新的建造材料！

en: Even during times of Shroud and war, there is light. A flicker. A spark of hope. A group of Ancients spoke to me... younglings, smaller in statue — kinder. Empathetic, rueful... Or perhaps remorseful. For the first time, in an age of outcries, they hushed. They plan to build "Cinder Vaults", and vessels that will guide an Ancient Flame into a human shell. Body and mind, Flame and flesh... a mortal soul born from fire, able to banish the fog. Hopefully, we can bring forward a new age this way. — Balthazar, 506 D.A.
cn: 就算在瘴气与战争中，光明依旧存在。尽管微弱摇曳，但毋庸置疑是希望的火苗。 之前有一群远古者找到了我……这些体型更小的年轻人显得更加友善、富有同情心以及……懊恼与悔恨。 在经过了不知道多久的呐喊质问过后，他们终于向我低语了。他们准备打造“余烬密室”以及一系列将能够引导远古者的灵火与人类的身体结合的装置。身体与心灵，火焰与肉体……从火焰中诞生的凡人之魂将能够驱散迷雾。 希望这能够带我们走向崭新的时代。 — 巴尔萨扎，506 D.A.

en:
You’ve found a part of the cosmetic Scholar of the Young Flame outfit in a Kindlewastes Night Sanctum. 

Perhaps the other parts are also strewn across other Night Sanctums in the region. 

Search the Night Sanctums in the Kindlewastes to retrieve all pieces of the Scholar outfit!
cn:
你在一座燃火荒原黑夜圣所中发现了“星火学者”外观装饰套装的其中一个部位。

也许在该地区中的其他黑夜圣所中能够找到剩下的套装部位。

寻找燃火荒原中的黑夜圣所并找齐完整的苍穹学者套装！

en: This staff was made from the roots of an age-old tree. Wisdom and calm flow through it. Staffs can cast spells by using spell charges and mana. Equip spell charges to cast.
cn: 使用一颗古树根须制作而成的法杖。能够感受到里面蕴含着的智慧与宁静。 法杖能够通过消耗法术充能与法力施放法术。装备法术充能以施放法术。

en: The Carpenter needs shelter for woodworking. Build a home for the Carpenter and grant him access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already! To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed. This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.
cn: 木匠需要庇护所才能开始木工制作。为木匠建造一个家，并且确保他的周围有能够使用的受到庇护的床！ 若要为幸存者提供庇护所，首先请制作合适的床。将床放置在幸存者能够方便使用，且拥有良好保护的区域内。放置后，床将自动分配给附近没有床铺的幸存者。如果想要重新分配床，装备召唤法杖然后使用它瞄准床铺。 如果幸存者缺乏庇护，此任务将重新开启。

en: When you are hit in melee combat, you have a 10% chance of ignoring the damage and losing 30 Stamina instead.
cn: 受到近战命中时有10%几率无视伤害并转而损失30点体力。

en: The creator did not add a description.

A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This piece shows the Drak arriving on Embervale. They spy Ancients buildings on the horizon, and are drawn to explore them.
cn:
详细记载着卓克的历史的浮雕。

这一块展示着卓克抵达薪谷的场景。他们看见了地平线外的远古者建筑，并且决定前去探索。

en: Opens doors in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls.
cn: 能够打开游牧高地空荡礼堂的大门。
迷失之人 - 木工助手

en: Bait that increases the chance of catching epic fish.
cn: 鱼饵，能够提高捕获史诗鱼的概率。

en: Good work! Here’s the plan: we’ll hook them onto a fishing line and try catching some fish. Fireflies may not be the tastiest bait, but I trust it will work. I learned how to craft a basic fishing rod back in the day, and I can show you too. Come back to me when you’re ready to fish.
cn: 干得好！我的计划是这样：我们要将这些小虫子挂在鱼线上，然后想办法用它们来引鱼儿上钩。萤火虫也许不算是最美味的鱼饵，但我相信这招一定能够起作用。以前我曾学习过如何制作基础的鱼竿，我可以把具体方法教给你。等你准备好钓鱼的时候就来找我吧。

en: A big burning pile that's both cozy and archaic.
cn: 古朴而且惬意的巨大火堆。

en: The wanderer arrived on the 49th Day of Midyear, 492 D.A., as promised — a gust of freezing winds trailing him. As he entered my throne room, an unsettling mist lingered where he stepped. His face was cloaked to hide a ghastly sickness... a kind I had never laid eyes on before. His flesh was pale and tinged blue; his face lacking symmetry as if he had suffered a stroke in years past - or as if he had been assembled, not born. Such a pitiful being. Thin hands held out a bright blue flask, shimmering in the candlelight. A weapon, he called it. A secret... hidden from us by the Ancients. He needed not say more. I had long been aware that the tricksters only reveal what they please. I grasped the flask and I gulped down the mystery inside. Dust motes began to swirl at the edges of my vision. Mist rose around me, enveloping each breath I took... crept inside me, breached my heart, my skull, and settled behind my eyes. It was pulling. Pulling upwards, towards my eyelids, fluttering, til my feet left the palace carpet. Levitation. I floated above the ruins, above the vermin, the cowards, the liars. Once I reunited with the familiar ground below, the wanderer flashed a smile. He had given me both means and reason to strike. My hands shake, still... but I must grip my blade firmly. — Lord Vorgoth, Guard of the North, Ruler of Rimgard
cn: 岁中第49日，492 D.A.，旅人如约而至，一股刺骨寒风在他身后如影随形。当他踏入我的王座室之后，我看见他走过的地方都留下了一片令人不安的雾气。 覆盖他面孔的斗篷遮住了一种可怕的疫病……我从来没有见过像那样的病症。他的身体苍白泛蓝，他的面孔歪七扭八，就像是多年前曾经历过中风一样……或者说那副面孔像是被人为拼凑起来的，而不是自然生长的。这副模样实在是令人觉得可怜。 他瘦弱的双手递上了一个亮蓝色的瓶子，瓶身在烛火下闪闪发光。旅人宣称这是一种武器。他说这是一个秘密……一个被远古者故意藏起来的秘密。 这下一切都明了了，一直以来我都知道，那些骗子从未将所有真相告诉我们。 我立刻拿过小瓶并一口吞下了里面的神秘物质。我的眼角立刻涌起了尘埃的漩涡。我周围浮起了迷雾，我的每一次呼吸都被迷雾裹挟……它们流进了我的身体里，钻进了我的心脏与头骨中，最后在我的双眼后扎下了根。那股力量向上拖拽着，直顶我的眼皮，迷雾不断摇曳，直到最后我的双脚离开了宫殿的地毯。 我飘起来了。我漂浮在废墟之上，漂浮在那些害虫、懦夫还有骗子之上。 当我终于回到下方的地面，旅人露出了一个微笑。他已经给了我出击的手段与理由。 我的双手颤抖不已，但是……我必须牢牢握住手中的剑。 — 沃格斯领主，北境守卫，里姆加德的统治者

en: The byproducts of felling a tree. Just be careful that it doesn't fall on your head!
cn: 砍伐树木后的副产品。砍树的时候千万小心朝向！

en: Health, Mana, and Stamina Orbs restore 30% instead of 10% of their respective resource. Health and Mana Potions restore 20% more resources.
cn: 生命值、法力和体力恢复球将恢复30%而不是10%。 法力和生命药水额外恢复20%。

en:
The trader Mei-Yin Chen would love to offer you some wares to celebrate the lunar new year, but most of her cargo was stolen by bandits. She knows the direction in which they took her special weaponry. 

Follow the bandits' footsteps and retrieve the wares!
cn:
商人陈梅茵想要给你提供一些用来庆祝农历新年的货物，但是她的绝大部分财产都已经被强盗们偷走了。她仍然清楚地记得拿走她的特制武器的强盗们离开时的方向。

跟随强盗们的足迹并拿回失窃的货物！

en: You emit a protective aura that increases Physical and Magical Resistances by %k for you and all allies within %k meters.
cn: 释放一道保护性光环，使自己与%k米范围内的所有友军的物理与魔法抗性提高%k。

en: I advise you to prioritize cleansing your curse.
Scales all health of bosses by this value.
cn: 根据该数值调整所有Boss的生命值。

en: An adorable Capybara. It's entirely unbothered while in your arms. The bristles can be used in crafting.
cn: 一只可爱的水豚。就算被你拿起来它看上去也毫不在意。它们的鬃毛能够用于制作。

en: HEUREKA! I, Paulette Leclair, am flesh and bone once more! Moments ago, I was a simple spec of dust, floating aimlessly and wrapped in darkness! Strangled by a faulty thesis, lost in the afterlife... but somehow, your magic pulled me back! You don't want to help me with my next self-experiment, do you?
cn: 啊哈！我波莱特·雷克莱尔又活过来了！片刻之前，我还只是在无边无际的黑暗之中飘荡的一缕尘埃！被虚假的论题所扼杀，在死后的世界中永远迷失……但是你不知怎么的竟然把我拉了回来！不知道你有没有兴趣帮助我进行新一批的自我验证？

en: Just once, I wanna sit around and take a hearty bite of my sandwich without the mountain ominously roaring in the background. The ground shook so badly that I even dropped my food. I mean, excuse me? I'm trying to eat here? Do you really have to huff and puff all the time? I thought this place would be far enough away from the winged beast, but somehow it still finds a way to bother me. The worst thing is that I dropped my sandwich on the overseer's head. Now I'm on bath scrubbing duty for the next two months. And my sandwich is gone. This is the worst.
cn: 真希望我能找一个舒服的地方坐下来享受我的三明治，我已经受够了永远在远方咆哮的那些可怕山峰。每次发出巨响的时候，地面都会剧烈摇晃，搞得吃的东西都被甩地上去了。 拜托？我就只是想安安静静吃个饭？有必要整天这么鬼哭神嚎么？ 我原本以为这个地方已经离那头长翅膀的怪物很远了，但没想到那家伙还在打扰我的清静。 最糟糕的是，我掉下来的三明治正好砸在了监督的头上。现在好了，连续两个月的厕所清理任务。而且我的三明治也吃不了了。真是糟糕透顶。

en: A hood fashioned from the scalp of a white wolf. The fangs at the front are still attached.
cn: 使用白狼头皮制作而成的兜帽。兜帽的前部还保留着没拔掉的狼牙。

en: A local delicacy with a creamy texture and rich taste. It fills the belly and heals the soul, especially when the north winds are howling outside.
cn: 这种本地美食拥有着绵密的质感与浓郁的滋味。不光能够填饱肚子还能治愈心灵，尤其是在门外北风呼啸的时候。
滑翔翼的体力消耗降低%k

en:
The Lakehopper is an agile fish that you might see "hopping" across the surface of a shallow lake — if you're lucky.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
跃湖者是一种十分灵活的鱼类，如果幸运的话，你能够看见它们直接“跳过”浅湖的水面。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。
追溯阿萨兰·斯克里的足迹

en: Our base could become even livelier! Why not tame some Yaks?
cn: 我觉得我们的基地缺乏活力！也许可以试着驯服一些牦牛？

en:
With the Drak'Dal present, I don't think it is right to place any Cinder Vessels down. Its inhabitants may not be saved but imprisoned by a metal cocoon. They could be pried open too easily, falling prey to these beasts... and their Ancient encasing won't save them then.

Therefore, we're setting our sights on the horizon, as planned. I hope to find a ship in Stillwater Bay to charter... perhaps then, we'll see how far the rot has spread and will trace its path on a map.

I wonder if it's right... not to turn around, not to ride towards the flying islands where the Elder Ancients linger... not to defend them despite their rigidity, not to bring my brother to his knees before he barges through their gates. But with what army? With what might?

We ought to live. For the future, and for everyone who depends on us. On me. For you, Emily.
When I come back, I will weave daylilies into your hair and serenade you with my lyre until my voice grows hoarse. One day. I promise.

— Queen Jezmina of Orindell
cn:
考虑到卓克·达尔的存在，我觉得并不适合在这里放置任何余烬笼。进入其中的居民有可能无法获救，反正只是被囚禁在由金属构成的茧之中。这些装置都能够被轻松撬开，那样的话里面的人将成为这些野兽的猎物……到时候就算是有远古者制造的外壳也无济于事。

因此我们决定按照计划将目光放在地平线外。我希望能够在静水湾找到一艘能够征用的船只……也许到那时候，我们就可以清楚地了解腐化的散播情况，并在地图上勾勒出它的轨迹。

我不知道这么做是不是正确的……我们没有选择回头，也没有选择前往远古者长老们所在的飞天群岛……我们并没有去保护那些老顽固，也没有在我的兄弟冲进他们的城门之前劝他悬崖勒马。但是我们哪里来的军队？又有什么能力去那么做？

我们要做的就是活下去，为了未来，为了所有依靠我们，指望着我的人们。这也是为了你，艾米丽。
等我回来之后，我将给你的头发编上日光百合，我还会弹奏着里尔琴的旋律为你歌唱，直到我的嗓音彻底沙哑。总有一天，我发誓。

 — 奥林戴尔的杰兹米娜女王

en: A sophisticated crown that frames the wearer's head with a golden halo and amethyst sparks. It represents the dawning sun, bathing the mountainsides in a long-awaited morning glow.
cn: 做工精美的头冠将给佩戴者的头部增添一抹金色的光环与紫水晶的闪耀。这顶头冠代表着新生的太阳，在漫长的等待过后，清晨的荣光将再次照耀山间。

en: You've found one piece of the cosmetic Winterly armor set. All pieces are scattered throughout a town called Polaris Falls. Search the area for hidden chests to find the other pieces of the cosmetic armor set!
cn: 你找到了凛冬护甲外观套装的其中一个部件。套装的部件全部散落在一个被称为北极星瀑布的城镇中。寻找区域中的隐藏宝箱并获取完整的护甲外观套装！

en: Begrudgingly, I Joined My Family's Reunion
cn: 我不情愿地参加了家庭聚会

en: A machine that's used to roast coffee beans. Necessary to make coffee.
cn: 用于烘焙咖啡豆的机器。制作咖啡的必需设备之一。

en: You've found my Half-Timbered Blocks, huh? Keep 'em in case you wanna make something masterful with them... A new home, built to last!
cn: 你找到了我的半木结构方块？归你了，说不定你可以用它们造点结实的东西……比如说一个屹立不倒的新家园！

en: Rah! Hunt over, many spoils! Had Capybara snack. Bristles too tough. No like mouth feel. Chief Gna'Rash gets to eat supple, tiny one. Bristles soft. Fits well in mouth, one gulp. Squeaks when touched. Likes pets. But no time for pets! Time for feast! I challenge Gna'Rash: Eat squeaky baby whole. Maybe it makes Gna'Rash heavy and slow. Then Gruul can fight Gna'Rash! Become new chieftain! New elite! Later, become Hydrak! Eat all the squeaky babies myself! Claim better mouth feel! Rah Rah!
cn: 拉！狩猎结束，很多战利品！ 吃了水豚零食。鬃毛太坚硬。口感不好。 格纳·拉许酋长才能吃柔软的幼崽。鬃毛软。一口一个。碰一下还会叫。像宠物。但是没时间养宠物！要吃大餐！ 我挑战格纳·拉许：吃掉吱吱叫的幼崽。也许它让格纳·拉许变得又沉又慢。然后格鲁尔就能打格纳·拉许！成为新的酋长！新的精英！之后甚至成为海卓克！到时候我就可以吃掉所有吱吱叫的幼崽！我要更好的口感！ 拉·拉！

en: Increases the skill level of Mana Currents
cn: 提高魔法涌流的技能等级

en: I wish I had a comfortable bed to sleep in! Would you be so kind to build one for me? You can use the Summoning Staff to tell me which bed I can sleep in.
cn: 真希望能够有一张舒服的床用来睡觉！能不能麻烦你帮我做一张床？你可以使用召唤法杖来告诉我哪张床可以睡觉。

en: Reach The Forgotten Tomb In The Albaneve Summits
cn: 抵达阿尔班耶夫山脉中的被遗忘的墓穴

en: I CANNOT BELIEVE they confiscated my mule AND my coin! Now I, esteemed magistrate — former magistrate, they say — have to tread on foot. What a lowly, grimy fate. I should tear their heads off one by one for banishing me. My legs gave out, so I was forced to rest at this cemetery. The Hollow roam outside, but they've failed to notice me. Unless... ...they see me as part of their kin? Oh, I shiver. A relentless cold is setting in... No! It must be the open roof! I am not like them. I won't turn! — Darius Whick
cn: 我不敢相信他们竟然没收了我的驴子和我所有的钱财 — 我堂堂一位执法官……他们口中的前执法官……现在竟然要被迫徒步前行。实在是奇耻大辱。总有一天，我要把那些把我赶出来的家伙统统干掉。 步行实在是过于辛苦，所以我被迫选择在这座墓地中稍事休息。虽然外面有在游荡，但是它们并没有发现我。但这也许是因为…… ……它们已经把我视作一份子了？我的天，一想到这个念头我就忍不住地颤抖。我感到背脊发凉……不可能！肯定是屋顶上的大洞让冷风灌进来了！我跟它们不一样，我绝对不会转变！ — 大流士·维克

en:
Energy, welling from deep inside the core. A light erupts, breaching the boundaries of space itself. 

A door to be opened by the flame touched — the brightest of sparks will walk a path lined by fire, and illuminate what is shrouded in shadow. 

Never let the stars be extinguished, never douse the sun. Rise above all, a legacy to last an eternity.
cn:
核心深处的能量正在不断攀升。一道光芒划破天际，撕裂了空间本身的界限。

被灵火触摸过的人将打开一扇大门，那些最明亮的余火将走在火焰铺就的道路上，照亮一切被阴影笼罩的存在。

永远不要让繁星熄灭，永远不要让太阳黯淡。崛起吧，那将是持续永恒的遗产。
搜索炼金术士的地下室

en:
Legends say that this weapon was once wielded by a hero who was mangled in battle. He sought a freezing cave to rest and tend to his wounds, leaving a trail of blood in the snow. 
Once he emerged after a hundred-year slumber, a swarm of ice bats soared into the night sky, signaling his return.
cn:
传说这把武器曾经的主人是一位在战场上身受重伤的英雄。离开战场后，他最终找到了一处冰冻的洞穴来疗伤，他走过的雪地上则留下来一条鲜红的踪迹。
经过一百年的沉睡之后，他再次走出了洞穴，一大群寒冰蝙蝠立刻呼啸着冲向夜空并宣告着他的归来。

en: Comfortable and modest shoes for lounging in a library.
cn: 适合在图书馆休憩时穿着，舒适低调。

en: You got an invite. Do you want to join?
cn: 你收到了邀请。你想加入吗？

en: Make Or Obtain Yak Food Bait
cn: 制作或获取牦牛食物诱饵

en: A sharp copper axe which is highly efficient at cutting wood. It can also be used to cut down enemies.
cn: 十分适合用于伐木的锐利铜斧，同时也能够用于劈砍敌人。

en: Increases your maximum Health by %k times your Intelligence attribute.
cn: 提高你的最大生命值，具体提升量等同于你的智力属性的%k倍。

en: A basic setup for preparing meals.
cn: 用于烹饪食物的基础设备。

en:
Do you want to salvage this item stack?
It cannot be recovered!
cn:
确定要拆解这些物品？
此操作不可逆！

en: Weapons, tools, and torches lose durability over time. Repair your weapons and tools at a workbench to replenish their durability and prevent them from breaking.
cn: 武器、工具以及火炬都会逐渐损失耐久。在工作台修理你的武器与工具以恢复耐久并避免损坏。

en: Open the submenu to select from different survivor categories.
cn: 打开子菜单，选择不同的幸存者类别。

en:
Create a magical barrier that protects from projectiles and reduces melee damage taken.

The shield fades when its Health or Lifetime is depleted.
cn:
创造一道魔法屏障，能够抵挡投射物并减少受到的近战伤害。

护盾生命值耗尽或时间截止后，护盾将消失。

en: You found all rare instruments? What are we waiting for, then? I'm on the lute, you take percussion — My vocal cords need rest, so maybe Athalan can sing! ...No? We'll, just a melody will do, too!
cn: 你找到所有的稀有乐器了吗？那我们还在等什么？鲁特琴给我，你来负责打击乐器……我最近嗓子不太行，得养养，也许可以让阿萨兰来唱歌！……不行吗？没关系，纯音乐也挺不错的！

en: You've found Emily's tavern! Take a look inside and claim any unused building blocks to expand your base-building possibilities!
cn: 你找到了艾米丽的酒馆！探索内部并拿走遗留的建筑方块以扩展你的基地建造选项！

en: Here Lie The Greatest Builders Of The Night Of Horror
cn: “恐怖之夜”的伟大建设者们在此长眠

en: Hits restore a percentage of damage dealt as Mana
cn: 命中时恢复等同于部分伤害量的法力

en:
- You can use roles to grant players in your session different rights. 

- Players joining your server with one of these passwords will have the corresponding role.

- If a role is enabled, but no password is set, everyone can join your session with the rights corresponding to that role.
cn:
- 你可以通过身份设置来为你的进程中玩家提供不同的权限。

 - 使用这些密码加入服务器的玩家将获得对应的身份。

 - 如果你开启了某个身份，但是没有为其设置单独的密码，那么所有加入你的进程的玩家都将拥有该身份对应的权限。

en: A solid roof over my head would really improve my craftwork — and you'd have my gratitude!
cn: 一个合适的房间绝对能够帮助我精进自己的技艺，拜托了！

en: You came back with new colors to dye clothes with! We should play "dress-up"!
cn: 你带来了新的染料！现在我们可以一起来玩“换装游戏”了！

en: It's a new day, a fresh start — and I've been thinking... wouldn't it be nice to celebrate while we can? I once knew this trader who'd come by the Low Meadows, Mei. She had a lot of decorations for the Lunar New Year! Her route was always the same. I wonder what happened to her.
cn: 俗话说新年新气象，我在想……也许我们应该抓住这个机会好好庆祝一下？以前我认识一个叫梅的商人，她经常会来低矮草原。我记得她会准备很多用来庆祝农历新年的装饰品！以前她每次都会去同样的地方卖货。不知道她后来怎么样了。

en: Archaic power vibrates deep within this sword.
cn: 这把剑中涌动着远古的力量。

en: The fragment of a torn treasure map, found on a dragon skeleton in the Albaneve Summits. Perhaps you could reconstruct the map if you found all pieces? There's writing on the back: Ony's' Memoir: I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed
cn: 在阿尔班耶夫山脉的一具巨龙骸骨上找到的藏宝图碎片。如果找齐所有碎片，也许你就可以拼凑出完整的地图。 地图碎片的背面写着字： 奥尼的回忆录： 在高空飞翔的我永远不会坠落 在太阳上翩翩起舞，我的身体就是熊熊烈焰 我的杯中永远满溢，我将痛饮直至淹没 在光芒之水与爱恋之中，直到那一切让我眩晕

en: A potted plant to beautify your home.
cn: 能够美化住宅的盆栽植物。

en: Another day, another screech! I can't finish my calculations when these horrid vultures keep passing by! Why must our lighthouse align so closely to their migration route? If Lord Vorgoth hadn't ordered the quarry to be shut down, surely they would've nested elsewhere... but I'd be wise never to voice that thought out loud. Not if I want to keep my tongue, at least. Even with these winged distractions, my work is almost complete. Soon, we'll be able to light our signal flames and burn our mark into the wintry sky. I call them "Balefires". They'll be a useful warning system when the great beast makes its return, but I am concerned. The passing vultures seem enraged by it... I better finish my project before they return.
cn: 新的一天，新的尖叫！那些可怕的秃鹫总是在附近乱转，这样子我根本没办法安心进行计算！为什么我们的灯塔非得建造在它们的迁徙路线边上？要不是沃格斯领主命令关闭采石场，它们也不会在那里安家……不过这种话还是不要公开说出去了。我还想留着自己的舌头。 虽然总是受到那些天上的捣蛋鬼的干扰，我的工作马上就要完成了。要不了多久，我们就能够点燃信号火焰并在寒冷的天空中留下我们的烙印。我管这些东西叫“篝火”。如果那头巨兽再度归来，篝火将能够起到提前预警的作用，不过我有一点担心。经过的秃鹫们似乎很讨厌篝火……我最好得赶在它们回来之前完成整个项目。

en: Increases your Shock Resistance by %k, which reduces the amount of Shock damage received.
cn: 使你的电击抗性提高%k，这将降低你承受的电击伤害。

en: You'll be the talk of the town!
cn: 相信你肯定会成为所有人眼中的焦点！

en: You were recently hit by a snowball. Ouch!
cn: 你刚刚被雪球击中了。有点疼！

en: Vibrant and deeply disturbing if you allow it to invade your mind.
cn: 颜色鲜亮，但如果放任它侵入你的意识，你将会看见令人不安的景象。

en: Ahh, won't you look at that? You've brought me a cursed-looking crystal, of sorts. Looking at it fills me with envy, even greed. With this, we're one step closer to the green hair dye of our dreams! Now, take that crystal away from me. It makes me nervous.
cn: 啊，这是什么？你给我带来了某种被诅咒的水晶。一看见此物，我的心中就充满了嫉妒乃至是贪婪。有了这件东西，我们就离创造绿色染发剂的梦想更近了一步！好了，快收起那块水晶吧。我快遏制不住心里的嫉妒了。

en:
They’re not even half as big as they used to be — ha! But they’ll do. I can even craft you a proper fishing rod. Won’t be so hard to reel in the big ones with that.
Only thing is… it’ll cost you an arm and a leg — har har, just joking! You’ll get a special offer, my friend.
cn:
这些东西甚至还没有以前的一半大——哈！不过够用了。甚至够给你做一根像样的鱼竿。到时候你应该就可以尝试钓大鱼了。
不过你得为此倾家荡产才行……哈哈，开玩笑的！我会给你特殊优惠的，我的朋友。
通往阿尔班耶夫山脉的道路

en: I tasked you to visit the Hollow Halls, so I fear our new associate is partly my doing. You know I walk a path of light. This individual lingers in the shadows... Shelter for all, of course — but I advise caution. This creature twists the strands of fate and ties them into a chaotic swirl. Such dark energy. I wonder how they've obtained such powers...
cn: 之前是我要求你去拜访空荡礼堂，所以恐怕对于这位新的朋友的出现，我也难咎其辞。我遵循着光明之道。但此人却徘徊于阴影之中……虽然我们理应为所有人提供庇护，但我建议你一定要谨慎。它扭曲了命运的丝线并将其便成为了混乱的旋涡，这里面蕴含着黑暗的能量。我不清楚这种力量到底来自何方……

en: The Huntress wants you to create warm clothes that will shield you from the cold. To create warm clothing, you need yak wool. Tamed yaks will need an enclosure with big farm animal pillows and yak feeders. When their needs are met, they will produce offspring. Tame yaks, meet their needs, and let them produce a baby!
cn: 女猎人希望你去制作一些能够抵御寒冷的温暖衣物。你需要牦牛毛料来制作温暖衣物。 驯服的牦牛将需要一处配有大型农场动物枕头以及牦牛喂食器的围栏。要求得到满足之后，它们就会繁育后代。 驯服牦牛，然后满足它们的需求并见证它们生育一只牦牛宝宝！

en: Interact with the Ancient Obelisk to reveal its knowledge of the land and recollection of the past.
cn: 与古代方尖碑互动，掌握关于这个世界以及其过去的知识。

en: Find The Cosmetic Items In The Revelwood
cn: 在喧嚣森林中寻找饰品

en: When equipped with a Melee weapon, you can perform a special attack by holding %k during a jump. Crash Down deals 50%% more weapon damage in a small blast radius and costs Stamina depending on weapon type used. Cost: 35 - 60 Stamina Block Breaker This special attack fills a blocking enemy's Stun Bar twice as much when hit..
cn: 装备近战武器时，你可以在跳跃期间长按%k发动特殊攻击。 坠落攻击将将对小范围半径内的目标造成额外50%%的武器伤害，并且会根据武器类型消耗体力。 消耗：35 - 60点体力 破防打击 这种特殊攻击将对格挡中的敌人施加两倍的晕眩条增长。。

en: I think <location>Thornhold</location>'s your best bet to find saw blades... to make me that <craftingstation>Table Saw</craftingstation>! Don't worry about how I lost my hand, totally unrelated!
cn: 我觉得<location>荆棘堡</location>是最有可能找到锯片的地方……到时候你就可以帮我做<craftingstation>锯台</craftingstation>了！别担心，我少了只手跟这事没关系！

en: In my final days, I am brought low by the weight my kin has placed on my shoulders. I see now that my wish for unity within our family was foolish. Out of all my 7 children, none came to my deathbed — so I declare that none shall enjoy the fruits of my labor! I wish for my most prized possession, a piece of artwork, to be passed down to my children. However, the piece will be torn apart and divided by 8. The pieces will be shared among my 7 children, thus rendering the priceless artwork useless. Finally, I wish to be buried with the final piece, atop the hill near the low end of the fort. Let the earth embrace me the way my children never would.
cn: 在生命的最后时光里，我感觉到了家庭给我带来的沉重压力。看来我原本希望团结所有家人的梦想只是个无稽之谈。我有7个孩子，但是没有一个人选择赶来见我，行吧，那他们休想享受我这辈子的辛勤成果！ 我有一件无比珍贵的艺术品，我希望将这件东西传给我的孩子们。但是，这件艺术品将被切分为8份。其中的7块碎片将留给我的7个孩子，除非拼凑完整，否则这些碎片本身毫无用处。 最后，我希望与艺术品的最后一块碎片一同下葬，把我们埋在靠近要塞最低点的山丘之上。就让大地代替我的孩子们来永远拥抱我吧。

en:
A feeding device that holds Dune Armadillo food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.
cn:
用于存放沙丘犰狳的饲料的喂食装置。

装满对应的食物后将喂食你的动物。

en:
You've found Queen Jezmina's first encampment in the Veilwater Basin.

Search for her final camp to retrieve the last of her leftover supplies!
cn:
你在幕水盆地找到了杰兹米娜女王的首个营地。

寻找她的最终营地并取回最后的残留补给！

en: Please enter in the following format: [IPv4-Address]:[Query-Port] or [Domain]
You claim the "Wailing Blade"? I forged it for her grasp afore she left me! ...Fine. You may wield it in her place. Pierce the Shroud's heart, Flameborn! It's what my daughter would want.
cn: 你拿到了“恸哭之刃”？！那原本是我为她打造的武器，但是她还没来得及用就……算了，现在你正好可以代她使用这把东西。替我刺穿瘴气的心脏，火之子！为我女儿实现她未了的心愿。

en:
A GPU crash was detected at the end of the last play session. Do you want to enable GPU crash dump collection? It could help the developers of Enshrouded to find the issue.

Please note: it might impact performance slightly. The feature will be disabled automatically when no further crash occurs.
cn:
检测到上次游玩进程结束时发生了GPU崩溃。启用GPU崩溃转储数据收集？这将能够帮助《雾锁王国》的开发者发现问题。

请注意：这么做有可能会略微影响性能表现。如果之后没有发生崩溃，该功能将会自动禁用。

en: Gems are seemingly rare — in our altitude, at least! Their properties are not at all common on the surface. I propose this: The Ancients unearthed these gems on their never-ending dig for knowledge! Why did they abandon the pursuit? Perhaps they were interrupted by a greater mystery, turned calamity: The Shroud?
cn: 这些宝石十分稀有，至少在我们这个“海拔高度”是这样！换句话说，地表上很少能够见到这些不同寻常的物品。所以我有个提议：为了满足永无止境的求知欲，远古者曾经在地下大肆挖掘这些宝石！但他们最后为什么放弃了？这说不定是因为某个更为庞大的谜团与灾难的出现：瘴气？

en: This will remove all simulated water currently within this Flame-protected area.
cn: 这么做将移除当前在这片受灵火保护区域中的所有模拟水体。

en: This impressive coat is regal, lived-in, and vaguely... salty. It makes you feel as though you should be steering a ship to safety amidst a thundering storm!
cn: 这件与众不同的外套尊贵、华丽而且散发着微微的……咸腥味。穿上这个之后，你感觉自己甚至能够操纵着船只安全穿越电闪雷鸣的风暴！

en: A very basic set of garments.

cn: 奥斯瓦尔德·安德斯的箱子

en: A baby Yak, fluffy and warm.
cn: 一只毛茸茸、暖呼呼的牦牛宝宝。

en: A hunter was taken by the Draconian Vulture and killed in their nest, leaving behind his powerful weapon.
cn: 残酷秃鹫掳走了一名猎人并将其带至巢穴中杀死，猎人的强大武器被遗落在了巢穴中。

en: End of Early Access area — turn back now!
cn: 已到达抢先体验版本区域边界，请立刻返回！

en:
A sharp tooth from a large aquatic being, possibly a megalodon variant. It's preserved incredibly well and, surprisingly, might be comparatively recent. The owner must've had quite an appetite to need such gigantic teeth...

This collectible is found in the Nomad Highlands.
cn:
这是一颗来自大型水生生物的锋利牙齿，可能是巨齿鲨的变种。它保存得非常完好，而且令人惊讶的是，它可能是最近才发现的。主人的胃口一定不小，才会需要如此巨大的牙齿......

此收藏品在 游牧高地 中找到。

en: My First Day With The Expansion Program
cn: 参与远征项目的第一天

en: A formidable greatsword, forged with a copper and tin alloy. Its maker took the time to carefully etch harmoniously flowing lines into it, which spill from the ricasso towards the centre of the blade.
cn: 一把不容小觑的大剑，使用铜锡合金锻造而成。制作者花费了大量的心血在剑身上雕刻出了和谐流畅的线条，从刃柄的部位朝着剑身中央延伸而去。

en: A flaming soul in a mortal body, nurtured amongst the ashes of a dying world.
cn: 在垂死世界的灰烬中，灵火之魂将在凡人躯体中涅槃重生。

en: An eternal version of the Ice Bolt I. The spell damages enemies upon impact and slows them afterwards. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 寒冰箭 I的永恒版本。该法术会在命中敌人时对其造成伤害，并使其减速。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en:
I was always proud of my intuition. Could spot those itching for mutiny before they'd ever stepped onto my boat, sensed a storm brewin' from the cry of the gulls miles away.

But this time, just once, could I be wrong?
When I heard the west winds whistle a new tune, did I mistake its sharpness as sinister?
When I reeled in a hundred fish with torn fins, did I misread their injury as a threat?
When I thought I saw the evil doers of old childhood stories leap from the pages into the water, were my eyes betraying me?

Am I spinning a yarn from my own sanity's thread? I ought to warn the others, lest I unravel fully.
Whether they will trust the word of a tale-teller, I cannot say. Some may claim a fisher ought to stick to fishin'...
cn:
我一直都为自己的直觉感到骄傲。有时候人还没上船之前我就能分辨出哪些坏东西会想要途中哗变，或者我可以凭借海鸥的叫声就察觉到远方正在蠢蠢欲动的风暴。

但是这一次，只此一次，难道是我错了？
当我听见西风的口哨声陡然变调，我是否将那种尖锐的声音误认为了是不祥的噩兆？
当我收紧鱼线拿到无数鱼鳍碎裂的鱼饵，我是将这种奇怪的伤势错误当成了威胁吗？
当我以为旧日童话故事中的恶棍们从纸上赫然跃入水中，是我的眼睛欺骗了我吗？

难道那一切都是我自己的错觉？趁着我还没有彻底发狂，我必须赶紧去警告其他人。
至于他们是否愿意相信一个说书人的话，这我无法确定。有些人也许会说，渔夫就应该老实钓鱼，不要多管闲事……

en: With these gloves, all the magic of the world can easily flow into the tips of your fingers to guide your sword arm properly.
cn: 有了这副手套，世界上所有的魔力都能轻松地流淌到你的指尖并引导你执剑的手臂。

en: You've descended! What interesting finds have you discovered? I'm all ears!
cn: 你已经去过礼堂了！你在那里有找到什么有趣的发现吗？快告诉我！

en: A helpful villager that will live and work in your base.
cn: 一位乐于助人的村民将在你的基地中生活与工作。

en: I was about to instruct you to find others like me, but you already did! You're way ahead of me, aren't you? I won't get lonely with these villagers around, so thank you! Make sure to fulfill the requests of your new followers, though. They'll lead you to more survivors! Or better yet, trinkets and treasure.
cn: 我本来还想指引你去寻找更多人，但没想到你已经完成了！看来你的手脚还挺麻利的啊？有了这些村民的陪伴，我肯定不会再感到孤单，谢谢你！不过还请记得一定要满足这些新的追随者们的请求。他们将会带你找到更多的幸存者！说不定你还会有机会获得全新的装备和宝藏。
炼金术士之塔搜索区域

en: Magical ammunition that releases a powerful lightning strike that shocks enemies and jumps to others nearby, dealing additional stamina damage. Stamina damage fills the enemy's stun bar. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 魔法弹药可释放强大的雷击，震飞敌人并跳到附近的其他人身上，造成额外的体力伤害。 体力伤害会充满敌人的眩晕条。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: Instantly restores 2 minute of your remaining time in the Shroud.
cn: 使你在瘴气中的剩余停留时间立刻恢复2分钟。

en: Highly concentrated Shroud energy, bundled in a pulsating core.
cn: 跳动的核心中蕴藏着高浓度的瘴气能量。
探索附近的独眼巨人洞穴

en: This server has unlocked the cooking recipe for this dish. Cook or obtain the dish to complete your set! Food can be cooked at a variety of cooking stations.
cn: 当前服务器已解锁这种料理的制作配方。 烹饪或获取料理以完成你的套装！你可以在各种烹饪站烹饪食物。

en:
You've collected blue gloomberries!

Return to the Barber with the berries in your inventory to remind him how to create blue hair dye!
cn:
你成功收集到了蓝色的暗夜果！

回去找理发师并确保物品栏中拥有暗夜果，帮助他重新回忆起制作蓝色染发剂的方法！

en: Chance to Spawn A Health Orb While Buffed
cn: 生命球生成概率（增益状态）

en: I am consumed with worry. It's one thing to mobilize an army, quite another to move entire towns across Embervale. And yet, I am Queen of Orindell and my kingdom relies on my steadfast leadership. We must light out for other lands. Seek fertile pastures. Find safety. Tomorrow, I will give orders to evacuate and form a caravan to Longkeep... I fear my voice will betray me, shake and quiver. I will push through, for mother. We'll head into a land of fern and moss. Lush greenery, emerald horizons... and yet, I see only darkness. Will my brother Vorgoth have the same idea? I cannot bear to face him after what he did to Gormander and his kingdom, Meldore. My nightmares are drenched in scarlet, still. I hear his voice, and it is unkind. Changed. I must rest. A big day awaits. — Jezmina, Yearfall, 505 D.A.
cn: 我的心中满是焦虑。与动员军队相比，指挥整座城镇的人们跨越薪谷完全是不一样的重担。但是，身为奥林戴尔的女王，我的王国依赖着我的坚定领导。我们必须动身寻找新的土地。我们需要肥沃的牧场与安全的住所。明天，我将下令撤离，届时所有人都将以车队形式前往长守镇……我担心我的声音会泄露我内心的惊慌失措。但是为了母亲，我必须坚强。 我们的目的地是绿意盎然，植被茂盛的地平线……但是我眼中看见的只有黑暗，我的兄弟沃格斯会不会有同样的想法？但是在他对戈曼德国王和梅尔多尔王国做了那些事之后，我再也无法直视他的面孔。虽然当时我们只是孩子。但到现在，我的噩梦中依旧是鲜血淋漓。我仿佛能够听见他的声音，但是那声音是如此的残酷，而且已经彻底改变。 我必须休息了。明天是个重要的日子。 — 杰兹米娜，岁末，505 D.A.

en: 5 Granting of Rights by Keen The Platform terms through which you purchased Enshrouded apply to the granting of rights for Enshrouded. As a freely available gameplay feature of Enshrouded, the granting of rights under the Terms of Use for Enshrouded shall otherwise apply to the use of Adventure Sharing.
cn:
5	Keen 授予的权利
您购买 Enshrouded 所通过的平台的条款适用于 Enshrouded 相关权利的授予。作为 Enshrouded 的一项免费游戏功能，Enshrouded 使用条款中的权利授予规定也应适用于冒险分享的使用。

en: %k meters range and %k Mana per level
Its glow is often the last thing which Fell creatures see before being vanquished.
cn: 这把武器的光芒往往是瘴气魔怪物们死前看见的最后景象。

en: A good thread can patch anything — or better yet, lessen any blow. We'll need a Loom eventually if we want stronger armor.
cn: 优良的丝线能够缝补缺口，甚至还能够用来抵挡敌人的攻击。如果想要更好的护甲，我们就得想办法弄一台织布机。

en: Another survivor awakened! The <npc>Alchemist</npc> will prove helpful by crafting potions and healing tinctures.
cn: 又一名幸存者被唤醒了！<npc>炼金术士</npc>将帮助你调配各类药水酊剂。

en: Throw out the fishing line and wait for a fish to bite. Once a fish is on the hook, quickly press %k to start reeling it in. Reduce the fish's stamina by steering against its movement with %k and %k. Once a segment of its stamina is drained, you can pull the fish closer with %k. Deplete its stamina before your fishing line breaks!
cn: 抛竿并等待鱼上钩。当有鱼咬钩后，快速按%k开始收线。 你需要朝鱼移动的反方向使用%k与%k来消耗鱼的体力。 当鱼的一段体力消耗殆尽后，你就可以使用%k将鱼进一步拉近。 在鱼线断裂前彻底耗尽它的体力！

en: The natural fiber won from the processing of Flax. The first step of cloth creation.
cn: 加工亚麻而来的天然纤维。制作衣物的第一步。

en: A decisive strike, freshly spilled blood, and a silence that follows — such are the impressions of a fleeting rush. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.
cn: 一次决定性的打击，刚刚挥洒出来的鲜血，以及接踵而至的沉默……一切都让人感到转瞬即逝的刺激。 瘴气附魔： 这把武器已经被瘴气侵蚀，并且能够造成大量瘴气伤害。只能够在瘴气巢穴中找到。

en: To tame an animal, earn its trust by feeding and petting it. Make sure you have food bait the animal likes, approach the animal while sneaking, and throw the bait within their sight. While it is eating, you can sneak closer. Don't move too fast, or you'll scare it away! Once you are close enough, you can pet it. Feed and pet the animal a few times to gain its trust. You can then pick it up and bring it to your home. Provide a nice sleeping place and food to keep it happy and protected from predators. Your livestock can reproduce if you have at least two happy animals and an extra spare bed.
cn: 如果要驯服动物，你需要通过喂食与抚摸来获取动物的信任。 确保你携带着动物喜欢的食物诱饵，以潜行状态接近动物，然后将诱饵投掷到动物的视野范围内。当动物进食时，你可以继续潜行至它们身边。切勿移动太快，否则动物将会被你吓跑！ 足够接近之后，你可以抚摸动物。 喂食并抚摸动物多次以获得动物的信任。之后你可以捡起动物并将其带回基地。 提供一个舒适的住所与食物来确保动物能够快乐生活，并且不用担心受到捕食者的侵扰。 如果你拥有至少两只快乐的动物与一张空闲的床位，你驯服的动物们将会繁衍。

en: There are many things we lack. Without a steady supply of salt, it'll be challenging to preserve fur. I might not be from here, but I know the land well. Here. I'll mark a location for gathering salt in your journal. Don't disappoint.
cn: 我们现在一穷二白。如果没有充足的盐块供应，我们根本没办法有效保存毛皮。虽然我并不是土生土长的本地人，但是我可以说对这片土地了如指掌。去我在你的日志里标记的地点搜集盐块吧。不要让我失望。

en: A relatively simple, but fortifying meal. Fast and ready to go!
cn: 质朴但是能够提供巩固效果的食物。方便好吃！

en: Hello, beautiful! What is it? ...You've learned how to mix red pigments? Marvelous! See, that's why everyone has faith in you! You're so reliable, courageous, and handsome! And you'd look great as a redhead... Care to try the style?
cn: 你好，美人！怎么了？……你已经学会如何调配红色颜料？太好了！就是因为这样，你才能够成为大家心目中的英雄！可靠，勇敢而且俊俏！还有……你说不定会很适合红色的头发……有兴趣来试一试吗？

en: Polaris' Memoir: I'm a shining star, drifting high up in the sky To find your path, you must look to me only Gazing down at the world, it's hard to deny Having no one at my side makes my spirit lonely
cn: 北极星的回忆录： 我是高悬在天空的闪亮星星 为了找到前进的道路，你的眼中只能容得下我 低头俯瞰世界，难以否认 无依无靠，我的心中只有孤寂

en: This Glider will allow you to travel extraordinarily long distances.
cn: 这个滑翔翼能够允许你前往遥不可及的远方。

en: Build walls and a roof to provide shelter for a survivor.
cn: 建造墙壁与屋顶，为幸存者提供庇护所。

en: Adjust the internal render resolution of the 3d scene. Decreasing this value improves performance.
cn: 调整3D场景中的内部渲染分辨率。降低此数值以提升性能。

en: Bastards closed the gates to the inner city. Just left us poor to rot and die!! It won't help. Vorgoth's army will get 'em. I hope they burn. Let Gormander taste copper and steel! I don't go down easy. I'm hidden, but I still have that blasted sickness from last yearfall. If my body fails me now, if I sneeze, if I yap — with the northlings sauntering 'round outside — these sewers will be my tomb. I'm shivering. It's not my cold flashes. Something is off. There's... there's a breeze in here. No. There's breathing. In here, and sharp like a blade. Can't see where, or what It's in me In my throat, so cold It's acid. It's worse. Worse than the sewer. Help The north winds are here
cn: 那帮畜生关上了通往内城的大门。任由我们这些可怜蛋自生自灭！！但就算这样也没有用。沃格斯的军队不会放过他们的。愿那帮混蛋不得好死。就让戈曼德尝尝刀刃的滋味吧！ 我才不会这么轻易认输。我现在已经躲起来了，但去年岁末染上的病还没有完全好。现在外面全是北佬，如果我的身体现在坚持不住，如果我打喷嚏，如果我发出声音……那么这里的下水道就将成为我的坟墓。 我现在不由自主地在颤抖。不是因为寒冷，是因为别的东西。这里……这里为什么会有风。不。是呼吸声。就在下水道里面，像尖刀一般锐利。但我看不见到底来自哪里或者是什么东西发出来的 它在我的身体里 就在我的喉咙里，好冷 是酸液。但比那更遭。比下水道还要可怕。救救我 北风已至

en: The inscription carved into this sword cannot be deciphered, since the archaic knowledge of rune matching has been lost to time. Whatever the writing entails, it makes the blade overflow with energy.
cn: 有关古代符文的知识已经彻底失传，因此你无法理解剑身上刻着的铭文的涵义。虽然无法理解其中的内容，但是这些符文能够为剑身灌注不同寻常的能量。

en: A wall sign that you can write on.
Oh dear, oh dear... whatever shall I do without my beloved dagger..? Oh, if only a valiant hero would save my day...!
cn: 天呐，天呐……没了我最心爱的匕首，我该怎么办……？唉，如果能有一位勇敢的英雄能够来帮助我……！

en: The Elixir. It was a cure, a blessing, a weapon.
cn: 魔药。它是解药、是祝福、也是武器。

en: When killing an enemy with a melee weapon, all players within 15 meters of the target gain 20 Health.
cn: 使用近战武器击杀敌人时，目标周围15米范围内的所有玩家获得20点生命值。

en:
Villagers and crafting assistants can be found all over Embervale. Quests and side stories will lead you to them. 

They can reveal more information about the world and guide you to new places, items, and hidden treasures! 
Once you've found a villager or crafting assistant, you can place them with a Summoning Staff. Your new followers must have access to food and a sheltered bed to become happy. Happy followers are needed to increase your Flame Level for every upgrade after the first.

A bed is sheltered when it is under a roof and surrounded by enough walls. Assign beds to townsfolk by using the Summoning Staff.
cn:
你可以在薪谷各地找到村民与制作助手。各种任务与支线剧情都会带你找到这些幸存者。

他们可以提供关于这个世界的更多信息，并且能够引导你找到新的地点、物品或者是隐藏的宝藏！
找到一位村民或制作助手之后，你可以使用召唤法杖安置他们。你的新追随者们需要食物与一张受到庇护的床才能够感到快乐。除了首次升级灵火之外，后续的每次升级都需要你拥有一定数量的快乐的追随者。

在屋顶与充足数量的墙体包围下的床才会被判定为是“受到庇护的”。使用召唤法杖为村民们分配床位。

en: An Axe with a bronze head. Sturdier than the Copper version.
cn: 装有青铜斧刃的工具。比铜制斧子更为耐用。

en: Increases the chance to poison enemies to 25% when using Daggers with the Venomous Blades perk.
cn: 使用带有剧毒之刃特性的匕首时，使敌人中毒的几率提高到25%。

en: The blades of this axe have sharp edges that flow into an upper peak. They were crafted like that to break through frozen lake surfaces or walls and resemble bat wings.
cn: 这把斧子的锐利边缘形成了冲向上方的山峰模样。这种像蝙蝠翅膀一样的特殊斧刃形状能够轻松打破冰冻的湖面或者是墙壁。

en:
Life isn't always black and white. Sometimes, power demands sacrifice.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn:
生活并不永远非黑即白。有时候，力量意味着牺牲。

可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en: Mine every valuable material in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 开采游牧高地中的所有贵重材料。

en: The alchemist told you about a mad wizard obsessed with creating a spell for eternal life. He allegedly conducted his experiments deep underground, where no one could see what he was truly doing. It’s uncertain if he ever achieved the spell he sought — but he did create something. Go to the hidden tomb where he is said to have worked, and search for any traces of him.
cn: 炼金术士提到了一个曾经执着于创造永恒生命的法术的疯狂巫师的故事。据说此人会在地下深处进行实验，因此外界根本不知道他在那里做了什么。没有人知道巫师到底有没有创造出他心心念念的法术——但他确实是创造出了某种东西。前往传闻中巫师进行实验的隐藏墓穴，并在那里搜索他的踪迹。

en: Set a password for your session
The <npc>Farmer</npc> Emily Fray crafts food and helps you grow your plants.
cn: 艾米丽·弗莱<npc>农民</npc>能够烹饪食物并帮助你栽培作物。

en: Increases your movement speed while sneaking by %k.

I despised working at the Cargo Lift. Turns out, I loathe being a farmhand even more. I still remember when we got shut down as the Shroud-infected water spread to our upper canals. Dragging sandbags around and building makeshift barricades to "ensure water purity" downstream, all while enduring this rotting stench. Then, poof: No lift, no work, and I was stuck with a scratchy throat. My new life on the farm is lonesome as hell. The cough and birds around were my only company... 'til yesterday. While tilling, I saw something shuffle through the trees. The thing was so crooked, I thought it was some sort of beast. Then, bang! Thunder! Lightning! A strange bird's coo! I was distracted by the ruckus above, and when I looked back at the thing, it had moved closer. No longer hiding behind a tree line, it revealed itself as a hunched-over hag, cawing: "Your cough is bad, my boy — but you're in luck! I'm an herbalist. Come by my hut, and let my healing tinctures soothe you." As if on cue, a flight of birds near me took off and soared past. Had to shield my face and all, so close were they! Moments later, the birds and crone were gone. I'll go see her tomorrow. Got nothing left to lose. —J
cn: 原本我很讨厌在货运梯的工作。但是没想到，我更讨厌当一个农民。 我仍然记得当被瘴气感染的水流散播至上游河道后，一切作业都被关停的景象。所有人都拖着沙袋手忙脚乱地搭建临时壁垒想要“保障下流的纯净水质”，与此同时到处都弥漫腐烂的恶臭。 然后一夜之间那全化为了泡影：没有升降梯就没有工作，留给我的就只有治不好的咳嗽病。在农场上的新生活孤独地让人难以忍受。咳嗽声还有偶尔飞舞的小鸟就是我唯一的陪伴……直到昨天。 在犁地的时候，我看见树丛中有什么东西一闪而过。那个身影过于扭曲，以至于我还以为是某种奇怪的野兽。接着砰！电闪！雷鸣！还有奇怪的鸟叫声！我被头顶的异变给吸引了注意，等我回过神再一次低头看向那个东西的时候，我才发现它离我更近了。 不再依托树木的隐蔽，它在我面前现出了原形，原来是一个岣嵝着背的老巫婆，她用尖锐的嗓音说到：“你的咳嗽很严重，我的孩子——不过你的运气不错！我是一名草药师。来我的小屋看看吧，我的治疗酊剂一定能够安抚你的痛苦。” 话音刚落，我身旁的一群飞鸟便不约而同地振翅朝我飞了过来。考虑到就在眼前，我不得已下意识地护住了自己的脸！片刻之后，那些鸟儿和老妪都已经不见了。 我打算明天去见她，反正我现在也什么都没有了。 — J

en: A factory that enables the production of color palettes and colorizes your clothes.
cn: 允许生产调色板以及衣物染料的工坊。

en: Lost and forgotten amidst the Shroud, this bow unleashes fury on anyone that crosses its path.
cn: 被人遗忘在瘴气中的这把弓将对遇到的一切敌人释放无边怒火。

en: A magical water barrier to keep water out.
cn: 用于屏蔽水流的魔法屏障。

en:
You've found a gem of lycanthropy!

Head to the Collector's Assistant, the Nameless One, with the gem in your inventory and speak to him to proceed!
cn:
你已经找到了一枚狼化宝石！

确保你的物品栏中储存着宝石，然后与收藏家的助手“无名”交谈以继续！

en: Of The Flaw In Us All
Craft And Use A Hemotoxin Antidote
cn: 制作并使用一份毒血解毒剂

en: A broad and imposing axe. If you want to leave a fearsome impression, this weapon will do the trick.
cn: 一把造型凶狠的巨斧。如果想要威慑他人，这把武器是你的最好选择。

en: The Shroud, a ruinous fog which sought only to spread and devour.
cn: 名为瘴气的毁灭性无情地蔓延并吞噬一切。

en: Sharp claws and a sharper tongue that refuses to be silenced — such is both sword and shield of the Blood Rose.
cn: 锐利的尖爪与口才拒绝沉默，而这两者便是血玫瑰的剑与盾。

en: I know a great fisherman... me!
cn: 我认识一个很棒的渔夫……就是我自己！

en: The delay after which regeneration becomes active.

...I see what it is you carry. A fell commander's bow, not so unfamiliar to me. My brother once wielded such a weapon. No need to mourn — He wouldn't want that. Thank you for freeing him, Flameborn. Now, the only family we've left is each other. I will be watching over you.
cn: ……我已经看见你拿着什么东西。那是一名瘴气魔指挥官的弓，对此我再熟悉不过。曾经我的兄弟就拥有像这样的武器。不必为此哀伤，他肯定也不会希望我们难过。火之子，谢谢你让他得以自由。如今你我便是彼此仅存的家人。我将竭尽全力照顾你。

en:
Queen Jezmina left a note near a large Ancient structure bordering the Blackmire. It seems that she ventured into the Veilwater Basin after stocking up on supplies.

Find her various Veilwater Basin camps to retrieve leftover supplies and continue her story.
cn:
杰兹米娜女王在靠近黑沼的一处巨大远古者建筑旁留下了笔记。看来她在补充了补给之后进入了幕水盆地。

找到她在各地的幕水盆地营地以取回残留的补给并继续她的故事。

en: Orville seems infested with Drak'Dal. If there used to be any people here, then they and their tools are long gone by now. Investigate the area to find clues.
cn: 奥威尔中似乎卓克·达尔成患。就算以前真的有人居住在这里，那些人和他们所使用的工具也早已不复存在。 调查区域以寻找线索。

en: Emily Fray's Diary, Beginning of Midyear, 505 D.A.
cn: 艾米丽·弗莱的日记，岁中之初，505 D.A.

en: I've never seen Embervale like this before. Who are you to open my eyes, and show me this beauty? A Flameborn? Greetings, I am Mei-Yin, a trader. The world has changed, but we remain. That alone is reason enough to celebrate. You've heard of the Lunar New Year, no?
cn: 薪谷已经完全不是我记忆中的那般模样。是你让我真正睁开了双眼并见证这幅美景，你究竟是什么人？一个火之子？幸会，我叫梅茵，是一名商人。虽然这个世界不复从前，但我们还在。我认为这一点就很值得庆祝。你以前应该有听说过农历新年的概念吧？

en: Thanks again for the flowers — let me repay you with a hair coloring, free of charge!
cn: 再次感谢你找到那些花，就让我用免费的发色来报答你吧！

en: As a Flameborn, your immortal soul allows you to resurrect at the last Return Beacon or base after perishing. However, this comes at a cost. When dying, you will lose items not placed in your hotbar and leave behind a tombstone. Venture to your tombstone to reacquire your lost items. The location of your tombstone will be marked on the map.
cn: 身为火之子，当你倒下后，你的不朽灵魂将允许你在最后使用的回归信标或基地处复活。但这么做也将需要付出相应的代价。 死亡时，你将失去除快捷栏内容物以外的所有物品并留下一块墓碑。找到墓碑即可取回丢失的物品。地图上将标记你的墓碑位置。

en: How I miss my favorite daggers... I have other ones, yes, but my heart aches nonetheless...
cn: 我真的很想念自己心爱的匕首……虽然我有备用的匕首，但是我真的很怀念那些宝贝……

en: Follow-up On The Request For Recruit Names
cn: 关于新人名单的申请进度询问

en:
The right arm of a Cyclops. It's taller than your whole body when propped up!

This collectible is found in the Albaneve Summits. It can be reassembled to form a Cyclops Skeleton on a Cyclops Trophy Base.
cn:
一头独眼巨人的右臂。竖直摆放时的高度甚至超过了你！

能够在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到此收集品。能够在独眼巨人战利品底座上重新组装为一套完整的独眼巨人骷髅。

en: So you had a chuckle doodling on my face when I was knocked out. Very funny. You know what's not funny? I can't wash the paint off! I tried for hours to scrub your childish scribbles off me, but it's no use! So all in all, great joke. Fantastic. Wanna know the real punchline? If I get my hands on the clown who did this, I'll rip his face off to use as my own. I'll get the last laugh, I'll make sure of it!
cn: 所以在我不省人事的时候，你们在我的脸上画了搞怪涂鸦。真有意思。但你们猜什么是真没意思？ 颜料洗不掉了！我已经花了好几个小时试图擦掉那些幼稚的简笔画，但是没用！ 恭喜，恶作剧成功了。太棒了。 你知道最好笑的一点是什么吗？ 如果被我抓到在我脸上画画的小丑，我就要把那家伙的脸给撕下来。 给我等着吧，我不会饶过你们的！

en: So, small fish, you’ve got all you need now. Time to venture out. I know a good spot — try your luck there! Don’t forget to come back and show me what you’ve hauled in.
cn: 好了，小虾米，现在你已经做好了万全准备。是时候该出发冒险了。我知道一个好地方，去那里碰碰运气吧！到时候别忘了回来让我看看你的收获。

en: Indicates how well you use melee weapons.
A plain pair of pants. Under different circumstances, they would allow the wearer to easily blend into any crowd.
cn: 一条普通的裤子。在不同的环境下，它能让穿着者轻松融入任何人群。

en: You've found out that a rambunctious cat recently stole someone's meal and escaped with it to a town called <location>Sapphire Strand</location>. Reach the city to search for the cat!
cn: 你了解到有一只粗暴的猫咪最近偷走了某人的烤肉，并逃去了一个叫<location>蓝石湾</location>的城镇。抵达城市并寻找猫咪！

en: Esteemed Investigator Lachlan, I write to you personally with dire tidings. The Revelwood lay restless, stirred by the Elixir. Disappearances of cargo and people plague our lands, and now, the province of Glennwood's End has ceased all communication with the crown. The town has shown great fealty to me, their one and rightful King, in the past — and I shall repay them in kind. With your many illustrious years of dedicated service, I hereby command you to seek out answers and report back with great haste. Signed, King Gormander of Meldore, son of glorious Pikemead, grand patron of the Revelwood and Springlands, 21st of Yearfall, 502 D.A.
cn: 尊敬的调查员拉克兰， 此次来信是有十万火急之事要告知你。魔药已经让喧嚣森林陷入骚乱。我们的领地中货物与人口失踪案件频发，而且此刻格伦伍德之末行省与皇室之间的所有联络都已经中断。 在过去，那座城镇的居民对我，他们唯一而且合法的国王，展现出了坚定不移的忠诚，因此我绝不能坐视不管。 考虑到你多年来功勋显赫，我在此命令你前去那里进行调查，并尽快掌握真相并回来汇报。 此致， 梅尔多尔国王戈曼德，荣耀的派克米德之子，喧嚣森林与春日平原的伟大主人，岁末第21日，502 D.A.

en: Without a password, everyone can join, terraform, modify bases, and access stored items.
cn: 无需密码，所有玩家都可以加入、改造地形、修改基地并存取储存的物品。

en: Your Oxygen ran out. Remember not to dwell in the depths and resurface regularly.
cn: 你已经缺氧窒息。请勿在深水区域逗留过久，并且记得定期浮出水面。

en:
For a thief, the only light visible from within the shadows is that which is reflected on a glistening gold coin. 

This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.
cn:
对于一名小偷来说，闪耀的金币是阴影之中唯一能够看见的光芒。

可以使用燃火荒原材料制作这种调色板。

en: Determines how much Health an ally is revived with.
cn: 决定盟友复活时的健康值。

en: Something sinister has overtaken Glennwood's End, a large town in the far reaches of the Revelwood. Find the city and explore it!
cn: 某种邪恶的存在已经侵占格伦伍德之末，那里是一座位于喧嚣森林深处的大型城镇。找到城市并探索内部！

en: The Shroud Fire is melting you! You're receiving heavy damage!
cn: 瘴气火焰正在将你融化！你正在承受大量伤害！

en: Timbering is an ancient building technique that was very popular for its decorative effect.
cn: 木结构是一种源远流长的建筑工艺，因为美观的装饰效果而十分流行。

en: Roasted with a smoky aroma, it's a real pleasure for the taste buds, able to set free all of its strengthening attributes.
cn: 烤过之后就有了一种烟熏香气，处理后的玉米更加美味，而且能够提供完整的属性强化效果。
青铜瘴气魔怪物战利品

en: Heavy gauntlets that aim to protect your hands in combat. You can swing your blade fearlessly with these.
cn: 沉重的臂铠，能够在战斗中保护你的双手。戴上它们之后，你就可以英勇无畏地挥舞手中剑刃。

en: Your attacks deal bonus Fire damage. This effect is activated by landing while Meteoric Impact is ready.
cn: 你的攻击造成额外火焰伤害。当陨石冲击准备就绪时，着陆将激活此效果。

en: Heyja, I still catch an eyeful of you plummeting to the ground in the distance every once in a while. No worries, there's no shame in that! But if you want to fly with style, consider crafting a better glider with me!
cn: 嘿，最近我老是看见你从空中坠落。不用担心，这没什么大不了的！但是如果你想要真正畅快飞行的话，可以来我这制作更好的滑翔翼！

en: People don't make eye contact with gravediggers because it brings bad luck. Therefore, some graveyard keepers wear a cap that covers their eyes to avoid trouble.
cn: 人们会尽可能避免与掘墓人有目光接触，因为他们做的往往都是被忌讳的工作。也正是因为这一点，有些守墓人会选择佩带能够遮住眼睛的帽子来避免麻烦。

en: Much time has passed since the first of your kind awoke, and my power has grown thanks to you. Our lights dance in unison, bound together through a joyous pact. This calls for a celebration — venture forth to find attire befitting such an event!
cn: 自从你们第一个人苏醒已经过去一段时间，多亏了你们的帮助，我的力量才得以不断成长。灵火的光芒正在一起翩翩起舞，这就是我们之间缔结的愉快契约。是时候该举办一次庆祝活动了——去准备一些适合参加活动的打扮吧！

en: A warm tunic, lined with white wool. The sleeves are long and wide, so it's fun to swing your arms around gleefully!
cn: 温暖的短上衣，内侧缝有白色毛料。宽大的长袖能够让你在挥舞手臂时感受特别的趣味！

en: I was carrying construction material when I felt a rumble under my feet. Startled, I tripped and let the heavy load tumble to the ground. I must've hit my head on the stone stairs on impact... everything went black. I was lost in the silence, who knows how long. When I awoke, a tingle danced upon my palm. A crawl. Then, a sting. A beastly critter had plunged its needle-like fangs into my hand! I shook it off, roused by the scare. I wanted to stomp it out, but the beast burrowed underground... build without me whilst I tend to this wound!
cn: 当时我正在带着建筑材料，然后突然就感觉到脚下有动静。 慌乱之中我被绊倒了，手里的东西狠狠甩在了地上。我当时肯定还撞到石头了……我只感觉眼前一黑，接着我便迷失在了沉默之中，我不清楚这种状态持续了多久。 醒来的时候，我感觉自己的手上传来了一丝瘙痒。感觉像有什么东西在爬，紧接着立刻又感受到了一阵刺痛。一只巨大的爬虫把自己尖刺一样的獠牙插进了我的手里！我吓坏了，立刻手忙脚乱把它甩了下去。我抬起脚想要把它踩扁，但是那东西瞬间就钻进了土里面……你们先继续造吧，不用管我，我得先处理好伤口！

en: Reach The Location And Slay The Scavengers
cn: 抵达地点并杀死拾荒者

en: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.
cn: 能够在合适的土壤环境中成长的幼苗。

en: This royal chest piece frames a gleaming gem as its heart, reminding the wearer that hope will prevail. Taupe colored sleeves drape at the sides like a chrysalis being shed. The shoulders are accentuated by wing- or petal-like shapes, blossoming outwards.
cn: 这件尊贵上衣的心脏位置镶嵌着一枚璀璨的宝石，这时刻提醒着穿着者，希望必将胜利。灰褐色的袖子像是蜕去的蛹壳一般垂在身体两侧。肩部点缀着翅膀或者是花瓣一般向外绽放的装饰。

en: A block made from pale ribs and cranial bone. Its ivory guise decorates tombs and temples alike. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 由苍白的肋骨和颅骨制成的方块。这个乳白色物体装饰着陵墓和寺庙。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: When you kill an enemy with a ranged weapon, you gain 20% more experience
cn: 使用远程武器击杀敌人时额外获得20%经验

en: We could still find color palettes if we keep our eyes and minds open!
cn: 眼观六路耳听八方，我们一定能够找到需要的调色板！

en: Indicates how well you use ranged weapons.

You... drank the Elixir! I see a semblance of madness linger in your eyes.
The Flame protects your soul. However, you must take great care. Too many people have drowned their sorrows in this confounded potion! Hell, the great Elixir Wars were fought because of it!
cn:
你……你喝了魔药！我在你的眼睛里看见了疯狂的迹象。
尽管有灵火守护你的灵魂，但是你依旧不能大意。我已经看见过太多人陷在这该死的药水中无法自拔！要知道当年就是这些东西引发了魔药战争！

en: A warm, padded vest. Ideal for enduring cold nights while awaiting the time to strike.
cn: 等待猎物时，穿上这件有内衬的温暖背心，抵御寒冷夜晚。

en: The Luscious Drakonian Maid, Chapter 3: Beneath Cloth
cn: 气质满满的龙裔女仆 - 第三章：布衣之下

en: The <keyitem>Crucible</keyitem> was found. It needs to be crafted into a <craftingstation>Smelter</craftingstation> with the <npc>Blacksmith</npc> in order to unlock more crafting recipes.
cn: 已找到<keyitem>熔炉</keyitem>。使用该物品为<npc>铁匠</npc>制作<craftingstation>冶炼炉</craftingstation>以解锁更多配方。

en: What is this place? Where is the fire, the explosion, the blaze? Just seconds ago, my lungs were burning, and my skin was melting... who took me from that fiery grave?
cn: 这是什么地方？火焰、爆炸还有黑烟都去哪了？就在几秒之前，我还感觉自己的肺部有一团火在燃烧，我的皮肤都融化了……是谁将我从熊熊燃烧的坟墓中救了出来？
完成你的精英空荡套装

en: A potent base for crafting potions of various kinds.
cn: 用于制作各类药水的强效基底溶液。

en: After hitting an enemy in the back the target is stunned for 1 second.
cn: 从背后命中敌人将使其晕眩1秒。

en: An infested Shroud bow, able to teach the true meaning of pain.
cn: 被瘴气腐化的弓，能够教会敌人何为痛苦。

en:
Food for attracting and taming a Capybara.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
cn:
用于吸引与驯服水豚的饲料。

若要驯服动物，请在潜行状态下小心靠近目标。在动物身边投掷诱饵食物以吸引其注意。在动物进食时抚摸它，重复过程直到动物被驯服。被驯服之后，你将可以捡起动物。

en:
Craft blocks, new items and repair broken equipment. 

The <craftingstation>Workbench</craftingstation> can only be placed inside the area of a Flame Altar.
cn:
制作建筑方块，新物品并修复破损装备。

<craftingstation>工作台</craftingstation>仅可放置在灵火祭坛范围内。

en: This setting scales the damage of boss attacks.
cn: 该选项调整Boss的攻击伤害。

en: 13.1 Choice of Law: These Adventure Sharing Terms are governed by German law, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. If you are a consumer and do not have a permanent residence in Germany, this shall apply subject to the proviso that mandatory provisions of the law of the state in which you have your habitual residence shall continue to apply insofar as they provide otherwise.
cn:
13.1	
法律选择：本冒险分享条款受德国法律管辖，但不包括《联合国国际货物销售合同公约》。如果您是消费者且永久居住地不在德国，则适用本条款时须遵循以下规定：在您常居地所在国法律中有强制性规定且该规定与本条款不一致的，应以该等强制性规定为准。

en: Oh, I am alive — and healthy, no less! No shattered ankles from the fall, or tired legs from my travels! My name is Robert Gibson — I ship wares with my partner, Kaori! Could you find her, too? She manages everything from <location>East Lapis</location> and had some trouble with a parcel there. I'd be forever grateful!
cn: 哦，我又活过来了，而且还很健康！从高处掉下来之后摔坏的脚踝还有旅途的劳累都已经消失不见了！我是罗伯特·吉布森，我与我的爱人嘉里都是货运商！能不能拜托你帮我去找到嘉里？她负责打理<location>东之岩</location>那边的事务，之前那里的一个包裹好像出了点问题。拜托了，请你一定要找到她！

en: Roll out the red carpet whenever you wish, and make your entrance in style.
cn: 随时随地铺设红毯，用最华丽的方式闪亮登场。
新神的诞生 - 阿里斯塔尔

en: A rougher version of the Refined Sandstone Block, mainly produced for quantity. Due to its outer appearance it was mainly used for foundations.
cn: 较为粗糙的量产型精致砂岩方块。因为外观欠佳所以主要被用作地基。

en: A new type of timber block for building. The brick accents warm up any space.
cn: 一种全新的建造用木砖。砖头的温暖色调将照亮整个空间。

en: My lonely heart yearns for a duet partner!
cn: 我孤独的心渴望着一个音乐上的伙伴！

en:
The fossilized remains of a lobe-finned fish. Descendants of this nocturnal drift-hunter were considered a delicacy and used to populate brooks and springs. However, consumption became impossible during the reign of the Shroud, as some fish developed new rows of rotting teeth and bit back.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.
cn:
一种叶鳍鱼的残骸化石。这种夜间漂流的猎手的后代曾被视为美味佳肴，在小溪和泉水中觅食。然而，在裹尸布统治时期，由于一些鱼类长出了一排新的腐烂牙齿并反咬一口，人们已无法食用。

此收藏品在 燃火荒原 中找到。

en:
Henry hasn't come back. He's not been down to bring me water, and I don't dare to step outside knowing that this spells demise. 
Right now I'm still hidden, but who knows what the guards will do if they find me. I'll hang for treason, most likely... just for speaking the truth. However, I only have enough water for maybe 3 more days. 
And what's even more depressing... it seems like my last words, written or screamed, will never reach a single living soul. Such a meaningless death for a reporter... A wise man would call it irony. I would call it twisted.

— Ramone Jones, Editor of what used to be The Pike Weekly.
cn:
亨利还没有回来。他已经很久没有下来给我送水了，而且我也不敢出去，因为我知道法术失败了。
虽然现在我还没有被人发现，但是谁知道那些守卫会对我做什么。他们估计会以叛国罪对我处以绞刑……就因为我胆敢说出真相。无论如何，我现在的饮用水最多只能再撑3天。
还有一件更让人崩溃的事……似乎并没有人收到我最后写的或者是大声疾呼的那些话。谁能想到我这个记者就会这样毫无意义地死去……智者也许会说这是天大的讽刺。但我认为这就是现实的残酷扭曲。

 - 雷蒙·琼斯，前《崇山城周报》编辑。

en: Scale Ancient Spires and speak to the Flame atop to reveal important landmarks on your map. Ancient Spires unveil the location of Elixir Wells and Flame Sanctums. They also function as fast travelling points once conquered. Open your map and select the Ancient Spire marker to Fast Travel.
cn: 攀爬远古尖塔并与位于顶部的灵火交谈，来标注出地图上的重要地标。远古尖塔将揭示魔药之井以及灵火神殿的位置。 征服这些地点后，它们还将开启快速移动功能。打开地图，然后选择远古尖塔标记进行快速移动。
就算是死神也有一颗心脏。

en: A penny for a song, perhaps?

Amber was found dead in Surat's Rest. She'd escaped there, hoping for a better life... but loud and righteous girls like her don't last long in a pit of vipers. We are both consumed with grief, but her mother can barely get out of bed. As husband and father, I have agreed to pick a place where we can lay her to rest. I think the tree behind our home will do nicely. A quiet orchard by the river... her favorite place to sit and ponder. She's so bright, so well-spoken. We are nothing without her light and grace. Deciding what to write on her tombstone is pure torture. My heart feels so heavy, it might've turned to stone.
cn: 安珀被发现死在了苏拉特之息。她逃到那里原本是想要过上更好的生活……但是像她这样吵吵嚷嚷而且正义感过多的女孩子并不适合在一窝毒蛇中生存。现在我们两个都悲痛欲绝，她母亲更是几乎连床都下不了。作为父亲与丈夫，我已经决定去为她挑选一块合适的墓地。 我认为我们家背后的那棵树就很不错。算是河道旁的安静小果园……以前她最喜欢坐在那里想事情。她是那么聪明热情。没有了她，我们感觉整个世界都变得灰暗了起来。思考墓碑上的刻字简直是折磨。我的心情无比沉重，仿佛就像是胸膛中其实是一颗石头一样。

en: A baby Fae Deer. They are fragile after birth, but they learn to walk and gallop astonishingly quickly!
cn: 一只仙鹿宝宝。虽然刚出生的时候十分脆弱，但是它们能够以惊人的速度学会走路与奔跑！

en: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.
cn: 能够在合适的土壤环境中成长的幼苗。完全成熟后可以采集一次。

en: Soft and comfortable maid attire. It's easily cleaned if dirtied with washing water, milk, or wine.
cn: 柔软而且舒适的女仆装束。无论是溅到了肥皂水、牛奶还是红酒都能够轻而易举洗干净。

en: Starting out on the path of the alchemist apprentice, these gloves will make your life a little more comfortable.
cn: 这些手套将为踏上炼金术士学徒道路的你提供些许慰藉。

en: This tropical wood can be harvested from ancient trees. It is very sturdy!
cn: 从古树上采集到的热带木材。十分牢固！

en: These pants are extremely light and therefore enable quick and flexible movements. Crouch, climb, and run to gain an advantage!
cn: 这些裤子异常轻便，穿着者能够快速且灵活地活动。尽情蹲伏、攀爬或奔跑，取得战术优势吧！

en: Call down a Shroud Meteor on your foes. Channelling this much dark energy drains your remaining time in the Shroud. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 召唤瘴气陨石打击敌人。引导如此巨大的黑暗能量将消耗你的剩余瘴气停留时间。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: The build version of this server is older than yours. The owner of this server needs to update it to the latest version.
cn: 该服务器的版本低于你使用的版本。服务器主人需要升级至最新版本的游戏。

en: Ahhh, a pyre burning through the snow... an inferno to rival the sun! This will keep us warm and satiated... for now.
cn: 啊，熊熊燃烧的火堆融化了冰雪……这是足以媲美太阳的火狱！这应该能够让我们温暖饱足……暂时。
亡灵巫师的骷髅召唤容器

en: The Collector has asked you to procure another shepherd of souls for him, or a blank slate that can be morphed into "something useful". They pointed you to a promising location, which may house the undead shell you need. Reach the temple in question to proceed.
cn: 收藏家要求你为他提供另一个灵魂牧者，那种空白石板一样的存在能够被改变为“有用之物”。 收藏家指出了一个有潜力的地点，那里有可能藏着你需要的亡灵躯壳。 抵达标记的神殿并继续。

en: A generous portion of grilled meat. It must've come from a giant crab. Enjoy!
cn: 一份分量十足的烤肉。有可能是从一只巨型螃蟹身上挖下来的。吃得开心！

en: You have not yet subscribed to any worlds.

A bandage that was made more absorbent by moss. The added silver dust and wound ointment will cure poison.

This item heals 80% health over 10 seconds if applied to a wound. 

Receiving any damage interrupts the healing effect.
cn:
使用苔藓制作的强力绷带。额外添加的银粉与伤药拥有解毒功效。

施加在伤口上之后，该物品能够在10秒内回复80%生命值。

承受任意伤害都将打断治疗效果。

en: A pair of boots that has been reinforced with Drak paraphernalia, granting you the upper hand in combat.
cn: 使用卓克器件加固的靴子，能够让你在战斗中获取优势。

en: The Albaneve Summits must be rich in minerals... silver, obsidian, and who knows what else? We need a new way to smelt these down... greater heat...
cn: 阿尔班耶夫山脉肯定富含矿物……白银、黑曜石，谁知道那里还有什么好东西？我们需要想办法熔炼这些东西……我需要更高的温度……

en: Fast Travel is not possible while in the Shroud
cn: 在瘴气中无法快速移动

en: They took Pikemead's Reach. They killed King Gormander. An army of lunatics, sickly pale, barely lifting their feet above the bloodied ground. They drag themselves through our valleys, through the miasma, led by the mad Guard of the North, Lord Vorgoth of Rimgard. I always knew the Elixir would sow a seed of distrust. I look up at the Ancient Spires, at the sky... There is no running, no hiding. We must persevere. — Balthazar, 503 D.A.
cn: 他们占领了派克米德之地。国王戈曼德已经被杀害。 由疯子组成的大军，那些苍白病态的身影仿佛就在血红的大地上飘荡着。这些行尸走肉穿过了我们的峡谷，穿过了迷雾，为首的则是疯狂的北境守卫，里姆加德的沃格斯领主。我早就知道魔药会埋下猜忌的种子。 我抬头望向远古者的尖塔，望向天空……我们无法逃离或躲藏。我们必须忍耐。 — 巴尔萨扎，503 D.A.

en: Ain't no way we can break through these defenses. Looks like the Ancients set up these beacons to protect their border. Every time we set foot behind the line, someone gets zapped, fried, or pulverized. Lord Vorgoth won't like this at all... If we want to cross the threshold to their territory, we'll have to tear down some beacons... or find a way to deactivate them. If we're victorious... no, when we're victorious, then the ancient gates will be right at our fingertips. Office of Lieutenant Arlington, First Overseer of the Expansion Program
cn: 我们根本无法突破这种防御。 看来远古者已经建造了许多座灯塔来守护自己的边境。 每一次冲进警戒线之后，就有人被电击、被烤焦或者是被彻底粉碎。沃格斯大人恐怕不会愿意接受这种事…… 如果我们想要攻入他们的领地，我们得想方设法拆除那些灯塔……或者是将它们关闭。如果我们胜利……不对，是等我们胜利的时候，远古者的大门将向我们敞开。 阿灵顿中尉，远征项目首席监督

en: The Things You Do For Money
This setting controls how many enemies are allowed to attack at the same time.
cn: 该选项决定了有多少敌人能够同时发起攻击。

en: The Farmer wants to teach you how to tame farm animals. Farm animals can provide useful ingredients for cooking and crafting. Craft goat food bait and use it to tame a common goat!
cn: 农民想要教你如何驯服农场动物。农场动物能够为你提供宝贵的烹饪与制作材料。 制作山羊饲料诱饵并用它来驯服一只普通山羊！

en: Smithing Tools...? For me? How strange. Well, I have plenty of use for 'em! Lost my old set in a fire... Set them down next to me, will ya? Thanks a lot, Flameborn! Let's use 'em to craft new armor!
cn: 锻造工具……？给我的？真是奇怪。但是无论如何，这些东西的确能派上大用场！毕竟我的旧工具都在多年前的大火中被毁了！东西放在我旁边就行。谢啦，火之子！用它们制作新的装甲吧！

en: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with greatly improved firepower.
cn: 一枚能够带来“爆炸惊喜”的特殊箭矢。能够造成巨大的威力。

en: You've obtained a Spark. Use the Spark to strengthen the Flame at your Flame Altar. Strengthen the Flame at the Flame Altar to increase your Shroud Passage Level and to establish more bases.
cn: 您已获得余火。使用余火来加强您灵火祭坛上的灵火。使用灵火祭坛 上的强化火焰来增加您的瘴气抵抗等级并建立更多基地。

en:
GQ cn
Ancient land, modern hand.

TaoliAnna
Fortune favors the bold

XinFang/GeLin
A Moonlit Night on the River

Hu Yue Kong Que
Building Life with Blocks

Fengzhongpiao
Smile when happy
cn:
大GQcn
远古之地的现代之手。

桃莉安娜
命运必将眷顾勇敢者

信方是条鱼&猪猪格林
明月照溪川

-护月孔雀-
用方块去创造生命

风中piao
开心的时候就微笑
第一天 — 被困升降梯（又一次）

en: Pure light engulfs the knowledge of the ancient breed, protects it in a flaming core. Wisdom far beyond my own imagination. I could stare into the fire for hours, seeking answers, a whisper... But I hear none. Despite possessing a voice, it only speaks to those born from the Flame. A shame, as I believe we could have quite enlightened conversations. — Balthazar, 508 D.A.
cn: 纯净的光芒笼罩着远古者的智慧，火焰核心保护着一切。那是我根本无法想象的无上智慧。但是就算我全神贯注凝视灵火再久，无论是答案还是低语都注定一无所获。尽管它明显能够发声，但是它只会与诞生于火焰的那些人进行交谈。 这实在是让人感到气馁，我是那么渴望它愿意与我分享自己的智慧。 — 巴尔萨扎，508 D.A.
移动：角色 仓库

en: So that rotten place really was haunted, huh? Ah, if ol' <lorename>Elin</lorename> was still around, she'd be relieved to hear that the horror's headless thanks to you! Sent that Sickle Susie right back to the grave, you did! Ah, we can feed the head to the Flame and roast a Hophare or two! ...Is that profane? Nooo, not if none are 'round to see, I'd say.
cn: 那个糟糕的地方真的闹鬼吗？啊，如果老<lorename>艾琳</lorename>还在的话，她一定会松口气的。多亏了你，那恐怖的东西才没了脑袋。你把镰刀苏西送回了坟墓。啊，我们可以把头喂给灵火，再烤一两个 跳脚兔 ！......那是亵渎吗？不，如果没有人看到，我就觉得不是。

en: You're asking about a green that represents nature and renewal? Well, many plants are green! The brightest I ever saw was when I traveled the Nomad Highlands with the caravan. My... "friend" and I were on a nightly walk when we wandered into this field of fluorescent flowers! But the next day, they were gone... that was strange!
cn: 你想要知道的事代表自然与新生的绿色？许多植物都拥有着翠绿色彩！与车队一起穿越游牧高地期间，我曾有幸见过最动人的绿色。当时我的……“朋友”和我正在夜间散步，这时候我们无意间遇到了一片繁茂无比的花海！奇怪的是，等到第二天再去看的时候……那里已经一片花瓣也看不见了！

en: The improved copper coating of this Tank Chestplate can withstand many more blows at the frontlines of battle.
cn: 改良后的铜质涂层，让这件坦克胸甲在战场前线能承受更多重击。

en:
