Please SUPPORT us and REPORT ISSUES you might encounter. Simply press [F1] when in-game to enter an issue.

We plan to remove the demo on the 22nd of October.

THANK YOU and enjoy the demo and PLEASE WISHLIST, if you like ENSHROUDED!
cn:
《雾锁王国》仍在开发中，将作为抢先体验游戏发布。

- 视觉效果、性能和稳定性并非最终质量。
- 特别是在AMD和非RTX GPU上的动态GI照明尚未完成。

请支持我们并报告您遇到的问题。只需在游戏中按[F1]即可报告问题。

我们将于10月22日删除试玩版。

谢谢您，如果您喜欢《雾锁王国》，请尽情享受试玩版，并将游戏加入愿望清单！

en:
Putrescence laps against the side of this brown hood, like a wave of pestilence crashing to shore.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
就像是冲刷海岸的疫病之潮，腐烂增殖不断拍打着褐色兜帽的两侧。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en:
This sea urchin sits atop a small platform and is too delicate to attempt removal. 

This collectible is found in the Springlands.
cn:
这只海胆位于一个小平台之上，由于过于脆弱，无法将其移走。 

此收藏品在 春日平原 中找到。

en: The great Fell Thunderbrute Greatsword — shrunken for your convenience.
cn: 瘴气魔雷兽的巨剑——为了方便你使用已经特意进行了缩小。

en: Gain one point of Spirit for every two levels of the Flame.
cn: 每两级灵火获得1点精神。

en: You've retrieved the improved millstone. With it, you can craft a mill. The mill will only function when there's a force generator nearby. A force generator can be a water wheel, which is placed in a water stream, or windmill sails. Both can be crafted at the Alchemist.
cn: 你已经取回改良磨盘。有了这件物品，你就可以制作石磨。 石磨只会在附近存在动力来源时运作。动力来源可以是放置在水流中的水轮，或者是风车帆。这两者都可以在炼金术士处制作。

en: When you hit an unaware enemy damage is doubled.
cn: 命中未警觉的敌人时造成双倍伤害。

en: Something terrible's at <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>... I know it in my bones.
cn: 我有种挥之不去的感觉……<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>里面有一个可怕的存在。

en: Did you find remnants of the royal guard yet?
cn: 你找到皇家卫队的残余了吗？

en: Captain Melville Fontane is a fisher and entrepreneur who offers fishing gear.
cn: 梅尔维·冯塔内船长是一位渔夫，同时也是提供垂钓装备的商贩。

en: The perfect soil for growing beautiful flowers. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
cn: 种植美丽花朵的完美土壤。 排水 这种材料会在溢出时排放少量水。

en: Ah, I can see the thirst in your eyes! You've had your hands on a Gem of Bloodlust, right? Do you feel ravenous yet? On a scale of one to ten, how would you describe your urge to annihilate? Oh, didn't I tell you? The "tests" I wanted to conduct all concern you. You're my assistant, as well as my subject. Let me know if you encounter any adverse effects, such as bloodshot eyes, uncontrollable wrath, and the desire to sin.
cn: 啊，我已经能够看见你眼神中的冲动了！你已经拿到了一枚嗜血宝石，对吗？有没有感觉心痒难耐？按照从1到10的标准，你心中的杀戮欲望有多大？哦，我之前忘记告诉你了吗？这些“测试”都是在你身上进行的。你是我的助手，也是我的实验对象。如果有任何负面影响的话，一定要第一时间告诉我，例如双眼充血、不受控制的愤怒还有想要犯罪的冲动。

en: Gathering Wool In The Albaneve Summits
cn: 在阿尔班耶夫山脉收集毛料
黄金瘴气魔独眼巨人战利品

en: Have you noticed? Our best, Emily, seems to fear the Fell Critter. I was surprised to hear that... In <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>, I saw many children play with stuffed toys of their likeness! Sure, it was early on, before the storm, so to say, and perhaps we're out of touch city slickers... but you have to admit: They're quite cute! Would such a plushy ease Emily's fears?
cn: 你发现了吗？我们之中最厉害的艾米丽似乎害怕瘴气魔虫。说实话听到这件事我还是很惊讶的……在<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>的时候，我看见很多孩子都拿着和那些家伙一模一样的毛绒玩具在玩！当然，那是一切刚开始的时候，那时候风暴还没有出现，也有可能我们只是对外界发生的事一概不知的城市居民……但是不得不承认，那些玩具真的很可爱！也许这种毛绒玩具能够帮助缓解艾米丽的恐惧？

en: Inedible, raw meat. Must be cooked over a campfire.
cn: 不适合食用的生肉。必须先架在火上烤熟。

en: These boots seemingly once belonged to a ruler whose name has been lost to time. It faded into oblivion, leaving only a title and a lingering curse.
cn: 这双靴子似乎曾属于一位统治者，但他的名字已被时间湮没。它逐渐被人们遗忘，只留下一个头衔和挥之不去的诅咒。
摘录自瓦尔的英勇传说

en: Fool others looking for hidden passages in your base with this fake secret door.
cn: 使用这扇假暗门来欺骗那些想要找到基地秘密通道的人。

en: The <npc>Hunter</npc> claims that the new survivor, Alden Crowley, reeks of decay. She seems cautious of them and gets shivers when she sees them.
cn: <npc>猎人</npc>宣称新来的幸存者“埃尔登·克劳利”散发着腐朽的气味。她似乎对此人十分警惕，并且表示克劳利让自己感到不寒而栗。

en: The Flame Altar is built, but the land is still strange and unfamiliar. Speak to the Flame in your new base to learn how to proceed.
cn: 灵火祭坛已经建成，但这片土地依然陌生。请与新基地的灵火交谈，了解如何继续前进。

en: Hush now! The night is calling.
Attacking while in the air spawns %k projectiles that home towards your target and deal %k piercing damage.
cn: 在空中时攻击将生成%k枚投掷物，投掷物将追踪你的目标并造成%k穿刺伤害。

en:
Timid little lambs, you should know not to question Lord Vorgoth and his hallowed mission. The gods of the wind have heard your concerns, and they answer with swift violence.

He who spews doubt will be judged by the skies
He who shows fear will be carried away by the Northwinds
He who puts down his arms will be pierced by a heavenly bolt, as Raphael was

Praise the snow! Blessed be Lord Vorgoth, the Guard of the North and Ruler of Rimgard!
cn:
怯弱的羔羊们，不要质疑沃格斯大人与他的神圣使命。狂风之神已经听见你们的疑虑，作为回答，祂们将降下风卷残云般的暴力惩罚。

散播怀疑之人必将受到天空的审判
显露畏惧之人必将被北风卷走
放弃投降之人将被从天而降的箭矢洞穿，就像拉尔夫一样

赞美冰雪！祝福沃格斯大人，北境守卫与里姆加德的统治者！

en: Requires less stamina. Can be activated at larger ranges.
cn: 消耗体力更少。激活距离更远。

en: Too far from the survivor spawn position.
cn: 距离幸存者出生点过远。

en: You've returned. On the outside, you haven't changed — but on the inside, friend, you've gained something you wish you hadn't.
cn: 你回来了。虽然从外表来看一切照旧，但是我的朋友，我知道你的内心中多了一些让你感到懊悔的知识。

en: You've crafted a potion that will enable more carefree movement underwater. Consume the potion and try its effects for yourself to proceed!
cn: 你已经制作了一份能够使你在水下更自由移动的药水。 服下药水并亲自尝试效果以继续！

en: This server offers a role with fewer permissions that doesn't require a password.
cn: 此服务器提供了一个不需要密码即可加入的身份（权限较少）。

en: Gaze at the sunlight washing over the mountains, and bathe in the early warmth as you set out on your journey. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 凝视洒遍山川的朝阳，在清晨暖阳的沐浴下踏上冒险征途。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: I told him to let it go!! I said so, didn't I? The family curse was set to take 'em, and it did! It wasn't me, t'was the curse! It took Wyllma over time, and now Kasper, too! I told him to let the SWORD GO! He wouldn't listen... so we argued. I can't remember much, except... A fight, a flash — and Kasper falling to the ground with a dull thud. I called out. Shook him. No response. He's all gone. He rests under the family tree, next to Wyllma... still clutching that cursed thing. I never want to see it ever again!
cn: 我明明叫他放手了！！怎么就不听我的呢？ 都说了有家族诅咒，最后的确成真了啊！不是我干的，那就是诅咒！维尔玛已经成了牺牲品，现在就要轮到卡斯帕了！我早就告诉过他，要他把剑放下！ 但他就是不肯听……接着我们就吵了起来。我记不清当时到底发生了什么，我只记得……我们扭打了起来，我就瞥见了一道闪光，停下来之后，我发现卡斯帕已经砰的一声倒在了地上。我当时立刻大喊并用力摇晃他，但是毫无回应。她已经死了。 现在他和维尔玛一起在家族之树根须下长眠……那把该死的东西还在他的手里。我永远不想再看见那个东西！

en:
This tomb is dedicated to all who passed without a family to bury them.

Lost souls of unknown names, untold stories, unsigned wills.
Elders who've turned to dust, leaving only ash where there should be splendor and wisdom.
Wanderers with no friends to sing their praises or dry their tears. 
Children whose breaths were taken away before their laughter could light up the sky.

We sear their initials into our minds, branding ourselves in their stead. We carry their burden on our backs, battered and beaten. We remember those who are lost, reliving the sorrows of the past — the reverberating pain of a healing wound — to burst open anew, relapse, and drown in gloom every blue moon.

The memories are painful, but we carry them in our hearts evermore, for no pain burns brighter than fading to black.
cn:
这个坟墓献给所有孤苦伶仃的逝者。

献给无名无姓、被人遗忘，也从未留下过遗嘱的迷失之人。
献给化为尘土的老者们，本该是辉煌与智慧的却只有一抹灰烬。
献给没有亲朋好友来缅怀或哀悼的漂泊之人。
献给还没来得放声大笑便过早离世的孩子们。

我们将他们的缩写字母铭记于心，我们将代替他们继续前行。哪怕伤痕累累，疲惫不堪，我们仍将接过他们的重担。我们记得每一个迷失之人，我们从未忘记那过去的哀愁，就像是伤口愈合时的阵痛，每一次蓝月升起之时，那些伤口就会再一次崩裂绽开，并让我们陷入阴郁。

这些回忆痛苦至极，但我们将义无反顾把它们纳入心中，因为这世间最痛苦的，莫过于在遗忘中隐入黑暗。
游牧高地 空荡礼堂

en: I feel the urge to sap a soul from the underground. What good are all these bones when they're lifeless and cold? Let's fill them with a purpose.
cn: 我渴望汲取来自地下的灵魂。这些了无生机的冰冷白骨有什么用处？我们得为它们带去目标。

en: I know it sounds silly, but a good ol' <keyitem>Kettle</keyitem> over a nice and toasty <craftingstation>Cooking Station</craftingstation> would make this place feel more like "home". Oh, all the meals we could make...!
cn: 我知道你肯定会觉得这有点傻，但是我认为暖烘烘的<craftingstation>烹饪站</craftingstation>与<keyitem>烧水壶</keyitem>一定能够让这个地方更有“家的温馨”。而且有了那些东西之后，我们就能准备各式各样的菜肴了……！

en: Obtain The Sword Of The Serpent

Took ya long enough to find me! Look at you — weak and puny. And they call you Flameborn? First thing you need is equipment... lucky you woke me up first. Crafting a Scrappy Sword, a Spiked Club or some armor will serve us well!
cn: 总算来了！看看你，怎么一副弱不禁风的样子。堂堂火之子就这种样子么？首先需要的是设备... 幸好你先找到了我。你可以先从制作废料剑或者尖刺棒 或一些铠甲 开始着手！

en: Descend into the Hollow Halls and venture where I cannot!
cn: 进入空荡礼堂，探索我无法触及的深处！

en: Child of the Flame, you've acquired the right tools to protect yourself against the cold. Let us test for how long you can withstand it — trial by fire, trial by snow. A trial by blood found deep below.
cn: 灵火之子，你已经拥有了能够保护自己免受寒冷侵扰的工具。让我们来看看你能坚持多久 — 火焰的试炼，冰雪的试炼。以及地底深处的鲜血试炼。

en: A good barber is worth his weight in gold!

Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.
cn: 战争夺走了无数士兵的生命。那些能够活着归来的人们都会被赠予黄金与各种礼物；对于一位受人敬仰的老兵，赠送武器是一种再合适不过的选择……但是对于某些人来说，这种礼物只会让他们再次想起那些不堪回首的过去。

en: A basic sword, forged for fighters that are just starting out.
cn: 一把基础的剑，专为初出茅庐的战士准备。

en: The Shroud Root is the source of our misery. Destroy it with a felling axe and prosper.
cn: 瘴气根是一切苦痛的来源。只有用伐木斧摧毁它才能走向复兴。

en: You currently don't have any unfinished Player Quests
cn: 你目前没有任何未完成的玩家任务

en: The wizard’s final experiment resulted in an eternal ice bolt spell. He believed he could use it to freeze himself and, in doing so, achieve eternal life — in a way. Go back to the Alchemist and tell him about your findings.
cn: 巫师最后的实验创造出了一种永恒寒冰矢法术。他相信自己可以用这种法术来冰冻自己的身体，并借此获得另一种形式的永生。 回去找炼金术士并将你的发现告诉他。

en: A flare that will stick to any surface. You can use it to mark and ping an area.
cn: 能够黏着在一切表面上的信号焰。你可以用它来标记并照亮一块区域。

en: Bindings using the same inputs in different orders were detected. We advise against using them.
cn: 检测到有其他以不同顺序使用相同输入的绑定。我们建议你谨慎使用。

en: The slotted Gem will also be destroyed! Remove it at a Gem Forge first to keep it.
cn: 这么做将立即摧毁已经嵌入的宝石！建议先前往宝石锻炉移除宝石。

en: Unlocks Special Abilities of Two-Handed Melee weapons. Press %k to unleash a powerful Special Ability after generating enough Focus. Focus Generate Focus by attacking. Focus can be built up with any weapon type and is used to trigger Special Abilities of weapons.
cn: 解锁双手近战武器的特殊能力。 拥有充足专注时按%k释放强大的特殊能力。 专注 攻击将生成专注。所有类型的武器都可以积累专注，你可以花费专注来发动武器的特殊能力。

en: Ignites roaring flames which incinerate foes quickly. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 这把魔棒施放的熊熊烈焰将把敌人迅速焚烧殆尽。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: Every swing of this axe leaves a tear in the veil that separates the living from the beyond. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.
cn: 这把斧子的每一次挥舞都将撕裂分隔生与死的彼界帷幕。 空荡回音： 这把武器释放的不洁回响魔力能够延长攻击范围。

en:
No longer does it reach for the sorrowful and the damned. The hunger in the dark was razed. Our dreams and minds are safe, for now.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
不再呼唤着哀愁与末路。黑暗中的饥饿终于被消除。我们的梦境与心智暂时安全了。

收集数个瘴气魔怪物头颅以制作黑铁战利品。

en: You've set the mountains ablaze — good. But yours is not the only fire that warms the cold nights! Northern soldiers, or what is left of them, reign in the Albaneve Summits! They expanded there to build Elixir Wells, smelting obsidian and steel to defend them... most likely in a nearby forge. Such a place must have great tools inside... tools we could use for a blast furnace!
cn: 你已经点燃山脉，很好。但是并不是只有你的火焰能够抵御黑夜的寒冷！北境的士兵，或者说是残存的北境士兵仍然统治着阿尔班耶夫山脉！曾经他们的领地也扩张到了那个地方，他们在那里建造了许多魔药之井、并且还熔炼了黑曜石与钢铁来保护自己……那附近肯定有一座锻炉。那里面肯定有很多好工具……只要拿到那些东西，我们就可以建造高炉了！

en: After finetuning the Health Potion, the ingredients were adjusted, instantly restoring a great amount of health upon consumption.
cn: 在对生命药水进行微调后，成分得到调整，服用后可立即恢复大量生命。

en: Targeting an enemy for a few seconds while aiming or blocking puts a mark on the enemy. Attacking the marked enemy deals %k additional fire damage. The mark can stack up to 3 times by continued targeting, increasing the bonus damage by %k at 2 stacks and %k at 3 stacks.
cn: 瞄准或者是格挡状态下，锁定敌人数秒后将对其施加标记。攻击被标记的敌人将额外造成%k火焰伤害。持续锁定将至多堆叠3层标记，额外伤害将分别提高至%k（2层）与%k（3层）。

en: This spinning machine can refine wool and is more effective at producing string and linen.
cn: 纺织机能够加工毛料，并且能够以更高的效率生产线绳与亚麻布。

en:
The Flame has told you about a new path to the snow-covered mountains. To reach this new frontier, you have to pass through a cavernous passage first. 

Travel through the cave passage and proceed into the mountains to spread your fire and call upon a new dawn!
cn:
灵火提到了一条通往白雪皑皑的山脉的新道路。为了抵达这个新的边疆，首先你需要穿过一条洞穴隧道。

穿越洞穴隧道并深入山脉，在那里散播你的火焰并引导崭新黎明的到来！

en: You've reached the prison that Anton Godwin was held in. Search the prison for any traces of Anton and rescue his soul to please his cousin, Oscar!
cn: 你已经抵达了安东·戈德温被关押的监狱。在监狱中搜寻安东的下落，他的表亲奥斯卡恳求你拯救安东的灵魂！

en: Find The <keyitem>Circular Sawblades</keyitem> In The Scavenger Camp
cn: 在拾荒者营地中找到<keyitem>圆形锯片</keyitem>
咖啡，有史以来最伟大的饮品

en: Difficulty can only be changed before starting a session. To change the difficulty of your server, select it in the world list and click "Edit".
cn: 只能够在开始进程前调整难度。如果需要调整自己的服务器难度，请选择世界列表并点击“编辑”。

en: Mine terrain for the first time.
These gloves allow nimble fingers to patch up wounds when in a pinch.
cn: 这副手套可以让手指在紧要关头灵活地包扎伤口。

en: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.
cn: 那些成功崭露头角的新兵偶尔会得到黄金装饰的武器作为礼物。虽然与其他质朴的武器相比并没有任何战斗能力上的区别，但是持有这种武器被认为是一种身份的象征。

en: Investigate the third stop on Kaori's shipment's route to find the next hat!
cn: 调查嘉里的货运路线上的第三个停靠点以寻找下一顶帽子！

en: Discover An Easier Way To Grind Materials
cn: 发现能够更轻松研磨材料的方法

en: A club was found at a Vukah location.
cn: 已在一处沃卡位置找到了一根棍棒。

en: A giant mace that is able to damage even enemies with the toughest of armors. Where blades fail, the mace might be a friend in need.
cn: 巨大的钉锤，甚至能够击穿最厚实的铠甲。如果刀剑效果不佳，那就是时候和这把钉锤交个朋友了。

en: The metal rim around this hood forms an elegant crown, jagging out from the wearer's skull. The shape of the tips is reminiscent of wings.
cn: 兜帽的金属边缘构成一个从穿戴者颅顶凸出来的优雅王冠。尖端的形状会让人联想到翅膀。

en: A sublime staff that carries an eerie visage and blank stare. Its face seems as if it were looking up at you from beneath the motionless surface of a black moor.
cn: 拥有着诡异形象与空白凝视的奇特法杖。它的面孔仿佛就像是正在从一片漆黑沼泽的死寂表面之下窥视着你。

en:
A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.

Boosts health and stamina upon consumption.
cn:
一大碗有益身体健康的清新水果。

食用后提高生命值与体力。

en: "<lorename>Captain Arkwright</lorename>" is engraved in the metal. Given to the most loyal commanders.
cn: 戒指上刻着“<lorename>阿克怀特队长</lorename>”。只有最忠诚的指挥官才能收到这样的戒指。

en: Look what washed ashore! A small fry with a big catch, it seems! Those Drak Scales look sturdy and fresh... They're from a youngin'. Damn it all! That means they've had enough time to breed, lay countless eggs, hatch... and feed their brood with our land! To kill the beast, cut off its head — but before we can challenge their leader, we've got to send them a message they'll understand!
cn: 快看是什么被冲上岸了！没想到你这个小虾米来了次大丰收！那些卓克鳞片看上去很牢固而且新鲜……它们应该是从幼崽身上弄下来的。该死！这意味着那帮家伙已经有充足的时间来繁殖，它们肯定早就产下了无数的蛋，然后再孵化……它们在蚕食我们的土地！看来只有砍下头颅才能阻止这些怪物……但是在我们挑战它们的首领之前，我们得让它们先明白我们的厉害！

en: A saber often carried by gentlewomen, slim enough to fit nicely underneath a petticoat if needed.
cn: 名媛贵妇使用的弯刀，剑身细长，因此可以轻松隐藏在衬裙之中。

en:
New iron teeth now line its disturbing grin. 

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
现在，新的铁牙将衬托出它令人不安的笑脸。 

收集多个 空荡独眼巨人 Heads，制作铁制奖杯。

en: Fell Draconian Vulture, Kindlewastes Shroud and Albaneve Summits Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔残酷秃鹫，燃火荒原以及阿尔班耶夫山脉瘴气区
建立第一个基地的平原

en:
Another day goes by. The snow tranquilizes the world outside, and my heart feels heavier with every beat. Each new night competes with the last to be the coldest. I wish you were by my side to warm me.

Amelie, your chair broke today. I tried to fix it, but my old back protested. Still, I couldn't throw it out, either. It just lies there, shambles of the past with no use but to bring pain at the remembrance. What a rotten day.
If you were here, you'd cheer me up. I would find you in the garden by the purple flowers you favored, your hair swaying in the breeze like the petals. You would turn around, and the light in your eyes would fill my dull, slowing heart with brightness.

I yearn to remember you only as that lilac whirlwind. To see you when I look at the winter blossoms, not the broken remains of a rickety chair.
But it's hard because you're all around. In the good, and the bad.
Still, If I could run away with you again, I would. I would always choose you, my little amethyst.
cn:
又一天过去了。积雪让外面的世界变得无比安静，而我的心也变得愈发沉重。每天晚上都愈发让我感到刺骨冰冷。真希望你能在身边温暖我。

艾美莉亚，今天你的椅子坏了。虽然我想要修好它，但是我的老腰似乎不太行了。但就算是这样，我还是舍不得扔掉那把椅子。现在它就倒在地上，像过去的回忆一样，除了带来痛苦以外毫无用处。今天真是不能再糟糕了。
要是你在这里就好了，你肯定知道该怎么给我打气。你会待在花园里，身边都是你喜欢的那种紫色鲜花，你的头发就像是花瓣一样迎风飞舞。这时候你会转过身，在你双眼里的光芒会立刻照亮我我这颗冰冷阴郁的心。

要是只有旋转不停的丁香花瓣能够让我想起你就好了。你应该像是寒冬中怒放的鲜花，而不是一把破破烂烂的摇椅。
但我做不到，你无处不在。无论是生活的美好还是糟糕都让我想起你。
如果再给我一次选择的机会，我仍然会和你一起私奔。我永远会毫不犹豫地选择你，你是我最美丽的紫水晶。

en: Pants that were formerly worn by soldiers of Lord <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>, oldest son to Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>. Legends say he was consumed by the Shroud after the Ancients pushed him off Howling Peak's summit.
cn: <lorename>派克米德</lorename>女王的长子<lorename>沃格斯</lorename>领主麾下士兵曾穿过的裤子。传说在被远古者从呼啸崇山的山顶被推入万丈深渊后，这位领主便彻底被瘴气所吞噬。

en: Filled with the burning Spark of the Flame, it's a valuable asset in the fight against the Shroud. It increases the time you can withstand the Shroud.
cn: 蕴含着灵火的余火，这枚戒指是对抗瘴气的宝贵装备。延长能够抵挡瘴气的时间。

en: An empty pouch. It can be filled at a well or any other water source.
cn: 一个空水袋。能够在水井或其他水源处灌水。

en: <location>Thornhold</location> has fallen to Scavengers. The town has been looted, and there are no <keyitem>Circular Sawblades</keyitem> to be found. Perhaps there are clues nearby.
cn: <location>荆棘堡</location>已经被拾荒者洗劫一空，根本找不到任何<keyitem>圆形锯片</keyitem>。也许附近能够找到其他线索。

en:
Nowadays it's rare to find crustaceans, petrified or alive. When crabs were still plentiful, they were caught for meat and later thrown back into the ocean as empty shells to appease the tides. This tradition didn't protect the waters from being corrupted by the Shroud, so it soon lost cultural relevance.

This collectible is found in the Kindlewastes.
cn:
如今，无论是石化的还是活着的甲壳类动物都很少见了。在螃蟹还很丰富的时候，人们捕捉螃蟹来吃肉，然后把空壳扔回大海，以安抚潮汐。这种传统并不能保护海水免受 瘴气 的侵蚀，因此很快就失去了文化意义。

此收藏品在 燃火荒原 中找到。

en: Gems can be leveled up at Shroud Forges to increase their power.
cn: 你可以在瘴气锻炉升级宝石并提升它们的力量。

en: A magical wand carved out of bones. Lifeless and cold, it shoots magical ice projectiles. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 使用骸骨雕刻而成的魔棒。这把阴冷而且死气沉沉的武器能够发射魔法寒冰射弹。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: The Barber is fascinated by the Hollow and the envious look in their dead eyes. He mentioned a graveyard near the capital he frequented when he was younger and suggested you explore the crypt. Reach the Hidden Hollow Tomb to proceed!
cn: 理发师对空荡以及这些亡灵眼中的嫉妒充满好奇。他提到年轻时候经常去首都附近的一座陵园，并希望你去探索那里的墓穴。 抵达隐藏空荡墓穴以继续！

en: Think of all the power you could wield if your weapons were equipped with gems!
cn: 想象一下，假如得到宝石加持，你的武器一定能够所向披靡！

en: A weaker form of poison, but poisonous nonetheless.
cn: 一种较弱的毒素，但依旧不容小觑。

en: Tools deal %k increased damage against wood. This includes trees and wooden terrain.
cn: 工具对木头造成%k额外伤害。 这包括树木与木制地形。

en: When a drakling hatches from its shell, its lowered, elongated body appears almost snake-like. However, they soon adapt an upright posture and bare their teeth — this process is represented through the design of this mace.
cn: 当一只龙裔从蛋壳中孵化出来之后，它细长的下半身几乎与蛇类一模一样。不过它们很快就会适应直立的形态并开始龇牙咧嘴——这把钉锤的造型灵感就是来源于那个过程。

en: A farmbed which will yield Hemp Fibres.
cn: 能够产出大麻纤维的农地。

en: (The writing is crude, and the signs are written with short, apathetic scratches. A plaque reads: Example for rudimentary Drak writing, found by fishers dredging near the archipelago. Presumed age: Recent.) Drak'Mer weak. Why breed underwater? Lay eggs in ponds? Waste of time. Dalszul would never. Would build temples. Adorned in gold. Would force humans, brick by brick. Young Drak should hatch and stomp their feet! Should stick spears in land that belongs to them! Not splish and splash! That's why Drak'Dal strong! Big muscles! Lift stone! Spill blood! Hail Dalszul! Rah Rah!
cn: （字迹十分粗糙，而且标志都是用短促胡乱的刮痕写就的。一块牌匾写着：基础卓克文字的示例，在群岛附近的渔夫据点找到。预计年代：现代。） 卓克·莫尔软弱。为什么在水下繁殖？在池塘里下蛋？浪费时间。 达尔斯祖尔永远不会那么做。反而会建造神殿。用黄金装饰。而且会逼迫人类，一块砖一块砖。 年轻的卓克应该孵化然后跺脚！应该将长矛插进属于他们的土地！而不是在海边踩水！ 所以卓克·达尔才强大！肌肉强壮！能够搬石头！挥洒鲜血！ 达尔斯祖尔万岁！拉·拉！

en: Staying on the beat would be easier with someone manning the drums!
cn: 如果有人能够帮忙敲鼓打节拍的话，我就不用担心自己跑调了！

en: Reach And Loot The Draconian Vulture Nest
cn: 抵达并搜刮残酷秃鹫巢穴

en: Increases the skill level of Skill Shot
cn: 提高技巧射击的技能等级

en: <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location> has been ravaged. The <npc>Farmer</npc>'s friend <lorename>Raúl</lorename> must be hiding in a safe place amidst the peril. Perhaps the <keyitem>Kettle</keyitem> can still be found somewhere.
cn: <location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>已被攻陷。<npc>农民</npc>的朋友<lorename>劳尔</lorename>肯定正在安全地点避难。也许附近能够找到<keyitem>烧水壶</keyitem>。

en:
The Hydrak'Dal would surely be outraged that you covered his golden decorations with bronze. Fortunately, he can no longer complain.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
cn:
要是知道你使用青铜盖住了那些黄金装饰，海卓克·达尔肯定会暴跳如雷。不过幸运的是，他现在已经没办法再抱怨了。

收集多个海卓克·达尔头颅以制作青铜战利品。

en: Light, polstered and ready to take a few hits — the perfect chest armor for a beginner.
cn: 缝有内垫的轻便胸甲，适合初学者的结实选择。

en: A pair of dark, grey daggers adorned with a bright green gem the color of envy. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 这对深灰色的匕首上镶嵌有一枚象征嫉妒的亮绿色宝石。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Heads plummet to the ground, eyes shut in terror. Victims prefer darkness rather than to face the Guillotine.
cn: 那些身首分离的牺牲者无一例外都在惊恐中双眼紧闭。这是因为在断头台面前，临终之人只想在黑暗中度过最后的时刻。

en: The bard Valory wants you to search all of Embervale for fossils. There are four fossils in the Revelwood and Blackmire combined. Each fossil can be found multiple times in different places. The Bard advised searching mines, dig sites, and ore deposits to find all fossils.
cn: 吟游诗人瓦罗里希望你寻找遍布在薪谷中的化石。喧嚣森林以及黑沼中总共存在4种化石。你可以在不同地点反复找到各种化石。如果要找到所有种类的化石，吟游诗人建议前往各地的矿井、挖掘场以及矿点搜索。

en: I believe the Shroud to be spores. Tiny, almost minuscule fragments that spread through the air... now condensed, heavy, and potent. They cling to airways, eyes, fur, and skin. They spread. The fungi release these spores upon contact, but their roots might've been anchored below us for a long time... We awoke a slumbering malady at the earth's core when we built the initial Wells and distilled the first Elixir. The Mysterious Wanderer opened the floodgates to ruin, pushing us down a spiraling staircase towards doom. — Balthazar, 501 D.A.
cn: 我认为瘴气的本质应该是孢子。原本只是在空气中飘散的细小碎片，几乎无法被肉眼发现……但是现在孢子已经沉积在一起，因此也变得更加沉重有力。它们会附着在喉咙、眼睛、毛皮还有赤裸的皮肤上。它们正在增殖散播。 真菌会在与其他物体接触时施放孢子，但是它们的根须很有可能已经在我们脚下沉睡了很长一段时间……当初为了首次提炼魔药而建造第一批深井时，我们唤醒了这些在地心沉睡的疫病之源。神秘旅人打开了通往毁灭的闸门，无情地洪水将我们从螺旋下降的楼梯冲向了最深处的末日。 — 巴尔萨扎，501 D.A.

en: A hang drum is a hand-played steel instrument whose gentle tones spread like ripples across still water.
cn: 手鼓是一种直接用手演奏的钢制乐器，温柔的旋律就像是水面上徐徐扩散的涟漪。

en:
A warrior's boots that used to brandish a golden sheen. They've dulled due to the fungal overgrowth.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
属于战士的靴子，曾经散发着金色的光彩。如今黯淡的表面已经长满真菌增殖。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: I want a beautiful little Yak as a new friend...
cn: 我想要一头漂亮的小牦牛当我的新朋友……

en: Time in the Shroud is increased by %k, allowing you to explore for longer. Time in the Shroud Should this time run out, the Shroud will consume you.
cn: 瘴气停留时间延长%k，让你能探索更久。 瘴气停留时间 如果停留时间耗尽，你将被瘴气吞噬。

en: A hat that is made both practical and fun with added fluffy fur.
cn: 顾虑到实用性与趣味的帽子，额外缝有一圈毛茸茸的皮草。

en: The Shroud, Elixir, and Elixir Wells
Reinforced gloves with makeshift chitin plating.
cn: 使用简易几丁质硬板加固过的手套。

en: Find The Chest By The Church
An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".
cn: 盖尔福斯家族引以为豪的祖传武器，最后持有它的人是维吉尔·盖尔福斯。维吉尔留下过一句很出名的话：“如果想要这把武器，你只能从我毫无生气的冰冷双手中夺过去”。

en: A metal crown, coursing with electrifying energy. Wearing it makes the hair on your body stand up.
cn: 闪电能量正在这顶金属头冠中奔腾。戴上它之后，你全身的毛发都会不由自主地竖起来。

en: The Hunter, Athalan Skree, wants to see animal fur. She will share a secret with you once you bring some to her.
cn: 猎人阿萨兰·斯克里想要一些动物毛皮。只要你能满足这个要求，她将与你分享一个秘密。

en: A provisional tool used to deal fast and ugly cuts.
cn: 能够让目标迅速遍体鳞伤的简易镰刀。

en: Sharp extensions jut out from the blade's periphery: an assortment of stingers, sharpened flint, and horns. A strike from this jagged edge will rip and tear almost anything.
cn: 尖锐的凸起物从剑身边缘伸出：那是一系列尖刺、锐利的燧石还有犄角。一旦被这种尖锐的边缘击中，一切血肉都将灰飞烟灭。

en: These daggers mark the next stage for young Drak after training with bamboo sticks. Their compact size makes them easy to wield even from an early age. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 在结束了使用竹竿训练的阶段后，年轻的卓克将会开始使用这些匕首。小巧的尺寸使得那些幼崽也能够轻松拿捏。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Shared world not found. Make sure you entered the correct Share Code.
cn: 未找到共享世界。请确保你已输入正确的分享码。

en: Lords, I feel filthy... but at least I am breathing! My name is Kaori Conway, I ship wares with my partner! Is my fiance anywhere? I must confess to him that I lost some wares due to... uhm...a faulty axle.
cn: 老天爷，我身上真的太脏了……但至少我还活着！我是嘉里·康威，我与我的爱人都是货运商！你知道我的未婚夫在哪吗？有件事我必须告诉他，之前因为……呃……车轴损坏，我弄丢了一批货。

en: Defeating an enemy with a Melee weapon restores %k durability to that weapon.
cn: 使用近战武器打败敌人将使武器恢复%k耐久。

en: Has anyone seen the hounds we confiscated from our prisoner, Lupa? I left them roaming in the courtyard, but when I woke up yesterday morning, they had disappeared! I'm sure they must've just slipped away... but something tells me the sudden cold of that evening, and the strange howling around midnight were not coincidences. I saw tracks leading to the nearby tower, but I'd be a fool to follow them! Can't we get an intern to check, instead?
cn: 有没有人看见我们之前从囚犯卢帕那里收缴的猎犬？ 之前我把它们留在了庭院里，但是等昨天醒来之后，我发现它们全不见了！那些家伙肯定是溜走了……但是我觉得那天晚上的突然降温，还有午夜期间的奇怪嚎叫肯定不是巧合。 我发现了有多条通往附近高塔的踪迹，但我可不傻，我才不会去那里！能不能找个实习生去调查一下？

en: When I first laid eyes on the reward the Mysterious Wanderer promised me, I was insulted. However, I quickly realized that this specter, this ghost who distorts reality as if I'm entering a dream, has bestowed me with a great gift... I hid the corrupted staff atop the wooden structure to overlook the Elixir distillery — only I deserve it. The visions of the floating figure still haunt me... I feel I might be dreaming, still.
cn: 最初看见神秘旅人允诺给我的奖励时，我感觉自己受到了侮辱。 但是很快我便意识到，这其实是幽灵扭曲了现实，导致一切就像在梦境中一样模糊不清。它给我送上来一份惊人的礼物…… 我将腐化法杖藏在了俯瞰魔药酿造室的木制建筑顶部，这是只属于我一个人的宝物。直到现在，那个飘忽不定的身影还在我的脑海中挥之不散……我担心自己还没有从梦境中醒来。

en: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.
cn: 能够在合适的土壤环境中成长的幼苗。完全成熟后可以反复采集。

en: Increases your Shroud Resistance by %k, which reduces the amount of Shroud damage received.
cn: 使你的瘴气抗性提高%k，这将降低你承受的瘴气伤害。

en:
Armor provides protection based on its Armor values.
Each point of Armor reduces incoming damage by 1, up to a maximum of 60% damage reduction. This maximum can be increased with skills.

There are physical and magical Armor types, each matching the incoming damage types.. Check an item’s Armor values in the Inventory (Most Recent Tab).
cn:
护甲根据其护甲值提供防护。
每点护甲可减少1点伤害，最高可减少60%的伤害。（这个上限可以通过技能提升。）

护甲包括物理和魔法抗性，与受到的伤害类型相对应。在物品栏（最近打开的面板）中查看物品的护甲值。

en: While the Elixir Buff is active, dealing damage activates the "Satisfied Battle Mania" buff, granting %k health, %k stamina, and %k mana regeneration for %k. Each additional hit refreshes the duration of that buff; however, once it runs out, the "Unsatisfied Battle Mania" debuff will suspend any health, stamina, and mana regeneration for %k.
cn: 激活魔药增益时，造成伤害将触发”战斗狂热·心满意足“增益，赋予%k生命值、%k体力以及%k法力恢复，持续%k。之后每次额外命中敌人都将刷新增益持续时间。但是，当增益结束时，你将承受”战斗狂热·心痒难耐“减益，中断所有生命值、体力以及法力恢复，持续%k。
寻觅新发色：最伟大的绿色

en:
11. Changes to this privacy policy

The current version of this privacy policy is always available at
cn:
11. 此隐私政策的更改

此隐私政策的当前版本永远在此处查看：

en: Hits restore a percentage of damage dealt as Health
cn: 命中时恢复等同于部分伤害量的生命值

en: Soft, water-soaked mud, hauled up from the bottom of a lake or silent stream.
cn: 被水浸泡的柔软泥土，从湖底或者是静静的溪流底部挖掘而出。

en: Try searching in the little towns and villages — maybe the people there left behind sparks of inspiration.
cn: 尝试在小镇与村庄中搜索，也许那里的人们留下了灵感的启迪。

en: Creamy butter with milky richness — perfect for bringing depth and tenderness to your baked creations.
cn: 口感绵密而且带有浓香奶味的奶白黄油，最适合为烘焙点心增添风味深度与松软口感。

en: The embellishments on this sword seem inspired by eastern craftsmanship, but the choice of material betrays the maker's origin. This weapon was most likely forged by a well-traveled blacksmith or commissioned by an aristocrat.
cn: 这把大剑的造型有着浓厚的东方工艺风格，但是材料本身却揭示了锻造者的真正身份。这把武器很有可能是某位游历四方的铁匠的作品，或者是某位贵族定做的产物。

en: A music sheet for a bright song fit for any lively tavern. Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 这张乐谱中记载着适合热闹酒馆的欢快歌曲。 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。

en: Can place flame altars, extinguish flames, and upgrade bases
cn: 能够放置灵火祭坛、熄灭火焰或者是升级基地

en: These golden boots carried the "Scholars of the Young Flame" across the open roads of Embervale. The soles still carry dust from places you have yet to discover.
cn: 这些金色的靴子曾经载着“星火学者”跨越了薪谷的辽阔大道。鞋底上沾满了从你尚未发现之地带回来的尘埃。

en: I'm bored of hair colors again. I need something more "fresh", like a cold splash of water! Come to think of it... nothing would be fresher than ice from the Albaneve Summits! At that altitude, you'd be close to the stars, too. My heart demands I wander northward, but my fear of heights instructs me to send you instead. I'm a hairstylist, not a mountain climber!
cn: 我又一次厌倦了那些一成不变的发色。这次我需要更加“清新”的色彩，就像是凉爽的清水一样！不过这么一想……最清新的应该莫过于来自阿尔班耶夫山脉的寒冰！在那里的山巅，你几乎都可以伸手触摸到天空的星辰。我的心要求我向北方进发，但我恐高，所以只能转而拜托你了。我是个发型师，不是什么攀岩运动员！

en: Coffee that's been refined with a splash of milk. The mild aroma makes it easy to sip!
cn: 添加了一份牛奶之后变得更为精致的咖啡。温和的香气让人忍不住想要一饮而尽！
墓碑“直到我们再次重逢”

en: An exciting journey begins! I am setting out from Brittlebush where I bargained hard for this map. I wonder if this mysterious Oasis is really as lush as that seller promised? Regardless, I sold all my worldly possessions and purchased enough rations and water to get me there and back again! I almost didn't have enough, but selling my trusty Glider filled my pockets with plenty of coin! Lucky me! I plan to camp by the ancient bones due east.
cn: 激动人心的冒险开始了！此刻我正从碎丛出发，我的手里紧紧攥着花大价钱买来的地图。不知道这个神秘的绿洲是否真像卖家说的那样，是一片青翠茂密的乐园？ 无论如何，我已经变卖了自己的财产，并且购买了足够支撑我往返的口粮与饮水！虽然购置物资时还是少了点钱，但我的可靠滑翔翼给我换来了充足的钱币！ 我真是太幸运了！接下来我打算在正东方的古代骸骨处扎营。

en: This byproduct of the Charcoal Kiln has many useful properties, which can be used in medicine and alchemy.
cn: 炭窑的副产品在医药与炼金术领域有着众多用处。

en: Nothing is more suitable for a long prowl than this set of pants.
cn: 没有什么比这条裤子更适合长途跋涉了。

en: Movement speed of all enemies within 10 meters is halved.
cn: 10米范围内所有敌人的移动速度减半。

en: The Huntress needs a Spinning Machine to refine raw wool. Craft a Spinning Machine with her to proceed!
cn: 女猎人需要一台纺织机才能加工粗毛料。为女猎人制作一台纺织机以继续！

en: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.
cn: 这件武器的设计风格让人一眼就能想到盘旋于燃火荒原之上的凶狠残酷秃鹫。

en: A plant known for its flowers and the deep blue organic pigment that can be won by processing it.
cn: 这种植物以独特的花朵与通过将其加工得到的深蓝色天然染料而闻名。

en: The <npc>Blacksmith</npc> revealed the location of an iron mine under the Shroud. The spot is marked on the map.
cn: <npc>铁匠</npc>揭示了瘴气下的铁矿位置。地图上标出了该地点。

en: Flameborn — Have you explored any Elixir Well in the Kindlewastes? They are the youngest of their kind! Oh, they send shivers down my spine. If we nabbed some Well Blocks from their depths, we could create a true monument!
cn: 火之子，你有探索过燃火荒原里面的魔药之井吗？那些都是最近才出现的！一想到那里我就有种不寒而栗的感觉。不过要是我们能从那里的深处找到一些魔井方块的话，我们说不定就能创造出真正值得一提的建筑了！

en:
Hard to believe there is an even better concoction.

This one instantly restores a massive amount of health.
cn:
难以置信竟然还有效果更好的药剂。

这种药水能够瞬间恢复海量生命值。

en: The ingredients found in the Albaneve Summits make me feel inspired. We should cook some regional food together! Something that will keep us warm and cozy... like some meat, a beef stew, or creamy pumpkin soup!
cn: 在阿尔班耶夫山脉找到的食材给了我一些新的灵感。也许我们可以一起试着烹饪一些特色美食！比如能够让人温暖放松的食物……单纯的肉食、牛肉汤或者是味道浓郁的南瓜汤都很不错！

en: A sizeable ectoplasm crystal. Its properties allow it to store life force for eons.
cn: 尺寸可观的灵质水晶。特殊的晶体能够持久存储生命之力。

en: The music sounds better with you.
cn: 有你在旁边，音乐也更加动听了。

en: Magical ammunition that, upon use, releases continuous healing projectiles. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 魔法弹药，使用时将持续施放治疗射弹。 引导法术：在一段时间内维持按键以持续引导。装备法术并消耗法力来用 法杖施法。

en: DaryRakiro Last seen in a stream Fox the Valiant Witch, Lover, Eater of Men Britva Mother, House of Underscore Kyie Nassu Pumpkins Dug her grave, now lies in it Futerko Queen of little empires Sir Frandulin and Lady Petrana If time ends, eternity begins Mistress Sianna Companion of Master Fluffers Here Lies Mr and Mrs Gingey Lovers From Different Places Lafondar the Drudge Built boxes, now boxed eternal Noveron Die together in Leubogdania
cn: DaryRakiro 最后见于直播间 Fox the Valiant 女巫、爱人、吞噬男人之人 Britva 母亲，下划线之屋 Kyie Nassu Pumpkins 自掘坟墓 Futerko 小小帝国的女王 Sir Frandulin&Lady Petrana 时间的终结是永恒的开始 Mistress Sianna 软软大师的伴侣 Gingey夫妇长眠于此 来自不同之地的爱 Lafondar the Drudge 亲手打造的盒子成为了永恒的归宿 Noveron 在Leubogdania一同赴死

en: It's a good day to be alive, isn't it? I'm Chester, and people call me the "Lucky" Chester Loft. I suppose today it wasn't luck that saved me, but your valiant act of heroism! Oh, I'm inspired! Would you prefer a sonnet or an operetta in your name?
cn: 能够活着真是太好了，对吗？我叫切斯特，人们叫我“幸运之人”切斯特·洛夫特。不过我猜今天拯救我的并不是运气，而是你的英勇事迹！哦，我感觉现在灵感迸发！请问你想听我为你创作一首十四行诗还是轻歌剧？
已激活未完成的世界任务

en: Uses salt to conserve furs for further usage. Place near a <npc>Hunter</npc>.
cn: 利用盐的特性来延长毛皮的保存时间。需要放置在<npc>猎人</npc>附近。

en: When you receive Shroud damage, all players within %k meters receive %k increased Shroud Resistance for 30 seconds.
cn: 当你承受瘴气伤害时，附近%k米范围内的所有玩家都将获得额外%k的瘴气抗性，持续30秒。

en:
Cauterize the wound. Cleanse the spreading stain, and erase the festering blight. The light of the Flame cannot be denied.

Collect multiple Fell Thunderbrute Heads to craft the Iron Trophy.
cn:
用火焰封闭伤口，净化不断扩散的污秽并祛除滋生的毒素。灵火的光明永驻。

收集数个瘴气魔雷兽战利品以制作黑铁战利品。

en: King Gormander's latest addition to Pikemead's Reach is, in my opinion, a disgrace — and the pathetic attempt of a man with timbered teeth to reach his mother's levels of adoration. It's a narrative more shallow than White Wind's waters. Last midyear, our lord's attempt to rename the Imperial Gardens to "Gormander's Gardens" was foiled by civil unrest. Instead, we've since been blessed with a statue of his likeness. The statue's gaze is as stiff and paralyzed as our ruler's disposition to the brewing troubles in the North. The grandest thing about Gormander, next to his treasury, is his wooden overbite. — Ramone Jones, editor of The Pike Weekly.
cn: 在我看来，戈曼德国王为派克米德之地贡献的最新作品是一种耻辱--一个不善言辞的人可悲地试图达到他母亲的崇拜水平。 其中所谓的寓意比白风的水还要浅薄。去年岁中，我们的主人试图将帝国园林改名为“戈曼德花园”，但因内乱而未能如愿。相反，我们从此有了一尊他的雕像。 雕像的目光麻木不仁 ，正好与这位统治者对北方动荡局势的态度不谋而合。 最让人钦佩的地方，除了他的国库之外，就是他那张惜字如金的嘴了。 - 《崇山城周刊》编辑，雷蒙·琼斯。

en: Your talk with the Alchemist was enlightening, but disturbing just the same. You learned you were cursed on your last expedition into the Shroud. The ailment has long-term consequences for your vitality, and you will suffer from this malaise until you find a cure. The cure can be made from materials that can be found above the Shroud at night, scattered among groups of Fell foes. Gather the materials, craft the cure, and use it to cleanse yourself.
cn: 与炼金术士的交流让人茅塞顿开，但与此同时又你感到深深的不安。 你意识到自己原来是在上一次探索瘴气期间遭到了诅咒。这种病症会对你的身体活力产生长期影响，除非找到对应的解药，否则症状将永远持续下去。 如果想要制作解药，你需要在夜间前往瘴气上方，并从分布在各地的瘴气魔敌人身上收集材料。 收集材料，然后制作并使用解药以净化诅咒。

en: Craft Or Obtain A Diver’s Endurance Flask
cn: 制作或获取一个潜水毅力药水

en: A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud.
cn: 悄无声息地将命运的织线与瘴气缠绕在一起的恶毒法杖。

en: Survivors can enhance your equipment and let you access your backpack and Manual Crafting recipes.
cn: 幸存者们可以强化你的装备，并且你还可以通过他们使用背包与手工制作配方。
芬恩，我们得弄死那些狼

en: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.
cn: 装有古代化石獠牙的锤子。沃卡会使用各类獠牙与牙齿来进行神秘仪式。

en:
The Collector mentioned that the Ectoplasm Shards inside the Nomad Highlands Hollow Hall have the perfect color and qualities for creating a mysterious green.
The Collector can craft a key to open the Hall for you only once you've passed through previous Halls.

Gather Ectoplasm Shards in the Nomad Highlands Hollow Hall and return to the Barber with them in your inventory!
cn:
收藏家提醒说游牧高地空荡礼堂中的灵质晶片拥有创造神秘之绿所需要的完美色彩与品质。
收藏家能够制造一把打开礼堂的钥匙，但你需要先穿越先前的厅室。

收集游牧高地空荡礼堂中的灵质晶片，回去找理发师时确保物品栏中拥有对应的物品！

en: Possessing magical properties, bones of the dead are often used in alchemy.
cn: 蕴含魔力的骸骨，在炼金术中有着丰富的用途。

en: When disaster struck, we adapted. Rose above all limitations, freed of prejudice and convention. A splinter group of ancients, usually hidden in silence and obscurity, worked hand in hand with humans to build the Cinder Vaults. They house the only hope humanity has left, hidden from the Shroud... Sleeping, waiting to be roused by the Flameborn.
cn: 当瘟疫降临，我们选择了改变。超越了一切枷锁，摆脱了狭隘与偏见。尽管往往处于沉默与晦涩的与世隔绝之中，但是一群特别的远古者分支决定与人类联手并打造出了余烬密室。人类最后的希望就在这些巨大的密室中躲避着瘴气……那些沉睡之人正等待着被火之子唤醒。

en: Bricks formed out of clay. Unknown to many though, it isn't only good for its handy shapes, but also quite robust.
cn: 使用黏土制作的砖块。很多人不知道的是，除了适合用于建筑之外，板砖本身也是一种极其坚硬的工具。

en: There's still blood to be spilled!

The heart of the Shroud Lair is haunted by a Fell Banshee. The Shroud will continue to spread here and steal resources to fuel their own brood unless the Banshee is destroyed! Defeat the Fell Banshee and claim her loot!
cn: 一头瘴气魔女妖正在瘴气巢穴腹地肆虐。除非摧毁女妖，否则这里的瘴气将继续扩散，并不断偷窃资源来供给巢群！ 打败瘴气魔女妖并搜刮她的战利品！

en: An item of power. Feed it to the Flame to gain its strength.
cn: 蕴含着力量的物品。献祭给灵火以获得其中蕴含的力量。

en: Two leather straps, locked in place with enchanted ectoplasm crystals, seal away this tome's whispers. Despite being ancient, the fine aquamarine binding shows no signs of age or decay.
cn: 蕴含魔力的灵质水晶与两根皮带牢牢束缚着不断低语的魔典。尽管年代久远，精美的海蓝色封面上根本见不到任何岁月或腐朽的痕迹。

en: Heavy gloves that can swing any weapon with added might.
cn: 这双沉重的手套能够在你挥舞武器时赋予额外的力量。

en:
The <npc>Collector</npc> talked about the Hollow beasts that originally hailed from the North. 

The one-eyed giants were cursed by the Flame and descended their mountaintops to escape their fate, to no avail. They now roam the deepest depths of the Hollow Halls.
cn:
<npc>收藏家</npc>提到那些空洞之兽最初来源于北方。

独眼巨人们受到了灵火的诅咒，虽然它们从山巅逃了下来，但依旧无法逃避被惩戒的命运。现在它们徘徊在空荡礼堂的最深处。

en: This section shows an overview of all quests you have completed.
cn: 这里将展示你迄今为止完成的所有任务的概览。

en: Filled with vitalizing ingredients, it instantly restores a good amount of health.
cn: 药水中蕴含的活力物质能够立刻恢复较大量生命值。

en: Speak To The Carpenter About The Lantern
cn: 向木匠询问灯笼的事情

en: Fell Mushroom Crabs, Nomad Highlands Shroud and Kindlewastes Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔蘑菇蟹，游牧高地以及燃火荒原瘴气区

en: Find all flame shrines and sanctums in the Springlands.
cn: 找到春日平原中的所有灵火神龛与神殿。

en: Select the material you want to build with.
cn: 选择要使用的建造材料。

en:
You've reached the Ancient Spire in the Albaneve Summits.

Reach the top of the Ancient Spire and speak to the Flame to proceed!
cn:
你已经抵达阿尔班耶夫山脉中的远古尖塔。

抵达远古尖塔顶部并与灵火交谈以继续！

en: Winding grooves carve through the body of the wand, creating a canal for extracting the lifeblood of your enemies. Their energy will fuel you long after they've passed. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 这把魔棒的主体上雕刻有无数蜿蜒凹槽，这种构造能够像河道一般汲取你敌人的生命之血。倒下敌人的能量将成为你的燃料。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: Scales all enemy health by this value.
cn: 根据该数值调整所有敌人生命值。

en: Are you still looking for those rare instruments? If we find all, maybe we can play my favorite song by the Honeydews: Honey Rain Rhapsody!
cn: 还在寻找那些稀有乐器吗？如果能够找齐乐器，我们就可以一起演奏我最喜欢的蜜露歌曲：蜜雨狂想曲！

en: I work day and night at the construction of the Bora Outpost. Yet we're still here living in this modest hut. All this hard work, for what? I hid some polished granite blocks under the stairs at the outpost. When night falls, I will bring them home and start working on renovating for our child. We have earned this.
cn: 我一直没日没夜地在海风哨所工作。但是我们一家人还是只能挤在这间小屋子里面。这就是辛勤工作的回报吗？在哨所的楼梯下面 我藏了一些抛光花岗岩方块。等到晚上，我会把这些东西偷偷带回家，到时候我们可以把房子翻修一遍。这是我们应得的东西。

en: Swiftness will activate on your next hit
cn: 下一次命中敌人时将激活“迅捷”

en: Glory Rises From The Depths Once More!

Replaces the Dodge Roll ability with a sideways Dodge Roll while an enemy target is locked. Use it to roll around your enemies, making it easier to flank them or deliver backstabs. Blink replaces the sideways Dodge Roll of the Strategic Maneuver skill. Cost: 20 Stamina
cn: 锁定一个敌方目标时，翻滚能力将变为侧向翻滚。 该能力将允许你与敌人周旋，并为你创造侧翼打击或背刺的机会。 将战术机动技能的侧向翻滚替换为闪现。 消耗：20点体力

en: This chest piece includes a silky white undergarment for warmth and a flowy cerulean cape for further insulation, and dramatic effect.
cn: 这套上衣由两部分组成：温暖而且柔软的白色衬衣，外加提供额外保暖与浮夸效果的飘逸青色斗篷。

en: A basic ingredient for all advanced armor. The padding added below the hard shell can create comfort and soften impacts. A Loom is needed to craft both padding and advanced armor.
cn: 制作一切高级护甲需要的基础材料。厚实外层下增添的护垫能够提高穿着舒适感并减缓冲击力。 制作加固与高级护甲都需要用到织布机。

en:
Flying rings around their peaks — Far, far away
Subtle shapes and shadows, framed by the morning sun

Flaring wings to powdered beaks — Hide, hide away 
Retreat from warmth and light, when midday's rays shall come

Whirl up with a flashing gust  — At dusk, again they rise
Emerge anew from darker clouds, fly higher with the flurry

Tiny specks of silver dust — Near, near our very eyes
They've come so close, oh Flame protect us from their descending fury
cn:
飞翔的圆环笼罩着它们的顶点 — 就在那遥远之地
黎明的光芒下，扭动的形体与阴影若隐若现

熊熊燃烧的翅膀与沾满白雪的喙 — 躲起来，不要被发现
远离温暖与光芒，正午的阳光即将来临

突然之间狂风大作 — 它们将在傍晚再度崛起
从乌云之中再度出现，飞舞的翅膀将前往更高的天空

那些几乎看不见的银色粉末 — 就在我们的眼前
它们就在眼前，愿灵火保佑我们免受那些从天而降的愤怒

en: I need better equipment to show off my cooking skills. My old and beloved Kettle would be a great start. Did you speak to my friend Raúl yet? He should have my Kettle!
cn: 我需要更好的工具来展现自己的厨艺。我以前最爱的烧水壶就是很不错的开始。你跟我的朋友劳尔聊过了吗？我的烧水壶应该就在他那里！

en: A seared fish cutlet that can only be prepared so well in a fish grilling cage. It is very flavorful.
cn: 只有专门的烤架才能够烹饪出如此完美的炙烤鱼排。一口咬下去唇齿留香。

en: Increases the skill level of Shiny Plates
cn: 提高闪亮铠甲的技能等级
黄金瘴气魔雷兽战利品

en: Hold to summon bone projectiles that seek out enemies with a devastating force. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 长按以引导能够自动追踪敌人的强力骸骨投射物。 引导法术：在一段时间内维持按键以持续引导。装备法术并消耗法力来用 法杖施法。

en: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.
cn: 用于砍伐树木的斧子。用来驱赶狼群的效果欠佳。

en: Resource for physically straining actions like sprinting, blocking, evading, and others.
cn: 类似冲刺、格挡、闪避以及其他耗费体力的动作需要的资源。

en: We're gearing up. Good. But no matter how much we prepare, we can't beat the Drak at their game... underwater traversal will remain a challenge lest we get more air in our lungs. Don't fret. Our army had teams of specialty divers equipped with proper tools for extended missions. I'll show you where they were deployed last.
cn: 我们已经拿到了全新的装备。很好。但是无论我们准备的多么充分，我们都无法在卓克的游戏中打败它们……除非我们能够在肺中储存更多空气，否则水下穿行将永远是一个挑战。不用担心。以前我们的军队拥有专业的潜水队伍，他们会借助各种工具来长时间执行任务。让我来告诉你他们最后部署的地点吧。

en: A rusted Simple Copper Sword, damaged by time itself. Its best days are far gone.
cn: 饱受时间摧残的锈蚀简朴铜剑。已经不复当年的品质。

en: The Bard Valory requires shelter. Provide her with a nice, warm room to unlock more crafting possibilities. Build a home for the Bard and grant her access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already! To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed. This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.
cn: 吟游诗人瓦罗里需要庇护所。为她提供一个温暖舒适的房间以解锁更多制作配方。为吟游诗人搭建一个家，并且确保她的周围有能够使用的受到庇护的床！ 若要为幸存者提供庇护所，首先请制作合适的床。将床放置在幸存者能够方便使用，且拥有良好保护的区域内。放置后，床将自动分配给附近没有床铺的幸存者。如果想要重新分配床，装备召唤法杖然后使用它瞄准床铺。 如果幸存者缺乏庇护，此任务将重新开启。

en: The Scavenger cave turned up a valuable find – The Wailing Blade, branded by the <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location>'s master Blacksmith. Perhaps he will know more about its origins.
cn: 拾荒者洞穴中存放着一件宝物“恸哭之刃”，上面刻着<location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>的大师铁匠的印记。也许他会知道此剑的来源。
黑铁瘴气魔怪物战利品

en: You've found a dead Capybara. Its body is still warm and carries traces of vicious Drak'Dal bite marks. It seems that the Drak'Dal have been hunting and devouring Capybara. Such a foul deed cannot go unjudged. Find the nearby enemy camp and avenge the animal's death! Perhaps you can even save some of its brethren in the process.
cn: 你找到一只水豚的尸体。它的身体尚有余温，而且体表能够看见卓克·达尔留下的惨不忍睹的咬痕。 似乎卓克·达尔正在狩猎并吞噬水豚。这种邪恶行径决不能够被姑息。 找到附近的敌人营地并为动物报仇雪恨！也许你甚至可以在过程中拯救它的一些同胞。

en: This weapon's sheen has been dulled by patina, hiding its once prestigious origin. Only the padded handle still hints at the lost glory.
cn: 这把剑刃的锋芒已经被锈蚀钝化，曾经的辉煌起源也早已被人遗忘。只有被层层包裹的握把仍然在暗示着逝去的荣耀。

en: Someone misplaced a building material on a ruined bridge in the Nomad Highlands. Find and claim the building blocks to learn more block-crafting recipes!
cn: 有人错把建筑材料放在了游牧高地中的一座废弃大桥上。寻找并获取建筑方块以学习更多方块制作配方！

en: This eternal spell is imbued with the power of light. When cast, a bright burst of radiance flashes before you and pushes back enemies. Additionally, this spell increases the stun bar of shrouded enemies based on your intelligence attribute. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 蕴含光芒之力的永恒法术。施法时创造一道强烈的闪光并击退周围的敌人。 除此以外，这种法术将根据你的智力属性提高被瘴气腐化的敌人的晕眩条。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: If you fish and catch nothing, you have still caught a lesson.
cn: 就算钓不上鱼，你至少学到了教训。

en: 13.2 Language: The contractual language of these Adventure Sharing Terms is German and may be accessed at any time at https://enshrouded.com/AdventureSharing_ToS . All other language versions are for convenience only. In the event of discrepancies between the language versions, the German language version shall prevail.
cn: 13.2 语言：本冒险分享条款的合同语言为德语，并可通过 https://enshrouded.com/AdventureSharing_ToS 随时访问。所有其他语言版本仅供参考。各语言版本之间存在不一致时，以德语版本为准。

en: Trigger Chance on Hitting a Soaked Enemy
cn: 命中湿透敌人时的触发几率

en: Magic weapon damage is increased by %k.
Letter Of Recommendation, Day 45 of Yearfall, 497 D.A.

A block made out of rocks extracted from the ground. Roughly cut to the right size to stack them. Great for building a foundation! Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 使用从地上开采的岩石制作的方块。被粗略切割成了适合堆叠的尺寸。非常适合用来建造地基！ 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: Soaked Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%. Soaked can be applied to enemies. Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.
cn: 湿透 体力与体力恢复降低30%，持续30秒。同时使寒冰与电击抗性降低30%，但是火焰抗性将提高30%。 敌人也会进入湿透状态。 湿透的持续时间无法通过温暖环境缩短，并且等结束时将会变为潮湿减益。

en: Your next attack applies a burn debuff
cn: 你的下一次攻击将施加燃烧减益

en: 4.3 No Transfer of Ownership: The granting of rights under Sections 4.1 and 4.2 do not result in any transfer of ownership of, or copyright in, the User Content. You remain the author of your User Content and retain all rights not expressly granted for use.
cn:
4.3	
所有权不发生转移：根据第 4.1 条和第 4.2 条授予权利，并不导致用户内容的所有权或著作权的任何转移。您仍然是您的用户内容的作者，并保留所有未明确授予使用的权利。

en: A richly decorated and festive-looking tree.

A bandage combined with antiseptics.

This item provides improved healing if applied to a wound.
cn:
涂有抗菌剂的绷带。

施加在伤口上之后，该物品能够提供更好的治疗效果。

en: An arrow made from giant bone. The force of this arrow allows it to pierce hit targets to harm multiple foes.
cn: 使用巨型骨头制作的箭矢。 这枚箭矢能够穿透目标并打击多个敌人。

en: Find A Way Inside The Laboratory
cn: 找到进入实验室的方法

en:
A superior arrow made from Giant Bone.

Its force allows it to pierce targets and harm multiple foes.
cn:
使用巨型骨头制作的卓越箭矢。

这枚箭矢能够穿透目标并打击多个敌人。

en:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

The Drak are shown to build temples under a bright sun, resembling the Ancients. They see the Ancients as godlike due to their overwhelming prowess, and aim to gain their favor to ascend to godhood themselves.
cn:
详细记载着卓克的历史的浮雕。

卓克正在代表远古者的明亮太阳下建造着神殿。他们将拥有巨大力量的远古者供奉为神明，并且希冀能够获得他们的青睐以获得神格。

en: A display to showcase weapons or shields.
cn: 用于展示武器或盾牌的架子。

en: Aw, look at the adorable Capybaras! My heart feels so warm and full! Should we dig a little water hole for them? I'll bring a shovel!
cn: 啊，看看这些可爱的水豚！我感觉心里面都暖洋洋的而且很充实！也许我们应该帮他们挖个小水坑？我去拿铲子！

en: The chest was taken and subsequently lost by Cade Hawthorn. Reach his former camp and unearth the chest to claim its contents!
cn: 卡迪·霍桑偷走了箱，之后又不小心弄丢了东西。前往他以前的营地并挖掘箱以拿走里面的物品！

en: This basic torch provides light for a short amount of time. Watch your step when exploring caves with this!
cn: 这种基础火把能够提供短暂的照明。举着火把探索洞穴时千万要小心脚下！

en: A Door To Seal Away All Light
A stone block often used for building sturdy, soundproof walls.
cn: 经常被用于建造牢固、隔音墙体的石块。

en: A sticky paste used to bind chemical substances.
cn: 用于黏合化学物质的粘稠糊状物。

en: Green is quite mystical, right? It's subversive — being the color of nature and renewal, but also immortality, envy, and disgust. Ah, I remember the ingredients I used to make green hair dye represented these aspects... Who could know more about life and renewal or immortality and envy...?
cn: 绿色真的充满了神秘感，对吗？这种颜色充满了矛盾性：即是代表大自然与新生的绿色，与此同时又是不朽、嫉妒以及憎恶的绿色。啊，我突然想起来，以前制作绿色染发剂的原料也拥有这两种截然不同的特色……但是谁会了解生命与新生，或者是不朽与嫉妒……？

en: You've discovered an Ancient Obelisk in the hunting grounds. Read it to uncover more hidden locations!
cn: 你在狩猎场发现了一个古代方尖碑。查看此物以发现更多隐藏地点！

en: My good mate, come 'ere! I've got a story for you!
cn: 我的好伙计，来这里！我有个故事要告诉你！

en:
Through the dark night until dawn drapes the sky in golden-yellow and red hues. This color combination would look stunning on a flag too!

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
穿过黑暗的夜，直到黎明的朝阳将天空染成金黄的红晕。这种配色放在旗帜上也一样美丽动人！

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: Prove me wrong or prove me right — at the end of the day, curiosity will tempt you.
cn: 无论我说的是对是错，你将永远面对好奇心的诱惑。

en: The recent influx of strangers unnerves both me and the workers — and even worse, it disrupts business. Liane wrote to me about this "incident" she had at the riverbank. It's unsettling, no doubt, but I attempted to convince her to keep working. If no one dares to enter the muddy fields at night anymore, the business will sink deeper than a boot stuck in muck. It's just a matter of time until our stored gloomberries run out. What will we make our wine and marmalade with, then? I wish Liane had met the other stranger instead. The barber was odd, yes — spending much of his time atop the keep's tower, staring at the constellations above — but at least he wasn't deranged. If only she had met him by the shore, peacefully harvesting gloomberries at midnight... then I'd still have a supplier!
cn: 最近突然涌入的陌生人们让我和工人们都有点提心吊胆，而且更糟糕的是，这已经影响到正常的生意。 连恩在信中提到了自己在岸边遇到的“意外”。这一切都让人感到不安，但我还是努力说服了她去继续工作。如果没有人敢在夜晚进入泥泞的田地，那我们的生意恐怕也就会像烂泥里的靴子一样一蹶不振。照这样下去，我们的暗夜果存货早晚会用光。到时候我们该用什么酿酒，或者是做果酱？ 真希望连恩遇到的是另外一个陌生人。理发师确实有点古怪，绝大部分时间里面，他都躲在要塞的高塔里面仰望头顶的星座，但无论如何，至少他不是个疯子。要是连恩当晚在岸边遇到的人是理发师就好了，她肯定能够继续安心在晚上采摘暗夜果，那样的话我也不用担心没人供货！

en: Dashing headgear with a set of goggles. They protect the wearer's eyes from vapors and water but were also used while gliding on wind currents back in the day.
cn: 配有一套护目镜的帅气头具。这些东西能够保护穿戴者的双眼免受蒸汽和水流的干扰，以前滑翔于天际之人也会用它来保护眼睛不受强风影响。

en: We should celebrate this beautiful new chapter. I know exactly how!
cn: 我们应该庆祝这个美丽的新篇章。我知道该怎么做！

en: Sister! Have my notes reached you? I've missed you greatly this past year. That vile Contractor locked me up in a cellar on Jasper Isles, but your predictions came true: He couldn't keep me shackled for long! I'm sorry I've been out of touch, but I've had to keep my head down... Umber Hollow isn't any better or worse than Surat's Rest. Two sides of the same coin, like us! More tavern brawls, perhaps — but nothing I can't handle! The Nomad Highlands are without order. One day, Kendal, we must eclipse this chaos. What do you say? Your sister, Lupa
cn: 妹妹！你有收到我寄来的信吗？过去一年里我一直在想你。那个可恨的契约人想要把我关在了贾斯帕群岛的牢房里面，但是你的推测是对的：他休想把我永远困在这个地方！对不起一直没有联系你，我得避免被人发现…… 褐赭空洞跟苏拉特之息比起来也差不了多少。我感觉就像是硬币的两面，就和我们一样！最多就是酒吧斗殴更为频繁，但是我不怕他们！ 游牧高地已经乱成了一锅粥。答应我肯戴尔，总有一天我们要一起逃离这混乱的一切，好吗？ 你的姐姐， 卢帕

en: This piece of armor only offers minor protection against incoming arrows, but that hardly matters. The best preventative measure is to aim for the eyes.
cn: 这件护甲只能对箭矢提供最基础的防护，但这并不重要。最好的防御措施就是瞄准敌人的眼睛。

en: Joining failed. The password is invalid.

cn: 喧嚣森林 空荡礼堂

en: Increases the skill level of Earth Aura
cn: 提高大地光环的技能等级
阿尔班耶夫山脉 空荡礼堂

en: The Flame spoke of "Ancient Obelisk" which reveal information about the world. The Obelisks show hidden truths, and some are connected to what festers below. The location of one such Obelisk is marked on the map. Seek out the Obelisk and discover the secrets it holds. The Obelisk's secrets will only be revealed to those who seek them.
cn: 灵火说“古代方尖碑”将揭示关于这个世界的信息。方尖碑将展现隐藏的真相，而且其中有一些还与滋生于深渊的存在有着关联。 已在地图上标记其中一处方尖碑的位置。找到方尖碑并解开其隐藏的秘密。只有勇于探寻之人才能够解开方尖碑的秘密。

en: A grassy green dress for housekeeping or working on the farm.
cn: 做家务或者是在农场工作室穿着的草绿色裙子。

en:
The fur is still speckled with bloody flecks.

Collect multiple Vukah Brawler Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
毛皮上仍有斑斑血迹。

收集多个沃卡斗士头颅来制作战利品。
所有人都可以作为[%k]加入。

en: Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
cn: 排水 这种材料会在溢出时排放少量水。

en: The Farmer stated that she would like to cook some new food. Certain recipes will keep you nice and warm when out in the snow! Consider cooking pumpkin soup, grilled fatty beef, or beef stew.
cn: 农民表示想要烹饪一些新的食物。特定食谱将能够帮助你在冰天雪地中保持温暖！ 你可以考虑烹饪南瓜汤、烤肥牛或者是牛肉汤。

en:
Nutritious Capybara food for tame animals on your farm.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
cn:
为农场中已经驯服的水豚准备的营养饲料。

必须被放置在对应的喂食器中。

en: Place at least one Flame Altar before sharing your world.
cn: 在共享世界前请先放置至少一座灵火祭坛。

en: Dealing damage with a Magic weapon has a %k chance to trigger a small flame burst that restores %k seconds of Time in the Shroud to you and your allies within %k meters. Time in the Shroud Should this time run out, the Shroud will consume you.
cn: 使用魔法武器对敌人造成伤害时有%k几率触发一次小规模的火焰迸发，为你以及%k米范围内的所有友军恢复%k秒的瘴气停留时间。 瘴气停留时间 如果停留时间耗尽，你将被瘴气吞噬。

en: You've learned that a group of people suffered a Vukah ambush. One of them dropped a weapon. The Vukah must've taken the loot to a nearby camp.
cn: 你得知有人遭到了沃卡伏击。其中一人在那里掉了一件武器。沃卡肯定已经把战利品都带到了附近的营地。

en:
Thanks again for letting me pass, my new friend! When I saw your fearsome patrol, I was almost worried! But as it turns out, The Honeydew's fan club has members even out here! Ha! Who knew?

I hope my old lute will bring you much joy! Remember: if you pluck the strings lightly, the others won't hear you practice. I know you have appearances to keep up, being the local Scavenger leader and all. I know all about that. I've had to push away my true passion, too. Hey, once I'm back from the Albaneve Summits — and once I've established my new career as a gliding master — I'll come back to teach you some tunes! I'll leave one here for you, too. Practice makes perfect!

Let's duet together soon!
Stay sharp, 

— Chester Loft
cn:
再次感谢你让我过去，我的新朋友！当我看见来势汹汹的巡逻队时，我都吓坏了！没想到蜜露的粉丝俱乐部竟然已经扩张到了这么远的地方！哈！谁能想到这种事？

希望我的旧鲁特琴能够给你带去快乐！记住：只要控制好拨动琴弦的力度，其他人就不会听见你的声音。我知道你得注意形象，毕竟是当地的拾荒者首领嘛。这种事我懂的。之前我也有向所有人隐藏我真正的热情所在。那什么，等我从阿尔班耶夫山脉中回来 — 并成为一名新的滑翔大师 — 我答应会回来教你新的曲子！让我给你在这里留一份乐谱吧。记住一定要勤加练习！

以后一定要一起玩音乐！
加油，

 — 切斯特·洛夫特

en: This song uses a colorful soundscape to paint a lively market on a cold day. The bright tones illuminate the scenery like fairy lights. It makes you want to warm up with some mead! Music Sheet: Music Sheets teach you a new song once picked up. You don't need to keep the sheet in your inventory to play the song. Gifting it to others will enable them to learn the song, too.
cn: 这首曲目用丰富的音域描绘了冰冷冬天的热闹集市。轻快的曲调会让人联想到仙境一般的美妙景象。听完这首歌会让你情不自禁地想要来几杯蜜酒！ 乐谱： 拾取乐谱后，你将立刻学会新的歌曲。之后就算背包中没有乐谱，你也可以演奏音乐。将乐谱赠予其他人后，他们也将学会如何演奏音乐。
耀眼的光芒与吞噬的黑暗

en: Glennwood's End has fallen to Scavengers. Defeat the Scavenger Matron to cleanse the town and claim your trophy!
cn: 格伦伍德之末已经落入拾荒者之手。打败拾荒者主母以净化城镇并获取战利品！

en: An extension to your backpack that enlarges your inventory by one row. Outdated This item is of an old design. Visit your craftsmen to find an improved version of the backpack with an additional row.
cn: 扩充背包，使物品栏空间扩展一排。 过时 此物品的设计已经过时。请拜访工匠并制作拥有额外一排储存空间的改良背包。

en:
I'm free at last, thanks to you, my friend. All names are fleeting, just sound and smoke. I've as many as an hourglass has grains of sand. To you, I will be "Alden".
I am the light that beckons downstream. A fading star behind the north winds. A collector and breaker of earthly chains. I shall part the veil for you once you're ready. The toll is little, I promise you, friend.
cn:
我的朋友啊，多亏了你，我终于重获自由。迄今为止我有过无数的名字，那种东西只是过往云烟。不过你可以称我为“埃尔登”。
我是照耀地下的光芒，走在北风之后的黯淡星辰。我是一位收藏家，同时也是尘世束缚的破除者。等你准备好之后，我将帮你揭开彼界的帷幕。你只需要支付一份小小的代价即可，这点我向你保证，朋友。

en: The Hunter wants to prepare fur and leather by drying it in the sun. She wonders if Nomad Highlands hunters could have tools and knowledge about it, but doesn't know any. Perhaps somebody else knows a Hunter from the area.
cn: 猎人希望通过日光暴晒鞣制毛草与皮革。她认为游牧高地的猎手也许掌握着所需的知识与工具，但是她自己并不认识当地的猎人。 也许其他人会认识那片区域的猎人。

en: You've found my notes! Yes, I've long considered myself among the best... though my Aunt Braelyn would beg to differ. Of course, great artists have a signature to mark their works! Mine is a chest I set in the foundation of Braelyn Bridge. Right by the middle pillar! Despite my best efforts, no soul has noticed yet.
cn: 你找到了我的笔记！没错，我一直觉得自己的造诣无人能及……不过布莱林姑姑不这么想。当然，艺术大师们都有着自己的独有的标志！我的标志就是藏在布莱林大桥地基中的一个箱子。就在中间的柱子旁边！只可惜不管我怎么明示暗示，迄今为止还没有人发现那里的玄机。

en: The Farmer lost a keepsake from her mother when she traveled from her childhood home to <location>Brittlebush</location>. Find the lost ring and return it to Emily Fray!
cn: 当初从自己的故乡前往<location>碎丛</location>的途中，农民不小心遗失了她母亲留给她的纪念品。找到遗失的戒指并还给艾米丽·弗莱！

en: This is it. Blackmire's final haven — a sunken city, guarded by moor and bramble. Whoever wanders here shall rest behind a magical gate, the doors of which may only open through buttons stitched in the thicket. Looking at these crumbling walls fills me with awe... and fear. This city's memories are lost to time, forever slumbering beneath tar. I've mistakenly added a few keepsakes of my own to this hidden treasure trove... not only leaving footprints in the mud, but my very own boots! I shall leave them behind... my garb is weighed down by remembrance and grime. This makes me wonder... Could humanity be forgotten, just as the stories here were buried? And if we are — if we crack, crumble, and fade to black like the bones below... can we rediscover, and rebuild ourselves? Only the Flameborn will know. I hope to help build your tomorrow. To carve the path you will blaze, to catch your fall, to raise you higher... I hope my words reach you, constellations apart, an echo through time. I believe in you, Flameborn. And one day, I hope to thank you. — Queen Jezmina of Orindell, 509 D.A.
cn: 就是这里。 黑沼最后的避风港，一座被沼泽与荆棘守护的沉没城市。 来到此处的人们将能够在魔法门扉之后找到休憩，只有按下镶嵌在灌木之中的按钮才可以打开那些大门。 看着这些分崩离析的高墙，我的心中充满了敬畏……以及恐惧。这座城市的记忆已经消失在时间的长河之中，它将永远沉睡在焦油之下。之前我错把自己珍视的一些信物留在了这个隐秘的宝库之中……我指的不光是泥泞中的脚印，我的靴子掉在那里了！我只能抛下它们……各式各样的回忆与污垢已经让我不堪重负。 不过这让我想到一件事……是否终有一天，人类也将和被埋葬在这里的故事一样被彻底遗忘？如果那就是我们的命运……如果我们终将粉身碎骨并像那些地下的骸骨一般遁入虚无……我们是否能够重新发掘并重建自身？只有火之子知道答案。 我只希望能够帮助你打造未来。开拓出供你熊熊燃烧的道路，在你坠落时接住你，托举着你向顶点进发……哪怕我们将被星辰分隔，我也希望这些话语的回音能够穿越时间来到你的心中。 我相信你，火之子。 总有一天，我希望能够向你表达最诚挚的感谢。 - 奥林戴尔的杰兹米娜女王，509 D.A.

en: Poor server performance. Players on your server might experience performance issues.
cn: 服务器性能差。服务器上的玩家可能会遇到性能问题。

en:
Gna'Rash's clutch grows well. Many strong Drakling. Only few need culling, but hide still strong. Tough for other Drakling to eat, but good nutrition. Makes scales twice as hard! Hail the Broodmother!

But why only Gna'Rash get to be with pretty Drak'Dal ladies? Gruul said chief even have girlfriends in Archipelago, outside tribe. Kriss'Kah wonder: How is breeding with Drak'Mer female? 
Why no pretty Drak ladies for Kriss'Kah? No fair!
cn:
格纳·拉许的幼崽长得很好。许多强壮的龙裔。只有几个不得不被剔除，但是兽皮同样很好。虽然给其他龙裔吃不方便，但是营养很好。能够让鳞片更加坚硬！育母万岁！

但为什么只有格纳·拉许能够跟漂亮的女卓克·达尔一起？格鲁尔说酋长甚至在群岛都有女朋友，而且是部落之外的。克利丝·卡在想：怎么跟女卓克·莫尔交配？
为什么克利丝·卡没有漂亮的女卓克不公平！

en:
The <npc>Alchemist</npc> believes that the <npc>Collector</npc> has meddled with dark energy or magic.

He advised caution but seemed curious nonetheless.
cn:
<npc>炼金术士</npc>认为<npc>收藏家</npc>正在使用黑暗的能量或者魔法。

他劝诫你谨慎行事，但似乎仍然对此十分好奇。

en: The world is lost, but not barren. Survivors of the Shroud wait to be roused by your inner fire. Find the sleeping survivor marked on your map. You will have to venture through the Shroud!
cn: 世界迷失了，但并不荒芜。瘴气的幸存者等待着被你的内在之火唤醒。 找到地图上标记的沉睡的幸存者。您必须冒险穿越瘴气！

en:
The sneak attack deals a massive %k bonus damage.

Sneak close to an unaware enemy and trigger the  Sneak Attack.
cn:
隐秘攻击会造成额外%k伤害。

潜行接近未警觉的敌人即可触发隐秘攻击。

en: This golden handpan was used by the Drak. Did they play it during ceremonies, sacrifices, or duels? You can't say for sure, but you do know that its sound is magical and enticing.
cn: 这个金色的手碟曾经属于卓克。不知道当年它们是在仪式、献祭还是决斗中演奏这种乐器？虽然无法确定这一点，但你知道它确实拥有动人的奇妙音色。

en: A staff that awakes slumbering anger inside the wielder. The protruding amethyst spikes help to channel the emotion towards enemies.
cn: 这把法杖会唤醒持有者内心中的愤怒。凸起的紫水晶尖刺能够帮助施法者向敌人宣泄愤怒。

en: Only dead fish swim with the stream.
cn: 只有死鱼才会随波逐流。

en:
4. Use of your ID

When you start our game, your game authenticates with an ID assigned to you by the respective platform through which you obtain our game. We only use it in anonymised form. The legal basis for the authentication and anonymisation of your ID is the provision of and our legitimate interest in a privacy-friendly evaluation of our game, Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR.
cn:
4. Use of your ID

When you start our game, your game authenticates with an ID assigned to you by the respective platform through which you obtain our game. We only use it in anonymised form. The legal basis for the authentication and anonymisation of your ID is the provision of and our legitimate interest in a privacy-friendly evaluation of our game, Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR.

en: So it does exist! An arrow that never rests, nor breaks! Amazing... there's magic in the world yet!
cn: 这么说它真的存在！永不停息而且永不折断的箭矢！不可思议……看来这个世界真的充满了魔法！

en: Your Parry Power is increased by %k. Parry A well-timed block with any Melee weapon or Shield will parry the attack and fill up the enemy's Stun Bar. Overpower Attacking blocking enemies or parrying their attacks fills their Stun Bar until they become overpowered. Overpowered enemies are open for Merciless Attacks.
cn: 你的招架能力提高%k。 招架 看准时机使用任意近战武器或盾牌进行格挡将招架来袭攻击并使对手的晕眩条增长。 压制 攻击格挡中的敌人或者是招架敌人的攻击都会使他们的晕眩条上涨，直到最后进入被压制状态。 被压制的敌人将毫无防备，这种时候你可以对其发动残酷打击。

en: Providing general protection and shade, the alchemist's apprentice hat is perfect for wandering around the world.
cn: 能够提供充足的阴凉与保护，炼金术士学徒帽是周游世界时的最佳选择。

en: Decorative bells are especially suitable for the yearfall.
cn: 专门为岁末准备的装饰用铃铛。

en: Available slot for food types that aren't already being digested.
cn: 有尚未被消化的食物类型栏位可用。

en: Increases your maximum Health by %k times your Strength attribute.
cn: 提高你的最大生命值，具体提升量等同于你的力量属性的%k倍。

en: A Tarred Wood Block. Now only the shingles are missing. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 一块焦油木方块。现在只需要瓦片顶就大功告成了。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: Full metal armor with flourishing lines, swinging around the leg like ensnaring vines. Their thorns may prick, tear, and break her, but a wounded deer leaps highest, so they say.
cn: 由华丽线条构成的全金属盔甲就像肆意生长的藤蔓一样包裹着双腿。也许那些荆棘会刺穿并撕裂她，但人们都说受伤的鹿才跳得最高。

en: I confess that I failed my brother when he needed me most. He was never well, but something made him worse. Suddenly, he tried to claw my eyes out. He refused to eat — said mum's soup was cold as ice and shattered the bowl. I think it was a cry for help. He'd vanish for days, and when he finally reappeared in our bedroom in the dead of night, he awoke me with a whisper. "In my new home, it's kill or be killed. I'll be strong for you. A somber voice calls to me. Someone, or something, wants to snuff me out. To eat me up, to steal my face and name. It wants to set me free." Dazed, I asked what he meant — but he simply whispered "Go back to sleep"... and I did. That's the last I saw of my brother Alden.
cn: 我有罪，我在自己兄弟最需要我的时候辜负了他。 虽然他的身体一直谈不上健康，但是他就像是彻底变了个人一样。他突然想要把我的眼睛抠出来。他不肯吃饭，说妈妈烧的汤太冰，然后直接就把碗摔坏了。我觉得那时候他其实是渴望得到我们的帮助。 之后他突然神秘失踪了好久，直到有一天深夜，他又一次出现在了我们的卧室里，我被他的低语声吵醒了。 “在我的新家里，只有杀或者被杀。我一定会为大家坚强起来的。有一个阴沉的声音正在呼唤我。有人或者是有东西想要将我彻底抹除。它想要吃掉我，然后偷走我的面孔和名字。它想要让我获得自由。” 我迷迷糊糊地问他这到底是什么意思，但他只是说了一声“回去睡觉吧”……然后我就又一次睡着了。 那是我最后一次见到我的兄弟埃尔登。

en: Our world grows wider by the day! Thank you for climbing that Ancient Spire, Flameborn!
cn: 我们的世界日渐宽广！感谢您登上远古尖塔，火之子！

en: I thought taking on some work here would be easy enough... fixing up the old shed with my smithing tools should be simple. But the farmer here, sir Fanning, creeps me the hell out. He offered, no, insisted that I can sleep in his room until the work is done. If that wasn't bad enough, the shed's in way worse condition than what was promised. These repairs will take much longer than I anticipated! Maybe I should've stuck with that hunting party in the Kindlewastes... It's no use. I need the coin to afford a ride home, and I can't blame anyone but myself. I really blew it this time. Will Dad even want to look at me, even if I reach him? Who knows. I've moved my bedding here. If this guy tries anything — if he even looks at me wrong — I'll blow this whole place up! I won't let my guard down!
cn: 我原本以为这里的工作应该很轻松……使用铁匠工具来修理旧棚屋对我来说应该是小菜一碟。但是这里的农民，就是范宁爵士可把我给吓坏了。 他之前想要，不，是坚持要我睡在他的房间里，直到工作结束。更糟糕的是，棚屋的情况比他之前说的更糟糕。完成修缮工作需要的时间可比我之前预想的要多多了！也许我就不该离开燃火荒原的狩猎队…… 但是没办法。我需要钱才能想办法回家，现在这种情况只能怪我自己。这回真的是搞砸了。就算我到时候真的能够回到家，父亲还会宽容地接纳我吗？谁知道呢。 反正我已经把床搬到这里了。如果那家伙敢乱来，哪怕是他敢色眯眯地看我一眼，我发誓我会把这个地方给炸了！我绝对不会放松警惕的！

en: The Collector, Alden Crowley, can create mystical and dark furniture sets and food items infused with a special, revitalizing energy.
cn: 名为埃尔登·克劳利的收藏家能够创造神秘与黑暗的家具，除此以外还可以烹饪出蕴含着特别的治愈之力的食物。
巴索夫与兰多·迪姆维尔德

en:
Hey Pablo
I hear you've been assigned to "rat extermination" duty. That went poorly for you!

If you're not feeling up for it, why not join me instead? I took some pelts from storage and thought about strolling down to that Ancient Obelisk tomorrow. I'll call it a scouting mission. Maybe you can talk to the commander, and he'll let you join, too. We can always deal with the rats later, no?
cn:
嘿，巴勃罗
听说你被分配去干“灭鼠”了。你可真是太倒霉了！

如果不想干了，你可以来我这。之前我从仓库里拿了一些皮草，我打算明天去古代方尖碑那边碰碰运气。就当成是侦察任务好了。也许你可以给你的指挥官谈一谈，他应该会愿意让你来的。老鼠的事情晚点再去处理也不迟，对不对？

en: Healing any target with a spell triggers a burst of fire that deals %k of the heal amount as Fire damage to nearby Fell enemies.
cn: 使用法术治疗任意目标将触发一道火焰迸发，对附近的瘴气魔敌人造成等同于治疗量%k的火焰伤害。

en: The host has banned you from the server. You may not rejoin.
cn: 主机已经在服务器中将你封禁。之后你无法再加入。

en: Savedata System couldn't be initialized. Please reinstall the game.
cn: 存档数据系统无法初始化。请重新安装游戏。

en: I've returned from the other side of the basin empty-handed. The farmhouse there has got creepy crawly spiders all over! You can't take a single step without walking into a web! I don't care about the rations or the loot in the attic... I'm not setting foot near those spiders again! No matter how low our supplies are, they can't force me to go back there. Can't I join the Cyclops Scouting Team instead?
cn: 这回我从盆地的另一侧空手而归。 那里的农舍到处都是恶心的蜘蛛！那里遍地都是蜘蛛网！我才不管什么口粮还是什么阁楼上的战利品……反正我再也不会靠近那些蜘蛛了！就算我们都要饿死了，我也不会回去的。 就不能让我加入独眼巨人侦察小队么？

en: See those little frogs hoppin' through the grass? I used to catch 'em when I was a kid and bring 'em to my old man. Didn’t realize back then he was using 'em as bait to catch bigger fish — clever move, really. Works like a charm if you’ve got the knack for it. I’m too old for crawling around now, though. Think you could catch a few for me?
cn:
看见在草地上蹦来蹦去的小青蛙了吗？还小的时候我会特意去抓青蛙然后拿给我老爸。那时候我并没有意识到他其实是在用青蛙当做诱饵来钓更大的鱼……说实话这招真的很妙。如果你知道怎么做的话，这招绝对百试不爽。
不过我现在老了没力气跑来跑去。你可以帮我抓几只回来吗？

en: Gliders must be crafted and equipped before use. To use an equipped Glider, jump off a ledge and press %k mid-fall. Using the Glider requires stamina. Crafting the Glider requires Shroud Wood. Fell dead trees in the Shroud to obtain Shroud Wood.
cn: 你需要先制作并装备滑翔翼才能够进行使用。如果要使用已经装备的滑翔翼，首先从平台边缘落下，然后在半空中按下%k。使用滑翔翼需要消耗体力。 制作滑翔翼需要瘴气木材。砍伐瘴气中的枯树以获取瘴气木材。

en: Determines how long it takes to revive an ally.
cn: 决定盟友复活所需的时间。

en: An ominous, green glowing building block made from ectoplasm. The construction is reminiscent of stained glass windows.
cn: 这种散发着不祥气息的建筑方块闪烁着绿色的光芒。不知道为什么，使用灵质制作而成的成品会让人联想到彩色玻璃。

en: Dearest people, hear my tale! It is true! They've returned! I've seen the Wisps with my own eyes, down by White Wind's shores, brighter than ever before! They've returned to bring glorious light from the depths, hailing from the cove! Do not fret! The Wisps are our reptilian brothers! Glistening, scaly backs peek out from beneath the waters, ready to carry you to safer shores! Good fortune must be upon us!! Our war will end, the craze for the Elixir will subside! The water and rain will clear, and the soil stop souring! Good omens are all around!
cn: 亲爱的各位，听听我的故事吧！他们真的回来了！我亲眼看到了精灵，就在白风的海岸边，比以往任何时候都要明亮！它们回来了，带来了来自深处的光辉，来自小海湾！ 不要担心！它们是我们的爬行动物兄弟！闪闪发光的鳞片背影从水底探出头来，随时准备把你们带到更安全的海岸！ 好运一定会降临在我们身上！我们的战争将会结束，对魔药的狂热将会消退！雨过天晴，土壤不再酸化！这一切都是好兆头！

en: Delicate fabric with intricate details, ever-shifting with the angle of the sun. Worn by the Scholars who chased knowledge across these lands.
cn: 细腻布料上的精致图案简直栩栩如生，而且会随着阳光的角度不停变化。原本属于云游四方寻觅知识的学者。

en: Multiple hounds went missing from <location>Raven's Keep</location>. All signs point towards them having been taken to a nearby watch tower. Perhaps some dogs could still be there. Investigate the watchtower and search for dogs there!
cn: <location>渡鸦堡</location>中有多条猎犬失踪了。所有证据指向了附近的一座瞭望塔。说不定那里还能找到狗。调查瞭望塔并寻找狗的迹象！

en: It's the first day of yearfall, 502 D.A. and I've finally reached the castle, and whilst preparing for my little soliloquy, I could not help but let my mind wander! How shall I ever memorize my lines whilst dreaming beneath such magnificent architecture? I thought the statues of our Lord that line the town entrance fed my hungry eyes, but it seems they were merely an appetizer! The stonework here holds space for scenery, I say: These columns reach toward the dome like prayers on a rainy night, coating the citadel in an awe-inspiring serenity. Imagine a gray chapel atop a cliff, moss creeping through the century-old brick. Thunder and lightning haunt not only the sanctuary, but the rivulet choking its precipice. Stone arcs spring from side to side, frogs leaping across the rippling stream. They span 'round the pilasters like the skeleton of an umbrella, sheltering us sheep from the howling winds. I must not forget myself! My audience is drawing near — I hope the Lord will savor my voice! If not, I might hang from one such arc soon enough... Focus, Chester! Grim thoughts ought not to be in a blond and pretty head like yours! — "Lucky" Chester Loft
cn: 现在是岁末的第一日，502 D.A.，我终于抵达城堡，在为接下来的小小独白进行准备的时候，我的心思不由自主地飘到了其他地方！ 在如此宏伟壮观的建筑之下，我还怎么能够冷静地背诵那些话？我原本以为城镇入口处的领主雕像就已经给您足够震撼，谁能想到和这比起来完全是小巫见大巫！庞大的石头建筑本身就已经成为了一道风景线： 这些参天石柱就像是雨夜的祈祷，将整座城堡都笼罩在了让人充满敬畏的静谧之中。想象一下悬崖顶部的灰色教堂，拥有百年历史的砖石上爬满了青苔。天空中的电闪雷鸣不光光是在侵袭着圣所，更是在教堂的岩壁上形成了无数道瀑布。 高高隆起的石头拱门连通两侧，青蛙们在潺潺流水之间来回蹦跳。它们就像是阳伞的骨架一样攀附在壁柱四周，让我们能够免受呼啸强风的骚扰。 我不能分心！正式表演的时刻马上就要到来——希望领主会青睐我的歌喉！如果失败，也许我马上就要被吊在其中一道拱门上了……这时候可不能分心，切斯特！像你这样长着曼妙金发的头颅绝不应该兴起那种阴暗的思想！ — “幸运之人”切斯特·洛夫特

en:
Listen you lazy brutes — Our leader, <lorename>Sameth</lorename>, demands we dig more Elixir Wells! This will give us all the Elixir we could ever need!!

 It will be dangerous work, but the risk is surely worth it. Dig, you fools! Or face the wrath of <lorename>Sameth</lorename>!
cn:
听好了你们这些蠢货，<lorename>赛姆斯</lorename>老大要求我们挖掘更多的魔药之井！这样我们就能有用之不竭的魔药了！

这活很危险，但收益颇丰。所以赶紧挖起来，蠢货们！不然就等着面对<lorename>赛姆斯</lorename>的怒火吧！

en: You look dreadful, friend. Come closer, let me look at you. Mhh... bloodshot eyes, cotton mouth, and a hint of decay in your breath. You're suffering from a Fell Curse, no doubt. I advise you to take a cleanser posthaste! You can craft one with the right materials, but they're only found among the Fell in the dead of night, above the Shroud!
cn: 你的情况看上去不太妙，朋友。过来，让我好好检查一下。嗯……双眼充血、口干舌燥，而且呼吸中有一股淡淡的腐烂味。毫无疑问，你肯定是受到了瘴气魔的诅咒。建议你立刻服用一份净化药剂！制作净化药剂并不难，但为了收集制作材料，你必须在深夜寻找瘴气上方的瘴气魔！

en: It's a formula I do not quite grasp, sophisticated beyond imagination. I'm not surprised to know that the source of this recipe is otherworldly. Created from the flesh of these tiny, delicate fungi growing deep beneath the earth... It grants power. Yet, when I look at this flask, worry fills my heart. This will never be a cure. This will always be a weapon. Perhaps the Ancients hid this for a reason. — Balthazar, 500 D.A.
cn: 说实话这种配方的复杂程度已经远远超出了我的想象与理解。因此得知配方有着不同寻常的来源时，我并没有感到惊讶。 使用在地底生长的细微真菌作为原料……服下魔药就能够让人获得巨大的力量。但是对我来说，这些药水只是让我的心中充满了忧虑。这种东西根本不是什么解药。这就是一种武器。也许远古者当初是故意把配方藏了起来。 — 巴尔萨扎，500 D.A.

en:
As its distinctive appearance suggests, the Thornridge is an epic fish that only a very skilled fisher can catch.

This fish can be grilled or used in a recipe.
It can also be released back into the water and kept in a pond.
cn:
从这种独一无二的外表可以看出，荆脊是一种只有娴熟渔夫才能捕获的史诗鱼。

能够拿去烹饪或者是用做配方材料。
也能够直接将其放回水中或池塘中饲养。
提高在瘴气中的停留时间。

en: Magical ammunition that releases a healing wave and jumps to nearby friends. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 魔法弹药，使用时将施放一道能够弹射至周遭同伴的治疗之波。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en:
You've discovered a button in the Alchemist's tower!

Perhaps this button has opened the door to the basement downstairs? Proceed onwards and gather the mortar from the basement!
cn:
你在炼金术士的高塔中发现了一个按钮！

也许这个按钮连接着地下室中的大门？继续前进并在地下室中找到磨臼！

en:
6.1.6	
If Prohibited Content is identified, it will in any event be removed, since this is the only way to ensure that Prohibited Content is not seen in Adventure Sharing.
cn:
6.1.6	
如果识别出禁止内容，无论何种情况都将予以删除，因为这是确保禁止内容不会在冒险分享中出现的唯一方式。

en: You're a candle in the wind, my new friend. Come — let me show you the darkness you can't escape.
cn: 此刻你就是风中摇曳的烛火，我的新朋友。来吧，让我来给你展示无法逃脱的黑暗。

en: But from the depths of the Wells an unforeseen curse crept into Embervale.
cn: 没人预料诅咒会从井的深处悄然降临薪谷。

en: You do not have the permission to use this item
cn: 缺少权限，无法使用此物品

en:
A broken piece of the Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename> sculpture.
Find every piece to reassemble a statue.
cn:
一尊<lorename>派克米德</lorename>女王雕像的碎片。
找到所有碎片以重新组装雕像。

en: A gorgeous pearl. The magnetic pull of its lustrious shine is only enhanced by its rarity.
cn: 洁白无瑕的珍珠。饱满的光泽因为珍珠的稀有性而更显得弥足珍贵。

en: Survivors need to be placed before assigning a bed
cn: 先放置NPC，然后再为其分配床铺

en: Dear sir, Allow me to introduce myself. I am Costner Meyers, and you may have heard of me. I have reason to believe that a valuable resource lies beneath the ground you own, and I would happily negotiate a deal with you. For, you see, it has been preordained. Recently, I was struck by a vision while searching for water. I became disoriented in the wild, my mouth dry as sand — but at last, I was blessed by a visit from some sort of hovering phantom. You might think this to be a hallucination, but it gave me water and bestowed me with unlikely insight. The Kindlewastes are deadly, but the Mysterious Wanderer says there's hope. The land hides liquid gold inside! You must believe me. Do not test my faith. Signed, Costner Meyers, Midyear, 493 D.A.
cn: 尊敬的先生， 请允许我介绍自己，鄙人科斯特纳·迈耶斯，也许你曾经听到过我的名字。我现在有理由相信，你拥有的土地下方存在着一种极其宝贵的资源，因此我十分乐意就此事协商一笔交易。请你明白，我相信这一切都是命中注定。 确切来说，之前在寻找水源期间，我突然经历了一次幻象。当时我在荒野中迷失了方向，而且口舌干燥仿佛像吃了满嘴沙子，但是到最后，一名飘浮着的幽灵找到了我。你也许会觉得那一切都是幻觉，但幽灵确确实实地给我带了水，而且还告诉了我一个不同寻常的秘密。燃火荒原固然危险，但是神秘旅人说希望依旧尚存。大地之下其实潜藏着一种液体黄金！ 请你务必要相信我，也请不要考验我的信念。 此致， 科斯特纳·迈耶斯，岁中，493 D.A.

en: Is it really her? Do my eyes deceive me? By the fire, she's so tall! I still saw her as my little girl... No, I'm not crying. I must have gotten soot in my eyes. Look away! I need a moment!
cn: 真的是她吗？我没有出现幻觉吧？灵火在上，她怎么长这么高了！我印象里她还只是个小女孩……不，我没有哭。肯定是眼睛里进烟灰了。别看！我需要冷静一下！
调整玩家的最大法力值。

en:
<warning> The items from the backpack are dropped</warning> when you perish.
Return here to retrieve them.
cn:
死亡时会<warning>掉落背包中的所有物品</warning>。
返回死亡地点以取回物品。

en: 12 Changes to the Adventure Sharing Terms

I saw it again, outside. Quick and quiet, between the trees. It's some sort of beast, I think. Stalks back and forth, prowls the outskirts of town at night. Maybe Galvan or Augustus should lead a handful of men to that cave nearby. I can hardly sleep anymore... first the drought, the bandits, and now this? Dear gods, has this town not suffered enough?
cn: 我又看见它了。动作很快，就在树木之间悄无声息地移动。 我觉得那有可能是某种野兽。所以才会四处徘徊，到了晚上还会在城镇外面嚎叫。也许嘉文或者是奥古斯图斯能够带上一些人手去调查附近的那座洞窟。我现在感觉觉都睡不好了……先是旱灾，然后是强盗，现在又来这种事情？ 诸神在上，这座镇子承受的苦难还不够多么？

en: You have two action bars that you can switch in the game by using %k.
cn: 您有两个动作栏，可以在游戏中按下%k进行切换。

en: You've found a Kindlewastes color palette! Oh, such wonderful brightness!
cn: 你已经找到了一块燃火荒原调色板！哦，真是明亮又美丽！

en: The Ice-Cold Winds Hid Whitewing Vultures
cn: 躲藏在刺骨寒风中的白翼秃鹫

en: My dear! The Alchemist tasked you to enter the Hollow Halls? Beware of the Hollow inside! These thieves conspired to claim part of the Flame, and were cursed by the Ancients as punishment! To never feel the warmth of another... I almost pity them.
cn: 我的天！炼金术士要你去空荡礼堂？千万要小心里面的空荡！那些小偷曾经企图将一部分灵火据为己有，远古者为了惩罚它们就降下了诅咒！永远无法再感受到温暖……说实话我几乎都有点可怜它们的遭遇。

en: My friend, you look ill. Could you have contracted sepsis? You should consider crafting a hemotoxin antidote to rid yourself of this sickness. Let me think... I believe you will need the wings of a moth. They're common at night. Perhaps you should hunt some down!
cn: 朋友，你看上去气色不太好。不会是得了某种败血症吧？你需要制作一份毒血解毒剂来治疗这种疾病。让我想一想……制作解毒剂应该需要飞蛾的翅膀。飞蛾在晚上很常见。你可以试着抓一些！

en: His twisted mind hides a secret. I smell the scent of decay inside the manor. The walls. The body. Rot and ruin, a festering circle — somewhere. I feel it. His bones. It's in his bones. Inside the walls — a riddle, a maze — locked behind his tired eyes. I will dig tirelessly. I know it's in there, somewhere...
