cn: 他的扭曲心智肯定藏着一个秘密。我能够闻到宅邸中腐朽的气息。就在墙壁里，在房间里。腐烂与废墟，一个瘟疫肆虐的圆环……就在其中。我能感受到。他的骨头。就在他的骨头里面。在墙壁里面，是一个谜题，一个迷宫，就锁在了他疲倦的双眼后。 我将日夜不停地挖掘，因为我知道，它就在那之中……

en: Increases the skill level of Frost
Hey, you remind me of a song.
cn: 嘿，你让我想起了一首歌。

en: Mhh... No, no this isn't it. It's close, but it's not right! Think, Elio. Think, think, think... I vaguely remember this place I used to visit when stocking up on blue hair dye. Maybe the ingredient I need now was found nearby? What was the name...? "Gloomy Keep"? "Glumfield Keep"? Let me show you where it was!
cn: 嗯……不对，不是这个。很接近了，但还是不对！好好想想，埃里奥。用力想……我模糊地记得一个地方，以前需要制作蓝色染发剂的时候，我就会去那里。也许那附近有制作那些染发剂需要的原料？那个地方叫什么名字来着……？“忧郁要塞”？“夜地要塞”？还是让我直接指给你看吧！

en: Your flaming soul burns brighter than the sun.
cn: 你的灵魂燃烧得比太阳还亮。

en:
You successfully set foot in a new area — the Veilwater Basin. 

The Flame said that traversing these lands and fighting the brewing threat within will require aid. You feel called to investigate a nearby settlement for clues towards a pure soul that can steer you on the right path.
cn:
你已经成功来到了一片全新的区域——幕水盆地。

灵火说为了在这片大地跋涉并对抗蠢蠢欲动的威胁，你将需要寻求帮助。你感觉有必要调查附近的一处定居点来寻找通往一个纯洁灵魂的线索，也许那个人将指引你走上正确的道路。

en: Unlocks Special Abilities of Wands. Press %k to unleash a powerful Special Ability after generating enough Focus. Focus Generate Focus by attacking. Focus can be built up with any weapon type and is used to trigger Special Abilities of weapons.
cn: 解锁魔棒的特殊能力。 拥有充足专注时按%k释放强大的特殊能力。 专注 攻击将生成专注。所有类型的武器都可以积累专注，你可以花费专注来发动武器的特殊能力。

en: These padded trousers have been hastily stitched at the seams. Despite that, they hold up well.
cn: 虽然缝线有些粗糙，但这些有内衬的裤子依旧结实耐用。

en: Darya's Expedition To The Night Sanctums
cn: 达亚前往黑夜圣所的远征

en: With this greenish castle roof block, nothing stands in the way of your architectural masterpieces.
cn: 有了这种浅绿色的城堡屋顶方块，你一定能够成就自己的建筑杰作。

en: Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en: Increases the skill level of Iceman

The wizard was indeed experimenting in this tomb, and you have also discovered one of his results: an eternal fireball. Yet he was unsatisfied with his creation and declared he would continue his journey to a hidden tomb behind the great tower in the lake, close to Goldrock Saddle.

Seek out this tomb and continue your search for the wizard’s spell experiments.
cn:
巫师确实曾在这座墓穴进行过实验，而且你也发现了他的一项成果：永恒火球。但是巫师对自己的作品并不满意，并且宣称他将继续自己的旅程，他的下一个目标是湖中高塔后方的隐藏墓穴，就在靠近金石鞍的位置。

找到这处墓穴并继续寻找巫师的法术实验。

en: You’re ready to catch your first fish! Find a body of water and cast your line. Don’t forget to bait the hook. Come back and show me what you’ve caught.
cn: 你已经准备好钓上人生第一条鱼了！首先找到一处合适的水体然后抛竿。不要忘记挂上鱼饵。等有收获了就拿回来给我看看吧。

en: East Lapis is quickly becoming a ruined city... Famine and drought plague us. Thankfully, Uncle Dreadbane, as Sadie calls him, has taken us in for the time being... although this blessing may be a curse in disguise. He carries that hammer everywhere he goes, hunched from the weight. I always hear him in the hallways, dragging it around, huffing. "It's for protection," he says. "They crawl below. I hear them. From the hollow core..." It's downright creepy. We need hope, not horror stories! He went to fetch water from the well nearby, but it's been hours, and I'm worried. I'd go and check, but I think... I hate to admit it, but I think I hear it too. The crawl below...
cn: 东之岩转眼之间就沦为了一座废墟……饥荒与干旱席卷而来。幸运的是，被萨迪叫做恐厄大叔的男人收留了我们……虽然我不确定这到底是幸运还是不幸。 无论走到哪，他都随身带着那把沉重无比的锤子。我永远都能听见他在走廊里气喘吁吁地拽着那把东西。“这是为了防身”，他这么说到。“那些家伙就在底下乱窜。我听见它们了。就在空洞的核心里面……”真的太诡异了。我们现在需要的是希望，而不是什么恐怖故事！ 之前他去附近的水井打水去了，但现在好几个小时过去还没有回来，我有点担心。我想去找他，但是我觉得……虽然不想承认，但我感觉自己也听见。有什么东西正在地下爬动……

en: Instantly restores health massively, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.
cn: 立即恢复巨量生命值并提供10秒的持续治疗效果。

en: A translucent, gelatinous substance. It shimmers with an eerie glow and possesses restorative and protective properties. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Shroud Depthdwellers, initially found in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 从瘴气深渊行者身上提取出来的透明胶状物。这种散发着诡异光芒的凝胶拥有着治愈与保护的功效。制作治疗法术与魔法结界的关键材料。
幕水盆地 空荡礼堂

en: Its maw is cradling a gem that glows as the curse is spoken, leaving foes weaker as it feeds itself.
cn: 这把武器的巨口中镶嵌着一枚释放诅咒的宝石，它会在削弱敌人的同时喂养自身。

en: Build A Sheltered Bed For Elio
cn: 为埃里奥建造一处受到庇护的床

en: Dark leather patterned arm guards wrapped in ashen grey strings. Wool padding peeks out from beneath them when wielding your weapon fiercely.
cn: 浅灰色的丝线固定着护腕部分的深色皮革。如果在挥舞武器时用力过猛，皮革内侧缝着的毛料衬垫有可能会被挤出来。

en: A chainmail coif, crowned with a wreath of roses and thorns. Beauty and pain, pleasure and despair — they all coalesce in her halo.
cn: 环环相扣的锁子甲头套，顶部套有玫瑰与荆棘的花环。美丽与痛苦、欢愉与绝望，一切都在她的光环之中交织融合。

en: My son — allow me to tell you a tale of creation. This has been passed down through our people for many generations, so listen closely. When I am done, the story will be yours to pass to your kin. Our lake fell from the stars. Your people are wanderers by nature and when we came to these lands, they were dry and arid. We could not find our way to water, so we turned our voices toward the heavens — toward the Ancients. And they answered! The sky cracked open, sending a bright light to this very spot. The light met the dry earth and opened this lake, which quickly filled with water to sustain our people. And now, you ask, where are the Ancients to scrub the Shroud from these lands? Where has the water gone, the lifeblood of our people? My son — we are all asking the same questions.
cn: 儿子，我想给你讲一个有关创造的故事。祖祖辈辈以来，这个故事都在我们的人民中间口口相传，所以还请你听仔细。等我说完之后，你将肩负起继续传递这个故事的职责。 我们的湖泊最初来自于群星之间。你的人民其实是一群旅行者，当我们来到这片大地时，这里贫瘠而且荒芜。我们没办法找到任何可以使用的水源，于是我们便向着天国，向着远古者说出了自己的请求。接着他们便回应了！天空随之开裂，接着一道耀眼的光芒照亮了这个位置。光芒触及干涸的大地并开凿出了一个湖的形状，接着迅速涌现出的清水便满足了我们的需求。 你可能会问，远古者为什么不能冲刷掉肆虐大地的瘴气？原本我们赖以生存的清水又去了哪？ 我的孩子啊，没有人知道这些问题的答案。

en: Fell Enemies, Albaneve Summits Shroud and Veilwater Basin Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔敌人，阿尔班耶夫山脉以及幕水盆地瘴气区

en: A simple pair of brown leather pants that connect well to the corresponding undergarments for the torso.
cn: 一条朴素的褐色皮革长裤，能够与套装中的上衣部分完美搭配。
迷失之人 - 炼金术助手

en: A treacherous chasm. You'll need a Grappling Hook to cross.
cn: 这是一处凶险的深坑。你需要使用抓钩才能跨越。

en: Discovered crafting recipes are saved here.
cn: 这里将保存已发现的制作配方。

en: All my weapons — the staff, the sword, the bow. Together, they form a fearsome triad, just like wind, water, and spark create a storm. Thank you for returning them to our care. Their power is yours to wield.
cn: 我的所有武器……法杖、刀剑还有弓。它们就像是能够引发风暴的风、水还有火一样强大而且威猛。谢谢你将它们带回来。现在它们的力量属于你了。

en: This basic shield allows you to block physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
cn: 这面基础盾牌能够允许你格挡物理攻击。格挡将消耗体力。

en: Sneak Attack Damage is increased by %k.
This tool can only be used inside the building area around a Flame Altar. It can help you to quickly build your desired base with pre-defined structures.
cn: 仅能在灵火祭坛附近的建造区域内放置此工具。之后你将能够使用预制结构快速建造基地。

en: Nice day for fishing, ain't it?
cn: 今天是个钓鱼的好日子，对吗？
将日光百合带给理发师

en: Mystical gloves that have been adorned with glistening aquamarine stones.
cn: 神秘的手套上点缀着闪闪发光的海蓝宝石。

en: Filled with the power of life, this wrap will increase the Health of the consumer.
cn: 这份活力满满的卷饼将提高食用者的生命值。

en: Well… you’re better at this than I thought you’d be.
cn: 好吧……看来你比我想的更擅长干这个。

en: Claim A Spot For Your Base

cn: 加工毛料以制作更好的装备

en: The banana and honey combine to create a smooth and creamy sweetness. A delicacy for any Flameborn with a sweet tooth!
cn: 香蕉与蜂蜜的组合带来了一种柔滑而且绵密的甜美口感。对于任何爱好甜食的火之子来说这都是一份不可多得的美味！

en: Scales the internal rendering resolution and visual features of the water in the game. Increasing the quality impacts performance.
cn: 调整游戏中水体的内部渲染分辨率与视觉效果。提高品质将影响性能。

en:
When encased in solid bronze, the head looks even more menacing than before.

Collect multiple Hollow Cyclops Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
cn:
当头颅被包裹在坚实的青铜中时，看起来比以前更加凶猛。

收集多个 空荡独眼巨人 头像，制作青铜奖杯。

en: I'll keep you in my thoughts.

We laid another one to rest today. Poor folk. Traveled all this way looking for respite, only to find ruins and scraps. This church won't hold, Helên said as much. The wind howls and forges new paths into our halls every night. Storms tore our roof apart, and we're too busy tending to the caravan's people to patch it up. Yet, we must stay. We are needed here and will hardly find shelter elsewhere. Burying these vagabonds next to relics and artifacts feels wrong to me, but perhaps Helên is right. Maybe the old times must make way for new customs and rites. Perhaps we may find that spark that united us decades ago once more.
cn: 今天，我们又安葬了一个人。可怜的人。他一路旅行寻找喘息的机会，却只找到了废墟和残骸。海伦也说，这个教堂撑不住了。风呼啸着，每天晚上都能找到吹进大厅的新口子。 我们的屋顶被暴风雨撕裂了，我们忙于照顾车队的人，没空修补它。然而，我们必须留下来。这里需要我们，在其他地方几乎找不到庇护所。 在遗物与工艺品旁边埋葬这些流浪汉让我觉得不对劲，但也许海伦是对的。或许旧时代必须为新的习俗和仪式让路。 也许我们能够重新拾起数十载前让我们团结一心的火苗。

en:
Nutritious goat food for tame animals on your farm. It can be given to both Common Goats and Frizzy Goats.

It must be placed inside the appropriate feeder.
cn:
为农场中已经驯服的山羊准备的营养饲料。能够给普通山羊与绒毛山羊食用。

必须被放置在对应的喂食器中。

en: You got what it takes, Flameborn. I'll let you in on something: The best iron ore can be gathered at Ridgeback Mine, deep below the Shroud. Don't fret! With a high enough Shroud Passage Level, it shouldn't stop ya!
cn: 你的确有点本事，火之子。不妨告诉你一个小秘密：最好的铁矿石都产自脊背矿井，不过那里已经彻底被瘴气吞没。不过不用担心！只要拥有足够的瘴气抵抗等级，问题自然迎刃而解！

en: Increases the skill level of Blood Letting
I need some <keyitem>Scientific Instruments</keyitem>, friend! For what sort of science, you ask...? I'm afraid I can't let you know.
cn: 我需要一些<keyitem>科研设备</keyitem>，我的朋友！你问我具体要进行哪方面的研究？还请允许我暂时卖个关子。

en: A highly performant pickaxe made out of iron, useful in every environment. A truly handy tool to have.
cn: 高品质铁镐，能够适用于一切环境。真正趁手的工具。

en: Lightning jumps to recently hit enemies
cn: 闪电将跳跃至最近命中的敌人身上

en: The Farmer needs shelter to make her crafts. Build a home for the Farmer and grant her access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already! To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed. This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.
cn: 农民需要庇护所才能工作。为农民搭建一个家，并且确保她的周围有能够使用的受到庇护的床！ 若要为幸存者提供庇护所，首先请制作合适的床。将床放置在幸存者能够方便使用，且拥有良好保护的区域内。放置后，床将自动分配给附近没有床铺的幸存者。如果想要重新分配床，装备召唤法杖然后使用它瞄准床铺。 如果幸存者缺乏庇护，此任务将重新开启。

en: This binding overlaps one or more others.
cn: 此绑定与一个或多个其他的绑定存在重叠。

en:
The Flame instructed you to prepare a celebration in honor of the first Flameborn awakening.

To do so, you should acquire celebratory clothing! Reach the location marked on your map to gain access to a new outfit!
cn:
灵火希望你准备一场祝贺首批幸存者火之子觉醒的庆祝活动。

接下来你需要想办法获取一套节日服装！抵达地图上标记的位置以获取全新的装扮！

en: I was surprised to see Willie so "protective" over those color pots we got from Nomad's Drop. I've never known him to be an artist — unless you want to call all his fingerpainting "art"... Well, they're not worth much, so there's no point in holding on to them. We might as well pull a little prank on Willie then! I grabbed some of those precious parcels from the last haul and put 'em up top. Maybe that'll keep Willie away from fingerpainting and refocus him on being a cold-blooded robber unafraid to shank, steal, and smuggle.
cn: 没想到威利竟然会如此“保护”我们从游牧集会所拿到的那些颜料罐。没想到这家伙竟然是个艺术家，当然，前提是他的那些涂鸦能算是“艺术”的话…… 总而言之，反正那些东西也不值钱，所以给他也无所谓。不过正好借着这个机会给威利来一场恶作剧！ 我从上次弄到的货里面拿了一些贵重的包裹，然后把它们都放顶上去了。 也许这样就能让威利不要再画那些丑陋的涂鸦，他应该是一个冷却无情的强盗，杀戮、偷窃还有走私才是我们该干的事情。

en: A pickaxe made out of bronze. Only struggling with the hardest of stones, it can be considered very efficient.
cn: 使用青铜制作的矿镐。效率极高，能够开采除最坚硬的矿石之外的一切石材。

en: A signpost that can be used to attach direction signs.
cn: 能够悬挂方向标志的路标。

en: An incredibly sturdy chest piece, often worn by generals or select members of the royal guard. It inspired fear as much as respect.
cn: 异常牢固的胸甲，通常只有将领或者是皇家卫队中的特定成员才有权穿戴。这件装备足以彰显威严的气势。

en: Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS) is an NVIDIA RTX technology that uses deep learning neural networks and Tensor Cores on RTX GPUs to deliver faster frame rates, better image quality, and great responsiveness.
cn: 深度学习超级采样 （DLSS） 是一项 NVIDIA RTX 技术，它在RTX GPU上使用深度学习神经网络和 Tensor Core，以提供更高的帧速率、更好的图像质量和出色的响应能力。
半木结构贝壳灰岩方块
小型空荡之夜南瓜 II

en:
Can't meet ya today
Dock office posted a notice about us. Did ya see it?

Don't worry
I'll be active on the docks, loud and sweaty — lookin' hard and hard at work — gonna cover us for a week or so.

In the meantime, nab some coffee from the Seascaper shipment before we load 'er up! I got a coffee grinder somewhere at home. Some coffee is bound to make our little breaks much sweeter!

DAVE
cn:
今天没办法去见你
港口办公室已经张贴了一份关于我们的告示。你看见了吗？

不用担心
我会去港口上弄点动静出来的，让别人觉得我有在努力工作，这样应该能够应付个一周左右。

与此同时，趁着我们还没给海景号装货，想办法弄点咖啡来！我家里正好有一台咖啡研磨器。休息时候能够来上几杯咖啡岂不美哉！

大卫

en: An item used by the <npc>Hunter</npc> to create better strings.
cn: 能够允许<npc>猎人</npc>制作更高级的线绳。

en: A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you stamina and stamina regeneration.
cn: 一罐美味的绒毛山羊奶。饮用后能够提供体力与体力恢复。

en:
A relief that details the history of the Drak.

This relief portrays two images. The top shows a human-made Night Sanctum, and people bringing books and scrolls as a tribute to the Ancients.

The bottom sees the Drak enraged. They refuse to let humanity gain the favor of the Ancients, and attack.
cn:
详细记载着卓克的历史的浮雕。

这块浮雕展示了两幅画面。上半部分展示了人类制作的黑夜圣所，以及人们将作为贡品的书籍与卷轴带给远古者的景象。

下半部分则展示了愤怒的卓克。他们拒绝让人类获得远古者的青睐，于是便发起了攻击。

en: The Fisher provided you with all the things you need to catch your first epic fish. A suitable location with a high change for epic fish is marked, but they can be found anywhere in the Veilwater Basin. Try your luck with your newly acquired Excellent Fishing Rod and Frog bait and show your catch to the Fisher afterwards.
cn: 渔夫已经为你提供了捕捉第一条史诗鱼所需要的一切。地图上已经标记了一个有极高概率可以钓到史诗鱼的位置，不过你可以在幕水盆地中的任意地点找到史诗鱼。 使用新得到的上等鱼竿与青蛙鱼饵挑战手气，然后向渔夫展示你的收获。

en: An edible flower used to enhance the effect of certain dishes. It only blooms at night in the Springlands.
cn: 可食用的花朵，能够提升特定食物的效果。只会在夜晚的春日平原绽放。

en: Cade Hawthorn shared some insight about building <location>Morwenna</location>. It was destroyed by wildlife and pests, so he decided to move on and focus more on building a future rather than repairing the present.
cn: 卡迪·霍桑分享了一些当时建造<location>莫文纳</location>的信息。那座镇子最后被野生动物与害虫们给摧毁了，于是他决定就此放弃，转而专心打造未来，而不是一味沉溺于修补现在。

en: Rectangular flints reach outwards from the blade's core, some as big as your fist. Their peaks and valleys make up the image of a gargantuan spine befitting an apex predator — hence the reference to the drakian god who strove for dominion of the continent.
cn: 矩形的燧石从剑身核心向外延展，其中有一些几乎和攥起的拳头一样大。崎岖不平的剑身会让人联想到某个顶级捕食者的巨大脊椎——就像是企图夺取这片大陆的统治权的龙裔之神一样。

en: My brother's always been the insolent sort. Right of the firstborn, he'd claim as he dove headfirst into battle. This Hollow Hall taunts him, and emboldened by his entourage, I fear he's to rebuke its mockery. Alas, he's chosen to drag himself and his troops into the shadowed caverns... while I'm left to await his return with bated breath. I've gathered my men; rowdy sorts with a dire need for coins in their pockets. Their loyalty is paid for, but there's no telling how the dungeons may test this bond. There's no time to waste. Berhtolf may already be held at a sword's edge, or buried beneath ice and rubble. Every minute counts. Lando Dimweald
cn: 我的兄弟一直是个刚愎自用的人。这是长子的特权，每次身先士卒冲向战场的时候，他都会这么说。在过去，这座空荡礼堂一直是他心中跨不过的那道坎，但是当逐渐壮大的队伍给他带来了新的勇气，我害怕他将试图回应那个地方的讥讽。 很遗憾，他将自己和跟随着他的士兵们都投入到了那片阴影横行的洞穴……而我只能在这里焦急地等待着他。 我已经召集了自己的手下，他们都是为钱卖命的那种狂野之徒。虽然我已经买下了他们的忠诚，但是谁也不知道那是否经得起地牢的考验。 时间紧迫。巴索夫有可能已经遭遇危险，或者被深埋在寒冰与废墟之下。 接下来我必须争分夺秒。 兰多·迪姆维尔德

en: A hat that looks like it protects your precious ears from the cold. It's just cosmetic, though.
cn: 这顶帽子看上去能够保护脆弱的耳朵不被冻僵。不过很可惜，那单纯只是装饰用的设计。

en: Banned in most mystic circles, this spell serves as an infinite well of acid to envenom foes. Its bite is most deadly, so use it with care. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 在大多数秘法学界都被禁止使用，这种法术会像一口无穷无尽的酸液之井对敌人下毒。它的腐蚀能力相当致命，因此要小心使用。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en:
The Saviour skill can be used to revive fallen players in the fog around you. Both players will divide their remaining time in the Shroud amongst each other.
Range: 5 meters around the caster
cn:
救星技能可以复活自身周围处于迷雾中的玩家。被复活的玩家与你将平分两人剩余的瘴气停留时间。
范围：施法者周围5米范围

en: Daggers that were bathed in sunlight during forging. Their spiked edge can cause a lot of damage! Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 沐浴在耀眼日光中锻造而成的匕首。尖端能够对敌人造成大量伤害！ 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: A Rough Stone Block built in the most basic manner of craftsmanship. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 用最简单的工艺制作的粗糙石方块。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en:
Two bloods laid siege to these lands.

One was cold and violet as a yearfall's plum, encased in emerald leaves like scales. The other red and warm as a song shared by the fireside.

A forsaken clash, brought forth by our favoritism of fire. When we lifted humanity, we lowered all else... trampled a seed that thought us to be its sun, its god. But the seed grew in silence and hate, and where one purple petal fell, its roots took hold.
cn:
这片大地发生过两场血腥的围攻。

其中一场和岁末的梅花一样冷冽又深紫，并且被包裹在像鳞片一样的翡翠叶片中。另外一场血红又温暖，就像是篝火旁分享的歌谣。

一次被遗弃者的征战，来源于我们对于火焰的热爱。当我们举起人类，其他的一切皆被我们放下……原本将我们认为是太阳与神灵的种子就此被践踏。但是那枚种子在沉默与仇恨中继续成长，当一片紫色的花瓣落下，它便深深扎下了根。

en: Our numbers grow by the day! Where the coals are alive, a fire can roar yet!
cn: 我们的人数与日俱增！俗话说众人拾柴火焰高！

en:
Sometimes, the muscles around the eyes still twitch. It's natural, and not worrying. Mostly.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
有时，眼睛周围的肌肉还会抽搐。这很自然，不用担心。一般来说。

收集多个瘴气魔镰鼬头颅来制作战利品。

en: When the Kingdom of Embervale still stood as one, we were beyond harm. The old walls were impenetrable during Queen Pikemead's reign. Now, they crumble. Every watch, I see the smoke come closer... the mistral weighs heavily with a pungent sweetness. Rot and decay... they'll tear through the rampart soon enough. Even the Mining Rift due east cannot yield enough stone to restore the imperial aegis afore the brewing siege.
cn: 在薪谷王国仍然团结一致的年代，我们无所畏惧。在派克米德女王的统治下，旧城墙是坚不可摧的存在……但是现在，那些城墙已经变得脆弱无比。 每次轮到我警戒的时候，我我都发现那些浓雾愈发逼近……迎面而来的风里面有一种甜腻到令人作呕的气味。腐烂与衰败……恐怕城垛也坚持不了多久。哪怕是东面的采矿裂隙也无法提供足够的石材来帮助帝国的城墙恢复往日的荣光。

en: An Alchemist is nothing without his cauldron! Mine erupted into flames long ago... but our dear Emily Fray has filled me with hope. She tells stories of Ikora, a remarkable mage from the Nomad Highlands... she must've fallen to time, but we could use her Black Cauldron to make an Alchemy Station! Emily Fray can tell you more.
cn: 俗话说坩埚就是炼金术士的命！问题是我的锅子在很久以前就已经烧坏了……不过最近亲爱的艾米丽·弗莱重新点燃了我的希望。她之前提到了依科拉的故事，此人是游牧高地中一位家喻户晓的法师……虽然现在她肯定早已与世长辞，但说不定我们能够用她的黑坩埚来建造一座炼金台！艾米丽·弗莱可以告诉你更多信息。

en: Just one look into those eyes and your enemies will want to turn the other way. That was your first line of defense, and you didn't have to lift a finger.
cn: 只要看见这些眼睛，你的敌人们就会情不自禁想要扭开视线。这就是你的第一道防线，而且你甚至不需要为此动一根手指头。

en: An axe with two perfectly rounded, balanced steel blades. They nearly form the shape of the full moon.
cn: 安装有两块圆形的平衡钢刃的斧子。斧刃的形状看上去就像是满月一样。

en: While investigating the keep, you uncovered a note that mentions a nearby "gloomberry" field. The writing in the text makes you believe that the berries can only be found at night. Visit the gloomberry field at night to collect gloomberries! You can also gather the ingredients elsewhere in the Revelwood and return them to the Barber while having them in your inventory.
cn: 调查要塞期间，你发现了一张纸条，上面提到了附近的一处“暗夜果”田地。根据纸条上的信息，这些浆果似乎只会在夜间出现。 在夜间拜访暗夜果田并收集暗夜果！ 你可以在喧嚣森林的其他地方收集原料，回去找理发师时记得确保原料就在物品栏中。

en: Every movement is softened and muted whilst clad in this upper body armor.
cn: 穿上这件上身护甲后，每一个动作都变得柔和而轻盈。

en:
9.1	
As a freely available gameplay feature of Enshrouded, the terms of the Platform through which you purchased Enshrouded shall apply to the use of Adventure Sharing. In addition, the provisions of Section 9 shall apply insofar as they do not conflict with the Platform terms. In the event of such a conflict, the order of precedence set out in Section 1.2 shall apply.
cn:
9.1	
作为 Enshrouded 的一项免费游戏功能，您购买 Enshrouded 时所通过的平台的条款应适用于冒险分享的使用。此外，第 9 条的规定在其与平台条款不冲突的条件下适用。若发生此类冲突，则以第 1.2 条规定的优先顺序为准。

en: Reach The Location Of The Celebratory Outfit

Back when my daughter Marianne was young, we fled our old home at the first sign of decay. I grabbed my little one, a sack of grain, loaded both onto a cart and never looked back. I left everything else, burying half my possessions in the festering basement... If you're brave enough to venture there, perhaps you'll find something of use. Sadly, that's all I can offer you.
cn: 在我女儿玛丽安娜还小的时候，我们因为害怕腐化而逃离了自己的旧宅。当时我把女儿和一袋谷物放到推车上之后就头也不回地离开了。我放弃了一切，几乎一半的家当还留在那边腐朽的地下室里面……如果你有勇气去那里冒险的话，说不定你能在那里找到有用的东西。很遗憾，我没办法给你提供更多帮助了。

en: A knight's boots. They've seen much peril and anguish.
cn: 这双靴子经历过无数危险和磨难，见证过骑士的荣耀与悲伤。

en: Vukah within 50 meters will no longer attack you unless provoked.
cn: 除非受到挑衅，否则50米范围内的沃卡将不会主动攻击玩家。

en: An ingredient used in crafting recipes.

On your journey, you will encounter locked doors and chests. To open them, craft lockpicks in your Manual Crafting tab. Lockpicks will be automatically used upon interacting with a locked door or chest. Crafting lockpicks requires Metal Scraps.
cn: 在旅途中，您会遇到上锁的门和箱子。要想打开它们，在 手工制作标签页中制作开锁器。在与上锁的门或箱子互动时，会自动使用开锁器。 制作开锁器需要金属废料。

en: A delicacy of the marine world, it is crispy on the outside and soft and full of flavor on the inside. It is the perfect meal for weary adventurers.
cn: 来自海洋世界的美味，外壳酥脆，内部柔软风味满满。适合疲劳冒险者们的完美餐食。

en: Never thought I'd see a war — nay, a live invasion — in the last of my tired days. I've buried so many. I confess this comforts me. Guiding people on their final voyage. So many last goodbyes. Today comes mine. Rimgard is past the gates. We can't seek respite in the castle... Gormander locked all doors and lowered the gates. It will not stop the horde. They will find their way. Ancients preserve us, the Shroud is seeping inside. Something drips from above. If anyone finds this, if anyone is left I want to be buried next to my wife and son under the old oak Leave the headstone blank I have nothing left to say
cn: 我从没有想到在垂垂老矣的年纪，还能亲眼见证一场战争，不，应该说这是一场入侵。 我已经埋葬了那么多人。我承认这一点让我感到欣慰。因为我知道自己是在引导人们走上最后一程。不过在经历了那么多次告别之后，今天终于轮到我自己了。 里姆加德的军队已经冲破城门。我们无法去城堡里面避难……戈曼德已经封锁了所有入口与大门。不过就算这么做也无法抵挡外面的大军。他们终究会找到进去的方法。愿远古者保佑我们，瘴气正在不断渗进来。楼顶已经在滴水。 如果有人找到这张纸条，如果还有幸存者 请将我埋葬在老橡树下，我想跟我的妻子还有儿子葬在一起 墓碑上不用写什么 我没有什么要说的

en: Learning how to create basic structures with the Construction Hammer and Building Blocks has enabled you to build shelter. Being sheltered fulfills one of the 3 conditions needed to become Rested: shelter, (or sitting, lying down) warmth, and comfort. The next major condition you need to understand is warmth. You're warmed by spending time near a fire, such as a Flame Altar, campfire, or fireplace. The latter two are also necessary for cooking food, which provides helpful buffs. Craft or obtain a fireplace to proceed!
cn: 通过学习如何使用建筑锤以及建筑方块来打造基础建筑，你已经解锁建造庇护所的知识。 身处庇护所是获得“休息良好”状态的3个先决条件之一：受到庇护，（或者是能够坐下以及躺下）温暖、以及舒适。 温暖是你需要掌握的下一个重要条件。在类似灵火祭坛、营火或者是火炉旁逗留一段时间将使你获得温暖。营火与火炉同时也是烹饪能够提供各类有用加成的食物的必要设备。 制作或获取一个火炉以继续！

en: You provide your fellowship with healing.

My Illustrious King — I write with troubling tidings. Glennwood's End is falling to ruin. It is as if a great cloud of sickness and decay has settled over the principality. The people have let their homes, roads, and daily way of life crumble... all this due to "The Elixir". I have taken samples from an unlawful distillery and am studying them behind bolted doors. Expect another report post-haste, your grace. Investigator Lachlan, 35th of Yearfall, 502 D.A.
cn: 尊贵的国王陛下，我有令人担忧的消息要带给您。格伦伍德之末已经沦为废墟，此地仿佛已经被瘟疫与腐朽的阴霾所彻底笼罩。当地的人们纷纷弃自己的家园、道路乃至是生活所不顾……这一切的不幸事件都源自“魔药”。 我从一处非法酿造室中提取了一些样本并且正在安全地点进行研究。我将尽快给您呈递后续报告。 调查员岁末，岁末第35日，502 D.A.

en: Every song must come to an end.
cn: 天下没有不散的宴席，歌曲也是。

en: The edible root of a forest plant. Not all that sustaining on its own. Maybe good as ingredient?
cn: 森林植物的可食用根茎。虽然生吃效果不佳，但是也许能够作为原料？

en: Have you gone to the quarry yet for me? The stones there are so beautiful, you won't regret it!
cn: 你有去过采石场了吗？那里的石头都很壮观，我保证你不会后悔的！

en: Fully upgrade the weapon to unlock the Gem Slot.
cn: 完全升级武器以解锁宝石栏位。

en: A mighty one-handed axe, tainted by the blood of the fallen.
cn: 受到瘴气魔血液污染的单手斧，威力巨大。

en: You should have seen the one I caught the other day!
cn: 你是没有看见我之前钓到的那条鱼有多大！
黄金瘴气魔幼龙战利品

en: It has come to our attention that some individuals have attempted to manually clear blockages in the grinder while the machinery is still in operation. We must emphasize that this practice is strictly prohibited due to the severe safety risks involved, including the potential for loss of limbs, or worse, loss of employment. Under no circumstances should any part of the body be placed near or within moving equipment. If access to the millstone is absolutely necessary, all water flow must be completely stopped prior to any intervention. To stop water flow, close the water gates in the waterwheel's basin.This will ensure the external water wheel ceases operation and that all related machinery is fully disabled. Please treat this matter with the utmost seriousness. Your safety is our highest priority. Sincerely, Timberwolf Logging & Co. Safety & Operations Team
cn: 近来我们注意到有人试图在研磨器仍然运作的情况下手动清理堵塞区段。我们必须在此强调，这种做法是被严格禁止的，并且会有着严重的安全隐患，包括潜在的肢体损伤，或者是更糟糕的，失业。 无论在何种情况下，请勿将身体的任何部分靠近或放置在运作中的设备附近。 如果必须操作磨盘，请在进入前中断所有水流。如果需要中断水流，请关闭水轮底部的水闸。这么做将确保外部水轮停止运作，所有与之关联的机器也会彻底停转。 请务必严肃对待此事。你们的安全是我们的优先目标。 诚挚的， 森林狼伐木公司 安全&运营团队

en: The Luscious Drakonian Maid, Chapter 2: River Maiden
cn: 气质满满的龙裔女仆 - 第二章：河畔女仆

en: Such a trivial pursuit, now that I've tasted eternity... but I did not go without a plan, nor a convincing argument. Just one drop of the Elixir to sweeten the wine. That was all it took for Gormander, old fool, to call forth his advisers and engineers. They may caution him against building the Elixir Wells at first, but their words will wither soon enough. Jezmina, however, could only be silenced through a swift backhand. The brat still believes the Ancients may have good reason to hide such power... A private contractor will build the Wells in her stead, should she not oblige. Once her yammering faded into weeping, I forced her eyes open and told her the truth amongst lies. The Ancients HID this from us! They're sleeping snakes, and all but me are too fearful to wake them! Cowards, I say! Rats before Dragons in disguise, I tell you! We are right to defend ourselves. Dig just a little deeper — What else lies hidden below? Will Earth spill her secrets if we split her tongue, crack her open, leave her bleeding? I trust only the mist under the wanderer's hood, the twitch of his shadow, the gaping of his hundred mouths He can make us rise Can make us levitate Can change the mice to men — Lord Vorgoth, Guard of the North, Ruler of Rimgard
cn: 在品尝过永恒的滋味后，这种事实在是让人感到渺小得可笑……但是我不能两手空空地去，我需要有一个能够说服所有人的手段。 只需要在葡萄酒中加入一滴魔药即可。戈曼德那个老傻瓜立刻召集起了自己的顾问和工程师。一开始那些人也许会劝诫他不要建造魔药之井，但是那些话马上就会烟消云散。 不过恐怕我只能够动用武力才能够让杰兹米娜闭嘴。那个小崽子仍然觉得远古者是出于善意才藏起了这种力量……如果她不愿意遵从，那我恐怕只能找一名私人承包商来建造魔药之井。等到她的喋喋不休变成啜泣，我将强行扒开她的眼睛，然后让她见证隐藏在谎言背后的真相。 是远古者们故意将这一切藏了起来！ 那些家伙就是沉睡着的毒蛇，除了我以外，没有人有勇气去赶走他们！一帮懦夫！一群在巨龙面前惶惶不可终日的鼠辈！ 我们有权利来保护自己。我们要做的只是稍稍挖开地下——那里还隐藏着什么东西？ 如果我们割开大地之舌并撕裂她的身体与血脉，她是否会愿意吐露自己的秘密？ 从今往后我只会相信旅人兜帽之下迷雾、他的抖动的阴影还有那无数张嘴的呢喃 他可以引导我们崛起 可以让我们漂浮起来 可以将老鼠变为真正的人 ——沃格斯领主，北境守卫

en: An extravagant helmet with red plumes, traditionally worn by high-ranking army commanders.
cn: 造型华丽的头盔，往往只有军队里的高阶指挥官才有资格穿戴这种装有红色尾羽的款式。
搜索有关<lorename>洛琳·克里姆</lorename>的线索

en: You've come far, but we must go further. Delicious fear escapes them and travels from beyond the veil to my little ears. Reach the tired sands in the East. Raze them further. Glide. Gather. Gain.
cn: 你做得很好，但我们必须继续前进。它们散发出的美味恐惧已经穿过帷幕并来到了我的耳旁。前往东面的倦怠沙海。毁灭它们。滑翔、收集、搜刮。

en: A pair of comfortable boots perfect for snow days.
cn: 一双舒服的靴子，寒冷冬天的完美选择。

en: Scales the length of daytime. A smaller value equals shorter daytime.
cn: 调整白天的持续时间。调低数值将减少白昼时长。

en: The old watchtower in Surat's Rest hides valuables. Reach the top of the tower and claim the treasures there!
cn: 苏拉特之息的古老瞭望塔中藏有宝物。前往塔顶并拿走那里的宝藏！

en: You look like you're suffering from an ailment, Flameborn! Please step closer so I can examine you!
cn: 你的健康情况似乎让人堪忧，火之子！请靠近一点，让我好好检查一下！

en: Look at this tranquil turquoise! It's so peaceful and serene, like a frozen mountain brook...
cn: 快看看这静谧的青绿色！静谧祥和，就像是冰封的山间小溪……

en: Summons an electrified wisp that follows you around and shoots shock projectiles.
cn: 召唤一个跟随你并且会发射电击投掷物的电流妖精。

en: Build A Sheltered Bed For Emily Fray
cn: 为艾米丽·弗莱建造一张受到庇护的床

en: You’ve found a note about a broken coffee machine. If they roasted and brewed coffee here, their recipes must be around somewhere. Find the recipes, so you can recreate them on your own!
cn: 你找到的笔记中提到了一台坏掉的咖啡机。 如果人们曾经在这里烘焙与烹煮咖啡，那这附近一定也能够找到配方。 寻找配方以亲自尝试烹煮咖啡！

en:
You can use the Grappling Hook to pull in small and medium enemies towards yourself. Enemies are stunned for 1 second. 
Cost: 50 stamina
cn:
抓钩能够将中小型敌人拉向自己。被拖拽的敌人将晕眩1秒。
消耗：50点体力

en:
4.2.2	
The right of use granted under Section 4.2 shall exist for the duration of the availability of the User Content on Adventure Sharing and shall end upon the actual deletion of the User Content by Keen or the Uploader. As an Uploader, you can therefore terminate this right of use granted to Downloaders by removing your User Content. For technical reasons, temporary local cached copies (cache files) of the User Content created during Visiting mode may temporarily remain on the user's device after the User Content has been removed from Adventure Sharing. Keen has no influence over when such cache files are automatically cleared by the relevant operating system or device and assumes no responsibility in this regard.
cn:
4.2.2	
第 4.2 条项下授予的使用权，其存续期间为在冒险分享中提供用户内容的期间，并于 Keen 或上传者实际删除该用户内容时终止。因此，作为上传者，您可以通过删除您的用户内容来终止授予下载者的这项使用权。出于技术原因，当从冒险分享中删除用户内容之后，在访问模式期间创建的用户内容的临时本地缓存副本（缓存文件）可能仍会暂时保留在用户设备上。Keen 无法控制此类缓存文件何时被相关操作系统或设备自动清除，并且对此不承担任何责任。

en: A shiny pair of boots. They're so heavy that you'll practically be immovable when wearing them.
cn: 闪闪发光的靴子，沉甸甸的几乎让你无法移动，但绝对拉风十足。

en: This forgotten piece of armor is covered in dried blood and shrouded in darkness. Maybe it should have stayed lost.
cn: 这件被遗忘的护甲上沾满了干涸的血迹，被黑暗所笼罩。也许它本该一直被遗忘。

en: Let's go easy on the legs for a moment.
You don't have any compatible ammo.
You've discovered a new survivor in the Hollow Halls. Place them in your home with a summoning staff to proceed.
cn: 你在空荡礼堂找到了一位新的幸存者。 使用召唤法杖将其安置在你的家中以继续。

en: The remains of an unfortunate distillery diver were brushed underneath the floorboards of the Willow Crush grindmill. Find the spot and dig for loot!
cn: 一名偷偷溜进酿造室后遇难的倒霉蛋的遗体被埋在了碎柳镇磨坊的地板之下。找到确切位置并挖掘其中的宝藏！

en: Are you sure you want to remove "%k" from your favorites?
cn: 确定想要将“%k”从你的收藏中移除？

en: An interesting plant, stimulating every persons taste buds. The use in tea has established itself as a custom.
cn: 针叶能够刺激味蕾的有趣植物。饮用这种植物泡制的茶水是当地的习俗。

en: The Collector, who introduced themselves as Alden Crowley, requires shelter. They will be able to craft more once sheltered. Build a home for the Collector and grant them access to a nearby sheltered bed if you haven't already! To shelter your survivors, craft a suitable bed. Place the bed in a protected area easily accessible by survivors. It will automatically be assigned to the nearest free survivor upon being placed. If you wish to re-assign the bed, equip your Summoning Staff and use it while aimed at the bed. This quest will reopen to notify you once your survivors are no longer sheltered.
cn: 自称为“埃尔登·克劳利”的收藏家表示自己需要一处庇护所。满足要求之后，此人将能够提供更多制作选择。为收藏家搭建一个家，并且确保其周围有能够使用的受到庇护的床！ 若要为幸存者提供庇护所，首先请制作合适的床。将床放置在幸存者能够方便使用，且拥有良好保护的区域内。放置后，床将自动分配给附近没有床铺的幸存者。如果想要重新分配床，装备召唤法杖然后使用它瞄准床铺。 如果幸存者缺乏庇护，此任务将重新开启。

en: I still remember when that strange fellow came to my tavern. It was a slow day in the yearfall of 498 D.A. My best customers had been the contractors and builders from this here Elixir Well, but nearing the completion of their project, they'd been too busy to come by. I was closing up early when a Mysterious Wanderer slid through my doorway. They were adamant about sharing a pint with me, and while I saw no fault in that, I made sure to keep my distance. My guest seemed... to be in bad health. Nevertheless, I got to work and poured our drinks as the traveler mused about secrets below the ground. I sat there for hours, listening to myths of magic that, when dug up, would bring boundless power and transformation. Once the stranger had left, I noticed my racing heartbeat — and that I hadn't touched my ale. That's when I knew I had to see the completion of the Elixir Wells myself!
cn: 我仍然记得那个奇怪的家伙来酒馆时的情景。 那是498 D.A.的岁末，那天酒馆里客人不多，来自魔药之井的建筑商与工人们向来是我最好的顾客，但当时他们的项目已经临近尾声，所有人都忙得不可开交。 我原本打算早点打烊，这时候一位神秘旅人悄无声息地跨过了我的店门。那个人坚持要请我喝一杯，虽然我不介意喝两口，但我仍然与那个人保持着距离，因为我看见这位客人……似乎身体欠佳。 无论如何，接下来我便开始忙活倒酒，而那位旅人则开始讲述各种深埋在地下的秘密。我在酒桌旁坐了好几个小时，倾听着旅人谈论着魔法的传说，旅人说只要挖开地表就能够获得无穷无尽的力量与转变。 等旅人最终离开之后，我发现自己的心砰砰直跳，而且我其实一口酒都没喝。我已经想好了，我一定要亲眼见证魔药之井竣工的那一刻！

en: Make A Dog Bowl And Dog Bed
cn: 制作一个狗碗与一个狗窝

en: Whoa, look at that! My legs work, and my nose isn't broken! I'm alive and kickin', and I love a good kick! Let's get our hands dirty and rebuild this place!
cn: 哇哦，我没有在做梦吧！我的腿又能走了，我的鼻子也完好无损！我还活着，我又能再一次走路了！让我们抓紧时间重建这个地方吧！

en: This pair of pants has significant padding on the inside, allowing you to travel for longer periods in frost-ridden lands. Traditionally, hides from the wearer's spirit animal are used to create the padding, but wool will do in a pinch.
cn: 这条裤子的内侧缝有充足的衬垫因此十分温暖，穿上之后你将能够放心在寒冷地带进行长途跋涉。根据传统，穿戴者会使用代表自身灵兽的皮革来制作衬垫，不过如果找不到合适的材料，毛料也可以拿来当替代品。

en: You have returned from your journey! Thank you for uncovering the mystery of that letter. Now I can make you stronger — consider crafting new armor!
cn: 你回来了！谢谢你帮我调查那封信的真相！现在我能为你打造新的装甲，让你变得更强了！

en: You've discovered that a nearby town, <location>Shorewatch</location>, was previously home to an old woman who fed many stray dogs. Perhaps some dogs are still there. Reach the town and look for a tameable dog!
cn: 你得知附近一个叫做<location>岸守镇</location>的镇子上曾经住着一位老妇人，她以前收养了很多流浪狗。也许那里仍然能够找到野狗。抵达小镇并寻找可以驯服的狗！

en: Jezmina, is it true? The Ancients call upon you to stay behind as the rest of us slumber? Will you be there when I awake? Please, you cannot leave my side! You're my all! Why must we change? I miss the old days when we used to travel... together, side by side. You let me linger next to you. You held my hand. And now? All this secrecy, for what? I thought you could confide in me. I don't want the Ancients to drive us apart! I'll lose all faith! If you must go, at least give me a farewell kiss. All my heart, — Emily
cn: 杰兹米娜，这是真的吗？远古者要求你留下来，而不是与我们一起陷入沉睡？当我醒来的时候，你还会在那里吗？求求你了，不要离开我！你是我的全部！ 为什么要改变？我怀念过去的日子，我怀念那些旅行……我们一起并肩前行的日子。你牵着我的手，和我一起走着。但是现在为什么一切都变了？为什么你要沉默隐瞒？ 我以为你会信任我。我不希望看见远古者把我们分开！那样我还怎么保持自己的信念！ 如果你必须要走，那至少给我一个离别的吻吧。 全心全息爱着你的， — 艾米丽

en:
They nigh blew me to smithereens, those scoundrels!

"Dieter, go witness! We discovered a chest in the new tunnel, I swear it! Nay, Dieter, 'tis no jest, observe for yourself!"

My mouth is choked with dust, and my hands are numb from digging! My nails splinter... I am famished.

Vicious curs! May the Shroud take you all!
cn:
老子差点就被炸没了，那些混蛋！

“迪亚特，快去看看！我们在新挖的隧道里找到了一个宝箱，真的不骗你！不，迪亚特，没跟你开玩笑，你去看看就知道了！”

这里粉尘乱飞根本张不开口，而且我的手都快挖到没力气了！指甲都裂了……而且还饿得要命。

那帮该死的王八蛋！愿瘴气把你们统统弄死！

en:
A vivid palette of bright blue, blazing red, and pure white — crisp, bold, and full of energy, like a banner snapping in the wind. 

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
由明亮的蓝、灼热的红还有纯洁的白构成的鲜艳配色——干脆、大胆而且富有活力，就像是迎风招展的旗帜。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en:
11.2	
Changes to Adventure Sharing as a freely available gameplay feature of Enshrouded shall be governed by the Terms of Use for Enshrouded. The adding, removing, and adjusting of game content and gameplay features of Adventure Sharing does not constitute a change to Adventure Sharing or Enshrouded or their scope of functions and may be carried out by Keen at any time without regard to the requirements of the Terms of Use for Enshrouded. This includes, in particular, the complete or partial modification, restriction, or complete discontinuation of Adventure Sharing as a gameplay feature. However, this does not include the removal or adjustment of in-game items already purchased.
cn:
11.2	
对作为 Enshrouded 免费游戏功能的冒险分享所做的变更，应受到 Enshrouded 使用条款的制约。对冒险分享的游戏内容及游戏功能进行添加、删除和调整，并不构成对冒险分享或 Enshrouded 或其功能范围的变更，且 Keen 可随时进行这些操作，无需考虑 Enshrouded 使用条款的相关要求。这特别包括对冒险分享作为游戏功能进行完整或部分的修改、限制，或完全停止提供。但这不包括删除或调整已购买的游戏内物品。

en:
I think we'll need a new space for storing the Elixir... the barrels leak and a film has started to form on the cellar grounds. It's moist and humid... going into the caverns below the marketplace makes one dizzy. Should be fine during yearfall, but come 501 D.A., we ought to expand storage.

Also, I let Remy go. Sneaky rat was lapping up spilled Elixir off the floor... disgraceful.
cn:
我觉得我们需要为魔药找一个新的仓库……这里的桶子都漏了，里面的液体都洒在了地窖里面。现在地上潮湿无比……而且一走进市场的地下就让人感觉晕头转向。岁末这段时间应该不会有问题，但是等501 D.A.我们还是需要更大的仓库。

还有就是，我把雷米开了。那个手脚不干净的家伙一直在偷喝洒在地上的魔药……实在是太不像话了。

en: A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.
cn: 一把烤熟的咖啡豆。散发着像是巧克力一样的浓香，同时又夹杂着微微的草本清甜。必须先将其磨碎才能够进行泡煮。

en: With these padded gloves, you can easily scale any cliff to reach snowed-in souls in need.
cn: 戴上这些加厚的手套，你可以轻松攀爬悬崖峭壁并拯救被困在风雪之中的灵魂。

en: A basic fishing rod made out of the simplest ingredients. Don't pull too hard, or it might break. It also doesn't lay particularly well in the hand, so long fights are not possible with it.
cn: 使用最简单的材料制作的基础鱼竿。收线的时候不要太用力，否则鱼竿有可能会断。这种鱼竿的手感也很糟糕，因此你没办法长时间与鱼进行拉扯。

en: Find The Weaver's Cottage In <location>East Lapis</location>
cn: 寻找在<location>东之岩</location>中的编织匠的小屋

en: Sheets melted out of Metal Scraps to make them more workable and open up options for further processing.
cn: 通过融化金属废料制作成的板子，经过处理后的材料更方便操作与进一步加工。

en: Scouting ahead can be quite challenging, especially in the dark. This special arrow leaves a flare at the point of impact, spending a little light.
cn: 侦查陌生环境往往极为困难，尤其在黑暗中更是难上加难。这枚特殊箭矢会在撞击时留下一处充当小型照明的信号焰。

en: A good amount of crystallized ectoplasm. Inside slumbers the essence of vitality.
cn: 一些灵质水晶。里面沉睡着生命力的精华。

en: An angular, golden urn. To match the sentimental value of the ashes, the grieving family adorned this vessel with ruby-red jewels. When shaking the urn, an act that is most likely godless and foul, you can hear clanking inside...
cn: 一个棱角分明的金瓮。为了体现骨灰瓮中寄托的情感价值，遗属们在金瓮表面镶嵌了红宝石作为点缀。摇晃金瓮（虽然这么做显得极其不尊重死者而且丧心病狂）时可以听到里面叮当作响……
移动：动作条 背包

en: These traditional archer gloves were made asymmetrical through multiple monstrous tusks and bone shards jutting outwards.
cn: 使用数根扭曲的獠牙与向外凸出的骨片打造而成的非对称式传统弓手手套。
模拟品质（仅在作为主机时）

en: Come, share a meal and a story!
Read all obelisks in the Nomad Highlands.
cn: 查看游牧高地中的所有方尖碑。

en: Delicate petals tainted by the Shroud. Their surface is coated in a faint, toxic residue. Though fragile on their own, they are surprisingly resilient when woven into armor. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Vicious Vines, initially found in the Revelwood.
cn: 被瘴气腐化的娇嫩花瓣。表面仍然覆盖着一层淡淡的毒素残留物。虽然作为花瓣十分脆弱，但是作为盔甲材料却能展现出惊人的柔韧性。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于喧嚣森林中的瘴气魔恶毒藤蔓。

en: Iron Blocks are incredibly reliable and add a decorative edge to any building.
cn: 铁方块极其牢固可靠，而且美观大方适用于一切建筑。
将建造区域扩展至125米x125米。

en: Gain one point of Dexterity for every two levels of the Flame.
cn: 每两级灵火获得1点敏捷。

en: A Green That Represents Envy And Immortality
Indicates how difficult the Fishing Minigame is.
cn: 显示钓鱼小游戏的困难程度。

en: Fine, shimmery silver powder. Don't drop it, or you'll find specs of silver in your floorboards for weeks to come.
cn: 精细研磨后得到的闪闪发光的银粉。小心别掉到地上，否则你永远也清理不干净地板缝隙里的银色粉尘。

en: Furnish your base with Comfort Furniture. A decorated base with higher Comfort Levels will increase the duration of the Rested Buff. As you progress, it will become harder to extend the Rested Buff.
cn: 使用舒适度家具来装饰你的基地。拥有高舒适度水平的精美基地将提高休息良好加成的持续时间。不过随着舒适度水平提升，延长休息良好加成所需要的要求也将愈发严苛。

en:
Nestled below our lands once lay a chasm so deep, its contents eluded us for millennia.

No secret can resist illumination by the light of the eternal Flame. An archaic evil, brewing... growing.

It must be buried, flooded, and sealed. Humanity should never brush against these tendrils of pandemonium.
cn:
我们的土地之下有一道深不见底的裂隙，千百年来我们一直未能成功进入调查。

没有任何秘密能够抵挡灵火的永恒光明的照耀。一个远古的邪恶正在蠢蠢欲动。

必须不惜一切代价将其掩埋、淹没并封印。绝不能让人类接触那种混乱的触须。
杰兹米娜前往黑沼的旅程

en: You haven't unlocked this Twitch Drop item and can't use it.
cn: 尚未解锁此Twitch掉落物品，因此无法使用。

en:
In a realm of tales untold,
Where shadows dance, mysteries unfold.
Flying creatures, strike from the sky,
Their warning shadows, swift and high.

Beware the darkened winged sprite,
Their presence brings a chilling fright.
Listen close to whispers old,
Secrets shared, their stories unfold.

Children, learn from ancient lore,
Guard your steps, forevermore.
In the land of dreams and wonder,
Heed the shadows, never blunder.
cn:
在无人知晓的那个传说世界，
阴影起舞，谜团不灭。
盘旋之物从天而降，
危险的声影迅捷飞翔。

小心那些飞舞着的黑色精灵。
它们的出现将在凌冽中夺走安宁。
仔细聆听古老的低语，
分享陌生的谜语，讲述未知的物语。

孩子们，用心领悟古老的传说，
永远要小心脚下。
这片大地充斥着梦想与企望，
凝视阴影，永不迷惘。

en: Protection Against The Cold And Hypothermia
Thick and reliable pants. Not very breathable, unfortunately.
cn: 裤子厚实可靠。可惜不是很透气。

en: You've crafted the dog food bait needed to tame a stray dog. Now reach <location>Thornhold</location> and look for dogs to tame there!
cn: 你已经制作了驯服野狗要用到的狗粮诱饵。现在前往<location>荆棘堡</location>并驯服那里的野狗！

en: A wall-mounted board that lets you display all your fishing achievements.
cn: 挂在墙上的板子，用于展示你的各项钓鱼成就。

en: Fell Enemies, Springlands Shroud and Revelwood Shroud
cn: 瘴气魔敌人，春日平原与喧嚣森林瘴气区
新神的诞生 - 达尔斯祖尔

en: Enough to brace the worst of it, until better armor crosses your path.
cn: 足以帮你支撑一段时间，直到找到更优良的护甲。

en: You have an %k chance to receive the damage you deal as Health.
cn: 您有 %k 的几率将您造成的伤害转化为健康值。

en: The Ancients saved me, maybe there are others... there's a vault I know of. You might take a look.
cn: 远古者救了我，也许还有其他人……我知道还有一处密室。也许你可以去那里看一眼。

en: A shiny red brick that is crafted by hardening Lump of Clay under a heat even a Flameborn has issues with.
cn: 通过将黏土团放置在就连火之子也难以忍受的高温环境中烘烤硬化而成的闪亮红砖。

en:
The head of a Shroud infested Cyclops. It has pretty bad breath, even now.

Collect multiple Fell Cyclops Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
一只被瘴气感染的独眼巨人的脑袋。就算是在死后，怪物也在散发着难闻的恶臭。

收集多个瘴气魔独眼巨人头颅以制作战利品。

en: A headwrap that's white as snow.

An electrically charged two-handed axe, able to release sparks into the overcast sky when striking. It was struck by lightning while inside a cataclysmic typhoon and survived, unlike it's previous owner.
cn: 蕴含雷电之力的双手斧，能够在发动打击时释放闪电飞入天际。这把武器曾经在一次毁灭性的风暴中被闪电击中，上一任主人因此当场暴毙，只有斧子留存了下来。

en: You've found lore about red eyes that were irritated by sand and wind.
cn: 你找到了一些提到因为风沙刺激而引发红眼病的知识。

en: The bow curves into a zig-zag shape on both sides, capturing a vision of a rattlesnake's tail in motion.
cn: 弯曲的弓身会以曲折形象延展至两侧，看上去就像是一只蠢蠢欲动的响尾蛇的尾巴。

en:
Drak'Dal were away for too long. 

All our temples crumble to dust! 
Drak'Dal will show Ancients true strength! Will show that Ancients made a mistake with fleshy humans! Drak'Dal won't build in anyone's shadow! 

Build a new home! Build for Dalszul! Build, or Broodmother Vesztah will have your head!

Rah Rah!
cn:
卓克·达尔去了太久。

我们的神殿都已经分崩离析！
卓克·达尔将向远古者展示真正的力量！要让远古者明白，它们在血肉之躯的人类身上犯了错！卓克·达尔将不会心甘情愿屈于他人的阴影之下！

将建造一个新的家园！为达尔斯祖尔而建！竭尽全力去建造，否则育母维兹塔阿会要了你们的脑袋！

拉·拉！

en:
Increases your Constitution attribute by 1.

Increases Health by %k per Attribute Point.
cn:
体质属性提升1点。

每点属性增加%k点生命。

en: Ah, so the forge used bellows to achieve its great temperatures... of course, why didn't I think of that?
cn: 啊，这么说锻炉都是利用风箱来提高温度的……这么做很合理，我之前怎么没有想到？

en: A mighty hammer, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Berhtolf, the firstborn son. Bravery was his downfall.
cn: 这柄强大的锤子是迪姆维尔德家族的传家宝。这把武器曾经属于家族长子巴索夫。勇敢使他走向覆灭。

en: The Collector revealed the location of the Hollow Halls in the Albaneve Summits. Descend there and reach the end to please the Collector. This will not be an easy task. Gather your strength and allies, if present, to prepare yourself accordingly.
cn: 收藏家揭示了阿尔班耶夫山脉中的空荡礼堂的位置。 前往最深处并完成收藏家的任务。 这是一个极其危险的任务，出发前召集同伴并做好万全准备。

en: A blazing fire dances atop the roofs of Surat's Rest. We were too late. They came from Raven's Keep — escaped inmates, with a penchant for fire. Now, our esteemed town is a pyre of madness. I tremble at the sight. What would mother do? She'd move before the sun rose, crown held high. Leave all baggage behind — swift and silent, carried by the wind. The road to Long Keep is a treacherous one... We must make haste. Glory to Queen Pikemead. Bless the Ancients. — Jezmina, 507 D.A.
cn: 灼热的火舌在苏拉特之息的屋顶上舞动不停。我们来得太晚了。 他们从渡鸦堡逃脱了，那些逃脱的囚犯都支痴迷于火焰。现在我们体面的城镇已经沦为了疯狂的火堆。眼前的情景让我不寒而栗。如果换做是母亲，她会怎么做？ 她应该会赶在天亮之前动身。抛下一切带不走的行囊，安静而又迅捷地随风而去。通往长守镇的道路十分艰险……但是我们必须去那里。 荣耀归于派克米德女王。赞美远古者。 — 杰兹米娜，507 D.A.
抵达卓克·达尔 废墟

en: Remains of the pests that dwell below the Shroud. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Fell Critters, initially found in the Springlands.
cn: 滋生于瘴气之下的害虫残骸。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于春日平原中的瘴气魔虫。

en: We could probably upgrade the Flame further with the right attitude! Why not go for it?
cn: 只要心意诚挚，我们说不定可以进一步升级灵火！不妨来试一试？

en: Easy to use and quite deadly. The sharp blades on the side allow for easier penetration of armor.
cn: 趁手好用而且十分致命。侧面加装的锐利刀刃能够轻松穿透盔甲。

en: We've introduced Special Abilities to the game. Due to our addition, the Quick Shot keybinding on controller was moved to the Right Trigger.
cn: 我们为游戏加入了特殊能力系统。因为新增内容，控制器原本的快速射击按键绑定已经被转移到右扳机。

en: Ya know, Flameborn, I helped to build "<location>Morwenna</location>." Named 'er after my most peaceful auntie! I built many a town 'round here. Ever seen <location>Diadwyn</location>? I think I left some of my Half-Timbered Blocks there. Why not check? Finders keepers!
cn: 你知道么，火之子，“<location>莫文纳</location>”就是我帮忙建造的。这个名字其实来自我最和善的那位姑姑！说实话这一带有很多镇子都是我的作品。去过<location>狄亚德温</location>么？我记得我好像在那里留了一些半木结构方块。有兴趣的话可以去看看？找到就归你了！

en: A cute baby Common Goat. They tend to rub their heads against your leg for attention.
cn: 一只可爱的普通山羊宝宝。它们喜欢用头蹭你的腿来寻求关注。
水豚 狩猎卓克·达尔营地

en: The Farmer wants you to find and tame a Capybara in the Veilwater Basin. The bristles produced by this animal can be used in crafting. To tame a Capybara, you must first craft food baits. Craft or obtain at least 3 Capybara baits to continue.
cn: 农民想要找到并驯服一只幕水盆地中的水豚。这种动物产出的鬃毛能够作为制作材料使用。 若要驯服一只水豚，首先你需要制作对应的食物诱饵。制作或获取至少3份水豚诱饵以继续。

en: You've discovered writing from a man named Ramone Jones. He was a writer from the capital and editor of The Pike Weekly. Investigate his current whereabouts and try to find him!
cn: 你找到了一个名叫“雷蒙·琼斯”的男人留下的信。他以前是首都的作家，同时也是《崇山城周报》的编辑。调查他的去向并设法找到此人！

en:
We hope you enjoyed your visit to Embervale. 

The timer for the Enshrouded demo has ended. We will remove the demo on the 22nd of October.

If you liked what you've seen so far, add Enshrouded to your wishlist to be kept up to date about the Early Access release and other news!

We hope to see you again, Flameborn, when Enshrouded is released into Early Access.
cn:
希望您喜欢薪谷中的体验。

《雾锁王国》试玩版的倒计时已经结束。我们将于10月22日删除试玩版。

如果您喜欢目前所看到的内容，请将《雾锁王国》添加到您的愿望清单，以便随时了解有关《雾锁王国》抢先体验版本的最新信息和其他新闻！

我们希望在《雾锁王国》开放抢先体验时与您再次相见，火之子。

en: This scroll is enchanted with the power of the Shroud Meteor. It releases a shower of Shroud Meteor on up to five enemies around the caster. But be careful with its usage, as it drains your fog survivability upon usage.
cn: 这个卷轴蕴含着瘴气陨石的力量。它将对施法者周围至多5名敌人释放瘴气陨石之雨。但是要小心的是，使用卷轴将会消耗你对瘴气的抵抗力。

en: Forged for ruthless efficiency, the Fell Commander Bow finds its purpose in the skulls of Scavengers who dare cross its path.
cn: 拥有无与伦比的杀戮效率，瘴气魔指挥官弓发射的箭矢将飞向每一个碍事者的拾荒者的头颅。

en:
The trader Mei sold a set of plants to the people of <location>Fort Kelvin</location>, but their beauty will fade with nobody around to admire them. 

Retrieve her plants from their previous owners so they can bloom inside your base! There are three plants in total, and all of them are found in <location>Fort Kelvin</location>.
cn:
商人梅卖了一组植物给<location>凯尔文要塞</location>的人们，但是如果没有人欣赏，那些美丽的植物都将黯淡凋零。

从原来的买家那里取回梅的植物，并让它们在你的基地中绽放！总共有三株植物，而且都在<location>凯尔文要塞</location>中。

en: A larger storage opportunity for bulk items.
cn: 能够储存大量物品的大型容器。

en: I didn't think I'd ever recall my childhood fondly — but now, after so many years of adventure, amidst the rot and decay... I gotta say I miss it! Sure, the days were simple and dull. Tilling the fields (or pretending to). Chatting at the market square when I was meant to sell produce. Carving my flute instead of sowing seeds. Sneaking out of the farmhouse to dance the night away at the tavern...! But now, decades later, I'm here — Following a bright light in the night sky that ripped through the Shroud's haze so long ago! Only a few survivors are left, but none I've met have seen the same light in the sky. Hopefully, they don't take my vision as just another one of Val's Valiant Tales to tell by the campfire! Valory
cn: 说实话以前我从来不想回忆童年的那段时间，但是在经过了漫长的冒险岁月后，在这片腐烂衰败之地……我发现自己突然十分想念小时候的事情！ 当然，那时候一切都很简单，也很乏味。从早到晚就是耕田种地（或者是假装自己在认真耕地）。要么就是把庄稼拿取市场卖，然后趁机跟其他人聊八卦谈天说地。有时候我会偷偷摸摸不去播种，而是找个角落安心雕刻自己的笛子。除此以外，我还会偷偷摸摸溜出去，然后跑到酒馆里面跟别人彻夜跳舞……！ 不过那已经是几十年前的事情了，看看现在，我正在夜空之下追逐着亘古之前曾穿透笼罩一切的瘴气的明亮光芒！现如今幸存者寥寥无几，而且也没有人像我一样能够看见夜空中的光芒。希望他们不会觉得这只是用来在篝火边打发时间的另一段瓦尔的勇敢传说吧！ 瓦罗里

en:
The <npc>Carpenter</npc> knows a fearsome <npc>Hunter</npc> from the Nomad Highlands. She was as big as a mountain and capable of taming animals. 
She was sent to <location>Raven's Keep</location> after a gruesome fight. 

This <npc>Hunter</npc> might have owned a <craftingstation>Tanning Station</craftingstation>.
cn:
<npc>木匠</npc>认识一位来自游牧高地的勇猛<npc>猎人</npc>。据说此人体型硕大而且擅长驯服动物。 
她之前因为大打出手而被关进了<location>渡鸦堡</location>。 

这位<npc>猎人</npc>也许有一个<craftingstation>制皮台</craftingstation>。
抵达燃火荒原空荡礼堂

en: A Wizard Hat. Most commonly worn during lunar ceremonies and divinations.
cn: 巫师帽子。通常用于月祭和占卜仪式。

en:
These two petrified gastropod shells have survived eons — together. One can hope that their inhabitants kept each other company, but a solitary fate is more likely.

This collectible is found in the Revelwood.
cn:
这两个石化的腹足类贝壳一起经历了漫长的岁月。我们可以希望它们的居住者彼此相伴，但更有可能是孤独的命运。

此收藏品在 喧嚣森林 中找到。

en: The mandibles of the staff open towards the skies like a snapjaw's maw, looking to drag prey down to the depths of the moor... Powerful magic cast through this weapon can damn anyone to darkness.
cn: 这把法杖的顶端就像是巨颚一般直指天空，随时等待着将猎物拖入沼泽的深处……通过这把武器释放的强大法力将让一切对手坠入黑暗。

en: I knew you had it in you! You really are a good-looking hero, aren't you?
cn: 我就知道你一定能行！你真的是个风华绝代的英雄，对吗？

en: These pants are just as short as a foe’s lifespan in your presence.
cn: 这些裤子就和你遇到的敌人的生命一样短。

en: A book. Conveyer of thought, the foundation of progress, and a bonfire of imagination.
cn: 一本书。传播思想的工具，进步的基础，同时也是点燃想象力的篝火。

en: New Plan: You remember the flooded town we found, right? Yeah, access to the lower level's blocked, and to breach the barricade, we'll need an Underwater Grappling Hook. I've seen the big Drak beasts carry 'em sometimes, but not sure if I wanna go down that route. Told Mack to craft one instead, but it'll take a while. In the meantime, let's continue to scout the area. We should keep an eye out for the crabs you spotted; they might become an issue if we're not careful. At least the ruins ain't far, so if one of us gets snipped, we don't gotta wait long to dress the wound.
cn: 新计划：还记得我们之前找到的那个被淹没的小镇吗？没错，通往下层的入口已经被堵住了，为了突破封锁，我们需要一个水下抓钩。 之前我偶尔有看见大型卓克野兽带着那些东西，不过我猜这种方式恐怕会有危险。还是叫麦克直接做一个吧，虽然这样会耗费更多时间。 与此同时，让我们继续侦察区域吧。我们需要留意你之前发现的螃蟹，要是疏忽大意，那些家伙有可能会成为真正的麻烦。 至少废墟就在附近，所以就算我们中有人挂彩了也能马上处理伤口。

en: They are not enough. Just copies of him, unfinished, unbound by flesh and blood. I must try again and obtain another vessel. This time, alive. I will bring him back — whole, not bony and broken. Not turned inside out. Not howling and screaming. Just whole, the way he was before. My next attempt must succeed. The newest living vessel is sublime. The perfect fur to rip away and reveal a husk ready to carry his soul. This time, it will work. It simply must. I will get my Ikko back.
cn: 他们还不够。只是他的残缺复制品，缺少血肉的躯壳。我必须再试一次，我需要再找一个容器。而且这一次的是活的。 我一定会把他完完整整的带回来，而不是残缺的骷髅。得确保身体一切正常。而且不会尖叫怒吼。完整的人，就像他以前那样。下一次尝试必须成功。 最新的一具活体容器简直完美。去掉毛皮之后，这具躯壳正适合承载他的灵魂。这一次一定能成功。必须成功。我一定会把伊科带回来。

en:
The <npc>Collector</npc>, Alden Crowley, was locked inside the Hollow Halls for so long that they did not yet know about the Flameborn. 

They claim to be "flame-touched" themselves, but wouldn't elaborate.
cn:
<npc>收藏家</npc>埃尔登·克劳利在空荡礼堂中被关押了很久，以至于甚至都不知道火之子的存在。

此人宣称自己也“被灵火触碰过”，但是并没有对此进行解释。

en: Every rose has thorns — and sometimes, nature can serve as inspiration for weaponry and design!
cn: 每一朵玫瑰都带刺，有时候大自然就是武器与设计的最好创意灵感来源！
前往被诅咒的建筑工地

en: A shield with a central amethyst. The metal frame around the sides makes it more durable.
cn: 这块盾牌的正中心位置镶嵌着一块紫水晶。边缘加装的金属框使得盾牌更为牢固。

en: We ought to spill their blood and drink it as wine.
cn: 我们应该挥洒它们的鲜血并像美酒一样痛饮。

en:
This fascinating seed I bought — It takes root and sprouts fast! I find myself dreaming of it at night — the faint glow, illuminating my garden and my soul. I must plant more. The whole village should learn of its glory!

— Hemming, Yearwake, 502 D.A.
cn:
我带回来的种子实在是太不可思议了，一下子就生根发芽了！晚上睡觉的时候，我梦到了种子，我仿佛看见微弱的光芒洒满了我的花园和灵魂。我必须种下更多种子。我要让村子里的所有人都感受到那种光耀！

—海姆明，岁初，502 D.A.

en: You've filled your pockets with the needed food bait. Now it's time to look for a Capybara to tame! An ideal spot for taming is marked on the map, but anywhere is possible. The quest will only update to the next page when you reach the designated area, but you can complete the quest by taming any Capybara.
cn: 你已经携带足够多的食物诱饵。现在是时候寻找水豚并将其驯服了！ 地图上标记的区域能够迅速找到这些动物，但是其他地方也能够找到可以被驯服的动物。当你抵达指定区域后，任务日志才会更新下一页内容，不过你只需要驯服任意水豚即可完成任务。

en: You woke the beast by lighting all balefires! It's time to end things. Reclaiming the Albaneve Summits and upgrading the Flame with the beast's head will enable you to build safely inside the cold! Reach the top of Howling Peak and challenge the beast to a fight! The creature is strong, but not invincible. Some of its attacks can be parried. Howling Peak is best reached by passing through Everfrore Keep.
cn: 点燃所有篝火之后，你已经唤醒了腐化之兽！是时候做个了结了。夺回阿尔班耶夫山脉并使用怪物的头颅升级灵火，之后你将能够在寒冷环境下安全进行建造！ 抵达呼啸崇山顶部并挑战腐化之兽！怪物十分强大，但绝对不是刀枪不入。它的部分攻击可以被招架。 呼啸崇山最好的通行路线是穿过永霜堡。

en:
The Sicklescythe's tongue froze once struck down, too powerless to cast the final curse stuck in its throat.

Collect multiple Fell Sicklescythe Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
cn:
镰鼬的舌头已经永远无法动弹，现在的它已经无法说出卡在咽喉中的临终诅咒。

收集数个瘴气魔镰鼬头颅以制作青铜战利品。

en: One has to be careful when harvesting this herb, but the reward is surely worth it.
cn: 采集的时候千万要小心别被刺扎到，但是这种植物的作用足以抵消被扎的痛苦。

en: Location: You know where!! Estimated Dive Time: Too damn long Post Dive Findings Time: It's dark out. No light. Place: No sign of Edd. Last seen: He hit the first checkpoint, the metal grates by the overgrown terrace, behind time. Seemed winded, but steady. I thought about pulling him out. I should've stopped the mission then. Pried open the bars. Lifted him up and out of those treacherous waters. I didn't. The sun has set, which means Edd will have trouble finding his scheduled resurfacing spots. Estimated dive time has been exceeded. I think he has air for... maybe thirty more minutes, if he doesn't panic. It won't last for the way back. We're running from grate to grate, lighting torches, yelling his name, trying to signal a safe spot to surface. But below, everything is pitch black. The deep swallows both sound and light. I wonder if he can even still tell up from down. I wonder if he's scared. Alone. Cold. I wonder if he knows he'll die... I wonder if he'll still try to make it to the end.
cn: 地点：你懂的！！ 预计潜水时间：太长了 潜水结束后的发现 时间：外面很黑，没有一点点光。 位置：没看见艾德。 最后目击地点：他抵达了第一处检查点，就是植物疯长的露台旁的金属栅栏那里，但这时候他的速度已经拖了后腿。看上去很累，但还算稳定。我有想过要不要让他回去。也许那时候我就应该终止任务。我应该扒开栏杆。将他推上去离开这些威胁的水域。 但是我没有那么做。 现在太阳已经下山，这意味着艾德将难以找到预定的上浮位置。 预计潜水时间已经延长。 我认为他的氧气……最多只能再坚持三十分钟，前提是他能够保持冷静。问题是这并不足以支撑他回去。 我们在一个个铁栅栏之间来回奔波，一边点亮沿途的火炬一边喊着他的名字，我们希望这么做能够让他看见安全的上浮地点。但我们下方只有一片黑暗。无论是声音还是光芒都被深海所吞噬。 我甚至不确定他还能不能分辨上下位置，我不知道他现在是不是很害怕，而且孤独寒冷，我不知道他是否意识到自己将死在这片黑暗中……我也不知道他是否有努力求生的勇气。

en: I need to see their pale bones in broad daylight! Bring them to me!
cn: 我需要看见它们惨白的骨头被暴露在日光之下！把它们的骨头带给我！
炼金术士之塔搜索区域

en:
4.1.1	
By uploading User Content, you grant Keen a worldwide, non-exclusive, and, where necessary, transferable and sublicensable right to use the User Content to the extent required for the operation, provision, improvement, and promotion of Adventure Sharing and Enshrouded, i.e., to reproduce, distribute, make publicly available, and publicly communicate the game feature, as well as to make technically necessary adaptations and formatting changes. This right permits Keen to do the following:
a)	Host and store the User Content on Keen's servers or on the servers of hosting service providers commissioned by Keen.
b)	Make the User Content available to other users in Adventure Sharing, including cross-platform public availability.
c)	Display the User Content in the ranking areas of Adventure Sharing.
d)	Reproduce, distribute, and publicly communicate the User Content for the purpose of promoting Adventure Sharing and Enshrouded by Keen, including on social media channels, in trailers, and on Keen's website and in other marketing materials. In this case, where possible and customary in the industry based on the type of use, Keen will identify you as the author.
e)	Make technical adaptations, formatting changes, conversions into other output formats, and corrections to the User Content insofar as this is technically necessary for the operation of Adventure Sharing, cross-platform provision, or display in marketing materials within the provisions of d), but no other content-related modifications.
By granting the foregoing rights, you represent that you hold all rights required for this purpose or are otherwise authorized to make the User Content available in Adventure Sharing. The granting of rights is free of charge. As such, no separate remuneration will be paid beyond the possibility of using Adventure Sharing.
cn:
4.1.1	
上传用户内容，您即授予 Keen 一项全球性、非排他性、并且在必要时可转让及可再许可的使用权，该使用权以运营、提供、改进和推广冒险分享及 Enshrouded 所必需的范围为限（即允许 Keen 复制、分发、公开提供、公开传播该游戏功能，以及进行技术必要的调整和格式调整）。该权利允许 Keen 进行以下行为：
a)	将用户内容托管并存储在 Keen 的服务器上，或存储在由 Keen 委托的托管服务提供商的服务器上。
b)	在冒险分享中将用户内容提供给其他用户，包括跨平台的公开提供。
c)	在冒险分享的排行榜区域展示该用户内容。
d)	以推广冒险分享功能及 Keen 的 Enshrouded 游戏为目的，在社交媒体渠道、预告片、Keen 官网及其他营销材料中复制、分发并公开传播用户内容。在此情况下，若根据使用类型按行业惯例可行，Keen 将注明您为作者。
e)	对用户内容进行技术性调整、格式变更、转换为其他输出格式以及修正，前提是这些操作是为了冒险分享的正常运行、跨平台提供或在 d) 条款规定的范围内用于营销材料展示所必需的技术操作，但不得对内容进行其他实质性修改。
授予上述权利，则代表您表示您拥有执行此类操作所需的所有权利，或者以其他方式获得了授权，能够在冒险分享中提供该用户内容。上述权利的授予不收取任何费用。因此，除可使用冒险分享之外，不再另行支付任何报酬。

en: You've found a note inside an Albaneve Summits chapel. The note describes strange developments in the chapel's crypt and a person's plans to escape. They meant to take a hidden route out of the chapel, down a cliff path. The writer took their club with them in case anyone, or anything, dared to follow. Follow their footsteps down the cliff and retrieve the club!
cn: 你在一座阿尔班耶夫山脉教堂中找到了一份纸条。纸条上记载着教堂地穴中出现了异动，而且纸条的主人已经打算逃跑。 按照上面的说法，此人原本打算利用一条秘密通道离开教堂并走下悬崖。为了避免有其他人或者是东西追杀自己，纸条的作者还特意拿上了自己的棍棒。 跟随纸条中记载的路线走下悬崖并取回棍棒！

en:
The Undying Flame... I thought I was onto something here, but all it does is reduce creatures to ash and bones. Eternity in the afterlife, perhaps, but hardly what I intended.

Adjacent to the large lake with the tower lies Goldrock Saddle, just east of which another tomb should be hidden, the earth arching over it.
cn:
不灭的灵火……我原本以为自己终于大功告成，但没想到法术只是将生物化为了灰烬与骸骨。也许彼世也算是另一种的永恒吧，但是这并不是我想要的。

金石鞍与拥有高塔的大湖相邻，那里的东面土地高高隆起的地方应该就是另一处隐藏的墓穴。

en: Warm and comfortable during yearfall. A versatile resource that is very common and can be used for many things.
cn: 能够在岁末时节带来温暖与舒适，这是一种十分常见的材料，并且拥有着广泛的用途。

en: You've made it far. I was right to place trust in you, my benefactor. Why remain bound by earthly chains? The red string of fate is tied around your neck and wrists, cutting into your flesh. You're torn apart by hooks of destiny, anchored between your ribs. Free yourself. Find me in this sea of souls, and escape with me. Reach out. Just a little further, now. Let us ascend together. You know who wrote this.
cn: 你已经走了很远。我果然没有看错人，朋友。 为什么要被尘世的枷锁束缚？命运的红线已经缠绕在你的咽喉与手腕，它正在割裂你的血肉。命运的钩子紧紧卡在了你的肋骨之间，你即将被撕扯得四分五裂。 解放自己。在这灵魂的海洋中找到我并与我一同逃离。伸出你的手。 你马上就能成功了。让我们一起飞升。 你知道我是谁。

en: Sort items from your inventory to existing item stacks in the target inventory.
cn: 将物品栏中的物品按类型放置到目标物品栏的现有物品堆叠中。

en:
The cold thrill of the night winds is far too electryfying to sleep. This color palette is bursting with a trance-like energy and tinged with madness.

This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.
cn:
冰冷晚风带来的刺激使人根本无法安心入睡。这种调色板充满了迷幻的能量与趋近疯狂的氛围。

可以使用阿尔班耶夫山脉材料制作这种调色板。

en: Work in progress. Not available in Closed Beta.
cn: 开发中。封闭公测版本不可用。

en: Increases the skill level of Runner

A deviously poisoned set of daggers that meander like the slithering body of a Kindlewastes Diamondback snake. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 用心险恶的淬毒匕首，刀刃就像是东部菱背响尾蛇的身体一样弯曲盘踞。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: You've reached <location>Thornhold</location>, but the town has been claimed by Scavengers. Look around to find the stray dog!
cn: 你已经抵达<location>荆棘堡</location>，但是这座城市已经被拾荒者占领。在附近寻找流浪狗！

en: When crafting a meal you have a 10% chance to get one additional meal.
cn: 烹饪时有10%几率获得一份额外物品。

en:
We meant to decipher the ancient language on our expedition. My findings so far: 

The little symbol that looks like a sleeping Fae Deer means "fire". Or something. I humbly suggest these symbols were constructed in the most obscene fashion to purposefully ridicule researchers.
However, I see unique signs compared to western obelisks... A dialect? 

Perhaps it's true what the townfolk say, and the Ancients truly intend to keep their secrets forever. I wonder what they're trying to hide.

— Loraine Crim, Yearwake, 506 D.A.
cn:
我们计划通过这次的探险破译远古者的语言。迄今为止我的发现：

像是沉睡着的仙鹿一样的小符号代表“火焰”。或者是类似的东西。我有种微微的预感，这些符号是故意采取了最晦涩难懂的风格样式，目的是为了故意妨碍后世的研究者。
不过比起在西部找到的方尖碑，我倒是在这里找到独特的符号……难道是某种方言？

也许真的就像民间传说的那样，远古者就是想永远隐藏自己的秘密。但是不知道他们当初到底是想要隐藏什么样的知识？

— 洛琳·克里姆，岁初，506 D.A.

en: To reward you for your efforts, I'll tell you a tale. Once, off the coast of Goldrock Saddle, I shipwrecked upon a silvery rock with no land in sight! I prayed to the Ancients, and behold, a mermaid emerged from the depths, and with a gift from her lovely lips, I grew fins and swam back to shore! Don't believe me? Har har har! Go see for yourself!
cn: 作为对你的奖励，接下来我将告诉你一个故事经，在远离金石鞍海岸的地方，我的船在一块银色巨石上搁浅了，放眼望去，周围根本见不到一丝陆地的迹象！不得已我只能选择向远古者祈祷，片刻之后，一个人鱼从深海中浮出水面，并且用她动人的嘴唇给我带来了一份礼物，我长出了鱼鳍并游回了岸上！不相信我？哈哈哈！那你就自己去看看吧！

en: Strengthen the Flame to gain Frost Protection in bases
cn: 强化火焰以在基地中获得冰霜保护

en: There's still more survivors to rescue. Don't just sit there!
cn: 还有更多幸存者。赶紧去把大家救回来吧！

en:
This cat is as dark as the midnight sky and its charming demands for attention never go unanswered. It purrs loudly whenever you are near! 

The Scavengers that kept this cat were unsure whether to call it "Captain" or "Whiskers".
cn:
像午夜的天空一般黝黑的猫咪，虽然十分粘人，但是没有人可以拒绝这位充满魅力的主子。当你靠近它的时候，猫咪将会大声地咕噜咕噜叫。

之前养这只猫的拾荒者不确定该叫它“船长”还是“胡须”。

en: We are in so very deep, my friend. Perhaps you feel as I do: Boundless power. Endless life. An eternal light, simmering in silence, sealed away in spires and sanctuaries — What good can it do there, I ask you? It was aching to be shared. Why don't we reach out together, fellow Flamekeeper? The depths are calling. Come closer, and take my hand. I will pull you in. — Your new friend
cn: 我们已经深陷其中，我的朋友。也许你和我一样已经感受到了： 无穷无尽的力量与永无止境的生命。那道在无声中闪烁的永恒光芒已经被封印在高塔与圣殿之中，将它禁锢起来的行为难道不是毫无意义吗？ 它渴望着被分享。 那么不如让我们一起去探索这份力量吧，亲爱的灵火守护者？深渊在呼唤。靠近我，握住我的手。我将把你带向深处。 — 你的新朋友

en: The cloth straps attached to this mask glide softly in the breeze, helping to discern wind direction and speed.
cn: 面罩上的布带在微风中轻轻飘动，有助于辨别风向和风速。

en: Find And Enter The Hidden Attic
Look For The Abandoned Caravan Camp
Increases the skill level of Shared Misery
cn: 提高感同身受的技能等级

en: You wouldn't believe the brawl you missed out on!! We watched the hounds battle it out when this woman — nay, this girl stomped into the arena, golden light reflecting on her armor plates, and raised her sword at the matron! "I'm Gabrielle Fairburn" She said. "And if I beat you in a duel, you must leave this town and return it to its people!" Of course, the matron accepted by spewing a massive fountain of bile at the girl! I thought I'd see her pale face melt away, but suddenly, a bright flash blinded me! Dancing light reflected from the girl as she ducked and dodged, and when the blindness faded, she was behind the matron, ready to strike! Furiously, we jumped down from the rafters — against all of us, she stood no chance! Afterward, I pulled her body from the pool of sludge she lay in to drop her below. You should've seen her head hit the platform! Don't miss the next pit fight!
cn: 你绝对不敢相信自己错过了一场多么精彩的斗殴！我们在竞技场里看见一个女人，不，确切来说是一位女孩与猎犬之间展开了大战，她的板甲上闪耀着金色的光芒，然后她还对着主母举起了剑！ “我是加布里埃尔·菲尔伯恩”她这么说道。"假如我在决斗中战胜了你，你必须离开这座城镇并将它还给这里的居民！” 主母当然答应了她的挑战，她立刻就朝挑战者的脸上喷了一大滩脓汁！我原本以为女孩的白皙脸庞会被彻底烧坏，但是突然之间一道炫耀的光芒就刺得我睁不开眼！原来是那女孩从容不迫地躲开时折射出的光芒，等我回过神来的时候，她已经站到了主母身后并且准备发动攻击！ 我们大伙立刻跳了进去，就算她再厉害也无法抵挡我们所有人！完事之后，我把她的尸体从污秽之中拖了出来并丢到了下面。可惜了你没看见那个美丽的脑袋在平台上摔碎的画面！总而言之，不要错过下一次的战斗！

en: Fade away like dust in the wind.
cn: 就像是风中的沙粒一般消散。

en: The many layers of smelted metal in these daggers make them appear similar to an animal's tiered horn, tapering off at the edges. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 使用多层金属叠加锻造而成，这把匕首的外形就像是一根被斩断的动物犄角，边缘的部分十分锐利。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: Ah, you brought back someone new! How exciting. This home finally fills with light and life.
cn: 啊，新的面孔！太好了，这个家园充满了光明和生机。

en: A ripped piece of fabric, detailing alchemical wisdom. Someone might be able to decipher it if you had the other half!
cn: 一片被撕裂的布料，上面描绘着不同寻常的炼金术智慧。如果能够找到另一半，也许你就可以让某人来破译其中的内容！

en: Magical ammunition that creates a single bolt of ice, damaging enemies upon impact and slowing them afterward. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 魔法弹药，使用时将创造一枚寒冰箭，命中时对敌人造成伤害并使其减速。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。
游牧高地以及燃火荒原

en: A note at the <npc>Alchemist</npc>'s Ancient Vault revealed that the Scavengers hid special belongings from the rest of the group. The hidden stash shouldn't be too far away.
cn: 根据在<npc>炼金术士</npc>的远古密室中找到的纸条上的内容，拾荒者藏起了一些特殊的东西。具体的藏匿点应该就在不远处。

en: Pumpkins are beloved for their sweet, earthy flavor in cooking and their sturdy, hollow shells for festive crafts.
cn: 南瓜因为甜美清香的滋味而成为了一种备受欢迎的食材，牢固而且中空的外壳则使得它们成为了制作节庆工艺品的最佳选择。

en: Are you sure you want to cancel editing? All changes will be lost.
cn: 确定取消编辑？这么做将丢失所有改动。
调查被诅咒的建筑工地

en: One of the run-down houses in the Imperial Gardens district of <location><lorename>Pikemead</lorename>'s Reach</location> hides valuables on its top floor! Find a way into the attic and search for hidden treasures there!
cn: <location><lorename>派克米德</lorename>之地</location>的帝国园林区的一栋破旧房屋的楼顶中藏有宝藏！想办法进入阁楼并找到里面的宝藏！

en: Embervale can be reclaimed! Collect Sparks and offer them at the Flame Altar to strengthen the Flame! Sparks lie scattered around the world in Flame Sanctums and Flame Shrines.
cn: 你可以夺回薪谷！收集余火并提交给灵火祭坛，以加强灵火！余火散布在世界各地的灵火神殿和灵火神殿中。

en: Flour that can be created by grinding Wheat Grains to dust.
cn: 将麦粒研磨成粉得到的面粉。

en: Children rumored that people killed by this Morningstar would have their souls banished inside the orb. These remnants would echo aimlessly forever in their spherical prison, bouncing between the curved walls and the void.
cn: 孩子们会悄悄说被这把流星锤杀死之人的灵魂将被封印在武器之中。圆形的监狱中满是无法逃脱的灵魂留下的回响，它们注定只能在弯弧的墙壁与虚空之间徘徊游荡。

en: The frozen horns made from ectoplasm don't melt near the hearth fire. They must be magical!
cn: 外质制成的冰冻犄角在炉火旁不会融化。它们一定有魔力！

en: Your fire burns ever brightly, child of the Flame — but even you cannot burn through freezing winds and snowcapped mountain trails. The Howling Peak calls your name, waiting to challenge your fire. Answer its call. Reclaim the tainted summits. Earn your respect.
cn: 你的火焰正在熊熊燃烧，灵火之子，但是就算是你也无法光靠火焰抵御刺骨的寒风与白雪皑皑的山脉。呼啸崇山正在呼唤你的名字，它渴望挑战你的火焰。回应它的呼唤吧。重新夺回被玷污的山峰。靠实力赢得它们的尊重。

en:
3.2	
By uploading User Content, you represent to Keen that:
a)	You hold all rights required to grant the rights of use under Sections 4.1 and 4.2, or are otherwise authorized to make the User Content available in Adventure Sharing.
b)	The User Content does not infringe any third-party rights, in particular no copyrights, trademark rights, other distinctive sign rights, personality rights, or other proprietary rights of third parties. If the User Content contains third-party content, you therefore represent that you have all necessary consents, licenses, or other authorizations.
cn:
3.2	
上传用户内容，即表示您向 Keen 作出以下声明与保证：
a)	您拥有根据第 4.1 条和第 4.2 条规定授予使用权所需的所有权利，或者获得在冒险分享功能中提供该用户内容的另外授权。
b)	该用户内容不会侵犯任何第三方权利，特别是版权、商标权、其他标志性权利、人格权或第三方的其他所有权。如果该用户内容包含第三方内容，您据此声明您已获得所有必要的同意、许可或其他授权。

en: To do my best work, I really need a Smelter, but crafting a Smelter requires a Crucible! I used to have one... I'll bet the Scavengers got to it. It's probably at their mine, way up north in the Revelwood.
cn: 我需要一个冶炼炉才能发挥我的全部技巧，但是制作冶炼炉需要熔炉！以前我有一个……但现在肯定已经落入拾荒者的手里了。东西很有可能就在他们的矿井里面，就在北面很远的喧嚣森林里面。
抵达伏击你的拾荒者营地

en: Simple gloves made from ethically sourced organic leather.
cn: 简单的手套由符合伦理标准的有机皮革制成。

en: Find The Building Blocks At The Tower In Fawnsong Frontier
cn: 在鹿歌边疆的高塔中寻找建筑方块

en: The Merciless Attack deals a massive %k bonus damage to an overpowered enemy. To overpower an enemy, fill their stun bar by attacking while they block, or by parrying their attacks.
cn: 残酷打击会对被压制的敌人造成额外%k伤害。 要压制敌人，你需要攻击正在格挡的敌人，或是招架敌人的攻击，来填满晕眩条。

en: A young Round-Billed Sailer, unable to fly yet due to its overly round shape and tiny wings.
cn: 一只年幼的圆喙水手，圆滚滚的身体和小小的翅膀使得它还无法掌握飞行的秘诀。

en: On Elixir Well, The Springs Of The Elixir
cn: 论魔药之井，魔药的泉源

en: Orange dyed fabric used for clothing.
cn: 染成橘色的布料，能够用于服饰。

en: Select a preset to reset your changes to:
cn: 选择想要重置回哪种预设方案：

en: You currently don't have any unfinished Main Quests
cn: 当前没有尚未完成的主线任务

en: When you need to rest, you can fast travel back to your home by opening your map. Navigate to the map with %k and select your home.
cn: 需要休息时，打开地图就可以快速返回自己的家。使用 %k 导航到地图，然后选择您的家。

en:
A pair of rotting pants, held together by stabilizing chitin shells.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
一条腐烂的长裤，仅靠几丁质甲壳将织物勉强固定在一起。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: A sturdy material used in extravagant tailoring.
cn: 用于缝制奢华服饰的牢固材料。

en: This tool paints the appearance of wear and tear on the outer edges and corners of building structures.
cn: 此工具将为建筑的外部边缘与角落位置添加磨损外观。
捏上去又滑又冷的结晶状物质。

en: Unlocks Special Abilities of Bows. Press %k to unleash a powerful Special Ability after generating enough Focus. Focus Generate Focus by attacking. Focus can be built up with any weapon type and is used to trigger Special Abilities of weapons.
cn: 解锁弓的特殊能力。 拥有充足专注时按%k释放强大的特殊能力。 专注 攻击将生成专注。所有类型的武器都可以积累专注，你可以花费专注来发动武器的特殊能力。

en: I feel so much more at home with my new sheltered bed. Thank you! Now, let's decorate it together to make it nice and cozy!
cn: 有了这张拥有庇护的床，这里也终于有家的感觉了。谢谢！好了，让我们来把这里打扮成温馨小窝吧！

en:
...then come to the Ol' Salt 'N Pepper! 

We got it all — self-caught fish, ale golden as the sun or deep as amber, and many a tale for weary travellers! 

Our prices are fair — and so are the barmaids!

Find us on 44 Clearwater Street, just down the road! We'll be happy to 'ave ya!
cn:
……那就快来椒盐吧！

我们这里应有尽有——自己抓的鱼，像太阳一样金灿灿或者像余烬一样深红的麦芽酒，还有许多给疲倦的旅人提神解乏的传说故事！

我们价格合理——而且女招待也同样美丽动人！

我们就在清水街44号，走到尽头就能看见！我们欢迎所有顾客！

en: The <npc>Carpenter</npc> Cade Hawthorn explained he built <location>Diadwyn</location>, a town nestled within the Revelwood, with his own hands. He might have left some of his Half-Timbered Blocks there.
cn: <npc>木匠</npc>卡迪·霍桑解释说他曾经亲自在喧嚣森林建造了一座名为<location>狄亚德温</location>的小镇。除此以外，他有可能在那里留下了一些半木结构方块。
新神的诞生 - 梅菲兹

en: Sometimes a Drak hatchling proves too weak to break its shell. In such cases, the Broodwardens use this poison-tipped blade to cut the egg open. The young bear a mark from that day onward — a symbol of frailty that brands them for life, forever beneath those who hatched unaided. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 有时候卓克的幼崽会因为过于虚弱而无法打破自己的蛋壳。在这种情况下，育种者将会使用这把淬毒的利刃划开蛋壳。自那之后，被解救的幼崽就不得不携带着标记生活——这种代表脆弱的符号将成为它们一生的耻辱，意味着比起那些凭自己力量破壳而出者，它们永远低人一等。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: This ceremonial robe belonged to an honorable "Scholar of the Empyrean", worn during sacred offerings in the Night Sanctums. Wear this piece with the same pride the previous owner did.
cn: 这件仪式斗篷属于一位荣誉“苍穹学者”，这是只有在黑夜圣所的神圣献祭中才能穿上的装束。效仿前人，骄傲穿上这件斗篷。

en: A small amount of frozen or crystallized ectoplasm. It contains a tiny bit of life energy.
cn: 少量冰冻或结晶化的灵质。里面蕴含着微乎其微的生命力。

en: A strange material extracted from ectoplasm fragments. It was filtered through cloth and coal but still smells odd.
cn: 从灵芝碎片中提取出来的神秘物质。虽然经过了布料与煤渣的多重过滤，却仍然散发着难闻的气味。

en:
Hannah Reed, one of your villagers, mentioned leaving most of her possessions behind to flee towards <location>Fort Kelvin</location>. Perhaps some valuables can still be recovered from her old farm.

 Hannah Reed allowed you to go look. You can keep everything you find!
cn:
你的一位村民汉娜·里德表示当年为了逃去<location>凯尔文要塞</location>，她将自己的大部分财产都留在了老房子里面。也许你可以在她以前的农场中找到一些有用的东西。

汉娜·里德已经批准你进去调查。而且找到的东西都归你！

en: A block of stone infested by Shroud spores. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 被瘴气孢子感染的石块。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: Fast travel is not possible while falling.
cn: 坠落时无法进行快速移动

en: I felt honored. Really. Being the first from my village selected to become a Scholar was… life-changing. Who would’ve expected such a feat from me, a mere lumberjack's son? From a village as sluggish and tumbledown as a soured lake, no less! I wear the Scholar's uniform with pride. I’m getting used to the stares, the whispers, the bowing populace. Still, some aspects of my vocation continue to stir me. The corridors of the Night Sanctums are relentlessly trapped. When the Empyrean Ancients instructed me how to turn the traps off, I made sure to memorize every detail — and when attempting the deactivation for the first time, I rigorously tested each spike and swinging blade, meticulously weaving my path through the machinery as I went. I can’t imagine passing these corridors any other way. One thing is for certain: the contraptions keep out whoever isn’t valiant or foolish enough to press on.
cn: 此刻我倍感荣幸。真的。 作为村庄里有史以来第一位被选中成为学者的人……这是天翻地覆的变化。 谁能想到，区区一个伐木工的儿子竟然能够获得如此殊荣？更何况还是从这个破败寒酸的小镇里被选中的！ 我骄傲地穿上了学者的制服。我已经逐渐习惯了人们的凝视、走过人们身旁时的窃窃私语，还有那些对我鞠躬行礼的路人。但是，这种新身份的某些方面仍然让我感到不自在。 黑夜圣所的走廊里面布满了不计其数的陷阱。 当苍穹学者们讲述解除这些陷阱的方法时，我确保自己将每一个细节都铭记于心，第一次尝试亲自解除陷阱的时候，我不遗余力地测试了每一根尖刺与摆荡利刃，我小心翼翼地检查着一路上所有机关的情况。 只有这么做，我才敢安心穿过这些长廊。有一件事可以确定：只有真正勇敢或者是愚蠢之人才敢无视这些陷阱机关。

en: Flameborn, I've reached the end of my wits. We've discovered almost every ingredient and concoction in these lands... I fear we must seek wisdom beyond our borders. The Flame must think so, too. It won't speak to me, but I see the silhouette of a blazing tower when I gaze into its fire... backed by mountains, and an ice-cold lake.
cn: 火之子，我现在已经无计可施。说实话我们已经发现了这些大地中的每一种原料与化合物……如果要进一步拓展我们的智慧，恐怕我们必须前往更远的地方。灵火肯定也是这么想的。虽然它不愿意与我交谈，但是之前当我凝视火焰的时候，我看见了一座熊熊燃烧的高塔的轮廓……而且就在一处背靠群山，面向冰冷冻湖的位置。

en: Ay, remember to get me some <craftingstation>Masonry Tools</craftingstation>. I'll repay you! Pinky promise, got it?
cn: 那什么，记得帮我找<craftingstation>石匠工具</craftingstation>啊。我会报答你的。我保证！不守信就剁手！

en:
You've found Goldrock Saddle. 

Take a look around and discover a tool to swim faster, like the fisher suggested!
cn:
你已经找到了金石鞍。

调查附近，按照渔夫的说法，这里应该有能够帮助你游得更快的工具！

en: You've reached the Drak'Dal Ruin. Now search for any hints on how the Drak'Dal create different colored lights.
cn: 你已经抵达卓克·达尔 废墟。现在设法寻找有关卓克·达尔创造不同颜色的彩灯的线索或方法。

en: Copper-plated gloves that protect the wearer's tender hands during a brawl.
cn: 带有铜制甲片的手套，在挥拳战斗时保护穿戴者脆弱的双手。

en: A barrel that will store rainwater.
The world will be updated with the latest version of your savegame.
cn: 将使用你的最新版本的游戏存档来更新世界。

en:
Yolanda is still weak. 

She can barely lift her body from the bed... She sleeps, has hot and cold flashes at night. I muffle her pained grunts with the pillow. We can't let them know we're here. 

They're always out there, prowling, shrieking through the night. We're surrounded. I don't want them to be our end... I want peace. I'll be by your side forever. I promise. 

I love you, Yolanda. 

— Alienor
cn:
优兰达依旧很虚弱。

她几乎没有力气从床上撑起来……她几乎一直在睡觉，晚上一会冷一会热。当她痛苦呻吟起来的时候，我只能拿枕头捂住她的嘴。不能让他们知道我们在这里。

他们永远在虎视眈眈，嚎叫声彻夜不停。我们被包围了。我不想死在那些家伙的手上……我就想安安静静活下去。我会永远陪着你的。我保证。

我爱你，优兰达。

— 艾丽诺

en: Flamekeeper, you know I collect many things... why not join me in this pleasure? Keep your eyes peeled — The Hollow Halls hide golden urns, forbidden books, and enchanting crystals! Oh, I've picked the Springlands clean, but the other regions still hide little treasures...
cn: 火焰守护者，你知道我收集了很多东西......为什么不和我一起分享这份快乐呢？请睁大眼睛 - 空荡礼堂之中藏有许多宝藏，金瓮、禁书和魔法水晶应有尽有！哦，对了，虽然我已经把春日平原彻底翻了个底朝天，但其他区域应该仍然能找到不少宝贝……

en: Increases the skill level of Finesse
To change the difficulty settings of a dedicated server, please use the server interface of the provider or update the enshrouded_server.json config file.
cn: 如果需要调整专用服务器的难度设置，请使用服务器供应商的服务器界面，或者直接更新enshrouded_server.json配置文件。

en: Some Half-Timbered Blocks could be found in <location>Diadwyn</location>. The <npc>Carpenter</npc> should be pleased.
cn: <location>狄亚德温</location>中应该能找到一些半木结构方块。<npc>木匠</npc>应该会很满意。

en: Gain one point of Strength for every two levels of the Flame.
cn: 每两级灵火获得1点力量。

en: You've reached the main Elixir Well. Delve into its depths and behead the one-eyed monsters within to fight back the Shroud!
cn: 你已经抵达主魔药之井。 潜入深处并斩杀独眼怪物以驱散瘴气！

en: The Huntress explained that she wants to hook the fireflies onto a fishing line to catch fish. She also showed you how to craft a basic fishing rod. Craft a fishing rod, then return to her.
cn: 女猎人解释说她想要把萤火虫挂在鱼线上来钓鱼。她还给你展示了如何制作基础的鱼竿。 制作一根鱼竿，然后回去找她。

en:
Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.

They first appear in the Springlands at night, among groups of Fell enemies above the Shroud.
cn:
新鲜的瘴气孢子，制作治愈瘴气诅咒的解药原料。

最初出现于夜晚的春日平原，就在瘴气上方的瘴气魔敌人身上。
调查<location>荆棘堡</location>附近的道路

en: There's still a faint glow behind its eyes. Hopefully, they won't follow your every move.
cn: 它的双眼中依旧能看见黯淡的光芒。希望它们并不是在监视着你。

en: This sacred shield consecrated by the Flame allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.
cn: 受到灵火洗礼的神圣盾牌将允许你格挡物理攻击。格挡将消耗体力。

en: A long, hollow iron tube. To highly skilled craftsmen it offers the possibility to work glass.
cn: 长长的空心铁管。对于技艺娴熟的工匠来说，这是加工玻璃的必备工具。

en: You brought back some Circular Sawblades! Huh? Scavengers gave ya trouble? ...So Thornhold didn't hold. A shame. Well, let's craft that Table Saw in their honor. Put it where I can see it!
cn: 你带了圆形锯片回来！什么？你遇到了一群拾荒者？……这么说荆棘堡也沦陷了。可惜了。行吧，就当是在纪念那里的人们，我们赶紧来制作锯台吧！把东西放在我能看见的地方！

en: I said it before, but we should form a band... I know where to start!
cn: 虽然我之前已经说过一遍，但我还是觉得我们可以组一个乐队……我知道可以从哪里开始！

en: You've reached the Alchemist's tower. Search inside for a stray cat!
cn: 你已经抵达炼金术士的高塔。在里面寻找野猫的迹象！

en: The Alchemist mentioned the location of a legendary Glider. The spot is marked on the map.
cn: 炼金术士提到了关于一个传奇滑翔翼的位置。具体地点已经在地图上标出。
