It's curious — thought I saw something glisten down there, but perhaps my vision was blurred by the haze. I'm tempted to descend once more — are there canals below? Sewage that allows the mephitis to putrefy and mold forth? Hidden treasures, washed up, though never dulled? — But I retch at the thought. The sun is setting. I'll risk staying overnight. Above ground has little cover, but it's far from the smell!
cn: 似乎有什么正在这片废墟的深处腐烂，但我觉得并不是瘴气。下层的恶臭几乎就已经到了让人难以忍受的地步。至于那里的厕所，我只能够感受令人胆战心惊的恶臭毒气的嘲笑。 每次打开厕所大门，那臭气熏天的味道都会让我不由自主地转身逃走，我会控制不住地冲上地下室的楼梯，然后大口呼吸外面的新鲜空气。 这段时间我只能够选择在外面的树丛里解决需求。 不过有件有趣的事情。之前我好像看见下面有什么闪闪发光的东西，不过也有可能只是浓雾扰乱了我的视线。我很想再一次调查深处的情况，也许下面存在着某种水道？或者是让臭气积聚闷烂的下水道？谁知道能不能在那里找到被冲上岸，而且仍然没有被腐蚀的隐秘宝藏？不过一想到要去那里，我就直想呕吐。 太阳快要下山了。今晚还是先留在这里吧。虽然地面上无法找到合适的庇护所，但至少不用忍受这股恶臭！

en: The end product of chemical experiments, the crystals sparkle like shimmering sea foam.
cn: 化学实验的最终产品，这种晶体像碧海浮沫一般闪烁。

en: Stop your whiny teeth chattering and listen up. I have a plan to regain the Flame's blessing and lift this horrid curse! First, we'll make a fine brazier, a chandelier , and oh so many candles. Second, we find ourselves a brittle-boned weakling who didn't gulp down enough milk as a kid. Third, we smash him to pieces. Fourth, throw his sad, fragile little bones into the firepit as a holy offering and DANCE UNTIL the Flame forgives us! We could chant, but the only song I know is "Ode to Pikemead". If you know some tunes by that bard Val, join in!
cn: 忍一忍，这里并没有你想象的那么冷，听好：我计划重新获得灵火的祝福并摆脱这种可怕的诅咒！ 首先我们需要搞一个精致的火盆，一个吊灯外加很多很多蜡烛。然后我们需要找一个从小发育不良所以骨质疏松的软蛋。接着我们需要把它彻底碾成粉末。最后我们要将那些骸骨碎片统统丢进火盆充当神圣的祭品，之后就尽情舞蹈，直到灵火原谅我们！ 在这过程中我们还可以吟唱圣歌，不过我只会“派克米德颂”这一首。如果你知道那个吟游诗人瓦尔的其他歌曲的话，大可以一起加入！

en: 1.4 Keen does not store the text of this agreement after the agreement has been concluded. You can access these Adventure Sharing Terms at any time at https://enshrouded.com/AdventureSharing_ToS.
cn:
1.4	
本协议签订后，Keen 不会存储协议文本。您可以随时通过 https://enshrouded.com/AdventureSharing_ToS 访问本冒险分享条款。

en: The maniacal Hollow are driven by resentment. They must be set free, returned to the winds of fate. Slash through their white-hot anger! Crack their pale fingers like wishbones! Pluck the gold teeth from their jaws, and bring me the head of the one-eyed beast in their midst so we may drink from its skull! Gather your might and craft the key to descend.
cn: 那些疯狂的空荡的心中只剩下了怨恨。必须让它们重获自由并再一次回归命运之风。斩断它们灼热的怒火！彻底粉碎它们的苍白之手！拿走它们嘴里的金牙，将独眼之兽的头颅带给我，我们将用它来畅快痛饮！做好万全准备，然后制造钥匙并深入地下。

en: I know we didn't part on good terms. And you know I'm bad with words. So, how to start...? ...When I look at the sky, I recall how you taught me to glide. Remember how I was so scared to jump, to drop down the ledge of the harbor? You were there. You held my hand. Guided my strike when I hammered my first iron, sparks flying. You never wavered. ...I didn't mean to raze your forge down. I was angry. Livid. I have my mother's temperament, as you always say. I'm sending new Smithing Tools. They work like a charm. Because... I wanted to apologi— ...No. You'll always be my fath— No... Oh, I don't know. Forget it. We both know I'm not good at goodbyes. A true Anders at heart, like mother. So, how to end...? Well. Goodbye. — Rochelle
cn: 我知道当初分别时闹得很不愉快。而且你也知道我不善言辞。 所以该怎么开头呢……？ ……每次看向天空的时候，我都会回想起你教我滑翔的时候。记不记得，我那时候怕得要命，根本不敢跳下码头？但是你就在我身旁。你牵着我的手，指导着我锻造出了人生中第一份铁器，我还记得当时火花四溅，但是你根本纹丝不动。 ……我并不是故意烧掉你的锻炉的。我当时只是在气头上。你也总说我跟妈妈一个脾气。我决定寄一套新的铁匠工具给你。这些东西非常好用。我之所以这么做是因为…… 我想要道……不对。 你一直是我的……不行…… 唉，我也不知道怎么说才好，算了吧。 我们都知道我不擅长说再见。我和妈妈一样，是一位真正的安德斯家族的人。所以结尾该怎么写……？ 不管了，总之再见。 — 罗茜

en: Pants such as these were originally made fashionable by prominent falconers from ages long past.
cn: 昔日著名猎鹰人带动了这种裤子的潮流。

en: A block of pure amethyst with no visible imperfections. Staring at it feels enchanting, and calms the mind.
cn: 使用纯粹紫水晶制作的方块，表面完美无瑕。如果凝视这些方块，你会感觉仿佛有一股不同寻常的魔力使内心变得平静无比。

en: Increases Critical Strike chance against Soaked enemies
cn: 提高对湿透敌人的暴击率

en: Ay, you've found my Crucible! Huh? Was that journey too tough for ya? Quit whining, Flameborn! Rekindling a flame takes time and patience. Right now, just crafting that Smelter will suffice. Let's get to work!
cn: 啊，你找到我的熔炉了！怎么了？你被路上的艰难险阻击败了吗？振作点，火之子！引燃火苗需要时间和耐心。好了，现在我们只需要制作冶炼炉就可以了。赶紧开工吧！

en: Cast Time of spells is reduced by %k.
This Glider is lighter and enables you to travel bigger distances.
cn: 滑翔翼非常轻，因此能够带你前往更远的地方。

en: Found in Flame Shrines and Sanctums
cn: 能够在灵火神龛与神殿中发现

en: FSR2 is an advanced antialiasing technique. Reducing the quality will increase performance.
cn: FSR2是一种先进的抗锯齿技术。降低质量可提高性能。

en: Tools deal %k increased damage against stone. This includes stone terrain and gemstone veins.
cn: 工具对石头造成%k额外伤害。 这包括石头地形与宝石矿脉。

en: Reach The Albaneve Summits Hollow Halls
cn: 抵达阿尔班耶夫山脉空荡礼堂

en: After Ignition the leather limits the amount of air around the coal, causing it to burn slower. This will keep you warm for a bit.
cn: 点燃之后，皮革将限制煤炭周围的空气流动并使其缓慢燃烧。能够暂时为你提供温暖。

en: We will be back shortly to hear your requests.
cn: 稍微走开一会，我们将很快回来聆听各位的申请。

en:
Galen Yager, a hunter in your camp, proposed that you slay a group of Scavengers in <location>Brittlebush</location> to retrieve the hunting clothes of his comrades!

Reach the location and eliminate the enemies there to find the 4 cosmetic items!
cn:
你的营地中一位名叫盖伦·耶格尔的猎人希望你能够杀死<location>碎丛</location>中的一群拾荒者并取回他死去的猎人同伴们的狩猎服！

抵达标记地点并消灭那里的敌人，设法找到全部4件外观物品！
阿尔班耶夫山脉 瘴气

en: Imagine the joy of dripping in jewels... I don't exactly know what it's like, but I reckon it's fantastic!
cn: 想象一下穿金戴银的华丽生活……虽然我没有体验过那种事，但我猜那种感觉肯定很美妙！

en: A Blast Furnace For The Blacksmith
A flask brewed from rare underwater materials, easing the strain of every powerful stroke. Reduces stamina drain while sprint swimming or sprint diving.
cn: 使用稀有水下材料调配而成的药水，能够减少每次用力摆动身体时造成的疲劳。 降低冲刺游泳或是冲刺潜水时的体力消耗。

en: Thanks for playing our Closed Alpha!
cn: 感谢体验我们的封闭内测！

en: Sturdy gloves, dark as the midnight sky. They've been adorned with animal horns that were gathered during the hunt.
cn: 牢固的手套，与午夜的天空一样黑暗。表层装有在狩猎时收集到的各种动物角。
燃火荒原 空荡礼堂

en: Increases the skill level of Brute

7.2	
In the "Popular" list, worlds are ranked according to the number of Likes received. The more Likes a world receives, the higher it will appear in this list. You can Like any world. There is no option to submit negative ratings. As an Uploader, you can influence the placement of your world in the "Popular" list by offering high-quality, attractively described, and well-categorized worlds that other users Like. Influencing the ranking by paying Keen a direct or indirect fee is not possible and is expressly prohibited.
cn:
7.2	
在“热门”列表中，世界按照获得的点赞数量进行排名。一个世界获得的点赞越多，在列表中显示的排名位置就越高。您可以给任何一个世界点赞。没有设置提交负面评价的选项。作为上传者，您可以通过提供高质量、描述吸引人且分类得当的世界来获得其他用户的点赞，从而影响您的世界在“热门”列表中的排名位置。无法通过向 Keen 支付直接或间接费用来影响排名，且明确禁止这种做法。

en: The Hunter thinks that you must spill and drink the same blood as the Drak to beat them at their own domination game. Craft or obtain a Drak Soulward Flask to strengthen yourself against the new foes! You can find the recipe at the Alchemist's workshop. While under the influence of the potion, you will also gain the ability to understand their written language.
cn: 猎人觉得为了打败卓克的争霸游戏，你必须像它们一样挥洒并饮用鲜血。 制作或获取一个卓克 御灵药水以获得对抗这些全新敌人的力量！你可以在炼金术士的工坊找到配方。 在药水的作用下，你还将获得理解它们文字的能力。

en: After sprinting for a short time, attacks deal %k bonus cutting damage for %k. The duration refreshes every time damage is dealt.
cn: 冲刺一段时间后，攻击将造成额外%k劈砍伤害，持续%k。每次造成伤害时刷新增益持续时间。

en: Wordslinger Thus one journeys to the stars InSaint Stuck in a death loop dietutnix Did she really do nothing? Phillychick Blocks to legacy Cloogshycer and Jackpotgal Lit by normal chaos and towers Chillpaka Forever invincible!
cn: Wordslinger 前进星辰 InSaint 陷入死亡循环 dietutnix 她真的什么也没有做吗？ Phillychick 方块的遗产 Cloogshycer and Jackpotgal 热爱普通的混乱与高塔 Chillpaka 永远无敌！

en: You can contact our data protection officer at the following e-mail address:
cn: You can contact our data protection officer at the following e-mail address:

en: Reached the ancient spire in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 抵达燃火荒原的远古尖塔。

en: Argh, just where is it? I used to have a chest with salvageable materials, but it got swiped! I'm telling ya, someone took it while I was sleeping in that damn pod... Ask around for me, will ya? Someone here's a dirty thief!
cn: 啊，它在哪里？我以前有一个装有可回收材料的箱子，但被人偷走了！我告诉你，有人趁我在那该死的吊舱里睡觉时拿走了... 你去问问吧 这里有人是个肮脏的小偷

en:
A white plant called "Calla Luna". To some, they represent purity and faithfulness, while they're a symbol of sensuality to others. 
However, everybody can agree on their beauty and that their nightly green glow sets them apart from other blossoms in the Nomad Highlands.
cn:
一种被称为“月之莲”的白色植物。有些人认为这些植物代表纯洁与信仰，其他人则认为这种植物象征着欲望。
不过所有人都一致认同，月之莲拥有着与游牧高地中的其他植物截然不同的美丽以及在深夜中散发绿色光芒的特性。

en: This pair of pants has ample space for carrying exposed blades and hidden toxins.
cn: 这条宽敞的裤子能够存放额外的剑刃或隐蔽的毒药。

en: A simple setup for basic grinding work. Especially good for hard ingredients.
cn: 用于基础研磨工作的简单设备。尤其适合用来处理坚硬的原料。

en: A heavy tunic with fur lining.
cn: 内衬有皮草的沉重大衣。

en: Duu, duu, duu, du-du-du, duu, duu, duu...
You are in every breath I take, in each tear I cry, and in all my waking dreams.
cn: 你就在我的每一次呼吸，每一次哭泣与每一个白日梦中。

en: Forged from old metal rests, it shows signs of improvement in performance but still does not deserve to be called a handy tool.
cn: 使用旧金属废料熔铸而成，虽然在性能上略有改善，但依旧算不上是什么趁手的工具。

en: A sturdy iron stove that warms up your cozy hut in style!
cn: 牢固的铁制火炉，能够为你的温馨小屋提供温暖与氛围！

en: Return The Gloomberries To The Barber

This ceremonial wand was often used when praying for downpours when the drought first started. While that didn't work, you can still use it to call lightning down on your enemies! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 当旱灾刚刚来临时，人们经常会使用这种仪式魔棒来祈祷求雨。虽然那种做法并没有成功，但你现在依旧能用它来呼唤闪电打击你的敌人！ 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: Search For A Bard Assistant In Cromville
cn: 在克罗姆威尔寻找一名吟游诗人助手

en: Explore The Goat Farm By The Basin
cn: 探索盆地旁的山羊农场

en: Do you want to discard your changes? All unsaved changes will be lost.
cn: 确定放弃之前的改动？这么做将丢失所有未保存的改动。

en: Despite its wild mixture, it still looks appealing. It's one of those things that isn't edible, yet you still want to take a bite out of it.
cn: 尽管使用了匪夷所思的材料，这种混合物仍然显得十分诱人。虽然明显不可食用，但还是让人情不自禁想要拿起来啃一口。

en: A hollow shape, empty as the night sky on a new moon, adorns this weapon's hand guard. The blade has been dirtied, but refuses to shed its silvery sheen.
cn: 就像是新月期的夜空一样空荡的中空形状装饰着这把武器的护手。尽管沾满泥泞，但剑刃拒绝褪去自己的银色光芒。

en: The Huntress believes that you could further extend the lengths of your dives with the right tools. She revealed that the northern army once trained specialty divers and equipped them with proper tools for extended missions. The divers were last deployed at a Drak temple, which was abandoned at the time. Reach the Drak temple to proceed!
cn: 猎人认为只需要拥有正确的工具，你就可以进一步延长自己的潜水时间。她透露说北方军曾经专门训练过一批潜水员，并且还为这些人配备了用于执行漫长任务的工具。 潜水员们最后部署在了一座卓克神殿，那里当时就处于无人问津的荒废状态。 抵达卓克神殿以继续！
提高所有魔法电击伤害

en:
You've discovered a gruesome sacrificial pit at the foot of the cliffs by <location>Fort Kelvin</location>. There, you uncovered daggers and a newspaper clipping centered on the King's mishandling of the town's safety concerns.

Talk to Marianne Reed about your findings!
cn:
你已经在<location>凯尔文要塞</location>悬崖底部找到了一个可怕的献祭坑。你在献祭坑中找到了几把匕首以及一张剪报，上面写满了对于国王导致城镇安全状况恶化这一问题的报道。

与玛丽安娜·里德谈谈你的发现！

en: A wonderful lute with carefully placed, playful decorative lines. They spring forth like joyful melodies on a sunny midyear day.
cn: 做工精美的鲁特琴，琴身上有精心放置的装饰性线条。在阳光明媚的岁中，琴弦将释放出令人愉快的旋律。

en: Bonus protection against ice-type magic, in addition to the general magic resistance.
cn: 除了常规魔法抗性外，提供针对寒冰魔法的额外防御。

en: Magical ammunition that calls a disastrous Shroud Meteor down on up to five foes. The meteors deal heavy Shroud damage. Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud. Spell: Depletes after use. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 魔法弹药可召唤灾难性的瘴气流星，最多可击中五个敌人。流星会造成严重瘴气伤害。 瘴气法术：施放此法术使你承受瘴气停留时间下降的减益效果。 法术：使用后会消耗。装备该法术并使用法力来用法杖施法。

en: The carnage you've caused among the Drak does not go unnoticed. You've gained the attention of their leaders. It's time to challenge them! You can find the Drak leaders in multiple places, but a convenient spot is marked on the map.
cn: 你在卓克中掀起的腥风血雨已经被它们的首领给注意到。现在是时候对那些家伙发起挑战了！ 你可以在多个地点找到卓克首领，不过地图上已经标记了一处合适的地点。
中型阿尔班耶夫山脉火盆

en:
Perhaps the Flame had been tainted all its life. Blinded by its own light — or perhaps, it was us. 

The final flaw, raised too high above the rest. A fall so deep, so devastating, it rivals the chasms below. A failure that ripped us in two. 

Divided, in shambles. Our young drowning in war, our old locked inside the stars. A miscalculation. Ash among starfire, after all. We must start anew.

— Manathor
cn:
也许从一开始，灵火就注定会走向灭亡。被自己的光芒所蒙蔽，也许我们一样。

最致命的瑕疵来源于最高的顶点。一落千丈，坠落的毁灭超乎想象，足以比拟下方深不见底的沟壑。这次的失败彻底撕碎了我们。

我们就此一分为二，蹒跚盲目。年轻者深陷战争，年迈者深陷星辰。这是一次错误的计算。但那只是群星之火洒下的灰烬。我们必须浴火重生。

 - 马纳索尔

en: The ominous structure — ...we cannot decipher its meaning. Caspian, that cretin, asked about our progress — I just stammered and made something up. Said that it's a gateway to the stars — that the Ancients built it to open a path into the sky, fueled by the energy of the fire. I think he bought it. I don't want Caspian to figure this out before we do... I plundered his masonry tools and hid them in our own camp. If Loraine Crim were here, she'd judge me, but oh well. Guess the dam is keeping her busy. — Nala
cn: 那个不详的建筑……我们根本无法理解其中的真正含义。那个笨蛋贾斯帕询问了我们的进度，我情急之下就只能信口开河胡诌了几句。说那里是通往群星的门扉，我说那是远古者通往天空的道路，并且能通过火焰的能量来驱动。我觉得他好像信了。我不希望看见贾斯帕赶在我们之前查明建筑的真实用途……所以我就拿走了他的石工工具并且藏在了我们的营地里面。 如果洛琳·克里姆在这里的话，她肯定会痛骂我一顿，但是无所谓了。反正她现在正忙着处理水坝。 — 纳拉

en: You've gathered some wool, I see. We could use this to craft warmer padding and better armor... perfect for the biting winds, trust me. To refine the wool, we'll need a spinning machine! I can show you how to craft it.
cn: 看来你已经收集了一些毛料。我们可以用这些东西来制作更温暖的衬垫与更好的护甲……等到你面对凛冽寒风的时候就明白了，相信我。我们需要一台纺织机才能加工毛料！我可以教你如何制作。

en: A large crystal with a threatening aura.
cn: 一块散发着危险气息的大型水晶。

en: Contains a higher Shroud concentration compared to spores. Source: Dropped by common Fell, starting in the Nomad Highlands biome.
cn: 与孢子相比蕴含着更高浓度的瘴气。 来源：掉落自最初出现于游牧高地中的常见瘴气魔。

en: These boots provide resistance and grip when stuck in a fierce snowstorm.
cn: 在铺天盖地的暴风雪中，这些靴子将提供良好的阻力与抓地力。

en: Increases your maximum Health by %k times your Dexterity attribute.
cn: 提高你的最大生命值，具体提升量等同于你的敏捷属性的%k倍。

en:
We stepped foot in humanity's Night Sanctum, crossed its threshold with glee and ease, shared our knowledge and voices.

Yet, as the brutish Drak built their temples on broken bones, their offerings held little interest to us, so we averted our gaze.

A farce, a failure, a fated misstep — for the creatures saw in this a challenge, and favor to be won in battle. When they attacked humanity for our attention, we recoiled... and vowed to never pick a side again, even as the Shroud emerged.
cn:
我们走进了人类的黑夜圣所，愉快又从容地穿过了界限，分享着我们的知识与声音。

但与此同时，当残暴的卓克用断裂的骸骨建造了自己的神殿，我们却对它们的祭品毫无兴趣，于是我们便挪开了视线。

一场闹剧、一次失败、一次命运的偏差——那些生物将这当成是一种挑战，一次需要在战斗中赢取的青睐。当它们为了得到我们的注意而向人类发起了进攻，我们惊慌失措……并从此发誓永不偏袒，哪怕当瘴气出现时也是如此。

en: Don't fool yourself, feeble Flameborn. Yer still in danger out there in the Shroud, so make sure you come see me to enhance your equipment.
cn: 切忌盲目自信，弱小的火之子啊。对你来说瘴气依旧无比致命，所以千万记得来找我强化装备。

en: Gate to the Pillars of Creation
These rough stones shimmer slightly and have a very rustic style. Building Blocks can be placed with a Construction Hammer when within range of a Flame Altar.
cn: 这些粗糙的石块闪烁着微弱的光芒，看上去有一种十分粗犷的感觉。 你可以在灵火祭坛范围内使用建筑锤放置建筑方块。

en: <craftingstation>Almanac of Plants and Seedlings</craftingstation> For The <npc>Farmer</npc>
Increased damage against Wildlife and Wildbeasts
cn: 提高对野生动物与野兽伤害

en: Reduced health, but bonus damage and life leech against the Hollow.
cn: 降低生命值，但对 空荡有额外伤害和生命值消耗。

en:
You've found a note that detailed the burial of a man possessed by his blade. He owned a sword that fell from the stars, and felt like a piece of him was missing ever since.

He was buried with his weapon. Find his resting place and retrieve it!
cn:
你找到的一张纸条上提到了某个因为神秘宝剑而发狂的男人的葬礼。此人拥有一把来自星辰的长剑，自从找到剑后，男人就一直在发了疯一般地寻找着对剑中的另一把。

男人与自己的武器一起下葬了。找到他的安息之地并取回宝剑！

en: Now that you've procured some Yak food bait, you have to search for a Yak! There is a spot marked on your map where Yaks can be found, but anywhere is possible. The quest will only update to the next page when you reach the designated area, but you can complete the quest by taming any Yak.
cn: 现在你已经拥有一些牦牛诱饵食物，你应该开始寻找牦牛！ 地图上标记的区域能够找到牦牛，但是其他地方也能够找到可以被驯服的动物。当你抵达指定区域后，任务日志才会更新下一页内容，不过你只需要驯服任意牦牛即可完成任务。
你的攻击将造成额外劈砍伤害

en: Instantly restores 1 minute of your remaining time in the Shroud.
cn: 立刻恢复1分钟的瘴气停留时间。

en: Choose tabs to navigate different sizes and categories of shapes.
cn: 选择分页以切换尺寸与形状类别。

en: An aged stone that outlasted all else for centuries. Leaves one wondering what kind of things it might have seen.
cn: 数百年后依旧历久弥坚的石块。谁也不知道它们见证过多少历史。

en: This pouch can be filled at a well or lake. A sip of water helps to recharge your power!
cn: 这个水袋能够通过水井或者湖泊灌满。喝水能够帮助你恢复精力！

en:
Unknown footprints in the mud are always a bad omen, wether one is superstitious or not.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
cn:
无论这是否是迷信，泥泞中的陌生脚印往往都是不祥的预兆。

提供针对瘴气的额外防护。

en: A delicate ring with the symbol of the Gemini — quivering with hatred in the moonlight.
cn: 刻有双子符号的精致戒指，在月光下会带着永无止境的仇恨颤动不已。

en: Runes are mystical artifacts that attract and store magical energy from the environment. Craftspeople and their assistants can use runes to enhance your weapons, shields, armors and rings, which provides powerful bonuses and effects. Salvage weapons, shields, armors and rings to recover runes, allowing you to reuse them and customize your arsenal.
cn: 符文是一种用于吸引与储存环境中魔法能量的神秘工艺品。 工匠与他们的助手能够使用符文来强化你的武器、盾牌、护甲以及戒指，并为其提供强大的加成与效果。 拆解武器、盾牌、护甲以及戒指来回收符文，这将允许你重复利用符文并自由定制自己的装备。

en: Fine iron dust, used for different crafting purposes.
cn: 磨碎的铁粉，能够用于各类制作目的。

en: It is said that one of the <npc>Carpenter</npc>'s aunts, <lorename>Elin</lorename>, was cursed in a Kindlewastes Sun Temple once. It's not clear if the story is exaggerated, though. The <npc>Farmer</npc>, Emily Fray, is from the Kindlewastes and might have insight about the haunted Sun Temple.
cn: 据说，<npc>木匠</npc>的某位阿姨，<lorename>艾琳</lorename>，曾经在燃火荒原太阳神殿遭到了诅咒。我不清楚这是个传说还是真正发生的事情。 <npc>农民</npc>艾米丽·弗莱来自燃火荒原，可能对闹鬼的 太阳神殿有所了解。

en: Special Ability: We've added a new ability that can be triggered with %k. Check out the Skill Tree for details. Fire Ranged Weapons: Due to the addition of the Special Ability, bows can now only be shot while they're charged via %k or selected in the Action Bar. Holding %k triggers the bow's special ability, and tapping %k triggers a normal shot.
cn: 特殊能力：我们添加了一种能够通过%k触发的能力。请查看技能树了解详情。 发射远程武器：因为添加了特殊能力机制，现在只能够通过%k或者在动作栏中选择弓来蓄力发射。长按%k将触发弓的特殊能力，点击%k将触发普通射击。

en: A club carved out of wood. Not much, but better than nothing.
cn: 用木头制作的棍棒。虽然有点寒碜，但总比赤手空拳要强。

en: While Wet or Soaked, damaging enemies will apply Soaked to them for %k sec. Damaging soaked enemies has a chance of %k to deal %k bonus Shock Damage. Wet Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30%% for 15 minutes. Warmth reduces the remaining duration. Soaked Reduces Stamina and Stamina Regeneration by 30%% for 30 seconds. Also reduces Ice and Shock Resistances by 30%% but increases Fire Resistance by 30%%. Soaked can be applied to enemies. Soaked duration can not be reduced by warmth, and transitions into the Wet debuff once it ends.
cn: 潮湿或湿透状态时，对敌人造成伤害将同时对其施加湿透效果，持续%k秒。对湿透的敌人造成伤害将有%k几率造成%k额外电击伤害。 潮湿 体力与体力恢复降低30%%，持续15分钟。温暖环境将能够缩短此效果的持续时间。 湿透 体力与体力恢复降低30%%，持续30秒。同时使寒冰与电击抗性降低30%%，但是火焰抗性将提高30%%。 敌人也会进入湿透状态。 湿透的持续时间无法通过温暖环境缩短，并且等结束时将会变为潮湿减益。

en: Before I took that job for repairing the shed, I was traveling with a hunting party. It was exciting but didn't make me any money... Maybe check out their camp if you're still looking for helping hands. It would be good to get more firepower in here!
cn: 在我接下修理棚屋的工作之前，我一直在与一支狩猎队一同旅行。那段经历还挺有意思的，只是一分钱都没有……如果需要帮手的话，你也许可以去他们的营地看看。这里确实需要更多人手来负责防御！

en: You've found a note that mentioned a nearby Ancient Obelisk. Reach the area marked on your map to find the Obelisk!
cn: 你找到的一张字条里提到了附近的古代方尖碑。抵达地图上标记的区域并找到方尖碑！

en: If anybody finds this, hand it directly to King Gormander. My men and I are DONE here, and we ain't coming back. Rimgard's army would've been bad enough, but they're still human, far as I know! Instead, what's stomping through the valleys is far more nightmarish! A brigade of flame-cursed, hollowed-out Cyclops is descending from the mountaintops, and with it, the stench of burnt flesh and decay! I can hear them move as one through the vale below! Don't know where they're headed, but I won't stay to find out!
cn: 如果有人捡到这份东西，请直接交给戈曼德国王。 我和我的兄弟们已经受够了这个地方，我们不会再回来了。 虽然里姆加德的军队很可怕，但据我所知，他们至少是人类！此刻正在山谷中横冲直撞的那些家伙才是真正的噩梦！ 一群被火焰诅咒的空荡独眼巨人正在从山顶上冲下来，而且他们还散发着血肉烧焦和腐朽的阵阵恶臭！我可以清楚地听见他们就在底下的山谷前进！ 我不知道他们要去哪里，但我绝对不会留下来等死！

en: Prodigious tin armor. The glistening sheen inspires hope.
cn: 熠熠生辉的锡甲，犹如希望的象征，鼓舞士气。

en: Simplistic head protection. It won't guard against much, but it's better than nothing.
cn: 朴素的头部防护。虽然无法提供太多防御，但聊胜于无。

en:
The <npc>Hunter</npc> Athalan Skree told you about the royal guard of former Queen <lorename>Pikemead</lorename>, known as the Blood Rose.
A small group rebelled against Lord <lorename>Vorgoth</lorename>. She doesn't know what happened to them, only where they were last seen.

Search there for traces of their rebellion.
cn:
<npc>猎人</npc> 阿萨兰·斯克里 向您介绍了被称为血玫瑰的前女王 <lorename>派克米德</lorename> 的皇家卫队。
一小群人反抗了 <lorename>沃格斯</lorename> 领主。她不知道他们发生了什么事，只知道最后一次见到他们是在哪里。

在那里寻找他们叛乱的痕迹。
空荡礼堂 展示柜（大型栏位x1）

en: Craft Or Obtain Rough Stone/Wood Blocks
cn: 制作或获取粗糙石/木方块

en: Ahh, fresh air fills my tired lungs... I greet thee, new friend. I am a ferryman. A  keeper of souls, a guide in the night. How lucky for you, aimless one. I will light your path.
cn: 啊，我疲倦的肺部再一次感受到了清新的空气……你好，我的新朋友。我是一名船夫。我保管着灵魂，并在深夜为人们指明道路。你很幸运，漫无目的之人。我将照亮你的道路。

en: A primordial wand that speaks of the previous dominion of the Drak. When the Drak'Dal were pushed back to the archipelago after they attacked humanity, their craft degenerated significantly, thus losing the ability to reproduce designs such as this. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.
cn: 传颂着卓克过去统治的原始魔棒。卓克·达尔在袭击人类失败后被赶回了群岛之上，自那之后它们的制作工艺便大幅下滑，如今它们再也无法复刻出像这样的设计。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。 多重射击： 发射多枚投射物，但是降低伤害。

en: Acquire Happy Villagers And Upgrade The Flame
cn: 获取快乐的村民并升级灵火

en:
Muted shades of green help you blend in, almost invisible as you chase little frogs through the grass.

This palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.
cn:
哑光绿将帮助你与环境融为一体，使你在草丛追逐小青蛙时不用担心被发现。

可以使用幕水盆地材料制作这种调色板。

en: Oh, my heart aches without the sweeter things in life! Won't you help, pretty please?
cn: 唉，缺乏甜蜜的生活像什么话！拜托了，请你一定要帮我。

en: Meant to hold and rip prey, these claws are still sharp as ever.
cn: 这些原本用来抓住并撕碎猎物的爪子仍然犀利无比。

en: The Alchemy Of Bean And Water
A little pillbug, also called a roly-poly. It can be found in the Albaneve Summits and used as fishing bait, especially popular among rare fish.
cn: 一只小小的鼠妇，也被称为西瓜虫。可以在阿尔班耶夫山脉中找到，能够作为鱼饵使用，尤其受到稀有鱼的青睐。

en:
The Bard has told you about her favorite band, The Honeydews, and their rare instruments. The band broke up, but if you investigate their last show, you might be able to find clues to the members' whereabouts.

Investigate the band's last venue to start your search for the rare instruments!
cn:
吟游诗人跟你说了她最喜欢的乐队“蜜露”还有乐队成员们使用的稀有乐器。很遗憾乐队后来解散了，但如果调查他们最后的演出场所，你说不定能够找到乐队成员的下落。

调查乐队最后一次演出的场所并寻找稀有乐器！

en: Your new friend is merrily strolling around your base. They would be even happier if you made a dog bowl and a dog bed for them! Craft and place both items to proceed!
cn: 你的新朋友正在基地附近愉快地散步。如果你能够为它制作一个狗碗与一个狗窝，狗狗将会变得更开心！ 制作并放置这两种物品以继续！

en:
An improved antidote that will cure poisoning upon use.

Also applies a buff that prevents the player from poisoning.
cn:
这种改良后的解毒剂能够在使用后立即解毒。

使用后还将同时为玩家赋予免疫中毒的增益效果。

en: Increased Damage Reduction Limit from Physical Armor
cn: 提高物理护甲的伤害减免上限

en: Adorned with a crystal and gold trim, these gloves give you a firm grip on your daggers — ideal for strikes from behind.
cn: 用水晶与金边装饰，这些手套将允许你牢牢握住自己的匕首——这是那些喜欢背刺之人的绝佳选择。

en: In these shoes, you glide through the thicket effortlessly, barely breaking a sweat.
cn: 穿上这些鞋子之后，你将能够轻松自如地穿越茂密的灌木丛。

en: Are you sure you want to delete this world? You will not be able to recover it, but worlds that were available as savegames can still be enjoyed by other players if they were downloaded before deletion.
cn: 确定删除这个世界？之后你将无法恢复这个世界，但其他玩家仍然能够游玩在删除前下载的世界存档。

en: Are you sure you want to unsubscribe from %k?
Fast travel is not possible underwater.
cn: 水下无法进行快速移动。

en: Ancient Obelisks contain lore about the world. After reading them, you will gain insight to the locations of hidden Flame Shrines and Shroud Roots. Flame Shrines can be harvested to obtain Sparks. Sparks are needed to strengthen the Flame. Shroud Roots must be destroyed to gain Skill Points.
cn: 古代方尖碑将提供关于周遭世界的信息。阅读之后，你将能够掌握隐藏灵火神殿以及瘴气根的位置。 搜刮灵火神殿以获取余火。 余火是强化灵火的必要资源。 你需要摧毁瘴气根才能够获得技能点。

en: The elevator broke. Again. I told the overseer to issue proper repairs countless times. This is where it got me. Stuck in an elevator, with no one else left on shift. Last time this happened, the guys were trapped for 2 days, but the shipment they were stuck with contained plenty of food and a sabertooth pelt to sleep on. Seems like I don't share their luck. All I've got is a load of books, parchment, and a creaking wagon to lie on. At least I won't have to wait long until I'm saved.
cn: 升降梯坏了。又一次。 我都不记得跟主管说过多少次，要他们赶紧去叫人来修理。现在好了。我被困在了升降梯里面，而且根本找不到其他人来帮忙。 上次出现这种事故的时候，那些可怜人被困了整整2天，但当时他们是在运送食物，而且还带着一张能够铺在地上当床用的剑齿虎皮。可我就没有这么好的运气了。我手头只能找到各种书籍和卷轴，唯一能躺的地方，就是一台吱嘎作响的货车。 无论如何，应该要不了多久就会有人来救我。

en: A sweet comfort in weary hours: Grind the beans and steep them in water — add sugar, that the flavor be full and kind A Sweet Mokka is prepared.
cn: 为疲惫时刻准备的甜美抚慰： 研磨咖啡豆并将粉末泡入水中—— 然后用糖让咖啡的滋味变得饱满而又友善 一杯甜蜜摩卡就此诞生。

en:
You've found a note describing golden-glowing plants that grow deep within a Shroud Lair. Their light is alluring, but the cave holds more than just wonder. 

Reach the Shroud Lair to find out what the author saw.
cn:
你找到的一张纸条里提到说，瘴气巢穴深处生长着一种散发金色光芒的植物。这些植物的光芒具有诱人的魅惑，但是洞穴里面并不只有美丽的奇景。

抵达瘴气巢穴并调查纸条作者看见的植物。

en: An adorable little Hophare. Its eyes frantically scan the environment when you pick it up, but it calms down quickly.
cn: 一只可爱的小跳脚兔。捡起来之后，它的眼睛会惊恐地扫视周围环境，不过要不了多久它就会冷静下来。

en: So you went atop that Ancient Spire, huh? I know a few people who'd give anything for a view like that. Although now... maybe there's less bustle to observe than before.
cn: 这么说你已经爬上了远古尖塔？曾经那里的景象可是让不少人都魂牵梦绕。但是现在……恐怕就没有多少值得称赞的“美景”了吧。

en: Save data error. Creating save data failed.
cn: 存档数据错误。创建存档数据失败。

en: My fingers ache to play new tunes! Soft melodies on silvery winds! Please, let us find some!
cn: 我的手指渴望着弹奏全新的旋律！在风雪之中弹唱温柔的乐曲！拜托了，一定要帮我们找到它们！

en: Are you sure you want to extract %k?

The Carpenter said that the lantern is in <location>Morwenna</location>, a town he used to reside in.

Go to <location>Morwenna</location> and search for the lantern!
cn:
木匠告诉你说灯笼就在<location>莫文纳</location>，他以前就住在这个镇子里面。

前往<location>莫文纳</location>寻找灯笼！

en: You've found a piece of armor in the Kindlewastes Hollow Halls. Collect all pieces to complete your set!
cn: 你在燃火荒原的空荡礼堂中找到了一件护甲。 集齐所有部件以完成你的套装！

en: Piercing attacks deal more damage to you.
cn: 穿刺攻击将对你造成更多伤害。

en:
2. Subject matter of data protection

This privacy policy applies to personal data. Personal data is any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person; this includes, for example, the name or identification numbers.
cn:
2. Subject matter of data protection

This privacy policy applies to personal data. Personal data is any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person; this includes, for example, the name or identification numbers.

en: Follow Queen Jezmina Through The Blackmire
cn: 跟随杰兹米娜女王的足迹穿越黑沼

en: It's an expertly layered blue coat with a white fur trim. The quilted cloth and leather provide better protection in close combat. The gold casing near the heart carries a faceted gem and resembles a cornflower blue eye, searching the battlefield for souls in need.
cn: 做工精美的多层式蓝色大衣，领口还缝有一圈白色的毛边。缝有衬垫的布料与皮革能够提供优良的近战保护。靠近心脏位置的金色外壳上嵌有一枚刻面宝石，像矢车菊一样的蓝色宝石之眼将在战场上寻找需要帮助的灵魂。
一样的双眼，不一样的面孔

en: No armor piece forged today can endure the sheer brutality of this mace.
cn: 今时今日铸造的铠甲根本无法抵挡这柄钉锤的残暴打击。

en: Have you found the cache yet?
This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind. Grilled over a fire, it will raise your maximum health, increase your magic damage, and accelerate your mana regeneration.
cn: 这种蘑菇烤串能够强化你的肉体与心灵。 在火上炙烤过后，这份烤串能够提高你的最大生命值、魔法伤害以及法力恢复。

en: Defeating an enemy with a Sneak Attack or Merciless Attack spawns a Health Orb. Gathering an Orb restores 10% of the respective resource.
cn: 使用隐秘攻击或残酷打击打败敌人时将生成一颗生命球。 收集恢复球将恢复10%的对应资源。

en: A delicious root vegetable that must be cooked before its sweet and mild flavor can be enjoyed.
cn: 一种美味的植物根茎，必须彻底煮熟才能享用甜美温润的滋味。

en: The light sweetness of the coconut rice pairs well with the smoky fish filet. A shame you couldn't add a hint of lime or lemon!
cn: 椰浆饭的清甜滋味与烟熏鱼肉搭配起来恰到好处，可惜这里找不到柠檬或者酸橙！
免费 - 恢复默认配色

en: The Hunter spoke of the "Greatest Game" and revealed the location of a Kindlewastes enemy camp. It should prove to be a good challenge!
cn: 猎人提到了“最极致的狩猎”，并且还向我展示了燃火荒原中一处敌人营地的位置。这次的狩猎一定颇具挑战！

en: What do you think of my draft?
cn: 你觉得我的草稿怎么样？

en: Orpheus' Memoir: Once born a wanderer, I sought incandescence and bliss Now I'm frozen in time, my body cast in chains Accustomed to a sea of shadow, deep in the abyss My eyes hurt in the brightness, so no light may remain
cn: 俄耳甫斯的回忆录： 生为旅人，我寻觅着炽热与极乐 现在我冰冻于时间之中，我的身体被锁链束缚 习惯了暗影之海与底层的深渊 这明亮之地刺痛了我的双眼，愿所有光芒消逝
完成燃火荒原空荡礼堂

en: Don't make me tell you again — clear that Elixir Well.
cn: 记住我跟你说的，赶紧清理那座魔药之井。

en: The world of the living calls me once more. I'm a huntress — I can help you survive. Let's not squander our time.
cn: 我再一次感受到了生者的世界的呼唤。我是一名女猎手，我可以帮助你在这里生存。时间紧迫，我们赶快开始吧。

en:
The residents of <location>Raven's Keep</location> have escaped. They fought through hordes of Vukah to break out, led by their new matron. They seem to have moved on to <location><lorename>Lupa</lorename>'s Lair</location>.

Perhaps the <craftingstation>Tanning Station</craftingstation> can be obtained there.
cn:
<location>渡鸦堡</location>的囚犯已经逃跑。他们在新的女领袖的带领下从沃卡中杀出了一条血路。那些人似乎已经前往<location><lorename>卢帕</lorename>之巢</location>。

也许那里能够找到<craftingstation>制皮台</craftingstation>。

en: A freshly brewed cup of coffee. The flavor is strong, bold, and lightly acidic. What better way to start the day?
cn: 刚冲泡的新鲜咖啡。风味强烈、大胆而且略带酸味。这难道不是开始一天的最好方式吗？

en: Curses! Last night's wind made a mess of our church — or what was left of it. Everett was right. We should have reinforced the roof when we still had the chance. He'll relish that, too! Now I must patch the holes, but I can't recall where I had last placed the chest with the materials... I thought I saw it near the church, but I can't find it anywhere! Did my eyes grow tired with age after all?
cn: 该死！昨晚的大风把我们的教堂弄得一团糟，或者说是一片狼藉。埃弗雷特说得没错。我们本该抓住机会尽快加固屋顶。那样的话，他一定会很开心的！ 现在我必须把洞补上，但我想不起来上次把装着材料的箱子放在哪里了……我想我在教堂附近看到过那东西，但怎么也找不到了！我的眼睛是不是老花了？

en: What is that...? Some sort of blight permeates every fiber. The skin is fibrous and porous... changed already. In the end, the Shroud reaches all. Animal, soldier, king... All our bones crack the same... Here.I'll share my hunting grounds with you. I'll mark it in your Journal. Walk my trails, and release them in my stead, Flameborn.
cn: 那是什么……？每一根纤维都渗透着瘟疫的痕迹。皮毛也已经变得干硬多孔……很明显已经被彻底扭曲。没想到到最后什么也逃不出瘴气的魔掌。无论是野兽、士兵还是王公将相……谁也无法幸免……好了。我会与你分享自己的狩猎场。我会在你的日志里做好标记。追寻我的足迹，释放那些被控制的生灵吧，火之子。

en: Increases the skill level of Ranger
An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.
cn: 一把做工精良的利剑，刀刃平稳而且锐利。能够像刺破夜晚的嚎哭一般穿透敌人的身体。刀身上带着派克米德之地的著名铁匠的印记。

en: Search Ocean's Heart For Epic Instruments
cn: 在海洋之心寻找史诗乐器
调查<location>凯尔文要塞</location>附近的悬崖
使用一份潜水毅力药水

en: A farmbed which will yield Wheat.
Its only eye still aimlessly rolled around in its socket before the beheading. Eventually, though, it spilled out.
cn: 在被砍头之前，它唯一的一只眼睛还在眼窝里漫无目的地打转。不过，它最终还是溢了出来。
黑铁拾荒者主母战利品

en: Before us lies the Veilwater Basin... a realm that sprouted from an insidious seed. The canopy here stretches far and wide, but its roots split open the scars of ages past. An old force has come to take their revenge, and to wet their blades and tongues anew with blood.
cn: 此刻在我们面前的是幕水盆地……这是一个从险恶的种子中诞生的国度。这里的树冠一望无垠，但是它的根须却撕裂了久远过去的伤疤。一个古老的势力已经回来复仇，它们将用鲜血振奋自己的剑刃与尖舌。

en: Anything can be domesticated with enough patience. Used to produce honey and wax.
cn: 只要足够耐心，一切生灵都能够被驯服。用于生产蜂蜜与蜡。
青铜瘴气魔荧龙战利品

en:
Mother once told me the ol' captain always has a story to tell... for a price. 
Last night, I shuffled along the shore, dead tired from work. As I strolled by the water, I caught a scent in the breeze — and when I looked up, I found myself right beside the Ol' Salt's doors.

I remembered my mother's words, and drawn in by the tavern's promise of ale and a good time, I stepped inside. The old mariner was polishing a glass as I walked in. I told him I was out of coins, but I tossed him a pearl from Orville. He prepared a beer and a tale right away.

In a hushed voice, he reminisced about the week he'd spent inside the maw of a beached sea dragon while stranded far away, his voice rough as the water outside the window. He said he hid between its pearly teeth and slept under its tongue, making a pyre atop its skull to signal rescuers.

Then, he abruptly stopped. I asked him how the story ended, and he quietly held out his hand for another payment. I'll return soon to hear the rest!
cn:
母亲曾经跟我说过，老船长永远有说不完的故事……只要你有钱。
昨天晚上，我因为工作精疲力竭所以决定在岸边散个步。就当我在水边踱步的时候，我闻到风中有一股特别的味道 — 我抬头一看，发现身旁就是椒盐的大门。

这时候我想起来母亲说过的话，麦芽酒还有精彩故事的诱惑吸引着我走进了酒馆。进去的时候，那个老水手正在擦杯子。我跟他说今天没带钱，但是我给他丢了一枚从奥威尔找到的珍珠。男人给我倒了杯酒，接着就开始讲了起来。

他压低嗓音跟我复述着他上周的经历：他因为意外搁浅不得已只能躲在一头搁浅的海龙的嘴里面，男人的嗓音就像是窗外的水声一样粗粝。他说自己就藏在巨龙洁白的牙齿间，累了就躺在它的舌头底下睡觉，而且他还在海龙的头骨顶上点了一堆求救的篝火。

说到这里，他突然戛然而止。我立刻追问这个故事是如何结束的，谁想到男人只是一声不吭地伸出了手示意我要付更多的钱。我打算尽快回去好听完剩下来的故事！

en: Ask Questions Only When You Can Handle The Answers
cn: 提出问题之前，先确保自己已经准备好面对答案

en: I sympathize with Marsha's apprehension. Really, I do. It's in her nature to be cautious, she's a "Hophare" at heart — always a mere breath away from skittering off, dashing to safety and comfort. Well, regarding animals, I'm more of a Whitewing Vulture... I'm bound to the skies! It's my calling to glide above these freezing valleys! How can Marsha not feel intrigued by the upstreams outside our cabin? By the landing site just beyond the winds? Just how high up would they take me, I wonder? Perhaps far enough to reach the giant skeleton by the ridge? ...How steep would the fall be, dared I make a mistake? Alas, there's no point in pondering it. I don't want to break my little snow rabbit's heart. Or my bones.
cn: 我很理解玛莎的担忧。真的。我明白她生性谨慎，在内心深处，她就像是一只“跳脚兔”，随时做好了逃回安全与舒适之地的准备。 不过如果要拿动物作比喻的话，我觉得我自己更像是一只白翼秃鹫……我注定要自由飞翔！我生来就是要在这冰冷的山谷之上滑翔！ 我搞不懂玛莎为什么就是对小屋外的那些气流不感兴趣？就是降落点旁的那些强风？ 不知道那些气流能把我抬升到什么高度？也许甚至足以让我滑翔至山脊旁的巨型骸骨那里？……但反过来，要是中途失误跌落的话，我会不会遇到生命危险？ 算了吧，还是别去思考这些事了。我不想让我的小雪兔伤心。我也不想摔断骨头。

en:
Even when dead, the swirling chaos inside the gaping maw leaves people spellbound. Don't get too close.

Collect multiple Fell Monstrosity Heads to craft the Bronze Trophy.
cn:
虽然已经死去，血盆大口中的混沌旋涡依旧让人不寒而栗。保持距离，不要靠近。

收集数个瘴气魔怪物头颅以制作青铜战利品。

en: A sticky and highly flammable substance. Handle with care!
cn: 极度易燃的黏稠物质。使用时千万小心！

en: A helmet which protects your sensitive cranial bone from harm while riding into battle.
cn: 头盔可以在骑马冲锋陷阵时保护你脆弱的颅骨不受伤害。

en: Harbor Log, Day 13 of Yearwake, 503 D.A.— Abandon Ship!!
cn: 港口日志，岁初第13日， 503 D.A. — 弃船！！

en: Did you get your hands on any coins yet? I know capitalism is evil, but I see no harm in bringing it back if it benefits me specifically.
cn: 你找到硬币了吗？我知道资本主义很邪恶，但只要我有得赚，让那种东西死灰复燃也没什么不好的。

en: Increases the skill level of Mass Destruction
cn: 提高毁天灭地的技能等级

en:
Hugo explained that the epic instruments might have belonged to buried royals. He doesn't know where the final instrument could be, but suggested asking the Bard Valory, also named "the balladeer of kings."

Talk to the Bard about your findings and ask her about the final epic instrument!
cn:
雨果解释说史诗乐器有可能是皇室成员的陪葬品。他不知道最后一件乐器的具体位置，但是建议你去问问吟游诗人瓦罗里，此人又被称为“诸王唱师”。

与吟游诗人谈论你的发现，并向她询问最后一件史诗乐器的下落！

en: Unlimited magical ammunition that continuously channels powerful lightning strikes. It shocks enemies by jumping between them and deals stamina damage. Stamina damage fills the enemy's stun bar. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff. Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 无限魔法弹药，能够持续引导强力闪电。能够在敌人之间弹射电击并造成体力伤害。 体力伤害将使敌人的晕眩条上涨。 引导法术：在一段时间内维持按键以持续引导。装备法术并消耗法力来用 法杖施法。 永恒法术永恒法术不会消耗。装备永恒法术，消耗法力来用法杖施法。

en:
Increases your Dexterity attribute by 1.

Increases Bow and Dagger damage by 5% per Attribute Point.
cn:
令敏捷属性提升1点。

每点属性值可使弓箭和匕首的伤害提高 5%。

en: You there! You help people, right? For free, correct? For exposure? I ask because I need assistance with our family business! We specialize in shipping wares, but we had some transportation problems, so all of the packages were lost. Now those hats we were shipping are scattered all over! I can't let this get out — it's bad press, even during the apocalypse. If you retrieve the hats, you can keep them. Deal?
cn: 喂！听说你能够帮助其他人，对吗？而且是免费的？不需要任何回报？是这样，我现在有件家族事务需要帮助！我们家族主要经营货运，但是之前我们遇到了一次运输事故，所有的包裹都被弄丢了。原本要送出去的帽子也都散落在了各个地方！不能让其他人知道这件事，就算现在世界已经毁灭，面子还是得要的。总之，如果你能找到那些帽子，你可以把它们统统留下来。一言为定？

en:
Food for attracting and taming a goat. It can be given to both Common Goats and Frizzy Goats.

To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding, and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.
cn:
用于吸引与驯服山羊的饲料。能够给普通山羊与绒毛山羊食用。

若要驯服动物，请在潜行状态下小心靠近目标。在动物身边投掷诱饵食物以吸引其注意。在动物进食时抚摸它，重复过程直到动物被驯服。被驯服之后，你将可以捡起动物。

en: The <craftingstation>Almanac of Plants and Seedlings</craftingstation> was gifted to a "matron" in <location>Surat's Rest</location>. The matron must be defeated so that the <craftingstation>Almanac of Plants and Seedlings</craftingstation> can be returned to the <npc>Farmer</npc>.
cn: <craftingstation>植物与幼苗图鉴</craftingstation>被赠送给了<location>苏拉特之息</location>的一位“女主人”。必须打败“女主人”，才能将<craftingstation>植物与幼苗图鉴</craftingstation>送回<npc>农民</npc>。

en: Nails made from Metal Scraps. Sharp objects that can be used as a tool or to improve a weapon.
cn: 使用金属废料制作的钉子。这些锐利的尖刺可以是工具，也可以用来改良武器。

en: This regal soldier's armor symbolizes chivalry, glory, and valor.
cn: 这件威严的士兵盔甲象征着骑士精神、荣耀和英勇。

en: The Cosmetic Scholar Of The Empyrean Set
cn: 苍穹学者外观装饰套装
青铜 空荡独眼巨人 奖杯

en: Two bindings can share the same key or button using one of these pairings:
cn: 两个绑定能够使用以下的配对方案分享相同的按键或按钮：

en: The server is full or unavailable.
An axe forged in pure light. Few have witnessed its glory, and those who did were blinded in a flash.
cn: 在纯净光明中铸就的斧子。很少有人见证过这把武器的光芒，那些见证者都在无比耀眼的光芒下失明。

en: Choose two attributes from the selection. They will be increased by $$arg0$$ levels each.
cn: 选择两种属性。之后这些属性将分别提高$$arg0$$级。

en: Chance to Spawn a Health Orb
Beauty fades from this realm. We must bring it back!
cn: 这个国度的美正在不断消逝。我们必须让美丽重新降临这片大地！

en: You can craft new equipment at the Blacksmith. Craft with him to create a Scrappy Sword, a Spiked Club or any piece of armor. Crafting the weapons requires Metal Scraps, which can be found in the world or dropped by Scavengers. A spot for collecting Metal Scraps is marked on the map. This quest will also be completed if you beat the Elixir Well.
cn: 您可以在铁匠制作新装备。与他一起制作可以获得废料剑或尖刺棒 或任何盔甲。 制作武器需要金属废料，它可以在世界中找到或由拾荒者掉落。 地图上标有收集金属废料 的地点。 如果打败了灵药井，这个任务也将完成。

en: Every enemy hit with an Explosive Arrow has a 20% chance to trigger a secondary explosion for 50% damage in a small radius.
cn: 每个被爆炸箭矢击中的敌人都有20%的几率在小范围内触发二次爆炸并造成50%的伤害。

en: Increases the skill level of Backstab Mastery
cn: 提高背刺专精的技能等级

en: A massive, razor-sharp talon. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by Giant Enshrouded Vultures, initially found in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 像尖刀一般锐利的巨爪。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于燃火荒原中的巨型瘴气秃鹫。

en: Did you find any new eye color inspirations yet? Don't think too hard about how it works. Think of the fashion, darling!
cn: 为你新的瞳孔颜色找到灵感了吗？有些事情没必要深究原理。重点是时尚本身，亲爱的！

en: That kid is playing tricks on me again! I told Phil to bring some Regular Stone Blocks for the bridge repairs... sure, he didn't seem happy, but he's young and spry! He can carry them with ease! Of course, he just drops them off and scurries away!! "You're sure to find them on your own, Pop. Don't break your back!" Such a rabble-rouser... now where are the blocks?
cn: 又被那个小兔崽子给耍了！我明明告诉过菲尔要带一些普通石头方块来修桥……我知道他不乐意，但他现在正是年轻有力气的时候啊！扛过来也不会有多大问题！可是这小子呢，就直接两手一甩跑了！！“你就自己想办法找回来吧，老爹。小心别伤到腰！”真是个捣蛋鬼……那些方块到底跑哪里去了？

en: Won't you look at that! A color palette in all gray! It reminds me of this pretty piece of granite I had as a child!
cn: 快看！通体灰色的调色板！这让我想起了小时候见过的一块美丽的花岗岩！

en: The Conway brothers traveled through Umber Hollow, where they were attacked. It seems like the <npc>Blacksmith</npc> was meant to receive an item, which was left behind in a town called <location>Jasper Isles</location> when the Conways fled. The note the <npc>Blacksmith</npc> received seems to be a farbrication of the Conways, since the original note was lost alongside a gift.
cn: 康威兄弟在穿越褐赭空洞期间受到了袭击。康威在逃命路上选择了将要带给<npc>铁匠</npc>的东西留在了一个叫做<location>贾斯帕群岛</location>的镇上。<npc>铁匠</npc>后来收到的信件似乎只是康威亡羊补牢的补救措施，原本的信件已经与随信物品都已经遗失。

en: Hold to deal continuous Shroud damage in a beam of up to 20 meters range. Shroud Spell: This spell results in a debuff that reduces your Time in the Shroud. Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.
cn: 长按发射一道最远20米射程的光束，并持续造成瘴气伤害。 瘴气法术：施放此法术使你承受瘴气停留时间下降的减益效果。 引导法术：在一段时间内维持按键以持续引导。装备法术并消耗法力来用 法杖施法。

en: If it bleeds, we can kill it!
cn: 只要它会流血，我们就能杀死它！

en: When an enemy within %k meters is killed by a Melee weapon, you fall into Blood Rage. Blood Rage Increases Melee weapon damage by %k for 10 seconds.
cn: 如果%k米范围内有敌人被近战武器击杀，你将进入鲜血狂暴。 鲜血狂暴 将使近战武器伤害提高%k，持续10秒。

en: An elaborate weapon adorned with prized horns, probably trophies from past hunts. At times, the Drak would make sacrifices to their gods in Ark Morgo to channel their elemental affinities. Therefore, this axe of a tribal chief was imbued with the power of lightning to aid in their pursuits.
cn: 这把做工精美的武器上镶嵌有珍贵的犄角，很有可能是来自过往狩猎的战利品。有时候，卓克会向他们在魔戈方舟中的神灵进行献祭以换取元素馈赠。通过这种方式，这把属于部落酋长的斧子拥有了能够帮助它们达成自己目标的闪电之力。

en:
A feeding device that holds Yak food.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.
cn:
用于存放牦牛的饲料的喂食装置。

装满对应的食物后将喂食你的动物。

en: The world still breathes, as do I! They call me Valory of the Silverstrings, Song of the North Winds, Balladeer of Kings, Voice of the People, and Adventurer Extraordinaire!  "Val" shall suffice, however. Should I add "The Reborn" to my titles...?
cn: 世界还活着，我也一样！人们管我叫“银弦的瓦罗里”、“北风之歌”、“王之歌者”、“人民之声”或者是“非凡探险家”！不过你可以直接叫我“瓦罗”。我突然想到，也许我该给自己加一个“重生之人”的头衔……？

en:
Each Gem Forge requires a unique resource for upgrading and inserting gems.
The level gems can be upgraded to is limited for each Forge. Seek out Forges in more dangerous areas to unlock higher levels.
cn:
每一座宝石锻炉都需要独特的资源来升级与镶嵌宝石。
每座锻炉能够为宝石提供的等级提升存在上限。在更危险的地区中找到的锻炉将能够解锁更高的等级。

en: Adventurers who wear these fearsome boots should not be messed with.
cn: 千万不要挑衅穿着这些令人生畏的靴子的冒险家们。
瘴气魔敌人，首次出现：喧嚣森林瘴气区

en: Healthy soil that will increase the growing speed of most plants. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
cn: 充满活力的土壤，能够加快绝大多数植物的生长速度。 排水 这种材料会在溢出时排放少量水。

en: An illustrious garb that almost shines brighter than the wearer's spirit.
cn: 这件华丽的服装几乎比穿着者本身还耀眼。
可以在湖泊以及水井灌满

en:
Yesterday, a traveler came by — helped us plan the construction work for the Elixir Well. I'd never seen him before, only heard stories. And now I see why everyone calls him the <lorename>Mysterious Wanderer</lorename>. He indeed has a mysterious aura. 
I noticed the scar right away — a deep one, straight across his face. You couldn't miss it.

But today, when he returned to check our progress, the scar was gone. Vanished, as if it had never been there. For a moment, I thought it was someone else entirely. But then he called each of us by name — so we must have met before. 
I don't know what to make of this. Maybe I don't want to know. I hope we finish this work soon, so I can get back to my family.
cn:
昨天来了一位旅行者，他帮助我们制订了魔药之井的建筑规划。以前我从未见过他，最多只是听说过关于他的传说。现在我终于明白，为什么所有人都管他叫<lorename>神秘旅人</lorename>。这家伙确实散发着一种难以言喻的神秘气质。
我第一眼就发现了那道伤疤，深深的疤痕直接将他的面孔一分为二。想不看见都难。

问题是，今天他回来检查我们的进度了，但他脸上干干净净。伤疤消失了，根本没有存在过的痕迹。这都让我以为来的是另外一个人。但是他又清楚地记得我们每个人的名字，他肯定是我昨天见到的那个旅行者。
总而言之，这件事让我感到无比困惑。但我总觉得，也许我并不想知道这背后的真相。现在我只希望我们能够尽快完工，这样我就能回去找我的家人们了。

en:
I can't get the "Myth Of The Dragon Slayer" out of my head.

You see, I know it's all crap, right? Granddad was among the first to settle the mountains, after all. He said Vorgoth never set foot here, or if he did, we "ought not to discuss it", as he put it. Maybe there's a less glamorous legend below the one we're told? The dragons were long gone when we arrived, too. 
Is everything a lie? But then, what did I see atop that dragon's head by the basin? I could swear I saw something sparkle in the vulture's nest there, and the damn things seemed protective over it!!
So, is there a shiny weapon or not? Could it all be a coincidence?

I'm dying to know, but I'm not messing with those vultures!
cn:
我老是想起“屠龙者的传说”。

我知道那都是哄小孩的故事。我爷爷可是第一批在山间定居的人。他说沃格斯从来没有去过那里，而且“就算他去过，我们也不应该讲起这件事”，爷爷当时是这么跟我说的。也许这意味着，当时的真实经过并没有传说中写的那么辉煌？而且当我们来到群山的时候，那里的巨龙们早就已经灭绝了。
难道那一切都是谎言？但是话又说回来，之前我好像真的看见盆地的巨龙头颅上有什么东西？我对天发誓，那边的秃鹫巢穴里面有什么闪闪发光的东西，但那些该死的畜生不愿意让我接近！！
所以那到底是不是某种武器发出的光芒？也许这一切都是巧合？

虽然我真的很想去一探究竟，但我可不敢招惹那些秃鹫！

en: The creature that seized the spell gave the wizard quite a fight. He had to hunt it down until they emerged on the other side of the tomb. Who would have thought this tomb was a tunnel? Yet again, he ended up creating a lightning spell — and still no eternal life spell. He already feels defeated, believing there is only one tomb left where he can attempt his experiments unnoticed. It's near Stillwater Bay towards the foot of the hills.
cn: 中了法术的生物与巫师展开了一场恶战。他不得不亲自狩猎对手，最后双方却从墓穴的另一侧走了出来。谁能想到这个墓穴其实是一座隧道？但和之前一样，巫师最后只是创造出了一种闪电法术——永恒生命的法术仍然遥遥无期。巫师为此大受打击，他认为只剩下最后一处墓穴能够允许他悄无声息地进行自己的实验。那里就在静水湾附近朝向山脚的方位。

en: You did well finding that color palette. I knew there had to be creative souls out here. Less work for me!
cn: 谢谢你帮我找到那份调色板。我就知道这世上肯定还有其他充满创造力的灵魂。这样我就省事了！

en: A totem's grimace decorates this wand, watching your every move... sometimes, it empowers your magic. Sometimes, you feel it waiting for your downfall. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 这把魔棒表面存在着凶恶的图腾装饰，它会监视着你的一举一动……时而强化你的魔力。时而，又仿佛在静待你的陨落。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: Heading to the Kindlewastes? Best be on your guard! Me aunty Elin was cursed in one of 'em Sun Temples! Struck by this ghostly skull from below, she said, teeth chattering! 'Tis true! Well, most likely. You know Elin, always a taleteller! But never a liar... Isn't Emily from the 'round the Kindlewastes? Maybe she knows. I bet she'd babble!
cn: 你要前往燃火荒原？最好提高警惕！我的阿姨艾琳在太阳神殿中被诅咒了！她被来自地底的幽灵般的骷髅头击中，它们牙齿咬得咯咯作响！这是真的！嗯，至少非常可能是真的。你知道艾琳的，她非常能说会道！但绝不会骗人......艾米丽不是来自燃火荒原吗？也许她知道。但我打赌她会胡言乱语！

en: You've made or obtained suitable Building Blocks. They will be useful for creating structures and shelter. Both you and other survivors will need shelter to function. The Blocks must be placed with a Construction Hammer. Craft or obtain a Construction Hammer in your Manual Crafting tab or at the Workbench to proceed!
cn: 你已经制作或获取了合适的建筑方块。有了这些东西，你将能够方便地创造建筑与庇护所。你与其他幸存者都需要庇护所。 你必须使用建筑锤来放置建筑方块。 在手工制作界面以及工作台处制作或获取建筑锤以继续！

en: The fabric that separates life from death is becoming thinner, I feel it. With some small changes to my old incantation, my ritual should allow me to cross into the afterlife without requiring a loved one's touch... and to find eternity. One hour 'till dawn, and I spend it beyond Twice the time on this Earth is just what I want Death cannot stop me, I will find my forever Breach thrice the darkness, death finds me never Sands of time free me, I fall to the waves Stretch out my hands, let reality cave I sacrifice light, countless steps that I take Walk once into black, until later I wake Remember, Paulette: Trace your steps, or else you won't return from the void! I'd best conduct the ritual in my secret cellar so I don't bring the smell of death into my living room... I'm all out of clementine-scented candles.
cn: 我能感受到分隔生死的帷幕正在逐渐衰退。只需要对我的旧咒语进行少许调整，举行仪式后我应该能够不需要爱人的触碰就能进入灵界……并在那里获得永生。 在黎明到来的一个小时前，我将在彼界等待 我唯一的渴求便是在凡间走两遭 死亡无法阻止我，我将找到我的永恒 三次突破黑暗，死亡将永远无法找到我 时间之沙释放我，我将坠入波浪之中 伸出我的手，让现实崩塌 我将献祭光明，我将踏上无尽的阶梯 再一次返回黑暗，直到我再度醒来 记住，波莱特：记住走的每一步，否则你将无法从虚空中归来！最好还是在我的秘密地窖里举行仪式，以免把死亡的气息带到客厅里去……还有，我的柑橘味香薰蜡烛都用光了。

en: A local legend in the Albaneve Summits describes a dragon being slain by an axe blow to the head. Such a myth warrants investigation! Reach the dragon skeleton near the Wildwater Basin and find a way atop its skull to investigate!
cn: 根据阿尔班耶夫山脉当地的一个传说所述，这世上存在着一把能够一击劈裂恶龙头颅的利斧。也许这个传说是真的！前往野水盆地附近的巨龙骸骨，并设法攀登至头颅的顶部并进行调查！
格挡命中时的触发几率

en: These boots were designed to allow for reckless charges and dashes. The metal tips at the front prevent you from stubbing your toes.
cn: 这双靴子的设计目的是让您可以不顾一切地冲锋陷阵。靴尖的金属保护片可以避免你踢到脚趾

en: We've been held captive for three days now. Weak, struggling with no food or water. This may very well be my last testament... So let it be known: The Scavengers are creating new horrors that I cannot unsee. Scavenger Matrons who've grown fat with gluttony are turning the dark laboratory in this encampment on themselves by injecting Elixir, flooding their veins. These Gorgers will spit poison and lob corrupted vials at their prey — avoid them at all costs! If I do not survive here, consider yourself warned!
cn: 距离我们被俘虏已经过去三天。我们现在极度虚弱，没有任何水或者食物。这有可能就是我的遗言……告诉所有人：拾荒者正在创造根本无法想象的噩梦。 拾荒者主母将这座营地里的黑暗实验室用在了他们自己身上，他正在往自己的血管里注射大量魔药。 这些暴食者能够朝猎物喷吐毒液，还会投掷腐化小瓶，千万要避开这些家伙！ 如果我没能活下来，这就是我能给你的最终警告！
使用一份卓克 御灵药水

en: You've retrieved my hand drum! Wonderful! So? Let's get a band together and sing the night away!
cn: 你找到了我的手鼓！太棒了！现在怎么说？让我们立刻组个乐队，笙歌燕舞！

en:
You've discovered a note that detailed the submission of some Cyclops remains to a local laboratory in Balefire Stronghold "Lance Point". 

Look around to discover and claim the remains!
cn:
你找到了一张字条，上面提到说有人把独眼巨人的尸体送到了篝火要塞“枪尖”的一间实验室中。

在那里寻找尸体！

en: Find, Feed And Tame A Goat
cn: 找到、喂养并驯服一只山羊

en:
Abundant like clover fields, yet mysterious like wild ivy scaling a wizard's tower. 

This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.
cn:
像三叶草一样无处不在，但又像附着在巫师高塔上的常春藤一样神秘。

可以使用游牧高地材料制作这种调色板。

en: A farmer named Fenrig was tasked with ridding his farm of encroaching wolves. Search for the wolf cave to discover the farmer's fate and belongings.
cn: 一位名叫芬里格的农民曾经下定决心要解决逼近自家农场的狼群。搜索狼穴以查明农户的下落并找到他的东西。

en: Equip a bow and select ammunition from your inventory to engage in ranged combat. Aim for the head or the enemy's weakspot to do more damage. You can detonate explosives at range with arrows, or throw grenades which detonate on impact. Equip a staff or wand to unleash magical power. Wands don't require ammunition and have a short cast time. Staffs need spell charges or channels as ammunition and require mana. Magical spells can only be cast with staffs.
cn: 从物品栏装备一把弓并选择弹药以开始远程战斗。瞄准敌人头部或弱点位置以造成更多伤害。你可以使用箭矢引爆远处的爆炸物，或者也可以投掷会在命中时引爆的手雷。 装备法杖或魔棒以释放魔法之力。魔棒不需要弹药而且施放时间更短。法杖需要使用法术充能或引导作为弹药，并且使用时将消耗法力。只有法杖能够施放法术。

en: Climb The Ancient Spire In The Revelwood
cn: 攀登位于喧嚣森林的远古尖塔

en: Go To The Location And Search For Remnants Of The Royal Guard
cn: 前往该地点寻找皇家卫队的残余人员

en: A poisoned arrow, deadlier than ever before. Poisoned Arrow: Wildlife and Wild Beast hit by this arrow are poisoned and receive 12 damage per second for 5 seconds.
cn: 一根无比致命的淬毒箭矢。 淬毒箭：被此箭射中的野生生物将中毒，并且将每秒承受12点伤害，持续5秒。

en: Its brain has been replaced by fungi and slush, but it's still tremendously heavy. The face is permanently petrified with a bitter expression.
cn: 它的大脑已被真菌和泥泞所取代，但依然沉重无比。它的脸永远石化在痛苦的表情中。

en: Lets seedlings germinate in a safe environment.
cn: 让幼苗能够在合适的环境中生根发芽。

en: Increases the skill level of Slasher
cn: 提高屠杀者的技能等级

en: It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.
cn: 装满对应的食物后将喂食你的动物。

en: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment. Drainage This material drains a small amount of water when overflown.
cn: 混合着土壤、岩石以及沉积物。 排水 这种材料会在溢出时排放少量水。

en:
A lonely soul, brought low by the Shroud — and set free by your blade.

Collect multiple Fell Dragon Youngling Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
被瘴气吞噬的孤独灵魂，你的剑刃已经帮助它重获自由。

收集多个瘴气魔幼龙头颅以制作战利品。
青铜瘴气魔雷兽战利品

en: There's some extra space in the pockets perfect for storing crypt keys, "borrowed" rings, and lost fingerbones.
cn: 口袋里的额外空间正好能够拿来放各种墓穴的钥匙，“借来”的戒指还有某人遗失的指骨。

en: Fell Monstrosity, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud
cn: 瘴气怪物，首次出现：游牧高地瘴气区

en: An expertly crafted lute, originally owned by Chester Loft of The Honeydews — the most daring and lucky of the members. Fans also dubbed him "The Lucky Lute". Despite his adventurous tastes, his good fortune always kept him and his lute out of trouble, so the quality and craftsmanship of the instrument are well preserved.
cn: 一把做工异常精美的鲁特琴，上一任主人是“蜜露”乐队的切斯特·洛夫特，此人被广泛认为是乐队中最大胆也是最幸运的成员。粉丝们因此将其称为“幸存鲁特”。尽管热爱冒险，切斯特经常能够凭借过人的运气让自己和他的鲁特琴化险为夷，鲁特琴的品质与做工也是无可比拟的。

en:
Euclid & Enoki: Aedificare Pro Pace

Salty: Loved building a bit too much

Xearah Flameheart: Seeker of futures untold
cn:
Euclid & Enoki：建造达人

Salty：热爱建造大于生命

Xearah Flameheart：探寻未述未来之人

en: Clear And Investigate The Gem Forge
When you run out of health points, your Mana will substitute as health until it is also depleted.
cn: 生命值耗尽后转而开始消耗法力，直至耗尽为止。

en: Have you noticed the small insects flying around at night in the Springlands? They aren’t the usual prey I hunt, but could you collect some of them and bring them to me? I have an idea for how we can put them to use.
cn: 你有没有注意到晚上在春日平原到处飞舞的小虫子？它们并不是我平常狩猎的对象，但是能不能请你帮忙收集一些并带给我？我也许知道如何利用那些家伙。

en: The Barber wants to remember how to create the ideal green hair dye. He believes the key to the perfect shade lies in the duality of the color itself. It needs to be both fresh and natural as well as mysterious. The Barber asked you to speak to someone who would know more about the mysterious aspects of green, those being envy and immortality.
cn: 理发师想要重新回忆制作理想的绿色染发剂的方法。他认为创造完美绿荫的关键在于颜色中蕴含的二元性。这种颜色需要同时展现出天然的靓丽与神秘感。 理发师希望你去寻找一位能够更为了解代表嫉妒与不朽的神秘之绿的人。

en: The golden adornments on these gloves create an aura of superiority and grace.
cn: 金色的装饰纹理给手套营造出了一种卓越与优雅的气质。

en: Hey, kid. I got somethin' strange here. Come take a look?
cn: 孩子，有个奇怪的事情，能不能过来一下？

en: What's that you're holding? A Mining Sieve of sorts? For all I know, you can use that underwater to dig for gold and other fare. Why not try it out?
cn: 你手里拿着什么？那是某种矿筛吗？据我所知，你可以用那东西在水下挖掘黄金与其他物品。不如来试一试吧？
想要达成完美就必须精益求精。

en: A stronger Shroud arrow that's even more deadly than the last. Disperses a cloud of Shroud upon impact.
cn: 威力更强大的瘴气箭矢，比之前的版本更为致命。撞击时会释放一团瘴气云雾。

en: The faded heart of a Fell Foe. Its potent essence is key in crafting resilient armor and powerful healing spells. Crafting Ingredient: Primarily used for crafting armor. Source: Dropped by the Fell Sporeheads, initially found in the Kindlewastes.
cn: 一名瘴气魔敌人的褪色心脏。里面蕴含的强大精华是制作牢固护甲与强力治疗法术的关键材料。 制作材料：主要用于制作护甲。 来源：掉落自最初出现于燃火荒原的瘴气魔孢子头。

en: One of the worlds you shared has been found to violate our Terms of Use. We have therefore removed the world from Adventure Sharing and revoked your ability to make further uploads.
cn: 你分享的其中一个世界违反了我们的使用条款。我们将从冒险分享中移除该世界，并且禁止你继续上传其他世界。

en: The Kindlewastes hide many secrets — none more mysterious than the massive fossils of creatures long extinct. I have pondered the origin of their species, but this wasteland of a desert holds no answers. If you ask the local tribesmen, they will tell you the bones are of the gods, but I know this to be false. I have theories, but need to do some more careful digging. I have a promising site in mind already. —Loraine Crim
cn: 燃火荒原隐藏着许多秘密，至于其中最让人百思不得其解的，便是早已灭绝的生物留下的硕大化石。我一直在思考这些种族的来源，但是这片荒凉沙漠并没有我需要的答案。按照当地部落民的说法，这些都是众神的骸骨，但是我知道这并不是真的。 我已经有了一些初步的理论，但是还需要做进一步的细致挖掘。我已经看中了一处具有潜力的地点。 —洛琳·克里姆

en: These raw coffee beans must be roasted and ground before unfolding the depths of their flavor!
cn: 这些生咖啡豆必须通过烘焙与研磨才能够释放最深层的香气！

en: There must be a buried cellar somewhere in Mayfair Lot. Dig your way into the basement and claim what lies inside!
cn: 雅梅农庄中肯定有一个掩埋的地窖。设法挖进地下室并拿走里面的东西！

en: A frightening mace that brings misfortune to any that oppose it.
cn: 一根可怕的狼牙棒，会给任何反对它的人带来不幸。

en: Use your Grappling Hook to pull flying enemies towards you during combat. Cost: 50 Stamina
cn: 在战斗中使用抓钩将飞行敌人拉向自己。 消耗：50点体力
黑铁瘴气魔荧龙战利品

en: Crops planted by you within the perimeter of your base will deliver double yields.
cn: 在基地范围内，你栽种的作物将提供双倍收成。

en: I'm telling you, Will — invading Ocean's Heart will be the last mistake you'll ever make!! Even without the Queen around... and besides, the girl's known for being humble! What do you reckon you'll find? Pots and paints? Poems and seafood? Perhaps you'll nab some Highly Polished Stone Blocks, but that can hardly be worth it!!
cn: 听我一句劝，入侵海洋之心是大错特错！！就算女王不在了……再说了，那姑娘是出了名的清贫！你觉得自己能找到什么？陶罐和绘画？还是诗歌与海鲜？你最多就能找到一些抛光石头方块，但是那些玩意根本毫无用处！

en:
You defeated a fearsome Hollow Cyclops at the bottom of the Revelwood Hollow Halls. 

Take its head and use it to craft an Ectoplasm Press. Place it to unlock better crafting options.
cn:
你打败了喧嚣森林空荡礼堂深处的可怕空荡独眼巨人。

拿走它的头颅并制造了一个灵质精炼机。放置炖锅以解锁更高级的制作配方。

en: Target switching has been improved to better handle vertical and horizontal combat. A new two-axis cycling mode allows you to switch targets in all directions, making it easier to select airborne or elevated enemies. This is now the default for controller, while mouse and keyboard retain the original one-dimensional behavior.
cn: 我们改进了目标切换机制以更好地应对垂直与水平方向的战斗。全新的双轴切换模式将允许你切换所有方向的目标，这将允许你更方便地选择空中或高处的敌人。现在手柄将默认使用这种模式的目标切换，键鼠将保留原本的一维切换逻辑。

en: A percentage of received Melee Damage is dealt back to attackers
cn: 将承受的一定比例的近战伤害返还给攻击者。

en: The grilled meat of a legendary fish. Try closing your eyes as you savor its flavor — you'll be able to envision the taste of the vast, blue sea.
cn: 一条传奇鱼做成的烤肉。品尝滋味的时候可以试着闭上眼睛 - 你将能够想象出一望无垠的碧海的味道。

en: Wood of extremely high quality that was manufactured with an eye for detail.
cn: 品质与做工无可挑剔的木材。

en: Some treasures of the old world will be lost in rubble and ash unless we uncover them!
cn: 如果不尽可能找回旧世界的宝藏，它们将注定消失在废墟与灰烬之中！

en: The natural resource needed to create Iron Bars, an important material for every adventurer on the way to the top.
cn: 用于制作铁锭的天然资源，天底下每一位冒险者都不可或缺的重要材料。

en: Two-Handed weapon damage is increased by 20%.

A little feeding bowl for your Cat.

It will feed your animals when filled with the corresponding food.
cn:
为猫咪准备的喂食碗。

装满对应的食物后将喂食你的动物。

en: Increases the skill level of Titan Edge
cn: 提高泰坦之刃的技能等级

en: Beautifully tender, juicy meat. It fills the belly and warms the soul by providing better frost resistance!
cn: 有着美丽纹路的多汁嫩肉。除了提供饱腹感，温暖人心之外，还提供更好的寒冷抗性！

en: You're a good shot, Flameborn, but are you coldblooded? Does your pulse slow before the kill? I know an enemy camp that might be your match. Go on. Snuff them out.
cn: 你的眼神很敏锐，火之子，但你能否在危险面前保持冷静？你能否沉住气捕获自己的猎物？我知道有一座敌人的营地也许能够让你大显身手。去吧，去寻找你的猎物。

en: It hugs your finger like an icy embrace and lets you become one with the cold. It imbues the wearer with increased frost resistance.
cn: 这枚戒指就像是献给你的手指的冰冷拥抱，你将与寒冷融为一体。提高佩戴者的寒冷抗性。

en:
You've found a note that detailed the curious case of repeated lightning strikes in a nearby Drak'Dal camp. 

Find the encampment and investigate it!
cn:
你找到的纸条上提到了一件有趣的事：似乎附近的一个卓克·达尔营地曾反复被闪电劈中。

找到并调查字条中的营地！

en: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.
cn: 口感酥脆的美味烤鱼。提高生命值与潜水时间。

en:
A strange cluster of sea urchins with varying sizes and shapes. Most of these were harmless ocean dwellers — but some carried fatal venom, so it's best to avoid being stung.

This collectible is found in the Springlands.
cn:
一群大小不一、形状各异的奇怪海胆。其中大部分是无害的海洋生物--但有些带有致命毒液，因此最好避免被蜇伤。

此收藏品在 春日平原 中找到。

en: Sturdy boots for gathering wood. They're lined with fur, ideal for the summits.
cn: 伐木工穿的牢固靴子。因为内衬有皮草而十分暖和，是攀登高山时的绝佳选择。

en: You can fashion a beautifully detailed, dark roof with this granite roof block.
cn: 你可以使用这种花岗岩屋顶方块来制作精美的深色屋顶。

en: There are only a few ways to flee a promise you don't intend to keep. At least one of them involves murder. Finesse: The damage caused by this weapon scales with your dexterity attribute. You can execute a unique post-parry attack.
cn: 背叛誓言的方法并不多。而且大多都会涉及谋杀。 灵巧： 该武器造成的伤害与你的敏捷属性挂钩。成功招架后，你可以发动独特的攻击。

en: We can improve your favorite weapons with some Enhancements and put all that gear you've been collecting to good use. See? I'm good for something around here!
cn: 你可以使用强化强化自己钟爱的武器，这样你收集的那些装备就能够发挥出真正的力量了。看见没，我还是知道点有用的事情的！

en: Fires a projectile that deals Shroud damage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.
cn: 发射一枚射弹，造成 瘴气伤害。 虚空复制： 魔棒的独特魔法使其有30%的几率制造出额外的射弹。 过度充能： 该魔杖有几率放大其伤害输出。攻击能造成最多与过度充能百分比一致的额外伤害。

en: My research has led me to a bold new theory: The Ancients once had an affinity for "gems", and used them for "augmentation". Perhaps Flameborn aren't fit for being augmented — but your weapons could be! If we found an Ancient Gem Forge — I have an inkling of where to look, don't worry — and perhaps a "conductor" or energy source... Then we could claim the gem power for ourselves!
cn: 我在研究期间中发现了一条激动人心的新理论：远古者与宝石之间曾有着特殊的联系，他们曾利用“宝石”来进行各类“强化”。虽然火之子本身并不适合被强化，但你的武器可以！假如我们能够找到一处远古者的宝石锻炉……不用担心，我有可能已经知道哪里能找到这东西……还有一个“导体”或者是某种能量源……那样的话，我们就可以将宝石的力量占为己有了！

en: Scales the amount of Runes required for upgrading weapons.
cn: 调整升级武器需要的符文数量。

en: These paper reed fibers can be used in many crafting recipes just like other plant fibers.
cn: 和其他植物纤维一样，这些纸莎草纤维同样也可以被用于各式各样的制作配方。

en:
A severed Hydrak'Dal Head with a regal headdress. Even now, it still exudes authority and a will to dominate.

Collect multiple Hydrak'Dal Heads to craft the Trophy.
cn:
佩戴着高贵头饰的海卓克·达尔首级。就算是在死后，它仍然散发着威严与野心。

收集多个海卓克·达尔头颅以制作战利品。
闪电不会击中同一个位置两次

en:
A ring with glowing blue engravings that read: 

"May the Shroud never tear you down — Balthazar"
cn:
一枚闪烁着蓝色光芒的戒指，上面有一段铭文：

“愿你永远不会屈服于瘴气 — 巴尔萨扎”

en: Thank you for granting me access to your spare basement, Henry. I won't write in peace with these guards on my tail, but I can't let them silence me! I know this room was Finnean's, so I'll take good care of it. He was such a sweet kid... and the little stories he wrote were magical. Nothing I could pen would lighten your heart, but there's one thing I can do. Even though editors don't earn much coin, I know how to repay you: Your last goodbyes don't have to be final. The old sorcerer in the Imperial Gardens owes me, and perhaps he can reunite you. Don't ask too many questions, just let him lead you to his secret attic, and never speak of it to anyone else. Just promise me you'll be responsible and come back. It's a deal with the dark that we're striking! — Ramone Jones
cn: 谢谢你把空的地下室让给我用，亨利。现在那些守卫对我穷追不舍，我根本没办法安心写作，但是我绝不会停止发声！ 我知道这个房间以前是芬尼安的，所以我会好好打理这里。他是个好孩子……而且我觉得他之前写的那些小故事真的很有想象力。 我知道不管自己写什么都没办法真的安慰到你，但我知道有一件事是我能做的。哪怕编辑的薪水谈不上丰厚，但我知道如何才能报答你：你们最后的告别也许并不是永别。 帝国园林里的一个老术士欠我一份人情，也许他可以让你们两个重聚。到时候见面了不要多问，直接让他带你去秘密阁楼，记住千万别跟任何人提这件事。 答应我你不会乱来，一定要好好的回来。你要明白这可是在跟黑暗的力量做交易！ — 雷蒙·琼斯

en:
Aster, you wimp! If you really want to prove yourself to Myrtle, invite her out to the edge of the farm — where those odd rock formations can be found. Then try to cross them, leaping from rock to rock. See how brave she thinks you are once you reach the other side! Yes, I think this will endear her to you for the rest of time, my friend!

— Jax
cn:
阿斯特，不要再这么软弱！如果你真的想向莫桃尔证明自己，那就邀请她去农场边上吧，那里有一片造型怪异的石阵。想办法踩在石头上跳到对面去。到时候她一定就能明白你有多么勇敢了！我认为这么做一定能帮你打动她的心，我的朋友！

— 贾克斯

en: The Flame revealed the location of a powerful eternal spell buried nearby. Once acquired, the spell can be cast indefinitely without being consumed as ammunition. The location is marked on your map.
cn: 灵火揭示了埋藏在附近的强大永恒法术的位置。一旦获得，该法术就可以在不消耗弹药的情况下无限施放。 该位置已标注在地图上。

en: The brown trousers possess a reinforced and padded knee area, visible through the applied scale pattern.
cn: 可以从缝制的鳞片图案看出来，下方的褐色裤腿的膝盖区域有加厚护垫。

en: You have reached the Miner's House. Now you can search for scriptures or other items of inspiration.
cn: 你已经抵达矿工之家。现在你可以寻找经文或者是其他能够带来灵感的物品。

en:
A simple bandage.

This item provides healing if applied to a wound.
cn:
简单的绷带。

施加在伤口上之后，该物品能够提供治疗效果。

en: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!
cn: 这把强劲的弓每次射击时都会从两个毒蛇的血盆大口中射出箭矢。你的箭矢将会像蓄势待发的毒蛇一样冲向猎物！

en:
The courier Kaori Conway has tasked you to find a new set of cosmetic clothing. She said that many abandoned outposts still store similar wares.

Follow the marker on your map and search for one such outpost!
cn:
邮差嘉里·康威希望你能够寻找一套全新的外观服饰。她说有很多废弃哨所里面仍然能够找到类似的货物。

跟随地图上的标记并寻找存放着衣服的哨所！

en: The design of these boots imitates the skin of wyverns. Their scales were rumored to have the exceptional ability to absorb magical energy from all around!
cn: 这双靴子的设计模仿了飞龙的皮肤。据传，它们的鳞片具有从环境中吸收魔法能量的特殊能力！

en: This ginger tea tastes like the paragon of good health.
cn: 喝一口下去感觉整个人都立马变得健康了起来。

en: You've vanquished the Shroud Root and cleared the Elixir Well, but there's plenty more work to be done! Let's see if you'll become the hero we've been waiting for!
cn: 你已经铲除瘴气根并净化魔药之井，但接下来还有很多要做的！愿你能够成为我们苦苦等待的那位英雄！

en:
There are a few music sheets scattered in the Albaneve Summits! Due to a traveling bard, multiple music sheets should be placed along a route leading into the mountains from the Nomad Highlands. 

Explore the area marked on your map and find the first music sheet!
cn:
阿尔班耶夫山脉中散落着不少乐谱！跟随一位吟游诗人的脚步，从游牧高地通往山间的道路上应该能够找到多份乐谱。

探索地图上标记的区域并找到第一份乐谱！

en: The Blacksmith says scaling the Ancient Spire will reveal more of the Springlands. The one he mentioned isn't too far from here.
cn: 据铁匠说，爬上远古尖塔就能获取有关春日平原的更多信息。他提到的那个就在不远处。

en: When you are surrounded by three or more enemies, a random enemy is pushed back every 3 seconds.
cn: 被至少三名敌人包围时，每隔3秒击退一名随机敌人。

en:
This month, we've lost more ships at sea than we ever did throughout my entire life.

I blame myself, though I know I've always upheld my duty. Every night, I light our fire to signal the safety of our harbor... I stay up, watching the pyre, stoking the flames, choking the smoke to leave only a bright merigold light... but it is not enough, and I'm losing sleep. 

Nightmares rip me from bed, force me to find my binoculars and nightgown, and make me stumble to the platform above amid darkness and rain. I thought, if I stared out long enough, I would see it. See what's causing this. Understand it. Beat it.

The storm clouds are drawing closer, and they're hiding something from me.
cn:
这个月发生的海难事故比我这辈子加起来的还要多。

虽然我怪自己没有尽责，但其实在内心深处，我知道我从来没有懈怠过。每一天晚上，我都会点燃篝火将船只引到我们安全的港口……晚上我会盯着火堆拨动柴火，确保烟雾不会挡住金盏花一样的明亮火光……但就算是这样也不够，而且我开始因此而失眠。

我经常会从噩梦中惊醒，这时候我会不由自主地披上睡衣并拿起望远镜，接着跌跌撞撞地在黑夜的大雨中走上观测平台。我在想，只要我观察的时间足够久，我一定能够看见它。看见引发这一系列事故的元凶。然后理解它并打败它。

风暴逐渐逼近，我觉得它们在隐藏着什么东西。

en: Planks created by cutting Wood Logs into shape. Very useful for building.
cn: 通过将圆木切割成形得到的板材。在建筑方面有很多用途。

en: There are more pumpkin farms around. Visit the next location to retrieve a large carved pumpkin!
cn: 还有更多未被找到的南瓜农场。拜访下一个地点并取回大型雕刻南瓜！

en: This Axe is destined to smite down creatures of the wild.

We were supposed to welcome the messenger two nights ago, but he's not arrived yet. 
Are we still taking bets on the decree he's got for us? I'm guessing it's instructions on punishing delinquents. Perhaps the exact measurements of what diameter the sharpened sticks used for prodding prisoners ought to have.

Well, we might never find out. I've got this feeling that the harsh winds of the summits were too much for what I imagine to be a scrawny little courier. Maybe the lads from the Veilwater Basin just don't have it in them. They're way too captured by Lord Vorgoth, that ol' lunatic, to prepare for any danger or hardship beyond the "Ancient Enemy"...

Keep that between us, alright? If the overseers read this, they'll put my head on a spike. A perfectly measured, evenly sharpened one at that!
cn:
按照原本的计划，我们两天前就应该迎接信使，但是他到现在还迟迟未来。
所以之前关于他带来的敕令内容的赌注还算数吗？我觉得是惩戒违规人员的指示。比如说要使用的刑具规格之类的内容。

但无论如何，也许这个赌注永远不会有结果了。我有一种预感，说不定那个软弱矮小的邮差根本无法应付山巅的凛冽寒风。也许那些幕水盆地来的家伙们就是不够格。他们已经被沃格斯那个老疯子哄得神魂颠倒，满脑子就只有“远古之敌”，他们根本不明白要在这里面对什么危险与艰辛……

信上的话千万别告诉其他人，明白了吗？要是被主管们看见我就死定了。而且他们肯定会遵照敕令里的内容准备刑具的！

en: This species constantly regenerates its outer shell, allowing for the collection of scales.
cn: 这个品种的外壳会持续再生，因此能够定期收集鳞片。

en: Increases the skill level of Healer
cn: 提高治疗师的技能等级

en: They broke through Rimgard's soldiers have arrived! They've ravaged it all, torn our brittle walls apart The gate's been lowered — Gormander's locked us out; has sold Meldore's valor one final time We cannot run. Rats in a cage Their fists clash against the iron — I lower my hands. Fold my palms and pray. Dear Ancients. Please, anyone. Open the gates!
cn: 他们冲进来了 里姆加德的士兵来了！ 他们摧毁了一切，脆弱的城墙已经变得千疮百孔 城门也被关上了，戈曼德把我们关在了外面，他再一次背叛了梅尔多尔的勇气 现在就是瓮中捉鳖 其他人都在用拳头敲打着铁门，但是我选择了垂下双手，我合上双手祈祷着。远古者在上。拜托了，随便什么人都行。帮我们把门打开！

en: Now, your time has come. Awake!
cn: 现在，你的时代已经到来。醒来吧！

en: Flameborn, these darkened waters dull my fire. My rays of light cannot reach across the shore, cannot rise and fall with the melody of the waves. You must transform the Basin's Spire into a lighthouse, set off a vibrant spark to alight these sunless seas.
cn: 火之子，这些阴暗的水域让我的火焰变得黯淡。我的火光无法穿透海岸，无法随海浪的旋律一起潮起潮落。你必须将盆地的高塔转变为一座灯塔，让耀眼的火焰照亮这片无光之海。

en:
It's a truly inspired concoction, and vastly superior to all other currently known Health Potions.

Instantly restores a supreme amount of health.
cn:
非同寻常的混合物，效果远超目前已知的其他生命药水。

立刻恢复巨量生命值。
为理发师展示一些寒冰

en:
If these brittle flakes are not handled carefully, they can fall apart and stick to everything, especially clothes.

Commonly found in the Shroud of the Kindlewastes biome.

It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.
cn:
这些脆弱的薄片一不小心就会被捏碎，之后随风飘散的粉末会沾得到处都是，尤其是衣服最为遭殃。

常见于燃火荒原的瘴气中。

虽然无法单拿来使用，但是能够加工为多种制作材料。

en: Set a password or remove password protection.
cn: 设置密码或取消密码保护。
